Before either of them could say anything else though, Alex quickly said,
"We'll both like a balloon please!" Recovering slightly, the mascot replied as they tried to salvage the situation,
"Of course! Here you go!" The mascot then handed Alex the strings to two balloons, one of which he gave to Sun so they both had one before they resumed their trip to the event going on at the colosseum.
The moment they left the mascot behind though, Alex's fingers shimmered slightly with magic right as the mascot suddenly let a cute and girlish yelp, both of her hands going to her rear after feeling something pinch it. The rest of the balloons that they were supposed to give now forgotten as they quickly rose up over the crowds, the mascot looked around for whatever it was that pinched her until an angry voice cried out,
"What do you think you're doing?! Those balloons were supposed to help promote the concert!" Seeing an angry looking man approach her, the mascot quickly turned around and fled the other direction, hoping to use the crowds to lose the man who thought he was her boss.
"How much longer do I need to wear this disguise...?" She muttered to herself dejectedly, the mascot's large head hanging down as she lamented her current situation.
...
Alex and Sun meanwhile had finally reached the base of the colosseum as everyone flooded inside, talking excitedly about how eager they were to see the High Summoner's concert. Overhearing several people mentioning them, Sun asked Alex,
"What's this 'High Summoner'?" Making sure no one was going to ask them for tickets or anything, Alex explained to her,
"For nearly a thousand years Spira was plagued by a powerful being known as 'Sin', which was considered impossible to truly defeat. Instead people known as Summoners would make a pilgrimage to perform a ritual known as the 'Final Summons', which was considered the only thing capable of defeating Sin at the cost of the Summoner's own life. It was never a true victory though, as Sin always returned after a few years, but those times that they wouldn't have to worry about being attacked were known as the 'Calm', while those who successfully managed the summons were known as High Summoners."
Sun looked confused at Alex's explanation as she asked,
"But how's this High Summoner performing a concert if they die while defeating this Sin?" Alex smirked knowingly as he replied while leading Sun to their seats,
"This particular High Summoner defied the tradition when she learned about it, and searched for an alternative way that led to her and her companions defeating Sin for good, giving the people of Spira an Eternal Calm. That's the reason why the people here can do fun things like this now."
Though Sun wanted to ask more, she didn't get the chance as the lights around them suddenly dimmed, and the thousands of people also watching the concert began to cheer deafeningly. In the center of the colosseum, which was completely surrounded by stands for people to sit in, a circular platform began to rise up while numerous Machina floated around them to shine spotlights on them.
The audience was then mostly silenced as more Machina started to fly around over them, except these were small floating platforms that held guitarists who began to cut loose on their instruments. Meanwhile by this point the platform in the center had risen enough that they could see the main support under it, a large metallic Machina that looked like a man as it twirled a set of large drumsticks while the actual drums spun around it.
By this point they could all see a solitary woman standing still in the center of the man platform as a countdown sound. She wore a long purple skirt with a sleeveless white top that had a golden band wrapped around her abdomen, and a pair of separate sleeves hanging on her arms. She had short cut brown hair that only went down to her chin, while a solitary long braid draped down until it was almost touching the ground.
A second later the spotlights focused on her as the audience gave one last roaring cheer before the background music began.
"What can I do for you?"
(A.N. Here's a link for the opening on YouTube if anyone wanted to watch it.

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - 421: Y.R.P.
chapters.content:
"What can I do for you?"
The moment the background lyrics started the girl in the middle of the stage looked up, and opened her heterochromia eyes as she began to strut forward confidently while her outfit began to shimmer. Under the watchful gaze of the crowds her skirt began to unravel like ribbons as the rest of her outfit began to glow, before 'shattering' to reveal an entirely new outfit that was a short black skirt with a flowing purple attachment on the left side, a matching bikini style top with white ruffles on the edges, and detached purple sleeves on both arms.
Her transformation complete, the woman then began to sing and dance with the song while two backup dancers appeared out of thin air behind her. Everyone in the colosseum went nuts as the woman, High Summoner Yuna, performed her heart out for her adoring audience.
While even Sun was enjoying the performance, Alex turned his attention elsewhere through his 'Domain' as if he was looking for something. Or someone.
***
"Y, R, P, in position. It's showtime girls." A young woman said into the mic attached to her bikini strap as the edges of her lips curled up into a smirk, before moving on down the hall from the guard she'd just knocked out.
With her partner having gone to a different area ahead of her, the girl made her way to a balcony overlooking the performance before taking out a pair of binoculars to watch Yuna, completely unaware of the muscular man with spiked up hair below her who glanced up, and accidentally ended up getting a perfectly good look up her skirt.
She was dressed in a tight brown leather skirt that had a belt with numerous pouches around it, short enough that it just barely managed to cover her ass, a yellow bikini top, separate sleeves with ribbons tied into them, and a red and yellow scarf that went down past her knees. Her long yellow hair was tied up into place with blue bandana, and had numerous braids and beads tied into it while her eyes were an emerald green with spiral shaped pupils, identifying her as an Al Behd. And as the man below her saw firsthand, she had a tiny g-string bikini bottom with straps that came up high on her hips, and did almost nothing to conceal the important spots beneath her skirt.
The girl, Rikku, was subtly dancing in place as she scoped out the colosseum, until something tapped her on the shoulder and someone said in a gruff voice,
"Hey." Rikku turned to look at the speaker only to see one of the coliseums guards standing there looking at her angrily, to which she only chuckled nervously before trying to give him a disarmingly cute smile.
"Hiya!" She suddenly cried out as she delivered a series of powerful, but nonlethal, punches and kicks to him, knocking the guard unconscious before she returned to her observations.
Meanwhile, a little ways away from her position, another girl dressed in short skintight black leather shorts that were strapped to similarly black leather leggings, a black leather band that covered her breasts while smaller leather straps wound up and down her body, matching gloves that came up to her elbows, and a pendant hanging around her neck by barbed wire. She had short cut silver hair that was swept back at the sides while the top was swept up, and ruby red eyes.
The girl, Paine, was making her way down one of the aisle stairs when a couple of guards called out to her. Without hesitating in the slightest, Paine reacted as the guards attacked her and knocked them unconscious, before sitting back on the railing behind her and sliding down it coolly with one leg crossed over the other.
When she stopped at the bottom Paine was joined by Rikku, who had high-jacked one of the flying platforms that the guitarists were using around them. Hopping onto it alongside Rikku, the duo then took to the skies as they approached Yuna on stage. By the time they arrived though she was just finishing up her song, and was about to start another when they jumped onto the stage with her.
"Hey! Give it back already!" Rikku told the person in front of her as she brought out matching red knives, 'Yuna' however sneered in a voice that didn't match her appearance,
"Hmph! Boys!" At her command the two backup dancers jumped forward to stand between Rikku and Paine, and their quarry. Their appearances shimmered for a moment before they changed to a couple of goons wearing green jumpsuits with heart shaped insignias and veils that covered their entire face, while three bladed claws protruded from the top of their gloved hands.
"You want in on this number? Then show me your moves!" 'Yuna' told them as she and the two goons prepared for combat. Paine however responded by producing her own sword as she and Rikku got into their respective stances, and asked tauntingly,
"Think you can keep up?" With that as their trigger, the duo moved with perfect coordination as Paine commanded their attention with her large sword, while Rikku used her knives and agility to get in close.
"Don't mind if I do!" Rikku proclaimed with glee as she swiftly and expertly relieved their opponents of anything valuable on their bodies, while Paine had their full attention with her longer weapon and sweeping attacks.
*TING!*
The sound of metal hitting metal echoed as Paine effortlessly cut through the blades on one goon's hand, before delivering a slash to his abdomen that, while not fatal, was enough to take him out of the fight for a while. Despite seeing the short work she made on his partner, the other goon quickly leapt into deal with them, only for Paine to disable him just as easily as she did the other.
"I could've danced all night." Paine remarked as she prepared to face 'Yuna', who only smirked before saying into the mic in her hand,
"Sorry, no time for an encore!" She then turned and fled from the stage while snapping her fingers, calling forth half a dozen more opponents for the girls to face. This time, while two of them were same type of goon that they had just defeated, two more were goons wearing skintight pink jumpsuits to show off their more feminine figures, and were armed with bladed heart-shaped fans instead of clawed gloves. The other two were actually two snakelike fiends, but, instead of the usual snake heads and bodies, their heads were actually rotating mini-guns while their bodies were slithering and winding belts of ammunition.
With neither of them faltering in front of the amount of opponents they had to face, Paine raised her sword to defend herself with its blade while Rikku took cover behind her. As they charge the vipers raised their revolving heads to look directly at them, and let loose with a storm of bullets while the female goons behind them prepared to cast a spell.
With each bullet bouncing harmlessly off of her sword Paine continued her charge without concern until she was right in front of the party of goons, only to suddenly leap over the entire group and land on the other side.
"Stop her!" One of the female goons cried out, realizing that Paine and Rikku didn't intend to let them slow them down. However Rikku, who they realized none of them had seen due to their focus being on Paine, held up her hands to show what was in them.
In one was all of their wallets and purses, containing their savings. While in the other, before any of them had the time to get mad, was the pulled pins of several grenades that every goon kept on themselves. Rikku them pointed downwards with a mischievous smile, prompting all of the goons to actually look down, and a see all of their grenades at their feet.
"Ah crud..." One muttered, right as they all blew up.
Ignoring them though, Rikku and Paine quickly made their way out of the stadium as they pursued their quarry. At that same time, the very same man who had accidentally gotten a lookup Rikku's skirt earlier stood up, and said to the petite girl as his side,
"Time to go."
On the docks directly outside the colosseum, Rikku and Paine spotted their target right as she rounded a corner, while several more goons were running the other direction directly at them.
"Ugh! How many of these guys does she have!" Rikku complained as she and Paine prepared to fight once again, using the same tactic they used inside. With Paine commanding all of their attention as she delivered fast and powerful attacks, Rikku used the chance to relieve them of any valuables even as they pursued the goon's boss.
Even then it wasn't enough though after having to deal with several waves of goons, and they lost the person they were after.
"Hey, you run too fast!" Rikku cried out in frustration as she and Paine looked around for any sign of her.
"You're too slow little girl." A new voice said from behind. Rikku and Paine spun around to see a tall man wearing a blue outfit with the same heart insignia on it approaching them, his narrowed and angular eyes glaring at them with contempt while he wielded a long revolver in each hand.
As he stopped just short of them, seemingly to box them in, another new voice roared from the other direction,
"Shows over! BWAHAHAHAHAHA!" This time it was a shorter man who looked fat, wearing the same outfit as the taller man except that he had an overly large shield strapped to his back.
"Yeowch.." Rikku said when she saw the man, before Paine called out to her,
"Rikku, this way!" Quickly the duo fled down to the end of the dock they were on, where the two men boxed them in from the way they came, but now they were both directly in front instead of being on either side.
Just as the fight was about to break out though, a series of gunshots rang out as the bullets impacted the ground at the two goon's feet, making them jump up and down and dance funnily to avoid the bullets. Once the gunfire ended though they both turned to see a certain someone standing behind them with a pistol in each hand, Yuna.
Unlike the Yuna from the concert though she wasn't wearing a purple top and short black skirt, but a white tank top that was open in the front to show a bit of her inner boob and stomach with a pink hood attached, a pair of extremely short jean shorts, and half of the same skirt that 'she' had been wearing before the concert started on the left side.
With quite a bit of frustration showing on her face, Yuna quickly ran up to the two men and used the shield on the shorter one as a springboard, launching herself up and over them as she slowly spun in air, and rained more bullets down onto them from above. She then landed with a pose directly in front of Rikku and Paine, who immediately posed behind her as they prepared to fight.
"Where's the imposter!?" Yuna demanded as she readied her guns, while the two men, Ormi and Logos, ignored her and instead leapt into combat.
The fat man, Ormi, raised his shield as he began to charge directly at Yuna, who was forced to leap out of the way even as she began to have a shootout with the taller man, Logos. While his attention was on Yuna, Rikku then charged at Logos while readying her red knives, forcing him to use one of his revolvers to try and deal with her while also holding off Yuna.
Meanwhile Paine tried to take the attention of Ormi off of Yuna by charging him, earning herself a powerful bash with his shield that thoroughly rung her bell, even though she defended herself with her sword. Just as he raised the shield up to use it's edge as a weapon to chop her with though, Paine quickly slid underneath and slashed at him with her sword, dealing just enough damage that he fell to one knee.
Logos meanwhile was doing his best to hold off Rikku and Yuna, but was quickly losing ground as Yuna drove him back with his one revolver against her two pistols, while Rikku easily wove between the shots of his other revolver. Quickly enough she got close enough that she not only took him out with her knives, she also liberated his wallet and any other values from him at the same time.
With the duo being beaten back by the trio, Ormi began to sniffle as he cried out,
"B-boss!"
"That's quite enough sniveling boys." A colder voice responder, prompting Yuna and the others to get back into position once more. They then watched as another Yuna approached them, who Ormi and Logos quickly fled behind as she prepared to face the three girls herself.
"Persistent, aren't you?"she remarked snarkily, to which Yuna held out her hand and replied angrily,
"My grid." Beside her Rikku nodded and demanded,
"You give us back Yunie's Garment Grid right now!" The Yuna imposter however shook her head and asked with a shrug of her shoulders,
"Didn't you girls ever learn to share?"
"Give it back." Yuna snarled with a tone and voice that one wouldn't usually imagine her using. To which the imposter replied,
"Very well, it's yours." She then tossed the item in question up in the air, which Yuna quickly grabbed while the imposter's form began to change.
Holding a large fan in front of her face to cover it, the imposter began to grown taller and older. Her outfit consisted of an open pink robe that left much of her chest and stomach exposed, revealing the heart shaped tattoo right between her breasts, as well as her right thigh. When she removed the fan she revealed a more mature face with purple eyes, and short blonde hair.
She then said in a haughty tone,
"But it won't be yours for long loves!" The woman and the trio then prepared to fight, each one taking their respective stances until another new voice called out,
"That won't be necessary!" Surprised, they all turned towards the speaker, and saw a muscular man with spiked up black hair approaching them, a petite girl with long dark blue hair at his side. While everyone else looked confused at their appearance, Yuna however exclaimed,
"You!?" This earned her numerous curious looks, while even the two newcomers even looked at her curiously as the man asked,
"Have we met before?" Yuna quickly realized that of course they would recognize her due to the disguise she had been wearing at the time, and, not wanting to admit that she had been the one who confused the woman at his side for a 'little girl', she quickly said,
"Nope, not at all! My mistake!" Though everyone else continued to look at her curiously, Yuna thought she noticed a bit of a sparkle in the man's eyes, as if he knew exactly who she was, and not just from her being the High Summoner. Instead of saying anything though, the man instead looked back at the woman they had just been about to fight, and said,
"Why don't we leave it here for today?" The woman however glared at him angrily and said,
"How about no? You may be good looking handsome, but I want that sphere, and the Mighty Leblanc ALWAYS gets what she wants!" The woman, Leblanc, then prepared to attack Yuna and her companions once more, but stopped as the man's voice rang out,
"Hey, I get it. I really do." Leblanc turned towards him suspiciously, and asked,
"You do?" The man nodded in a way that made it seem like he was full of understanding, but what he said next stunned everyone.
"Yeah, I do. I mean, if I looked as old and wrinkly as you do then I'd want to look as beautiful as her as well." While Yuna's cheeks reddened from the sudden compliment, and Rikku giggled, Ormi and Logos looked as if death itself had arrived.
"What. Did. You. Just. Say?" Leblanc asked slowly and in a low tone, to which the man replied,
"I said you looked old and wrinkly. You may use a ton of makeup to cover it, but I can still see the wrinkles even from here." Leblanc's entire body began to shudder with fury and humiliation, even as she fought the urge to dig out a mirror to see if he was correct, while Ormi and Logos quickly tried to comfort her.
"H-he's just an idiot boss! He has no idea what he's talking about!"
R-right! Boss has always been, and will always be the most beautiful woman!" No matter what they said though, Leblanc's fury wasn't abating as she roared,
"BRING ME HIS HEAD!" Instantly over a hundred goons and gun viper fiends appeared and rushed towards the man to take his head, to which Yuna cried out,
"We have to help him!" With Rikku and Paine both nodding in agreement, they were about to charge over to help him when the girl who had arrived with him appeared in front of them and said,
"It's alright, Alex has this under control." Though they wanted to ask what she meant, none of them got the chance as Yuna suddenly felt something like a pulse come from the man, Alex. The next thing she and the others knew, all of the goons and fiends suddenly fell to the ground, foam appearing from their mouths under their veils as the man slowly approached Leblanc and the other two.
While they both tried to take defensive stances between him and their beloved Boss, both Ormi and Logos also started foaming from the mouth as they too passed out, leaving just Alex and Leblanc staring at each other.
"What are you?" Leblanc asked, as, regardless of how furious she was, it was painfully obvious that Alex was in a completely different league from her. Smirking, he replied,
"That's for later, now it's time you to go to sleep as well." Though she wanted to argue, and try to at least get one hit in, Leblanc was unable to even do that much as Alex produced a large club out of nowhere, and hit Leblanc over the head with it, knocking her out as well instantly.
Nodding in satisfaction, Alex remarked to himself,
"This works quite nicely for when I don't want to actually kill someone." After putting Sir Bonkers away, Alex turned to look at Yuna and the others before saying,
"There's quite a bit I wanted to talk to you all about, but I think we should change locations first." Nodding in agreement, Yuna said something into her own communicator before a giant red airship approached them from the sky with great roar.

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - 422: The Gullwings
chapters.content:
As the roar of the engines became louder, Alex looked up to see what could only be described as a very 'unique' airship.
Looking like some sort of hot rod, the airship was bright red with numerous blue flame-like decals decorating it. The front two thrusters looked like the wheels and engines from a motorcycle with two similar wheels in the back that were more angled on their side, while numerous exhaust pipes put out a constant stream of flames in the back.
As it closed in on them Sun watched the airships approach with undisguised awe, while Rikku made a trumpeting noise before declaring,
"Introooooooducing the home, headquarters, and transportation of the super awesome sphere hunter group, the Gullwings. THE CELSIUS!" As if to punctuate her declaration, the Celsius then crashed down into the surf next to the dock they were on, sending up a giant wave of water splashed over all of them.
"KYAAAAA!"
"WAHOOOOOO!"
Yuna and Rikku both cried out in different ways to the sudden rush of water, while Paine appeared indifferent to suddenly getting soaked and Sun simply enjoyed the feeling of the seawater on her skin due to her disposition as a siren. Alex meanwhile, after shaking out the seawater from his hair and red fur, had his eye drawn to something else aside from the eye-catching Celsius entirely.
After being splashed with water Sun's sundress was clinging to her body perfectly, outlining the faint curves of her petite figure, while the dark circles of her nipples also showed through the thin fabric. It wasn't just Sun though, who had eventually gotten used to being seen by Alex after bathing together so much.
Despite the fact that she supposed to be the 'pure' and 'innocent' one of the group, Alex could also perfectly make out Yuna's breasts through her now see-through white top. And when she also tried to wring out the half-skirt hanging from her waist with her back turned towards him, Alex concluded there was nothing 'innocent' about that ass in such tight and short shorts. Especially as they began to wedge into her ass and crotch.
And while neither one were similarly see-through, Rikku's nipples were definitely distinctive through her yellow bikini top, while Paine's black leather shorts also began wedge into her ass and crotch like Yuna's were. In all, Alex felt exceptionally thankful to be able to witness such a sight.
Of course Alex quickly adjusted his focus elsewhere when one of the girls looked his way, as ogling them when they were in such a compromising position probably wouldn't make the best first impression. Instead he placed his focus on the still unconscious goons and machine-gun vipers, before realization hit him.
With a wave of his hand, Alex swept all of the machine-gun vipers into a sub-space to give to Lucy later, while Sun used her magic to finally fix her and the other's compromising looks. Pretending to be none the wiser once everyone was again dry and proper, Alex finally joined them and introduced himself,
"It's a bit late, but I am Alexander Morningstar, and this is Sun Otonashi. You all can just call me Alex though" With Sun also properly greeting the trio of girls as they waited for the Celsius to settle, Yuna said in a proper tone,
"It's nice to meet you Alex and Sun. My name is Yuna." The words were barely out of her mouth before the ever energetic Rikku practically shouted,
"And I'm Rikku!" After Rikku introduced herself everyone looked towards the final person, who just glanced up at them and uttered,
"Paine."
With the first round of introductions out of the way, Yuna turned towards the Celsius and said into her communicator,
"Yuna here, coming aboard with some visitors Brother!" Immediately an energetic voice boomed out of the speakers on the Celsius' exterior,
"ROGEEEEEER!" Then immediately after the voice began to singing,
"Yuna is coming~! Yuna is coming~! Yuna is coming ~! YAY YAY YAY-"
"The mike is still on Brother!" A new voice suddenly cut him off, before the feed from the interior of the airship suddenly went dark completely. Outside though Rikku started shaking her head while Paine groaned, and Yuna giggled at the situation. Rikku then turned back towards Alex and Sun before saying,
"That, unfortunately, was our captain, my brother, Brother." Though Alex knew about Brother and didn't find anything Rikku just told them strange, Sun couldn't help but to ask,
"His name is 'Brother'?" Rikku nodded and said,
"Yep it is. Why?" While Rikku was curious about Sun's interest in her brother's name, Alex quickly said,
"It's just a rather unusual name where we come from." Hearing this Rikku nodded quickly in understanding, before she realized something.
"Are you somewhere aside from Spira?" Immediately both Paine and Yuna looked up at this, as the only place that could be considered 'outside' of Spira was the Bikanel island. The island however was entirely desert, and it was the home of the Al Bhed, which Alex and Sun obviously weren't.
With Alex and Sun simply nodding slowly to Rikku's question, more and more questions began forming in their heads regarding their sudden new acquaintances. Instead of immediately asking them though, the three girls led the way onto the airship as Alex and Sun followed, deciding to ask them once they were properly inside.
Of course the interior of the Celsius was just as outrageous at the outside, with glowing rainbow light strips and other similar decorations everywhere within. Seeing it, Alex was immediately reminded of the fads from the 90s and early 2000s.
As the automatic door to the Bridge opened though, Alex's attention was automatically on three guys lined up before him.
On the left was a dark skinned man with buzzed short blonde hair, goggles covering his eyes, and a sleeveless purple shirt with blue pants. On the right was undoubtedly a kid based on their stature, but nothing else could be gleaned about them due to the full body suit and mask that prevented any of his bodily features from being seen.
Then in the center was the most noticeable of the three, a man with a blonde Mohawk, numerous earrings in his ears, dressed only in pants held up by suspenders and bracers, while his arms, stomach, and chest were all covered in blue or purple flame tattoos.
"Rikku! Fru ec drec cicbeleuic bancuh fred Yuna?!"(Who is this suspicious person with Yuna?!) The one in the center demanded once he saw Alex, to which Rikku angrily retorted,
"Tuhd pa nita Brother!"(Don't be rude Brother) Brother however just snorted and asked Alex directly as he approached him,
"Who are you to be walking with Yuna!" Rather than being annoyed by Brother's attitude though, Alex just smiled warmly and said,
"I'm the Dragon Emperor, Alexander Morningstar. And I'd heard about Yuna's 'quest', so I thought I'd share what I knew with her." This immediately caught everyone's attention, for one because they had never heard of an emperor in Spira before, and secondly because Alex apparently knew of Yuna's quest.
Immediately Yuna grabbed Alex's hand with both of hers as she desperately asked,
"Do you really know something about 'him'?!" Knowing she was asking about the protagonist from the original Final Fantasy ten game, Tidus, Alex nodded his head and told her,
"Yes, but it isn't necessarily the news you'd want to hear." Though Yuna's expression fell somewhat, she nodded slowly before saying,
"I expected as much, but after seeing him in a sphere I had to be certain..." Alex nodded in understanding as Yuna pulled out a sphere she had somewhere on her body, which swirled and sparkled in the light. She then played the recording that was left on it, showing them the staticky scene of a man that had been imprisoned.
Though the image meant nothing to Sun, Alex clearly recognized the man as the main antagonist that Yuna, Rikku, and Paine would've had to fight without his interference, who was also the spitting image of Tidus. Shaking his head lightly, Alex explained,
"That may look like him, but this man's name is Shuyin."
"Shuyin?" Rikku parroted the moment the name left Alex's lips, to which he nodded and continued,
"Yes, Shuyin. Tidus' existence was the result of a 'dream' of the Fayth, and so when the dream ended he too faded away. However all of the dreams of the Fayth were based off of real people or places, and I believe that Shuyin was the template they used for the creation of Tidus."
For a moment no one said anything as they digested this information, which, unfortunately for Yuna, made much more sense than anything else she'd been able to think of ever since she first watched the sphere. There was however one doubt in everyone's minds, which Brother immediately voiced as he asked,
"And how are we knowing that what you say is correct?" Paine nodded as she added,
"True, is there any evidence to support your story? And why go out of your way to tell us this to begin with?" With Paine making a decent point since Alex didn't even know any of them to begin with, they all looked at him questioningly. Alex however shrugged and replied,
"Evidence or no, that doesn't make what I have to say any less true. As for why I'd tell you, it's because of what would happen if you continued blindly pursuing Shuyin." Yuna this time narrowed her eyes as she asked him,
"What would've happened?" With Alex's fingers shimmering with Regeneration magic, he started,
"A little history first. You're all aware of the history behind the creation of Sin and the fate of Zanarkand, right?" With everyone nodding in affirmation, as nearly everyone in Spira knew the truth by now, Alex continued,
"Well Shuyin had a lover a thousand years ago, a Songstress named Lenne. Unfortunately though Lenne was also a very skilled summoner, and when the war between Zanarkand and Bevelle broke out she was sent to the front lines, even though she knew she would most likely never return. Desperate to save her, Shuyin attempted to use one of Bevelle's most powerful, and dangerous weapons against them, Vegnagun."
At this point Alex used Regeneration magic to show them the figure of Shuyin approaching a giant demonic looking figure, a massive Machina that had a skull-like face, with gargantuan tusks jutting out from either side of it. As several members of the Gullwings gulped at the image, Alex continued,
"Vegnagun was a Machina powerful enough that it was said to be able to destroy all of Spira, but was unable to differentiate between friend or foe, so it was stored away deep under Bevelle. And there it sat until Shuyin tried to turn it on, resulting only in the execution of himself and Lenne. However even after death Shuyin never found peace. His anger and resentment has festered over the last thousand years, and he awaits the moment that he would believe that Vegnugun is needed once more."
For a moment no one said anything as they digested what Alex told them, until Paine said,
"So you're saying that by investigating Shuyin, we might also awaken him and Vegnugun?" Alex nodded slowly as he explained,
"Vegnugun is very sensitive, just thinking of doing it harm is enough to activate it so it can preserve its own existence. Though what doesn't help is Spira's current state of affairs and how close it is to seeing war once again. That would definitely set Shuyin off." Again everyone was silent as they absorbed what Alex said, and thought about the very real events taking place across Spira.
Originally there had been three major factions in Spira when Sin was terrorizing them, Yevon, who more or less ruled all of Spira through the religion and temples, the Al Bhed, who were mostly ostracized and outcasts due to their reliance on Machina when the teachings of Yevon strictly forbade it, and then the Crusaders, a militant group of volunteers that were determined to protect the people of Spira from Sin.
However, during what was called Operation Mihan, the Crusaders were excommunicated from Yevon due to their partnering with Al Bhed, and were almost destroyed during their confrontation with Sin. Shortly after Yuna and her companions, her Guardians, discovered and revealed the deceit and corruption of Yevon, leading to it too being reformed after the destruction of Sin.
Now there was New Yevon, and the remnants of the Crusaders who formed a group known as the Youth League who were very antagonistic towards each other. On top of that was the rapidly deteriorating situation involving the Guado and Ronso.
Two years ago they were both affiliates of Yevon, but when the Ronso learned of the truth behind them, they splintered away from Yevon's control. As a result, the then leader of the Guado, Seymour Guado, ended up slaughtering so many of the Ronso he claimed they had gone extinct, except for Yuna's Guardian Kimari.
Thankfully though there were still a number of Ronso scattered across Spira, who Kimari had been bringing together to recover from the slaughter, but they hadn't forgotten the suffering of their people at Seymour's hands. Though he had been dead for several years, many of the Ronso still wanted revenge. And they were more than willing to go after the remaining Guado who supported Seymour to get it.
There was also the Machine Faction, named so in order to allow people to get used to Machina without calling them such, but they weren't antagonistic towards anyone. But, with so many groups ready to go to war with each other, Yuna muttered,
"So what you're saying, is that Shuyin and Vegnagun are both going to wake up soon?" Surprisingly, Alex shook his head as he replied,
"No, I've sent people to subdue Shuyin and Vegnagun, so they should be harmless soon, if not already."
***
While Alex was talking with the Gullwings in Spira, Grayfia, Kuroka, and Erza were all currently back in Asora as they delivered their prize to Azazel and Hajime.
"What did you do to it?!" Hajime wailed as he beheld the pathetic appearance of the once great Machina.
Once insectoid in appearance, Vegnagun was now in pieces and completely in-operational as Grayfia and Kuroka dropped it on the ground before them. In response to his despair at the state of it though, Kuroka smirked as she said,
"You can thank miss maid for that, she's the one who totaled that thing when we were asked to bring it in intact~Nya." Grayfia directed a look of incredulity at Kuroka and remarked,
"Well maybe if you hadn't been wasting time and helped me disable its power supply, we would've been able to deliver it intact!" Kuroka however snorted as she responded,
"I had to purify that annoying man, Shityun or something~Nya." This time it was Grayfia who smirked as she muttered,
"So it takes you so long just to purify one spirit, huh? Pretty bad for the Dragon Emperor's 'Queen' if you ask me." When she heard that Kuroka's expression twisted as black swirling flames appeared in her hands,
"Maybe I should 'purify' you to show you how strong I am~Nya?" In response to the threat Grayfia's expression also grew fierce as her entire body began to radiate demonic power.
"I'd like to see you try, cat." With the two monsters preparing to trade blows, Hajime and Azazel stopped complaining about the state Vegnagun arrived in as they suddenly busied themselves with studying it, while Erza muttered quietly,
"I could've sworn we had other things to do though..."
***
"Haaaaa..." Yuna sighed as she sat on one of the stools at the bar within the Celsius, her mind still swimming with everything Alex told them previously as she took a sip of the drink before her. On one hand she was glad to get the answers to her questions so soon, but on the other she didn't know where to go from here since she had practically run away from home to find those answers after Rikku showed her the sphere.
"Anotter drink mish Yuuna?" Their barkeeper, a Hypello they called Barkeep, asked as she emptied her glass. Yuna nodded slowly as the blue skinned Hypello refilled her glass with fruity non-alcoholic drink she liked. Seated next to her were of course Rikku, Paine, and even Alex's companion, Sun.
"So what are you going to do now? You're not just going to go home, right?" Rikku asked worriedly, as she enjoyed having Yuna around as they hunted spheres. Yuna however just shook her head as she replied,
"I'm not sure just yet..." As she thought about the answer to that question, a new voice asked,
"Why don't you stick with us for a while?" The four girls looked up to see Alex approaching them, who had stayed on the bridge after they left to talk to Brother and the other two, Buddy and Shinra. Rikku narrowed her eyes at Alex's approach, and asked,
"Why would we stick with you instead of the Gullwings?" Before answering Alex took his own seat and asked Barkeep for a drink, and then he finally said,
"I'm not planning on keeping my focus in Spira for long, so I'd like to tour as much of it as possible before we leave. I was hoping that while Brother, Buddy, and Shinra worked on the projects I gave them, you three would act as out guides since you've been all over Spira." Alex's words immediately caught their attention as Yuna asked with interest,
"What kind of projects did you give them?" Before answering Alex produced a compass from midair, and explained,
"This is a magic compass that shows you where anything you want is. Using it, I located numerous ancient airships that they could excavate and collect, while I also used another item I have to quickly find and collect a number of spheres that could be used as Dresspheres for Shinra to analyze. In return for the new airships and large amount of spheres, I asked for Shinra to pass on to me the way to create Dresspheres, and my pick of one airship from the ones Brother and Buddy excavate for my people to examine and study."
His words caused a stir of excite the amongst the girls as Rikku demanded,
"So we're going to get more airships soon?!" As an Al Bhed who grew up while researching Machina and helping to locate and recover things like the airship her father owned, Rikku was especially excited at the idea of having more airships to fly around on, she just hoped that these ones wouldn't be as dangerous to find as the Celsius.
Alex nodded to her excitement as he said,
"Yep, I located about a dozen more airships that could be salvaged and repaired for them, and gave Shinra over twenty more spheres that can turned into Dresspheres. So he promised me that he'd give me the data that we'd need to replicate them and produce them ourselves once he's done analyzing them."
This surprised the girls even more as, at the moment, they only had four Dresspheres to choose from with the fifth being worked on. Currently they only had Rikku's 'Thief', Paine's 'Warrior', Yuna's 'Gunner', the 'Songstress', and Shinra was currently making another based off of Brother called the 'Festivalist'.
They weren't the only ones though, as Alex knew he had produced more spheres than what were used in the game. Including the five aforementioned spheres, there were also the 'Black Mage', 'White Mage', 'Gun Mage', 'Alchemist', 'Dark Knight', 'Samurai', 'Lady Luck', 'Berserker', 'Trainer', 'Mascot', and 'Psychic' Dresspheres from the original game, all with their own unique skills and abilities. On top of that though, Alex had also apparently found extra Dresspheres like the 'Sentinel', 'Lancer', and several others. (A.N. Feel free to add ideas for new Dresspheres if you want.)
As he finished listing the majority of the spheres he found, Paine finally spoke up as she asked,
"What do you need Dresspheres for?" With both Rikku and Yuna looking at him curiously at her question, Alex replied,
"Because in my homeland, Asora, strength is one of the things people idolize and desire the most. Even our Academy encourages its students to try and push their limits, though we have no intention of forcing anyone onto a battlefield or anything.
"The problem though is that some people are born with natural gifts, skills, and abilities for growing stronger and fighting, while others aren't. I want to use the Dresspheres as a sort of 'equalizer' for them, allowing those who have no skills or talents to developers their own with them. They would also compliment our Peerage system fairly well as well." Yuna cocked her head cutely when she heard that and asked,
"Peerages?" Alex nodded and continued,
"Peerages are a system developed by one of the nations in my empire, elite soldiers under a single commander, or 'King', to fight instead of entire armies. They're based off of a game system we have called chess, and each piece can be given to recipients to increase their base physical abilities, such as strength, defense, speed, and magic power." Alex then spent the next several minutes detailing the Evil Pieces and how they were used, the different types and effects.
Ending his explanation, Alex pulled his own final remaining Evil Piece, and said,
"This is my own last piece, a 'Pawn'. I just need to find a decent candidate to give it to, and then I'll have a full peerage." As he said that Alex glanced at Yuna and Rikku meaningfully, though neither one seemed to notice this.
(A.N. Already had one in mind, but I'm curious who you guys want for Alex's final peerage member. I'll comment Yuna and Rikku's name below, and give a like to whichever one you want to join him. The other will probably end up becoming Ingvild's 'Queen".)

chapters.title: Chapter 423 - 423: Besaid Island
chapters.content:
"Welcome to Besaid Island!" Yuna declared excitedly as they stepped off the wooden docks onto the white sandy beach, the Celsius roaring subtly behind them as it got further and further away.
Agreeing to act as Alex's guides, the trio of Gullwings had decided to start his tour of Spira in the same place Yuna began her pilgrimage two years prior, and the place she called home. Despite her excitement though, it fairly obvious to Alex and the others that Yuna was pretty nervous.
It wasn't too hard to guess why though considering she had essentially ran away from home, and was understandably feeling anxious about suddenly returning. So Rikku went up to Yuna's side and placed a comforting hand on her shoulder before saying,
"Don't worry Yunie, I'm sure everyone will be excited to see you!" Looking at her, Yuna nodded in agreement and said,
"Yeah, let's go!" Yuna then led the way to the tropical forest at the edge of the beach, leading further into the island's interior. Along the way both Alex and Sun couldn't help but to admire the sights around them, as the trail Yuna led them onto took them around the base of a cliff, and even onto a bridge right below a waterfall, though unfortunately the mist from the falls wasn't enough to give Alex the same wondrous view he received earlier.
All around them though, along with the natural beauty of Besaid Island, were numerous ruins that showed the remains of some long-lost civilization, a testament to how much destruction had wracked Spira's landscape, and it's people.
After nearly half an hour of walking, they finally they reached a hill overlooking Besaid village, a collection of tents set up behind a wall and outside one of Yevon's temples. Seeing this, Yuna looked relieved despite her earlier anxiety, as she performed a wide sweeping gesture and said,
"I present to you, Besaid Village!" Everyone took a moment to pause as they admired the view below them, from the village to the rest of the island that they could see, and even the endless waves that sparkled in the sunlight clear to the horizon.
"It's beautiful." Sun said, reveling in the sun on her skin, the wind on her face, and smell of the ocean in the distance. Alex nodded in agreement as he took in the sights, with looked especially amazing with four beautiful women in the foreground.
Their admiration of the village and the surrounding landscape was cut short though, as some of the nearby vegetation began to rustle violently before a large creature showed itself.
"Count on a fiend to ruin a moment." Paine said as her outfit began to shimmer, while she, Yuna and Rikku prepared to fight. With all three women's glowing from their swift uniform changes, Alex and Sun watched as they used some of the new Dresspheres Alex gave them for the first time.
Paine's outfit changed from black leather straps and shorts to serrated black armor with fins on the head and shoulders, while her sword transitioned to one with several wavy serrations as well. Rikku went from her bikini top and skirt to what appeared to be a schoolgirls sailer uniform, with a white long-sleeve top, an incredibly short green skirt, brown boots that went up to her calves, and dark techno looking shades to cover her eyes. Meanwhile Yuna was suddenly adorned in a long purple dress that had large gashes open on her shoulders, hips, thighs, and calves, and left the center of her belly and chest open to reveal the black spade now printed on her sternum.
They were the 'Dark Knight', 'Psychic', and 'Lady Luck' Dresspheres accordingly, the first one which granted excessively powerful offensive attacks and the ability to sap health from the opponents, while also being able to deliver powerful attacks at the expense of the users own health. The 'Psychic' Dressphere however granted one telekinetic abilities, like how Rikku started hovering the moment she transitioned to it, and was now able to use abilities like Teleportation. The 'Lady Luck' Dressphere on the other hand allowed Yuna to summon giant slots to make their attacks completely unpredictable, or use abilities like Tantalize to dazzle and stun her opponents before her deadly playing cards struck.
As each girl finished their transformation the fiend that was approaching stepped out of the bushes to reveal its giant form, a large carnivorous looking plant with a gaping mouth filled with teeth, and numerous long vines ending in giant hooks.
"It's an Ochu!" Paine said in warning, as each of the hooks on the long vines were not only deadly if they impaled you, but can also drag its victims into its waiting maw, or even inflict a debilitating toxin with just a scratch that could either kill you, or cause hallucinations that made the victim unable to distinguish friend from foe(confusion).
Alex and Sun stood back and watched as the three ladies then sprung into action, having already decided that they'd do most of the fighting while traveling with him. Paine ran directly up towards the Ochu with her sword ready at the side, unflinching as its tentacle-like vines whipped viciously at her. Before any of them could sink their venom-laced hooks into her though, they were suddenly severed by small flying objects that rushed right back to their owner.
"Are you feeling lucky?" Yuna asked playfully as a deck of cards swirled around her in a razor sharp twister, whipping up a minor gust as they did so that ruffled her hair and dress. As the Ochu then fried to focus on her while several of its remaining vines tried to occupy Paine, Rikku suddenly teleported right behind it and cried out,
"Over here~!" She then fired off a laser from her hands that pierced the body of the Ochu, but apparently only pissed it off since it barely seemed affected by it.
"Oh poopie!" Rikku swore when she realized her attack didn't do as much damage as she hoped, but then again it was a new Dressphere. She didn't have long to dwell on it though, as the bushes rustling once more behind her drew her attention to several more fiends that had appeared, except these were the 'weaker' coyotes.
"You're bothering me!" She cried out as she once again drew on her psychic powers, and forcibly teleported the entire pack of coyotes away.
While Rikku was dealing with the smaller fiends, Yuna and Paine were both busy taking down the Ochu. Yuna was using her cards to keep the seemingly endless supply of vines busy to they wouldn't bother Paine, while Paine was still making her way to the main body of the Ochu through the few vines Yuna couldn't occupy.
"This armor is too heavy and bulky..." Paine grumbled as she struggled to dodge the hooks vines, before she finally got fed up and summoned a wave of Darkness that not only assaulted the vines attacking her, but also the main body of the Ochu itself.
Unlike Rikku's previous attack though, it was obvious that her attack did quite a bit of damage to the fiend as it no longer had the strength to attack them with its vines, before Paine immediately cut into its body with her sword to deal the finishing blow.
As the Ochu's body dissolved into Pyreflies, Paine, Yuna, and Rikku took a step back as they thought back on their first battle with the new Dresspheres.
"I like this 'Psychic' Dressphere, but I think I have to use it a bit more before I can actually do some real damage with it..." Rikku complained as she recalled the shallow attack she dealt to the Ochu, to which Yuna nodded as she added,
"It's the same with the 'Lady Luck' as well. The cards were really useful for dealing with all of the vines, but I think they would've been useless if I tried to attack the main body. Plus I was hesitant to use the slots as well." As Yuna said, if she had bad luck when trying to use the slots to attack, and got a bust, then she could end up hurting herself or her teammates more than she would the enemy.
When Paine changed back to her usual 'Warrior' outfit though, both Rikku and Yuna became concerned when they saw her wipe a trickle of blood from the corner of her mouth.
"What happened Paine?!" Yuna cried out in concern while Rikku tried to check Paine's body for injuries.
"It's nothing, just the result of using that Darkness attack from earlier." As she said, several abilities of the 'Dark Knight' Dressphere would cause a backlash on Paine herself in return for their high damage output, which would have to be something she'd have to get used to if she was going to use it.
What surprised them though was when Paine was suddenly enveloped in a magical light, and any pain she was in suddenly vanished as Alex healed her.
"I think you all did well for using those Dresspheres for the first time. After all you'll only become stronger with them from here." With Sun nodding in agreement and also giving them encouragement, Rikku and Yuna adopted shy yet happy looks while Paine looked away pointedly, until a new voice piped up,
"I'll say. Those outfits sure were surprising!" They all turned to see a tanned man approaching them from the direction of the village.
He had reddish-orange hair that was sticking up with the bangs up in a plume, held in place with a blue bandana, an orange vest, yellow pants with sandals, and blue and yellow pads on his left arm and shoulder. As he approached the man directed a stern look at Yuna and said,
"You caused quite a fuss around here young lady, suddenly taking off like that!" Despite his stern tone though, the man's eyes were kind as his lips curled up into a smile. Going up and giving him a hug, Yuna said,
"It's nice to see you too Wakka." Wakka gently hugged her back as he said,
"Eh, it is what it is. Welcome home." In an instant the anxiety Yuna had about returning melted away into nothing as she hugged the man who had been like an older brother to her, and had been by her side as she marched into battle to end Sin once and for all. When they separated though, Rikku immediately ran up and said,
"Hey! What about me!" Wakka laughed as he released Yuna and pulled Rikku into his embrace, even as he playfully said,
"I don't know, you're the reason Yuna ran off to begin with, ya?" Rikku only chuckled awkwardly since Wakka did have a point, and she'd even felt like a kidnapper at certain points after Yuna joined them.
It was only at this point that Wakka directed his attention to Alex, Sun, and Paine, and asked,
"Who's all this?" Yuna immediately realized that introductions had yet been made, and quickly introduced them all.
"It's a pleasure to meet one of the people responsible for the destruction of Sin." Alex said as he shook Wakka's hand, to which he laughed awkwardly this time before saying,
"Thanks I guess. It was really Yuna that did most of the heavy lifting, I was just mostly along for the ride." Alex cocked a brow at this as, regardless of his actual contributions, Wakka had been one of the group that directly defeated the colossal beast, and should be proud of such a thing.
The topic was immediately changed though as Rikku excitedly asked,
"So how's Lulu with the baby?!" Wakka immediately perked up at the mention of his soon-to-be-born baby, as he eagerly said,
"Lu's good, she should be due any day now. If anything it's almost too soon since I'm not sure I'm ready yet to be a father..." As he trailed off Wakka thought back to his own parents, who had both been killed by Sin when he and his little brother, Chappu, had been kids.
"I just wish I had something to go off of..." He added, missing them more now than he had in years with his own impending parenthood. Surprising him though, Alex clapped a hand on Wakka's non-padded shoulder as he said,
"A little advice, nothing you say or do will prepare you for that moment. The second you hold that little bundle in your arms, everything will change." His words made Wakka and the others look at him curiously, before Yuna asked,
"Do you have kids?" Alex nodded as he pulled out what appeared to be a wallet, but was filled entirely with pictures of every single one of his children. With the entire stack unfolding, all four of them went wide eyed at the sheer number of children Alex had, with the newest addition at the very bottom of the line being an infant girl with a little tuft of green hair, Jade.
"These are all your children?!" Rikku exclaimed in shock, to which Alex nodded and said,
"Yeah, one of the benefits of having a harem."
"H-h-h-h-h-Harem!?!?!?!?" Yuna cried out in shock, her face turning beet red at the thought, to which Alex nodded nonchalantly as he said,
"Of course, polygamy is pretty common for people of power and authority in most of the places I've been to. As an emperor who rules over all of them, it's practically expected that I'd also have numerous wives. Not to mention that every single one of my peerage members are one of my wives as well." While Wakka was wondering what a peerage was, Yuna, Rikku, and even Paine went red in the cheeks as they recalled the actual number of Evil Pieces he had told them there was in a set.
Meanwhile Sun was almost tempted to remark about how big Alex's harem actually was, but decided not to for the moment. With everyone now silent as they tried to digest such information, Wakka awkwardly coughed before saying,
"Anyways, let's head down to the village Yuna, everyone saw that flashy airship of yours arrive and they're eager to see you." Nodding slowly, Yuna followed Wakka despite looking like she was in a daze as the word 'harem' reverberated within her skull.
She quickly recovered though when they finally arrived at the village, and everyone swarmed them to greet her and meet the new arrivals.
"Welcome home Yuna!"
"Yuna! It's great to see you!"
"Come play with us Yuna!"
All around them people happily greeted Yuna, asked how she was doing, and the children even begged her to play with them. It was obvious how much she was loved here in Besaid where she grew up, at least compared to other places that only saw her as the High Summoner.
Of course Rikku got her fair share of love too, as Yuna's cousin and one of her closest friends, while everyone was also interested in learning who Paine, Alex, and Sun all were. After meeting the majority of the village though, someone else that Alex actually wanted to meet alongside Wakka appeared.
"Look who came home." Said a certain woman as she approached, her voice oozing with sensuality.
She had pale skin with red eyes, and long black hair that was mostly tied up into braids, while a large portion of her bangs covered her face. Meanwhile a long black dress covered most of her body while leaving a large amount of her cleavage exposed, and several black belts were laced and crossed over the front to cover her legs. She was a remarkably beautiful woman, but the most eye catching thing about her was her swollen belly that stretched her dress out.
"Hello Lulu, are you sure you should be out and about?" Yuna greeted her and asked with concern, to which Lulu laughed with a smirk as she replied,
"I'm sure I'm better than whatever Wakka told you, and I can use the exercise." When he heard that Wakka made a face and said,
"Hey! I'm not that bad Lu!" Lulu giggled at that and said to him,
"Yesterday you tried to make sure I never got on my feet all day, even to use the toilet." When they heard this several of the people around them snickered and chuckled at Wakka's expense, making him groan as he recalled the talking to she gave him.
Lulu then walked out of the village with Yuna, Rikku, and Paine trailing behind her, as well as Sun after Alex sent her to keep an eye on them, and any fiends in the area. Alex meanwhile clapped a hand on Wakka's shoulder and led him into the village, while saying,
"Relax, she'll be fine, lets go talk ourselves." With no choice but to be dragged along by Alex's ridiculous strength, Wakka followed along until until they arrived outside the largest tent of the dozens that made up Besaid village, where he and Lulu made their home together.
Within was several rugs with only a few pieces of furniture, including a sofa, a short table, a dresser, and a futon to sleep on. With Wakka plopping down on the sofa, Alex conjured a chair across from him before also placing several drinks on the table between them.
"What was that!?" Wakka exclaimed in surprise at the things Alex conjured, to which he explained,
"The magic used outside of Spira is rather unique. Consider these a gift from me to you and Lulu, though I'm sure that Lulu will probably get more use out of them." Alex waved his hand and once again numerous items appeared out of midair, except this time it was a stack of numerous books and scrolls detailing some of the types of magics used in Asora.
With Lulu being a Mage Alex was pretty sure she would appreciate being able to learn about magics from other worlds, though wether or not she would was a different story altogether since she'd be taking care of a baby soon. Though, academic curiosity would probably get the better of her eventually.
As he poured Wakka a drink Alex then said once again to him,
"You really should loosen up Wakka. I told you before, no matter how much you try to prepare, nothing will make you ready for that big moment." Wakka was silent for a moment before he finally said,
"You said that before, but my own parents died when I was so young I barely even remember them. I...just wish I had something to go by, ya know?" Alex smiled wryly as they made a complete circle in their argument, so he held out his hand and showed Wakka another example of his magic.
Crimson swirling energy filled the room as Wakka watched on in awe, before it began to condense into Alex's open hand to form a spherical shape. Once the process was finished he was holding a single Crimson sphere in his hand, which he offered to Wakka.
"Take it, see what's on it." Alex told him as Wakka gingerly accepted the sphere, which he then activated.
"WAAAAA! WAAAAAA!" The sound of a baby wailing filled their ears as the clearest image Wakka had ever seen on a sphere came into view, showing a little baby with a tuft of reddish orange hair on his head, and the woman who held him in her arms.
"Aren't you going to hold him?" She then asked someone nearby, her voice filled with exhaustion and pain from just giving birth, but also endless love and affection. When she handed the baby off though, it showed a man who gaped disbelievingly at the small bundle in his arms.
The man looked almost identical to the one sitting across from Alex now, matching his looks almost to the letter as he cradled the newborn baby in his arms.
"Have you thought of a a name yet?" The woman asked her still dumbstruck husband, who didn't even look away as he said,
"How about Wakka, ya?" The woman smiled beautifully as she repeated,
"Wakka... I love it."
As he watched the scene play out before him the current Wakka began to tear up as he threatened to start sobbing violently, his eyes transfixed on his father and mother. All he had of them since they died was memories, or a memory of a memory, never once having been able to see what they looked like until now.
"...thank you...." He muttered finally, to which Alex just silently nodded as the scene shifted, once again to the woman having just given birth, except this time an older Wakka was at their side as his little brother was born, Chappu.
...
While Wakka was able to see his family once more for the first time in decades, the girls had arrived at the top of the same hill where they had defeated the Ochu earlier. This time however there curiously wasn't a single fiend in sight, though none of the other girls seemed to notice Sun occasionally whistle once or twice in a high pitched tone.
When they finally reached the top of the hill, Lulu then asked Yuna,
"So, can I see this sphere that made you leave?" Though she was hesitant after already learning the truth, Yuna still held out the sphere for one of her closest friends to view.
As the same scene she showed Alex and Sun earlier played out, Lulu was completely silent until the entire thing had finished playing before saying,
"Well, it certainly does look like him." Yuna nodded slowly at her comment, before saying,
"Yes, but I've already learned that it isn't him." Lulu's only visible brow arched when she heard that, and she asked curiously,
"Oh? How'd you find that out already?" Yuna then repeated everything she had learned from Alex earlier, and it was only once she finished that Lulu glanced at Sun before asking,
"And are you sure you can trust him? He's not trying to use you for anything, is he?" Yuna slowly shook her head as she responded,
"I don't think so, or at least he hasn't mentioned anything other than showing him and Sun around Spira." As she said this Yuna and the other three looked at Sun pointedly until the siren said,
"I can't think of anything Alex would want to 'use' Yuna for, except for maybe eventually inviting her into his peerage at some point." Though Lulu wanted to ask what a peerage was, Yuna, Rikku, and Paine all reacted as the blond exclaimed,
"Wait! Would he actually ask her to join him?!" Sun however just shrugged as she responded,
"I'm not sure to be honest, or at least he hasn't mentioned anything about it to me. All I know for sure is that Alex seems drawn to women with strong ties to 'fate', and in this world that appears to be Yuna, or maybe even you Rikku."
As Sun said Rikku had been with Yuna when they defeated Sin, and would have been the only one from the original 'party' to be with her this time when they would have gone to fight Vegnagun. If she had to single anyone out in this world that Alex might invite to his peerage it would be the two of them, something she had next to no doubts about considering they were both beautiful women with good potential, even if they were a little weak right now.
However they seemed to have the wrong idea as Rikku suddenly exclaimed,
"Does that mean he'll also try to draft us into this harem of his?! I don't know if I'm ready to join a harem of all things!" As the two girls began to fret, and Lulu looked at Sun pointedly since this was the first she'd heard of a harem, Sun fought the increasing urge to sigh as she explained,
"Don't worry, Alex doesn't force anyone to do anything. If he did ask you'd be able to turn him down and he'd respect your wishes, like he did when he asked me originally and I did just that." Paine then spoke up for the first time as she countered,
"But you joined anyways, didn't you?" Sun nodded before saying,
"Yes I did, but I originally refused because I feared he was just another person who merely wanted to abuse my abilities. After hearing and seeing everything Alex had done up until that point though, I decided to join him because I concluded he was a good person who wouldn't abuse my powers, even if he himself won't admit it."
As she said that Sun flashed a warm smile as she recalled the way Alex tried to refute her claims that he was a 'good person', even though almost everything he'd done since they met had proved her right time and again. In fact, the only 'bad' thing she could think of off the top of her head that he'd done was going to war with the other factions in the DXD world, but even that had been orchestrated by the higher ups of those very same factions to prove the strength and skills of Alex and his people.
Seeing her like this, the other four women were momentarily at a loss for words as Sun's expression could only be described as a 'maiden in love', something that made Rikku groan as she recalled her own failed relationship, while Yuna appeared envious as she had started her journey to find the man she had fallen for. Paine meanwhile appeared indifferent since she wasn't interested in matters of love, while Lulu grew curious about this Alex since they hadn't really had a chance to talk earlier, and decided to learn more about him if he was going to be spending more time around Yuna.
The usually cool expression on her face faltered though, as a disturbance in her body caught her attention as she held her belly tenderly.
"Oh, he just kicked." She exclaimed softly, drawing everyone's attention as Rikku ran over and asked,
"Oh oh oh! Can I feel?!"
They then took turns feeling Lulu's belly as the baby within continued to kick energetically, making Lulu giggle as she thought of how much her baby would be like its father in the future. Soon they then began the trek back towards the village, with Lulu asking Yuna if they had any plans to stay the night.
(A.N. For everyone saying wait until Dragon Ball for the last Evil Piece, there's already several stupidly strong martial artist types in Alex's peerage starting with even Alex himself, Shia, Moka, and even Lala. There's no need to add ANOTHER person who's entire move set with either punching and kicking, or powerful energy blasts.)

chapters.title: Chapter 424 - 424: Lucy's New 'Friend'
chapters.content:
When the girls eventually made it back to the village shortly before sundown, they discussed the specifics of everyone staying for the night. Yuna, Rikku, and Paine would stay in the tent next to Wakka and Lulu's, which was originally Yuna's to begin with, while Alex and Sun were given the tent directly on the other side of Yuna's for the duration of their stay. Not that Alex planned to stay for more than a couple nights.
Then they sat around and talked for a while, with everyone getting to know one another or catch up, before they all finally went to crash for the night. With Sun snuggled up to his side, Alex relaxed on the futon as he let sleep overtake him.
Later, in the dead of the night, a solitary figure rose as she rubbed the sleep from her eyes.
"Mmmmm..... I need to tinkle...." Rikku groggily muttered as she crawled out of her futon in the tent she was sharing with Yuna and Paine, and made her way to the bathroom outside. She was only wearing a pair of really short shorts, and a tank top that had slipped on one side to expose one of her breasts, but thankfully it was still the middle of the night so no one saw.
After finishing her business Rikku made her way back to Yuna's tent, but in her half asleep state she accidentally entered the one next to it. There she collapsed without checking who the other two people side her were, instead snuggling up to the large figure beside her covered in soft fur.
...
When Rikku awoke early the next morning she was instantly aware of several things that were 'wrong'. First was that her 'pillow' was actually an arm covered in soft red fur, second was that the same person that the arm belonged to was currently hugged up to her from behind while one of their hands was squeezing her breast, and finally was that something large, and incredibly hot, was nestled between her thighs to rub right up against her precious spot.
The secondary thing that Rikku noticed after waking up was that her tank top was now laying on the ground in front of her, having apparently been removed at some point in the night, while a subtle movement of her legs revealed that her shorts and panties were now wrapped around her ankles, meaning she was pretty much completely naked.
Naturally, she began to panic slightly at the situation but forced herself to calm down, lest she wake the man hugged up to her backside. Rikku knew he was still asleep due to the gentle rhythm of his breath on the back of her head, the only saving grace in this situation.
As for her, and his, apparent state of undress, Rikku already knew she had a habit of stripping in her sleep, even more so when it was hot or warm out like it currently was in Besaid. So, instead of freaking out, she put her mind to escaping this situation before the man, Alex, woke up.
After more than twenty minutes of squirming and maneuvering, all with bated breath, Rikku finally managed to extract herself from Alex's tight, and erotic, grip. Heaving a sigh of relief, she quickly collected her clothes and escaped from the confines of Alex's tent, deliberately ignoring the patch of wetness between her legs as she did so.
As Rikku 'escaped' though, Alex cracked open an eyelid, having woken up at some point as she tried to get out of his grasp, and smirked humorously.
"Such a naughty girl..." He joked as quietly as possible, before tucking his morning wood back into his shorts and turning over to hug onto Sun as the siren continued to sleep peacefully beside him.
***
A while later, shortly after the sun began to crest the mountains, numerous people throughout the village began to rise for another day in what many considered paradise. And as Alex and Sun similarly emerged from their tent after both waking up, they found the three Gullwings also outside, though Rikku pointedly looked away from Alex with reddened cheeks.
"Good morning, did the two of you sleep well?" Yuna greeted and asked as the duo approached, to which both Alex and Sun nodded while saying,
"Yeah, it's very peaceful here." Yuna smiled happily that the place she considered her home was praised, before asking,
"So, is there anything specifically that you wanted to do today?" To this Alex only said,
"I just planned to spend today enjoying life in Besaid with my family, and planned to head to Kilika tomorrow." When she heard that, Paine recalled the pictures Alex showed them of his children the day before as she coolly told him,
"We said we'll show you around Spira, but we're not babysitters." Alex nodded as he explained,
"No need to worry, they're good children and we'll be the ones to watch over them." Though she merely grunted in response, Alex took Paine's silence as acquiesce.
Even if she wanted to comment further, she didn't get a chance as a new voice called out,
"ALEEEEEX!" Everyone that was up and moving around in Besaid looked up to see several figures flying towards them with large bat-like wings, a girl with her blonde hair tied back into a ponytail in the lead.
"Lucy! Yami! Kurumu! Moka! How was your first day in Spira!" Alex shouted back to them as the quartet of girls approached them, before both Lucy and Kurumu leapt into his open arms and snuggled up to him.
"It was amazing! I never thought it'd be so fun to explore another world!" Lucy exclaimed before listing everything they had since separating the day before, all while Kurumu just inhaled Alex's scent as if she were deprived of it. Meanwhile Yami and Moka just stood back, the former trying to appear indifferent, while the latter seemed 'too cool' to join in on the reunion, their long silver and blonde hair blowing in the morning breeze.
It was only after a few minutes of talking that Lucy noticed the gazes centered on them, and blushed deeply to the amusement of those around them while Kurumu continued to shamelessly revel in Alex's presence. Using the moment where Lucy had gone silent, Yuna hesitantly asked,
"A-are you all also Alex's.....wives...?" Though she was silent on the last part, Alex and his entourage still heard her clearly as he nodded and said,
"Yep, they are. That's Yami, a living weapon." As he pointed at her Yami raised her hand as if to say hello, but, surprising everyone watching, her hand then turned into a long sword as she quietly said,
"Nice to meet you." Alex then pointed at Moka and said,
"That's Moka, a vampire." Everyone cocked their head when they heard that, as Yuna asked curiously,
"What's a vampire?" For the first time Moka showed a smile as she sauntered over towards the trio of girls, and said slowly,
"Vampires, like myself, are creatures that feed on humans as they drink their blood." At this point the vampiress' smile widened as her fangs flashed in the sunlight, making Yuna gulped as she leaned in and said,
"I wonder how your blood tastes?" Moka then punctuated her remark by sensually licking her lips, as if she found the idea of sipping on Yuna to be delicious, until Alex issued a light chop to her head.
"Hey, cut it out." Alex reprimanded her, to which Moka furrowed her brows before he said to Yuna and the other two, who had moved to stand between her and Moka protectively,
"Don't let her scare you. While vampires do drink human blood, Moka lives almost exclusively on mine, and will only drink someone else's blood if she needs to 'refill' during a battle." The Gullwings looked at Alex incredulously when they heard that, while Moka snorted as she turned away from Yuna and the others to approach him. She then leaned into Alex's body and opened her mouth to once again show off her fangs, before they sank into Alex's flesh like knives into hot butter.
With Moka enjoying her breakfast, Alex then pointed to Kurumu at his side and said,
"This is Kurumu. She's a succubus, which is a type of demon that survives off of sexual energies." A stunned silence filled the atmosphere as everyone tried to figure out a way to respond to that, as none of them had heard of something needing to survive off of literal sex before. Breaking the silence though, Alex pointed to the still cringing Lucy as he said,
"And last, but not least, that is Lucy, a summoner/tamer." The moment she heard 'summoner' Yuna's eyes lit up as she excitedly asked,
"Are you able to summon Aeons where you're from as well?!" With the talk turning towards summoning, Lucy finally looked back up and calmed herself before saying,
"I don't know about 'Aeons', but where I'm from we can form contracts and summon Spirits." As she said that, Lucy produced a ornate silver key and declared,
"Open the gate of Canis Minor, PLUE!" With her magic power draining several times more than if she would have summoned it on Earthland, a flash of light appeared in the place where Lucy held out the silver key that vanished to reveal a certain short figure in its stead.
An unusual creature, Plue only came up to most people's waist and was completely white with a bulbous head and canine-like paws, while a carrot-like nose extended out from the center of his face. His entire body was shaking noticeably as he looked around at all the people around him, before saying as if in greeting,
"Pu-pun!" Lucy smiled widely as she scooped the little spirit into her arms, and looked at Yuna as if to show him off as she said,
"Isn't he adorable?" All three of the Gullwings cocked their heads to the side as they examined Plue's appearance, before Paine finally said,
"It certainly is.....unique." Rikku, now distracted from her earlier embarrassment, added,
"Yeah, but I don't see how it would be useful in a fight?" Lucy however shook her head as she explained,
"Plue isn't for fighting, spirits like him are usually kept around as pets and companions because they cost so little magic power to summon. Since we're not on Earthland though, where I and my keys come from, the cost to summon just one of my spirits is several times higher, so I settled with just summoning Plue for now."
Nodding his head as if in agreement, Plue made the same unusual sound he made earlier as if he was trying to speak to them, but no one understood what he was trying to say. Taking advantage of the momentary pause, Rikku asked Lucy,
"Didn't Alex also say something about taming too? Does that mean that you can tame fiends as well?" Lucy nodded energetically when Rikku asked her that, and she gently set Plue down before her as she pulled out another key and said,
"Yep, I've also been using a type of magic Alex taught me to tame and power up monsters, or fiends as you call them, to help me fight as well! This is one I tamed just yesterday!" As she said that, Lucy held out the second key that was tied to the virtual world that Lala made for her to store all of the monsters she tamed in.
"Come on out, Tom!" Lucy cried out as there was another flash of light, except this time it was in the shape of a magic circle large enough for another figure roughly the size of Plue to walk through. What came out though was something that none of them, except the trio that had been traveling with Lucy the day before, expected.
"Holy shit!" Alex cried out as he grabbed Kurumu and Moka and leapt backwards suddenly, genuine fear showing on his face for the first time that any of the girls had ever seen. He wasn't the only one though as Yuna, Rikku, and Paine all similarly leapt backwards while preparing for battle, and numerous residents of the village quickly fled further back as well.
What had appeared was a creature that Alex knew all too well from his previous experiences of playing Final Fantasy games, and had fueled many a player's nightmares.
It looked like a waist high upright amphibian with smooth dark green skin, and bulbous yellow eyes.
