Unlike most fiends it wore a hooded robe with the hood down, while a finned tail poked out from the back, and in its left hand was a lantern that cast an eerie light on their surroundings, even in the morning sunlight. In its right hand though was a sharp butcher's knife that was covered in a reddish-brown substance, which was obviously numerous splotches of blood in various stages of drying.
The thing Lucy had somehow tamed, was none other than the terrifying Tonberry.
It was a fiend capable of killing almost any opponent with single attack, which, depending on the game, was either due to each attack dealing a stupidly large amount of damage, or because every one of their attacks carried the attribute of Death. On top of that they were exceedingly difficult to kill due to their high health pools in the games, making them one of the most terrifying opponents one could ask for.
Seemingly oblivious to the alarm her new companion amused around them, Lucy knelt down and wrapped her arms around the Tonberry, Tom, as if she were snuggling a cute animal or plushy. Meanwhile the Tonberry just stared at Alex with its blank and bulbous yellow eyes, seemingly devoid of any intelligent thoughts, but Alex was pretty urge the only thing going through its mind was, 'stab, stab, stab, stab'.
"Isn't Tom adorable?" Lucy asked as she turned her attention back onto Alex, her eyes shining excitedly. And while Alex had to admit there was a certain 'cuteness' to a Tonberry's appearance, there was a significant difference to a stuffed Tonberry and one in the flesh.
"Sure...." Alex practically groaned as he stared intently at the Tonberry, as if daring it to make a move against one of his wives. Lucy however nodded as if it was obvious, and continued,
"Not only do he and Plue get along well, but Tom also told me where to find more like him so I can tame a whole group!" The entire left side of Alex's face twitched when he heard that there'd be an entire group of Tonberrys that Lucy planned to tame, though thankfully something else happened at that moment to distract him from such a thought.
Plue walked right up to the Tonberry as Lucy was in the middle of hugging it, and waved its paw while saying to it,
"Pun-pun!" The Tonberry then looked away from Alex for the first time as it turned its attention to Plue, but obviously didn't say anything in return.
"..."
"Pu-pun!"
"..."
"Puuuuuuuun." Plue then seemingly ended the conversation while nodding its head, and stroking its chin like they had been discussing a form of philosophy, or something enlightening.
...
Thus was the rather unusual start to an otherwise fun day.
After Lucy sent 'Tom' back her virtual space, more and more women joined them along with Alex's older children, before they then had a day of just enjoying themselves in southern Besaid sun.
With Wakka and Yuna acting as their guides, they were able to visit most of the interesting spots on the island to play at, from the same sandy beach they arrived on, to even numerous water filled caverns that crisis-crossed under the island itself. Of course at first Wakka, Yuna and the others were worried about the children being allowed to roam freely across the island, but after they witnessed the children 'play' with a fiend to death their worries mostly vanished.

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - 425: The Youth League
chapters.content:
With the crisp sound of the trumpet echoing throughout the entire village, all but the heaviest of sleepers were shocked awake at the sound. Many of them then grumbled in irritation due to the late night they had before bed, and several people rose to give the jerk a piece of their mind.
Outside though they found someone none of them knew in the center of the village, who had an obvious look of judgment on his face despite it being half covered. Then a certain group of men appeared from one of the tents, and one of them cried out,
"Hey! What's the big idea, ya?" Turning to them, the man asked in a condescending tone,
"Are you the Blitzball team, the Besaid Aurochs?" Looking confused, one of them, a man with red hair tied back in a bun and a bandage stretched across his nose, asked,
"Yeah? What about it?" The masked man sneered as he stated,
"You all won't last long in the Youth League with an attitude like that! And here I was thinking you wanted to join us!" The men's faces immediately became sheepish as they realized who it was they were talking to, a representative of the newly founded Youth League, sent to train them in order to become the Besaid branch of the League.
Someone else however approached at the moment, Rikku, who angrily stated,
"Even if they're joining the League you didn't need to wake us all up! Who do you think you are!?" The man turned towards her, and, upon noticing Yuna behind her, sneered in contempt before saying,
"I am Beclem of the Youth League, and the way I train our new recruits isn't any of your concern." He then went to turn back towards the Aurochs, only for Paine to remark,
"It is our concern when you wake up the entire village." Looking around at the dozens of angry and sleepy people, Beclem snorted again before saying,
"And? This place is too lax as it is. You could all use a major reality check." Of course Beclem's remark only earned him numerous groans while others muttered rude remarks about him under their breaths. However a certain siren quickly made her way over to him as well as she snapped at him,
"Why on Spira would you even wake the children up like that!?" Sun actually had to use one of her Songs to put them back to sleep for a few more hours, something that left a horrible taste in her mouth.
"And how is that my problem exactly?" He replied snarkily, before turning his attention back towards the Aurochs.
"Now then! I'm here on League orders to whip you all into shape, and I only have so long to do so. Now then, give me a lap around the entire island you slackers!" While many of the Aurochs grumbled and complained, none of them disobeyed Beclem's order since they had willingly joined the Youth League to begin with.
"What a jerk!" Rikku snapped as Beclem followed his new recruits out of the village, to which many of the other villagers voiced their agreement as some tried to go back to bed, while a few others decided they might as well start the day.
It was at that point though that Alex finally showed himself, emerging from his tent alone while wearing a pair of shorts.
"What's all the commotion?" Alex asked while stifling a yawn, unaware of what happened due to the silencing barrier he put up the night before. Though while the three Gullwings immediately averted their gazes as their faces returned red, Sun explained,

"Are the children still asleep?" Alex asked her. Sun nodded in affirmation and said,
"Yes, I used one of my Songs to keep them from making a fuss." Though she was worried about Alex getting mad at her for using her Songs on his children, he just nodded slowly before kissing the top of her head and saying with appreciation,
"Thank you, we'll let them sleep for a couple more hours while we get ready to go." Though she hesitated to look in Alex's general direction, Yuna asked him,
"S-so we're still leaving today?" Alex nodded and said,
"Yes. I want to try and make it to Kilika around noon and we'll spend the afternoon and night there, before leaving and arriving in Luca tomorrow." The sky was completely cleared of any cloud cover, and there was still giant hole in the middle of the ocean where sea had yet to rush back in to fill. Meanwhile the entire section of the cliffs where Erza had stood were now crumbling into the sea, and almost every single one of the League members were still picking themselves up off the ground.
Though he knew it was a moot point, Nooj grabbed a nearby telescope and quickly scanned the horizon, confirming what he already knew as he couldn't spot a single fiend that had escaped Erza's attack.
Nooj then recalled what Sephie said before about Asora being an inter-dimensional empire, and shuddered at the thought of how many monsters they had hidden away since one person had managed to pull off something like this. Recalling also that Sephie said this Dragon Emperor wanted peace, Nooj then began to rethink his plans of traveling to Kilika for a sphere he'd heard the temple there had hidden away.

chapters.title: Chapter 426 - 426: Interview
chapters.content:
While Sephie, Erza, and Shizuku were dealing with the Youth League, Alex and the others had arrived and were enjoying themselves at Kilika island.
Not only was the island a fair bit bigger and more populated than Besaid, but it also had more of a energetic atmosphere than laid back. With most of the island's population living in a port town, it was built almost entirely on the wooden docks that housed wooden huts, numerous fishing boats, and trade ships.
Also unlike Besaid was the heavy amount of Youth League presence in the port town, due to the League being the ones to help rebuild it after Sin destroyed the town two years prior. Meanwhile the supporters of New Yevon were mostly located deeper into the island's interior, in the temple at the top of a mountain that was surrounded by a fiend infested jungle.
Immediately after they landed Lucy and Lala made their way into the jungle in their search for fiends and Machina, while the rest of them just walked around the port town to take in the sights and visit with the local people, with the children in particular creating a ruckus as they excitedly ran up and down the docks. Yuna especially was welcomed warmly by the people as she had been there immediately after Sin's attack two years prior, and helped the people as much as she could during her stay there.
Similarly to Besaid, the people threw together a last minute party to celebrate Yuna's visit, except this one was much more lively with fast paced music and dancing, as well as whole roasted animals for everyone to feast on throughout the night. Alex's wives that were present enjoyed the night very much as well, as he took them one at a time onto the dance floor to show off their moves as well. Needless to say they were the center of attention quite a bit due to every one of them being able to perform some superhuman feats.
Surprising them, Alex even dragged Yuna, Rikku, and Paine out onto the dance floor as well once he had danced with each of his wives, earning them numerous looks as rumors began to fly since he had arrived with them, and the trio hadn't danced with anyone else.
And so, their brief stay on Kilika was filled with festivities and fun until every one of them collapsed into bed late at night.
...
Meanwhile, at the same time at the edge of a mystical frozen wood, a group of rough looking Al Bhed men were searching around a solitary building for someone.
"Where is that slimy weasel?" One of the men growled angrily as he searched through one of the rooms in the building, a former Travel Agency that offer board and items to travelers in need.
"He must have fled into the woods." One of his companions snapped in irritation as they regrouped on the road outside.
It was a one way road that led to either the beautiful, but extremely treacherous Macalania Woods, or down to the deep frozen chasm lake that had swallowed the Macalania Temple two years prior. With the other direction being a dead end, the group naturally assumed their quarry fled into the deadly woods.
"Damn it, let the woods have him. I'm not about to risk my neck searching them off of the main path for a deadbeat." The rest of the men nodded in agreement, as none of them dared to explore the woods off of the main trail they took to get there on their Machina. Finally the leader of the group said,
"Alright, we'll give up for now, but we'll also come back in a few days to see if he survived. Either the woods'll take him, or we'll beat his debt out of him. Let's go!" With his command, the men began preparing their Machina to leave, large vehicles that were propelled by a giant fan on skis.
Meanwhile the very man they were looking for cowered on top of the former Travel Agency itself, shaking his head at himself as he muttered in self deprecation,
"Oh O'aka XXIII(23rd), you've right gone and done it this time! Not only did you go and buy a Travel Agency that isn't ever visited anymore, but you even went and got into debt just to buy the darned thing! What are you going to do now?" Just as O'aka was about to give into despair, and the debt collectors were about to leave, something happened that none of them would have ever dared to imagine, even in their wildest dreams.
The entire sky suddenly lit up as a massive magic circle appeared above them, casting an eerie silver light down onto the Travel Agency and the men around it. Then, as if that wasn't frightening enough, the entire world around them began to shake and shudder as something massive began moving within the deep chasm.
"Let's get out of here!" One of the Al Bhed cried out as they all fled on their Machina, unknowingly leaving O'aka alone to deal with the current situation.
"Oh, what is a poor and lonesome O'aka to do in this situation!?" He wailed in despair and fright of whatever fiend could possibly cause such a phenomenon, until O'aka just so happened to look up.
There, in the light of the magic circle, O'aka noticed a beautiful woman dressed in unusual, but very appealing, white and black clothes, with long flowing silver hair. With his gaze transfixed on her in awe, it was only when the ground beneath the Travel Agency began to shake even more violently that he switched his focus back to the chasm that had swallowed the temple.
What he saw there shocked him beyond words, as the ruins of the temple slowly rose up out if the depths.
***
"WOW!" The children exclaimed excitedly as they swiftly approached one of the largest cities in Spira, the seaside city of Luca.
Though Alex and his peerage members had arrived in Luca when they first came to Spira, this was the first time the children saw the numerous ships that dwarfed those they saw in Kilika, and the large stadium that was usually used for the Blitzball tournaments. It was also the first time they actually saw people from the numerous races of Spira as they got closer to the docks, where they could see the Guado, Hypello, and the rare Ronso walking about.
Though they were happily babbling about how excited they were to see all the new people, Alex furrowed his brows when he watched a Ronso pass by a small group of Guado, his jaw clenched and fist clenched. Thankfully though the Ronso kept his rage in check and passed by the Guado without incident, but Alex knew it was only a matter of time before his entire people decided to avenge those who were killed by Seymour Guado.
For the moment though, Alex turned his attention towards the gathering crowds of people at the docks they were headed to, all of which were pointing and staring at the very unusual and large ship pulling in. Of course the attention they were receiving only multiplied once people noticed Yuna standing on the deck, and the already large crowd exploded in size as people clambered to see her after the concert that Leblanc put on while impersonating her.
"Smile and wave to your adoring public, High Summoner Yuna." Paine told Yuna with a slight smirk as they prepared to disembark, to which the High Summoner replied sadly,
"But all I want is some peace and quiet..." Rikku then snuck up to Alex and whispered,
"Poor thing, she's lived such a sheltered life." Paine then added,
"Maybe she's getting old." Yuna then whirled around and demanded,
"Who's getting old!?" Paine and Rikku then snickered at Yuna's outburst, while even Alex chuckled lightly at her expense. The High Summoner then stamped her foot and pouted cutely as she turned her back to them, but had to put on a different expression as they got closer to the people.
Once they finally left Zenith's deck to step onto the docks, Yuna was instantly swarmed by her adoring public.
"Lady Yuna! Can I have your autograph?"
"Lady Yuna, over here!"
"Will you be doing another concert lady Yuna?!"
Everyone on all sides bombarded the befuddled High Summoner with rapid fire questions, leaving her no room to answer until a certain person approached them with what appeared to be a camera
"Lady Yuna! A word for the local sphere broadcasting station!?" A girl asked who was adorned in green and orange robes with a matching hat that was pointed on either side of her head.
"This is Shelinda from the Luca sphere broadcast station, would you please give us a statement regarding your recent performance Lady Yuna?" With the girl's mike being offered to her, the crowds around them went silent as they awaited Yuna's answer.
"Well," Yuna began quietly, not sure of how to respond. "In a way it was me, but not really."
"Puzzling words to be sure." Shelinda replied, before asking next,
"And what about your recent activities as leader of the Gullwings? Two years of silence on Besaid and then a concert, and now a sphere hunter of all thing? Is there a boy involved?" Again there was silence as everyone anxiously waited for Yuna's answer.
"Well firstly I'm not the leader of the Gullwings, Brother is. And secondly, the reason I joined is private." Yuna smirked playfully at that last part as she intentionally left everyone guessing, but what Shelinda asked next made her mood do a complete flip.
"And what of the rumors regarding a marriage arrangement between yourself and the son of the former New Yevon Praetor? Will such an arrangement carry over to to the current Praetor of New Yevon, Praetor Baralai?" Though Yuna's expressions went through a series of changes throughout Shelinda's questioning, her response was to ask,
"There's a new Praetor of New Yevon?" Shelinda nodded and replied,
"Indeed. The former Praetor was recently asked to resign, and the new Praetor, Baralai, was elected to take his place. Does this mean the marriage arrangement hasn't carried over?" Yuna immediately shook her head as she fairly stated,
"The marriage arrangement was a one sided request from the former Praetor, that I repeatedly turned down. There is no marriage." Ending her declaration with a huff, Shelinda and few others giggled until the next person stepped down from Zenith's decks, drawing everyone's attention with his size, wild hair, red fur, and the small army of children clinging onto him.
"And who is this?" Shelinda asked Yuna, who would obviously know his identity since they had gotten off the same unusual ship. Yuna however hesitated for a second, before Alex suddenly spoke up as he introduced himself,
"I am Alexander Morningstar, the Dragon Emperor."
His words sparked a series of murmuring and muttering since no one had ever heard of an Emperor in Spira before, and even the reporter Shelinda was dazed for a moment before she remembered herself, and asked,
"And what is your relationship with Lady Yuna?" Alex then glanced at Yuna, Rikku, and Paine, the edge of his lips curled up in a smirk that made all three blush and look away embarrassedly, before he answered,
"I'm currently employing the Gullwings to show me around Spira, since I've never been to this land before." Again, Alex's words caused a stir since he made it sound as if he wasn't from Spira, which Shelinda immediately asked for confirmation about.
"Are you saying that you aren't from Spira?" Alex nodded and said,
"Yes. I and my wives came to Spira in order to explore it and to establish peaceful relations with its people, as well as to study some of the unique Machina, spheres, and fiends that are found here. It is also our intentions to find a place to establish as a sort of base in Spira, allowing us to trade and regularly interact with Spirans of all races."
More and more people began to mutter in interest at Alex's answer, before Shelinda sadly said,
"We're all out of time, but I think I speak for all of Spira when I say we're anxious and excited to see what you will bring to Spira, Mr. Dragon Emperor." At Shelinda's cue the person operating the camera stopped filming as they prepared to leave, while numerous people also tried to shuffle the crowds away to give Yuna and her companions some room.
"Phew." Shelinda let out a sigh as she turned to Yuna, and asked, "Now that that's over, how have you been Lady Yuna?" Yuna flashed a genuine smile at Shelinda, and answered,
"I've been good, but you've certainly changed in the last two years Shelinda. I hardly recognized you." Shelinda however smiled wryly and replied,
"Maybe. I still feel like the same old me, though I do enjoy what I'm doing a bit more than when I was with the temples." The two and Rikku then spent a few minutes catching up, as Shelinda was a big supporter of Yuna's during her pilgrimage two years prior, before someone called out to her and she said,
"'Sorry to cut this short Lady Yuna, but my ship is about to leave. I have to head to Bevelle since a major story came up in Macalania." Yuna cocked her head to the side curiously, and asked,
"Oh? What kind of story?" Shelinda's eyes lit up as she excitedly told them,
"Last night there were numerous reports from Bevelle of an eerie light filling the skies in the direction of Macalania temple, and the earth began to shake as if there had been an earthquake. We haven't confirmed anything yet, but some reports state that the temple has risen out of the lake and been restored! I'm going to report on it now!" As Shelinda's eyes shone excitedly, her name was called once again by a group of people nearby, prompting her to say goodbye one last time before running off.
"Did something really happen to the temple?" Yuna uttered out loud with conflicted feelings, after all her last visit to the temple had been marked with her killing Seymour Guado in battle, being branded traitors of Yevon for doing so, the temple being knocked down into the frozen lake below, and then Yuna being whisked away into the arms of the undead Seymour, who tried to force her to marry him. Rikku however then took her hand as she said,
"Whatever happened, I'm sure we'll get to see it when we go by there." She then turned towards Alex, who nodded and said,
"Of course, we still have a few days yet before we reach the Macalania woods to prepare yourself." Yuna nodded slowly as they finally began to move forward through the crowds.
Though Luca was much larger than Besaid and Kilika put together, they didn't intend to spend much time there since Alex and his group had first arrived in the city. Instead they were only slowed down when the children who hadn't been to Luca yet spotted something that they wanted, like a plushy or a type of treat they had hadn't seen before.
When they finally reached the edge of the city though, they found a grassy expanse stretching out to meet them that marked the entrance to the Mi'ihen Highroad.
With only towering ruins dotting the immediate landscape, rolling grassy plains surrounded them in every direction but behind where the city was, though Alex could also see evidence of numerous mountains and canyons in the distance. Instead of the peaceful silence one would expect here though, there was actually quite a bit of noise around them due to the nearby Chocobo rental station, and the numerous Al Bhed machina that surrounded them.
"Welcome to the Mi'ihen Highroad." Yuna said as she swung her arms out wide, while the children excitedly gasped and flocked to the Chocobo rentals. Alex chuckled at their behavior before Lucy spoke up from behind him,
"So I take it that we'll part ways here for a few days?" Turning to look at her, Lala, Kurumu, Shia, Sun, Yami, and Moka, Alex nodded as he said,
"Yep, let's try to get everything we need to done in Spira before my timer runs out, but remember there's no real hurry since I intend to install a gate." Every one of his wives nodded in affirmation, before going to say their goodbyes to the three Gullwings for now, and causing quite a stir by taking flight.
With it just being Alex and Sun once again, he then approached his children as they happily petted the Chocobos. The owners of the rental station just smiled warmly as they watched over the children petting and trying to feed their Chocobos, until Alex approached them and apologized for any trouble they might have been. He then turned towards the kids and said,
"Alright, are you all ready for your 'big adventure'?" Immediately the children looked at him, some with excitement, and some with hesitation since they wanted to continue playing with the Chocobos.
"Are you coming with us daddy?" Edith quickly asked, before looking dejected as Alex shook his head as he told them,
"No, daddy has some things he needs to do. Besides, this is YOUR adventure. I want all of you to go out there and have fun exploring together, seeing new places and fighting new fiends as you do so. Sun will watch over you all to make sure none of you get into trouble though." As he said that the petite siren stepped forward, prompting the children to gather around her as she laid out the few ground rules they needed to follow, such as to watch out for one another, and to not get separated while traveling.
As Alex approached the three Gullwings, Yuna anxiously asked him,
"Are you sure about this? Some fiends can be really dangerous." Alex nodded slowly before saying,
"Yeah, I believe that they need to be able to get out and see what's out there for themselves, spread their wings so to speak. But I'm also not going to throw them to the wolves, that's why Sun will be watching over them." With Sun having learned numerous 'songs' that prioritized healing and protection, he had no problem with her watching over the children as they explored; plus there was the fact that if she needed, the siren could instantly wipe out all life in several miles around them with her attacks.
Though they hadn't seen Sun getting serious with her abilities, the three girls decided to trust in Alex's judgement since they had seen just how much he cared for his children over the last few days. Nodding her head, Yuna then asked,
"Ok, then how do you want to proceed?" Alex smirked as he said excitedly,
"Isn't it obvious? We need to ride some Chocobos!"
***
While Alex and his family were preparing for the next stage of their respective adventures, a group of Al Bhed raced across the burning hot sands of the Bikanel Desert in their large gliders. Despite the giant fan roaring right behind her though, the leader of the group, a woman with short blonde hair named Nhadala, was deep in thought.
The night before the desert had been lit up with an eerie purple light that had caused their excavation encampment to go on high alert, prompting her to call back all of their deployed men and women in case the light was an indication of some kind of danger. When her men tried to calculate where the light was coming from though, the location they gave her sent chills down the spines of every Al Bhed present.
That was why she was now leading nearly all the men under her control to investigate, while a select few had remained behind to report to the leader of the Machine Faction, Gippal, if they didn't return. As even the early morning sun burned down on them, the group raced through sands to reach their destination as swiftly as possible.
When they finally crested the last dune between them and their target though, all of the Al Bhed powered down their Machina as they stared at their destination in awe, and sadness.
"E lyh'd pameaja ed..."(I can't believe it) One of them muttered as they fell to their knees, tears streaming down their face after they removed their goggles. All around him though several other Al Bhed were having similar reactions, while Nhadala was having a hard time keeping the waterworks back herself.
After all, before them was the one place they never thought they'd see again. A place that had been blown up two years prior after all of the Al Bhed fled in the wake of an attack led by the Guado. The only place they had been welcomed in all of Spira until the truths of Yevon were brought to light.
Home.
Seeing the sole Al Bhed city, Home, restored once again reduced many of the men Nhadala had under her to sobbing wrecks, which she couldn't blame as she too tried to fight the urge to begin sobbing uncontrollably from seeing the ruins. Instead, she steeled herself before snapping at those same men,
"Alright! This isn't the time to be standing around wailing like a bunch of children! I want you, you, and you to head back to camp and report this! Send word to Gippal and Cid so they can spread it to the rest of the Al Bhed!" As the men she pointed out began to hurry back to their Machina to race back to their encampment, Nhadala turned to the rest of them as she continued,
"The rest of you are with me! We're going down there to investigate and see what happened! We're going home." With the last bit being notably softer in tone, the men quickly returned to the Machina as well as they quickly raced down to the metal spires that marked Home.

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - 427: The Great (Mini)Saiyan Adventure!
chapters.content:
*WHOOSH!*
*WHOOSH!*
*WHOOSH!*
*WHOOSH!*
Across the grassy plains of the Mi'ihen Highroad, much too far from the actual road to be considered safe, a number of small figures moved like a blur as they sped through the land.
Even as they approached a giant canyon that housed a raging river at its bottom, the figures simply leapt across and kept moving without slowing down in the slightest. Above them though was a solitary figure that flew gracefully through the skies, her white feathered wings spread on either side as she enjoyed the wind rushing through her feathers.
Sun watched on as the mini Saiyans raced below her, a wry smile on her lips as they steadily approached a more forested area. There the one in the lead, the only non-Saiyan of the group, held up her hand and said,
"Let's take a quick break here." With everyone coming to a stop behind her, Alec complained,
"But Myuu, were not tired yet!" With the other Saiyans complaining that they could go on as well, Myuu turned towards them and said sternly,
"I know, but this isn't training. What if a fiend shows up and every is too tired to fight it? We need to take plenty of breaks and make sure we eat plenty of snacks to keep out energy up!" Though she hadn't even turned ten yet, Myuu had matured quite quickly due to her role as everyone else's big sister. So, despite her being the weakest of the group, the rest of the children heeded her words as they sat down to take a break, not that any of them wanted to refuse when Myuu mentioned snacks.
As she watched over them from above, Sun silently praised Myuu's decision to call for a break to refuel, since they did never know when a fiend would show up. As if to prove exactly that, a screech on the wind drew Sun's attention as she looked out over the horizon to see a large fiend flying towards them.
It was none other than the massive Zu, a flying fiend that was as black as night, with a large mouth filled with razor sharp teeth.
As it approached their location though, Sun decide to let the children enjoy their rest as she pursed her lips, and let out a sharp a crisp whistle. Immediately the Zu, infamous for being a deadly and powerful fiend to fight against, exploded in a rain of blood and gore that quickly disappeared as it dissolved into Pyreflies.
And all with the children being none the wiser.
Eventually they all finished eating their snacks, just a drop in the bucket of what they had stored in their own storage rings, before Lizzy asked,
"Myuu, why don't we just fly instead of running the entire time?" Instead of Myuu though, it was Edith who answered as she replied,
"Don't you know anything Lizzy!? It's not an adventure if you just fly everywhere! How are you supposed to have fun then?!" Myuu, Mai, Alec, and Anna all nodded in agreement as, while flying was fun, if you simply flew everywhere then you'd miss out on all the cool things that were on the ground. They could all fly whenever they wanted, but this was their big chance to have a 'real' adventure, there was no way any of them wanted to cut corners by flying.
And as if to prove Edith's point, the brush all around them started rustling as numerous fiends suddenly appeared.
"Alright! A workout after snack time!" Alec cried out excitedly as they all got ready to fight.
Out of the brush came an entire group of fiends that looked at the children like they found a tasty snack themselves, only for the children to look back at them with excitement. Among them were several different colored Flans(slimes), Geckos, Fly Eyes(giant eyeballs with bat-like wings), and a single Takouba leading them.
While her siblings split up to deal with the Flans, Fly Eyes, and Geckos themselves, Myuu turned her attention towards the Takouba that approached her. It had a long slender body with a matching tail, and four long legs that ended on the pointed tips that it balanced on.
Despite not possessing magic or unique abilities like the rest of the gathered fiends, the legs and whip-like tail of the Takouba were instead razor sharp like the edge of a word, making each of its movements deadly if one wasn't careful. Myuu wasn't worried about that though, as she raised her fists that were covered in a silvery metallic material.
"Let's test out the new weapon papa gave me!" Myuu declared as the substance covering her hands and forearms began to move like a liquid according to her whims. When it became still though, Myuu looked as if she now had two long sickle-like blades extending from both of her wrists, both of which possessed a short barb that curved inward on the end.
For a moment neither she nor the Takouba moved, both sizing the other up as they stared at each other, before both suddenly disappeared from their previous positions.
*CLANG!*
A metallic clang rang out as Myuu's sickles collided with one of the Takouba's bladed limbs, only for it to suddenly unfold twice as the extra length curled around her sickles to slash at her.
"!!!" Though alarmed, Myuu swiftly disengaged and lunged back to avoid the elongated blades as it whipped around, which shaved off a lock of her hair as the tip just barely missed her head.
Seeing the few strands of her emerald hair flutter to the ground, Myuu glared at the Takouba with anger as she prepared to attack again. This time however the sickle on her left hand turned into a liquid once again as it flowed back towards her hand, before solidifying as small buckler.
No sooner than when her buckler formed did another clang ring out as the Takouba's bladed forelegs collided with it, only to sink slightly into the liquid metal before it hardened around them again. With its forelegs stuck in her buckler, Myuu flashed a confident smirk before she swung the barbed sickle around one last time, hooking the barb on the Takouba's throat and cutting it open in one swift movement before it tried to use its tail instead.
The fiend shuddered as thick dark red blood poured out of it's neck, before it was replaced by the glowing Pyreflies that all fiends were actually made of. And as the fiend dissolved away in front of her, Myuu took a moment to admire the gauntlets her papa gave her as she tried a few different ways to use them, such as making numerous spikes come out of her knuckles, or hooked claws on the tips of her fingers.
"I love these papa!" Myuu muttered to herself, before turning to see how her younger siblings were fairing against their own opponents, a sight that left her fairly exasperated.
Wether they used magic, their own skills, or simply their fists, the area around them had taken quite the beating as the mini-Saiyans defeated their opponents. Currently the only fiends left were a couple of the Flans that Regal was facing, and were red in color...
"Burn already!" The Phoenix/Saiyan growled in annoyance as he summoned yet another pillar of fire that swallowed the Flans whole, only for them to emerge looking healthier than before. They would then in turn use their own fire magic to attack Regal, which was, needless to say, useless against a Phoenix.
Again the two sides used their own brand of magic, back and forth, with neither gaining ground on the other until finally Lizzy appears to have enough, and waved her heart-shaped magic wand at the Flans while also doing a little dance.
"Freeze my enemies, Magical Li-Li Tan!" With a wave of her wand and a twirl of her skirts, Lizzy then summoned numerous heart shaped blasts of freezing cold wind that froze the red Flans solid, before they shattered into hundreds of pieces.
"They were mine!" Regal immediately whined at his sister, who snapped back,
"Well obviously fire wasn't hurting them! You should have used ice magic!" Regal however appeared offended as he proudly declared,
"I am a Phoenix! My flames will conquer all!" When they heard that the rest of the children just shook their heads at their brother, while Myuu couldn't help but think to herself that Regal needed to worry about his flames torching regular enemies before trying to outdo fireproof ones.
Even Sun shook her head from above since combat 101 was that if one tactic didn't work, switch it up. Every single one of the mini-Saiyans were trained in their own unique abilities, AND physical combat. If his flames hadn't hurt the Flans, then Regal should have just directly pummeled them into goo.
Though Myuu still took a few minutes to scold Regal for his actions, while also pointing out that their father would be disappointed in him struggling against such weak enemies, the children soon left after the battle to continue their adventure.
As the day wore on they covered miles of ground, exploring, fighting, snacking, until the sun began to dip upon the horizon. With dusk settling in the children began to search for an area to camp for the night, as camping was a big part of having an adventure.
They searched the area around them when Mai noticed a ruined tower in the distance, which they all promptly agreed to go and check out. Upon arriving though, they heard something else already moving within.
"Ugh! There's nothing here Pacce!" A young sounding voice cried out, to which another one answered,
"Keep looking then! There has to be a sphere around here somewhere!" The noise of the group searching the interior of the ruined tower grew as the children approached it, until a face peeked out of one of the holes in the wall.
"Uh Pacce, someone's here!" Immediately two more heads poked out to see who was coming, before all three rushed forward to block their way.
"Stop! We found this place first, any spheres here are ours!" Their leader, Pacce, cried out. Edith however cocked her head to the side in confusion, and said,
"Spheres? We just thought this might be a good place to camp. Why would we be interested in any spheres?" When they heard that the trio of children seemed to relax slightly, as their leader hesitantly asked,
"So you're not sphere hunters too?"
"Sphere hunters~Nya?" Mai asked this time, before Lizzy followed up,
"What are sphere hunters?" Pacce and the other two children gaped at them in shock, before one of them remarked,
"Sphere hunters hunt spheres of course!" Pacce nodded and said proudly,
"We're sphere hunters!" Pacce and the one on his right then made a pose before declaring loudly,
""THE KINDERGUARDIANS!""
A second later the other member got into their own pose, and added late,
"The Kinderguardians!"
Watching the display, Edith and others started giggling while Sun shook her head above them with a wry smile. When they got out of their pose though, Pacce then asked them,
"So who are all of you?" Myuu then stepped forward and said,
"I'm Myuu, and these are my little brothers and sisters." She then went down the line to introduce every single one, before concluding, "We're all on an adventure to explore Spira!" When he heard that Pacce suddenly got a serious look, as he told them,
"You should be careful, exploring Spira can dangerous with all the fiends around." This earned him and his companions numerous looks from the children, as Alec retorted,
"What about you three?" Pacce grinned smugly as he declared,
"I was a Guardian for my brother, Isaaru, when he was a Summoner! I was trained to defend him from fiends, and I taught Taro and Hana when we formed the Kinderguardians!" The trio then grinned cheekily while looking smug, making Sun shake her head above them as she watched on, but then something else took her attention that was rapidly approaching the group of children.
Though she was tempted to intervene like she did the Zu earlier, Sun ended up deciding not to since she knew Alex would want to let his children test themselves. They themselves also noticed the rapidly approaching fiend as it made their surroundings shake, and crashed through whatever was in the way of the prey it smelled.
Immediately all of the Kinderguardian's bravado disappeared as they realized what was approaching, while Myuu and the others grew increasingly excited as they awaited the next challenger. When it finally showed itself though, with massive horns, fangs, and claws, rippling muscles, and murder in its eyes, the children grew excited for an entirely different reason as the same thought seemed to cross all of their minds.
"ITS A PUPPY!" Edith cried out.
***
Meanwhile, in a completely different are of the Mi'ihen Highroads, a solitary figure flew through the skies as she searched for her quarry below. Not seeing what she was after though, Anne sighed as she slowed to a stop and contemplated returning to Asora for the night.
She had spent the last few days searching for Chocobos to round up, and bring to Asora to establish their own flocks for the people to ride and interact with. So far she had not only found a few such flocks that she'd brought with her, but also a couple good candidates to bring to Asora with her to raise and care for them, a young girl named Calli, and a young man named Clasko.
Both being Chocobo enthusiasts, they had readily agreed to Anne's offer when she told them who she was, and that she wanted them to care for the Chocobos she brought to Asora.
Now however she was searching for one last decent sized flock to migrate before turning her attention onto the massive Shoopuffs, except it appeared like all of the Chocobos in the area had vanished. No matter when she looked Anne couldn't find even a single Chocobo running about, which was strange because she knew she hadn't taken that many.
Deciding to look around just a bit longer before turning in for the night, Anne descended to the ground to see if there were any tracks that she could follow. What surprised her though, was that not far from where she landed Anne found numerous tracks from what appeared to be a huge flock of Chocobos that had passed by not too long ago.
The thing that caught Anne's attention though was that there was also several strange tracks that she had never seen before mixed in with the Chocobos, making her think that the giant birds might have been fleeing from something and that had been why she couldn't find any. Her decision made, Anne immediately took off in the direction that the tracks led to find the Chocobos and whatever it was that chasing them.
Flying low to the ground, Anne rushed over the plains of the Highroad as she neared a series of canyons and ravines that rose up overhead, following the tracks as they led led straight into these very same ravines. She then wove through the maze-like area as she searched for the large birds, until a sudden cry alerted her that she was close.
Rounding a corner, Anne finally found herself face-to-face with the largest flock of Chocobos she'd seen yet, and the things that were apparently trying to make a meal of them.
There were three of them, fiends that about twice as tall as normal person, but almost the entire main body was composed of their head. They had two arms that extended out for more that twice their body length, and ended with a series of hook-shaped claws designed for grabbing prey without it getting free. And when one turned for her to see its front, Anne saw a massive mouth that had several long fangs, two purple tongues side-by-side, and even several disgusting bugs that were crawling around its teeth.
As the fiend, a Chocobo Eater, cornered its next meal, Anne watched with increasing horror as it swiped the nearest Chocobo with its large talons, and swept the poor thing into its enormous mouth.
"KWEEEEEE-GURK!" The Chocobo cried out in pain and fear as the massive jaws came down onto it, before its cry was cut short as it was crunched to death by the fiend.
Within seconds the fiend had finished eating the poor creature, before it turned its attention towards the next one. With three of them eating like that, Anne knew the entire flock would be wiped out if she didn't do anything.
Using her Sky Dragon Slayer magic to enhance her speed, Anne rushed forward and leapt in between the Chocobos and the Eaters while also using earth-bending to create a short wall between the two groups to protect them. While the Chocobos looked at her with caution and curiosity, the Eaters glared at Anne as if aware that she was going to stand between them and their meal.
"GRAAAAAA!" One roared as it charged her, to which Anne calmly said,
"Sorry, but not today you ugly son of a-" Whatever she said next was downed out by the sound of a roaring inferno as Anne produced a ball of fire in her hand, and turned it into a raging flamethrower right into the Eater's face and open mouth before it reached her, making the fiend screech as it burned.
As the fiend ran off screeching from the pain, the other two Eaters turned their attention towards Anne, their beady eyes narrowing dangerously as they both began to move to encircle, and entrap her. Anne however calmed herself, steadying her breathing as focused on her power over the elements, instead of just relying on her slayer and telekinesis abilities.
The first eater was blasted backwards by a pillar of rock that shot up from the ground, launching back and into the air before it crashed into ground, hard. It wouldn't kill it, but the Eater was dazed enough for Anne to focus on the other one as it closed in. She then drew on a nearby source of water, a small creek that ran down the cliff face, and created three razor sharp disks made of ice.
The Eater didn't even get the chance to react as all three disks slid through its body without any resistance, making both of its great arms fall off, before its actual main body split into two right as the entire thing began to dissolve into Pyreflies. With one dead, the other still on fire and dying, Anne then turned her attention to the other one that she had sent flying.
Rather than do anything fancy though, Anne simply decided to end the lives of both the remaining Eaters at once as she turned her attention towards the cliffs above them. She then used her earth-bending to 'pull' then entire cliff down, bringing tons of rock and dirt directly down onto the two Eaters to crush and bury them alive, which worked if the glowing Pyreflies that appeared afterwards were any indication.
Sighing in relief, Anne then turned her attention towards the flock of Chocobos behind as she told them softly and soothingly,
"It's ok, I'm not going to hurt you." As she spoke, Anne reached out to pet them and, surprising her, none of the Chocobos shy'ed away from her touch as she patted the first one on its large beak.
Seemingly knowing she was a friend, Anne soon found herself surrounded by the giant birds on all sides as they clamored for attention, which she tried to give all of them before shocking them with the sudden transfer to Asora.
"I think we'd have enough of you guys now." Anne said jokingly, to which several of the Chocobos cried out as if in agreement.
***
As the night wore on, in another area of Spira known as the Calm Lands, a certain petite figure hovered in the air as she gathered and focused her magic power. With her platinum blond hair flowing in the breeze, the vampiress channeled a shocking amount of her magic power into her spell as she opened her eyes, and uttered,
"...Flare..."
Immediately the entire area she was in was lit up like night had turned into day, as an intense concentration of fire and light vaporized almost an entire mountain that was thankfully devoid of any people.
When the light eventually died down, and her vision returned to normal, the edge of Yue's lips curled up in a smirk as she was actually glad she decided to learn this particular branch of magic.
Before they came to Spira Alex told Yue about the magic they used there, and about one branch in particular. While she wasn't concerned about he other elemental branches of magic, Yue was especially interested in the Flare branch, which Alex said was the most powerful branch in every single Final Fantasy world.
Even the spell she just used, Flare, was only the weakest one in the line, with each one significantly more powerful and devastating than the last.
Yue's small frame shuddered in excitement as she imagined just how powerful the variants of Flare would be once she mastered them, Megaflare, Gigaflare, Terraflare, and even the most powerful, Zettaflare.
Seeing the destruction caused by just Flare though, Yue decided that it would probably be best if she practiced someplace else since Alex most likely wouldn't appreciate it if she accidentally wiped out all of Spira. She then used Regeneration magic to restore the mountain to its previous appearance, and then took off upwards into space to find some barren planet to practice on.

chapters.title: Chapter 428 - 428: The Machine Faction
chapters.content:
"YAHOOOOOOO!!!"
"KWEEEEEEE!!!"
Rikku and the Chocobo she was riding both let out cries of joy as they raced down the Highroad, with Alex and the other two right on their tails.
"We're gonna get you!" Yuna declared competitively, even as she had a massive grin on her face. However a moment after her declaration Paine and her Chcocobo sped past her, while the silver haired girl cooly said,
"Later Yuna."
"Hey! Get back here!" Yuna cried out in response as she urged her Chocobo to go faster.
While the three were competing in their race, Alex was mostly just enjoying the ride as marveled at his Chocobo's soft feathers, and strong body that was able to even support him in his SSJ4 form with ease. Of course, just because he enjoying himself didn't mean that he wasn't participating in the race, as he quickly sped past both Yuna and Paine while calling out,

Seeing Alex fly past them like it was nothing, the two girls shared a look before nodding in agreement as Yuna began to change into her Songstress Dress sphere. She then began to sing a melody that invigorated her and Paine's Chocobos, and increased their speed as both shot forward like a pair of bullets.
"We'll see YOU at the finish line!" Yuna paused her singing to call back as they passed Alex, before resuming it as they quickly caught up to Rikku. Glancing back when Yuna's voice carried to her, Rikku saw the duo swiftly catching up while Yuna continued singing to keep up their speed boost.

"Stop right there!" She declared before unleashing her skill, which made Yuna, Paine, and their Chocobos freeze in mid air as if time itself had halted.
"And the victory goes to me!" Rikku declared happily as she turned herself around on top of her Chocobo and held up her hands in a peace sign, only to be immediately confused when she realized Alex was nowhere to be seen.
"Down here!" His voice suddenly cried out, making Rikku jump as she turned and saw where he was.
Down in a nearby ravine, was Alex, his Chocobo hopping from stone spire to stone spire, using it's short and stubby wings to glide to the next one after its powerful legs propelled them both into the air. A scowl forming on her face, Rikku turned back around so she was facing the front once again, and declared,
"Come on! We've got to beat him!"
"Kweeeee!" Her Chocobo cried out as if in agreement, as it rushed forward once again as Yuna and Paine also regained their ability to move.
***
After racing their Chocobos for the better part of two days, stopping at one of the Travel Agency rest points along the way, Alex and the three girls finally reached the end of the Mi'ihen Highroad. Now they stood at the beginning of the Mushroom Rock Road, the craggy and treacherous path that had sheer cliffs on the left, choppy and violent seas on the right, and housed all kinds of dangerous and tricky fiends. This also happened to be where the Youth League headquarters were, but they were located off the beaten path and Alex had no intention of stopping there.
"We should rest here for the night and try to push to Djose Tenple on the other side tomorrow." Yuna advised as she said goodbye to her Chocobo. From that point on they'd either have to go on on foot, or take one of the Al Bhed Machina to the temple; both of which weren't good options since it was already almost half through the afternoon, and regardless of their choice they would be out after dark.
Not wanting to deal with either the dangerous fiends or the treacherous terrain in the dark, both Rikku and Paine nodded in agreement until Alex said,
"Nah, we can take my car the rest of the way." As he said that, Alex shocked the three girls, the Chocobo handlers, and the nearby Al Bhed when the area in front of him lit up, and a Machina like nothing any of them had ever seen before appeared.
"WOAH! What is that?!" Rikku asked with stars in her eyes as she examined the sports car, which had a dark red body with pitch black Windows. Alex smirked as he watched her admire the car before replying,

While all of the nearby Al Bhed sent looks of envy their way, Yuna, Paine, and especially Rikku all looked excited to see what Alex's car could do.
...

With this arrangement though, Rikku was leaning forward so much that she might as well been sitting on the center consul between them. "You're gonna hit your head if I hit a big enough bump." Alex eventually told her, as with her barely covered tits already right next to his face, he was more than convinced something was going to happen. Rikku however waved away Alex's concerns, saying,
"It'll be fine! I haven't felt a single bump since we started!" Though she was right, since the car made almost any road they drove feel as smooth butter, the moment those words left Rikku's mouth they suddenly hit a rock that was large enough to send Rikku crashing right into the roof before falling directly into Alex's lap.
"Told you so." Alex said bluntly, as somehow Rikku slid down face up with her legs on either side of his face, giving him a perfect up-close view of her scantily covered crotch.
Immediately Rikku tried to pull herself up to keep from sliding down to the floorboard, only to actually press her crotch and ass up into Alex's face so she couldn't move at all. Thankfully though Alex could easily use his 'Domain' to see where he was going so they didn't wreck.
When she finally started sliding back down so he could speak again, Alex said,

"Wait! Wha-?" Before she could finished what she was saying, Alex twitched his finger and the blonde suddenly found herself completely naked and exposed to his gaze.
With her completely smooth pussy now bared directly in front of his face, Alex didn't hesitate to place his tongue directly at the bottom of her slit.

"Alright people! I want everything that's going to be ready tonight! The ships will be here in the morning!" Shouted a man with spiked up blonde hair and an eyepatch, wearing a jumpsuit and purple overalls. This was none other than the leader of one of Spira's three biggest factions, Gippal of the Machine Faction.
Currently they were based out of one of Yevon's old temples, the Djose temple, which was built within a large stone spire that was surrounded by numerous magnetic rocks that were conducting arcs of electricity. All the electricity had made the location perfect for them to run the Machina of the Machine Faction, but now they were apparently packing up to move somewhere else.
"Gippal, Muug!(look)" One of the Al Bhed exclaimed suddenly, directing Gippal's attention towards Mushroom Rock Road. There he saw a dark red thing rushing towards them at speeds that put their Machina to shame, kicking up a massive cloud of dust in its wake as it moved.
"BATTLE STATIONS PEOPLE!" Gippal shouted as everyone around him began to hurry to meet whatever it was that was approaching them.
All around the Al Bhed were grabbing their Machina weapons and prepping for combat, which were mostly a form of rocket or grenade launcher. They then gathered around their leader, Gippal, who readied his own launcher as they all took aim at the rapidly approaching thing.
"Ready people!" Gippal stated as they all took aim. "Steady..." He told them as they waited for the thing to get within range.
"FIRE!"
At Gippal's command every single Al Bhed around him open fired on the approaching red thing, filling the air with smoke as the combined assault of dozens of Machina weapons honed in on the thing. What happened next was something none of them were expecting though, as several missiles were similarly shot out of the approaching thing.
*BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!*
Numerous explosions rocked the area as each and every one of the rockets and grenades fired at the thing were blown up before they even got close to it.
"Ec dryd y Machina?!(is that a Machina)" One of the Al Bhed asked incredulously, making them all pause as the same feelings surged through everyone there, the feeling of awe as they had never seen such a Machina before. Gippal however narrowed his one eye as he watched the apparent Machina approach them, before saying,
"Stand down everyone." Though they hesitated somewhat, everyone around him slowly stood down as the Machina finally reached them. Instead of coming to a gradual halt though, it turned so that its side was facing them as it slid along the dirt road until it finally came to a halt right before the bridge they were all stationed on.
For a moment no one did anything as they simply stared at the sleek body of the Machina, listening as it's engine rumbled lightly. Then the Machina became still and quiet as it was seemingly turned off.
With its Windows being completely black from the outside, none of them could tell what was going on within until one of the doors opened, and a large figured covered in red fur stepped out.
"Well that's certainly one way to greet someone." Alex said as he looked around at the gathered Al Bhed, while only Gippal stepped forward and said,
"Yeah, well you can't really blame us when someone shows up in something like this. Though I will say that she is a thing of beauty..." As he trailed off Gippal began to truly admire the vehicle before him, as never before had he seen something so sleek and beautiful in his life. His admiration was cut short though when the second door opened, and the most famous person in Spira stepped out of the vehicle this time.
Gippal let out a long whistle as he remarked,
"The High Summoner herself, well this is a surprise." Though Rikku exited the car after Yuna, all of Gippal's attention was on her as he leaned in closer to her and continued,
"Never been this close to a celebrity before." Leaning back from Gippal, Yuna awkwardly said,
"That's nice..." Seeing her reaction, Gippal smirked as he commented,
"I could get used to this." Yuna looked even more awkward at that as she said,
"Let's not..." Hearing all of this, Alex cocked an eyebrow as he looked over towards them from the other side of the car, where he was helping Paine get out. It was apparently only then that Gippal noticed Rikku behind Yuna, and said,
"Hey Rikku, how ya been? I saw Brother and Buddy not too long ago." Rikku however seemed to barely even react to Gippal's greeting, as her face was completely red and she appeared to be avoiding everyone gazes, specifically Alex's. Yuna however leapt at the chance to change the topic as she asked despite her own rosy cheeks,
"The two of you know each other?" Though he was looking at Rikku with concern, Gippal nodded as he replied,
"Yep, we made quite the couple a while back." That seemed to get Rikku's attention though, as she embarrassedly cried out,
"Fryd yna oui cyoehk?!(What are you saying?!)" Though Gippal would usually consider her reaction to be normal embarrassment, he did notice that only then did Rikku seem to glance in Alex's direction nervously after her exclamation. Looking Alex over once again, Gippal remarked,
"Let me guess, the rebound?" Though Alex frowned at Gippal's implication, he didn't deny anything as Gippal continued,
"Well, I guess that I should take it as a compliment that the guy after me is apparently some kind of emperor." He then held out his hand to shake while adding, "Gippal of the Machine Faction." Though Gippal seemed annoying, Alex knew he wasn't truly a bad person, so he grasped the offered hand and said while giving it a firm shake,
"Alexander Morningstar, the Dragon Emperor." As the two shook hands in greeting, Rikku then leapt at changing the topic as she asked,
"So, are you all going somewhere?" Gippal glanced around at all the men who were still standing there watching them, who then took that as a hint to get back to work as he cocked a brow and asked Rikku,
"You haven't heard?" Most of her earlier embarrassment gone by now with growing curiosity, Rikku asked,
"Heard what?" Gippal then appeared uncharacteristically serious as he told her,
"Someone rebuilt Home." Rikku immediately froze when she heard that, before uttering in dumbfoundment,
"What...?" Gippal nodded in understanding at her amazement, before going on to explain,
"The head of my excavation team on Bikanel island, Nhadala, reported seeing strange lights in the direction of Home the other night. When she took her team and went to investigate the next day, they found that Home had been completely restored, as if nothing even happened that day." Gippal then paused to let Rikku absorb what he had told her, as she stared ahead blankly from the news.
He then continued after a moment,
"Now we're planning move our base of operation to Home while using Djose as a smaller base on Spira for any other groups to contact us. We're setting sail tomorrow." Rikku then looked up as he finished speaking and asked,
"Do you have any idea who fixed it?" Gippal however shook his head as he replied,
"I know your old man had plans to repair it, but doing so would've costed a ton of Gil(money in Spira). Last I heard he was working on some harebrained scheme to order to make the Gil." When Gippal mentioned her father Rikku's brow twitched, as last she heard he and Brother had an argument and hadn't spoken to each other since.
She also knew firsthand that her pops could be incredibly hardheaded and stubborn towards those around him, to the point that he even refused to speak to his own sister after she married Yuna's father, a 'Yevonite', until Yuna herself had been born. He was also fairly extreme, as when they tried to fight Sin his own 'great idea' was to actually crash the airship they were on into Sin itself.
As Rikku tried to think of who might have fixed Home, Gippal suddenly caught sight of someone who had been hiding behind Alex's figure since she got out of the car, and now it was his turn to be surprised as he shouted,
"Wha-? You!?" Paine however didn't even react as she simply stuck out her hand this time, and bluntly said,
"Paine. Nice to meet you." Once again Gippal cocked a brow at Paine's attitude as he simply said,
"Riiiiiiiight..." Paine however didn't pay him anymore attention as someone called out to him, and Gippal had to get back to work preparing for their departure.
As he left Yuna looked at Rikku concernedly as she asked,
"Are you alright Rikku?" Startling slightly at Yuna's voice, Rikku said,
"Yeah, it's just hard to wrap my head around that Home has actually been fixed." Rikku was so distracted by this news, that she didn't even notice Alex approaching until he panted a chaste kiss on the top of her head, and whispered to her,
"Think nothing of it." Rikku then looked up at him in alarm as she asked,
"Did you do it?!" Alex however made a shushing gesture to her, making Rikku quiet down as he said,
"Of course I didn't, but one of my wives did on my orders." Rikku looked as if numerous emotions went through her at once at that information, before she finally asked,
"Why...? How...?" Alex however just shrugged and said,
"Why not?" The trio just looked at Alex curiously at that, before he said to them,
"Doing such a thing is a fairly trivial matter to us, so why not repair some of the damage done to Spira and its people as a kind gesture?" The girls were silent when they heard that before Yuna asked,
"Were you also behind Macalania Temple too?" Alex nodded as he explained,
"Without the Fayth in the temple the Macalania Woods have already begun to disappear. I had one of my wives investigate the woods to figure out a way to remedy this, and the end result was the restoration of the temple itself. The Fayth may not be useable for summoning anymore, but it still carries the power of faith that has been poured into it for over a thousand years."
The girls were silent for several moments as they absorbed this, before Yuna hesitantly asked,
"But, wouldn't it be better to let something that has been destroyed rest? Isn't that the more respectful thing to do?" Alex turned to look at Yuna when she asked that, cocking a brow as he did so, before answering,
"I'd say that depends really." He then walked towards the edge of the cliffs they were on, and added, "I want to show you guys something."
With Yuna, Rikku and Paine following Alex to the edge of the cliffs curiously, they were able to see the choppy and violent surf below. What happened next though was something that resounded within the hearts of everyone who witnessed it for years to come.
Without a single word, fanfare, or any discernible effort on his part, Alex slowly raised his right hand and the world itself seemed to respond to his will.
Below them, the ocean water that always angrily hammered against the cliffs began to recede at an alarming rate, with the level dropping lower and lower until the tops of numerous ruins were visible. Meanwhile, in the distance, the water level was rising as all of the water that being forced out began to amass into a massive wall, reaching along the entire length of the Mushroom Rock Road until it began to even tower over them.
"What do you see?" Alex asked them suddenly, startling everyone who was staring dumbstruck at what he had done.
"....a massive wall of water...?" Rikku asked hesitantly, to which Alex shook his head with a wry smile.
"All of the ruins." Paine said as she looked down to the seabed, directing everyone else's attention down there as well. Alex nodded slowly before saying,
"Yep. One thing I've noticed since arriving is that almost every single inch of Spira is littered in them, from the mainland, to the islands, and even under most of the oceans." Looking directly at Yuna, Alex then asked,
"So how much of Spira exactly had been 'destroyed' at some point? Wouldn't the people living in areas so close to, or right on top of these ruins be disrespectful?" Yuna was silent as she contemplated what Alex was saying.
Though it was true that Yuna wanted the places she had visited and seen to remain the same, she also understood what Alex was talking about. If every place that had some type of 'memory' attached to it was preserved instead of being restored or built upon, then there'd be no place in Spira for people to go.
"I understand what you're saying..." Yuna began hesitantly, before continuing, "I just don't to lose those memories..." Alex nodded in understanding at her hesitation, and said,
"There's nothing wrong with that, but remember that those memories will always be locked away here." With his left hand Alex pointed directly to Yuna's heart, which he had to admit was one of the cheesiest things he had ever done.
It seemed to have done the job though, as Yuna seriously considered his words for a moment.
This was probably one of the biggest issues Alex foresaw with his actions in Asora, that Yuna would reject his actions due to her own experiences. One of her biggest concerns in the original Final Fantasy X-2 was the blatant tourism and disrespect that people began to show towards places that she had fond memories of, while others had actually been at risk of being destroyed or burned down.
Alex of course had no plans of doing anything so extreme or disrespectful, but he did have some plans for Spira that Yuna might have a problem with due to them involving some of the places she wanted to preserve. Hopefully by discussing such things now though, Alex would be able to avoid any complications between them in the future.
Of course Yuna wasn't able to think things through peacefully, as at that moment numerous screeches echoed through the air as hundreds of fiends that made their home on the sea floor started to rush them. Again the Al Bhed around them began to prepare for combat while the girls similarly prepared themselves, however Alex didn't feel like entertaining the fiends at the moment.
"And we were having a decent moment too." Alex growled with a tick mark appearing on his forehead. He then declared a single word with such authority and power, that it echoed across the coast menacingly.
"Die."
While Alex intentionally prevented his command from affecting the people around him, all of the fiends on the sea floor suddenly dropped like marionettes with their strings cut, before dissolving into Pyreflies. Shaking his head at them like he hadn't just slaughtered an entire horde of fiends with a single word, Alex released his control on the ocean and then turned back to Yuna as he said,
"Just keep what I said in mind Yuna." He then began to make his way to the Travel Agency right outside of Djose Temple, intending to book them a room for the night while the trio behind him thought on Alex's earlier words.
