Though Alex could respect people's desire to see new and exciting things, he couldn't help but be amazed at the lack of care the group's leading these attractions were showing. It was to be somewhat expected since they didn't have as many regulations in terms of respectful showing and viewing, but if things continued in this way then the very things that made Spira so beautiful and mysterious would be completely destroyed in a few short years.
Making a mental note to discuss this matter with Anne later, the group continued across the bridge as they headed towards a series of pillars that led up to the foot of Mount Gagazet. Thankfully though the Ronso lived close to the foot of the mountain, so their destination for the day shouldn't be much further after they started up the trail.
For the most part the hike was quiet except for when Rikku and Paine tried to find something to help Yuna recover her previous cheerful mood, such as mentioning Kimahri and how happy he'll be to see Yuna again. It seemed to do the trick for the most part since Kimahri had been her guardian long before she even began her apprenticeship as a Summoner.
As her mood improved Yuna then explained to Alex about how Kimahri had always been bullied in his youth due him being smaller than the other Ronso, which led to his horn being broken and his exile from Mount Gagazet. However he then discovered the dying figure of Auron, one of the Guardians of Yuna's father, Braska.
Auron had asked Kimahri to keep a promise he made to Yuna's father in his stead, which had been to take her to Besaid to live in peace. Desperate for meaning in his life, Kimahri accepted and escorted Yuna across the length of Spira to the distant and small island, where he then chose to stay alongside her with Yuna's protection being his greatest concern from that moment on. Once she began her apprenticeship to become a Summoner, Kimahri then became her first official Guardian.
It was only a year after the defeat of Sin that Kimahri left Yuna's side, and returned to Mount Gagazet where he became the Elder of his people. Then, a year after he became their Elder, Kimahri discovered the sphere on Gagazet that sparked Yuna's new journey.
By the time she got Alex all caught up on her relationship with Kimahri, Yuna's mood had brightened considerably as she practically began skipping up the mountain's trial, despite the increasing cold and snow that began to appear around them.
As was the usual around Spira, once the mood finally improved a screech caught the attention of everyone, which was quickly followed by dozens more. Looking up, Alex and the girls saw several dozen flying figures that were swiftly approaching them from the skies.
"On your guard!" Paine cried out as she and the other two prepared for battle, however Alex surprised them when he held up his hand, and said,
"I think Yuna should handle this one." Needless to say Rikku and Paine were surprised at they glanced at each other, then Yuna to see what she had to say.
Though Yuna herself was surprised at Alex's sudden decision, one look at Alex was all it took for her to get his meaning in her being the one to fight the approaching fiends, he wanted her to test her newfound strength after obtaining her new powers.
"I'm on it!" Yuna declared confidently as her dual pistols appeared in her hands, which she then pointed directly at the fiends.
They were a type of fiend family known as Evil Eyes, large bat-like fiends that had wide mouths filled with teeth, and a large singular eye that took up most of their body. The group however appeared to be made up of the numerous different type of Evil Eyes, like the Ahriman, Fly Eye, Vertigo, and then the strongest of them, the Grim Gaze.
Rather than letting her opponents intimidate her though, Yuna took in a deep breath as she calmed herself. As the Evil Eyes got closer, Yuna felt as if time itself began to slow around her as she raised her pistols and took aim.
*BANGBANGBANGBANGBANGBANGBANGBANGBANGBANGBANGBANGBANGBANGBANGBANG*
Without pause Yuna fired dozens of shots within seconds from her seemingly endless clips as she rained bullets onto the unfortunate fiends, many of which pierced their unfortunately oversized eye and sent them plummeting to the ground, only to turn into Pyreflies on the way down. If the Evil Eyes weren't targeting them before they were now, but even if they tried to send their own attacks at Yuna to defend themselves, it didn't do them much good as they too ended up plummeting to the ground before firing them at her.
Before anyone knew it the skies had been cleared of fiends as Yuna slowly lowered her pistols, the mountain now deathly silent in the wake of the barrage of gunfire.
"Wow Yunie...." Rikku began in awe as she broke the silence, before crying out excitedly,
"THAT WAS AMAZING!" Rikku then rushed Yuna as she put away her guns, while Paine approached her as well as she asked,
"When'd you learn to shoot like that?" With Rikku also staring at her cousin pointedly for answers, Yuna just chuckled nervously as she said,
"I'm not sure, it just came to me..." Though she knew she'd have to tell them eventually, Yuna was still a little hesitant to tell her two best friends that she joined Alex's peerage.
Glancing over at him though, Yuna saw pride in Alex's eyes at her performance, a look that promised that this was just the tip of an impossibly large iceberg. Before they could get too excited though, there was a slight rumble as something large and heavy approached them.
"Get ready!" Paine exclaimed as the three of them immediately got into their battle stances, right as the next fiend appeared. Unlike the Evil Eyes though, this one was in an entirely different category.
It stood nearly ten feet tall and was covered in dark purple fur, while its face possessed ape-like features with a mouth full of wicked looking fangs. A second pair of arms extended from it's shoulders right above the first, each one thick and rippling with muscle under it's fur, while each of the fingers and toes on it's four hands and two feet were tipped with lethal looking claws. Curiously however the fiend appeared to covered with a shimmering blue energy, while what looked like Pyreflies surrounded it.
"Damn. It's Oversouled." Paine swore as the fiend began to square up to them, making Alex cock his head as he asked in confusion, "Oversoul?"
Rikku nodded as she tensely explained,
"Some fiends will Oversoul if certain conditions are met, meaning that they become several times stronger while also gaining entirely new skills and abilities in some cases." As they explained what an Oversoul meant Alex vaguely recalled something about it from the game, and looked at the fiend as he seriously considered taking this fight himself.
This particular fiend was known as a Gug, something Lucy had been showing him during one of the recent nights he spent in Asora after the girls went to bed. It was the strongest fiend of its type in Spira, and the fact that it was Oversouled made it even more powerful if the energy that Alex felt it gathering in it hands was anything to go by.
However, just as he was about to step in himself, something caught Alex's attention that made the edge of his lips curl upwards as he suddenly said,
"Stand down, someone else has this." Though the girls looked at him in confusion at first, Alex pointed in a certain direction and when they followed it with their gaze they saw a certain figure standing on a large rock nearby.
Immediately Yuna and Rikku's faces broke out into massive grins, right as the newcomer released a mighty roar that even made their surroundings shake and rumble.
"ROAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAR!"
Covered head to toe in blue fur, the figure stood a little bit taller than Alex and possessed about as much muscle as him, as a mane of white braided hair flowed down his back. Extending from his forehead was the bottom half of a shattered horn, but on each of his fingers was his own set of lethal looking claws, while a feline looking tail extended from his backside.
With his challenging roar echoing through the mountain side, the Ronso was immediately the Gug's focus as it released the energy it had been gathering in it's hands towards him, which took the form of a massive ball of fire. The attack was a tier three magic spell, the strongest spell of the fire branch known as Firaga.
Rather than appearing intimidated by it though, the Ronso snarled in contempt as he swatted the magic attack away with his bare hands, causing it to explode against a nearby cliff.
*KABOOOOOOM!*
Instantly a tidal ave of fire washed over the surface of rock, clearing after a moment to reveal molten slag in its place that began running down the cliff face. Instead of paying it any attention though, the Ronso braced himself, before launching himself forward at such speeds that he shattered the ground beneath his feet.
*CRASH!*
One of the Ronso's fist collided with the Gug's, causing a crater to form beneath their feet before the Gug slowly began to be pushed back. It's eyes widened in surprise at it's strength failing it in front of this opponent, while the Ronso's yellow feline-like eyes narrowed.
Then he did something that would've made no sense to anyone who didn't know how Ronso fight, and opened his mouth. The next thing Alex and the girls knew there was a mighty torrent of white-hot flame that billowed from the Ronso's mouth, and washed over the stunned Gug.
"GRAHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!" The Gug screamed in pain as it was set aflame by a fire more powerful than what it conjured earlier, however no matter how much it struggled it could not escape the grip of the Ronso that it foolishly challenged as he burned it to death.
Each second that passed as the Gug screamed felt like an eternity, until it's cries eventually began to die down, and then all that was left was the roar of the flames. That too began to slowly die down as the Ronso closed his mouth, allowing the flames to disappear to reveal that the Gug had been completely reduced to ash before those too dissolved into Pyreflies.
For a beat no one said or did anything, before Yuna suddenly rushed forward and cried out as she wrapped her arms around the Ronso,
"Kimahri! I'm so happy to see you!" As she embraced him the Ronso, Kimahri, flashed his own fangs as he smiled, and used one of his hands to pat Yuna's back as he replied,
"Kimahri is happy to see Yuna too."
***
After Yuna and Kimahri's reunion the Ronso Elder then began to lead them back up the mountain as he visited with Yuna, saying little as Yuna told him of the adventures she'd had since they last saw each other. Rikku was beside her as she too told Kimahri about everything that had happened ever since he gave her the sphere that prompted Yuna's journey, while Paine also threw in the odd word, having met Kimahri when Rikku came to see him last.
The only odd one out was Alex as he trailed behind the group, and Kimahri ignored him entirely. That was too be expected though, as the Ronso spoke rarely and not at all to those he didn't know or trust. From what Yuna told him earlier, Kimahri didn't even say a single word to Tidus until after they had been traveling together for several weeks.
After a while of walking and talking, Kimahri finally led them through the entrance of the Ronso village, where Alex saw several dozen Ronso walking around.
Though Kimahri already stood taller than him, Alex couldn't help but to note just how tall the Ronso were in general as almost every single one that he saw had at least almost a foot on Kimahri, even the females.
Naturally the moment they entered the village with Kimahri all of the surrounding Ronso centered their attention on them, while several performed gestures of respect and admiration towards Yuna.
Not only were the Ronso a warrior race that idolized strength, but they were fiercely loyal and honorable, to the point that when they arrived at Mount Gagazet during Yuna's pilgrimage Kimahri engaged in a life or death battle with the Ronso who broke his horn in order to regain his honor. Naturally Yuna was one of the people the Ronso respected the most due to her being the High Summoner that defeated Sin for good.
As Alex used his 'Domain' to explore the Ronso village and the network of tunnels they used to live in and get around, Yuna explained their intentions to Kimahri about crossing Gagazet once again in their journey to show Alex Spira.
For the first time Kimahri glanced at Alex very briefly, before looking back to Yuna and saying,
"Kimahri trust Yuna, Yuna respect Sacred Mountain." Yuna looked happy at the praise and said,
"Thank you Kimahri, can we stay here with you tonight and leave in the morning?" Kimahri immediately nodded and replied,
"Yes, Yuna very welcome to Ronso." As he said that numerous other Ronso around them uttered their agreement, while several immediately left to prepare a small feast for them, mostly of meat of course.
However not all of the Ronso were respectful or appreciative of Yuna's presence, as a Ronso with shorted black hair that was tied back in a ponytail approach them, and angrily declared,
"Ronso filled with vengeance and Elder welcomes guests!? Kimahri not fit to be Elder, not fit to lead Ronso in battle!" As he declared that a small group of Ronso that arrived with him shouted their agreements, before the leader stormed off with them following behind him.
"Garik filled with much hate." One of the other Ronso muttered, to which many of those around them nodded and voiced their agreements.
"D-did we do something wrong Kimahri?" Yuna asked hesitantly, to which Kimahri sighed as he explained to her,
"Garik and other Ronso youth filled with hatred and vengeance, wish to wage war with remaining Guado over many deaths of Ronso." Though many of the Ronso around them also growled or looked angry as they recalled the slaughter that killed so many of their people, they did not react like Garik. Kimahri then continued,
"Kimahri have no answer for Garik and other youth. Garik now believe Kimahri unfit for role of Elder.....maybe Garik right." As Kimahri began to doubt himself Yuna placed her hand on his arm to comfort him, but didn't say anything.
She knew that even if she tried to intervene Kimahri would refuse, insisting that this was his problem to figure out and that he shouldn't get help from her. So, in order to change the discussion, Yuna decided to use this moment to gesture Alex over to them.
Curious about what she intended, Alex approached Yuna so that he too was standing before Kimahri, making the Ronso Elder look directly at him for the first time. His eyes were filled with suspicion and distrust, even as Yuna said,
"Kimahri this is Alex, the Dragon Emperor." As she introduced him Alex extended a hand and said,
"Nice to meet you Kimahri. I'm Alex, though you can just call me Yuna's mate." If there'd been a record playing Alex was sure it would've scratched at the moment as every single Ronso stared at him in awe, while Kimahri just glared down at him menacingly.
Of course equally stunned were Yuna, Rikku and Paine, though the latter two more at how Yuna didn't even try to deny Alex's claims, and only appeared shy as he wrapped an arm around her and pulled her close. The entire time Kimahri didn't say a single thing, until a sole word escaped his lips.
"Come."
Then, without another single word, Kimahri turned and stormed away, leaving Alex and Yuna to follow behind him as he entered a tunnel that led into the mountain.
For several minutes Alex and Yuna followed Kimahri through the tunnels, with Rikku and Paine following them, and the rest of the Ronso following after them as they all flocked to see what Kimahri was going to do. Yuna meanwhile felt her mind racing as she tried to figure out what was happening, not at all expecting to Alex to suddenly introduce himself as her 'mate', something that gave her a giddy feeling mixed with intense worry.
When they finally exited the tunnels though they came upon an open area with racks of weapons and a few Ronso who were sparring.
"Leave." Kimahri growled at them, making them immediately clear the area as none of them had ever seen their Elder act like this.
"SPEAR!" Kimahri roared, making a few of the Ronso race as they quickly left, only to return seconds later with a brilliant looking spear that they then handed to their Elder. Kimahri then pointed the spear at Alex and declared in a loud voice,
"Kimahri will test Alex now, test if Alex worthy of being Yuna mate!"

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - 434: Duel on Mount Gagazet
chapters.content:
As Kimahri's challenge echoed off the mountainside, the edges of Alex's mouth curled upwards in a smirk.
"I accept." Alex declared as he used Spatial magic to warp Yuna away from him before she could protest. When she realized what had happened though, Yuna spun around and tried to intervene.
"Kimahri don't!" To Yuna, Kimahri and Alex were two people who were very important to her so she didn't want to see them fight each other, especially for such a stupid reason. However before she could even get close to Alex, Yuna slammed into what was an invisible wall that shimmered upon impact, as numerous magic circles appeared along it.
"I placed a barrier between us and the others, we wouldn't want our fight getting someone else hurt." Alex said to Kimahri as he stepped into place across from him, his excitement evident on his face while Kimahri's showed a brief flash of gratitude.
Saiyan and Ronso.
Two warrior races with great strength and pride.
From the moment Alex arrived in the Ronso village he knew that there would inevitably be a battle between himself and at least one Ronso, particularly Kimahri once he found out about the relationship between himself and Yuna. And from the moment he met him Alex had been dying to see what Kimahri's limits were.
Though there were several people he hadn't met yet, based on those he had Alex had concluded that Kimahri could very well be one of, if not the strongest person in all of Spira.
After the defeat of Sin both Wakka and Lulu entered retirement, and with them only fighting when the occasional fiend strayed too close to Besaid village their strength had more than likely stagnated or fallen slightly from when they were at their peak. Meanwhile Yuna had lost the majority of her powers after the Aeons she would summon were sacrificed in the battle against Sin, and Rikku sacrificed most of her knowledge and skills as a Thief in the process of making the respective Dressphere, meaning she had to relearn the vast majority of her skills.
This meant that Kimahri was the only one from their original group who had been continuously training and growing stronger since the defeat of Sin, as to the Ronso their strength and capabilities in combat were everything. Meanwhile Alex was sure that outside of their group, though there undoubtedly numerous powerful people, they didn't compare to those who had directly fought against Sin at their peak.
So, despite the fact that he was well aware there was still what others would call an insurmountable gap between them, Alex decided to show Kimahri and the Ronso what TRUE strength looked like.
There was suddenly an explosion as Alex increased his energy to the utmost limits of what he was capable of at the moment, making the mountains around them shake and shudder at his mere presence before the same phenomenon began to spread to all of Spira. If he hadn't erected the barrier between the two of them and the rest of the spectators, Alex was sure they all would've been blown off of the mountain entirely.
Almost immediately though he began receiving messages from his wives through the system asking what he was doing as they too felt his sudden increase in energy, which Alex asked Lauren to send back a reply stating he was just participating in a 'little' dual. Meanwhile what Alex and the others didn't noticed was all of the oldest and most powerful fiends scattered across all of Spira and far beyond also reacting to his sudden increase in energy, some feeling fear for the first time in their long existence, while others looked towards the source of the disturbance with interest.
Not caring about the effects his actions were having on the rest of Spira, Alex held out his hand and summoned a brilliant flash of golden flames, temporarily blinding all of the spectators until their eyes adjusted. When they could see again, Alex had reached his hands into the inferno of golden flames and grasped something, before the vast majority of the flames flickered out to reveal a beautiful and long golden sword, it's blade still flickering with golden flames.
His preparations complete, Alex looked directly at Kimahri once more, the Ronso having barely reacted to Alex's performance as he instead fearlessly prepared for battle, even as Alex declared while brandishing Ascalon,
"I am Alexander Morningstar, of the mighty and proud Saiyan warrior race! Are you ready Kimahri?" To respond Kimahri took a single step forward and unleashed a mighty roar, one that dwarfed the roar he gave to the Gug earlier while also brandishing his mighty spear, one of the most powerful weapons that existed in Spira, the Spirt Lance(A.N. Or in other translations the Longinus).
While his roar was still echoing off of the trembling mountainsides, Kimahri launched himself forward with such speed that even several of his fellow Ronso couldn't follow his movements. The ground and the cliffs around him shattered from the force of his movement as he rapidly approached Alex, his spear poised to make one single decisive attack to end the fight instantly.
As the most powerful Lance in Spira approached him, Alex's expression never faltered as he waited until it was less than an inch from his skin, before Ascalon flashed in his hands.
Faster than even the sound could reach them, Ascalon impacted the Spirit Lance to deflect it towards the side with a great shower of sparks. Kimahri's eyes just barely began to widen at the impossible reflexes, before Alex's fist impacted his face and sent him flying.
Just from that single exchange, the spectators had to struggle to hold their ground as the entire mountain shook from the force of the impact of Alex's fist against Kimahri's face. But it didn't end there, as Alex moved faster than Kimahri and appeared in the place where the Ronso Elder was about to hit the cliff side, only to raise his foot and bring it down right on top of Kimahri's flying body.
*KABOOOOOOOOOOM!*
*CRASH!*
*RUMBLE!*
As Kimahri's body impacted the stone ground, the entirety of Mount Gagazet didn't just shake, but massive fissures began to form from the force of the impact, while entire cliffsides began to crumble to form massive rockslides. As they witnessed Alex's strength firsthand, all of the watching Ronso were torn between awe and frustration due to the mountain they were sworn to protect being damaged like this, even as almost all of them ended up falling back onto their asses.
The most anxious ones of course were Yuna, Rikku, and Paine, the former two the most so due to how long they had known Kimahri from all of their travels together.
"This is too much!" Rikku complained as she rubbed her sore butt, but even as she did so Yuna only continued watching the 'fight' between Alex and Kimahri with bated breath.
When the dust cleared they all saw Kimahri laying in the middle of a crater that was the epicenter for all of the major fissures that had formed in the arena, with Alex standing at the craters edge looking down at him. Of course, the big softy that he was, Alex had held back to the precise point where Kimahri was still conscious within the crater as he struggled to get to his feet.
"Am I worthy yet?" Alex asked in a loud voice, making Kimahri look at him with narrowed eyes as he growled back,
"Kimahri....not defeated yet..." This time it was Alex who narrowed his eyes, as he truly did not want to push things further than this. Kimahri however was displaying the same indomitable will he possessed even as a child, using his Spirit Lance as a crutch as he tried to stand despite his numerous broken bones.
A second later he fixed Alex with a firm look that stated he still had something up his sleeve. Despite his desire to end the fight with as little damage done as possible, Alex smiled in anticipation of what Kimahri would show him next.
"LANCET!" Kimahri roared as he pointed his Lance at Alex, resulting a ray of light shooting out at Alex before returning to Kimahri a second later after it impacted him. As a mild sense of fatigue suddenly assaulted him, Alex fought the urge to laugh as he recalled one of the Ronso's greatest abilities, which was what allowed them to become some of the greatest warriors in all of Spira.
Lancet was an ability that all Ronso apparently possessed, allowing them to absorb vitality and energy from their opponents in the heat of battle. It was truly a reverser in almost any battle.
It's true strength though was that along with the energy they could take, the Ronso were also capable of learning brand new skills and abilities from their opponents that they'd be able to use for the rest of their lives. This made them the only ones in all of Spira that were even capable of learning attacks used only by certain fiends, while they could also learn attacks from other people as well.
As an alarming amount of energy filled him from using Lancet on Alex, Kimahri appeared more than a little surprised. However he knew this alone wouldn't be enough to turn the tide, so Kimahri decided to take this fight even more seriously.
"White Wind! Mighty Guard!" As he cried out the name of these moves several changes happened to Kimahri at once.
Firstly was the energy that enveloped his body as all the injuries he'd acquired so far were rapidly healed, then was the appearance of several barriers that surrounded Kimahri's body to protect him. The first was the spell Protect, which severely limited the damage he'd receive from physical attacks, while the second was Shell, which would similarly limit the damage Kimahri would receive from magic attacks. The final barrier though was called Nulall, which severely limited the damage he'd receive from elemental based attacks as well.
The entire time Kimahri was activating his healing and buffs Alex just stood there watching and waiting, eager to see more of what the Ronso were capable of, and Kimahri didn't disappoint.
Once his buffs were active Kimahri began to behave weirdly as his size began to increase, and the fur covering his body took on a different pattern. Within the blue and silver fur similarly colored scales began to form while the tip of Kimahri's feline tail grew several pikes, and a pair of scale covered wings sprouted from his back.
"So you copied that skill, huh?" Alex muttered to himself as the skill Kimahri gained from using Lancet on him became apparent, his 'Draconian Form'.
Once the transformation was complete Kimahri stood there as he examined his new appearance, standing quite a bit taller so that he was now the same height as the rest of the Ronso, and with a pair of wings that had hooked claws on the tips.
"Kimahri has grown stronger..." The Ronso Elder said with undisguised awe, as the 'Draconian Form' had also increased his strength along with the new capabilities that it gave him. Kimahri then focused his now reptilian eyes on Alex, a calm confidence filling his body as he suddenly moved so fast he disappeared.
"True, you ARE stronger now." Alex said calmly even as Kimahri appeared behind him with his Lance raised high.
*CLANG!*
The sound of metal colliding rang out as again Kimahri's Spirit Lance was blocked by Ascalon, except this time Alex didn't even turn to face Kimahri or deflect the attack.
"But there's something you need to remember Kimahri." Alex continued as he finally turned his head to face, his eyes now also in the shape of reptilian slits.
"'I' am the Dragon Emperor." Kimahri's eyes widened as a sudden sensation overcame him, something the likes of which he never felt before as his body suddenly almost instinctively tried to submit and prostrate before Alex.
Forcing the sudden urges down though, Kimahri immediately tried to use his new wings to take flight and gain some distance from Alex, but before he could something wrapped around one of his ankles and pulled him in the opposite direction. Again Kimahri was slammed against the stone ground with less force than before, but still strong enough that another crater was formed in it.
Looking up at Alex, Kimahri was shocked to see crimson red scales slowly forming along his skin, his nails elongating into lethal claws, and a pair of sharp curved horns protruding from his forehead. As his own transformation completed, a pair of red scaled wings sprouted from Alex's back, turning him completely into a humanoid dragon as he stared down at Kimahri.
"RAAAAAAAAAAAA!" Kimahri roared as he tried once again to attack Alex, only to have his attack deflected as Alex simply flicked his now serpentine tail, then again as one of his wings moved to act as a shield.
*CRACK!*
*SMASH!*
Again and again Kimahri's attacks failed to land, and again and again Alex would immediately retaliate with his tail or wings. With each attack Kimahri took more and more damage, until the only reason he was still standing was because of his earlier buffs lessening the damage Alex's attacks dealt to him, but even those were beginning to falter.
Eventually Kimahri was driven to his knees, unable to bring himself to attack anymore as Alex slowly approached him, pointing Ascalon at him as he said,
"It's my win." In response to such taunting words, Kimahri spat out a mouth-full of blood that even contained a tooth. He then looked back up towards Alex, and despite the fact that every fiber of his draconic being wanted desperately to submit, he refused to as he said back,
"Kimahri never admit defeat. Never give up." When he heard that Alex didn't know if he should be irritated or impressed at the Ronso's stubbornness, causing him to furrow his brows slightly.
"Fine then." Alex said after a moments thought. "Have it your way."
He then began to raise Ascalon up over his head, until it was pointed straight up into the sky, and gathered power to his sword to deal one final blow. Behind him Alex could hear Yuna pleading with him not to, but he tuned her out as he finished gathering power.
The entire time Alex was gathering power Kimahri never looked away or closed his eyes, seeming resigned to what was to come once Alex delivered his next attack.
Then, as if in slow motion, Alex began to drop his arm down to deal the final blow to Kimahri, which would undoubtedly kill him once it connected.
As the sword fell a light more intense than anything else yet shone, as if Alex had utilized even the sun itself in his attack. For over a minute no one could see anything through the bright light, until it finally began to lessen in intensity before dying down entirely, to reveal the effects of Alex's final attack.
Needless to say everyone was surprised at what they saw, but none more than Kimahri as he saw the very tip of Ascalon less than a centimeter away from his nose, and Alex said,
"Well damn, looks like I missed. I guess this is my loss...." As he said that Alex stored Ascalon away while simultaneously canceling his draconian transformation. He then turned around and began walking back towards the gathered Ronso, even as Yuna raced passed him now that the barrier was also down.
She immediately dropped down onto her knees next to Kimahri to see to his wounds, which consisted of numerous lacerations, nasty bruises, and an entirely new set of broken bones.
"Are you alright Kimahri?" Yuna asked as she began using her White Mage Dressphere to heal him, to which Kimahri said as his own transformation ended,
"Kimahri fine. Alex however not worthy of being Yuna mate." As he said that Kimahri looked up towards Alex's back, having concluded that Alex wasn't worthy since he decided to admit defeat instead of dealing the final blow.
When he heard tat Alex paused and turned back towards Kimahri, before saying,
"And what makes you say that Kimahri? Just because I chose to think of Yuna's feelings over a useless sense of pride doesn't mean I'm not worthy of her." Of course Kimahri looked confused at Alex words, making him sigh as he approached them once more and continued,
"You refused to admit defeat, even though it was obvious you'd never be able to win. So the only options I had to win were to either beat you until you were on the verge of death and unable to fight, or simply kill you outright. Even though I could've healed you or even brought you back to life, Yuna still would've been incredibly sad to see such a thing happen. I decided to admit defeat so that Yuna wouldn't have to see that, because to me Yuna is more important than my own pride."
As he finished speaking Alex approached Yuna's side and planted a kiss on the top of her head, leaving his words hanging as they reverberated within Kimahri's mind. Of course he hadn't missed Alex's implication, that to Kimahri his own pride was more important than Yuna's happiness or wellbeing.
Clenching his first in anger, Kimahri then began to push himself to his feet, despite the numerous severe injuries still affecting his body.
"Kimahri wait, you're till injured!" Yuna tried to get him to stop, but Kimahri pretended not to hear her as he slowly approached Alex while using his Spirit Lance as a crutch, which looked as if it was going to crumble to pieces at any moment.
Once in front of Alex though, Kimahri stared at him intensely for a moment before dropping down onto his knees. The proud Ronso then pressed the stump of his broken horn against the ground and said in a clear voice,
"Kimahri admit defeat. Alex win dual, and is worthy of Yuna." The reaction to Kimahri's admission of defeat was akin to the world ending to Yuna and the spectating Ronso, as all of them knew he had never in his life admitted defeat, no matter battered and injured he became.
However he had chosen to put aside the very pride that prevented him from ever admitting defeat, to show Alex that Yuna meant more to him than his pride. This was the correct choice as Alex nodded in approval above him, and gently placed his hand on the back of Kimahri's head before saying in a firm voice,
"Rise Kimahri." As Kimahri rose from his prostration, numerous gasps and muttering so filled the air as everyone stared at him in awe, making Kimahri confused until Alex conjured a mirror for him to look into.
When he did Kimahri was stunned at what he saw, which was a whole foot long horn that protruded from his forehead, instead of the broken partial horn that he'd had for the last thirteen years. Along with that all of the pain in his body had vanished as Alex simultaneously healed all of Kimahri's wounds, before he then placed a hand on the Spirit Lance.
The Lance shone brightly for a second before the light faded to reveal it looking as good as new, though Kimahri knew as he gripped his weapon that it was enter than knew since Alex did something to it. Looking at him curiously, Alex just said,
"I may have made some improvements. You'll have to experiment with it later though." Bowing his head in gratitude, Kimahri then said,
"Kimahri grateful. Alex is good man, Yuna very lucky." Alex smirked at Kimahri's praise as he clapped the Ronso on the shoulder, only for someone to suddenly impact the both of them as she wrapped her arms around them and said,
"Never do that again, please." Though he wanted to assure her it wouldn't happen again, Alex was unable to make such a promise since he could see himself and Kimahri sparring quite a bit in the future, especially since he wanted to help make the Ronso grow stronger. Before he could though a voice suddenly declared,
"See! Elder weak! Unfit to lead Ronso!" Looking up, everyone Garik approaching them with a scowl on his face as he looking Kimahri's direction. Before he reached them though, Garik spun around and raised his fist up high as he declared,
"GARIK STRONG! GARIK LEAD WARRIORS TO ELIMINATE GUADO!" As his shout echoed off the mountainside numerous younger Ronso joined in as they grabbed nearby weapons to prepare for battle.
With this happening right in front of him, Kimahri was about to step forward to put Garik in his place. But before he could Alex tightened his grip on Kimahri's shoulder, and muttered to him,
"No, let me deal with this." Though Kimahri wanted to refuse because this was a Ronso matter, he was also curious about what Alex intended to do.
Walking right up to Garik, Alex was about to say something when Garik turned and looked down at him, scorn evident in his eyes as he growled,
"Ronso business of no concern to outsider. Stay out, or Garik will show outsider that not all Ronso as weak as Elder." As he said that Garik straightened his back to make himself look even taller, despite already being nearly a foot taller than Alex was already.
The act and Garik's remark made Alex cock a brow at the sheer ridiculousness of it, before he declared in a firm voice,
"Prostrate." In an instant Garik found himself on his knees with his face and horn digging into dirt, before he felt Alex's foot press down on his head. Alex then knelt down and growled at him,
"Garik weaker than Kimahri. Kimahri strong in both mind and body, but Garik weak in both." All the Ronso could do was groan into the dirt as Alex put just a little bit more force into his foot, before he turned his attention to every other Ronso present.
"Many Ronso died to Seymour Guado, yes. But Seymour Guado is gone now and will never come back. War with Guado will do nothing." As Alex let his words hang over the Ronso they began muttering amongst themselves, before he continued in regular speak,
"Do I need to remind you what the last war resulted in?" This time there was no noise whatsoever as the Ronso thought of the answer before Alex said it.
"Sin."
That single word hung over the entire mountainside as everyone recalled the truth behind the creation of Sin. And as that sunk in Alex continued,
"The war between Bevelle and Zanarkand created Sin, which terrorized all of Spira for over a thousand years. However this war would be even worse than that one, as the enemy would not be a nation full of capable warriors that would fight to defend their lives and loved ones." Alex then looked down at Garik with undisguised disgust as he spat at him,
"Garik's mission is not just to get 'revenge' for the Ronso killed by Seymour Guado, but to exterminate every Guado man, woman, and child in all of Spira. Tell me Garik, what kind of 'honorable' and 'proud' warrior will target those who can't defend themselves? A weakling? A coward?"
As Alex's words rang out the Ronso began to mutter them as well, some actually calling Garik and supporters weaklings and cowards for wanting to attack such people. It was that moment that Kimahri stepped forward, and stated,
"Alex right, killing Guado wrong and dishonorable. Ronso must learn to forgive." Again the gathered Ronso began muttering amongst themselves, before one of Garik's supporters stepped forward and demanded,
"Then what Ronso do now!? No Summoners travel to Sacred Mountain, no need for Ronso to protect! No war with Guado, no need to fight! What Ronso do!?" Every pair of eyes then turned to Kimahri for direction, wanting him, as their Elder, to decide what the Ronso were supposed to do from now on if they didn't need to protect Gagazet anymore, and couldn't go to war with the Guado.
However it wasn't Kimahri that spoke up, but Alex as he declared,
"That's easy! The Ronso will leave Spira and follow me to my homeland, Asora!" The shock the Ronso felt at Alex telling them to leave Spira was evident as they began to discuss this amongst themselves, before Kimahri asked Alex with an intense look in his eyes,
"What is there in this 'Asora' for Ronso?" With everyone again hanging onto his every word, Alex walked back towards Garik and placed his foot on the back of the still prostrating Ronso's head before saying,
"The Ronso are proud warriors, but weak. The people of Asora are strong, and will make the Ronso strong as well! Stronger than ever before!" When they heard that the Ronso grew excited at the prospect of becoming stronger and meeting strong opponents as well, as one asked him,
"Ronso will be able to fight strong opponents?" Alex's mouth curved into a wide smile at the question, before declaring,
"Let me tell you about them, the Rating Games!"
***
Several hours later the Ronso village was lit up with a festive atmosphere as night fell, and the Ronso prepared the feast Kimahri promised Yuna when they arrived, except now they were celebrating something else as well. On the side of a cliff making up the walls of the Ronso village, an image was being projected that showed one of the recent Rating Games that had been broadcasted in Asora, which many of the Ronso were gathered around as they eagerly watched the fights.
Naturally once they heard about the Rating Games the Ronso became very excited for the chance to compete in order to fight more strong opponents, as well as to earn honor and fame. So, after taking a moment to restore the state of Mount Gagazet using Regeneration magic, Alex returned to Asora to retrieve numerous recordings so that the Ronso could learn more about the games while watching some of the fights, as well as to inform his wives of the new residents they could expect.
Of course there was one Ronso who was also watching the games, but was standing apart from everyone else after what happened earlier. Garik.
After Alex told them of the Rating Games, he then broke off Garik's horn at the base as a mark of his shame and cowardice in wanting to slaughter the weak innocents of the Guado. However Garik wasn't getting the same treatment as Kimahri when his horn had been broken, and he had been exiled from Mount Gagazet.
Instead, Alex declared that Garik would continue living amongst the Ronso even after they moved, and would participate in the Rating Games as well. If through them he was able to prove his bravery and strength for all to see, then Alex would restore his horn for him like he had done to Kimahri's earlier. Garik however had a counter to his offer.
The Ronso declared that his horn would only be restored 'when' he grew strong enough to defeat Alex in single combat. With him swearing this before the entire Ronso village, Garik now had no choice but to one day defeat Alex to get his horn back. Even if he somehow found another way to restore his horn, like someone else using Regeneration magic for him, then Garik would be shamed infinitely more than he was now with no horn.
Now he was treated akin to an outsider due to his current status, with even his own former followers refusing to acknowledge his existence. Kimahri however promised Alex he would keep an eye on Garik, and that this experience would help the young and hotheaded Ronso mature and become even stronger than he was now.
As for the Ronso Elder, Kimahri had led the other Ronso in swearing their allegiance to Alex, which in turn led to him acquiring the 'Ronso Grand Elder' title as well, simply because the Ronso didn't believe in Emperors. This meant that to them he now held the greatest authority over the Ronso people, while Kimahri would be in charge whenever he wasn't around since he still their Elder.
Of course, Kimahri only swore his allegiance to Alex when he confirmed that Yuna was going to follow Alex away from Spira in the future, meaning that he was now able to continue keeping an eye on her by living in Asora as well. Kimahri then made Yuna turn crimson red when he mentioned that he'd be able to watch over and 'protect' her pups as well when she and Alex had them.
Speaking of, after their fight, and seeing the way Alex handled the other Ronso earlier, Kimahri appeared to have accepted Alex completely as Yuna's mate, and had even become even friendlier with him as well. This was something Alex appreciated since he and Kimahri got along pretty well once they actually started talking, and Alex even gave him some pointers on the 'Draconian Form' as well for when Kimahri used it in the future.
And so the festivities in the Ronso village continued well into the night, and with there being numerous games on the recording brought playing one after another, several of the Ronso even stayed up all night watching them as their excitement in getting to participate themselves only grew.

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - 435: Cid
chapters.content:
(A.N. I'm trying something new by using first person point of views, so let me know what you think and please be patient if there are any slip ups.)
As morning dawned on Mount Gagazet, I arrived from Asora with Sephie, Yasaka and Sairaorg behind me. Their purpose was to help the Ronso move and get settled somewhere in Asora while I continued on my journey with Yuna, Rikku, and Paine.
Using the warp panels that were located all over the mountain we quickly reached the snowy pass that would let us cross the mountain, and down into the holy land of Zanarkand. Seeing it spread out below us, I couldn't help but to mutter,
"It's even more amazing in person..."
The ruins of the once great city stretched out as far as the eye could see, the sheer majesty of the city persisting even after over a thousand years. All throughout it glowing Pyreflies danced through the ruined buildings, which were all that remained of the souls of those who once called Zanarkand home. Their only company was the numerous powerful fiends that roamed the streets, each one having fought the others for survival for over a thousand years.
Or at least that was how it was supposed to be.
"Are those....people down there...?" Rikku muttered in confusion, drawing our gazes to the numerous dots that were gathered at the entrance to the ruined city as well.
"That can't be...." Yuna uttered, her confusion evident on her face. Well, it wasn't like I couldn't understand why, Zanarkand was one of the most dangerous places in all of Spira.
What caught even me by surprise was when I felt the slight buildup of demonic power in Yuna's body, which indicated she was about to manifest her devil's wings and fly down there herself to see what was going on.
"Hold on there!" I said as I gently grabbed Yuna's wrist, preventing her from taking off all of a sudden by herself. When she whirled at me to demand why I was holding her back, I said placatingly,
"There's no need to rush off ahead by yourself, all of us should go together." Though she still looked as if she wanted to rush ahead, Yuna eventually nodded slowly to me as the demonic power I felt within her body began to die down.
"So how ARE we going to get down there? Don't tell me we're going to have to walk?!" Rikku exclaimed worriedly as she eyed the long and treacherous path ahead. I smirked though while looking around at all the snow around us, and said as if it were obvious,
"No, there's a much faster and more fun way down a snowy slope you know."
***
""KYAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!""
Yuna and Rikku both cried out fearfully as we raced down the snowy slope on a sheet of metal.
Sitting in the middle of it, I had Rikku and Yuna clinging to me on both sides fearfully as we soared at breakneck speeds, both seemingly trying to make me deaf as they screamed. Paine on the other hand was standing on the rapidly moving sled as cool as could be right behind me.
It's not like the situation was all that bad though, as each of my hands caressed their share of warm and soft skin, the one on the right slipped into Yuna's tight shorts and panties, and the one on the left up Rikku's skirt where my fingers played with the straps of her thong. Looking back at Paine, I said over the whipping wind,
"You know there's still room on my lap if you want to join us." Paine twitched her brows at me in annoyance before saying,
"Thanks, but I'd rather not."
"Suit yourself." I said with a shrug of my shoulders, only for something incredibly ridiculous to happen as we hit a bump.
"Wha-" Paine uttered as she lost her balance, and fell forward so that the crotch of her tight leather shorts landed right onto my nose and mouth.
'Well this is an interesting development...' I thought to myself, since I obviously couldn't speak with my mouth occupied.
With the swiftly moving sled under them on a sharp incline, Paine was unable to regain her previous balance even when she tried to use Yuna and Rikku for grip. Of course, it was even harder for Paine to regain her balance when my tongue traveled the length of her slit, which I was able to perfectly felt through the tight leather.
"N-no....d-don't..." Paine uttered, which was drowned out by the bloodcurdling screams of Yuna and Rikku.
And so we traveled down the snowy slope at breakneck speeds, my fingers playing with Yuna and Rikku, while my tongue toyed with Paine.
***
"NEVER DO THAT AGAIN!" Rikku shouted at me with a red face once the sled finally came to a stop at the very bottom of Mount Gagazet, just a short walk from the entrance to Zanarkand.
"Which part? Using the sled? Or playing with your ass and thong?"
"ALL OF IT!!!" Rikku shouted again, while Yuna tried to placate her and Paine looked away pointedly, trying to act as if she weren't embarrassed despite the fact that the tips of her ears were red.
Though it took a while, once Rikku finally settled down we began to head towards the area where we saw the people earlier. And as expected, there was quite the crowd.
"I'm so excited!"
"To think I'd actually get to see Zanarkand one day!
"And for only 300 Gil too! It's such a steal!"
As we made out way through the crowds of people such things could be heard, and with each one Yuna and Rikku appeared increasingly annoyed.
"What is this...?" Yuna growled as the realization that this place too had become a tourist stop, what was once the most sacred place in all of Spira.
"Who could have done this?" Rikku asked as we reached one spot in particular, the same exact place that they had stopped and made camp at two years ago.
"It's completely unrecognizable now...." Yuna continued as she looked at one place in particular, where someone was standing. I noticed that for the briefest of seconds there was a faraway look in Yuna's eyes, as if she were recalling something, when the person turned around suddenly and said,
"Yuna?" Coming out of her reverie, Yuna focused on the man who was approaching them and asked questioningly,
"Issaru?" The man, Issaru, approached them and said,
"It is an pleasure to see you again Lady Yuna, and I'm honored that you have remembered me." Yuna's only response was to chuckle awkwardly, while Rikku rolled her eyes.
'If I recall correctly Issaru is another Summoner that actually tried to fight Yuna because he thought she betrayed Yevon, though they were the ones who tried to silence her after she learned too much.' I thought to myself, but decided not to mention it since obviously no one else was going to.
"What are you doing here Issaru?" Yuna asked once the greetings were out of the way, to which the former Summoner said,
"I'm here to help Cid with his work." Issaru then looked towards the ruins with a gaze full of awe, before continuing,
"I too once dreamed of seeing this place, and with my work I can help others see the majesty and mysticism of Spira's most sacred place." As he said that Issaru gestured to the hundreds of people who had gathered, missing the obvious annoyance in Yuna's eyes.
"I'm sorry to cut our reunion short, but I have to get to work now. I hope to see you later Lady Yuna." Without giving any of us a chance to respond to anything he said, Issaru walked away as he headed towards the city itself.
"What is pops thinking!?" Rikku exclaimed once Issaru was out of earshot, referring to her and Brother's father, Cid.
"Who knows, maybe we should go ask him ourselves." Paine replied as she began to walk towards the ruins. Yuna however stood in place, seemingly trying to digest all of this until I put my hand on her shoulder,
"Come on, let's go." Yuna looked up at me from the contact, a determined look in her eyes as she nodded in affirmation. We then followed after Paine with Rikku hurrying alongside us.
...
As we wandered through the ruined streets of Zanarkand, all that was noticeable for as far as the eye could see was and endless sea of rubble and Pyreflies. It would have truly been a mesmerizingly sight, if not for the hundreds of people that were digging through said rubble without a single care for the damage they were causing at the same time.
"Looks like sphere hunters from all over Spira are here." Paine said as one of the group's celebrated from uncovering a sphere from some of the rubble. When we looked at the group celebrating though, Yuna uttered with confusion,
"Pacce?" Hearing his name, one of the three kids halted their celebration to look at us, before his face lit up in excitement.
"Lady Yuna!" The trio of children quickly rushed us as they gathered around Yuna, where their leader, Pacce, happily introduced his friends Hana and Taro.
"We're Sphere Hunters!" He then declared proudly, before striking a pose and declaring with one of his friends,
""THE KINDERGUARDIANS!""
"The Kinderguardians!"
The third one declared as she posed a moment too late, making the image more comical than serious as Rikku noticeably fought the urge to laugh out loud. Yuna however appeared concerned for them as she said,
"But aren't you all worried about the powerful fiends around here?" Pacce puffed up his chest proudly as he declared,
"It's alright Lady Yuna, our new friends will protect us!
"..."
Dead silence met Pacce's declaration as the three Gullwings looked around, before Yuna asked,
"What friends?" Rikku however quickly pulled on Yuna's shirt and whispered in her ear,
"Yunie! You should be more delicate since they're probably imaginary!" Pacce however heard this and angrily stated,
"They're not imaginary! They just went out to explore more of Zanarkand by themselves since they haven't joined the Kinderguardians yet!" Rikku however didn't appear to believe him, and was about to say something to Pacce when I put my hand on her shoulder and finally said,
"Wait a second Rikku." Though she looked at me curiously, the three Gullwings suddenly became alert when they felt the ground shudder beneath our feet.
"What was that?!" Rikku exclaimed in surprise, while Paine immediately readied her sword and pointed it in a certain direction.
"It comes!" She declared as her eyes just barely made out a giant figure moving within the debris.
At her lead, both Yuna and Rikku were similarly on their guard as they summoned their weapons to prepare for battle, the two of them knowing all too well how powerful the fiends in Zanarkand were. I however was completely relaxed as I gently pushed Paine's sword aside with a finger and said,
"Hold on there, that fiend has some other company with it." The three of them looked at me with confusion from my statement, until the large figure suddenly leapt up and sailed over us, before landing with a crash that kicked up a giant cloud of dust.
"DADDY!" A shrill voice suddenly cried out, before several figures flew out of the cloud of dust and into my arms, where they snuggled up against me happily.
"My monkeys! How is your adventure going?" I asked as if I wasn't receiving regular reports from Sun, which then prompted a tidal wave of shouting as each of the children tried telling me of the adventures they had since leaving Luca.
"I fought against soooooo many fiends papa!"
"We saw this huuuuuuuuge waterfall!"
"Alec and Myuu dove to the bottom of a giant river! There were even buildings in it!"
On and on the children bombarded me with info about their travels, while Yuna, Paine, and Rikku loosened the tensions in their bodies before recalling the hulking fiend from before. Edith then seemed to recall something as she pulled me towards the fiend and said,
"Daddy! We found a puppy while we were traveling! Can we keep it?! Can we? Can we? Can we?" Looking up at this 'puppy', I couldn't help but chuckle wryly as Sun left THIS out of her reports.
The 'puppy' was a massive fiend that was standing on all four of its legs as it anxiously watched us. It was covered in a thick layer of dark purple fur, that still wasn't thick enough to hide it's rippling muscles, while a long plume of yellow hair stuck up from it's brow, all the way down to its tail and even on the underside of it. On each side of its ferocious looking face was a pair of massive horns promised death to any unfortunate enough to find themselves on the other end of them, while a line of long spikes covered its shoulder blades.
He fiend was none other than the Behemoth, one of the most powerful fiends in all of Spira.
"We call him Spike because of all his spikes!" Edith supplied happily as if it would help their case in getting me to let them keep it. As she approached it though, 'Spike' cowered and shied away from Edith's presence, making me wonder what exactly she did to make it so docile.
Instead of dwelling on it though I stroked my chin and made an expression as if I was thinking, making each of the children practically hold their breath as they awaited my answer, until I finally said,
"Are you sure? Keeping a pet is a lot of responsibility. You'll have to feed him, walk him, and clean up after him every day." Not just Edith, but all of the children nodded excitedly while they chanted,
"""We will! We will! We will!"""
I then made a show of throwing my hands up into the air as if I had no choice, and said,
"Ok then, he's ALL of yours to take care of then."
"""YAAAAAAY!!!"""
The children all cried out with joy as they rushed me for another round of hugs, while the behemoth, Spike, looked resigned to the fact that, instead of one of the most powerful and feared fiends in all of Spira, he would spend the rest of his days as a children's pet. Taking another look at him though, I realized that it would be inconvenient to have such a large animal living in the Misty Manor.
So, I then turned my back to everyone and took several materials out my personal storages. I may not be the craftsman that Hajime is, but I can still make some pretty impressive things if I put my mind to it.
This however was a fairly simple item to make, as I used Creation magic to mold the materials to my liking and to infuse it with both Spirit and Alteration magics. Once I finished making my creation, I turned back around and held it up for everyone to see, making the children cheer while Spike audibly groaned in despair.
"Here's a new collar for Spike, with a set of tags and everything for him! Go ahead and put it on him Edith." Practically snatching the collar from my hands, which was mostly a chain, Edith flew up to spikes neck and looped it around him. The second that the collar was fastened around him though, Spike began to shrink at a rapid pace until finally he was about the size of your average terrier, and his shoulder spikes had disappeared while his horns were little more than rounded nubs.
"Spike shrunk!" Anna cried out in alarm, to which I explained,
"Don't worry, I just made it so that he could fit in our house better. After all, you wouldn't want Spike to crush all of the furniture in the house now, would you?" As if they just now realized that Spike indeed would have been too big for the Misty Manor,the children calmed down while Edith ran up and to me for one biiiiiiiiiiiig hug as she said,
"Thank you daddy!" Smiling warmly, I reached down and patted the top of my daughter's head with affection, which of course brought the rest of them to me for more attention as well while Spike proceeded to fall over as he tried to adjust to his new size.
...
After the reunion with my children I ended up sending them home so they could show Spike the manor, and properly get some rest after traveling for the past several days. Of course I sent Pacce and his friends with them as well, as the only other options would have been to use Spatial magic to wither send them back to Luca, or leave them alone in the dangerous and fiend infested Zanarkand.
With all that done, Yuna and Rikku led the way further into the ruins as we headed for the place where Cid was apparently running his business.
Eventually we came upon a series of ruins that were larger and more intact than the rest, which was all that remained of Zanarkand's Blitzball stadium. There we found a higher concentration of people as they all searched for ancient treasures and goodies, which they could acquire hints to find after paying a small sum to Cid and his employees.
As for the man himself, Cid was staying at the highest point in the stadium that had been reinforced to act as a 'base of operations' of sort, which was also where the majority of the money they'd made was kept. And when we approached him the man immediately focused on us before loudly declaring,
"WELL I'LL BE! IF IT ISN'T YUNA! Come to buy a clue from uncle Cid?" Grinning ear to ear from seeing Yuna, Cid was completely bald with the only hair on his head being his black eyebrows, and the goatee on his chin. Like all Al Bhed he had spiral green eyes and wore a jumpsuit, though curiously he had the word 'Love' tattooed on the side of his head.
"FRED TU OUI DREHG OUI'NA TUEHK(what do you think you're doing)!?" Rikku suddenly shouted at him in Al Bhed, making Cid look at us funny as he asked,
"What's wrong?" Rikku grew increasingly agitated as she practically shouted at him,
"Hello? Making this place a 'gift shop'? It's like if we made a theme park of Home!" Though Home was already repaired, Cid obviously knew what Rikku was referring to as he adopted a serious expression and said,
"I see your point..." He then looked at Yuna and asked her,
"Do you have a problem with what I'm doing Yuna?" Yuna took a deep breath before looking her uncle in the eye, and saying,
"It isn't right."
"..."
"I see..." Cid said after a moment, though I was sure I saw a bit of a shimmer in his eye from what Yuna said to him(A.N.in the game if you tell Cid this you literally find him balling his eyes out later because Yuna told him off).
Only then did Cid turn his attention towards me, seemingly just to find something else to focus on so he didn't lose it in front of Yuna and Rikku, and asked,
"And who are you?" For a moment I didn't reply, instead I slowly looked towards Rikku suggestively before a smile broke out on my face. Meanwhile Rikku's expression turned to horror as she realized that I must've been planning something, but before she could react I took her into my arms right in front of her father and said,
"While not quite yet, I'm the man who'll be banging your daughter in the near future." If she appeared horrified before, Rikku's current expression would've made someone feel like the world was ending as she promptly tried to hide her face from everyone around them. I then kissed the top of Rikku's head affectionately, effectively putting a cherry on top of the image we'd created as Rikku's still visible ears turned red.
"Is that so..." Cid said slowly in a low voice, his expression darkening as several of the employees around them took cover to avoid the worst of it when Cid naturally blew his top. Even Yuna took cover as she hid directly behind me while Rikku just wanted to crawl into a hole, before Cid suddenly shouted,
"THATS FANTASTIC! HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!" Naturally everyone looked up in surprise at his reaction, while even Rikku peaked out cautiously before her father continued,
"I was getting worried there for a bit! Gallivanting all over Spira with all this 'Sphere Hunter' nonsense, I was beginning to think you'd never properly find a husband Rikku! Now we just have to find little Yuna a good man, and the two of you'll be all set!" Cid then began to laugh boisterously at the 'good' news while everyone just gaped at him, until I said while pulling Yuna in close on the other side,
"Actually Yuna is technically already my wife. We just haven't had a ceremony yet." Naturally everything seemed to ground to a complete halt when I said that, while Cid then uttered "Huh?"
He then looked between both Yuna and Rikku, who were both wrapped in my arms, before looking back directly at my face and asking,
"And who do you think you are to think you can just waltz in here and claim both my niece and daughter?" Contrary to when I said I was taking his daughter, Cid's mood completely flipped when I said I had already taken Yuna for myself, as the leader of all the Al Bhed in Spira sized me up.
"Well....." I began slowly as if I was thinking of how to answer.
"I am the Emperor of Asora and another world, while I also control an entire nation in a second world. Not to mention that I'm pretty much an actual God." When he heard that Cid narrowed his eyes while never taking them off of me as he took a step closer, before asking,
"You're an actual emperor?"
"Yep, I even announced myself to Spira not too long ago during a broadcast in Luca. Don't worry though, Yuna and Rikku have already met several of my other wives and I'm pretty sure they'll all get along well in the future."
"I see...." Cid said before either girl could remark abut anything I was saying, as he took another step towards me so that we were now standing directly in front of one another.
"WELCOME TO THE FAMILY SON! CALL ME POPS! HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!" Cid then began laughing the hardest I'd heard yet while simultaneously clapping me on the shoulder, confusing a good many people around us as he readily accepted both Yuna and Rikku becoming my wives. Rikku however had completely forgotten to be embarrassed or to argue about becoming mine, as she instead gaped at her father for readily accepting the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - 436: Zanarkand Restored
chapters.content:
Once the introductions with Cid was over with the old man began barking out orders to all of his employees, most of which were to pack up and leave Zanarkand since Yuna didn't want them there. As everyone began to move though Alex said,
"You know, I can speed things up." Cid looked up curiously and asked,
"Oh really?" Alex nodded and, without any further explanation, waved his hand and teleported every single person in the ruins of Zanarkand just outside the entrance.
"What the-!?" Cid exclaimed in surprise at the sudden transfer, before everyone else Alex transferred began to voice their own shock and outrage at having their exploration cut short.
Once he realized what happened though, Cid immediately asked,
"That's a nifty trick and all, but was there a reason to kick everyone out so suddenly?" With Yuna and the other two also looking at him curiously, Alex nodded and said,
"Yep, I have my own plans for this place." Then without bothering to explain further, Alex began rising up into the air.
"Come." Alex commanded once he reach a certain height, his voice echoing across all of Spira and alerting the masses that something was happening.
At first nothing happened, but as the seconds ticked by the people gathered below Alex began to notice several changes happening in the space around Alex.
"Something must be up if you're calling us all here~Nyan." ***
A short few hours later Alex was standing in the newly renovated airship docking zone, where the numerous attendees of the meeting would be arriving on some of the different airships. Already having arrived were the council members of Luca, who ran the city in an impartial manner without favoring any of the factions, the elders of Kilika island, and Kimahri along with a few of his most trusted Ronso.
Eventually they saw a new airship approaching them from the horizon, which turned out to be the Fahrenheit that was transporting the guests from Besaid. After the ship docked as everything came to a halt, the side doors opened to reveal a certain duo that Alex had already met.
"Wakka! Lulu! I can't believe you guys came!" Yuna cried out excitedly as she rushed forward to greet them, to which Wakka replied while awkwardly rubbing the back of his head,
"Ya, I wasn't going to come since our kid's gonna be born any time now, but Lu insisted that this was too important to miss. Ya?" As he trailed off Lulu stated from behind him,
"This IS too important to miss Wakka. And the worst case scenario is that I give birth here instead of Besaid." As she said that Lulu caressed her swollen stomach, and Alex said to her,
"That wouldn't be such a bad thing, there are worse things to welcome the dawning of a new age than the first birth of a child that would live in such an age." As he said that Alex gently patted Lulu's stomach, to which the child within her responded by kicking the place where his hand rested.
As Wakka and Lulu were led away by one of the attendants, Alex noticed Yuna gently rubbing her own stomach as she watched them depart. Smirking, Alex whispered to her,
"Don't worry, we'll have an eternity together to have all the children you want." When she heard him Yuna's entire face turned red as she waved her hands and anxiously denied,
"That's not what I was thinking at all!" Alex's smirk widened as he told her,
"I see, then you must've wondered if you'd gotten pregnant already, huh? Well don't worry, Devils have a hard time reproducing so it could literally take a couple decades, or even a hundred years to have one kid without help of some kind." When she heard that Yuna's expression changed again, but this time it appeared like she didn't know what to think from what Alex told her.
At that time the next arrivals showed up, which was a group that had arrived the day before and spent the night in Zanarkand.
"Greetings lord Dragon Emperor." Baralai said as he and his entourage approached them, which consisted of numerous council members from New Yevon. Waving in response to Baralai's greeting, Alex said,
"Nice to see ya Baralai, how did you sleep?"
"Exceedingly well, the accommodations we were provided with were above and beyond what we expected, and are used to." With the rest of the council members behind Baralai voicing their agreements, Alex smiled politely at the praise and responded,
"That's good to hear. Now if you'll step this way, the next wave of guests are about to arrive." As he said, the next airship swiftly approached Alex's position as it came in for a landing, prompting Baralai and his entourage to quickly retreat inside the building they would be meeting at.
As the New Yevon representatives departed, Alex turned his attention towards the group that began disembarking the now stopped airship, the Guado. When their leader, an elderly looking Guado with green hair and matching beard, approached him, Alex said to him,
"Tromell I presume?" The Guado, Tromell, nodded slowly as he said,
"We thank the gracious Dragon Emperor for inviting us to join in this meeting, but we of the Guado can't help but to wonder if we have a place here..." As Tromell said that the rest of the Guado behind him appeared either anxious or downcast, all of them having acknowledged their collective 'guilt' in supporting Seymour Guado in his crimes.
Alex however readily said in a voice loud enough for them all to hear,
"Of course you do, this meeting is taking place specifically to settle old grudges and to help ALL the people of Spira move forward to create a better future, regardless of their past actions." Even as he said so, the Guado didn't seem swayed by Alex's words as they slowly made their way to the meeting.
They were a serious race that disliked outside interference in their affairs, even if it meant the difference between their own death or survival. Even before Alex called them to join in the meeting, the Guado had abandoned their home of Guadosalam as they awaited the retaliation of the Ronso for the deaths of so many of their people at Seymour Guado's hands, of which they had no intention of fighting back even if they were slaughtered down to the last man, woman, and even child.
Watching them leave, Alex only shook his head at their collective acceptance of their own supposed doom. Even Yuna, who had been one of the ones to suffer the most from Seymour's actions, seemed upset at their lack of will to fight against their supposed fate.
However, knowing that this meeting was intended to change just that, and that Alex had already dealt with the Ronso desire for vengeance, the duo put the matter of the Guado out of their mind as they turned to greet the latest of the arrivals.
"Greetings once more." The newest arrival said as he limped off of the next airship, his cane firmly grasped in his hands as his officers followed behind him.
"Likewise Nooj." Alex said as he greeted the Meyvn of the Youth League, before narrowing his eyes at one of the people behind him, Beclam.
The moment Beclam's eyes made contact with Alex's, he readily looked down to avoid prolonged contact, something that made Alex smirk. Noticing the instant interaction, Nooj explained,
"I'm hoping that by bringing him along Beclam can learn to overcome his shortcomings in order to see the bigger picture. It would be a waste for someone as skilled in combat as him to be sidelined forever." Alex of course nodded in agreement, as he understood the need to be a little 'tolerant' for those of great talent. However that didn't stop him from replying,
"Of course, though I hope he understands that if insults Yuna once again, being sidelined will be the last of his worries." Alex then clapped Beclam on the shoulder with a wide smile that was as fake as a Kardashian, and told him,
"Watch your mouth today, or I'll make sure you become a splendid Magical Girl." Of course, none of the Spirans around Alex understood the true meaning of the threat, but the attendants from Asora paled when they heard that as a few even looked at Beclam with pity.
Though he was about to ask what exactly that meant, when he noticed the looks he was receiving from those around him Beclam surprisingly decided to keep his mouth shut, earning him a smile from Alex that was a bit more genuine.
As the Youth League also made their way inside, the final group that would be attending the meeting arrived, the Machine Faction.
Despite being made up almost entirely out of Al Bhed, the Machine Faction was a separate group altogether that actively worked to create more awareness and understanding about Machina for the people of Spira. So, while Cid was representing all Al Bhed in general, Gippal arrived specifically for his own faction and followers.
"Heyyyy, how's it hanging?" Gippal asked Alex once he got close enough, extending his hand for a handshake as he did so.
"Well enough, be even better if it weren't for the politics." Alex said as he accepted Gippal's handshake, making the Al Bhed laugh as he replied,
"Ain't that the truth? Best to treat these things like a bandaid, and rip it off all at once." Alex laughed in agreement as he entered he building alongside Gippal and Yuna, while the higher ups of the Machine Faction followed behind them, one of which was their chief of excavation, Nhadala.
Entering the meeting room, which took up an entire floor of the skyscraper, Alex looked around to meet the eyes of everyone attending before he said,
"Welcome, and thank you all for attending today." As he took his seat at the large table, which was covered in a variety of snacks and pastries for everyone to enjoy, they too sat down and got comfortable. Meanwhile in every corner was a man or woman with a camera in their hands, which was streaming the meeting live to all of Spira so that everyone could see what was happening.
As everyone took their seats though, there was a palpable tension amongst several of the attendees. A couple of the Ronso with Kimahri glared at the Guado, while members of both the Youth League and New Yevon were glaring at each other as if they were mortal enemies. Thankfully though they all had arranged seating to prevent anything from happening, and everyone had also been required to hand over their weapons before entering the meeting hall.
Shaking his head with a sigh, Alex snapped his fingers while channeling Spirit magic, making everyone appear slightly alarmed as a noticeable change overcame them.
"Better?" Alex asked as he forcibly calmed everyone present, raising their awareness of him in particular even before he continued,
"Now, then, I presume you're all aware of why we're here today, correct?" The numerous faction leaders all nodded as Nooj said,
"Yes, we're here to discuss the future of Spira and find a way to end the hostilities between our differing factions." Nodding in affirmation Alex said,
"Correct. I hope that I don't actually have to specify this, but just in case, the future of Spira and her people is in a precarious stage at the moment. If things continue as they have been then a new war would be inevitable, a war that would make everything Sin has done in the last thousand years pale in comparison." Though some nodded in agreement at Alex's statement, a few frowned at him as Gippal asked,
"Isn't that overplaying things? I mean Sin was the greatest evil that ever existed! How would a war between these guys top THAT?" With everyone else looking at him expectantly, Alex sighed and explained,
"None of you are aware of this because there hasn't been a REAL war in Spira for over a thousand years, but the cruelest beings that exist aren't fiends, or even Sin, it's people. The worst crimes ever committed have always been by people, as only people are aware of what they're doing as they're doing it. Beings like fiends and Sin are typically only acting on instinct, meaning that there is usually no malicious intent behind their actions unlike people."
As everyone fell silent in contemplation, Kimahri then spoke up as he said,
"Alex words true. Sin not kill Ronso two years ago, Seymour Guado kill Ronso with hopes of extermination." Though he wasn't trying to point fingers at them, the participating Guado looked down in shame of Seymour's past actions, while everyone else adopted serious expressions from the example Kimahri gave them.
Everyone knew of what happened that day, that when the Ronso stood in the path of his pursuit of Yuna and her Guardians, Seymour unhesitatingly slaughtered them with the intentions of exterminating their entire race. He then proceeded to taunt Kimahri by telling him he was the last of his kind, and offering him 'mercy' by killing him as well to relieve him of his pain.
Looking at everyone present, Alex then said in a firm voice,
"What Kimahri said is true, war gives people an excuse to commit the most horrible atrocities they can think up in the name of attaining victory." As he said that Alex used magic to project images of the numerous atrocities he had seen, from the actions of the Chaos Brigade in the DXD world, to the crimes and destructions cause by the remnants of Ehito's worshippers on Tortus.
And as they truly behold images of war and the horrors that a person was capable of committing the faces of those who were attending the meetings changed in various ways, even if the change was slight as Nooj and Baralai simply turned ashen pale. However, even in the face of such atrocities, Nooj said,
"That's all well and good to show us, but what about the various people in our different factions? For some the conflict is more personal, and they probably wouldn't take well to us trying to play nice if we even tried for peace." With several others nodding in agreement or throwing looks of blame, Kimahri was the one who answered instead of Alex as his guttural voice said,
"Rating Games." With confusion filling the attendees, Alex readily launched an explanation of the Games and how they worked.
...
