What they found waiting for them though was almost the exact opposite of what the duo expected, though in hindsight it made sense when they considered that Lala shared the island with her mother and sisters.
Everywhere the two girls looked they saw lush vegetation with numerous small and cute animals frolicking around them, almost all of which were completely alien to them. Though what was really surprising was when Yuna noticed some of the small animals and plants they had on Spira, like some of the monkeys that one would typically see around Zanarkand when it was still ruins, or even the lilies found on the Moonflow.
"It's so pretty here!" Rikku exclaimed while looking around excitedly, as even the animals around them began to approach them curiously. Soon they were both petting and holding several of the animals that were living on the island, more and more of which were approaching them with each passing minute.
"Look at this little cutie." Yuna said as she picked up one particular little animal, one that was mostly black with a white back, along with several other white tufts and stripes, and a fluffy tail.
"He's so soft!" Yuna said happily as she patted it and scratched its chin, making the animal squint its eyes in pleasure. A second later however, the small animal let out a sound like a fart, and they were both enveloped in a greenish gas.
"Gah gah! What was that?!" Rikku coughed and exclaimed in a higher tone of voice than usual, before the cloud of gas began to disperse and she and Yuna began to gape at each other.
Both of them had shrunken noticeably while they also seemed to become more childlike in appearance, but most unfortunately was that their clothes no longer seemed to fit.
"What happened!?" Yuna cried out in alarm as she tried to keep her now too large shorts and panties from falling down her legs, while Rikku's were now pooled around her ankles due to both of her hands being full of now smaller animals.
"Did we...turn back into children!?" Rikku asked as she set the animals down, and tried to fix her own clothing as her bikini top and ribbon sleeves also tried to fall off.
Leaving the animals behind in the wake of their sudden change, the duo quickly located and made their way to the only building on the floating island. After ringing the doorbell though, they then had to wait a couple minutes before they heard Lala cry out on the other side,
"Coming!" Relief filled the duo at the thought of being able to remedy their current predicament, until the door opened to reveal Lala completely naked, the only thing on her being the towel wrapped around her head.
"Good morning- wait, why are you guys so small?" Lala asked curiously as she greeted them, earning her a deadpan as Rikku exclaimed,
"Something out there sprayed us and now we're kids again!" When she heard that Lala made an expression of realization as she also smack her fist against her palm, and said,
"Ah! That must've been the Skunk of Youth!"
"Skunk of Youth?" Yuna asked curiously, to which someone else behind Lala explained,
"It's a skunk that sprays a cloud of gas that makes those enveloped in it young again, instead of stinking like a normal skunk. Don't worry though, the effects are temporary and will wear off in about an hour or so." From behind Lala appeared a petite figure that shared her vibrant pink hair, but not her proportions as she looked just as flat as Yuna and Rikku were at the moment. Nana.
Similarly to her sister she too looked as if she had just gotten out of the bath, but unlike Lala she at least had a towel wrapped around her body. Looking at her own sister though, Nana said in an exasperated voice,
"Big sis you should really stop waking around naked like that after we take a bath, you'll catch a cold. Or even worst, that beast will show up and take advantage of you again." Lala however waved away her little sister's concerns as she said,
"It's fine Nana, PEKE!" Yuna and Rikku followed Lala as she turned back around into the house, both of them trying very hard not to look at Lala's exposed and bouncing butt. That was a task made all the harder due to Lala's tail moving behind her and drawing attention to it.
They were distracted though when a small doll-like machine drifted into the room on its own pair of devil-like wings, and asked,
"Did you need me Lala-sama?" As Yuna and Rikku gaped at the thing, Lala quickly explained to it,
"They accidentally got sprayed by the Skunk of Youth, so can you fix their clothes?" As a machine she built to act as her own clothes, and could change into almost any outfit on a whim, Peke was more than capable of modifying Yuna and Rikku's clothes so they would fit them again.
And a second later they were both standing there in their newly adjusted clothes as Nana apologized,
"Sorry about that, Momo and I usually keep our friends in a virtual space that big sis made, but we let some of the more harmless ones run around and live on the island." As the Skunk of Youth's spray wasn't at all actually threatening or deadly, it too had been allowed to run loose with the others, though it could be considered a small annoyance if someone didn't know what it was and got sprayed.
"It's ok, we were mostly just surprised." Yuna assured Nana as Lala also got dressed, now equipped in her usual alien-wear jumpsuit with a large hat. She then retrieved Yuna's Dresspheres and returned them while saying,
"Here you go Yuna, thanks for letting me look at them!" Yuna accepted the spheres and reequipped them into her Garment Grid while replying,
"It's no problem, did you get everything you needed?" Lala beamed at the question as she excitedly replied,
"Yep! I managed to make my very own Dressphere!" Her answer caught both Yuna and Rikku by surprise, as neither expected that Lala would've made her own Dressphere just by looking at Yuna's overnight. Lala then produced a wand-like object topped with a pink heart that had bat-like wings spreading from the sides, and continued,
"I tried making one before, but couldn't make it with just regular clothes." She then closed her eyes and focused, before crying out,
"MECHA MAGICAL GIRL, TRANSFORM!" Yuna and Rikku watched in amazement as the wand lit up their surroundings and enveloped Lala, hiding her from view as she made a transformation within. Once it died down though, she was wearing something they never expected.
"Presenting, Iron-Lala!" Lala proudly declared while taking a pose, adding to the strangeness of the current scene.
Currently Lala was completely encased in a black robotic armor with pink hearts all over it, many of which were illuminated along with the two points where her eyes were. Even her tail was encased in its own suit as it swayed excitedly behind her, while her long and pink hair was the only part of Lala's body that wasn't covered.
After posing for a second, Lala then explained with a slightly more robotic voice,
"I tried making this to better channel and control my powers, because if we use too much energy then we'll shrink like you are now." As she spoke Lala recalled the time she fought Yami when she first transformed into Darkness, as well as her father who had also been reverted into a child-like state after the Galactic War. Thankfully though her reversion had only been temporary, while her father's had been permanent.
Thinking about him though, Lala became slightly downcast as she recalled both him and her first love, Rito.
For a moment Lala didn't say anything as her expression became somewhat melancholic under her suit's mask, before she forced herself to pep up as she continued,
"Anyways, what I really wanted to make was a certain other type of outfit, but I wasn't sure how until now!" As she said that Lala dismissed her robotic armor, making everyone's brows twitch as she was once again naked. With Peke reappearing next to Lala in her doll-like form, she said,
"Sorry Lala-sama, it's really hard for me to maintain my button form when you transform like that." Lala however waved away Peke's apologies and said,
"It's ok Peke! I'll try and figure something out for you later!"
"Thank you Lala-sama." Peke said respectfully at that, while Yuna and Rikku were both sure they heard tones of happiness within Peke's robotic voice. The longer they were around her, the more the two girls were fascinated by Peke due to never having seen such a Machina before.
However Lala soon commanded their attention once more as she retrieved a second wand that was identical to the first, except the heart on this one was clear crystal.
"TRANSFORM!" Lala cried out for the second time, triggering a second light show. Unlike the first one though, this time ribbons of light shot out of the crystal at the tip of the wand, spreading out through Lala's surroundings before they began wrapping around her naked body.
Once Lala's entire body was wrapped within the ribbons of light, it began to flash piece by piece to reveal one area of Lala's transformed body at a time. Starting from her legs and feet, the light flashed before vanishing to reveal a pair of pink boots that went up to her knees over her bare legs.
Then what was revealed was a short pink skirt with black ascents that only went about halfway down her thighs, with a matching belt hanging loosely on her hips. Then on her hands and arms was a pair of white gloves that went up past her elbows with pink ruffles on the edges, as well as several jeweled rings on her fingers.
On Lala's abdomen was a white button up top that, like her gloves, had pink ruffles on the edges, while the collar flared out around her neck. Then, on Lala's head was a golden tiara that held her hair in place, while a single Ruby-red teardrop gem dangled from it in the middle.
Opening her eyes, Lala smiled widely before twirling the wand around, which produced a series of shining sparkles and did so, and struck a pose as if she was about to fight evil in the name of the moon before declaring,
"Introducing a defender of friendship and justice, magical girl LA-TAN!!!" Even as Lala introduced herself to them though, all Nana was able to do was deadpan at her sister, while Rikku and Yuna clapped politely for her. Neither one had ever heard of magical girls before, so they just thought that Lala's new getup was just like any of their other Dresspheres with it own unique set of abilities.
"Big sis...." Nana uttered in disbelief, which Lala apparently took the wrong way as she excitedly said,
"Don't worry Nana, I made a transformation wand for you, Momo, Yue, and Serafall as well!" When she heard that Nana turned deathly pale as she also became somewhat unsteady on her feet. Meanwhile, elsewhere in Asora, Yue suddenly shuddered as her dreaded 'black history' reared its ugly head for some reason.
Not understanding her sister's reaction though, Lala readily brought, Yuna, and Rikku into her own virtual training room to show off the abilities of her transformation. Of course her actions were more impactful than even she expected, as Lala proceeded to eliminate any enemies that spawned before her and even destroy entire landscapes with whip-like ribbons of light, and heart shaped blasts of magical power.

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - 442: A New World
chapters.content:
"LETS GO LADIES!" A voice shouted as several rabbit eared figures flew through their surroundings, which was a forest with trees so large their interiors could be carved out for homes.
The next thing the rabbit in the front of the group knew a large humanoid figured leapt out and snapped its teeth at him, which he very narrowly avoided by using his ODM gear to make himself spin to the side. As the Titan's attention was on him though, another rabbit flashed right by as they carved a chunk of flesh out of the back of the Titan's neck, killing it instantly.
That was just the beginning though, as an entire horde of Titans suddenly appeared and attacked the squad of rabbits. Rather than panic though, the one who had just nearly been eaten shouted,
"FORMATION 27-B!" Immediately the other rabbits began moving in uniform as they systematically avoided the Titan's attacks, before eliminating them within minutes.
As the last Titan began dissolving into the steam, the rabbits gathered to discuss the battle and any areas they needed to improve in. During their discussion though, the environment around them began to change as they went from the large forest to the very edge of a sheer cliff that was so far up, it appeared as if they were standing on the edge of the world.
Immediately the rabbits moved into a formation as they watched all sides for oncoming enemies, until one of their's ears began to twitch.
"Is that....buzzing?" One asked in confusion as he looked around for the source of the noise, before glancing over the edge of the cliff they were on. For a second nothing happened, before a swarm of massive wasp-like creatures began swarming up at them from the fog below.
"WASPS! SCATTER!" The rabbit-man yelled right before they all took off in different directions.
There appeared to be hundreds of Wasps, composed of the four different Wasp-type fiends that one might find in Spira, that surround the one massive Wasp Queen. With so many small enemies appearing the idea wasn't to stay gathered in one place to become a target for all of them, but to split up and scatter so that the Wasps also had to split into smaller groups to give chase.
And that was exactly what they did.
With each rabbit having tens or dozens of Wasps chasing them, each with deadly stingers that were nearly a foot long with a cocktail of toxins in them, they all focused on evasion rather than conflict. Instead, they all kept careful track of where their comrades were as they raced through the air, and when an opportunity presented itself, two of the rabbits would perform a flyby to eliminate several of the Wasps that were chasing the other.
With every one of the rabbits cooperating without any form of verbal communication between them, Wasps were soon raining down from the skies as they quickly and efficiently worked to eliminate them. If a rabbit was coming up on them from the front of the one they were chasing, then another would strike from the side to cull the swarm even more. Then when they were distracted by the sudden attack, the same rabbit they had weary of before would strike from the front.
Soon even the Wasp Queen felt the need to become involved as she began giving chase as well. Unlike the rest of the Wasps though, she possessed much more power with a longer and deadlier stinger, meaning that within seconds the rabbit that was her quarry could feel the air vibrating around him from the beat of her wings.
Immediately from the side one of the other rabbits came in with her blades at the ready, only for the both to snap as they struck in the incredibly hard exoskeleton of the Wasp Queen.
"Damn!" The rabbit-girl swore as the Wasp Queen turned its attention to her, prompting her to quickly take off as the massive stinger stabbed right in the spot she'd been just a second earlier.
Again the Wasp Queen gave chase to the new target as she quickly closed in on the rabbit-girl, only for yet another rabbit to swoop in from the side to try another attack with completely fresh blades. Again however the blades snapped against the Wasp Queen's exoskeleton, but this time she didn't change target as she persistently chased the rabbit-girl.
When the next rabbit moved in at the side though, the Wasp Queen was ready this time as she immediately pivoted in midair and poised her stinger right in the rabbit's path, only for him to use his ODM gear to make a last second ditch effort to avoid her attack. As she was focused on him though, another rabbit plummeted down from above as they used their ODM gear to move as fast as possible at his target.
"TRY THIS!" He cried out as he began spinning like a top, before his blades sliced cleanly through the very thin and weak segment holding the two parts of the Wasp Queen's body together.
As the two segments came apart the rabbits gathered once again on the edge of the massive cliff, and watched as they fell back into the mists below.
"That....haa....haa...wasn't too hard..." One of the rabbits said as he tried to catch his breath, but no sooner were the words out of his mouth before the scenery around them changed once again, and the entire group found themselves falling through skies above a chain of active volcanoes, which were the homes of hundreds of wyverns.
***
"Man, I really love these Dresspheres!" A high pitched voice declared in the middle of the crowded lunchroom at the Academy, a voice belonging to the young witch, Yukari Sendo.
In response to her declaration though the boy next to her, Millicas, chuckled dryly due to the numerous looks Yukari's declaration drew their way. Noticing Millicas' reaction, but not apparently why, Yukari quickly and loudly declared as she latched onto his arm,
"But not as much as I love you Millicas!" This time several of the surrounding students were the ones chuckling in amusement at Millicas' current predicament. Like a chain reaction, the rest of the girls sitting at their table immediately tried to hog Millicas or make a pass at him themselves, but a single look from Yukari was enough to cow them, for the moment.
Though she wasn't necessarily powerful compared to the majority of them, Yukari was still Millicas' 'Queen', and she managed to retain her position for a reason. What she lacked in strength, Yukari more than made up for in intelligence and raw talent in almost any school of magic she laid her hands on. Not only that, but she was also prone to inventing any number of magical items that had any number of effects, which she wouldn't hesitate to use to harass or embarrass those who irked her.
On top off all that, Yukari had also collected one of every type of Dressphere that had recently become available, which was helping her draw out all the benefits her position as 'Queen' gave her. Though she was originally more compatible with the 'Bishop' piece to begin with, Yukari was also becoming more accustomed to the traits associated with the 'Knight' and 'Rook' pieces as well due to the Dresspheres.
Despite the fact that there were some limits placed on people who obtained Dresspheres, to keep them from simply collecting every single one even if they wouldn't be able to master even one, Yukari had gotten her hands on all of them. This was due to her peerless intellect and talent, which allowed her to excel at all of them to certain extent within a short amount of time. She still had a VERY long road ahead of her to completely master them of course, but Yukari was still a fair ways ahead of the majority of those who also received the Dresspheres.
Millicas on the other hand was trying to prevent any fighting from breaking out amongst his peerage, using the advice Alex and his father gave him to take a firmer hand, when he suddenly received a message from his mother.
"What's up?" One of the girls asked curiously as Millicas' expression changed when he read the message, to which he replied,
"I have to cancel our plans tomorrow."
***
"And here we are!" Alex declared to his family, before the older children responded by squealing and shrieking in excitement as they ran out to explore their surroundings.
Currently Alex had brought a good chunk on his family to a large chasm in Asora that had been recently discovered by Artemis and her huntresses. Winding through the chasm was a large river that was being fed by a waterfall, which was also surrounded by towering trees and lush greenery. At the edge of the river though was a long expanse of sandy beach, which was what Alex and the others came for.
With him was of course all of Alex's children, as well as their mothers, the members of his peerage, and a few others. With his countdown expiring the following day, they decided to have a nice and fun family day beforehand.
"This place looks really cool~Nya!" Kuroka declared as she readily removed her kimono, revealing her mature and alluring figure to all present, though thankfully her most intimate areas were hidden behind her scant bikini.
Normally Kuroka would rather strut around naked, despite the children, but with Millicas, Vali and Elfman also accompanying them she reluctantly wore a swimsuit to help ward off prying eyes. However her bikini was still revealing enough that Grayfia sent her a pointed look, but ultimately decided to hold her tongue until Kuroka did do something to warrant confrontation.
All around the girls mimicked her by stripping down to their swimsuits, with the girls either in one or two piece swimsuits, and the guys in their swim trunks. The girls then began laying down blankets and getting out the various necessities and toys they'd brought for the little ones, while the children themselves started exploring.
"Alec, Anna, come back here so I can get some sunblock on you two!" Anne called out in a firm voice, which brought the twins reluctantly back to her to be covered in the protective lotion. And with all of Alex's children carrying his devil traits, meaning they were more susceptible to sunburns, every single one of them was forced to come back and receive their share of block.
As they did that Alex explored an open area above the beach, and marked out a squared area about twenty feet across in both directions. Once he was done marking it out, Alex then called out,
"Millicas, Alec, Regal, come here a moment." When the trio of boys were finished getting sunblock applied to them, the older two approached Alex curiously while Regal excitedly ran up to him.
Picking the little Phenix up in his arms, Alex said to him,
"Hey little man, wanna help daddy out?" Regal excitedly bobbed his head up and down as Alex told him and the older two,
"I want you guys to go out and find as much firewood as you can. Remember, nothing green, just stuff that's already dead." While Millicas just nodded in affirmation and headed out to do as Alex asked, both Alec and Regal paired up as they ran off into the brush, both excited to help their dad.
With the trio setting out to collect the firewood for him, Alex started working on his job.
Following the markers he'd set out, Alex used his 'Telekinesis' to begin digging a giant hole twenty feet wide and long, and five feet deep. With him going slowly to make sure he got the depth and dimensions how he wanted them, by the time Alex was done the three boys had collected enough firewood to completely fill the pit, mostly logs and stumps they ripped out of the ground.
Regardless of what they brought, Alex told the three of them to throw it all into the pit as he made sure the wood was scattered evenly. Once that was done Alex said to them,
"Ok, now we only need to l-l-AAAAAACHOOOOOOOOOO!!!" Sneezing suddenly, blazing flames shot out of Alex's nose and into the pit, making all of the kids that were watching exclaim in surprise and amazement, while some of the wives didn't appear quite as amused.
Regardless of how it was started though, there was now a raging fire in the giant pit that Alex dug. Letting it burn for the moment, Alex then turned his attention to why he started the fire in the first place.
"Alright boys, let's prepare dinner." As it was still early enough that several people were still full from breakfast, Alex's words caused some confusion even as he produced numerous types of meat that had been stored in a spatial ring, along with a massively large pot.
He then walked the three boys through prepping and wrapping up the dozens of meats, which included giant chunks of ham, turkeys, beef, and several other cuts taken from the creatures that had been hunted in Asora. Then, in the massive pot, Alex dumped a bunch of water from the river, which he had already confirmed was clean, before tossing in fifteen whole prepped chickens, a few bags of carrots, tomatoes, garlic, onions and celery, before topping it off with a handful of mixed spices.
Looking over their spread of meats, Alex nodded to himself and said,
"Looking good, but I feel like we're missing something...?" Thinking for a moment as the three boys watched him, Alex suddenly made an 'aha!' gesture before walking right up to the edge of the river, and diving in.
As wide as it was, the river was also very deep with numerous cavities and small caves dotted in the sides and bottom for things to hide in. But even as they tried to hide from him in the deep, dark waters, Alex was still able to locate what he was after.
Within minutes he reemerged from the river with two still struggling catfish slung over his shoulders, both of which were nearly twenty feet long with mouths big enough to even swallow people whole. Despite their struggling though, Alex slung them down on the beach next to the rest of the food they were preparing, and within another minute there were four long flays harvested from the fish that were similarly prepped, before being wrapped in tinfoil like the rest of the meats.
"Alright, that'll do it!" Alex then looked back at the three boys, and said,
"I'm gonna show the three of you one of the best ways to slow cook your meats while camping! First you make sure they're all wrapped up like so!" Alex then gestured to the meats they had already prepared, all of which were wrapped in tinfoil while the large pot had been topped and magically sealed to prevent leakage.
"Then you get a nice bed of coals going in a deep pit!" Alex then gestured to the fire that was still going beside them, but under Alex's influence it had turned into a nice and hot bed of coals.
"Next we're going to place all of our meats directly onto the coals, before shoveling more coals on top!" Alex then led the boys in doing exactly that, with the massive pot going directly into the center of the pit, while each of the meats were arrayed around it.
Once everything was neatly arranged, Alex then finished,
"And finally we fill the hole back in and leave everything there until we dig it up tonight!" Naturally his words caused a bit of a stir amongst those who hadn't heard of cooking in this fashion before, and Alec asked with tears eyes,
"Is the food no good daddy?!" Smiling wryly at his son's distress from burying the meats, Alex shook his head and explained as he used his 'Telekinesis' to sweep the dirt he'd removed earlier back into the hole,
"No, but the dirt is going to seal in the heat and help the meat cook. When we dig it up it'll be really good, trust me!" Deciding to trust in his father, Alec became notably happier to hear that the meat would still be good after they buried it, and became really excited to eat it when they had dinner.
After that was a day of fun as everyone enjoyed themselves on the river.
Alex led his children as they all charged and dove into the water to splash and play as they pleased, while the youngest children were being carried by their mothers to the edge of the water so they too could splash around.
Looking around, one would see the princess Hisui carrying her newborn daughter, Jade, Levy was sitting at the edge of the water with her son Andre in her lap, while Millicas gently walked his little sister, Lana, around. Meanwhile many of the older children were excitedly running around, swimming, or climbing the cliffs to jump off into the river.
Though Alex already confirmed that there were giant catfish in the river capable of swallowing them whole, none of them were worried as, not only could each of the children easily take care of themselves, but Alex's presence alone was enough to deter the large fish from even leaving their hiding holes. Instead, there was probably more of a risk of the children swimming down to try and catch some themselves.
As the day wore on and got hotter, everyone took a break from playing to eat some lunch, which consisted of a simple but satisfying sandwiches and chips. Afterwards though everyone got a treat as Mizore, Tsurara, Yuki, and Aurora used their ice powers and fresh fruit to make some frozen treats for them.
Taking a big bite out a piece of frozen watermelon that Tsurara's daughter, Aurora, brought him, Alex smiled widely and said to her,
"It's really sweet, just like you!" As he said that Alex gently poked her nose with his finger, making Aurora smile widely and giggle a little as she ran off to get him another piece.
After lunch they all took of bit of a rest as they waited for the food to digest, before going out to play with even more vigor than they had that morning. Alex even made his way up to a tree that hung out over the edge of the cliffs, and tied a piece of rope to it for the children to use as a rope swing. Then, with a call like a certain 'king of the jungle' he swung out and dove into the river from over a hundred feet in the air.
Along with his own children though, Alex also made sure to spend some time with his goddaughter, Vali's daughter, Lilith.
She too was growing fast due to Vali and Aiko spending time in their own personal space-time orb like Alex did, and was roughly around the same age as Lana. Alex found this somewhat humorous due to the fact that they were both from the Lucifuge and Lucifer families, which were always closely related in the past.
As the day wore on and the sun sank lower, more and more members of their groups began to get tuckered out from all the playing and excitement, and went to collapse on one of the many blankets that had been spread out on the sand. As dusk began to creep up on them though, Alex decided that it was finally time to dig up the food they buried earlier that morning.
As the dirt was lifted away, and Alex pulled the many meats out of the still glowing coals, a mouth watering aroma filled the air once the meats were unwrapped, one by one. Immediately there was round of growling as everyone's stomachs began to roar in anticipation for the feast ahead.
"Alright everyone," Alex said as he unwrapped the last of the meats. "Dig in."
Though they were all eager to dig into the food, everyone hesitated until Rias asked the question on everyone's minds.
"Where's the eating utensils?" Alex however cocked his head in confusion as he asked in return,
"Utensils?" He then smiled widely before reaching down and picking up a particularly large piece of meat with a single bone through, what others commonly recognized as 'anime meat', and tore into it before saying through a mouth full of food,
"What utensils!? We're going caveman here!" Following their father's lead, the children then readily tore into the food before them like a pack of ravenous animals.
Realizing that Alex was being serious, many of the girls looked at each other questioningly, even as Elfman also followed Alex's lead and began tearing into the food with gusto.
Slowly but surely the rest of the girls began to dig into the numerous meats, though they tried to act a bit more civilized than Alex and the children were acting. Eventually there was only Grayfia standing there without any food, clearly unsure of what she was supposed to do.
Alex then approached her with a massive drumstick that he ripped off of one of the turkeys, and said while offering it to her,
"Here, eat up!" Though her eyes twitched at the gesture, Grayfia eventually sighed as she adopted a defeated look, and accepted the drumstick from him. Alex then watched with a widening smile as she hesitantly bit into the drumstick, which then covered her mouth and chin in gristle from how juicy the meats were.
Laughing loudly at how awkward she looked from the new experience, Alex loudly declared,
"Eat up everyone! There's plenty for everybody!" He then removed the large pot from the coals as well, before also removing the lid to allow the smell of the chicken soup to spread throughout the surroundings.
Alex then produced the only utensils he'd allow for the meal, small bowls, and took one to scoop up some of the soup before loudly slurping it as the delicious broth trickled down his throat. Again everyone followed his lead as they too tried some of the soup, before they continued to gorge themselves on meat.
Soon after the feast was over, everyone then laid down on the blankets and stared up at the stars as they began appear. They then spent the rest of the night watching the night skies as shooting stars streaked across, as one by one the children quickly began to drift to sleep after a full day of playing, followed by a feast of various meats.
After the kids Alex's wives also began to drift to sleep, until he was the only one left. It was only then that he too closed his eyes, and drifted off to sleep under the stars, surrounded by his children and loved ones.
***
The next morning everyone awoke on the same beach they all played so enthusiastically on the day before, covered in sand of course.
After a while of fighting with the children to get them up, Alex and the girls did a sweep of the beach to make sure they had cleaned up every single piece of trash they might've left. Then, they headed home.
"How long until we leave?" Rias asked as they returned to the Misty Manor, to which Alex replied,
"I don't really want to delay any longer than necessary, so how about getting to Luca by noon?" Nodding in confirmation, Rias and the rest of the girls swiftly vanished into the space-time orb to have more time to recuperate from sleeping on the beach, and especially to wash up.
While they did that Alex took the children to the baths in the manor, helping them all to wash and clean up as well alongside himself. Then, with no idea what was waiting for him on the other side, Alex made a quick trip to any place that might need his attention before departing.
Thankfully there wasn't any major issues that required Alex's attention, and by the time he finished making his rounds the girls were finished resting and getting ready in the orb.
"This is so exciting!" Yuna said as everyone got together once more, to which Kuroka seriously responded while nodding her head,
"Yep yep~Nya. Even if Alex can take everyone with him through Asora, only we are able to directly travel with him~Nya. This is our privilege~Nya!" Yuna was then surprised as everyone nodded seriously in response to Kuroka's strangely serious remark, showing her just how honored they were be a part of Alex's chosen.
A sense of pride and responsibility then filled her as Yuna was once again reminded of who she was now, and what her future would hold as Alex's 'Pawn', the last of his Evil Pieces. That was a thought seemingly shared by everyone as Lucy stated,
"It's still weird to think that this will be all of us." The rest of the girls muttered their agreements as they slowly looked at one another, until Alex said to them seriously,
"I chose all of you for a reason, and I would never change that for anything. Hold your heads high and walk proudly." As he said that the girls all puffed out their chests, a sight that was more mesmerizing when some did it than others, and held their heads high.
With everyone ready, Alex opened the first of the portals they would be going through.
Firstly was a wall of mist that led directly into Luca, right where they had first arrived to Spira with Anne. There, Alex then surprised everyone as his figure began to shrink down slightly, while his fur began to disappear and his hair began to grow shorter.
"Why'd you change back to your base form Alex?" Mirajane asked curiously, while Yuna gaped as this was the first time she was seeing Alex in his base form.
"A precaution." Alex said simply before adding,
"All of you too, the people where we're going are very sensitive to strong energy levels given off by people. Until we know exactly what things are like on the other side, force your energies down so we can keep a low profile."
In response to his warning, the girls all then took a second to force their respective energies down to negligible levels, or equip artifacts that would cloak their energies for them if they couldn't. Once they were done Alex smiled widely, his excitement peaking at the thought of the world they were about to enter, and another portal formed before him that Alex readily stepped through.
The moment everyone was through, they all looked around in awe of where they were.
Surrounding them was a city, but was completely unlike any city Alex and the girls had ever seen, except perhaps Lala and Yami. There were towering skyscrapers all around them, but at the top of several of them were round bulbous sections that expanded out to the sides from the rest of the tower, kinda like a dandelion. Also above them was a series of tubing of various sizes, which were used as roadways or walkways.
There was also numerous flying vehicles zipping between the buildings, while on the streets before them was a mixture of vehicles that either hovered, flew, or rolled on wheels like more typical vehicles. What really caught the girl's eyes though was when a massive shadow eclipsed them, courtesy of a giant dinosaur that flew overhead.
"This place sure is strange..." Shia muttered as she took in the sights, which Alex figured it was for her, Yue, Lucy, Mirajane, and Erza specifically due to them coming from more medieval world's. But, before he could reply to her comment, something else caught Alex's attention.
Unlike the flying dinosaur that seemed pretty chilled as it passed overhead, the people on the street level appeared to be on the verge of panicking as they hurried too and fro up and down the street. Realizing that he more than likely didn't end up in the time he aimed for, Alex immediately waked up to a random man on the street and asked,
"Excuse me, what's going on around here?" The man looked at Alex like he was stupid, and snapped irritably,
"What, do you live under a rock or something?" Alex just shrugged and replied,
"I live out in the countryside with my family and don't get the news. I just came in for some supplies with my wives and saw the panic." Though the man's eyes passed briefly over the women behind him, his expression softened slightly upon realizing that Alex genuinely didn't know what was going on as he said,
"It's the end man... In one week, all of us will be killed..."

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - 443: Start of the Cell Games
chapters.content:
(A.N. Before people start freaking out there WILL be several things different from the cannon Dragon Ball.)
Deep in the rocky and wild lands of uninhabited Earth, there stood a solitary figure in the center of a large square tiled ring.
Unlike a normal person they appeared notably insect-like in appearance, with large sections of their body covered in what appeared to be green and purple carapaces. On either side of its head was another section of carapace that wrapped around halfway before jutting straight up, while the actual top of its head was purple.
Descending from its shoulders was a pair of long beetle-like wings that went all the way down to the back of its knees, while nestled between the wings at their base was syringe-like stinger.
The thing, Cell, stood stoically and silently as if waiting for something like he had already been doing for the last ten days, except for when he wiped out the foolish soldiers that tried to attack him.
All of a sudden though he looked up, and smirked as if he found something humorous.
"Finally, they're here." He muttered to himself as several figures approached him from the sky.
Touching down first on some nearby cliffs was a man with a perpetually angry expression on his face, with his black hair standing straight up on end to make him look like an angry pinecone. Immediately after him was a younger looking man with purple hair that was combed straight into a bowl cut.
Then, one after another, arrived several more people like the non-human Namekian Piccolo, who had green skin with pink patches on his arms, the triclops Tien Shinhan, and a shorter man with a bald head and six scarred dots on the middle of his forehead. Last to arrive though was a trio of individuals with golden hair that was sticking straight up similarly to the first man's, except one of them was an actual child.
"You've arrived!" Cell declared with humor in his voice as he turned to face the new arrivals, almost as if he hadn't expected them to show up. Cell then focused his attention on one of the men with the golden hair, the one who appeared to be between the other two in age and had a massive broadsword strapped to his back, as he commented,
"Oh? I don't believe we've met! And you are?" Rather than being taken in by Cell's polite mannerisms, the young man stepped forward and declared with a scowl,
"I'm Grant, a Saiyan that's here to help take you down!" As he declared so Grant's golden energy suddenly spiked as if to show how serious he was, though the duo next to him noticed that his hands were trembling slightly.
"Don't worry Grant, I'll face Cell first. With any luck you won't have to fight!" The older man next to him suddenly said, making Grant look up at his closest friend and mentor, none other than Son Goku.
Rather than being reassured though, Grant's uneasiness only grew as, if this fight went the way it did in the original series, then Goku would be killed by Cell. Normally that in itself wouldn't be that bad, as they were able to easily revive people with the Dragon Balls, seven magic wish granting orbs, but Grant also knew that Goku would refuse being revived due to him believing he was the cause for the Earth being in danger so much.
If Grant allowed things continued in their original pattern, then he wouldn't be able to see his best friend again for seven years!
Thankfully however he was granted a little more time to think about how to save Goku's life when a sudden fanfare caught everyone's attention. Directing their attention towards the source, everyone saw a fleet of helicopters and small airships headed towards them.
"CELL! TODAY, YOU MEET YOUR MAKER!" A loud voice declared from the lead vehicle, a helicopter with the word SATAN emblazoned on the side, as it began to set down next to the ring Cell had created.
Releasing a small sigh Cell looked up at them and said,
"I guess we'll have to postpone our match Goku, after all, I need to save the best opponent for last." Though many of the fighters who had gathered gritted their teeth at Cell's words, they didn't move to save the newcomers as, except for perhaps Goku, they were all too weak to stop Cell if he truly decided to kill all of them. Plus they already planned to being everyone Cell killed back with the Dragon Balls after he was defeated.
As the entire fleet of vehicles set down behind the first, the man who had been piloting it stepped out so that everyone could see him.
The man was fairly tall with a muscular figure, had black hair that was in a curly Afro, notable sideburns, and a mustache that framed his mouth. His clothes were comprised of a brown and white gi that left his chest open, with a layer of hair covering most of his exposed skin and a large white cape. (A.N. For those who don't know what he looks like, just imagine a guy who looks like he belongs to an 80s porno)
As he stepped forward dozens of people who had been in the other vehicles appeared as they held up numerous signs and posters they had made, while from another helicopter appeared a news crew who immediately began broadcasting the scene live.
"This just in at the site of the infamous Cell Games, the champion of the World Martial Arts Tournament, Mr. Hercules Satan, is about to challenge the devious Cell for the safety of the world!" As he tried to report the situation to the entire world, the numerous fans around them began screaming their excitement as the man himself walked up to the stage.
"MR. SATAN, WE LOVE YOU!"
"SAVE US MR. SATAN!"
"YOU'RE MY HERO MR. SATAN!"
"Heh." Mr. Satan chuckled to himself, reveling in adoration of his fans even as he faced down the man who threatened the safety of the entire world.
As he walked up onto the same exact style of tournament ring he'd won so many championships on, Mr. Satan's image was broadcasted all over the world for every single one of his fans to see, as well as some who weren't his fans.
"HEY! It's on!" Someone called out in a large mansion with the words 'Capsule Corp' on the side, located in the middle of the metropolis West City.
Immediately several figures swarmed into the room to watch the broadcast, only for the oldest person present, an elderly man with a bald head, full beard, and mug of beer in his hand, to ask,
"Who the heck is that?" In response to the old man, who they all knew as Master Roshi, a notably younger man with short-cut spiked hair, Yamcha, answered,
"I saw him on tv the other day, the guy's name is Hercule Satan. Apparently he's won the last several World Martial Arts Tournaments while everyone was dead, on Namek, or busy preparing for the androids." His response made everyone give the television pointed looks as Master Roshi muttered,
"That guy won a tournament?" Though he didn't look bad compared to 'normal' people, this apparent 'champion' obviously had no idea about 'real' martial arts, otherwise he'd already know how powerful his opponent actually was.
When the camera panned across the area though, they all suddenly caught sight of the people they were actually hoping to see. But before anyone else could say anything, a certain woman with large and puffy blond hair shouted while brandishing a mini-machine gun,
"IF YOU LOT LET ANYTHING HAPPEN TO MY TIEN, I'LL PUMP ALL YA'S GUTS FULL OF LEAD!"
"Yeah!" Shouted a blond little girl who looked no older than ten, who had a third eye in the center of her forehead, as she too brandished a pair of authentic looking revolvers that matched her brown leather cowgirl outfit.
"If anything happens to daddy or Gohan then we'll pump ya's guts full of lead!" Rather than worry about such a young girl brandishing a dangerous weapon, another woman in the room with light blue hair, who was cradling an infant baby in her arms, asked teasingly,
"Oh? Why'd you mention Gohan there Brunch?" The girl, Brunch, glared at the older woman, Bulma, and snarled thug-like,
"Ya I mentioned Gohan, what's it to ya?" Bulma's brow twitched at the girl's response, before she muttered under her breath,
"If I have a daughter one day I hope she's a lot cuter than you." Brunch however didn't hear her as she stared pointedly at the screen, which most of those present were also doing. One of which was Goku's wife as well as Gohan's mother, Chichi; Yamcha's oldest friend, a blue furred cat that was capable of changing form at will, Puar; a small pig with similar, but weaker, powers of transformation, Oolong; the previous blond haired woman, Launch; and finally a short statured person with pure white skin and bright red cheeks, named Chiaotzu.
They all of course gathered to watch the Cell Games that was being broadcasted all over the world, which would also allow them to keep tabs on their friends and loved ones at the same time. And if something happened to the broadcast, Master Roshi had his sister, Fortune Teller Baba, on standby to help them stay in the loop.
Back at the games the crowd of fans were growing louder and louder as they cheered for their champion.
In response to the growing crowd of cheering fans, Mr. Satan threw his arms up in the air with his hands balled into fists, making them scream even louder. Though he didn't consider Mr. Satan or his entourage worth even acknowledging, Cell still contemplated killing all of them just to shut them up.
Ultimately he decided against it though since this WAS a tournament, and tournaments usually had spectators...even if they were obnoxiously annoying.
With the cameras rolling and his fans hyped, Mr. Satan turned his attention to Cell and declared in a threatening voice,
"Alright Cell! It's time for ME to put YOU in the ground for all your crimes!" In the face of Mr. Satan's bravado though, Cell just sighed before saying,
"Very well, I did say I'll take on all challengers. Round start." Then, despite the match being started, Cell simply decided to cross his arms and look down as if he was bored or just waiting.
"I'LL SHOW YOU TO NOT TAKE A CHAMP SERIOUSLY!" Mr. Satan roared as he immediately lunged at Cell, before leaping up and dropping his foot down directly on top of Cell's head.
"HAAA!" Mr. Satan shouted with his attack, before recovering himself as he landed back on the ground. Then he delivered a series of his strongest punches and kicks at Cell's head and upper body.
"Wow!"
"Look at those moves!"
"He's moving so fast!"
Throughout the crowds the fans were exclaiming their awe at Mr. Satan's martial arts, while the newscaster even announced,
"Amazing! As you can see folks, Mr. Satan is simply pummeling the terrifying Cell! Under the powerful and rapid onslaught, the vicious fiend is helpless and unable to even counter attack!"
"How pathetic...." Master Roshi said in response to the newscaster, before following up with,
"People at least used to be able to recognize REAL martial arts back in the day, what happened that THIS can pass for it?" Though he typically never berated another martial artist, Master Roshi couldn't help himself when he saw the pitiful display of power Mr. Satan was showing, which the man himself readily claimed was the peak of what humans were capable of.
The point of practicing martial arts wasn't simply to gain fame or fortune, but to master ones body and to constantly test the limits of what one was capable of. For as long as they were capable, a true martial artist never stopped working to improve both their body and skills.
"Maybe we should make a point to enter the next tournament...." Yamcha muttered as he too watched the pitiful display that was Mr. Satan.
"You'd only look good if none of the others entered." Bulma immediate shot at him, making Yamcha flinch since he couldn't really deny her remark, which was truly why he was there instead of at the Cell Games with the others.
Meanwhile, back at the actual fight, the pinecone looking man, Vegeta, snorted from Mr. Satan's display as he sneered,
"Is this really what passes for a 'champion' on this miserable little planet?" Both Krillin and Tien looked away pointedly at Vegeta's venomous question, while Goku chuckled awkwardly without saying anything.
Before anyone COULD say anything though, Cell apparently had enough of Mr. Satan's pitiful attempts to defeat him, and swatted him across the face like one would a bug. There was dead silence across the world as the people watched what they believed to be their only hope be sent flying into a nearby mountain.
"Tch." Vegeta clicked his tongue when the dust on the mountain settled, and they could still sense the so-called champions life energy.
"I must be losing my touch..." Cell muttered to himself, almost in awe that the pathetic little insect he swatted was still alive.
Disregarding the group of people that flocked to Mr. Satan's side with a stretcher, Cell then looked up at Goku and asked in a voice loud enough to carry,
"Anyone else, or shall we get to the main event Son Goku?" Though the name meant nothing to the gathered fans of Mr. Satan, as it was heard all around the world various people began to react.
"Did he say Goku?" Asked a large person with scars all over his face, who was sitting next to red-haired woman and her family as they too watched the broadcast. They were Eighter and Suno, two of the many people Goku had helped throughout his journey as a child.
And just like them, everyone who heard his name being mentioned immediately perked up as they recalled him saving them before, all the way to the ruler of the entire planet, King Furry.
"Goku?" King Furry said as he perked up slightly, before going on to say,
"Maybe hope isn't lost for the world after all." As he said that King Furry, an anthropomorphic dog-man with vibrant blue fur and a bushy white mustache, recalled the time that Goku, as a little kid, saved the entire world from the evil King Piccolo.
Though they learned the name of their savior at the time, no one knew who Goku truly was or where he went until he reappeared and won the World Martial Arts tournament four years later, only to disappear once again. However King furry couldn't help but to be somewhat confused when he saw who Cell was talking to, as the Goku he recalled had messy black hair, not golden hair that stood straight up on end.
Taking a close look though, he could see the same eyes that Goku had that day so long ago, and for the first time since Cell announced his Cell Games ten days before, he felt hope.
Back at the Games though, Goku smiled wryly as he replied,
"I'm not the main event, but sure." Goku then began to lift off of the ground to fly down to the ring, but before he could Grant grabbed his arm and anxiously asked,
"A-are you sure Goku? Maybe someone else should go down there first or something?" Though he was terrified of facing Cell himself, Grant considered doing so if his friend could live in the end.
On top of being a step away from the powerful SSJ2, Grant also possessed one of the powerful soul weapons from the world of Bleach, a Zanpakutō, as well as the still uneaten Gomu Gomu no Mi. The reason Grant hadn't eaten the Devil Fruit, which would turn his body into rubber, was because he didn't want to give up his ability to swim just yet, and was saving it for a day when he'd truly need to use it. (A.N. I started rereading Bleach last night to brush up on the specifics involving a Zanpakutō, and now I'm already on chapter 121...)
With Goku's impending death though, Grant now strongly considered eating the fruit so he could gain every advantage possible against Cell.
Not knowing this though, Goku flashed Grant a fearless smile as he replied,
"Don't worry, even if I lose we still have our 'secret weapon'." Grant then briefly glanced at Goku's only son, the eleven year old Gohan that was closer to obtaining SSJ2 than any of them.
"Wait Goku! It's not that, but....." As he tried to warn Goku of his concerns though, Grant trailed off since he wasn't even sure of what he'd say.
As his friend looked at him curiously though, and Cell began to tap his foot impatiently, something happened that Grant never even thought to expect.
"WAHOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!" A voice suddenly cried out from the heavens, as a single figure plummeted down through the clouds directly into the middle of the Cells Games stage.
When they crashed down the entire area shook violently, kicking up a large cloud of dust and making all of the spectators have to brace themselves while Mr. Satan was also shaken awake. While everyone present was shocked at the sudden development, the most shocking part was when the dust cleared to reveal a young woman with light blue hair, a pair of fluffy rabbit ears, and big breasts. The most noticeable thing about her though was the bunny suit she was wearing that revealed the entire length of her legs, and emphasized her already large breasts.
"Helloooooo everybody~! Now presenting the adorable Shia-chan!" *Pyon Pyon* The rabbit girl greeted them all while bouncing on the balls of her feet excitedly, as if she was completely unaware of the presence of Cell himself right next to her. To be fair though, a lot of those watching also momentarily forgot about Cell as they watched her breasts bounce with her.
"OHOHOHOHOHO! LOOK AT THOSE TITTIES!" Master Roshi shouted excitedly as he forced himself directly in front of the tv, with his entire head bouncing in time with the mysterious girl's boobs.
"How disgusting..."Bulma muttered, even as Oolong and Yamcha appeared at Master Roshi's side to ogle her.
The one who appeared the most gobsmacked at her appearance though was Cell himself, who immediately swipe his hand to produce a wave of powerful energy to kill her once he got over his shock.
Instead of her being instantly killed though, Shia-chan's foot suddenly slipped as she toppled over just in time to avoid the attack.
"That was scarrrrrrrrrry!!!" Shia-chan shuddered at the attack, leaving Cell even more gobsmacked that she escaped unscathed.
"I really must be losing my touch..." He muttered after TWO weaklings so somehow managed to avoid being killed by his attacks, however back in Capsule Corp Master Roshi was now looking at Shia more intensely.
"That girl....."
"Yeah yeah yeah, she's got giant tits. CAN'T YOU EVER FOCUS ON ANYTHING ELSE YOU PERVERTED GEEZER!?" Bulma shouted at him angrily while also delivering a hit to the top of his head, however Master Roshi seemed to barely even register the hit as he said,
"Yes she's got giant titties, but I was talking about how her movements are those of master fighter." That comment immediately got everyone's attention as they focused on her once again, before Launch asked with an annoyed voice,
"Isn't she just some lucky bimbo?" Master Roshi quickly shook his head before saying,
"No way. She's acting like one, but I guarantee that girl is a martial artist!" With the world authority on martial arts saying so, who had studying and practicing martial arts for over three hundred years after consuming a substance called the Paradise Herb, everyone else began taking the suddenly appearing rabbit girl more seriously. Though it was admittedly harder to do so as she trembled in fear of Cell's attack.
"How scarrrrrrry!" She said once again, before suddenly bouncing back up onto the balls of her feet once more. *Pyon Pyon*
"You shouldn't bully Shia-chan!" She suddenly said to Cell as if she were scolding him, making him snort before asking,
"Oh? And why shouldn't I?" However the words were barely out of Cell's mouth when he suddenly felt a chill run down his spine.
'W-what was that?' Cell asked himself as his entire body tensed.
If he had to describe it, Cell would say it felt like he had been caught in the eyes of a supreme predator eyeing its latest snack. This was impossible though, as he had been designed from a genetic level to he 'perfect'.
Taking the girl in front of him more seriously, Cell was dumbfounded when Shia-chan continued acting the same as she had before, and stated,
"Because Shia-chan has a big and scary husband~!" As she said that the girl put her hands to her cheeks and shouted with a "kyaaaaa" as if she were embarrassed, making the muscles in Cell's face twitch irritably as he considered attacking her again.
Before he could though, another new voice suddenly shouted,
"Hey! Sorry I'm a bit late!" Every person present turned to see a man slowly walking towards the stage.
He had messy wild black hair, curiously good looks that drew the eye of every girl watching the fight, a notable layer of muscle covering his body, and most noticeable of all were the swirling tattoos that covered his entire exposed upper body. He wielded no weapons, and the only clothes he wore was a pair of shorts with a brown furry belt, leaving his entire upper body exposed and his feet bare.
As the man hopped up onto the stage, he then began to slowly approach the duo of Cell and Shia-chan, even as his eyes scanned those around them. His gaze then traveled to where Goku and and the others were, going over and analyzing each and everyone one of them before his eyes met with Goku's for a brief second.
The second their gazes connected Goku's heart began pounding in excitement as his hands involuntarily clenched into fists, and his mouth curled into a smile without him noticing.
His reaction was nothing compared to Grant's though, as when the newcomer looked at him Grant immediately paled due to knowing who he must've been, and wondering what he wanted. As his 'Angel' was unable to share information about the other competitors though, Grant had no way of knowing if the was friend or foe until they actually talked to one another.
"Hmph, another weakling who thinks they're worth something." Vegeta sneered as he scrutinized the newcomer, who walked in a manner that left him completely full of openings and had no power whatsoever that he could sense.
Gohan however noticed his dad's hands trembling as they were clenched, making him asked questioningly,
"Dad?" His voice drew the other attention, as Vegeta, Piccolo, Grant, Tien, Krillin, and Vegeta's son from the future, Trunks, all looked at Goku curiously. Goku however surprised them all by saying,
"That guy...... He's really strong!" Goku's observation caused a stir amongst the other fighters, as they all had similar opinions as Vegeta as they watched the newcomer approach Cell. But all of them, even Vegeta grudgingly, had to acknowledge Goku's skills.
So they all looked at him once again with different eyes as he walked right up to Cell, with Shia-chan bouncing right up to his side and snuggling up to him lovingly. The man wrapped an arm around her shoulders as he gave her a kiss on the top of her head, before giving her butt a light smack to shoo her off of the fighting ring now that he was there.
The man then looked up at Cell, who was a fair bit taller than him, and said,
"You must be Cell. Nice to finally meet ya." Though his instincts weren't as refined as Goku's, Cell could still tell that the man before him wasn't simple as he replied,
"Indeed, but I'm afraid you have me at a bit of a disadvantage." The man's smile widened as his energy suddenly exploded outward with enough force and intensity that even the normal people that were watching right next to them felt it, while Goku and the others almost like they had been slammed into a brick wall as they all felt his energy skyrocket even further.
The man then opened his mouth and calmly introduced himself,
"I am Alexander Morningstar, otherwise known as the Dragon Emperor."

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - 444: 'Perfection'
chapters.content:
As Alex's energy began to skyrocket every single person on the planet who was able to sense energy simultaneously turned to face the same direction, regardless of whether or not they knew of the battle going on.
"Holy crap!" Master Roshi exclaimed as he, Yamcha, Chiaotzu, and even Chichi all felt sudden spike of energy, which rivaled even the current Goku and Cell's.
"Who the heck is this guy?!" Master Roshi demanded as he focused intensely on Alex's image on the tv, until Yamcha seemed to notice something as a horrifying suspicion occurred to him.
"C-Chiaotzu, that thing around his waist. Is that what I think it is?" As Chiaotzu also scrutinized Alex's waist like Yamcha, he also saw what it was he referring to and gasped dramatically, before saying,
"I-I think so Yamcha..."
Meanwhile, back at the Games, Goku's group had to braces themselves as waves of Alex's energy impacted them directly, while tens of Mr. Satan's fans ended up falling backwards as it lifted them off of their feet.
"What the hell is this!?!" Vegeta demanded as his entire body shook from the fury and indignation he was currently feeling. The Super Saiyan transformation was supposed to be the pinnacle of power in the entire universe, yet ever since he himself acquired the transformation they've been encountering one person after another that made them look like chumps.
And though he wasn't expecting an answer, Piccolo still replied,
"I don't know, but it's best we stay on our guards. Even if he's going to fight Cell none of us knows who he is or what he wants, so he could easily turn on us at any given moment." Several grunts of acknowledgment answered Piccolo's warning, as everyone steadied themselves and renewed their focused states.
Acting as though neither of them could hear the others though, Alex and Cell continued staring at one another until the latter finally responded to the formers self introduction,
"'Dragon Emperor' huh? And what exactly are you 'emperor' of?" Though he was acting casually, those who were skilled enough noticed Cell tensing his muscles in the face of the overwhelming levels of energy Alex was emitting.
Cell of course was still faring far better than the majority of the 'normal' people who had come to watch the Games, as many of them collapsed and had been unable to get back up under the pressure. This lasted only until a certain silver haired woman dressed in a maid outfit and placed a barrier between the spectators and the ring.
As she and others made their separate preparations, Alex answered Cell while he began to perform a few stretches,
"Well it's kinda a long story and I don't feel like getting into it, so why don't we just get ready to fight?" Cell's smile widened at Alex's suggestion, but before he could say or do anything, Alex pointed his middle and pointer finger at Cell, before bending them upwards.
The next thing everyone knew the ground beneath the ring, Goku's group, and all of the spectators began to rumble before they all started to rise up towards the skies. Up, up, and further up still, they all rose until they were within the clouds themselves, and were completely unable to see anything around them except for the ring. Despite this though the camera crew was still able to broadcast the fight to their station, and the rest of the world.
"Now I can fight without worrying as much of destroying the entire planet." Alex said to Cell as if what he had just done was simple, though Goku and several of the people in his group were filled with gratitude for Alex's consideration.
"If that's all, then shall we begin?" Cell asked as he took a fighting stance, prompting Alex to do the same opposite of him. For a moment nothing happened as a few drops began to fall onto them from above.
The duo then both raised their respective energies to such a point that, had Grayfia not erected the barrier between them, the spectators would have actually been blown off of their own viewing platform to their deaths. Lightning formed between them as their raw energies collided and clashed, each trying to subdue the other before they themselves even moved.
*BOOM!*
*BOOM!*
*BOOM!*
Faster than anyone except for a select few could follow, Alex and Cell moved and clashed repeatedly in the center of the ring. With the rain picking up speed around them, their energies clashed to create the lightning, and the impacts of their fists were like the thunder to their own terrible storm.
In the center of this growing storm though, both Alex and Cell had massive grins on their faces even as the latter swung his fist, and Alex ducked under it before planting his own into Cell's face. Alex then followed up with another fist that sank directly into Cell's side, right where a normal person's kidneys would be, before swaying backwards to dodge another one Cell's punches.
Cell then tried to land a hit on Alex's chin with an uppercut, only for Alex to weave to the side around the attack before punching the crook of Cell's elbow to earn himself a satisfying crunch.
This was just one of the many injuries that Alex had inflicted onto Cell as, with his Observation Haki coupled with the instincts honed through his regular sparring with Elaine, Cell had yet to land a single hit on Alex. Every single one of the impacts so far had been either one of Alex's attacks landing on Cell, or him blocking one of Cell's attacks.
Despite this though the actual damage Cell had accumulated was very little, as even his now broken arm quickly resettled itself within seconds.
This was due to Cell possessing genes harvested from the Saiyans Goku and Vegeta, the Namekian Piccolo, and the Frost Demons Lord Frieza and King Cold. This meant that, along with the incredible vitality of the Frost Demons that allowed them to live even if they were chopped into pieces, he also possessed the regenerative properties of the Namekians, which would allow Cell to rapidly regenerate from any wounds he receive, including instantly regrowing entire limbs.
These abilities, combined with Saiyan potential and ability to grow stronger after recovering from injuries, meant that Cell was slowly and steadily growing stronger the longer he fought Alex. Naturally Cell himself didn't miss this, but neither did those who were watching and able to sense their respective energies.
"Cell's getting even stronger..." Krillin muttered anxiously as he watched the battle below, though he could only really see a couple of blurs. Though there were several nods in agreement, the only one who seemed unconcerned was Goku as he excitedly said,
"If I'm right about this Alex guy, then there's nothing to worry about." His comment of course earned him several looks from his comrades, while Krillin sighed as he recognized Goku's look as he watched Alex fight. Then again, amongst them Goku, Gohan, and Grant were the only ones able to actually see what was going on down there for the moment.
Meanwhile the newscaster was getting increasingly heated up as he exclaimed,
"Amazing! Both this Dragon Emperor and Cell are moving so fast, that we can't even see what is happening! How is this possible!?" Though it was a rhetorical question, a certain 'champion' jumped right in front of the camera, blocking the shot of Cell and Alex, and exclaimed,
"It's not! People can't move like that! Or make the ground float! Or any of these other crazy things!" Though he was annoyed that Mr. Satan was blocking their shot, the newscaster maintained his professionalism as he instead asked the champ,
"Then how would you explain all of these amazing phenomenon Mr. Satan?" When asked that Mr. Satan's expression fell as he then tried to come up with an answer.
"Um...well......you see....... It's all a trick...?" Providing absolutely no grounds to support his claims, the newscaster and even several of Mr. Satan's own fans looked at him with a deadpan. But before he could continue the newscaster noticed something, and asked another question.
"Mr. Satan, what happened to all your wounds?"
Though he hadn't sustained any serious injuries after receiving Cell's attack, Mr. Satan had still been covered in numerous minor wounds from when he impacted a mountain, wounds that were all now gone as if they had been washed away in the rain.
Realizing this himself, Mr. Satan was more than a little shocked, but immediately tried to claim that his own body was just that amazing that he was able to recover from such little wounds in mere minutes. Hearing this, Shia looked back away from the fight, a scowl on her face as she muttered irritably,
"Maybe I should teach this blowhard a lesson." As she seriously considered doing something to make Mr. Satan regret making his baseless claims and bragging, a certain duo approached Shia on either side as Moka muttered,
"That trash needs to learn his place, but that'll be later. We got more important things to focus on." Shia, and Lala on the other side of her, both nodded in agreement as they all turned their attention back to Alex's fight with Cell.
Alex had warned them that Cell was likely to try attacking the bystanders if the fight started to truly go south for him, so the three of them were there, along with Grayfia and her barriers, to ensure such a thing didn't happen. As for why they didn't just use magic to send the spectators away, and why Alex had gone through the trouble of bringing them along as well, with someone like Mr. Satan around that would try to steal all the credit he can while discrediting their abilities, they needed numerous witnesses who could testify otherwise.
It was also for that same reason that Lala had a backup camera for the news crew in case the one they were using broke, or was otherwise damaged.
Back at the fight though, even the three of them were amazed at how strong Alex currently was in his base form. Despite Cell becoming increasingly stronger with each injury Alex inflicted on him and he recovered from, he wasn't losing any ground whatsoever and was inflicting a steady stream of damage to Cell's body.
Then again, with how long he'd been in his SSJ4 form, none of them had any idea just how strong Alex's base form had become despite the fact that he'd stopped training almost altogether in recent months. The only training any of them had seen him do was his usual sparring against Elaine, and when he sparred against one of them to help them train.
Despite that though Alex seemed stronger than ever as he remained untouched by Cell even after all this time, while even his attacks started to become heavier as they dealt even more damage.
What Alex started doing next earned him numerous gasps and exclamations from the spectators as his actions became increasingly violent and ruthless, such as when he planted his foot against Cell's knee, and broke it. Then he punched Cell with enough force, that he actually blew a hole through Cell's body that was nearly a foot in diameter, before his fist began to glow as Alex detonated a powerful blast of energy that shredded Cell's body even further.
Despite all of this though, Cell regenerated in seconds to become even stronger than before, before the process repeated itself over and over again.
"Something wrong..." Piccolo grumbled as he watched the fight, to which Trunks replied,
"You're right, its not going to end if this keeps up." Though Trunks was right, Piccolo shook his head as he explained,
"That's not it. Cell's regeneration ability comes from my Namekian genes, but he's regenerating at a much faster rate than I do. It's almost too fast..." As he trailed off Piccolo groaned as he tried to figure out why Cell's regenerative powers were so strong, even as Krillin offered,
"Maybe Doctor Gero enhanced his regeneration to make him more 'perfect', you know what I mean?" Though it was a reasonable theory, Piccolo's gut told him that wasn't it as he continued watching the fight below, which was getting harder and harder as Alex and Cell moved faster and faster. Until, Cell suddenly stopped fighting altogether.
"Why don't we call this here?" Cell asked Alex with a smirk on his face. "You can't kill me, and I've only been getting stronger and stronger as we fought. So why don't we just skip to the inevitable outcome?" In the face of Cell's taunting though, Alex sighed and surprised them by saying,
"Yeah, you're getting stronger, but not strong enough yet..." Not just Cell, but everyone else outside of Alex's own entourage was shocked at his comment as Piccolo roared,
"WAIT! ARE YOU SAYING THAT YOU'VE BEEN TRYING TO MAKE CELL STRONGER THIS WHOLE TIME!?" Alex looked up at him and said as if it were obvious,
"Well yeah, why else would I drag the fight out like this and combine Phoenix Tears with this rain?" As he said that Alex held his hand out to catch several drops of rain, all of which contained a fraction of the restorative power of Phoenix Tears that had been diluted to the extreme.
"Phoenix....Tears...?" Piccolo asked, unfamiliar with the term since they've only ever used Senzu Beans as a remedy in battle. Alex however nodded and explained,
"Phoenix Tears are one of the most powerful medicines that could ever exist. They're capable of healing any injury, restoring stamina, reattaching recently lost limbs, and even bringing back those who had just died. Though, I doubt the last two would be possible right now with how diluted they are."
Naturally such a miracle medicine sounded too good to be true, but if it was then Piccolo along with the rest of the fighters couldn't help but to wish they'd had such a miraculous medicine during most of their previous battles. But of course, the thing at the forefront of everyone's minds was outrage at how Alex had been trying to make Cell, an already seemingly unbeatable monster, even stronger than he already was.
But then again, the one who was the most outraged was Cell himself.
"Are you trying to say, that my 'perfect' self isn't enough!?" Cell demanded angrily, furious at the implication. Alex then looked at Cell as if he were stupid, before simply holding out his hand with his palm pointed upwards. Everyone was then blinded as he shot up a massive and powerful pillar of energy that punched a hole through the clouds as it was sent up into space.
Then, so that he didn't accidentally destroy any planets, Alex detonated the attack to that there was a massive explosion of energy above them that created shockwaves powerful enough to buffet anyone on that side of the planet. As they all gaped at the attack though, Alex gained their attention once again as he said,
"I came here for a good fight, and damn it I'm going to get a fight one way or the other. But since my previous method was taking too long, it looks like I'll have to go with plan B." While everyone was trying to figure out what Alex meant, he suddenly flashed forward and sank his fist into Cell's stomach.
Unlike his previous attack though a hole wasn't blown through Cell's body, instead something was forced out of the syringe-like stinger on Cell's back. Despite the fluids covering it though Alex carefully caught the item in his left arm, which was a beautiful woman with sharp features and blonde hair that was cut at her chin.
As the girl was ejected from his body, Cell himself also began to undergo a series of changes right before everyone's eyes as his form became distinctly less humanoid, and more insect-like.
"Wh-WHAT HAPPENED!?" Cell cried out in alarm from his current predicament, but, instead of getting an answer, Alex moved faster than Cell was now capable of perceiving, his strength having plummeted after the last attack, and sank his fist into his stomach a second time. Just like the first time the stinger on Cell's back spit out a person, except Alex didn't catch them this time as they fell to the ground in a heap.
This one however was a man with long straight black hair, and similar facial features to the girl in Alex's arms. The duo were siblings that had been turned into androids(cyborgs) by the same man who had created Cell. However, unknown even to them, they were designed simply as parts needed for Cell to completely mature into his 'perfect' form.
As Alex forcibly ejected them from Cell's body though, he was forced to revert to his weaker and 'imperfect' forms that even someone like Vegeta or Trunks could defeat.
"Nooooooo!!!" Cell wailed as he realized he was no longer in his perfect form, even as Alex ignored him and sent the two androids, named 17 and 18, to Asora. Then, as if it was the simplest thing, Alex blasted Cell from point blank with a ki attack that rivaled the one he used for a demonstration earlier, obliterating Cell's entire body.
"What just happened...?" Krillin parroted Cell, as he and everyone else struggled to keep up with the rapid sequence of events until the broadcaster announced,
"E-everyone, it appears as if....CELL HAS BEEN DESTROYED!" The spectators and all of the people watching around the world then began to cheer as the monster they had been fearing for the past ten days was destroyed, until a calm voice cut through their's.
"No he hasn't." Alex regained everyone's attention as the broadcaster asked,
"Eh? Cell hasn't been defeated?" Alex however shook his head without ever taking his eyes off of the spot where Cell previously was, and explained,
"He was designed to be genetically 'perfect', so long as there is a single cell left of Cell's body, he'll regenerate and return." Dead silence answered Alex's claims, allowing everyone to witness for themselves the moment Cell's body began to form once again from singular speck that Alex hadn't destroyed.
"HahahaHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!" With an insane laughter permeating the air before his arrival, Cell popped back into existence right in front of everyone, once again in his 'perfect' form.
"HOW AMAZING!" Cell exclaimed excitedly as he examined his newly constructed body.
"Even if my entire body is destroyed, so long as a single cell of me remains, I'll return! And not only that, but my body seems to recall my 'perfect' form, AND I know I'm even stronger than I was before due to my Saiyan genes!" With his body having gained the greatest boost in strength yet, even Alex nodded in agreement as he remarked,
