"Yeah, I'd say you're finally at the point where I'd need to transform myself to deal with you...but it's not enough yet." Alex then snapped his fingers to produce a glowing magic circle that spread out under Cell's feet for several feet in either direction.
"What is this!?" Cell demanded as he tried to escape the magic circle, only to slam into a barrier that entrapped him.
"It's a magic circle that will allow me to force your body into the next stage of its evolution, which will also make you significantly more powerful than you already are."
"Wait, he's forcing Cell into an even stronger form!?" Krillin exclaimed, shocked that such a thing was possible, and that someone was insane enough to do it.....someone aside from Vegeta that was.
"HOW DARE YOU!?!" Cell roared in anger as his fists slammed against the barrier, enraged that Alex dared to suggest that the current him wasn't 'perfect'. But before he could say anything else, Cell's entire body was enveloped in the light of the magic circle to hide him from view, before an ear splitting scream could be heard as Cell experienced more pain than he'd ever felt before.
Truthfully Alex had developed his ability to evolve others so that it was faster and significantly less painful than the day he first evolved Rias, but he didn't see the point of doing away with the pain in Cell's case.
For several minutes all anyone heard was Cell's bloodcurdling screams from within the pillar of light, until the screams began to slowly die down. Then, with no warning, the most powerful and evil energy that any of them had ever felt radiated from within the magic circle, shattering Alex's barrier while almost throwing Goku and his friends through the air.
As the light died down though, and Cell's aura began to settle, Alex's mouth curled upwards into a wide smile.
Cell's body had grown by nearly a foot in height while the previously green and purple exoskeleton had been replaced thick plates of black and red, while his arms and legs were covered in serrated blades that ran down their length, and a large Y shaped horn was growing up and out from between his brows.
After taking a moment to admire his new form, Cell looked up at Alex and said,
"I must thank you, for showing me what TRUE 'perfection' is." Alex just smirked at Cell's remark, as he was still truly far from perfection, even as Cell continued,
"A being that transcends perfection itself is nothing short of a god, and as such I shall refer to myself as 'Divine Cell'!"
"Pft!" Alex snorted when he heard that, before descending into flat out laughter that drew Cell's attention as he asked,
"And what pray tell is so funny?" Alex however just shook his head as he tried to compose himself, before explaining,
"B-because, there are so many beings out there that are far more powerful than you, that I can name ten right off the top of my head, starting with myself!" Cell's eyes narrowed dangerously at Alex's remark, while many other people stirred as Krillin asked his friends,
"Did you hear that?" Goku nodded slowly with a serious expression on his face before answering,
"Yeah I did..." Then Goku's face morphed into an expression of excitement as he exclaimed,
"There's a ton of people even stronger than Cell out there to fight!" Krillin immediately face palmed at Goku's remark as Piccolo groaned, but next to him Grant felt a cold sweat run down his back, knowing EXACTLY who Alex was referring to.
Cell however sneered at Alex's remark as he said,
"You? Stronger than the 'divine' me? HA, don't make me laugh!" Alex however, finally composing himself, said,
"But it's true, don't you recall what I said earlier?"
"Hm?" Cell momentarily humored Alex's claims, not believing them for even a second until Alex said,
"I'd said that hadn't even needed to transform myself yet." That simple comment shocked everyone present, but that was still nothing compared to when Alex's tail was unwrapped from his waist, and his body began to emit a bright golden aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - 445: Going Even Further
chapters.content:
"That can't be!"
"Are you kidding me?!"
"So we were right?!?!"
Back at the Capsule Corp headquarters, the people there were voicing their disbelief at what they were seeing on the tv, which also confirmed Yamcha and Chiaotzu's earlier suspicions when they saw the brown monkey-like tail wrapped around Alex's waist.
But their surprise was minuscule compared to a certain Saiyan Prince, who roared once he saw the all too familiar golden glow,
"THERES ANOTHER SUPER SAIYAN!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!" Despite him screaming in their ears no one in their group could blame the shock Vegeta was feeling as they too wondered what was happening.
Shortly after Goku had been born the planet of the Saiyans, planet Vegeta, had been destroyed by the same tyrant they served at the time, Lord Frieza. From that moment on there only existed four Saiyans in the entire universe, the prince Vegeta, a former general of their people, Nappa, Goku's older brother who was the one that discovered he was still alive, Raditz, and then finally Goku himself.
As he tried to get Goku to join the three of them though, Raditz was killed due to him threatening Goku's half-Saiyan son, Gohan, as well as the Earth. Then Nappa had been killed by Vegeta after losing to Goku a year later, leaving them the only two remaining full blooded Saiyans in the entire universe...or they were supposed to be.
Unknown to Vegeta, when he and Nappa arrived on Earth to confront Goku there had been a second pure blooded Saiyan waiting for them, one that was too young to have been born when planet Vegeta was destroyed, Grant. Unfortunately though, Grant was never able to explain his existence to Vegeta, who was the only one that truly cared, other than saying that he'd been raised on Earth similarly to Goku.
Now however, there before them was ANOTHER Saiyan that shouldn't even exist, who was ALSO able to go Super Saiyan just like them. Then, as if that wasn't bad enough, he was apparently far stronger than Vegeta and even Goku despite the former being descended from the former king of all Saiyans.(A.N. I went over it before when Alex decided to start training his kids, but as the son of the king it means Vegeta has far more potential than a normal Saiyan like Goku, since the Saiyans followed only the strongest members of their race)
"I knew he was a lot stronger than he was letting on!" Goku exclaimed, his excitement reaching an all time high at the thought of another Saiyan out there aside from himself and Vegeta.
And a second later they got a taste of just how strong Alex truly was as his own golden energy exploded outwards to vastly dwarf his previous energy levels to the extreme, while the swirling tattoos on his upper body began to glow with a dim orange light. They may be using the same exact transformations, but it was immediately apparent to Goku that they were on completely different levels, a prospect that made all him all the more eager to challenge Alex himself to see how he measured up.
Cell on the other hand snorted when he saw Alex's transformation, as he said,
"ANOTHER Super Saiyan? I've been dealing with so many Saiyans that I'm starting to get bored of them." Of course, his reaction wasn't entirely unexpected since the current Cell was still significantly stronger than Alex in his SSJ1, but then again if he weren't then there'd be nothing for Alex to look forward to.
"Who said this is my only transformation?" Alex asked with a smirk, alarming everyone who heard him as they focused on his now golden tail.
"Wait, he's not going to...!" Piccolo gave voice to the other's concern as Krillin and Tien already began looking to see if the full moon was out. Cell however found the idea humorous as he asked,
"Are you talking about that giant ape thing? The good doctor already programmed all of the data he had collected on that form into my mind when he created me, so I know that I just have to cut off your tail." Alex however shook his head as he explained,
"Nope that's not it." Then, glancing up at the other five Saiyans gathered nearby, Alex continued,
"This transformation is the most basic of the Super Saiyan forms, and shouldn't even be something to proud when compared to the later levels." Though his comment obviously agitated the already pissed Saiyan Prince, Cell smirked as he said,
"Let me guess, you're going to use the same form that Trunks tried? That one is completely useless!" Again Alex shook his head as he continued,
"Nope, I'm going to transform into the SSJ2." Silence met Alex's claims as he began raising his energy levels even further.
A barrage of lightning flashed to bath the area in brilliant golden light, which then reflected off of the still falling rain. Meanwhile Alex's golden hair elongated noticeably as a single strand fell forward in front of his face, while his muscles became even more pronounced, and the light orange glow on his tattoos became even brighter.
"I knew it!" Goku exclaimed excitedly as Alex's power spike even higher than it already was, as his suspicions that there was SOMETHING beyond a regular Super Saiyan was confirmed. And if Goku's hunch was correct, then Gohan was a single step away from the same transformation and simply needed the right trigger to achieve it.
"This-" Alex began once he finished the transformation, "-is the Super Saiyan 2. The power of this form is double that of the normal fully powered Super Saiyan, though it also has the unfortunate side effect of increasing ones aggression and making them more sadistic."
As Alex explained the specifics of his new transformation, the people around him paid close attention to every single thing coming out of his mouth. For the normal people watching the broadcast, this was the first time any of them had even heard of a Saiyan, let alone the Super Saiyan. For Goku and the others though, they were learning from Alex the heights they were still able to achieve and that they still had a long ways to go.
Cell on the other hand, after looking Alex's new form over and studying his new energy levels, shook his head and replied,
"Impressive, but still not enough for the divine me." Contrary to his expectations though, Alex simply said,
"Oh? Then perhaps I should take this further?" That got Cell's attention, along with everyone else's as Vegeta uttered dumbfoundedly,
"H-he can go even farther!?!" Alex's smirk widened as he then casually asked,
"Should I show you all their Super Saiyan 3?"
"THERES A SUPER SAIYAN THREE!?!?" Master Roshi exclaimed in shock, giving voice to the thoughts of everyone else watching the fight as, once again, Alex's energy levels began to soar.
This transformation however took noticeably more time for Alex to prepare, as his energy levels climbed higher and higher. He wasn't concerned with Cell trying anything while he was transforming though, as he WAS part Saiyan, and would readily welcome a challenge to further prove his strength and superiority.
This time however the effects of Alex's transformation were several times more dramatic, as his increase in energy began to impact the entire planet itself. Massive waves and storm systems began to form and expand outwards from their current position, while the planet itself seemed to begin to tremble as if it too was in awe of the energy Alex was giving off. Then there were the people themselves, as everyone on the planet, regardless of whether they could sense energy or not, could feel Alex's power and see the golden glow on the horizon.
As for Alex himself, his golden hair began to grow several times longer as it extended down his back, his muscles became significantly more pronounced as they became saturated with energy, and even his facial features began to change as his eye brows extended outwards. The most curious change though was the tattoos covering Alex's torso that began to turn white as his levels of energy spiked even higher, until, one of them cracked.
As the tattoo somehow cracked, Alex's energy shot up even more to staggering levels that could be felt all over the universe, while traces of green began to appear in his golden aura and hair.
...
Meanwhile, on a lush and green planet far, far from Earth, two figures were relaxing peacefully as one served the other tea. One was fairly short, had purple skin, and white hair that had been shaved into a Mohawk. The other person was significantly taller than the first, had pink skin, and long white hair that was combed back.
The former was the Supreme Kai and ruling God of the entire universe, Shin, while the latter was his faithful attendant, Kibito.
As they were relaxing though, something suddenly caught both of their attention.
"Did you feel that!?!" Kibito asked Shin with shock on his face as he looked in the direction the powerful aura was coming from.
Immediately Shin leapt to his feet with a worried look and declared,
"Come on, we're going to Earth! Hopefully 'that' hasn't been released..." With Kibito nodding in affirmation, the duo then quickly departed as they went to investigate the source of the powerful aura.
...
Meanwhile, in a completely different part of the universe, another figure that was tall and thin, with light blue skin and long white hair combed to stick straight up looked up suddenly.
"Oh?" The man said as he held up a scepter he was holding that had a sphere on the end.
In it he conjured up the image of the source of power he'd suddenly detected, and was surprised by what he saw within it.
"That tail..... Is that a Saiyan?" Though the Saiyans were all wiped out over two decades prior, the man knew that a small number of them survived on another planet called Earth. However, Saiyans had black hair, not blond.
Something about the Saiyan with blond hair seemed familiar though, so the man looked back at the defeat of Frieza a few years prior, and saw that it was a different Saiyan with similarly blond hair that defeated him. The strength of the two was completely different though, while the being was also sure he could detect traces of divine power within the current Saiyan's body.
"Oh what to do?" The man mused to himself as he contemplated his next course of action.
"Lord Beerus would want to learn about such a being, but he isn't scheduled to wake up for nearly ten more years... What to do, what to do?"
...
Just as Alex's power skyrocketed to the point where even Cell began to look fearful of the difference, he suddenly reverted to his base form before scratching his head and laughing awkwardly,
"Haha, sorry about that." Alex then ran a finger along the tattoo that cracked to repair it, before saying,
"Anywho, that was the SSJ3. It's a form that draws out every single drop of the Saiyan's power and potential, completely saturating their body in ki to multiply their power to four times that of their SSJ2. Though, unfortunately it has the drawback of rapidly consuming the users energy, making it like a double edge sword."
Even as Alex casually explained the SSJ3 and laughed awkwardly, almost all of those around him were looking at him with expressions of pure shock, horror, and awe. The only exceptions of course were Goku, who's whole body began to shake with excitement at the power Alex possessed, and the girls that were a part of Alex's peerage.
"Did you see that?" Moka asked Shia, to which the rabbit-girl nodded slowly and said,
"Now I think I get why Alex stopped training..." Though her voice was calm, even Shia's hands were shaking slightly at the power Alex just displayed.
Cell though was trying to regain his earlier bravado, as he said,
"Well, if you want to have a hope of defeating the 'divine' me, then you should probably go back that last form, unless for some reason you can't?" Digging on Alex's earlier admission regarding the energy drain of the SSJ3, Cell was surprised when Alex said,
"Nope, I'll be using a different form to fight you. The Super Saiyan 4." Ignoring just how shocked people were to hear that there was yet ANOTHER form for Alex to transform into, they were surprised when this transformation didn't go anything like the previous three.
Instead Alex's figure began to grow slightly as bright red fur sprouted over his upper body, covering his tattoos everywhere but on the chest, and his muscles were again much more pronounced. Meanwhile his hair began to grow long while seemingly becoming even darker in color, draping down over his shoulders, and a red ring formed under both of Alex's eyes.
Unlike his previous transformation though, Alex's energy didn't explode outwards at such levels that it even caused changes in their surroundings, instead it grew while remaining calm within his body.
Opening his eyes, Alex focused on Cell once again as he said,
"This, in my opinion, is the 'perfected' Super Saiyan transformation." Cell's eyes narrowed dangerously at Alex's use of the word 'perfected', while Goku and the others paid close attention as they tried to figure out what made this form so special.
"Firstly this form makes use of the same energy levels as the SSJ3, except instead of saturating the users body with ki for a quick but massive burst of strength, it also makes use of the strength of our Oozaru forms to provide balance to our bodies."
When he heard that Vegeta's fist clenched in anger, even as Goku exclaimed,
"I can't wait to get back to my training!" That comment sent Vegeta over the edge as he shouted back,
"Didn't you hear him Kakarot(Goku's Saiyan name)?!? To obtain this form we need our tails, which have been cut off!"
"Wait, what!?!" Goku exclaimed in shock, as realization dawned on him that they would be unable to obtain the power the SSJ4 if they couldn't master their Oozaru forms. Meanwhile someone else was reacting as he watched Alex's rapid sequence of transformations, falling to his knees as he muttered,
"He did it.... He actually got to the SSJ4..." Grant didn't realize he'd said this out loud, until Trunks demanded,
"Wait! You're saying you knew about these transformations this whole time!?!" Trunks outburst caught everyone else's attention, making them all direct their focus on Grant who was now panicking inwardly.
"W-well.....I mean..." Grant then struggled to find an excuse for not telling his friends such crucial information, something that was made significantly more difficult under Vegeta's murderous glare, before Alex suddenly called up,
"Hey, don't be too hard on him just yet, there might've been a good reason for that guy not to tell you all about these forms. I shouldn't take much longer here, and then we can all get together back at Capsule Corp to talk." Though they were still mad that Grant kept something so important from them, the group agreed that taking care of Cell was more important as they redirected their attention back to the fight.
Cell however, even in the face of Alex's SSJ4, appeared calm as he remarked,
"Pretty cocky, aren't you?" Alex however didn't respond as he again started stretching, trying to get used to his new form after spending the last week in his base form. Cell then continued,
"If you ask me that previous form of yours was more powerful than this one. I mean, can you even keep up with all that mass?" As Alex's muscles were notably larger than before, Cell wondered if he'd even be able to keep up due to them interfering with his speed. Alex however shook his head as he relied,
"There shouldn't be a problem." Then, the next thing Cell knew Alex was right behind him as he resumed their earlier slugfest.
Off to the side, behind the defensive line made by Shia, Moka, and Lala, the newscaster was hanging onto everything occurring in the stage as he then said into the camera,
"This is it folks! I believe we are finally in the final stages of the fight between Cell and this mysterious Dragon Emperor! They've both been elevated to their strongest forms! It's all or nothing!" As the spectators and all the people of the world watching the broadcast began to get hyped up once more, a certain 80s pornstar-lookalike jumped in front of the camera and declared,
"WAIT! You're not telling me you actually believe this 'transformation' stuff are you!?" The broadcaster, who had practically forgotten that Mr. Satan was there, narrowed his eyes as he said,
"Well we have all seen it happen right before us, and that is hardly the most surprising thing to happen so far today." As he said that the broadcaster pointed towards the edge of the area they were all floating on, proving his point as Mr. Satan groaned in frustration from losing his dedicated audience.
"I-it's gotta be a trick or something! I mean, people flying, shooting lasers, glowing, transforming, and all that other stuff! It's impossible for ANYONE to do that stuff!" Growing increasingly annoyed at Mr. Satan for disrupting their filming of the final fight, the broadcaster then asked,
"Ok then, if it is a trick then how are they doing it?"
"Huh?" Mr. Satan asked with confusion, before quickly trying to recover as he said,
"O-oh, right! Well.....I mean there's all that special effect stuff being used for tv and computers nowadays, isn't there? So maybe their just using holograms or viral effects or something?"
"You mean VIRTUAL effects?" The broadcaster asked, to which Mr. Satan quickly and eagerly nodded to try and convince them, though his heart sank when the broadcaster asked,
"Is there any proof to your theory Mr. Satan?" That one question made Mr. Satan's expression fall as he uttered in a very small voice,
"P-proof...?" With the broadcaster nodding in affirmation, Mr. Satan glanced at the ongoing battle with an incredibly pale complexion.
Meanwhile, Alex and Cell were both focusing so intently on each other that neither one noticed anything else.
'W-what is this!?' Cell mentally exclaimed as he tried to get some distance from Alex, the battle not all going his way as he experience firsthand that this truly was Alex's strongest form.
Unlike before, when Alex had made each of his moves methodically and calculated, Cell now truly felt as if each second that ticked by was bringing him closer and closer to death. Despite all the growth Alex had forced him to undergo, and the evolution into 'Divine Cell', Alex's SSJ4 made him too powerful to deal with.
Every time Cell attacked Alex's wouldn't dodge or even react in any way, instead just tanking every single hit without so much as flinching or becoming damaged in any visible way. Cell on the other had only taken a few hits, but that was just because Alex was practically toying with him instead of trying to seriously end it. Not to mention that, with the rain having stopped falling, Cell was no longer receiving the restorative effects of the diluted Phoenix Tears, and was steadily running out of steam.
This meant that not only was his expended stamina not being replenished, but his healing was nowhere near as extreme as it had been previously. As Alex delivered a punch into his face, Cell could feel his hardened exoskeleton shattering as black and red fragments went flying.
Again Cell tried to get some distance between himself and Alex before gathering energy into his hands.
"EAT THIS!" He roared before firing a massive blast of ki energy at Alex, only for Alex to stand there as he simply swatted Cell's attack upwards into space. He then flashed forward and sank his finest into Cell's gut once again, except this time it hurt even more than all of the previous times, including when Alex blasted a hole through him.
"Wow...he's just toying with Cell now..." Krillin uttered in awe as he watched the fight taking place, before Goku added,
"That SSJ4 looks REALLY strong!" Tien then piped up while glancing sideways at Vegeta,
"Too bad you won't be able to achieve it yourself."
"SHUT IT TRICLOPS!" Vegeta shouted in retaliation, making Tien snicker while even Piccolo cracked a bit of a smile.
By this point it appeared as if Alex was wrapping things up as Cell was barely able to stay on his feet, after having received the worst beating he'd ever received.
"What do you say we make this the last of it?" Alex asked as he got into position in front of Cell with his hands together at his side.
Recognizing the form, Cell mimicked Alex as he struggled to stay on his feet. For a moment neither moved as they stared each other down, before they both began gathering energy at the same time.
""KA......ME....""
A bluish sphere of light formed in both Alex and Cell's hand as their respective energies began to take form.
""HA.....ME....""
Their respective spheres of ki grew larger as they poured as much energy as they could into them, but unknown to Cell, Alex also combined his attack with his 'Soul Break' skill to completely destroy Cell's soul when it connected, preventing him from ever being revived or recovering.
""HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!!!!!""
The two of them then released their respective attacks at one another at the exact same time, but when their attention was completely on one another as well as everyone else, something completely stupid happened that Alex never saw coming.
"SEE! IT'S A TRIIIIIIII-"
Mr. Satan leapt out in between Alex and Cell's attacks, trying to prove that he was correct in that people were unable to perform such feats, only to be caught right in the middle as the attacks collided.
"MR. SATAN!" One of his fans cried out as the world champ disappeared in a flash of light, while Alex also momentarily lost his concentration from the sudden development, which allowed Cell's attack to push back his own.
Before it could reach him though Alex put the matter regarding Mr. Satan out of his mind as he channeled more energy into his attack, forcing it back towards Cell.
"HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!" Cell shouted as he tried to stop the attack from hitting him by channeling every drop of energy he possessed into it, but it was only enough to slightly slow down Alex's own Kamehameha.
"HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!!!!!!!!" Alex shouted as he poured as much energy into his attack as he dared, overwhelming Cell's before completely obliterating every single atom of Cell's body.
As the light from Alex's final attack died down, and he managed to collect his thoughts, he mentally asked Lauren and Ddraig,
'Did I really just kill Mr. Satan?!'

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - 446: An Unexpected Reunion
chapters.content:
'Did I really just kill Mr. Satan?' Alex asked both Lauren and Ddraig mentally, not sure if he'd been seeing things or if his mind had been playing tricks on him.
'Yep, he looks pretty dead partner.' Ddraig said bluntly, obviously not caring about the life of one weak human. Lauren however said,
'I wouldn't worry about it too much since it saves you the trouble of having to deal with him and his influence later.' Though Alex knew Lauren was right in that this development would make some things easier for him, he still felt sorry for actually destroying Mr. Satan's soul and effectively erasing his entire existence.
"I-is that it then? Is Cell truly dead?" Looking over to the spectators, who didn't want to jump the gun with their celebrations a second time, Alex nodded and said,
"Yeah, that's it. Both Cell and Mr. Satan are dead." Though there were a few exclamations of relief, no one celebrated like they had before as the reporter said to the camera,
"Folks, today is both a joyous one and a tragic one, as the terror who threatened the population of the entire world is finally destroyed, but at the cost of the life of our world champion." As he said that Alex heard a few people sniffling within the spectators, while he even noticed a few others glaring at him for his role in Mr. Satan's death. However, the silence of mourning was then broken as someone stated out loud,
"Don't worry, I'm sure Mr. Satan will be revived when we bring back everyone else Cell killed!" Alex then directed a glare at the speaker, Krillin, as he and the rest of their group touched down on the stage.
Normally they would never interact with the media or otherwise risk their identities being known, but due to Alex's presence they decided to take that risk since they felt they needed to figure exactly who he was, and what he wanted. But as the people became happy at the news that Mr. Satan could be revived, Alex instead frowned and furrowed his brows as he remarked,
"You just HAD to open your mouth, didn't you Krillin?" Taking a step back under Alex's glare, Krillin quickly asked,
"W-what did I do?! I was just trying to say you don't need to worry about his death because we can bring him back!" With the spectators, reporter, and cameraman all paying attention to their every word, Alex massaged the bridge of his nose as he admitted,
"But the Dragon Balls CAN'T bring Mr. Satan back!" Alex's admission was met with a stunned silence, to which he sighed before explaining,
"When I killed Cell with that Kamehameha, I combined it with another ability I possess that allows me to completely destroy souls, so that there was no chance of Cell ever reviving as well. That was the kind of attack that Mr. Satan got caught up in."
As Alex explained the details of the current predicament involving Mr. Satan, Piccolo groaned as he asked with a slight growled to his voice,
"So you're saying there's no way to bring him back?" Alex shook his head as he replied,
"Not that I can think of off the top of my head. So far as I can tell, Mr. Satan isn't just dead, his entire existence was destroyed." Though, as he said that, Alex still had an idea of a way that Mr. Satan could be brought back, the Super Dragon Balls.
Though they looked just like normal Dragon Balls, the Super Dragon Balls were literally the size of entire planets and were infinitely more powerful. However Alex had absolutely no intention of going through the trouble of gathering them, just to bring back the one person he'd argue would benefit them more with his death than life.
So he held his tongue regarding the Super Dragon Balls, even as he detected some people calling him a murderer under their breaths. That was fine by him as Alex had no intention of denying his part in Mr. Satan's death, though rather than murder he compared the situation akin to suicide via a person jumping out in front of a speeding car.
Their discussions and musings though were interrupted as the reporter asked,
"Um, so am I right in hearing that you have a way to bring those killed by Cell back?" With microphone in hand and camera on them, Alex took the lead as he said,
"That is correct, however the method we plan to use is not absolute. If you wish to hear the details though, then I will discuss them all in an exclusive interview later at Capsule Corp." Alex's comment earned him several pointed looks from the others as, until then, no one knew any of them were affiliated with Capsule Corp, which was the wealthiest organization in the world that was owned by Bulma and her family.
Now however there was a good chance people would try to get ahold of them through Capsule Corp, which was bound to ruin their peaceful lives and drive Bulma up the walls.
Without caring though, Alex then began moving the floating platforms they were all standing on down, causing quite a commotion amongst the spectators when the ground beneath them started moving again.
As they drifted downwards though, Piccolo was apparently eager to gain more information as he asked Alex in a low voice,
"So what ARE you here for? I doubt you showed up just to fight Cell" Alex was silent for a moment, as if he was contemplating his answer, before finally saying in an equally low voice,
"I want to fight strong opponents to challenge myself, and make some new friends. As far as I'm aware, this is the universe to do so." Alex then smirked at the shock Piccolo showed behind his back, as the hint that Alex wasn't even from their universe sunk in.
By that point they finally reached the ground, where the chunks of earth that Alex had levitated sat seamlessly back into their original positions. Then, with a snap of his fingers, Alex rewound all the damage that had been done to the surrounding landscape as a result of the military's attack on Cell.
"I think we need to learn that one..." Krillin voiced out loud, earning him a few nods of agreement from the others as they too recalled the amount of damage their battles usually had on their surroundings. Of course the most dramatic example was when the battle between Goku and Frieza resulted in the complete destruction of an entire planet.
Once the complete restoration of their surroundings was finished, the people then began to notice several figures that appeared as if out of thin air around them, all of which were beautiful women. Looking at Grayfia, Rias, Yue, Shia, Lala, Moka, Shizuku, Erza, Sun, Yami, Lucy, Mirajane and Yuna, Alex said,
"Alright, everyone's here so let's go." Before anyone of Goku's group could ask who exactly the numerous women that surrounded them were, Alex snapped his fingers a second time and they all suddenly found themselves outside the main dome-like building of Capsule Corporation.
"Was that Instant Transmission!?" Goku asked excitedly, as to perform the same thing he'd need to have contact with everyone he was transporting, and need to lock onto someone's energy.
"It's kind of similar, but there are several key differences." Alex said simply as everyone inside the building noticed their appearance, and rushed out to meet them with a certain elderly pervert at their lead.
"OH SUCH AMAZING BOOBIES! ONE PUFF-PUFF IS ALL THIS OLD MAN NEEDS TO DIE HAPPY!" Master Roshi cried out as he happily tried to dive directly into Rias' bust, only for lightning to appeared out of nowhere and strike him in mid air.
".....those fatty udders....belong to Alex....." Yue stated firmly, as she and Rias shared a brief look of understanding. The two may squabble constantly, but they both had a firm understanding that Alex was the only man who could lay hands on either of them.
"Woah, Master Roshi!" Krillin cried out in alarm as several of them checked on the pervy Master to see if he was ok. Bulma meanwhile immediately gave Yue a thumbs up and said,
"Anyone who shows that pervert a thing or two is ok in my book!" As the rest of the girls gave Bulma a look of approval, and Master Roshi began to regain consciousness, Alex then stated so everyone present was aware,
"I'll let it go with that, but know that I don't tolerate any harassment or disrespect to ANY of my wives." As he said that, Alex was then surrounded by the thirteen girls present as they all tried to find a piece of him to snuggle affectionately, though the more stubborn girls like Yami and Grayfia tried to act otherwise.
"W-w-wives!?!" Yamcha stuttered in shock to finding out all the girls around Alex were 'his', to which Alex simply nodded before adding,
"There's two missing, but these are my 'main' wives, while there's still a few hundred more waiting for me at home."
"A-a-a-A FEW HUNDRED!?!" Krillin stammered this time, before he then tired to imagine the staggering amount of work it must be to manage so many women at once. Alex however interrupted his wayward thoughts as he said,
"As amusing as your reactions to every little thing is, we do have some business to discuss." Though several of them still wanted to discuss Alex's home situation, everyone adopted serious expressions as Goku led by asking,
"So, why are you here?" Alex then glanced at Piccolo before saying,
"As I said to Piccolo earlier, I mainly came to further myself in finding strong opponents to fight seriously, as well as hopefully to make some friends. There's a few other smaller things, but nothing that you lot necessarily need to worry about for the moment." Bulma however appeared agitated at that and remarked while pointing in the sky,
"I'd say I need to worry about THAT!" In the direction she was pointing was several incoming helicopters and other air transport vehicles, while several other vehicles gathered in front of the Capsule Corp entrance. Alex however just shrugged as he said,
"Well there is that, but it'll just be something all of you will need to get used to." At this point Goku's wife, Chichi, stepped forward and snarled at him,
"Who do you think you are mister?! You can't just waltz in here and decide how we're all going to live our lives from now on! I mean how is my poor little Gohan going to be able to study if people are constantly bugging us!?!" As her anger turned into distress for her son's future, Chichi then knelt down and pulled her son into a tight embrace as if to show how much she cared for him.
Alex however rolled his eyes art the display before saying,
"A bit of fame isn't going to hurt Gohan's future, and I'm thinking of helping this planet and the people on it in the years to come, unlike all of you." Alex then directed his attention to the rest of those around him, and asked, "Do any of you have the slightest clue what your continued anonymity will do?"
With several of them shaking their heads as Krillin even asked, "it wouldn't have that big an pact, would it?" Alex groaned before explaining,
"Well firstly your refusal to publicly acknowledge your deeds just means that idiots like Mr. Satan will step up and claim them as their own for fame! Then those idiots would be free to continue degrading the abilities of the people on this planet, until they won't be able to defend themselves from even the simplest threats. Or do you all intend to fight for this planet's peace yourselves until the end of time?"
Silence met Alex's argument until Master Roshi said,
"That's blowing things a little out of proportion, isn't it?" Alex shook his head though and replied,
"No it's not. I'm aware to an extent of future events on this world, and had I not stepped in Gohan would've obtained SSJ2 and killed Cell after both Android 16 and Goku were killed by him, only for Mr. Satan to steal the credit after everyone leaves. He'd then spend the next several years basking in his fame and glory while degrading the skills of the planets fighters even further with everyone thinking someone as weak as him was unbeatable."
As could be expected, everyone appeared skeptical of Alex's claims, except for Goku of course as he said,
"I would've died against Cell? Well I'm glad you stepped in then! Hahahahaha!" Seemingly not at all worried about how close he was death, Goku then began laughing until Piccolo said,
"I don't think that would've happened Goku, I'd say a lot of what this guy says is questionable at best." With everyone else nodding in agreement, someone else then spoke up as Grant said,
"It's true..." Everyone's attention turned towards him as Vegeta, who had been silent until that point, growled,
"That's right! You knew about those Super Saiyan forms and didn't tell us! So you knew about this as well!" Grant nodded slowly as he shrank under Vegeta's piercing glare, until he finally said,
"I didn't want to change things, and risk making everything worse..... But if I'd left things as they were then Goku would've died, and we wouldn't have been able to see him again for several years!" As Grant explained that he hadn't wanted to lose his friend, Bulma looked thoughtful for a moment before asking,
"Was that also why you insisted on Android 16 staying here as well?" As Bulma said, instead of accompanying the group to the final battle the large and gentle android had stayed behind at Grant's insistence, and even now was within the atrium where Bulma's father kept numerous small animals as pets.
Nodding once again, Grant explained,
"It would've been Android 16's death that triggered Gohan's ascent to the SSJ2, but Goku's death would've come after when Cell would try to destroy the entire planet with a self destruct...." As he detailed some of the other things that would've happen had Alex not interfered, the man himself was scrutinizing Grant since this was the first time he'd gotten a chance to do so.
For the week they'd been in this universe, Alex and his wives had been keeping a low profile as they tried to ascertain how the reincarnator here was compared to the ones they'd run into in the past. Alex had been quite surprised to find that next to nothing had changed though, making him almost wonder if something else had interfered with them ending up in a different time than he was aiming for.
Seeing the man right in front of him though, Alex was quite surprised at how Grant was due to the overwhelming amount of 'bad' reincarnators he'd ran into. Until now the only 'good' ones had been Anne and Beth, the latter one having only met Alex due to another reincarnator taking her as a captive as he transferred world's.
Alex was then stirred from his thoughts as Vegeta demanded,
"Hey! Do we really need our tails to be able to use that SSJ4?" With his question putting everyone's attention back onto Alex, he nodded slowly before saying,
"I won't explain the full details, but yeah you need both the SSJ3 and the tail to obtain the SSJ4."
"DAMMIT!" Vegeta swore at Alex's answer, before turning to look at Bulma and demanding,
"Woman! Bring out the Dragon Balls so I can wish my tail back!" Before Bulma could tell Vegeta exactly what he could do with the Dragon Balls, which wouldn't have been at all a child-friendly offer, Alex said,
"No need to waste a wish, I planned to restore your tails to begin with." Then, with another snap of his fingers, Goku, Gohan, Vegeta, and both future and present baby Trunks all had brand new tails sprouting from their behinds.
"How'd you do that!?!" Krillin asked in amazement, to which Alex shrugged nonchalantly before saying,
"It's just a bit of time manipulation magic. I can rewind time on almost anything to restore it to a previous state, though it takes more magic power the further back it goes." Then, to give them another demonstration, Alex used Regeneration magic on Master Roshi until he was a young man once again with a full head of hair and no wrinkles.
"HOLY CRAP!" Master Roshi exclaimed, before leaping into the air and clicking his heels together in excitement. Alex however said,
"Don't think that's permanent Roshi, I can reverse it just as easily if you so much as look at any of my wives with impure intentions ever again. Though if you ever actually go as far as to genuinely molest or overly harass any women, you'll get a lot worst than that." With some of Alex's intent leaking out of his body while he said that, Master Roshi stood straight up as he said,
"O-of course!" Though he was already planning to go pick up girls with newfound youth, Master Roshi also mentally noted not to do anything that might upset Alex so he wouldn't get turned back into an old geezer. What he didn't know was that Alex wouldn't do that to him, but his punishment would be much, much, worse.
Giving Roshi one last pointed look, Alex then passed several cases to each of the Saiyans and said,
"These all have several pairs of sunglasses that are designed to filter moonlight, put them on during a full moon to avoid accidentally turning into an Oozaru." Though Goku, Gohan, future Trunks, and Bulma(on behalf of baby Trunks) all gratefully accepted the cases, Vegeta snorted before stating,
"I don't need those pointless things." Alex however immediately countered with,
"It's either accept the glasses or lose the tail all over again, your choice." Though he looked as if he was going to argue, Vegeta caught himself as Alex coated his hand in energy to form a sharp blade to show how serious he was being.
Despite grumbling about it, Vegeta still accepted the case with several pairs of sunglasses from him, which Alex incidentally enchanted to prevent Vegeta from 'accidentally' losing or breaking any of the glasses within. After giving them a moment to admire their new glasses, and giving Bulma a sample of the moonlight filtering material to adapt to their own Windows, Alex said,
"While I'm giving you guys stuff, there's something else I wanted to give you two as well Goku and Vegeta." The words were barely out of Alex's mouth when Vegeta snarled angrily,
"We don't need any more of your charity! I've got work to do!" Vegeta then turned around as he seemingly tried to go into the Capsule Corp building, possibly to use the gravity room to train, when Alex suddenly brought his hand down on the top of Vegeta's head.
Normally such a thing wouldn't even be enough to so much as faze someone as powerful as Vegeta, but since Alex was still in his SSJ4 form and didn't bother holding back, Vegeta was instantly sent into the ground as a sizable lump formed on the top of his head.
"How brutal..." Chiaotzu muttered while also cowering from the thought of receiving a SSJ4 chop, as Master Roshi then asked,
"Is there any particular reason you're still in that form?" Ignoring Vegeta as he tried to get up, Alex said,
"I've actually been using the SSJ4 form as my base form almost ever since I acquired it, but reverted to my base form before we arrived so we can go undetected until figuring what the situation on this world was. With how easy it is to maintain, I can pretty much remain in this form indefinitely. Plus, my wives like to use the fur as a handle at night."
The last comment made everyone look at the gathered wives in shock, to which several responded with their own suggestive looks that basically confirmed Alex's claims, while some looked away pointedly with red cheeks.
After helping Vegeta out of the hole, and dusting him off, Alex continued from what he had been saying earlier.
"Anyways, even if you aren't interested in receiving 'charity', I'm sure you'll like this Vegeta." Ignoring the Saiyan Prince's protests once again, Alex conjured a wall of mist before everyone, through which a face familiar to most of them appeared.
"RADITZ!" Goku shouted as he and the others immediately got into position to fight, as the last time they saw Raditz he'd kidnapped Gohan and threatened to destroy the Earth just to get Goku to join him. The encounter ended with both Goku and Raditz dying from one of Piccolo's attacks, with the former holding the latter in place to keep him from dodging.
"Long time no see, brother." Raditz sneered when he saw them.
Raditz was a Saiyan that stood a fair bit taller than Goku, had long and wild black hair that went all the way down to his knees, and shared numerous facial features with Goku that identified them as brothers. Unlike Goku though, who almost always had a happy smile on his face, Raditz's face seemed to be permanently stuck in a perpetual evil sneer.
As everyone remained tense in his presence, despite Raditz not doing anything for the moment, two more figures emerged from the wall of mist behind him, who immediately locked eyes with Goku as one of them uttered,
"Son?" Never dropping his guard against the newcomers, Goku responded with,
"Yeah I'm Son, Son Goku!" Even as Goku remained alert though, everyone else's jaws practically hit the ground as they got a good look at the newcomer for the first time, who looked almost identical to Goku except for a few small differences, like the X shaped scar on their left cheek.
Despite Goku not dropping his guard though, the newcomer readily approached him while stating,
"No you idiot, I mean 'son' as in you're MY son!" As he said so, the newcomer took advantage of Goku's stunned state from the news to clap his hand on his son's shoulders, giving it a brief squeeze due to him not knowing what else to do in that moment. But, before Goku could process exactly what the man said, another voice spoke up as a shorter woman with a slender body, and shaggy black hair reminiscent of Raditz's that went down to her shoulders, approached him.
"Kakarot...it's really you!" Then, with tears in her eyes, the mystery woman quickly wrapped her arms around Goku's body, stunning him even further as he tried to process what was happening.
Seeing this, Raditz's sneer widened as he said,
"Since you appear to be at a loss for words brother, allow me to introduce our mother and father, Gine and Bardock."
"EHHHHHHHHH!?! MOTHER!?! FATHER!?!" Goku exclaimed in shock, as the idea of having parents had never even occurred to him, even after meeting Raditz several years previously.
As Goku tried to wrap his head around the idea of meeting his parents, Vegeta almost appeared frozen as his gaze focused on the final person to emerge from the wall of mist behind Gine and Bardock. The person was stern looking older man with his brown hair sticking straight up, and a mustache that grew down to connect with his goatee.
"F-f-f-father!?!"
***
"Why?"
Vegeta asked Alex once the shock had worn off and everyone calmed down, to which the latter simply said with a shrug,
"I figured having more Saiyans would be helpful in the future, and who better than your own family?" Though Alex's comment made more than few people anxious, especially considering Raditz's track record, Vegeta then asked another question.
"How? Did you use the Dragon Balls?" Before Alex could answer Bulma piped up,
"He couldn't have, we still have them inside and the usual phenomenon when Shenron is summon hasn't occurred." As she said, when the dragon that appeared to grant the summoner a wish was called, the skies of the majority, if not the entire, world would turn black as if a mighty storm was forming, while a golden glow could typically be seen on the horizon.
Krillin immediately countered though,
"But he could have just gone to Namek to use their Dragon Balls?" A a debate of how he did it began, Alex casually mentioned,
"Or, maybe you can let me answer." Immediately everyone quieted down, allowing Alex to begin,
"Well firstly, like I said earlier, I was actively working to keep my energy levels down until I knew what was going on in this world. Instead of remaining completely idle though, I decided to take a trip to Hell to find some people and used the same magic I showed off earlier to return them to a state of living. They all then spent the last several days catching up on everything that's happened since they've died, and preparing for this moment."
As Alex finished speaking and everyone absorbed what he said, there was suddenly a commotion as Raditz shot to his feet and declared,
"I still don't believe it! Do you honestly expect me to believe that Kakarot of all people managed to become a Super Saiyan and defeat Frieza?!?" Imagining only the weakling he'd fought before, Raditz was still having a hard time adjusting to how much had changed in the relatively short time since he died.
Contrary to his expectations though, Goku simply smirked as he effortlessly changed in his SSJ1 form, and said,
"How about it then 'bro'? Wanna have another go?" Eager to see just how much he'd grown since they both died, Goku was more than willing to have another match with Raditz then and there, until,
*SMACK!*
"KNOCK THAT OFF!" Chichi roared at Goku as she smacked him, surprising all four of the new Saiyans as she then seized his ear and went off,
"You just now get a family and the first thing you wanna do is fight them!?! Not on my watch buster!" As Chichi scolded Goku, everyone was then surprised as Gine stepped in as well as she added,
"That's right! This is the first time we've all been together in so long, so everyone should just get along!" Even as she tried to scold her son's though everyone couldn't help but to think about how unusual the scene was, as Gine was significantly smaller than both of them, and due to her being dead for so long they both also appeared really close to her in age.
Deciding to let everyone hash things out themselves, Alex stood and said,
"Well if that's all I'm gonna take off real quick, got some more things to take care of before having to deal with the reporters later." Before Alex could leave though, Vegeta's father, King of the Saiyans and also named Vegeta III, also stood and said,
"Indeed, it's time we were off as well son. Bardock, Raditz, you too!" With no one understanding what he was talking about, Vegeta demanded,
"Father, what are you doing?" King Vegeta then looked at his son and said as if it were obvious,
"Frieza is gone, along with all of his most powerful and faithful followers. The remnants of his army and empire are ripe for the taking! And with the power of the Super Saiyan transformations on our side, nothing in this universe will stop us from taking power!" King Vegeta then directed his attention to Alex and said,
"I appreciate you resurrecting us, but we part ways here. So long as I'm King, I will never bow to the whims of others again." Then, as if everything were decided, King Vegeta began walking away from them as his son, Bardock, and Raditz all appeared confused at the sudden development.
As he watched him walk away Alex just groaned from how troublesome the Saiyan King was acting, before he said,
"You do realize I'm not just going to let you become the new Frieza, right?" King Vegeta looked back when he heard that, before he said,
"Did you not hear me? I will never bow to someone else again as King!" As he said that, King Vegeta's energy levels suddenly spiked as if to show how serious he was in his refusal to serve under Alex.
Despite being King of all Saiyans, King Vegeta had to spend a good portion of his life being subservient towards Frieza and his father, as well as sucking up to the most powerful being in the entire universe, the God of Destruction, Beerus. Now however he intended to change all that.
Though he couldn't get revenge on Frieza and his father, King Vegeta was still able to show the entire universe the true might of the Saiyan race, and even planned to become powerful enough to force Beerus himself to submit.
Shaking his head at the Saiyan King's behavior, Alex immediately moved so he standing directly in front of King Vegeta, and asked,
"And if you WEREN'T King?" The moment he heard those words King Vegeta's expression hardened, before turning into a flat out glare as Alex declared,
"King Vegeta, I hereby challenge you for the right to rule the Saiyan race."

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - 447: Saiyan Emperor
chapters.content:
"King Vegeta, I hereby challenge you for the right to rule the Saiyan race." The moment those words left Alex's mouth a heavy and oppressive atmosphere descended upon everyone present, though wether it came from Alex or King Vegeta, no one knew.
Nodding slowly and solemnly, King Vegeta stated,
"Vegeta, Bardock, Raditz, and Kakarot, form the square!" Though Goku had no idea what King Vegeta was talking about, the other three quickly moved into position around the duo before Vegeta Jr. stated irritably,
"Kakarot! You're supposed to stand over across from your father and brother!" Goku quickly moved into the spot that Vegeta was pointing to, which formed a large square around both Alex and King Vegeta as the latter explained in a low voice,
"The rules are no flying and no energy attacks, if you leave the square it is considered automatic forfeiture of both the duel and your life. This match is to test your skills, strength and overall ability, any questions?" Alex however smirked as he said,
"We gonna keep chatting or get to the actual fighting?" Though his remark earned him a glower from King Vegeta, Alex was sure that he also noticed a hint of a smile at the edge of his lips. But then it was gone in an instant as both men prepared for combat, and Bardock announced,
"Fighters ready? BEGIN!" Even as the match started though Alex didn't so much as move a single muscle, a fact that seemed to irritate King Vegeta as he said,
"I know you're looking down on me, since you're a Super Saiyan and I'm not.....even I can't help but to admit how weak I must be in comparison. But-" As the Saiyan King cut himself off Alex felt the aura within him begin to surge in strength.
It had already been several days since he resurrected the four Saiyans, so Alex wasn't surprised that they had already started training and learned how to suppress their energy like Goku and the others did. What did somewhat surprise him though was when King Vegeta's aura began to flicker with a golden light, before his hair similarly began to transition to gold.
"HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!"
As King Vegeta's power surged even further Alex felt the ground tremble under them, until his aura and hair turned completely gold as his energy levels peaked at higher levels than they'd ever been in his entire life. With the Saiyan King having successfully achieved Super Saiyan, Alex couldn't help but to smile widely at the development even as King Vegeta continued his earlier statement,
"But, remember that if you grow complacent there will ALWAYS be someone trying to knock you off your pedestal!" In response to the Saiyan King's ascension, Alex simply held out his open hand before making a 'come on' gesture while saying,
"Come and try it then!" The words were barely put his mouth before King Vegeta disappeared and reappeared right next to him, where his fist then connected with Alex's face.
Despite the explosion of power and energy that was generated by the punch, Alex didn't even look fazed as he looked at the King and asked tauntingly,
"Is that all you're capable of?" Naturally King Vegeta became even more incised at this, and vanished once more before reappearing on Alex's other side, and delivering a powerful kick to the side of his head.
*KABOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!*
The impact created a powerful shockwave that even made Raditz, was who standing behind Alex to the right, have to brace himself for fear of being blown away.
*BOOM!*
*BOOM!*
*BOOM!*
*BOOM!*
In rapid succession a series of blasts rocked the backyard of Capsule Corp, as King Vegeta delivered punches and kicks one after another onto Alex's body, while he himself just stood there and took it all despite the former's growing irritation.
The problem wasn't that King Vegeta was 'weak' per say, but that Alex was too strong as he consistently tanked even the most ferocious attacks. And Alex himself was aware of this as, even though he knew they used the space-time orbs available for public use, obtaining the Super Saiyan transformation a mere few days after being brought back to life and learning about it spoke volumes about King Vegeta's potential and drive. Even his son, Vegeta IV, took several years to achieve it after witnessing Goku use the transformation for the first time.
Regardless of how talented or driven he was though, with each second that passed by the difference between Alex and King Vegeta was becoming increasingly clear. Alex was even sure that he heard something in King Vegeta's hands and feet snap when he punched or kicked him a few times.
"I must admit, I'm impressed by your drive and commitment." Alex said as he moved for the first time, making King Vegeta become alert while he struggled to catch his breath due to the drain in energy he was experiencing from using the transformation for the very first time.
"However-" Alex continued as he suddenly appeared behind the Saiyan King. "Sadly drive is not always enough." Alex then chopped down with enough force that the Saiyan King was sent crashing into the ground, and rendered instantly unconscious.
"This duel is over." Alex said simply as he turned to walk away, but before he could something grabbed onto his ankle. Looking down, Alex saw King Vegeta using what little strength he still had to hold him, even as his transformation faded, as he growled,
"Not...over...until...one.....is....dead....!"
Saiyans had always followed the strongest members of their race, this had been their ironclad rule for all time. And whenever a challenger to the throne appeared, the duel between them was not over so long as they both drew breath. If Alex stepped outside the ring right then while King Vegeta was still breathing, it was the same as him forfeiting the duel.
Kneeling down to look the former king in the eye, Alex said to him with all seriousness,
"This match IS over. I didn't bring you back just to kill you immediately after so I can take your place. Killing you now is jut an idiotic waste of potential and assets, and nothing else. Do you understand?" As he spoke Alex channeled a bit of Regeneration magic to help the former king recover just enough that he could talk normally, to which he replied,
"So long as I continue to draw breath, I will NEVER cease to continue working to surpass you, to reclaim my throne!" When he heard that Alex didn't appear the least concerned or anxious, instead a large smile formed on his face as he offered the former king a hand and said,
"I'm a Saiyan, I relish the competition!" Vegeta Sr. was momentarily stunned when he heard that, before he too show a wide smile as he accepted Alex's outstretched hand and replied,
"Then it would be my honor to serve you, your imperial majesty." No sooner than when he was on his feet again did the former king sink to his knees, as he knelt before his new emperor.
Immediately following him were Bardock, Raditz and Gine, while the rest of the gathered Saiyans appeared to be unsure of what they were supposed to do. Though they earned themselves a glance from Bardock and Vegeta Sr., since Alex didn't say anything about it they left the matter alone for the moment.
Instead, Alex's attention was on the new notification he'd received the moment the former King Vegeta knelt to him.
[NOTICE! The title 'Saiyan Emperor' has been obtained!]
Alex involuntarily cracked a smile when he saw that, since it would hopefully make dealing with any other Saiyans he'd encounter in the future easier. Turning his attention back to the four Saiyans already kneeling before him, Alex simply commanded,
"Rise." As one, all four rose until they were standing once again, which was when Alex said to the former King,
"You know, if you wanted to pass your crown on to me then you could've just said so instead of giving that bad performance." When he heard that Vegeta Sr coughed lightly before looking away pointedly, contrasting his usual self.
Though the former King had always given off an atmosphere that oozed arrogance, pride, and ruthlessness, Alex knew there was more to the former king than his rather 'extreme' exterior.
One example was how, instead of simply killing off or otherwise discriminating against the weaker Saiyan children that were born with low 'power levels', he would instead send them off to planets with weaker inhabitants. There they'd not only be safer, but could also grow stronger while gaining experience in combat that could help them become even greater warriors, a theory that was greatly supported by the fact that someone as 'weak' as Goku eventually went on to defeat Frieza.
Then there was the scenes Alex had seen the last several days, when the four newly revived Saiyans weren't training in a space-time orb, and Vegeta Sr would interact with his children.
As could be expected, once Vegeta Sr learned of an entire generation of Saiyan children in Asora sired by Alex, he became VERY eager to meet them. What he and the other three Saiyans never expected to see though, was a group of children with the oldest being around six(Edith), with several already capable of going Super Saiyan even as young as three.
Though he hadn't been too thrilled to how much the children were like their non-Saiyan mothers, Vegeta Sr couldn't say anything when he briefly sparred against, and barely managed to hold out against the really young Saiyan/Phoenix, Regal. Of course, the only reason Vegeta Sr managed to hold out against the young boy was due to his own incredibly high potential, and the decades of combat experience he had accumulated throughout his life.
On their side though, the children had been equally excited to meet the four newly revived Saiyans, as the only other Saiyan they knew was their father(though Edith briefly interacted with Alice back on Earthland). Their disappointment when they leaned that none of them could also go Super was quite devastating to Vegeta Sr and the others though.
As Vegeta Sr tried to regain his previous composure, Alex's expression turned serious as he stated,
"Firstly I want everyone to prioritize becoming stronger. We all know the secrets of the Super Saiyan now, so there's no reason that all of you can't at least obtain that form." Though Gine looked down at the news, none of the Saiyans protested Alex's decision since whatever they did from then on was up to him.
However Alex then surprised them by directing his attention to future Trunks, and continued,
"As for you Trunks, you need to make a decision on what you're going to do from now on." Trunks appeared confused at that as he asked,
"What do you mean? Now that Cell's been defeated I planned to return to the future soon." Though he glanced at Vegeta Sr for a second, who was also his grandfather, Trunks' firm gaze remained unwavering since his intention to return home remained unchanged.
He had originally traveled back in time to try and prepare Goku and the others to face Android 17 and 18, since they were both destroying the Earth and slaughtering its people unchecked in his time after killing Vegeta and the others. Then, because Piccolo and his counterpart Kami died, who created the Dragon Balls, the magical wish granting orbs were unusable.
His actions however had the unintended effect of creating a completely separate timeline from his own, one where the Androids were even stronger and Cell emerged. That meant that the duo were still rampaging in his original time unchecked, where his mother Bulma and close companion Mai were still.
Alex however surprised him by saying seriously,
"I know, but time travel is a serious offense to certain beings, and you could end up causing the destruction of yourself and any others involved in it if you continue." Trunks' expression changed into shock along with everyone else's as he asked,
"Then does that mean I can't go home!?!" Alex shook his head though and continued,
"I'm saying your choices are to either return home and completely destroy the time machine along with all the data related to it, or to stay here for the rest of your life."
For a moment Trunks didn't say anything as he seriously considered what Alex said, before he then asked,
"You said you knew of things from the future to an extent, right?" Alex nodded before elaborated,
"Yes but I'm not a time traveler myself, just a knower of certain things." Trunks nodded slowly as he contemplated what he was going to say next, before asking,
"Will there be any major threats after I defeat the Androids?" Alex was silent for a moment as he considered his answer, before finally saying,
"In the future a being will come possessing Goku's body, prompting you to come back here for help even as they kill your mother. However the threat is so great that not even this Goku and Vegeta together with significantly more powerful SSJ transformations can win."
Trunks nodded slowly as he digested this information, before finally saying,
"I'll return then, and possibly see about coming back here one last time to stay with my mother and Mai." When he said this though Vegeta Sr cocked his head and asked,
"Mai?" Immediately he and everyone else from Asora imagined a certain cat-eared Saiyaness with white hair, Alex's second oldest daughter with Koneko. Trunks however quickly produced a picture he had on himself to show them, a picture of a beautiful woman with long straight black hair.
"I haven't seen her in a while since she was helping the other survivors while mom and I worked on the time machine, but she is my oldest and closest friend." As he trailed off, Trunks showed a warm smile as he admired the picture of Mai, with it already having been close to several years since he'd seen her due to them using the Hyperbolic Time Chamber to prepare for Cell, a chamber that could extend a single day into an entire year.
"Oho! You never said anything about a girlfriend~!" Krillin immediately said as he lightly nudged Trunks with his elbow, making his face go red as he quickly denied,
"She's not my girlfriend!" His denial fell on deaf ears though, as Krillin, Yamcha, and even Bulma began to tease him.
As the scene began to become noticeably more light hearted over there though, Alex glanced over at Goku's own son, Gohan. While he watched Gohan interact with the little girl that was Tien and Launch's daughter, Brunch, Alex contemplated how to handle the situation with him.
Goha's situation was unique to say the least, and not at all enviable to most people. Instead of ever deciding what he himself wanted out of life, Gohan was forced to become a warrior from the tender age of four, when Piccolo kidnapped him and tossed him out into the wilds to train and prepare him.
That was the trigger that led to Gohan's complicated life, as he was forced to alternate between spending the majority of his time studying, and preparing for one threat or another. Typically Goku or Piccolo would push for Gohan to train for battle, due to his innate strength and potential being absolutely necessary, while his mother, Chichi, would angrily insist on Gohan studying regardless of whatever threat there was towards the world.
If he could, Alex wanted to give Gohan a chance to decide what he wanted for his own future instead of being forced to go along with his parents plans(mostly Chichi's). So, he beckoned Grayfia over and whispered something into her ear, to which she replied,
"It will be done." The taciturn maid then became enshrouded in a cloud of mist, indicating that she had returned to Asora.
While he waited for Grayfia to return, Alex figured he'd take the time to follow through on something he'd promised to as he saw more and more vehicles circling the Capsule Corp property.
"Hey Bulma, is there a quieter place where I give the interview I promised?" As he reminded her about about it, Bulma directed an annoyed look in Alex's direction as she said,
"Yeah, any place but here..." Bulma's glower deepened as Alex just smiled wryly, before she eventually sighed and said,
"You're lucky you're hot... You can use the gazebo over there by the pond." Pointing as she said so, Bulma directed Alex to a structure built at the center of a decorative pond that had a single walkway leading towards it.
Looking back at her, Alex smiled disarmingly as he said,
"Thanks, I'll make up for all the trouble somehow." Alex then winked suggestively at her before making his way over to the gazebo, making Bulma blink in surprise as she watched his departure, until baby Trunks began to cry in her arms.
Arriving at the gazebo, Alex used a bit of magic to make the area more comfortable while also producing some snacks and tea. With the preparations finished, Alex then used his 'Domain' to scan the many reporters that were surrounding the large property, before finding the same one that had gone to cover the fight with Cell.
"You'll do." Alex muttered to himself, before instantly transferring the reporter and his cameraman directly to the gazebo within the property.
"Wha- OH!" He exclaimed from his surroundings suddenly changing, before noticing Alex sitting there calmly.
"How about an exclusive?" Alex asked as the reporter tried to calm himself. When he heard the word 'exclusive' though, the reported immediately became excited as he sat in the chair next to Alex and said,
"Of course! I would love an exclusive interview with the mysterious Dragon Emperor!" With Alex and the battle against Cell being the hottest topic of the day, and him already in the limelight for being the only reporter to actually I'll the battle, the man was very eager to increase his own renown even more.
So, after making sure all of their equipment was ready and working, the reporter gave his cameraman the cue and began once they were live,
"Greetings! I'm coming to all of you live from Capsule Corp with the Dragon Emperor himself here, along with the rest of those mysterious people from earlier today." As the reporter greeted the viewers Alex waved casually to say hi, while everyone with them tried to stay out of the camera's range as much as possible.
The interview began with the typical questions that Alex was expecting, such as who exactly he was, and where he came from. Of course he answered as truthfully as he could without revealing anything too confidential, but Alex also noticed many of Goku's friends paying close attention as they too tried to learn more about him. Finally however they got to the interesting stuff, as the reporter asked,
"So, what were those abilities you and Cell used during your battle? Was it a type of hidden weapon? Tricks? Something else?" Alex laughed lightly at the question before answering,
"No no, nothing like a trick or weapon." Alex then held out his hand and conjured a sphere of Ki the size of a baseball before continuing,
"This substance is usually referred to as 'Ki' energy, and it is found in every living thing in the universe. When a person reaches a certain level of strength and skill, they can generate enough energy to be able to tap into it, and use it for a variety of purposes." Alex then held his hand out and shot the sphere of Ki off into the distance, before detonating in a safe place for the camera to see. He then continued,
"The most common use for Ki is to attack using a variety of different techniques, and with the proper control almost any kind of attack you can imagine is possible." Alex then demonstrated by using his Ki in numerous different ways, while also restraining the amount of energy used to prevent any real damage from occurring. Once he was done he then added,
"Aside from attacking though, Ki has several other uses as well, such as flying." As he said that Alex began levitating off of his seat in front of the camera, before slowly lowering himself and continuing, "It can also be used to help jumpstart someone's heart in certain circumstances to preserve their life, teleporting to another location instantly, and much more."
As he finished his explanation the reporter excitedly asked,
"So you're saying that anyone can use this 'Ki'?" Alex nodded before standing up from his seat and moving behind the reporter.
"Sure, hold your hand out like I did earlier, and concentrate on forming a small ball in your palm." As he said that Alex placed his own hand on the reporters back, and began using his own energy to help manipulate his.
The reporter then concentrated so hard that his face quickly began to turn purple, and he began groaning as if he was constipated. After nearly a minute though, with Alex helping him out, a ball of light smaller than a pea formed in the palm of his hand.
"I-I did it!" The report exclaimed in excitement, before adding, "It's so small...." Alex nodded and said,
"Of course, you haven't undergone any training or anything. Normally just getting to that point would be impossible for someone like you, but since I helped to stimulate and control your energy you were able to succeed. Now try firing it like I did earlier." As Alex prompted, the reporter held out his hand towards the water surrounding them, and willed the tiny spot of energy to shoot forward.
Though it was nothing compared to Alex's previous demonstrations, the speck of energy sill shot forward before impacting the water, creating a few small ripples that were still caught on camera.
"Wow! That was amazing! That.....was......" Though he was noticeably excited at first, the reporter quickly became winded as he talked, allowing Alex to say as he offered him some snacks,
"That's what it means to use energy. Though not as noticeable when you have an abundance, like myself or other powerful martial artists, each bit of energy you use would slowly build up and fatigue the user over time. If you used enough, you could easily tire yourself out even with minimal bodily movement."
Recovering after having some snacks, the reporter then asked,
"So, how would this Ki compare to commonly used weapons, like firearms?" The question was barely out of the reporter's mouth when Alex snorted in contempt, and replied,
"They don't compare. Typical firearms are useful for newbies or other people who similarly can't fight, but are useless against people who have undergone enough training, or possess the right skills to counter them." Alex then produced an actual rifle like the ones used by the Earth military, and beckoned Yuna over to help him with the demonstration.
"Woah!" The reporter exclaimed in surprise by the sudden appearance of the firearm, even before Alex readily gave it to Yuna and said,
"Shoot me with it."
"WAIT A SECOND!" The reporter cried out as he immediately tried to escape from the line of fire, right as Yuna pulled the trigger.
Since it was only set to single fire mode there was one loud bark as the gun went off, and Alex's hand blurred before the bullet could hit anything.
"I-is it safe to come out?" The reporter asked as he cautiously peaked out from behind the chair he had been sitting on a moment previously, making Alex laugh out loud as he simply held out his hand for him and the camera to see.
There, in the middle of his palm, was a single bullet that he had snatched out of the air. As the two of the gaped at it Alex said,
"With enough training anyone could snatch a bullet out of the air without being harmed, but with even more training you wouldn't have to bother with catching it." Trailing off, Alex then nodded to Yuna who, after a second of hesitation, set the gun to automatic fire and unloaded the entire clip into Alex.
Again the reporter tried to take cover, but as he peaked out he couldn't help but to be stunned at what he saw, as each and every bullet bounced off of Alex's skin with a small shower of sparks. Meanwhile the man himself simply continued munching on a snack, as if he wasn't being inconvenienced in the slightest at the hailstorm of bullets raining down on him.
Soon the gun clicked, indicating the magazine was empty, and Yuna handed it back to Alex before turning to walk away. Before she took a single step though, Alex gently grabbed her and pulled her head down close to his to plant a quick and tame kiss on her lips.
"Thank you for your help." He said to her, knowing Yuna wouldn't feel too good about actively shooting him while he wasn't resisting, though she was the one in his peerage with the most experience with guns. Truthfully, the simple fact that Yuna had been the one shooting him meant that each bullet was significantly more deadly due to her skills and Gunner Dressphere.
Rather than respond though, Yuna's entire face turned bright red at the sudden, but tame, display of affection in front of so many people, let alone the camera. While Alex took the time to admire Yuna's ass in her booty-shorts as she walked away, the reporter slowly recovered from the shock of an actual rifle being unloaded right next to him.
Finally, he said in awe,
"So you're completely bulletproof?!" Alex nodded slowly as he turned his attention back to him, and replied,
"To an extent. And while I'm actually transformed for extra durability, anyone could become resistant to bullets with the right training. When taken to extremes a person could even train themselves to resist strikes from higher levels of artillery, including missiles." The reporters expression became serious then as he asked his next question,
"So does that mean that, if the person is strong enough, our military would be completely useless to stop them?" Not just him, but all around the world the people who were watching the broadcast held their breaths as they awaited Alex's answer, until he confirmed their suspicions by asking in turn with a slight smile,
