"Wasn't that already proven by Cell and the Demon King Piccolo?" Silence filled the world as everyone took in what Alex had just said, and the truth of what he meant.
Their military was powerless to stop any REAL threat that they might face.
If another Cell or King Piccolo tried to kill or enslave them, then the people of Earth would be completely at their mercy unless someone like Alex stepped up to stop them. Such a thought was truly terrifying.
That was the moment that several people around the world reached the same conclusion, as even King Furry declared to his advisors,
"Get my head of military in here, we have some matters to discuss."
Back at Capsule Corp though, Alex continued
"If you TRULY want to see what people are capable of, then you'll be able to see all that and much more in six months." That comment stirred the reporter from his brief stupor as he asked,
"What do you mean? What's in six months?" Alex smiled widely at the question as he pointedly looked over at Goku and his friends, before turning back to the camera and said,
"In six months I will be hosting an event like nothing anyone on Earth, or perhaps the entire universe has ever seen. A competition featuring competitors from all over the universe and beyond, who'll duke it out for the title of the strongest out of thousands, or even millions of fighters. The Universal Grand Martial Arts Tournament."

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - 448: Disciple
chapters.content:
(A.N. After posting the last chapter I realized that I shouldn't have added the 'Martial Arts' to the tournament name, since it implies that it'll only have martial arts. The tournament will be open to every style of fighting, barehanded, magic, armed, etc, so it'll just be referred to as the Universal Grand Tournament (UGT) from now on)
After Alex announced the tournament the interview only lasted a few more minutes before coming to an end, and the reporter was asked to leave. During this time Trunks had also left to return to the future, after saying goodbye to everyone he had grown close to. Though he hoped to return with his mother and Mai, none of them treated it as a guaranteed outcome since there was a lot that could happen once he returned home, including even the two refusing to leave for one reason or another.
As Alex approached the group, sans Trunks, he was immediately approached by Goku, who was practically bouncing up and down in excitement as he asked,
"Are you really going to gather the strongest fighters from all over the universe!?!" Alex nodded and said,
"That's what I'm hoping for, and I know a few people who might be able to help with that. On top of that I'm also going to have people from Asora and the other realms we're connected to compete as well, you should have more than enough people to challenge." Goku's excitement only intensified when he heard that, as he automatically began imagining all the tough new challengers he would face, with Alex being at the top of the list of course.
In response to Goku's excitement though, someone snorted with contempt as he said,
"What tournament? We all know that one of us Saiyans will win without competition! Except perhaps each other." As one, everybody turned to look at the speaker, Vegeta Jr, with various expressions.
Though no one openly argued with his declaration, there were various reasons why.
On the side of Bulma and the rest of their gang, they were silently in agreement due to having witnessed the power of the Saiyans so many times, the same power that allowed them to overcome the most impossible odds to achieve victory time and again.
On Alex's side though, most of the girls just flashed wry smiles while Shia in particular had a shit-eating grin on her face. Though Vegeta Jr had a point about the power of the Saiyans, their superiority as warriors was primarily in this universe.
In the Dragon Ball universe everything was settled by punching, kicking, screaming, and energy blasts. Yes, Saiyans were incredibly and stupidly powerful, but they were in for a surprise when they saw how people from the other worlds fought.
Even more so considering that the people there had known about Alex's Saiyan heritage for years, and had been preparing methods to fight against his ridiculous and absurd power. After all, battle maniacs like Sairaorg, Cao Cao and Vali would never stay down after he beat them, not to mention the numerous gods with matching godly egos.
Though Yuna didn't know much about the other people in Asora, DXD and Earthland, she could still feel the atmosphere of excitement being emitted from most of the girls next to her as they too planned to compete.
Just as Alex himself felt torn between warning Vegeta Jr not to get too cocky, and letting him find out for himself, there was suddenly a flash as Grayfia returned with two other people in tow. With everyone directing their attention to the newcomers, Alex quickly stepped forward and gestured towards Gohan while saying,
"Good timing! Gohan, this is Millicas, Grayfia's son, and Sona Sitri, headmistress of the Academy in Asora."
...
Immediately after introducing Gohan with Sona and Millicas, the former to discuss Gohan attending the Academy to get him away from his mother, and the latter to help him make friends around his own age despite Millicas being a little bit older than Gohan, Alex excused himself to take care of some buisness.
Though he left, Alex didn't end up going far as he appeared on a mountain within view of West City, and said to the open air,
"So how long are you gonna hide for?" Immediately the space before him shimmered as the two beings that had been spying on them appeared. Immediately Alex recognized the duo as the Supreme Kai(God) of this universe, Shin, and his faithful attendant Kibito.
While he wasn't surprised that the duo were spying on him, Alex was surprised that they moved this quickly after he stopped trying to hide himself. His suspicions on why were proven correct however when Shin said,
"I don't know who you are or why you're on this planet, but you need to leave immediately. There is a danger slumbering here that can threaten the safety of the entire universe!" Alex was surprised that Shin outright told him about the danger laying dormant on planet Earth, as for all the relatively 'young' Kai knew he intended to release said threat.
Though this meant that Alex must've earned some semblance of trust from the Kai after killing a threat like Cell, that didn't stop him from wanting to fuck with them. A shit-eating grin formed on Alex's face as he held out his right hand, confusing the Kai until a massive sphere appeared in it that was purple in color, and had a network of veins crisscrossing over it.
"You-!" Shin exclaimed in surprise as both he and Kibito readied themselves to fight, but also hesitated due to not wanting to disrupt the sphere in Alex's hands.
His smirk widening, Alex then proceeded to spin the sphere on his middle finger as he taunted,
"This wouldn't happen to be the threat you were talking about, right?" If looks could kill Alex would've died hundreds of times over from how Shin and Kibito were both glaring at him, only to immediately shift to panic when he almost 'dropped' the sphere, only to catch it before it hit the ground with his 'Telekinesis'.
"Oops, almost dropped it!" Alex said with a jovial tone, stressing the two of them out to the max as Shin demanded,
"Are you TRYING to exterminate all life in the universe!?!" Alex however just shrugged as he replied,
"Might as well since it would probably be destroyed soon anyways with the way you're running things." Those words made Shin pause before he slowly asked,
"What do you mean?" For the first time a serious expression appeared on Alex's face, as he replied,
"I mean that I know things you don't, things like how your negligence will endanger the universe several times over." As he spoke Alex put enough force into his voice that both Kai flinched in the face of it, both from the overwhelming power, and the truth in the accusations.
"I don't deny I've made mistakes...." Shin began humbly, before continuing, "I was never supposed to be the Supreme Kai to begin with, but uncontrollable events led to my appointment to the position. Regardless of my mistakes though, I know for a fact that they'll all be considered insignificant if you allow that THING to escape from that sphere!"
By that point Alex felt the energy around Shin spike as he seemingly prepared to fight him in order to preserve the peace of the universe. What Shin didn't expect though, was for Alex to suddenly smile as he said,
"So you do have some balls. Good." To say Shin and Kibito were surprised at Alex's sudden shift was quite the understatement, before he continued,
"If you want to do better as a Kai, then let's go talk some more. But first let's change locations." As he said that Alex raised his hand to use Spatial magic to transfer all of them to the planet of the Kai's, but first he glance back at Capsule Corp to see how things were going down there.
Of course, Alex tuned in just in time to see Chichi shout at Sona that her academy was 'just a fourth rate bum of a community college, which could never compare to the multi-award winning universities she had already picked out for Gohan'. Though he shook his head at Chichi's behavior, Alex decided to let Sona hash this one out as he quickly transferred himself and the two Kai away.
***
In the days following Alex's defeat of Cell numerous changes were made on Earth regarding how people approached martial arts.
Dojos all across the planet had revamped their training and techniques due to Alex's revelations making them feel inferior, as well as to try out the things he had displayed regarding energy. But even better than that was that the numerous police academies around the world had also began implementing body strengthening training, while King Furry had also began implementing similar changes.
The latter two changes were especially good in Alex's opinion, as it was the job of the police and the military in the first place to protect the people of this planet, no matter how much Goku and his friends considered themselves the planet's protectors. Though it was doubtful they would reach the same level as Goku and the others, if the number of strong fighters on the world increased then it would be that much safer.
And surprisingly the one helping the most with increasing the collective strength of the Earth, was none other than Bulma.
As two of the most brilliant minds on the planet, if not the entire universe, Bulma and her father were usually the ones who made the equipment that Vegeta Jr in particular used to become stronger. They had been the ones to make the gravity chamber Goku used to become strong enough to defeat Frieza, which was then later became Vegeta's primary source of training.
Now Bulma had numerous people across the planet contacting her for information about her friends and the source of their strength. Though at first she had been extremely annoyed at it, that changed once her father casually mentioned marketing the gravity chamber in capsule form to them.
This caused a spark to ignite in Bulma as she began doing just that, as well as starting numerous projects of other inventions that people could use to become stronger. She had gained a lot of ideas recently after Alex took her family on a tour of Asora, part of which was specifically for them to meet with the Grigori to open the discuss for any future cooperation.
Of course, the most impactful part of their visit was when they got to know Lala better and see the numerous outrageous things she had invented. The bubbly Devilukian then gained yet another rival without even knowing it. (A.N. Lala, the ultimate cheat cheat/troll to other inventors, and she doesn't even know it.)
On top of the changes taking place on Earth, things in space were also beginning to move due to Alex's previous 'discussion' with the Kai. Now they were the ones spreading word of the Universal Grand Tournament all across the universe to gain the participation of as many planets and warriors as possible.
With the changes taking place on Earth, and word of the tournament being spread throughout the universe for him, Alex decided that it was soon time for him to make contact with the next person on his list, Beerus the Destroyer.
Before he traveled clear across the universe to wake up the angry kitty cat though, there was one last little thing Alex wanted to check on on Earth.
Transferring to his destination, Alex found himself beside a crowd of people clambering outside the gates of a large mansion with the letter S emblazoned on the front door. This was the home of Mr. Satan.
Though Alex didn't necessarily care for the supposed martial artist, there was still someone here he wanted to check up on after his death. But with the crowd of people trying to get past the gates, the vast majority of which were paparazzi and reporters trying to get a scoop, Alex frowned as he produced a pair of sunglasses and a metallic cylinder.
"Excuse me everybody!" He nearly shouted after putting the sunglasses on, getting the attention of everyone present as they then tried to interview him regarding why he was there. Instead of answering a single question though, the moment all eyes and camera were on him, Alex immediately pressed the button on the cylinder, which then produced a flash in their direction.
Instantly the people all calmed as blank expressions appeared on their faces, none of them now remembering what they were doing there. On top of that, with the upgrades made to the device in Alex's hand, any audio or digital recordings made with the cameras and tapes were completely wiped clean.
Taking the sunglasses off and putting them away with the cylinder, Alex then said to the crowds in a clear voice,
"I was not here today, and none of you have any reason to be here either. You will all go home, and think about the choices you made in your life before thinking about how to better yourselves." Once Alex finished speaking the gathered reporters and paparazzi didn't respond right away, before empty mutters replied to him as they slowly shuffled away from the mansion.
Satisfied, Alex then teleported himself directly in front of the doors to the mansion, before knocking on them loudly.
"HOW MANY TIMES DO WE HAVE TO SAY NO!?!" An angry voice shouted from the other side, before the door was violently thrown open to reveal a beautiful woman with bushy orange hair.
When she saw that it was at the door instead of reporters her expression briefly morphed to shock, before absolute fury as she declared,
"YOU HAVE SOME BALLS COMING HERE AFTER YOU MURDERED MR. SATAN!!!" Alex however, having already been dealing with numerous people blaming him for Mr. Satan's death, didn't even flinch as he calmly and casually said,
"Nice to meet you too miss." Though she was about to verbally tear into him some more, the woman was interrupted as someone else asked,
"Who is it Miss Piiza?" Apparently they had heard her raised voice, but not what she yelled. When the man saw Alex standing at the door though, he too had an incredulous expression as he demanded,
"What do you want!?" With more and more people gathering and demanding what he wanted, all of which had angry expressions on their face, Alex just sighed before transferring himself directly behind the growing crowd.
Now inside the mansion itself, Alex let out a whistle as he took in the gaudy and extravagant decorations within, while the numerous people that had been previously blocking his entrance whirled around.
"What are you doing?!" The woman, Miss Piiza, demanded, to which Alex replied,
"Well, if any of you had let me reply earlier you'd know I was here to check up on some things after Mr. Satan's death." This however raised an entirely new wave of protests from the group as they insisted that they needed nothing to do with Alex, while several also called him some choice colorful words.
They were of course Mr. Satan's martial arts students and his promotional agent, a group consisting of the self-proclaimed strongest people on the planet. While they were exceptionally powerful compared to the average person, they were all still pitifully weak in the grand scheme of things. But with the waves Alex had created, that wasn't going to be the case for much longer.
As the group began making a bigger and bigger racket, to the point where Alex was unable to tell was anyone was saying, he finally got fed up enough to where he stated with a small amount of divine power in his voice,
"Shut up." Immediately there was silence as everyone suddenly found themselves unable to so much as open their mouths, let alone speak. Once there was finally quiet, he then stated slowly,
"I do not deny my role in Mr. Satan's death, but I did not 'kill' him. His death, if anything, would be considered suicide by my hand, not murder. Do you understand?" As he finished Alex released his hold on the group, allowing them to speak once again.
Though they could speak again, no one did for a moment until the promotional agent Piiza asked venomously,
"Why do you care about Mr. Satan's interests?" Alex sighed in exasperation at the question as he replied,
"As I said before, though it was an accident I won't deny my part in his death. No matter whatever else he was, Mr. Satan stood up to face the greatest threat the people of this world had ever seen, the least I can do is make sure the things he cared about are doing ok. Especially his daughter."
Immediately everyone became tense as Alex mentioned Mr. Satan's only living family, Videl Satan.
At only eleven years old, Videl was now an orphan due to losing her mother when she was younger, and now her father to Cell and Alex. Needless to say she wasn't taking the loss 'well'.
...
"HA!"
"RA!"
"HIYAH!"
Within the dojo owned and ran by Mr. Satan before his death, located within his own home, a certain little girl was shouting over and over again as she repeatedly struck a wooden post with differing moves.
With each hit her knuckles became bloodier as the skin covering them split, and with each step and kick blisters burst on her feet that made even the simplest of movements painful. No matter how much pain she obviously was in though, the girl continued moving as she seemingly tried to destroy the wooden post with a ferocity that didn't match her age.
As he, and Mr. Satan's students, watched her train from the doorway secretly, Miss Piiza explained,
"She's been doing that almost nonstop since her dad died..... She's barely eaten anything, works herself until she collapses, and then just gets back up once she wakes to start all over again....." For a moment Alex said nothing as he watched Videl literally beat herself bloody on the wooden post, which he noticed even had a piece of paper with his face on it.
"This isn't healthy..." He finally said, to which Miss Piiza replied snarkily,
"Well who's fault do you think that is?" Without missing a beat, Alex looked down at her and said with all seriousness,
"Yours." As priceless as the incredulous look she gave him was, Alex wasn't even remotely humored as he continued,
"With Mr. Satan gone, you're all pretty much the only family Videl has left, and apparently none of you have tried to actually help her when she obviously needs it. Or did you all think she'd be perfectly ok after her dad died?" Every one of the men and woman looked away at that due to the truth in Alex's words, as none of them even knew the first thing about taking care of and looking after a little girl.
Even Miss Piiza, Mr. Satan's promotional manager, didn't know the first thing about raising a child. In fact, the only idea she had been able to come up with was have Videl hold a press conference to discuss her loss in order to rally people against Alex, an idea that had been immediately dismissed for obvious reasons.
Shaking his head at the group, Alex then surprised them all by stepping out into the dojo, and saying out loud,
"Sure you have heart, but keep this up and that's all you'll have at this rate." Immediately Videl spun around to look and see who was there, allowing Alex to get a good look at her for the first time.
She had light blue eyes that had grown red and puffy from crying, was wearing a white gi, and had her chest-length black hair tied into two low pigtails at the sides.
With how physically and mentally exhausted she was it took Videl a moment for her eyes to focus on him, but when she realized who was standing in front of her any sign of fatigue instantly vanished. She then immediately charged him with a look of fury that no child should have, before actually leaping into the air with her foot leading in a kick.
"HIYAH!!!" Videl cried out as she tried to attack him, only for Alex to barely shift his body to side as she flew right past him harmlessly.
"Do you attack everyone when you first meet them?" Alex asked half jokingly, which Videl apparently didn't find funny as she cried out,
"I'm gonna kill you and get revenge for my dad!" Her declaration was then followed up by a series of punches and kicks that Videl threw at him with more viciousness than an eleven year old should possess.
Again, Alex avoided everything Videl threw at him with ease, before he began saying,
"'You' intend to kill 'me'? Not with those lousy skills." Videl practically snarled at Alex's taunt as she stated,
"I learned how to fight from my dad, the strongest person in the world!" Despite her ferocity though Alex just tutted at her lack of strength and said while avoiding another kick,
"Regardless of who taught you, it was be extremely embarrassing if I died to someone with such pitiful skill. Here, fix your stance and put more power into your fist here-" Then, even as she tried to kill him, Alex began directing Videl on how to better improve her skills while bringing more power out of her body.
Of course this just made her angrier, but Alex paid no mind as he continued directing her.
"Is he.....teaching her?" One of Mr. Satan's students asked incredulously, to which another one slowly nodded as he said,
"I think he is..."
"Why?" Another uttered, until they saw Videl suddenly deliver a punch more powerful than any yet directly into Alex's abs.
"Excellent! Keep this up and you might actually make a half-decent martial artist, though it'll take a lot more practice." By this point though Videl was too out of breath to retort, as the abuse she had been putting her body though the last several days quickly caught up to her.
Noticing this, Alex approached her and plopped his hand directly down on top of her head to pat it. Videl flinched at the contact, but was unable to shake his hand off due to how tired she was. Before she knew it though, her eyes began to grow heavy as even more of her strength left her body.
As Videl succumbed to her exhaustion, Alex gently held her like he would any of his children, before turning to face the group that had been watching the whole time.
"I'm taking her to my home. There I'll teach her how to fight, and maybe with time she'll be able to recover and move forward." Immediately of course Miss Piiza stepped forward and stated,
"Absolutely not! I'm not going to stand idly by as you essentially kidnap Mr. Satan's only child!" With a few others backing her up as they too voiced their objections, they were all suddenly silenced as Alex emitted an intense atmosphere, and stated with some anger in his voice,
"And do you think it's better for her to stay here? Where there's apparently no one to properly care for her?" That made them flinch, as with the current state Videl was in none of them were in any position to argue Alex's point. He then continued while healing Videl's hands and feet,
"In my home I have numerous children that will be able to keep her company while she trains, and I have numerous wives with their own tragic pasts that may be able to help her move forward like they did. And with how many of them have children of their own, you can be assured that Videl will be more than properly cared for as my student."
His piece said, Alex then turned to leave without giving any of them so much as a single glance, before pausing as he added,
"Someone will be by later to pick up Videl's things, and I'll arrange to have all of her father's assets frozen until she's old enough to claim them herself. As for the dojo, feel free to continue training. If you want to prove me wrong, then prepare for the Tournament in six months." With nothing else to say, Alex then exited the mansion before disappearing into a wall of mist, Videl still slumbering peacefully in his arms for the first time in days.

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - 449: Beerus the Destroyer
chapters.content:
"Nnnnn" Videl groaned as her consciousness slowly stirred.
"Finally awake?" A foreign voice asked her, making Videl jerk awake suddenly as she took in her new surroundings.
Instead of her father's dojo, which was the last place she recalled being in, Videl now found herself laying on a comfy sofa in a cozy room, with a massive fireplace roaring in front of her. Meanwhile sitting on the couch was a woman who just had Videl's head in her lap, and had apparently been watching over her while she slept.
She had charcoal black hair, eyes that seemed to glow like living coals, and despite appearing only a few years older than Videl, possessed stupidly large breasts that didn't fit her smaller figure.
"Who are you and where am I?" Videl immediately demanded as she tried to back away from the mystery woman.
The woman however didn't appear at all concerned about Videl's suspicions, as she simply bowed her head slightly in greeting and introduced herself,
"I am Hestia, goddess of Hearth, Home, and Architecture. You are currently at the Misty Manor, and it's a pleasure to meet you after watching over you for the past day Videl." Rather than appeared get relieved at Hestia's introduction, Videl was put even more on edge as she asked,
"And where is this Misty Manor?" Videl's heart then sank as Hestia answered,
"It's in Asora of course."
Asora, the home of the man who murdered her father. Alexander Morningstar.
Videl's clenched fists trembled in anger as she spat out at Hestia,
"Why am I here?" For a moment Hestia didn't say anything as the two instead stared at each other, Videl through glaring eyes while the goddess appeared to be studying her. Eventually she asked in return,
"Why do you think you're here?" Videl narrowed her eyes at the question before retorting,
"Why would I know? Maybe that jerk just wants to rub it in that he killed my dad!" Hestia sighed when she heard that, as it was obvious Videl was just trying to come up with excuses to make Alex out to be a villain, not that it wasn't to be unexpected of an eleven year old.
That was why the one asked to watch over Videl had been Hestia, as she was definitely the goddess with the most patience along with her divinities related to Home.
So, rather than losing her patience with Videl's attitude, Hestia simply poured the two of them some tea, which Videl completely ignored, before saying,
"Or maybe he wanted to help you." She then took a sip of her tea, while Videl threw hers on the ground so hard the cup shattered.
"If he wants to help me, then he should give me back my dad!"
Naturally that was what Videl asked for, but it was the one thing she couldn't have. Instead, she had been forced to watch as that mysterious group of people who had been there during the fight with Cell somehow brought back everyone else who had been killed by him. Everyone but her dad.
Instead of immediately going into an in depth explanation, Hestia pointed at the cup Videl just broke and said,
"Put it back together." That stumped the angry little girl as she looked at the goddess and uttered, "Huh?"
Hestia however took another sip of her tea before elaborating,
"Put that cup back together, exactly the way it was with no imperfections." Videl only grew more confused as she wondered what the cup had to do with her dad, until she stated,
"I can't do that, it's impossible..." Instead of trying to say otherwise, Hestia nodded and explained,
"Exactly. Even if Alex is able to bring back someone who had died, the requirement is that their soul is intact, or at least in a manageable state. Because of the attack he took though, your father's soul was completely shattered, even worse than that cup.
"Unlike the fragments of that cup though, the fragments of a soul would fade away almost immediately before anyone could even try to collect them and rebuild it. To rebuild it would take a being of ultimate power, a being thousands of times more powerful than even Alex is."
When Hestia trailed off she noticed tears forming at the corners of Videl's eyes, which was understandable after what she just told her. Though cruel, Hestia knew it was necessary for Videl to understand the truth since it would help her accept it and move on...hopefully.
However that didn't mean that she was just going to let Videl suffer by herself.
As tears began streaming down Videl's face, and choking sobs escaped her throat, Hestia grabbed the girl and pulled her face into her bosom. There, Videl tightly clung onto Hestia's clothes as she bawled her eyes out, while the goddess gently stroked the back of her head to comfort her.
***
While Videl was being comforted by Hestia and adjusting to the sudden changes around her, Alex was hurtling through space at greater speeds than he ever had before.
"THIS IS AMAZING!" He cried out with child-like joy while increasing his speed even further, something that made even Elaine next to him smile in amusement.
She was accompanying Alex to see the undisputed strongest being in this universe, the God of Destruction, Beerus.
While Shin was the Supreme Kai of this universe, the sixth of the twelve universes that existed, his own strength paled significantly compared to that of Beerus, who possessed enough power to destroy the entire universe itself if he felt like it. And even if he was too lazy to regularly train, his strength was still growing constantly.
That was why Elaine of all people went with him. Though she couldn't intervene if Alex's life was at risk, she could still provide him with extra muscle if needed.
And despite being able to open a gate directly to Beerus' planet, the duo were flying through space at hyper speeds so that Alex could enjoy the chance to truly let loose for once. Though, for someone like Elaine it was still a leisurely pace.
Entire solar systems and galaxies flashed by as blurs in the distance as the duo sped forwards, with them having to dodge planets, comets, asteroids, and any stars that happened to be in their paths. They didn't try to avoid all of them however, as Elaine called out to him,
"I'm sensing a large amount of the Frieza army remnants on the planet coming up, are you going to leave them alone?" Alex glanced up to see an insignificant speck on the horizon, and answered,
"Can you remove any of the innocents on the planet so they don't get caught up in it?"
"Of course." Elaine answered as she casually waved her hand, teleporting all of the people on the planet who weren't a willing part of the Frieza army to another planet where they could be free of oppression.
No longer needing to worry about getting innocents caught up, Alex flashed an evil smile as he sped up and aimed directly for the planet.
*KABOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!*
Shockwaves echoed throughout the solar system they were currently in as the planet was smashed into pieces, instantly killing every single person on it.
"Look at those fireworks!" Alex declared with a smirk as the fragments of the planet began hurtling through space themselves, at a much slower speed than Alex and Elaine of course.
As a group that made a business out of wiping out entire races and selling their planet to the highest bidder, Alex had no problems wiping them out if they were unfortunate enough to cross his path in return. Frieza may not be around to personally lead them anymore, but that didn't mean Alex would tolerate their continued actions.
"I'm pretty sure you gained a LOT of levels from that." Elaine said to him suddenly, to which Alex simply shrugged as he replied,
"Probably, but it's not like I can know unless I make the next purchase." Though Elaine began to nod in agreement, she was soon distracted as Alex veered off course towards the solar system's sun.
There, Alex began to zip across the surface of molten and boiling flame as if the heat meant nothing to him, dodging arcs of solar flare ups and pillars of flame as he went with a joyful expression on his face. He then zipped around the star with such speed that massive waves formed and rippled out to spread over it's entire surface, before slingshotting himself even further into deep space.
The entire time Elaine was rolling her eyes at him due to his childish behavior, but at the same time she also had a wry smile at the edge of her lips as she watched him. If someone questioned her about it or pointed it out to her though, the 'Angel' would adamantly refuse such a thing ever occurred.
...
After nearly an entire day of flying through space, an incomprehensible pace for anyone outside the gods, Alex and Elaine finally arrived at the small world of Beerus the Destroyer.
The 'planet' was unlike any other that Alex and Elaine passed on the way there, as it was shaped like an upside-down pyramid with a massive, twisted, dead-looking tree at the center. Surrounding the tree was several miles of forests, lakes, and clear plains while numerous moons orbited the planet.
Unsurprisingly, a certain figure walked out to greet them as Alex and Elaine touched down in a cleared area, but what did surprise Alex was when the figure said,
"Welcome. I've been wondering when you would arrive here, oh 'great' Dragon Emperor." Though his tone at first was light and jovial, Alex noticed a slight gleam in the speaker's eyes at the last part. Instead of appearing surprised that the figure had been spying on him though, Alex said in return,
"It's a pleasure to meet you, Whis." The figure, Whis, didn't even try to hide his surprise that Alex already knew who he was, but then his expression transitioned into one of amusement as he said,
"I suppose I shouldn't be surprised that I'm known by someone who already knew such 'interesting' things. Then again, I guess that is to be expected by someone who's not even from this universe." This time Alex did look surprised, which made Whis laugh with an exaggerated face, while his hand covered his mouth in a show of elegance. He then added,
"Ohohohohohoho! Please don't act so surprised, it's only a natural conclusion once I confirmed that you never existed in this universe prior to a week and a half ago. However, you also don't appear to be a Saiyan from Universe Seven." As he trailed off Whis conjured up an image of those very same Saiyans who, while they were almost identical in numerous aspects, showed some distinct differences with the Saiyans of Universe Six.
This time Alex had a wry smile as he said,
"You're right. I'm not from either Universe Six or Seven, but that's irrelevant for the moment. I came to chat with Beerus." Though he already knew why Alex had traveled all the way here, Whis still frowned as his intentions were voiced out loud.
"I'm sorry to say that Lord Beerus is currently asleep, and is not scheduled to wake up for several years yet." He said while shaking his head, as if it couldn't be helped. Alex however shrugged, and replied,
"Then I'll just wake him up since what I need to talk about is fairly important." Whis however smiled once again at that.
"Ohohohoho! I wouldn't recommend that, Lord Beerus can be VERY cranky if his naps are disturbed." This time Alex surprised Whis as he snapped his fingers, and produced a fifty foot long table laden with various types of food that were popular on Earth.
As Whis examined the food in awe, Alex smugly said,
"Then it's a good thing I prepared a peace offering! And by the way, there's a spell on the food to preserve its freshness and keep it from cooling, so take your time enjoying it." Without any hesitation, Whis readily took a seat at the table and began debating what to try first as his nose was assaulted by the symphony of aromas.
"Thank you very much!" He declared before finally making his choice, and eagerly placed an entire pizza onto his plate before trying to figure out how he was supposed to eat it.
Alex meanwhile turned his attention towards the massive tree that was in the center of the world. Within, the God of Destruction slumbered, unaware of the very rude wake up call he was about to receive.
Meanwhile on the outside, though he appeared to be focusing on his pizza, Whis paid attention to every single move Alex and Elaine were making even as the former vanished to go wake up Beerus. Whis then focused his attention onto Elaine, his curiosity regarding her climbing with each passing second.
Though there were many unique and interesting things about Alex and his companions that Whis had observed so far, Elaine was the only one he was completely unable to read. Instead, any time his intent focused on her too much, he was suddenly feel a chill as if a predator was breathing down his neck.
As someone who never even flinched in the face of the Omni King, the being who stood at the pinnacle of all twelve universes and beyond, this made him even more curious about her and what she was.
Before he could probe too much though, both Whis and Elaine suddenly looked over at the tree that housed Beerus as part of it exploded, with a single figure rocketing out of the resulting dust cloud.
Immediately following it was a second figure, dressed only in a long nightgown with a matching cap that was covered in soot. The person himself though had dark purple skin with catlike features, incredibly long pointed ears that stuck straight up, squinty eyes, and appeared completely devoid of any hair on their body.
"INSIGNIFICANT MORTAL! I WILL SKIN YOU FOR DISTURBING MY SLEEP!" The figure, Beerus the Destroyer, shouted in rage as he pursued the other figure, Alex.
Beerus then flashed forward with such speed and power that Alex barely had enough time to cross his arms to defend himself, before he was sent flying back into one of the surrounding moons, and beyond.
*BOOM!*
The moon then exploded as Alex went flying through it back into the deep recesses of space, before he too faded and reappeared right next to Beerus.
"Miss me?" He taunted, before sending his own powerful punch directly into Beerus' side with enough force that fissures spread out on the ground around them. Contrary to expectations though, Beerus didn't even budge from the powerful punch, instead catching it in his hand.
Though he appeared unfazed by Alex's punch, Beerus' hand was still shaking slightly from the strength behind Alex's punch. The edge of his lips curled upwards ever so slightly in amusement at that as he commented,
"Cheeky mortal, it appears you have a little bit of skill." Despite still being incensed about his nap being disturbed, Beerus began to regard Alex a little bit seriously since he hadn't been completely destroyed by one of his punches.
He then put a small amount of force into his hand to send Alex sliding back across the ground, before snapping his fingers seriously. Hearing this, Whis immediately paused his eating to pick up his staff, and tap it lightly on the ground. Beerus was then enshrouded in a sphere of light, which faded a second later to reveal him fully dressed to do business as the God of Destruction.
Instead of the nightgown and cap he had been wearing earlier, Beerus was now attired in a pair of baggy blue pants with a darker blue sash wrapped around his waist, with another band of decorated cloth hanging downwards between his legs. Adorning his wrists, biceps, ankles, neck, and one of his ears were bands of gold while brown cloth shoes covered his feet. Draped over his shoulders was a black Usekh collar with white edges, blue stripes, and an orange diamond in the middle.
Now formally attired, Beerus tucked one of his hands behind his back while raising the other to point at Alex with his claw-tipped finger, and said,
"Prepare yourself mortal, for I will NOT be holding back!" Rather than seeming concerned about that, Alex smiled widely as he returned,
"That's exactly what I want, but it's not 'mortal' Beerus. My name is Alexander Morningstar, remember it!" This time Beerus' entire mouth curled upwards in a cruel and malicious smile as he replied,
"We shall see if you are worthy of the honor!"

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - 450: Beerus VS Alex
chapters.content:
(A.N. I got it mixed up last chapter, Beerus is the God of Destruction of Universe Seven, and his brother is from Universe Six. I was writing away from Internet at the time and couldn't double check, and forgot to do so before publishing.)
"We shall see if you are worthy of the honor." Beerus sneered as he and Alex stared each other down.
Despite the fact that he was still looking down on him, Beerus couldn't help but to get his hopes up that this 'mortal' might actually be able to entertain him a bit after their 'greeting'. Alex meanwhile was grinning for similar reasons as this would the first opponent that could genuinely threaten him that he's faced in years.
As the duos respective energies began to skyrocket, they then took to the skies once again before clashing with enough force that the shockwaves buffeted even the nearby galaxies. Meanwhile, Alex was sent flying back once again as the force from Beerus' hit overwhelmed his own, before the god suddenly appeared in his trajectory and stopped his flight with another hit.
"So what are you, worthless mortal who's name escapes me?" Beerus suddenly asked as he scrutinized Alex's body, demonstrating just how lightly he was taking him. "You have the tail of a Saiyan, but I've never seen a Saiyan with a red tail and fur that matched before..." Honestly, he had never seen a Saiyan with fur or the other traits Alex had at all.
As Beerus blocked another one of his hits though, Alex stated,
"I am a Saiyan, but I'm currently in my SSJ4 form! That's why I look different from other Saiyans!" As he finished speaking Alex threw another punch, but instead of being blocked this time, he used Spatial magic to create a portal that opened right next to Beerus' face, letting him get his first decent hit on the god since the fight began.
Rubbing the cheek that Alex had hit, like he was still trying to register the fact that one of Alex's fists had actually connected, Beerus was silent for a moment as if he trying to recall something.
"Super Saiyan....why does that sound so familiar?" He muttered to himself while cocking his head to the side in thought, not even flinching as Alex delivered a powerful kick to his side.
'This is crazy!' Alex thought to himself, even as he was smiling like a maniac. 'I knew he overpowered the SSJ3 Goku like it was nothing, but to think he can even shrug off hits from me in my SSJ4 form like this!'
'He didn't become the God of Destruction in this universe for nothing you know.' Lauren said with a bit of humor in her voice, while even Ddraig chimed in,
<Seeing him for myself, I now wish we had such beings back in our universe to challenge.>
Though Alex wanted to comment about how Ddraig couldn't even compare to Great Red in his prime, Beerus suddenly demanded his attention once more as he declared,
"THATS IT!" Everyone looked at Beerus curiously at his declaration, to which Whis asked,
"What's 'it' Lord Beerus?" Beerus looked down at Whis and stated excitedly,
"I remembered the dream I was having before I was so rudely woken up! A prophetic dream that showed me who would become my ultimate rival, the Super Saiyan God!"
While normally Whis would show skepticism at one of Beerus' 'prophetic dreams', this time he looked directly at Alex and uttered, "Oh my..." After all, he HAD been watching Alex for the last several days, and, while he wasn't aware of ALL his trump cards, Whis knew there was still a thing or two Alex hadn't showed Beerus yet.
His excitement growing even higher, Beerus then pointed at Alex and ordered,
"Turn into a god, mortal!" Instead of letting Beerus' commanding tone bug him, Alex just shrugged as he replied,
"Ok, I was thinking of doing so anyways since none of my attacks even seemed to be affecting you." Beerus blinked at that, before muttering,
"Now that you mention it..... I do recall feeling something bumping into me while I was trying to recall my dream..."
This time Alex's brow did twitch as Beerus casually dissed his attacks, tempting him to temporarily remove his tattoos and ask if Beerus could feel it then. With Lauren however reminding him of how that would a be a VERY bad idea, Alex instead closed his eyes and began channeling his divine power.
Though he had long since tapped out the divine energy he absorbed during his battle with all the factions, Alex was still able to enter his 'God mode' whenever he wanted now due to his constant connection to the system of Heaven, as well as the millions of prayers he was receiving daily from the people of Asora, DXD, and surprisingly even Earthland.
So, when Alex opened his eyes once again, they glowed with a brilliant red divine light, before his entire body was cocooned in divine power. Alex's red fur and eye markings began changing to a brilliant blue, while his black hair shifted to the same red his eyes had.
"Oh look, a minor cosmetic change!" Beerus said mockingly as the light around him began to fade, however even he couldn't deny the powerful divine aura Alex was now emitting.
Immediately the both of them moved as they clashed once again, their fists colliding with enough power that a massive fissure formed that split Beerus' planet in half, with Alex on one side and Beerus on the other. Neither one paid any attention to that though as they quickly began to trade a series of high powered blows at point blank range.
"Do you have to take things so far? My goodness..." Whis uttered disapprovingly as he erected a barrier to keep the food from being disturbed.
Glancing over at their fight though, Whis was surprised to see Alex actually gaining the slightest bit of ground as he and Beerus hit the other more than a hundred times per second. Taking a closer look, Whis noticed a foreign form of energy coating Alex's body and hands that was negating a large portion of the damage he was receiving, while also increasing the amount of damage Beerus was taking.
"He's using Haki." Elaine suddenly said, drawing Whis' attention as she explained further,
"It is a type of energy usage from a different universe. Haki itself has numerous uses, Armament Haki in particular specializes in coating the users body in a type of armor, increasing both their offensive and defense capabilities. There is also Observation Haki, which can grant one a form of precognition that would allow them to know how their opponent plans to attacks, or dodge, before they even do it. And then finally, there is the Conquerer's Haki..."
As Elaine trailed off there Whis' attention was drawn back to the battle as a massive shockwave shook them, courtesy of Alex delivering a fist clad in black lightning directly into Beerus' face. The Destruction God was sent flying back with such force, that he unintentionally destroyed the entire half of the planet he was on along with another one of the moons surrounding them.
Then, before he could reorient himself from the hit, Alex instantly appeared directly behind Beerus with Spatial magic and delivered a second punch with his fist clad in Conquerer's Haki. With black lightning coating his arms clear up to his elbows, Alex then followed up and 'clapped' his hands in Beerus' direction with enough power, that the universe itself seemed to shudder from the force as the remaining moons around them shattered into dust.
Beerus himself, never having encountered such a technique before, took it head on and was dealt more damage than he had received in eons because of it.
"Oh my, this is certainly looking quite interesting." Whis remarked as he watched the battle unfold, which he was admittedly looking forward to seeing how Alex would respond once Beerus decided to truly get 'serious'.
"I don't care how interesting it is, THIS IS INSANE!" A new voice shrieked as the only other resident on the planet joined Whis and Elaine, a blue, eel-like fish creature that was approaching them in its floating fishbowl. The other two ignored her however as they continued watching the match with growing interest.
"I must admit, you've surpassed my expectations mortal." Beerus said as he and Alex approached each other once again, to which Alex remarked,
"Well with what I went through to learn this technique I better." As he said that Alex glanced down at his black lightning clad hands, reminiscing on all the battles he had to go through with Elaine before he touched upon actually using Conquerer's Haki to fight directly, instead of just as a form of suppression.
Since he never got a chance to finish One Piece before dying, leaving off unfortunately right before the Wano arc had started, Alex didn't even know it was possible to use Haki this way. After learning this he had began to wonder what else he didn't know about the abilities he already possessed, reaffirming his earlier decision to focus on mastering his current powers over purchasing more through the store.
"That is an impressive technique, but if you think that's enough to defeat me then your grossly mistaken." Beerus said as he instantly appeared directly in front of Alex with his fist raised.
"Let's see how you deal with this!" He sneered evilly, as Alex immediately tried to block the attack with his right arm.
The moment Beerus' fist impacted him though, Alex entire right arm was completely and utterly Destroyed as he himself was sent flying back with more force than he'd sent Beerus flying with. Instantly though Beerus appeared in Alex path and punched him a second time, this time in his stomach, Destroying several of Alex's internal organs in an instant as all of his momentum was arrested.
"GAH!" Alex vomited up mouthfuls of blood as a result of the internal damage he had taken, while even more blood was flowing out into the open space from the stump where his right arm used to be.
Beerus smirked at Alex's current bloody and beaten state, asking tauntingly,
"So, how does the power of a Destroyer feel?" Contrary to expectations though, other than ejecting the blood filling his mouth and throat, Alex smirked and wiped the blood away with his left hand as he replied,
"I've suffered worse on a daily basis!" He then stunned Beerus by using Regeneration magic to instantly undo all of the damage that had been inflicted upon him, including his tattoos.
After restoring himself to peak condition, Alex then stated,
"If you're going so far, then I guess I have no choice but to get completely serious as well! BALANCE BREAK!"
Immediately, Alex was encased in red light that faded to reveal Crimson armor that now covered his entire body, except his head. Before he could begin attacking once again though, Beerus remarked with a deadpan,
"That looks so idiotic..." For a moment no one said anything, before Alex heard Ddraig roaring in his head,
<KICK HIS ASS PARTNER! SHOW HIM THE POWER OF THE WELSH DRAGON!>
Agreeing full-heartedly, with his partner, Alex stated seriously to Beerus,
"You shouldn't judge things by their outer appearances. This armor is my trump card for a reason!" As he said that Alex held up his left hand to display the jewel on top, as the Boosted Gear roared out,
<BOOST! BOOST! BOOST! BOOST! BOOST! BOOST! BOOST! BOOST! BOOST! EXPLOSION!>
Alex's power then exploded out from him as he powered up to the utmost limit he could take in this form, without compromising his tattoos. As it was, they began glowing yellow from the amount of energy currently coursing through his body, but thanks to being in his SSJ4 form they held out, and no one was able too see them at the moment.
Even Beerus and Whis looked shocked at the sudden spike in power Alex was showing, before he appeared directly in front of Beerus with such speed that space itself began to crumble around him.
<PENETRATE!>
The armor cried out right as Alex's fist impacted Beerus' body, sending the god flying as he vomited blood this time.
<PENETRATE!>
<PENETRATE!>
<PENETRATE!>
One after another Alex delivered powerful hits that damaged Beerus more than anything he had taken in millions of years, stunning the god as the unfamiliar sensation assaulted his body.
This was because of Alex repeatedly using Penetrate while attacking him, which ignored any and all forms of defense to deal the maximum amount of damage possible. Eventually though Beerus had enough and shouted while releasing as much of his power as he could,
"ENOUGH!" The shockwave from his voice alone had been enough to buffet Alex and prevent him from going through his his next attack.
Once again the duo were staring the other down, except by this point Beerus was covered in numerous shallow wounds. Alex wasn't much better though, as even if he had used Regeneration magic to heal himself he had used up tons of energy in this fight, and was unable to muster any more without compromising the tattoos on his body.
"This will be it." Beerus suddenly said, breaking the prolonged silence as he continued,
"I will draw out all of my power for this last exchange." He said while raising a finger upwards, the tip of which he began focusing all of the energy he could muster to form a ball of energy that resembled a star.
Agreeing silently with his opponent, Alex replied,
"Very well, I'll take that attack of yours and we'll see how things end up from there!" Beerus smiled widely at that, before declaring,
"Very well then! Take this, Alexander!" With his attack growing to similar proportions as a planet, Beerus then threw it at Alex with full intent behind using it to wipe him from existence.
Instead of shying away from the attack, or even using either his 'Energy Nullification' and energy absorption ability, black lightning coated Alex's entire armored right arm as he focused all of his power into it. Concentrating all of his remaining energy into Conquerer's Haki, Alex stood proudly as the dangerous attack closed in on him before swinging his fist at it.
"HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA-"
Alex shouted as his fist collided with the gigantic mass of energy, his Haki exploding outwards in a storm of black lightning from the point of contact to destroy anything that had drifted even relatively close to the battle.
For several minutes it was a case of 'unmovable object meets the unstoppable force' as Alex fought against Beerus' attack, using every single drop of his strength to fight against it as he desperately pushed back. Meanwhile Beerus was on the other side pushing his attack as much as he could so that it would consume and Destroy Alex.
For a moment the duo were locked in what appeared to be an unmovable stalemate, until,
*CRACK...*
Bolts of black lightning began expanding across the planet sized attack, fracturing it bit by bit until,
*KABOOOOOOOOOOM!*
Beerus' sun-like ball of energy exploded to send its energy throughout the universe in waves, which were mostly harmless compared to its previously disastrous form.
"Well well, this is a surprise..." Whis said as he witnessed the outcome of the clash, in which Alex stood tall and proud, though the armor on his right arm had been destroyed while the flesh beneath was charred black.
*clap clap clap*
The sound of clapping broke the silence as Beerus slowly approached Alex with a broad smile on his face, despite the circumstances.
"That was, without a doubt, the most fun I've had in eons! I thank you Alexander!" Dispelling both the Boosted Gear and his God form, while also healing his arm, Alex replied with his own smile,
"I should be thanking you, you're not the only one who's been looking for a good opponent for a while!" As his arm finished healing, Alex and Beerus grasped each other's forearms like brothers as they shook to the marvelous battle they just fought.
With everything calming down, Whis approached the duo and coughed lightly to get their attention,
"Ehem! I'd hate to interrupt, but I feel I must point out to Lord Beerus that we are currently homeless." Blinking in surprise, Beerus looked down to see that their battle had completely destroyed his planet to the point that it was just a few bits of rubble floating through space.
Before he could, blow his top about it though, Alex quickly said,
"It's ok. Elaine can fix it up immediately, and then we can sit down for some food." His ears twitching at the word 'food', Beerus quickly said,
"You better have brought something good for me to eat after destroying my home like this! Or I might just have to return the favor Alexander!" Waving away Beerus' threats, Alex quickly said,
"It's no problem, and you can just call me Alex." Even as they were talking, Elaine was already moving as she swiftly restored the planet to its previous state, as if nothing had ever happened to it.
...
"So what did you come here for anyways?" Beerus skillfully asked through a mouthful of food as they began to stuff their faces.
Though Whis and the Oracle Fish were both elegantly snacking on the food that survived the battle, both Alex and Beerus had their own mountain of food in front of them as they both eagerly stuffed their faces. Elaine naturally stood behind Alex as his dutiful maid, showing just how well Grayfia's teachings had been instilled into her.
Unlike the god though, Alex swallowed his latest bite of food before answering,
"There's something things we need to talk about so you're up to speed with everything that's been going on, including the tournament that's going to be taking place in six months." That caught Beerus' attention as his ears twitched once again, and he asked,
"Tournament?" Alex nodded and was about to go into further detail, but before he could a new voice supplied,
"It's something the Dragon Emperor came up with for the people throughout the universe to display their strength, showing everyone else what they are capable of doing." Everyone turned to look at the newcomer, a portly man with pink skin, pointed ears, and a kind expression on his face.
Beerus' eyes widened slightly in surprise and recognition, before he asked,
"The Grand Supreme Kai? Weren't you eaten by Majin Buu five millions years ago or something?" In response to Beerus' inquiry, the Grand Supreme Kai could only chuckle wryly before answering,
"Yes, I was. However the kind Dragon Emperor here saved me and my fellow Kai from that horrible fate, while also granting us new bodies. Though we're not too sure how to feel about them being made of Majin Buu's flesh." As he said that the Grand Supreme Kai demonstrated by pulling his entire arm off his body, showing them how he was now made of the same amorphous substance that Majin Buu was.
In between bites Alex quickly explained,
"It was nothing. I just immobilized Majin Buu while on the planet of the Kai, then used his own body to create 'clones' in the forms of the Grand Supreme Kai, the Southern Kai, the Northern Kai, and the Western Kai. After that I pulled their remaining spirits, which had been trapped within Majin Buu after he ate them, out, and placed them within their new bodies before killing him." (A.N. Before people look it up on the wiki and throw a fit, I'm doing it where Buu ate all three of the other Kai aside from Shin in order to prepare to fight the Grand Supreme Kai)
Though Alex acted as if he hadn't done anything worth mentioning, both Beerus and the Grand Supreme Kai gave him incredulous looks. Meanwhile Whis chuckled as he said,
"Ohohoho! I was going to ask how you'd like to take Lord Beerus' position as this universes God of Destruction, but it appears as if you'd be more suited for a different role with your skills." Though his remark earned Whis a glare from Beerus, Alex just shrugged before saying,
"Not necessarily, I understand the importance of a Destroyer needing to make room for new growth. However I'd have to decline on the grounds that such a position is too low for me." Not just Beerus, but the Grand Supreme Kai and even Whis blinked slowly in surprise from his comment before the former asked,
"The position of the God of Destruction, the most powerful being in their respective universe(A.N. Aides like Whis don't count), is 'too low'?" When Alex just nodded slowly without answering due to a full mouth, Beerus mockingly asked,
"What position would you settle for, the Omni King?" Though he wasn't being at all serious, Whis still gave Beerus a pointed stare at such a careless thing to ask. However they were even more shocked when Elaine this time stated matter-of-factly,
"Even that position is too low for Alex's ambitions." Dead silence answered her words due to the sheer shock the trio felt, as each of them gave Alex very different looks.
Such words would normally be completely discarded as utter nonsense, but with the skills Alex displayed along with his strength, the three of them couldn't help but to be worried about the future peace of the Seventh Universe. At that point though, having finally swallowed the food in his mouth, Alex said himself,
"I wouldn't worry too much about that. After all, it's not like I can even do anything with the Omni King at the moment, and even if I could I wouldn't necessarily want to." As he then went back to eating after saying his piece, Elaine asked him,
"But what about Ophis? If you needed to she would be a match for the Omni King." Alex nodded slowly at Elaine's suggestion, and replied when he was able,
"True, but I promised Ophis that I wouldn't make her fight or use her. Having her be the Guardian Deity of Asora is one thing, but sicking her on the Omni King like a hunting dog is something I would never do." Throughout Alex and Elaine's conversation the trio of beings before them only gaped at the thought of a being equal in power to the Omni King, the pinnacle existence that was capable of 'erasing' entire universes with a mere thought.
"If you don't mind my asking..." The Grand Supreme Kai spoke up hesitantly, drawing both Alex and Elaine's attention before he continued,
"Who exactly is this 'Ophis' that you've been referring too?" Without a single care Alex immediately replied,
"The Dragon God of Infinity, who possesses infinite strength, power, and existence." (A.N. In case any of you forgot I mentioned before that Ophis was originally a being on the level of the Omni King, she just never had a reason to use that much power and was unintentionally nerfing herself until Paul broke into Asora)
Naturally, hearing that Alex had a being that actually represented the concept of 'Infinity' in his pocket was a bit too much for the trio. Even Whis was dramatically affected by this info as he debated on wether or not he should alert his father, the Grand Minister who directly served as the Omni King's attendant, and was one of the most powerful beings in the multiverse after the Omni King.
Before he could reach a conclusion though, a voice suddenly said within Whis' head,
'Do anything to compromise us, and I'll personally erase you from existence myself.'
Just barely suppressing the urge to jump in alarm, Whis subtly glanced in Elaine's direction to find her watching over Alex's pig-out session. However he couldn't shake the feeling that all of her attention was on him, reading even his thoughts and intentions.
Though he had never feared the thought of erasure before, Elaine's threat was something completely new to him making Whis increasingly both cautious, and fascinated by her. That was why, after a moment of thought, he mentally replied,
'Very well, I won't say anything to my father.' Though she gave no physical indication that she heard him, Elaine voice echoed within Whis' mind once again as she said,
'Good. Behave and I'll make sure neither the Omni King or your father hold you accountable for keeping us a secret.' And with that Elaine's presence completely left Whis' mind, leaving him with even more questions than before regarding who, and what, she was.
However it appeared that would be all that he'd gleam about for the moment, as Elaine continued watching over Alex while he ate, and the Grand Supreme Kai filled Beerus in on the last few days, and Alex's plans that he knew about for the future of their universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 451 - 451: A Gift
chapters.content:
While Alex was busy with Beerus, back in the Misty Manor Videl was still trying to adjust to the sudden changes around her.
After crying for nearly an hour in Hestia's arms, Videl was now somewhat calm as she slowly sipped on the second cup of tea Hestia had given her. Though she still gave the occasional sniffle.
"Feeling a bit better?" Hestia asked after a little while, to which Videl slowly shook her head.
Not expecting anything different, Hestia nodded and continued,
"Well that's to be expected. But maybe you'll feel a bit better if you had some friends to help you out, and I know some kids who are dying to meet you." Videl looked up at that, only to see the door burst open suddenly as a horde of children rushed into the room.
"""Miss Hestia! Miss Hestia!""" The children called out excitedly as they flocked around both Hestia and Videl, confusing the girl until the oldest of the bunch, another girl that appeared to be around the same age as her with emerald green hair, said to her with an outstretched hand,
"You must be Videl, I'm Myuu." Not knowing what else to do in this situation, Videl cautiously accepted Myuu's handshake while muttering,
"Nice to meet you....." In the face of her awkwardness though, Myuu didn't miss a beat as she promptly sat right next to Videl and said,
"It'll be nice having someone else the same age as me around, I hope we can be friends!" In the face of Myuu's earnest behavior and desire to be friends, Videl didn't quite know what to say at first, even before she caught sight of the former's lightly webbed fingers and finned ears.
"What are you?" Videl suddenly found herself blurting out, her curiosity overriding her caution. Thankfully though Myuu didn't seem to take offense to the question, as she had already learned from her papa's wives that there were a LOT of people who didn't know about her species.
"I'm a Dagon! The rest of the people like me live next to the ocean, but mama and I live here with papa!" As Myuu mentioned her papa, Videl noticed that the rest of the children who had barged into the room, who were now surrounding Hestia and begging her for a story, all had monkey-like tails. Clenching her fists tightly, Videl asked in a small voice,
"By 'papa', do you mean him?" For a moment Myuu didn't say anything as she watched Videl's face, as if she was scrutinizing her before answering.
As the oldest and closest in age to Videl, Myuu was the only one amongst Alex's children that knew the truth about the link between the two, that her papa had accidentally killed Videl's father. She didn't blame him though of course, as in Myuu's eyes her papa was always right in everything he did, even if he made a mistake.
Though she hadn't been willing to socialize with Videl at first when her mama warned her that she was likely to hate her papa, Remia had explained it to Myuu by telling her imagine if someone took her papa away from her as well. She then asked her how she would feel towards such a person.
So, despite the look on Videl's face as she asked about Alex, Myuu tried not to let it get to her as he replied,
"Yep! My papa is the Dragon Emperor! Not by blood though!" That made Videl look at her in confusion, prompting Myuu to hop off of the couch and point her butt towards her, displaying her lack of tail.
"Papa saved me from some bad men when I was little, and my real papa died before I was born, so I decided to adopt papa as my papa!" Remembering the day she first met her papa, Myuu was smiling widely despite the horrible things she went through before Alex and Shia found her in the sewers.
Videl was watching this as Myuu sat back down next to her, before a horrible thought suddenly occurred to her.
"Will he....try to make me call him papa too?" Not just Myuu, but Hestia and several of the children looked up at Videl's question. Myuu however quickly said,
"No no, papa wouldn't do that. He did tell me that he intends to teach you how to fight and get stronger. But don't worry, I'll help you when we start training!"
Recalling how Alex seemed to be trying to 'teach' her when they met before, Videl felt a little bit of relief that he probably wouldn't try to make her into his daughter. But when she thought of being taught to fight from him, Videl frowned as she said,
"But I want to learn actual martial arts, not the stupid tricks fake people like him use!" Myuu cocked her head to the side at that, and uttered confusedly in response,
"'Tricks'?" Videl nodded and explained,
"Yeah, tricks! My dad told me when we watched old videos of the martial arts tournaments together, the people that won before he fought used stupid tricks to distract everyone from how bad they were at martial arts! And that they all quit before he competed because they were scared of him!"
Though Videl was like the exact opposite of how she was a moment ago, Myuu genuinely didn't know what to say as she began talking about 'tricks'.
"What do you mean by 'tricks' though?" She asked curiously, to which Videl explained,
"I mean things like flying or shooting lights from your hands! Those are all impossible for people to do, so they must be tricks with wires and stuff! My dad told me about it before!" Saying so matter-of-factly, Videl huffed as if that was that, leaving Myuu at a momentary loss for words before he said with a flat voice,
"You mean like this?" She then produced a sphere of energy in the palm of her hand, stupefying Videl as she saw it firsthand.
"Yes! Those are just tricks!" She stated firmly, stubbornly refusing to believe that people could do such things.
At a momentary loss of words, Myuu wondered how she could convince Videl that it WASN'T a trick. She then leapt to her feet energetically, before saying to the rest of the kids,
"Hey! Let's go play in the backyard for a while!" Though her suggestion was met with numerous whines and complaints from the rest of the children, since they were in the middle of one of Hestia's stories, the goddess herself clapped her hands lightly and said,
"That sounds like a great idea! You can all show Videl around the manor and tell her about your favorite places to play!" With Hestia saying so, the children quickly filed out of the room as Edith and Mai both seized one of Videl's hands apiece to drag her along.
Though she was surprised at the sudden turn of events, that was only the start of the numerous surprises she was going to get.
***
Back on Beerus' planet, Alex had just finished putting away the entire mountain of food when he received a message from Kuroka.
While he had been eating, the Grand Supreme Kai had been telling Beerus the specifics regarding the tournament, as well as the reason Alex was having it to begin with.
"So you're telling me, that our universe is one of the lowest in terms of average strength, and that means the Omni King would most likely Destroy us in a little over ten years along with the rest of universes that aren't in the top four?"
"Yep, that's right!" Alex declared as he stood, drawing Beerus' attention back to him as he snarled,
"That's not even remotely funny." Alex however answered with a serious expression,
"I'm not trying to be. You can feel free to check with him yourself, but IF I'm right then you could just hasten the end of your universe." When he heard that Beerus' entire body twitched just from the idea of going before the Omni King, before Alex continued,
"Or, you can go along with my plan and try to raise your rating before then. It's not a bad idea with all the threats that seem to pop up in this universe." Though he clicked his tongue, Beerus didn't say anything due to the fact that Alex did have a point.
In fact, he could even acknowledge that they WERE a low ranking universe compared to the other eleven, primarily due to how many threats that always seemed to pop up. Freiza's entire family line for one, who could never train a single day in their life and still grow up to possess the strength to rule over entire sectors of the universe with an iron fist. Then there was Majin Buu, who was so powerful that he was even able to defeat, and then consume, the Grand Supreme Kai.
With other names such as Moro and the newbie Cell popping up in his mind, Beerus couldn't help but to mutter,
"Come to think of it, I'm actually amazed that we still have a universe to begin with with all these people constantly appearing..." Nodding in agreement, Alex stated,
"That's why I'm trying to help the people of this universe get stronger, so that they could be able to stand up to such beings themselves if needed. As things currently stand, there would only ever be two people who would be able to stand up to such threats, which would mean the universe wouldn't be that safe once they eventually died."
Unfortunately Beerus had no choice but to agree with Alex's words and actions, as if these beings continued appearing and destroying more and more planets without leaving room for growth, then he would be out of the job. And if that happened, then he himself could very well be the next one erased by the Omni King due to him no longer being needed.
However, there was one thing he didn't understand.
"Why bother me? I'm a Destroyer, I wipe out civilizations and eliminate planets, I don't help them grow." Nodding slowly in agreement, Alex then said,
"True, but I'm not expecting you to help them grow. All I want from you is to be a bit more mindful of WHICH planets you Destroy, and to show up to watch the tournament in six months. Basically, putting the 'fear of God' into people." Blinking a few times in surprise, Beerus smiled evilly as he commented,
"Now that, I can do!"
"Then we have an agreement!" Alex said happily, before continuing,
"Just as well though, I need to go now since my 'Queen' has finished collecting something I asked her to find for me." Sensing something in Alex's voice, Beerus asked,
"Oh? And what is it that this queen of yours found that could be so important?" Alex smirked as he replied,
"Instead of telling you, would you like to see for yourself?"
...
With his business with Beerus finished for the moment, Alex returned to Capsule Corp on Earth while Elaine returned to Asora. There, he entered the main workshop where Bulma and her father worked on their inventions, except he found two Bulmas covered in grease as they worked together on a new invention.
Shortly after Alex left the group to go to the planet of the Kai's the other day, future Trunks had returned in a remodeled time machine that was now also big enough to allow two other people to travel with him, his mother and Mai. He had of course defeated the version of androids 17 and 18 that had been the original reason he traveled back to begin with, before going on to destroy the larval stage Cell that still existed in hiding in that timeline.
Now Trunks and the other two had officially moved into their time in order to escape the future potential threats Alex warned him about, something that left a bitter taste in all three's mouths. Though apparently they only came back since Bulma theorized that, if they weren't around, then maybe the remaining people of that Earth would be able to rebuild their lives in peace.
""Hey!"" Alex suddenly looked up as both Bulmas reached a stopping point, and noticed he was there.
Though there had been a little bit of drama when they first met due to one being roughly twenty years older than the other and so on, Alex had settled the drama by using Regeneration magic on both of them until they were the same exact age, in their lowers twenties. Now the only difference between the two was that the Bulma from the future had decided to dye blond highlights into her light blue hair, which made her match more with her mom and older sister.
Waving his hand at them, Alex returned their greeting before asking,
"So what are you guys working on there?" As if they were completely in sync with one another, both Bulmas proudly puffed out their chests and declared,
""This is our latest invention, the space-time room!"" Though they both acted proud of their latest invention, Alex just deadpanned at them as he retorted,
"Isn't that just a rehash of the space-time orbs that we made with magic?" This time both Bulmas deadpanned at him, before the one from the present stated,
"So what if it is? Us 'mere mortals' can't use your fancy magic, so I'll one up you by recreating your stuff without any magic whatsoever!" Bulma then thrust her chin up as if she were proud of what she said, until Alex tossed her something.
"What's this?" She asked while scrutinizing the thing.
"It's a drive containing numerous blueprints of machines that Lala created. She doesn't care about things like wealth, recognition, or patents, and made every single one of her designs public knowledge in Asora. There should already be a design in there that will turn any closed space, like a closet, into an area that can be expanded and customized however you want. The most recent ones even allow for time manipulation within, and all without magic."
When Alex finished speaking Bulma slumped to her knees and muttered with empty eyes,
"I give up...Lala is too ridiculous....." Seeing her past self's depressed state, future Bulma couldn't help but to ask incredulously,
"Is Lala really that good?" Having never met her before, the future Bulma had a hard time imagining someone as ridiculous as her past self described. Alex however nodded as he said,
"Give her an hour, and Lala will probably give you a time machine she made out of spare parts, or something equally extreme. The only problem is that her inventions have the unfortunate habit of.....malfunctioning in somewhat ridiculous ways." As he trailed off a faraway look appeared in Alex's eyes as he recalled all the various, and perverted, misadventures he'd gone through because of Lala's inventions.
After reminiscing for a moment, Alex cleared his throat before continuing,
"Ehem. Anyways, you'll get a chance to meet her soon anyways since I already asked her and the rest of my peerage to come meet me here. Think you can get everyone on this side together for a bit Bulma? There's something I want to show you all." Recovering somewhat from her slump, Bulma stood and cleared her throat this time before saying,
"Yeah, I'll send out the message. No guarantees they'll show up though since some of the guys are probably busy training after seeing the difference between you and them."
Bulma then went and used a handheld communicator to send a message to everyone, as the technology in this world was still equivalent to the eighties and early nineties of Japan, before saying to Alex,
"Ok, they should be here within the hour. And while we wait for them to arrive the two of us can go shower to wash all this grease off." The words were barely out of Bulma's mouth when Alex asked her with raised eyebrows,
"You know, I worked up quite the sweat earlier myself. Mind if I join you ladies?" Though future Bulma appeared interested, present Bulma immediately shouted,
