"No! Not gonna happen buddy! We're not the type of bimbos you can trick into joining your collection of sex toys!" She then seized future Bulma's hand and started dragging her away so they could shower together, which made her seem disappointed.
Alex then listened through his 'Domain' as the two women began discussing his request to join them in private. Future Bulma wanted to know why present Bulma refused his advance, especially since Alex was exceptionally powerful, both politically and physically, handsome, wealthy, and overall better than Vegeta Jr in every way, especially with his recent attitude.
Interrupting his snooping though, a group of five people materialized out of nowhere outside of Capsule Corp, Bardock, Gine, Raditz, Chichi, and Goku. Though he was tempted to continue snooping on the two Bulmas, and maybe even play a prank on them, Alex ultimately decided to let them wash up in peace as he went out to greet Goku and the others.
"Hey there-" Alex began once he saw them, before Chichi suddenly launched herself through the air while directing a kick at his face.
"Give me back my son you kidnapper!" She shouted with fury, even as Alex smoothly dodged her kick and acted as if nothing happened.
"So anyways-" He began a second time, only for Chichi to shout while swinging around for another kick,
"Don't ignore me!" Shaking his head in exasperation, Alex gently caught Chichi's attack this time before saying to her,
"Chichi, I did not kidnap Gohan, and neither did Sona. He CHOSE to attend the Academy in order to go to school like a normal kid, and interact with other kids his age." Despite Alex telling her the truth of the matter, which everyone else knew, Chichi refused to accept it and whimpered desperately as she collapsed to the ground disheartedly,
"My poor baby....all alone and confused....crying for his mommy....." In the face of her crocodile tears, Alex just sighed before conjuring a projection from the few times he'd checked in on Gohan, and said,
"He's actually doing pretty good over there. Gohan and Brunch both already made quite a few friends, he's made himself known for his strength, AND he's already impressed the majority of his teachers with how smart he is." As he spoke Alex showed the group images of Gohan happily chatting with other kids his age, admiring the sights of Asora as Millicas showed him and Brunch around, and otherwise enjoying themselves in their newfound school life.
"WAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!"
Rather than being assured though, Chichi wailed as tears streamed down her face, and she cried out,
"I-I-I KNEW IT! GOHAN ISN'T STUDYING AT ALL! HIS ENTIRE FUTURE IS GOING TO BE RUINED!"
Everyone around Chichi gaped at her in amazement from the fact that, even though Gohan looked to be perfectly happy, healthy, and active, all she cared about was that he wasn't stuck behind a book 24-7.
Shaking his head at her, Alex decided to bring out his secret weapon to pacify Chichi. First using magic for confirmation, Alex then said,
"You know, I doubt all this stress and worrying will be good for the baby." Though it took her a moment, once Alex's words sunk in Chichi looked up at him and asked,
"What baby?" Alex pretended to be confused as he asked her in return,
"You didn't know you're pregnant?"
"..."
For a moment no one said anything, before Chichi suddenly leapt up and declared,
"Hospital! I have to get to a hospital!" Though she was rushing to confirm if what Alex said was true, Gine took Chichi's hands in her own and excitedly declared,
"How wonderful! And this time Bardock and I will be around to watch him/her grow up!" Even as she said that, Gine paused before awkwardly asking,
"Oh yeah, where do you get your incubators here on Earth?" Goku and Chichi both looked at Gine in confusion, and asked in unison,
""Incubators?"" This time gone looked confused as she replied,
"Yeah? The pods that you put a newborn in for the first few years of their life." Chichi stared at gone and Bardock in dumbfoundment before she exclaimed,
"You mean Saiyans leave their children in pods for the first few years after they're born!!!?" As the group learned more about the difference between Saiyan and earthling child rearing, Alex decided to slip away silently as he sensed a new group of people approaching.
This time it was the Vegeta family, consisting of Sr, Jr, and future Trunks. Compared to Goku and his family, who had spent the last few days getting to know each other, the Vegetas and Trunks had of course jumped right into training. While both his father and son were working on catching up to him and Goku, Vegeta Jr specifically had been desperately trying to ascend to the SSJ2 to close the gap between himself and Alex.
His efforts so far were in vain though apparently, as the moment he touched down Vegeta took on look at Alex, and stormed off angrily.
"Forgive him your majesty. My son is just having a hard time adjusting to all of this." Vegeta Sr. said as he kneeled before Alex. A melancholic look appeared on his face though, as he added, "I suppose it's mostly my fault for not setting a good example of what a king is."
Alex nodded slowly in agreement as he replied,
"I'd say it's the opposite of the 'don't meet your hero' situation." Vegeta Sr voiced his agreement on the matter since it was almost exactly like that.
Ever since the day Planet Vegeta was destroyed by Freiza, one of the few remaining Saiyans, prince Vegeta, had continued living his life as if he were the ideal of the Saiyan race.
He was brutal, destructive, merciless, and most of all, cruel.
Any who crossed him or even slightly inconvenienced him were killed, while even if the few remaining members of his race died, he scorned them for their weakness.
Even when he learned the truth of his people's destruction, that his planet was destroyed by Freiza and not an asteroid, Vegeta didn't care and initially blamed his own people for their weakness that led to their slaughter. Though he did seem to care about it later, his biggest issue had always been Frieza using him like a puppet afterwards.
His attitude was entirely opposite one of a king, where one needed to be ruthless and powerful, as well as both wise and compassionate.
Even his father, who had been known for his cruelty and ruthlessness, had a hidden compassionate side. If the Saiyans hadn't been wiped out then Vegeta would have most likely learned of this and become wiser and more kind, but instead he had been raised within the ranks of the Frieza army where they encouraged only cruelty and ruthlessness.
While Alex knew Vegeta would mellow out eventually, it would take over seven years from their current point in time, and that was if everything went as it did in the original story. So, he could only hope that having his father and future Trunks present would help speed the process along.
Alex then spent the remainder of their time waiting chatting with the other Saiyans, trading stories of different battles they'd fought, while everyone else slowly but surely arrived.
First was Master Roshi, who arrived via helicopter that was filled with a gaggle of girls that he had picked up with his newfound youth. Then was Yamcha, who had also just arrived from a nearby date with one of his many girlfriends alongside Puar. After him was Krillin, Piccolo, and then finally Tien with Chiaotzu and Launch, who had a much different attitude regarding her daughter attending the Academy, and was pleased to see how well she and Goan were fitting in.
Last to arrive was Grant, who had gone to seclude himself to do a bit of soul searching after meeting Alex, as the Bulmas finally finished cleaning up and getting dressed. As he approached them Grant looked to Alex and said,
"Alex, can we talk for a minute?" Curious, Alex followed Grant a short ways away from everyone until they were out of earshot, to which the other reincarnator asked him,
"How do you do it?" Cocking his head to the side in confusion, Alex asked him back,
"Do what?" For a moment Grant didn't say anything, before clarifying,
"How are you able to do the things you do so easily? You change the way things are supposed to be without hesitation, and you'll go into battle without worrying if you'll die or not. Also we're the same age, but you've already ascended to the SSJ4 and are more powerful than I could probably ever be. Not to mention that you're an actual Emperor who rules over even gods. How?"
As Grant asked him that, Alex didn't immediately answer him.
Though they hadn't spent much time talking the last few days, what little time they did talk had given Alex quite a bit of insight into Grant himself. The guy was only ten when he had been reincarnated, much too young to have been corrupted by the dark aspects of the human psyche.
Instead he, a literal child, had been thrown into the dream-like situation of being able to live and fight alongside his favorite characters and heroes, while Alex and the others had focused on either gathering power, or living their new lives. With how dangerous this universe was though, with beings like Frieza and Cell appearing every few years, it was understandable that Grant had developed a hesitation towards fighting due to not wanting to die against them, and not being able to come back through the Dragon Balls like the others.
Thinking for over a minute on how to respond, Alex finally asked Grant in return,
"Grant, what do you have here?" The other Saiyan cocked his this time in confusion, before asking,
"What do you mean?" Smiling wryly, Alex surprised him by saying,
"For the first part of my life I was a lot like you, wanting to follow the 'story' and use certain events to my advantage. My goal however, was to create a harem with all of the beautiful and amazing women that existed out there in the multiverse." When he heard that Grant's face turned red from embarrassment at the idea of a harem, but Alex continued,
"However as time went on I realized I couldn't keep doing things like that forever. Merely my existence itself would cause problems regardless of how much I tried to hide, and there became things I wanted to protect no matter what." As he said that Alex produced a wallet fold stack of pictures that showed every single one of his children and wives in it.
As Grant realized just how big Alex's family was, he continued,
"My choices now are either to continue charging forward to get ahead, and get enough strength to overturn anything that dares to stand in my way, or to risk losing it all because I hesitated for a single moment.
"I want to ensure that no matter what happens in the future, I regret none of it. I may spend a lot of my time training my ass off(though not so much recently), but I also make sure to spend as much time as possible caring for my children, making love to my wives, and interacting with my people.
"Truthfully, though I say I'm aiming to win in this competition between us reincarnators, I haven't thought too much about the actual endgame. I just focus on enjoying my second life to the fullest, and working to be better than everyone else."
As Alex finished speaking, Grant felt like he began to understand the difference between them a bit better.
Alex had always been charging forward, working to better himself and those around him while refusing to bow down due to not wanting to lose the people he had gained. He on the other hand, had always remained passive. Grant was more than eager to train with Goku and the others, but he rarely ever put his strength to the test and fought himself, not wanting to risk his life since he knew that they'd always be able to bring back anyone they might lose with the Dragon Balls.
"I think I understand a bit..." Grant eventually said, to which Alex nodded in approval. In his eyes, Grant was almost like a little brother that needed some guidance, but was unable to get it due to their unique circumstances, similarly to how Beth had never been able to get over the trauma of her death.
What surprised Alex though, was when Grant then pulled something out of his travel pack, a purple fruit with swirled markings all over it that didn't look like any other fruit one would find. Alex however recognized what it was the second he saw it.
"A Devil Fruit?" He asked curiously, to which Grant nodded before confirming,
"Yes, the Gomu-Gomu no Mi to be exact." Alex's brows shot up when he heard that, as he hadn't known Grant got the same Devil Fruit that Luffy used in One Piece. He then continued though,
"I've had this fruit on me ever since I turned five. Ever since then I hesitated on eating it because I didn't want to lose my ability to swim, instead swearing that I'd wait until the day we needed its ability." Grant then surprised Alex even more as he held it out to him and said with resolution in his voice,
"I want to give it to you. Use it yourself, or give it to someone else, it's your choice Alex. I've been hesitating so much, I'll give up on it." Instead of taking the fruit though, Alex instead asked him,
"Are you sure Grant? If it's been about losing your ability to swim, couldn't you have just used the Dragon Balls to wish for that back?" Grant's eyes widened when he heard that, as he asked out loud,
"Wait, I could have done that!?!" Alex place palmed at him when he heard that, reaffirming his decision to discuss with the Dragon team their inability to use the Dragon Balls properly, instead of just using them to fix their mistakes afterwards.
Though shocked by this sudden revelation, Grant shook his head and stated,
"It doesn't matter though, I already decided to give the fruit to you Alex. And I'll be fine without it anyways, I'll just have to work harder to become a stronger Saiyan, plus I have my Zanpakutō." As he said that, Grant patted the handle of the massive great sword that was strapped to his back.
Shaking his head at him as he did so, Alex finally said,
"Alright, I'll find someone who'll want to eat a Devil Fruit, even if it is the Gomu-Gomu no Mi." As he said that, Alex accepted the fruit from Grant's outstretched hand. However, the moment the fruit came into contact with him, Alex felt an unusual feeling come over him, while a sound like drums began to echo in his head.
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶*

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - 452: The Rubber Saiyan
chapters.content:
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶*
With each passing second that he held onto the Devil Fruit the drums got louder and louder within Alex's mind, while his gaze was completely transfixed on the fruit itself, like he was in a type of trance.
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶*
Alex didn't even hear Grant asking him if he was ok as the volume of the drums seemed to increase, instead, the next thing Alex knew his mouth was filled with a disgusting taste as juice flowed down his throat.
"Oh my god that's awful!" Alex cried out, drawing everyone else's attention as the piece of fruit he'd bit slid down his throat.
"What is it?" Present Bulma asked as she approached Alex and Grant, to which the former answered while fighting back the urge to gag,
"Nothing, I just ate something that tasted disgusting." Goku took one look at the Devil fruit in his hand and said,
"Well yeah, that thing looks rotten." Alex smiled wryly at the comment, and explained,
"It's not rotten, it's called a Devil's Fruit. Eating one with grant you incredible powers, but they taste incredibly nasty and will take away your ability to swim." As he said that Alex looked at the remaining fruit in his hand, wondering what it had been that drove him to eat the damn thing.
Alex had long since decided that IF he ate a Devil Fruit it would be a significantly powerful one, and while the Gomu-Gomu fruit could be powerful, it wasn't in the way Alex wanted. However what happened next caused Alex's brain to stall as he received a notification.
[NOTICE! The ability Gomu-Gomu no Mi(Hito-Hito no Mi: model Nika) has been acquired! The title 'Joyboy' has been acquired!]
For a moment Alex tried to process what he looking at, as he never heard anything about the rubber fruit having two names, until Lauren said to him,
'That's the actual name of the Gomu-Gomu fruit, before the world government changed it in order to hide its true purpose. Rather than a simple Paramecia(ability) type, it was actually a mythical Zoan(transformation) type that allows the user to turn into the Sun God Nika if they awaken. It was also the fruit that had been eaten by Joyboy eight hundred years before One Piece actually began.'
"Huh...how about that." Alex said out loud as he learned he hadn't eaten just any old Devil Fruit, but a god one.
"How about what?" Goku asked while Grant also looked at Alex funny since he hadn't expected him to just straight up and eat it then and there. Rather than explain everything he just learned though, Alex looked at Goku and said,
"This." He then raised his arm, drawing everyone's attention to it, and pulled on it so that it bent unnaturally, like it was made of rubber. He then released the hold on his arm, allowing it to spring back into place like a rubber band.
Smirking at the dumbstruck looks he was getting, Alex explained,
"The fruit I ate gives the person who ate it a rubber body." As he explained it to them began experimenting a little bit with his newfound rubber body, bending and stretching it in various ways. Needless to say the looks he got from the others were quite interesting.
There was one person in particular who wasn't at all amused though, as Vegeta Jr. angrily demanded,
"Where is your pride as a Saiyan?!?" Everyone looked at Vegeta with confusion, only to see that his father, Bardock, and Raditz were also giving Alex strange looks.
"Saiyans don't need stupid tricks! Any that are willing to use such things, have no right to refer to themselves as a Saiyan!" With the other three nodding in agreement, Alex just shook his head before asking Vegeta,
"Weren't you the one who was going to wish on the Dragon Balls for immortality because you were too weak to take over Frieza's empire otherwise?" Immediately Vegeta's expression cramped as he awkwardly sputtered,
"W-well, t-that then and this is now!" Smirking now, Alex then asked,
"And when it comes to 'Saiyan pride', weren't you the one who cried like a bitch and threw a temper tantrum because you wanted to become a Super Saiyan?"
"I DID NOT CRY!" Vegeta roared at the numerous looks he was suddenly receiving from those around them. However Alex then produced an image with Regeneration magic that showed Vegeta on the ground, tears streaming down his face while he repeatedly slammed his fists into the dirt.
For a moment no one said anything as they gaped at the image, until Vegeta's father uttered,
"Son..." Vegeta however held up a single finger to silence him, and spat out,
"Not one word.....from any of you!" Though many of them wanted to laugh at Vegeta's misfortune, none of the people gathered were dumb enough to anger a Super Saiyan, especially one as volatile as Vegeta... Well, there was one person aside from Alex.
"Wow Vegeta! I didn't realize you could cry like that!" Goku exclaimed without bothering to read the room, making Vegeta's entire face turn purple in rage as he silently raised his hand and started gathering energy.
Before he could unleash said energy though, Alex's arm extended in an instant to sink his fist into Vegeta's gut, knocking the wind out of him while Alex also forcibly dispersed the energy he gathered. He then look at his arm as it returned to its original state, and said,
"Neat. But it'll take some getting used to. I wonder what my wives will think though...." Just as Alex began thinking about what he'd say to them, a voice asked,
"What we'll think about what?" Everyone looked to see the girls in Alex's peerage, minus Kuroka and Kurumu, appear from a wall of mist as they arrived from Asora. Without hesitating though, Alex simply said,
"I ate a Devil Fruit." Needless to say they were more than a little surprised, as Alex had already made it clear that he wouldn't eat a Devil Fruit unless it was an exceptionally powerful one.
"What kind of fruit did you eat?" Rias asked, but before saying anything, Alex one again bent his arm unnaturally and said,
"A fruit that turned me into a rubber man." If they were shocked before, the girls were downright dumbfounded when they heard that and saw the way Alex's body now moved.
"So...." Shia eventually began. "Instead of a fruit that made you something like lava, you chose to eat one that made you rubber?" Alex could only smile wryly at her question, and replied,
"Well, it's more like it chose me." The girls looked even more confused when they heard that, while for Alex it was the only explanation he could think of since he recalled that supposedly Zoan type Devil Fruits had a will of their. And apparently, according to Lauren, the Gomu-Gomu no Mi was actually a Zoan fruit.
"Well-" Grayfia began with tones of irritation in her voice. "-at least we're in the world where you can wish to regain your ability to swim." Alex laughed awkwardly at Grayfia's biting remark, before adding,
"Yep, that's the second wish I need to make now." That got everyone else's attention as Bulma asked him,
"Oh? Is that why you called us here? Because you want to use the Dragon Balls?" When Alex nodded for confirmation everyone appeared more than a little annoyed that they had been called for such a 'small' thing, before Krillin even commented,
"You can't though. The Earth Dragon Balls are on a cool down for the next six months after we used them to bring back everyone Cell killed. Unless you plan to go to Namek." Alex however shook his head before saying,
"I know I can't use the Earth Dragon Balls, and I'm not planning to go to Namek... Well I wasn't, but I probably will after this to regain my ability to swim." THAT got everyone's attention, as Bulma excitedly asked,
"So are you saying that there's more sets of Dragon Balls out there!?" Alex nodded as he said,
"Yep, but before I start explaining about that, there's something I need to talk to you all about." Alex then adopted a serious expression as he told the group,
"The way you all use the Dragon Balls needs to change."
Naturally they were all more than a little confused at what Alex meant, and Yamcha asked him,
"What do you mean?" Alex looked at every single person before him in the eyes, and said,
"The Dragon Balls are essentially your most powerful tool to grow stronger or prepare for any threat the planet might face. And yet all any of you seem content on doing is using them AFTER a fight to wish people back from the dead, and otherwise undo the damages you've caused with your negligence."
Though several of them tried to protest Alex's claims, it was Vegeta who snorted and spat at him,
"Not everyone is as gutless as you! We don't need to wish for power!" This time Vegeta had several others on his side since they too were against wishing for power instead of working for it. Alex however deadpanned at them before saying in a mocking tone,
"Oh powerful Shenron! I wish for a magical training facility where we can control the space, time, and even gravity within!" Immediately everyone went silent as they realized what Alex truly meant by using the Dragon Balls to help with their battles. Meanwhile the Bulmas adopted a sheepish look since they had JUST recently started trying to create such a facility, instead of during the last three years when they needed to prepare for the Androids, and Cell.
Alex didn't leave it at that though, as he continued with,
"There's also 'I wish for the ability to make real life projections of opponents to train against!' Or 'I wish to learn the secrets of the Super Saiyan transformations!'" With each word the people around Alex looked increasingly sheepish as they realized that there had been a whole variety of ways they could've used the Dragon Balls, before he looked at Krillin, Yamcha, and Tien directly and said,
"And you three could have wished for the same potential as a Saiyan so you wouldn't get left behind. Or hell, you could've gone the full mile and wished to be Saiyans entirely." Though the actual Saiyans booed and hissed at the idea, Tien responded by saying,
"That would be the same as directly wishing for power, wouldn't it?" Alex however shook his head as he replied,
"No it wouldn't. You might immediately gain power with your bodies catching up to the level of training you've already done, but it would not actually put you on the same level as Goku and Vegeta. Unless you've all done the same amount of training that is. Or hell, you could have also wished that humans could gain a similar ability to the Super Saiyan so that you can increase your power for battle as well." Alex then looked over everyone present once again before stating,
"Regardless of if you agree with it or not, the fact is that any of those wishes would have been better than simply summoning Shenron just to bring people back because you failed. After all, Shenron can only bring someone back once, so what'll you all do when innocent people get killed more than once due to your negligence?"
That fact as well drove home Alex's point about their over reliance on the Dragon Balls to mitigate the damage caused by some of their foes. Hell, Goku went out of his way to go to planet Namek just to find a Namekian to come become Earth's guardian(basically God), and restore the Dragon Balls to use after they defeated Cell.
Then, surprising even Alex, two people stepped forward to support his concerns, future Bulma and Trunks.
"Alex is right you guys. If we didn't rely on the Dragon Balls so much, then maybe our timeline wouldn't have suffered so much when the Androids appeared." Bulma said, while Trunks nodded in agreement before he added,
"Yeah. It's nice knowing that the Dragon Balls can bring us back if we died, but I feel like it also makes us lax instead of taking fights as seriously as we need to." As he said this Trunks glanced briefly at Goku, who, upon exiting the Hyperbolic Time Chamber that could extend a single day into an entire year, spent almost the entire time they had to prep for the Cell Games relaxing with his family.
Plus there was the fact that even if the group did go into a fight seriously, they would still have the thought in the back of their heads that even if they failed, the Dragon Balls would make everything better.
Even Master Roshi began nodding in agreement at Alex's concerns and Trunks' support, as he said,
"That's true. It'll be hard to take any fight seriously if you believe there will be no consequences for winning or losing, especially if the stakes are so high."
One by one the people before him slowly began to agree with Alex's concerns, especially if they were going to battle more powerful foes in the future.
It had mostly been future Trunks and Bulma that convinced them though. In their timeline, while Goku had died of natural causes and couldn't be brought back with either set of Dragon Balls, everyone else had been killed by the Androids when they appeared, Vegeta, Krillin, Tien, Chiaotzu, Yamcha, and then finally Piccolo.
When Piccolo died though, his connection to the Earths Guardian, Kami, meant that Kami also died and the Dragon Balls became useless lumps of stone. With no Dragon Balls of their own to use to bring anyone back, the people of Earth only had Gohan and the child Trunks to rely on, before the former also ended up dying to the Androids.
So, with an actual example of how much over relying on the Dragon Balls could do more harm than good, everyone had to take Alex's warning seriously.
Surprising even him, once again, Bardock of all people suddenly muttered as if to himself,
"I think I might've made a wish on something like those Dragon Balls once... Well, there was a Namekian there too when it happened." As he said that Bardock looked at Piccolo, while everyone else, even Gine, looked at him in shock.
"You made a wish once too dad?" Goku asked curiously, giving voice to what was going through everyone's heads at that moment. Bardock however shrugged as he said,
"I don't know. I was fighting at the time and the Namekian I was trying to protect asked what I wanted to wish for. I thought it was nonsense like trying to wish on a shooting star or something, but if he had some of those Dragon Balls too then it makes sense." Bardock then waved his hand dismissively at the story, as he wouldn't have even remembered it if it weren't for all the talk of wishing and stuff.
Vegeta Sr however seemed the most intrigued by Bardock's story, and asked,
"Which planet were you on at the time? Because I don't recall ordering an attack on a planet with Namekians." Immediately Bardock answered,
"It was planet Cereal. There were a few Namekians living there, and one survived the slaughter along with a Cerealian woman and her child. Since they were all that was left I decided to spare them, but then the Heeters showed up and tried to kill all of us because we overheard their plans to betray Frieza."
Vegeta Sr made a look that said 'I see' at the story, as if he was recalling the attack on planet Cereal himself, despite not actually being present for it. Meanwhile Gine began teasing Bardock for being a big softy, before Vegeta Jr sneered,
"Looks like being soft hearted was a family trait. Raditz was the only normal one out of the lot of you!" Raditz smirked when heard this, happy for the praise until his mother suddenly asked without paying Vegeta's comment any mind,
"So what did you wish for Bardock?" This brought everyone's attention back to the man in question, who simply shrugged again as he said,
"I don't recall, it was so long ago." This however earned him a pout from Gine as she tried to get him to spill about what his wish was, which Bardock refused regardless of how much she tried.
Alex however let his curiosity get the better of him, and used Regeneration magic to peek back in time to that moment.
*
Bardock- "Sorry Monaito, but I don't take orders from anyone. And I'm not leaving this place until I beat him!"
Monaito- "What's it going to take to make you see reason? Fine... Then tell me, is there another wish I could make for you? I'm just trying to help you."
Bardock- "What's this all about anyways? Are you trying to wish on a shooting star or something?
"But sure..... I'd wish that my sons end up thriving."
*
As he stopped snooping Alex looked at Bardock, who was still claiming that he didn't recall what he wished for, and said,
"That was a good wish Bardock, and exactly the type of wishes that I think should be made more often." Alex's remark drew every gaze directly to him, while Bardock clicked his tongue in annoyance that Alex 'peeked'. Of course, this also made Gine redouble her efforts to get her husband to spill on what kind of wish he made.
Alex then clapped once to calm things down, to which Gine told Bardock that she'll talk to him later, and said,
"Alright, now that I said my piece I think it's about time we take off. I want to head to Namek first to make my wish there, and then we'll go to what I really wanted to show all of you." As he said that, Alex pointed to an empty space in Bulma's backyard, in which a giant magic circle formed.
Everyone who hadn't seen it before stared in awe as Zenith suddenly erupted from the ground.
The massive and majestic ship flew up into the air, catching the eye of everyone who was relatively close to Capsule Corp as it made a loop, before coming back down to land right in front of them. Alex then patted the side affectionately as he said,
"This is Zenith, my familiar. She's been with me for a long time now." As he said that the ship groaned and rumbled contently beneath his hands, before Alex suddenly thought he heard a phantom child-like giggle in the back of his mind.
Though he investigated the surrounding area through his 'Domain', Alex couldn't find anything that could have been the source of the laughter. Dismissing it for the moment, he then said,
"Alright everyone, let's hop on board!"

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - 453: To Make a Wish
chapters.content:
After several minutes of everyone loading onto Zenith and looking around excitedly, Alex took his place at the helm and shouted,
"Cast off!"
Immediately they began rising into the air, once again drawing the gazes of the people below them as they rose higher and higher. Meanwhile the majority of Alex's passengers were excitedly looking around as, even though they could all pretty much fly on their own or owned flying vehicles, this was the first time they had ridden on such a 'unique' vehicle.
"So what exactly is this thing?" One of the Bulmas asked as they quickly soared high enough that they left the Earth's atmosphere.
"Like I said, this is Zenith, my familiar. Through our link we share my power, so the stronger I become, the bigger and more powerful she becomes as well." As he said that Alex patted Zenith's railing once again, remembering how she used to be the size of a toy when he got her, and now was larger than even the the greatest of galleons that had built throughout history.
By this point though Alex kinda hoped her future changes would be mostly cosmetic or upgrading any equipment on her, as there was no real reason for Zenith to become even larger than she already was.
Putting such thoughts out of his mind for the moment though, Alex pulled out his Skeleton Key while checking the coordinates for the new planet Namek on the magic compass that they had installed onto her. Once that was done he held the key up, and declared,
"Here we go!" At that moment a beam of light appeared from the key, shooting out in front of Zenith before expanding to create a massive portal large enough for them to fly through. On the other side they could see what was unmistakably the planet Namek, a planet covered in green water, matching skies, and blue plains of grass.
"So this is Namek..." Tien uttered out loud, as for him, Yamcha, Chiaotzu, Launch, Master Roshi, Chichi, future Trunks, and all the others Alex brought back, this was their first time actually seeing it.
Krillin nodded and said with a somewhat bitter tone,
"Yep....good old Namek. Sure brings back some memories, huh?" Despite his bitter tones, a few snickers responded to Krillins words.
After Tien, Yamcha, Chiaotzu, and Piccolo all died during Vegeta and Nappa's attack, Krillin had traveled to Namek along with Gohan, Bulma, and Grant to use their Dragon Balls to bring them back. That however had led to their battle with Frieza, during which Krillin had been killed halfway through the battle between him and Goku, who arrived later after recovering from his battle with Vegeta.
"I'm sure the trip this time will be a lot better Krillin!" Goku said optimistically as he clapped his friend on the shoulder, already knowing that would be the case since he'd actually been here right before the Cell Games.
While the Dragon Team were reminiscing, Alex's peerage were having their own reactions.
"Finally we can see something that's actually like 'another world'!" Shia exclaimed excitedly, to which the rest of the girls nodded in agreement.
While each world they had been to did have its own unique characteristics, they had all seemed like similar world's with different time periods or cultures. Namek would be the first world they'd travel to that was completely different. Different water, different landscapes, different flora and fauna, and even different people entirely.
With nearly everyone's excitement to see Namek rising, Alex readily brought them closer as he zeroed in on the current Grand Elder of the Namekians.
Locating the largest of the few settlements on the planet, Alex directed Zenith towards it as they began their rapid descent. As before on Earth, they caused quite the commotion as the Namekians watched them descend, briefly thinking they were invaders, until they noticed Goku and the others from Earth happily waving at them.
"Hey guys!" Goku cried out at them, making the Namekians show relieved expressions that it wasn't another invasion.
"Greetings Goku! It is a pleasure to see you again!" Cried out an elderly looking Namekian with darker green skin than the rest. Once they landed though, he immediately asked,
"Is everything alright? We felt the power surge from here and were worried. Nothing happened to Dende did it?" Immediately asking after their fellow Namekian, who had gone to Earth in order to become its guardian, the Grand Elder was worried along with the rest of his people when they felt Alex and Cell's auras clashing a week and a half earlier.
Goku however waved away their concerns and said,
"Yeah, everything's fine and Dende is ok! We just stopped by for a quick visit to see if you'd let us use your Dragon Balls real quick Moori." Punctuating his request by putting his hands together to make 'pretty please' pose, Moori looked at the group with confusion before smiling and saying,
"Well if that's all then it's fine, after all we still owe all of you a debt of gratitude." With the rest of the Namekians gathered with Moori voicing their agreements, and everyone else disembarking Zenith as well, Alex stepped forward and said,
"Thank you for your generosity, I really appreciate it." Though the Namekians looked at him with confusion, not knowing who Alex was, he still bowed his head at them respectively since they didn't need to let him use their Dragon Balls.
Though the Namekians were about to tell him not to mind it, and to raise his head, but before he could there was a sudden explosion of energy behind them as a furious voice roared,
"I HAVE HAD ENOUGH!!!"
Everyone immediately jumped out of the way as Vegeta Jr went Super Saiyan, his energy arcing in every direction as he directed a furious glare in Alex's direction.
"You're no emperor, YOU'RE A DISGRACE TO EVERY SINGLE SAIYAN WARRIOR THAT EVER LIVED! WHERE IS YOUR PRIDE!?!"
Raising his head, Alex glanced in Vegeta's direction with a furrowed brow and asked,
"What's your problem now?" That just pissed Vegeta off even more as he demanded,
"'What's my problem'? 'WHATS MY PROBLEM'?! YOU'RE MY PROBLEM!" Alex however just cocked his head to the side as if he were confused, to which Vegeta shouted even more,
"AT EVERY TURN YOU'VE BEEN SHAMING THE SAIYAN NAME! AND NOW, ON TOP OF EVERYTHING ELSE, YOU JUST LOWERED YOUR HEAD TO A BUNCH OF LOWER LIFEFORMS LIKE IT WAS NOTHING!"
Nostrils flared, veins popping, and eyes bloodshot, this was obviously the most furious Vegeta had been in his entire life...and that was saying a lot. And even though anyone else would have been terrified to be the source of that fury, Alex didn't even flinch as he replied as if it were obvious,
"Well yeah, I came here to ask them for a favor. It's only natural that I show them respect in return." Again however, that only served to make Vegeta even angrier as he shouted,
"YOU SHOULD HAVE JUST TAKEN THEM AND SQUASHED THESE WEAKLINGS LIKE THE WORTHLESS INSECTS THEY ARE!"
Not just Alex, but everyone else was stunned at Vegeta's declaration, as even if it was very slight, they thought he had even been making progress in becoming a better person. However with the numerous recent revelations regarding his lack of strength, Alex's existence, the return of his father and subsequent loss of their royal standing, this seemed to be the final straw.
And while everyone else was still edging away from the ticking Super Saiyan time bomb, Alex's expression was darkening by the second as he asked,
"And is that your final stance on the matter?" The surrounding spectators shuddered from the chill in Alex's voice as he asked that, as until this point, they had never seen him become 'serious'.
And while they all recoiled, Vegeta appeared unfazed as he snorted,
"Don't try and play the tough guy here. You're nothing but a pathetic coward who only plays at being tough, and I'll reveal you for the fraud you are!" With that said, Vegeta suddenly launched himself forward to personally show Alex what a 'true' Saiyan was like.
With the training he'd been doing since the Cell Games, and the rage he currently felt, even Goku was hard pressed to keep up with Vegeta's speed as he rocketed towards Alex like a deadly projectile. However, there was a certain group of people who had no problem following Vegeta's movements, which very much included the very person he was trying to attack.
*BOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!*
None of the Dragon Team or surrounding Namekians saw what happened, they only knew that a great concussive force tried to blow them back while the entire planet seemed to shudder from the force of the blow as a massive cloud of dust covered their sight.
"Pathetic."
That was all they heard as the shuddering of the planet came to a stop and the dust began to settle, showing them the scene of Vegeta in the dirt with a clear fist imprint in his face, and Alex standing over him with a clenched fist.
Alex looked down at Vegeta with a stone cold expression, on which they could only make out disappointment, before he began,
"I've been patient with you out of consideration for the life you've lived until now, and the rapid series of changes I've been causing, but that stops now." Surprisingly, Vegeta was able to weakly groan as his body twitched, seemingly in response to Alex's voice.
Wether this was because of his sheer tenacity, or Alex's skill in using such force while minimizing damage, none of them could tell. Those who knew Alex though were well aware that he was purposely leaving Vegeta on the edge of consciousness, especially when he used his 'Telekinesis' to lift Vegeta's twitching body into the air, and continued,
"Your attitude and refusal to let go of the outdated and pointless ideology of how Saiyans are 'supposed' to act brings more shame to us than anything else." Alex then twitched his fingers just ever so lightly, making Vegeta's entire body jerk to confirm he was still conscious.
With that being the case, he continued,
"All around you there are examples of Saiyans who don't possess the same point of view and ideals as you, yet have surpassed you in nearly every way. Goku, Grant, me..... The three of us were born with lower potential than you, less power..... And yet here we are, racing ahead of you while you're still stuck in the past that you've created in your mind. Well that stops now."
His monologue finished, Alex then proceeded to plunge his fist directly into Vegeta's abdomen, making the former prince cry out in pain.
"GYAAAAAAAAAAAAA!"
With his cry came blood, while the point where Alex's hand was connected to him began to shine with a magical light.
"W-what are you doing!?!" Goku demanded as, from their point of view, Alex was merely torturing Vegeta right now. Even as he prepared to fight on Vegeta's behalf, Alex calmly replied,
"I'm simply teaching Vegeta a lesson. No need to worry, he's not being injured physically." The words were barely out of Alex's mouth when he drew his hand back from Vegeta's abdomen, and dropped him to the ground.
Once he was finished dealing with Vegeta, Alex turned his attention back towards the Namekians who were watching while horrified, and said while bowing lowly,
"I apologize profusely for the scene Vegeta and I have shown you all. I hope this doesn't lessen your opinions of me." Though he could hear the groaning protests from Vegeta as he lowered his head once again, Alex was stunned when someone else did the same next to him.
"No." Vegeta Sr said to them, before continuing, "The fault in my son's actions and demeanor are mine and mine alone, due to my inability to raise him properly. Please forgive his earlier transgressions, and the disciplinary actions taken by my liege."
Many of the Namekians were shocked to hear that this man was the father of Vegeta, who had even gloated about how he slaughtered the entire population of one of their villages. However, none were shocked more than Vegeta himself as he watched the scene from his position on the ground, and clenched his fist in anger.
"Please! Both of you, raise your heads!" Moori said urgently as he gestured for them to rise, as he was greatly unaccustomed to being regarded so highly. As they did so, Trunks hesitantly asked as he looked down at his still groaning father,
"What did you do to him?" Glancing at Vegeta with a look as if he were looking at trash, Alex answered,
"I sealed Vegeta's energy so that he can't use it anymore. No more powering himself up, energy blasts, or Super Saiyan transformations from him. On top of that I placed limiters on his physical strength, putting him at just above the average human in terms of strength. If he wants his abilities back then Vegeta will have to work his ass off to get them."
Shock filled the group at Alex's answer, as they never even thought such a thing was possible, let alone to someone as powerful as Vegeta." One person however appeared gleeful as he teasingly asked,
"Oh? So that means I'm stronger than even the mighty Vegeta right now?" That earned him the greatest response yet from the former Prince as he glared up at the speaker, Yamcha, hatefully.
"Rather than being happy, shouldn't you feel bad that it took me actually doing that to him for you not to be the weakest reason the team?" Yamcha's earlier glee immediately vanished as he flinched from that remark, followed by him paling considerably as krillin added,
"Plus I wouldn't poke too much fun at Vegeta even now. I mean imagine what he'd do to you once he gets his strength back later?" By this point Yamcha's hands had actually begun shaking as he imagined just that, while for the first time Vegeta's lips curled upwards into his trademark sneer.
It was only for a moment though as his body lost strength once again, as Vegeta had literally never been this weak in his entire life, and that was on top of the damage Alex had dealt to him earlier. Throwing his son over his shoulder, Vegeta Sr. said to them,
"If you'll allow, I'll take my son back to the ship to rest and have some words with him." Alex waved away Vegeta Sr's words as he turned his attention back to Moori to ask more about the Dragon Balls, which he learned were already on their way.
Once Vegeta Sr got his son into one of Zenith's cabins and on a bed, he pulled a vial out of the storage ring he had received from Alex, alongside the rest of his fellow Saiyans, and said,
"Here son, drink this." As he tried to put the vial to his son's lips though, a surge of strength rushed through Vegeta's body as he swatted the vial away, causing its contents to spill all over the bed.
"I-I-I'd rather die...than accept something like that...!" In the face of such resolve though, Vegeta Sr immediately did something that shocked the former Prince to his core.
*SMACK!*
For the first time in his life, Vegeta's father had hit him(outside of training of course). And as Vegeta tried to wrap his head around this, his father suddenly demanded in a harsh voice,
"What do you think you're doing son?! This has to stop!" Vegeta looked up at his father with a blank face, before his expression contorted in anger as he stated,
"What has to stop father? Shaming ourselves at every chance he gets? Trying to hold on to what remains of our pride? Remembering what makes us Saiyans, the strongest race in the entire univ-"
*SMACK!*
A second time, Vegeta Sr smacked his son, stunning him completely into silence, before slowly saying,
"What pride son? The same pride that let us be destroyed by Frieza?" Vegeta noticeably flinched at that, before he was forced to recall the years of borderline servitude he had endured as one of Frieza's lackeys. However his father didn't stop there, as he continued,
"'Strongest in the universe'? We weren't even the strongest in Frieza's army! We were practically a laughing stock unless the full moon was out!" At this point Vegeta Sr slammed his fist against one of the wooden walls around them, holding back of course to avoid damaging Alex's familiar, but it was still hard enough that the ship groaned and rumbled at the impact.
Looking back at his son, Vegeta Sr declared,
"The ideals you're trying to cling to so desperately, the way you or I handled things, are exactly what got our people destroyed to begin with! Think about it! The Super Saiyan transformation was right there, within grasp of not just our family, but all Saiyans! And we completely disregarded it because of our way of doing things! Did you not think son, that maybe we were wrong?"
At this point Sr's expression became sad as all his past failures came back to him, dumbfounding his son as he had never seen his father make such an expression before. He then continued,
"That's why I goaded Alex into a match over the right to rule the Saiyans son. We needed to be pushed into a completely new direction, one that we never even considered before but could push us to never before seen heights! And yet here you are, clinging to very same ideals that resulted in our downfall."
Looking directly at his son once again, all Vegeta could see was disappointment in his father's eyes. He clenched his fist in frustration as he forced his aching body into a sitting position, and declared,
"But that same 'new direction' is one of shame and cowardice! Someone who would readily lower his head like that, doesn't deserve to rule the Saiyans!"
For a moment Vegeta's force eyes locked onto his father's disappointed ones, showing just how strongly he was against Alex's ways of doing things. Eventually, Vegeta's Sr closed his eyes and sighed in disappointment, before opening them to reveal the same fierce gaze that Vegeta recalled from his youth, the look of the King of Saiyans.
"You're right about one thing son, I have never in my life felt more shame that in this one moment." Vegeta Sr then turned his back on him and made to leave the cabin, saying over his shoulder as he did so,
"But it's not our emperor that has shamed me."
...
As the former king Vegeta rejoined them Alex was deep in conversation with Moori regarding the Dragon Balls. They had discussed what he needed to wish for, which earned him some speculation when he said he had recently been cursed to be unable to swim, and were now on the subject on the actual creation of the Dragon Balls themselves.
"I see, I never knew that was how they were made..." Alex said as he nodded his head sagely, seemingly ignoring the numerous people that were curiously pulling on his now rubber body. Grayfia in particular was stretching his ear and cheek out as if to test something, before looking back at the girls and saying seriously,
"We need to learn how to use Armament Haki..." Her comment was met with numerous nods of agreement, while Shia was currently busy testing how Alex's body would respond to being punched. Needless to say the results were fairly frustrating for her.
Yuna however then added with a chuckle,
"I'm sure the children will like their fathers new abilities though." Alex quickly nodded as he stretched his arms out so they were several feet long, and excitedly said,
"Yeah! Now I can hug and hold everyone at once!" His actions were met with a series of either laughter or shaking heads, though those with the latter were smiling wryly as they did so.
Soon however the moment Alex was waiting for arrived as several fully grown Namekians arrived, all of which were holding the golden basketball-sized orbs in their arms as they did so. Within minutes all seven of the Dragon Balls were gathered before him, each one identifiable by the number of red stars within the otherwise completely golden orbs.
"Are you ready?" Moori asked Alex once they were all gathered on the ground before them, to which he nodded while also taking a step back, as the dragon the balls summoned was fairly big.
With Alex's confirmation Moori began speaking in a strange language, which Goku and the others couldn't understand, but Alex and his peerage members could due to the universal translation granted to them by their Evil Pieces. Once he finished the password needed to activate the dragon Balls, they glowed with a golden light that shot upwards suddenly to fill up the sky above them.
Those that hadn't witnessed the phenomenon before oohed and awed at it, while Alex had a large smile on his face as the nostalgia of watching the series hit him like a truck. Next to him Grant smiled knowingly, as he had felt similar things when he first witnessed the Dragon Balls being used.
With another flash of light the figure of the dragon Porunga came into view, who was admittedly fairly humanoid looking compared to other dragons. Unlike Shenron, who appeared like an elongated eastern dragon, Porunga had a humanoid upper body with dragonesque features, such as spikes coming from his shoulders and head, green dragon scales, claws on the tips of his fingers, and a fan running down his back.
"STATE YOUR WISHES."
Porunga demanded in his booming voice while looking down at them, though the moment the words were out of his mouth his gaze focused on Alex specifically. There was something about him that made Porunga want to submit, a feeling that was completely alien and uncomfortable to the wish-granting dragon.
Unaware that he was affecting Porunga with his 'Dragon Emperor' title, Alex then called up to it,
"I wish that I was no longer weak to deep water and dragon slayer attribute." Though one usually needed to speak in the language of the Namekians, that wasn't needed this time due to Alex's built-in translation magic.
As a result, after a moment of being engulfed in shimmering golden light, Porunga boomed down to them,
"IT IS DONE. WHAT ARE YOUR OTHER WISHES?"
Rather than immediately answer, Alex quickly stretched out his arm to confirm he still had Nika's power, before promptly jumping into a nearby lake.
As the water settled from his sudden cannon ball those who were watching began to get increasingly nervous as Alex didn't resurface, while even Porunga watched the scene play out with interest.
"When do we get worried?" Shizuku asked eventually as Alex's absence stretched out, before he suddenly broke the surface of the lake once again.
"Come on in! The waters fine!" Alex called out to them with a smirk, making several of the girls twitch their brows in annoyance at his antics.
"Anyone tempted to wish he couldn't swim again?" Grayfia asked the rest of his wives, to which every single one, sans Lala and Yuna, raised their hands in agreement. However a booming voice above them suddenly said,
"I WOULD PREFER YOU DID NOT DO THAT. NOW WHAT IS YOUR SECOND WISH?" With everyone turning their attention back to Porunga, and Alex crawling out of the lake, he then called up to the dragon,
"My second wish is that I can consume as many Devil Fruits as I want, and then my third one is for the Saiyan race to flourish!" As Alex was once again engulfed in golden light, Porunga boomed to them for the final time,
"IT IS DONE. FAREWELL."
The massive body of the wish granting dragon then vanished, while the seven golden Dragon Balls turned to stone as the magic that made them work vanished alongside Porunga. In four months they would return to normal after they finished recharging though.
After a moment of gaping at the giant round stones though, Shia immediately seized and stretched out Alex's cheek before saying,
"Hey, didn't you think to save any wishes for us? Huh?????????" Alex however appeared unconcerned as he calmly replied,
"What? I made almost all the wishes I can think of that I'd want, and it's not like none of you can't gather up the Dragon Balls once they recharge anyways." Though he still had one wish he was saving for a different set of Dragon Balls, Alex didn't see any problem with using up the rest of the wishes himself since they would basically be able to call upon them as many times as they wanted in the future.
And, if everything went well, there would be another set of Dragon Balls to use really soon.
So, using his 'Telekinesis' to lift the Dragon Balls, Alex returned them to each of the Namekians that had brought them while saying,
"Once again, thank you all for allowing me to use your Dragon Balls." Each of the Namekians bowed respectfully to Alex as they accepted their respective dragon Balls, before taking flight as they returned to their own villages. Moori meanwhile accepted the final stone orb, and replied to him,
"Again, we are happy to provide assistance to Goku and his friends after everything they have done for us." Instead of refuting Moori's sense of gratitude, Alex instead handed him several slips of paper, and explained to the elderly Namekian,
"Use these if the Namekians ever require assistance, and I'll do everything I can to provide it." Shuffling the Dragon Ball to hold it with one hand, Moori accepted the slips of paper while saying,
"Then I will thank you ahead of time, while also saying that I hope we will never have to use them."
With everything they needed to do done, Alex and his group quickly reboarded Zenith so they wouldn't make Kuroka and Kurumu wait any longer. As they began to rise up into the air, Rias asked Alex,
"So do you plan to eat more Devil Fruits in the future since you made that wish?" With the other girls turning to look at him curiously, Alex just shrugged as he answered,
"Not necessarily, but I figured it'd be better to be prepared in case I came across one that I really wanted to eat. Hopefully I won't find another one that will choose me though." As he said that Alex resumed testing his newfound powers since it was truly trippy seeing his body move in such ways.
As he was doing that another certain group approached Alex, and Raditz demanded,
"And by the way, what was up with that last wish of yours?" Alex looked up at the Saiyans to see they were giving him weird looks, to which he replied,
"Nothing, I just thought I'd make a wish to help our small number of people prosper in the future. Well, it was mostly for my children since they're all Saiyans as well." As Alex said, there was a very small handful of Saiyans left in the entirety of Universe Seven, only one of which was a female. Though he would (hopefully) live for a much longer span of time, all it would take is a few generations after the current Saiyans passed away for them to fade into obscurity.
Alex's final wish was an attempt to prevent that from happening since he didn't have any intention of reviving all of those who had been killed by Frieza, as conforming a handful of Saiyans from their 'evil' ways was easier than the entire former populace. It was when Alex wistfully thought to himself 'if only they were more like the Saiyans of Universe Six' that an idea came to him, and an evil smile formed on his lips.
"What are you thinking about?" Vegeta Sr asked hesitantly at the look on Alex's face, but nothing could prepared him for the next words to come out of his mouth as Alex replied,
"Oh nothing, I just happened to recall a large population of Saiyans that still exist, and was thinking about paying them a visit in the near future." As could be expected, all of the Saiyans on deck, including Goku and even Vegeta below deck when Alex's words carried to him, jolted in shock as the former king Vegeta even seized his shoulders and demanded,
"Are you serious! There's more Saiyans out there!?!" Though he could technically take offense to being manhandled by one of his vassals, Alex ignored it as he replied,
"Yes and no. They exist, but not in this universe." Alex then went over the twelve universes that existed in this corner of existence, as well as Universe Six, which was the mirror to this Universe Seven.
As could be expected, the moment Alex finished speaking Goku excitedly exclaimed,
"So there's even more universes with strong people to fight out there?! I can't wait to meet them!" Aside from Goku's excitement though, the former king slumped to the deck as he uttered,
"Unbelievable.... There's still an entire planet of Saiyans out there... And they're even living on planet Sadala...." Even Bardock, Raditz, and Gine were all reacting to learning there were more Saiyans out there, as it meant they weren't truly the only ones left.
Leaving the former king and other Saiyans to their thoughts, Alex turned his attention to the most pressing thing, meeting with Kuroka and Kurumu. So, once again wielding the Skeleton Key, he held it up and focused on the mischievous cat and succubus before turning it to open the gate.

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - 454: Pangea
chapters.content:
As they passed through the portal for the second time that day, the group found themselves in a rather peculiar place.
"Where are we?" Future Bulma asked, as she stared out into the pitch black endless void before them.
"We're at the outermost edge of Universe Seven, where there is nothing but the endless void for as far as you go." Everyone sans Alex whirled around at the voice, which belonged to someone none of them had ever met before, except for one person.
"Who are you?!" Goku demanded as he put his guard up, alongside his father and brother. One Saiyan however had a completely different reaction, as his expression paled and and his hands began shaking.
"L-l-lord Beerus! What are you doing here!?!" Vegeta Sr demanded with obvious fear in his voice, alerting everyone else present as curiosity regarding this new face increased.
Beerus however didn't mind the new people who were acting hostile towards him, instead focusing on Vegeta Sr as he casually approached him and sneered,
"Well if it isn't King Vegeta? Been a long time since I last saw your face, and it appears you forgot what it means to have manners in that time." Without any hesitation Vegeta Sr dropped in front of all of them and pressed his forehead to Zenith's deck, shocking everyone present as he pleaded,
"Please forgive me my lord, I meant no disrespect!" Beerus' sneer widened as he raised his foot, and said as he was about to step on Vegeta's head,
"That sounds better Vegeta....!" But before he could though, something else appeared right below Beerus' foot, surprising him and Vegeta both as they looked up to see Alex standing there with a smile that didn't reach his eyes.
"I'll ask you not to torment my subjects Beerus, or I might have to personally get involved." As he said that Alex's aura began to increase in intensity, which began to clash with Beerus' own aura as his too began to increase.
Though the Dragon Team couldn't actually feel Beerus' aura due to its divine nature, they could still feel the intensity rising between him and Alex as they clashed. While they were clashing though, Beerus cocked an eyebrow as he parroted,
"'My subjects'? Alexander, you never told me you took over as the ruler of the Saiyans!" Alex rolled his eyes at Beerus' comment while Vegeta Sr looked between the two of them confusedly, not yet aware that they had already met, albeit it had been a mere few hours ago.
"Never seemed relevant to our conversation. But, if you want to harass them, then that means picking another fight with me." As he said this Alex was smirking confidently due to his eagerness to truly test out Nika's power, though he had just gotten it.
He wasn't the only one though, as even Beerus was raring for a second round against Alex now that he had eaten and was ready to go.
Before either one could throw the first punch though, the top of a certain scepter was thrust in between their faces while the wielder tutted at them.
"Tut tut tut, to think the two of you would act in such a way on sight. It's like I'm dealing with a couple of children here." Whis stated woefully as he caressed his cheek with his free hand.
With his interference both Alex and Beerus backed off immediately, before the former helped Vegeta Sr up off the floor. When the former king was on his feet once more, he immediately asked Alex,
"My liege, have you...met lord Beerus before?" Alex chuckled at the question even as everyone else looked at him, including his wives since they hadn't heard how his meeting with Beerus went yet. Alex then surprised them all by saying,
"Actually we had a 'little' sparring match earlier and fought to standstill." If anyone was surprised before, then every single person was completely stunned when they heard that.
On one side was Alex's wives who couldn't believe that there was actually someone who could match the current him, and then there was the former king Vegeta, who had been one of the many people within the universe who had been struck with the fear of Beerus' might, and forced to submit to him. Goku and the others meanwhile didn't know who Beerus was, but since he was someone Alex acknowledged then there was only on thing going through Goku's mind.
"If even Alex couldn't beat you, then you must be REALLY strong, right?" He eagerly asked the Destruction God, to which Beerus cocked a brow before looking at Alex and asking,
"Is he serious?" Alex smiled wryly as he gestured to the two of them and said,
"Beerus, Goku. Goku, Beerus." Goku happily reached out at the introduction to shake hands with Beerus, but the Destruction God ignored it as he continued looking at Goku with narrowed eyes. He then asked after apparently deciding to completely ignore Goku,
"So what did you bring me all the way out here for Alex? Surely not for a reunion with the former king Vegeta, or to meet some weak Saiyan." Alex shook his head before gesturing out towards the endless void, and saying,
"We're here for THAT." As if to respond to him, the void suddenly began to shimmer before seven actual planets appeared out of nowhere, all covered in barren rock or other space debris.
Then, before anyone could ask what the planets were for, two figures suddenly appeared that immediately attacked Alex as they clung to him.
"Darling! I missed you so much!" Kurumu cried out as she leapt into the air and wrapped her arms around Alex's head while her legs wrapped around his body, leaving his face firmly planted between her breasts.
"Ah miphhed ooo ooo..." Came Alex's muffled voice from within her bosom, while his hands went to her butt to support her.
Before Kurumu could get her fill though, a certain mischievous cat pulled her off by the nape of her neck while saying,
"Back off, I'm first as Alex's 'Queen'~Nya!" Then, literally throwing Kurumu over Zenith's side into the empty space, Kuroka quickly pulled Alex's head down into her own massive bust. Her head then began to nuzzle the top of his own, while the sound of her purring spread out over the deck.
"Who the hell are these two?" Beerus asked irritably, during their reunion, to which Whis explained,
"I do believe they are two of Alex's wives, alongside the rest of those young women over there." Pointing to the rest of Alex's gathered peerage, Beerus merely glanced in their direction dismissively before noticing something interesting.
"Oh?" Beerus uttered as his gaze focused on a certain Crimson haired devil, who looked directly back at him as he began to approach her.
"You there! I sense the power of Destruction within you." Beerus said to her suddenly, surprising Rias momentarily before she smiled wryly.
"It's the specialty of my mother's family." She said before proudly summoning a mass of destructive energies. However Beerus appeared disappointed at the display as he questioned,
"What is that?" Rias looked at him with confusion as she stated,
"It's a mass of pure Destruction." Beerus however appeared unimpressed as he stated,
"No it's not, that's just an energy based attack with destructive properties." Shaking his head disappointedly, Beerus went to rejoin Whis while leaving the stunned Rias behind. She then directed a pointed glare at Yue, when the petite vampiress began to snicker at her expense,
"....fake Destruction Goddess..." Rias was going to show her just how 'fake' her Destruction naturally was, when Beerus suddenly asked with a sharp look,
"What does she mean by 'Destruction Goddess'?" Looking back at him, Rias stated irritably,
"I'm regarded as the Goddess of Destruction in Asora." This time Beerus was truly shocked, before an angry expression formed on his face.
"So 'this' is what passes for a Goddess of Destruction where you're from?" Feeling even more insulted by Beerus with each passing second, Rias puffed out her chest proudly as she declared,
"I AM! and I've pushed my power of Destruction farther than anyone else that has possessed it in my entire family's history! Now I can even Destroy an entire planet!" In response to her declaration though, Beerus just looked back at her like that was most idiotic thing he had ever heard.
He then stormed up to her, and seized Rias by the front of her shirt before snarling,
"When we are done here you ARE coming to my planet, and there I WILL beat the true path of the Destroyer into you! I refuse to have a being as pathetic as you calling yourself a God of Destruction! And if you can't prove yourself capable enough, then I'll Destroy you myself!"
Leaving no room for argument, Beerus then practically threw Rias back as he stormed back to Whis' side, and the rest of the girls went to make sure she was alright. Alex meanwhile had been keeping an eye on the entire situation, even as he was being smothered by the fighting Kurumu and Kuroka, and said as he approached Beerus,
"I have no problem with you teaching Rias, but if you ever tried to Destroy so much as a single hair on her head, then I WILL come down on you with EVERYTHING I have Beerus." Though he ain't exerting any energy this time, Alex was deadly serious as he would never allow any of his wives to come to real harm if he could help it.
And with several cards still up his sleeve that Alex didn't use in their earlier fight, he had no doubt that in a true fight to the death between them, he'd win. Beerus however just snorted as he stated,
"If she's anywhere as capable as she believes, then you have nothing to worry about Alexander." For a moment no one said anything as Alex and Beerus directed one last glare at each other, before someone suddenly appeared between them as she stated,
"Alright! That's enough already! You didn't bring us all the way out here for a point dick-measuring contest, did you?" Present Bulma stated as she tried to defuse the situation between Alex and Beerus this time, prompting them to give one last glare to each other, before Alex finally said,
"No I didn't." He then turned towards the seven planets that were floating before them, all of which had been gathered from throughout the twelve universes where they had been scattered.
Shaking himself out, Alex then confused everyone by biting down on his thumb.
"Less shee if thish worksh." He then took in a deep breath through his nose, one large enough that his chest began to visibly expand to the point that both Kuroka and Kurumu were shocked.
"Gear, third!" Alex exclaimed before he began blowing air directly INTO the bones in his hand.
If his spectators were shocked before, that was nothing compared to the shock they felt watching Alex's hand literally blow up like a balloon.
"What....the fuck.....is that?" Kuroka demanded with dead seriousness, to the point that she even forgot her verbal tick, to which Grayfia explained,
"Alex ate a Devil Fruit that turned him into a rubber man." When they heard that both Kuroka and Kurumu looked at the rest of the girls around them as if they expected someone to shout 'just kidding!' But no one did.
And even if they wanted to deny him gaining such a stupid ability, the truth was right there before their eyes as Alex literally inflated his hand like a balloon. Then, once he inflated it to the size he wanted, Alex proceeded to maneuver half of the air now inflating his hand down through his arm, back into his chest, down the other arm, and finally into his other hand so that both were inflated.
"Giant....." Alex began as he then thrust both his enlarged hands out to the sides, which stretched both of his arms to the extreme until they could stretch no further. Then, Alex's entire hands became completely black as similarly colored lightning began to cover them.
"....CLAP!" Alex cried out as he brought his hand together with as much force as he could muster, creating a shockwave of energy and black lightning that buffeted the seven planets before them with a force that even Beerus couldn't help but to be impressed by.
Then, as all of the seven planets were engulfed in the massive shockwaves, the debris and rocky terrain began to fracture and break apart to reveal a golden smooth center.
"No way..." One of the Bulmas uttered in awe as she and the rest of the Dragon Team gaped at what they were seeing.
And as the air deflated from Alex's hands(thankfully he didn't shrink like Luffy did when he used that technique), he proudly declared,
"Presenting, the origin of every set of Dragon Balls in existence, THE SUPER DRAGON BALLS!" As he said that Alex gestured at the seven planet-sized orbs as they floated there in a cluster, each one with its appropriately numbered star.
"These are.....the origin of all Dragon Balls...!" Krillin repeated dumbfoundedly while present Bulma hurriedly pulled out her Dragon Radar that could detect the faint energy signature given off by the Dragon Balls.
"I can't believe this..." She uttered as the radar confirmed what Alex told them, that all seven of those planets were in fact the magical wish-granting orbs they had all grown familiar with over the years.
While the others also made comments of awe and disbelief, Alex was nodding slowly as he said,
"Believe it. These are the most powerful Dragon Balls in existence, which scatter throughout the twelve universes after a wish is made. And unlike the Namekian or Earth Dragon Balls, they truly can grant any wish without any restrictions." That part also got everyone attention, as each time they had tried to use the Dragon Balls in the past there had been rules or restrictions that they typically had to try and find ways around to get what they needed.
As everyone else was gaping at the Super Dragon Balls, Alex decided to work on the first part of what he wanted to do before making his next wish.
Warping onto the surface of the one star planet in an instant, Alex used Creation magic to manipulate the substance of the planet itself. Pulling some of the mysterious material away from the planet, Alex soon had a baseball sized orb of his own with a singular star in the middle, exactly like the planet he was currently on.
Quickly warping to the rest of the planets, Alex soon had the seven orbs he needed to complete his own set of Dragon Balls to establish in Asora. After he stored them in his personal storage, Alex returned to Zenith's deck where everyone else had been waiting for him.
"Where did you go?" Yuna asked curiously, as only a select few could have sensed what Alex was doing on the planet sized orbs.
"I had a little something to take care of, but it's all good now." Then, clapping and rubbing his hands together excitedly, Alex asked them,
"Alright then, who's ready to see the Super Dragon Balls in action?" Immediately everyone voiced their agreement due to heir excitement to see the dragon that would be summoned when these balls were used.
With everyone ready, Alex then shouted as loud as he could into the void,
"COME FORTH, DRAGON OF THE GODS, AND GRANT MY WISH PRETTY PLEASE!"
Though he earned himself numerous weird looks due to the last part of the password, everyone's attention was immediately on the Super Dragon Balls once again as they began to shine with a bright light.
"Back up Zenith!" Alex exclaimed as the Super Dragon Balls activated, before Kuroka instead instantly warped them all away from the increasingly bright light, which was growing to rival even the brightest of stars."
"Good heavens." Whis casually remarked as he tapped the butt of his staff on Zenith's deck, forming a protective bubble around all of them as he did so.
His intervention couldn't have come at a better moment, as the light from the Super dragon Balls suddenly exploded outwards like a supernova before condensing to create one truly massive golden form. Even after Kuroka warped them the length of an entire solar system away from the Super dragon Balls themselves, none of them could see the entirety of the golden massive being before them.
All any of them could truly make out was a portion of its head as the being began to open its glowing red eyes, which were much more massive than even a planet was. Then, surprising everyone present, they were suddenly transported into an entirely different space where a much smaller projection of the dragon appeared before them.
"STATE....YOUR....WISH...."
The dragon boomed at them in a much louder voice than Porunga had, though, only Alex, his peerage, Beerus, and Whis understood what he said due to speaking in the language of the gods.
"What did he say?" Goku asked curiously, to which Alex cut off both Beerus and Whis by stating,
"He told us to make our wish, but like the Namekians there's a certain language that we need to use when making it. Thankfully I don't need to worry about that." When he said that Alex stepped forward to make the wish he wanted, while Beerus and Whis muttered to each other behind him,
"It appears we're unneeded here lord Beerus." Whis said as if he were distraught, to which Beerus replied,
"Who cares, at least we don't need to do anything ourselves now, though I am curious what Alex is going to wish for." As he said that everyone focused their attention on Alex, curious as to what he wanted that they needed this particular set of Dragon Balls for it.
Surprisingly though, Alex asked for something that none of them were expecting.
"I wish...." Alex began normally, though it was being translated for the projection of the dragon. "....for a planet."
"""HUH!?!"""
Everyone was dumbfounded when they heard that, as why would Alex want a planet when he already had Asora? Within which they had even stolen Mars from the universe Moka, Sun, and Kurumu came from before terraforming it. Ignoring them though, Alex continued,
"I want it to be a habitable planet larger than any other in the twelve universes, filled with the most dangerous flora and fauna that can be found throughout all the universes. And I want it to be located within Universe Seven."
For a moment nothing happened, but then the projection of the golden dragon reared back and unleashed a mighty roar, before booming back at them,
"IT.....IS....DONE.....!"
The next thing they all knew they were back where they had been a moment before, and with a final flash of light, the seven Super Dragon Balls shot out in every direction as they were once more scattered throughout the twelve universes. With everything settling down once more, Beerus looked at Alex and said,
"Interesting wish, but why would you wish for a planet like that?" With everyone else looking at him questioningly, Alex smirked as he said coyly,
"Shouldn't we go to see it before you judge it?" Narrowing his eyes at him, Beerus remarked,
"Ok then, but if this appears to be a waste of my time I'll have you make up for it in other ways." Shaking his head at the Destruction God, Alex flicked his wrist to produce an entire buffet table of goodies that both Beerus and Goku immediately jumped into.
"It's like we have a second Goku..." Piccolo uttered as he watched Beerus eat, to which Alex shook his head as he replied,
"Not really. Goku's just a glutton, while Beerus likes to experience new tastes." The Destruction God then proceeded to throw his thumb up into the air, as if telling Alex the food was excellent while he made his way to the helm once again.
"Now then, onto our third destination!" Alex exclaimed as he used both the magic compass and Skeleton Key, which both Whis and Beerus paid attention to, before opening yet another portal to go through.
...
