Once through the portal they could see a world that looked nothing like any other planet any of them had ever seen, including Beerus.
Firstly the planet itself was nearly the size of a star, which it would need to in order to dwarf any other planet within all twelve of the universes. And secondly, even from space, they could all notice entire sections of the planet that differed from the others to match the numerous foreign habitats and environments that were needed to support the creatures that lived there.
"Hmmm how interesting." Whis remarked as he used the gem at the top of his staff to analyze the planet, after a moment of which he said,
"Indeed, this planet is in fact home to both flora and fauna from all across the twelve universes, and as a result it has the most diverse habitats and environments I've ever seen, to the point that even the gravity differs by region depending on the actual gravity from the original world. Also, there doesn't seem to be any 'intelligent' life anywhere on the planet."
While everyone else was paying close attention to Whis' report regarding the planet, one person in particular seemed to get excited as he exclaimed,
"So this world has different levels of gravity and the most dangerous creatures from all over the universes on it? Then it must be a really great place to train!" As one, everyone looked in Goku's direction as he said that, before they all collectively face palmed as Moka uttered,
"Of course. It's a world to use for training, isn't it?" Alex nodded with a broad smile as he said,
"Yep, a world unlike any other that can be considered to have the most hostile and dangerous environment there is. A primal world if you will, that I think would suit the name Pangea." Everyone mused on that for a moment, though the true meaning of the word Pangea was lost on those who hadn't come from the cookie-cutter modern earth, there was still something they liked about it.
"Now then, let's land on Pangea!" Alex exclaimed as he directed Zenith towards the new world, before adding,
"Whis, can you find a place for us to set down that's relatively safe?" As the angel had been analyzing the planet since earlier, he quickly replied,
"Of course! I believe I already found a suitable place over here that appears to be the safest region, and even has the same level of gravity as on earth." Nodding in affirmation, Alex guided Zenith in the direction Whis indicated on the massive planet.
As they got closer to the surface of Pangea, everyone on deck began 'ooh'ing and 'aw'ing at the alien sights of the freshly made world. From the vibrantly colored plants, the completely alien animals that looked nothing like what any of them had seen, to the completely new environments and natural wonders.
There were stone spires that rose up miles into the sky, creating a world of their own as vegetation sprawled out between them, winding rivers wove around them even in midair, and creatures went about their business as they all fought for survival.
"I believe those are the octa lemurs and grapple gliders of Universe Three." Whis commentated as they passed a group of alien monkeys with six arms, and then a flock of large bird-like things with barbed hooks on their wings.
"Oh wow! Animals from another universe!" Lala exclaimed excitedly, before proceeding to take numerous pictures to send to her little sister, Nana.
What followed was an ongoing commentary as Whis named each creature they passed, while everyone admired the scenery and Alex piloted Zentih, until they began to get attacked by some of the animals.
"Wow, you weren't kidding about some of the strongest creatures in the universes..." Krillin grumbled as he and Tien returned to the deck after fighting off some creatures that tried to turn them into lunch, a massive monster centipede this time that had an nearly impossibly hard exoskeleton.
"That one took seven Destructo Disks to take down!" Krillin bemoaned as he slumped down with his back against the railing, closing his eyes as he tried to catch his breath.
"Dude..." Tien uttered next to him, making Krillin open his eyes as he looked to see what Tien was talking about.
"What the...?" He too uttered in disbelief, as they watched four of Alex girls utterly dismantle anything unfortunate enough to caught in their path.
On one side was the ponytailed girl who introduced herself as Shizuku, who was currently clad entirely in shadows and had a dog-like appearance, as she readily slashed through the swarms of lesser creatures that tried to attack them with scythes made of shadow. Then there was the girl dressed in armor, Erza, who wielded hundreds of swords as if they were extensions of her own body, as anything that tried to attack them from the skies was instantly shredded.
Then, down on the ground, was the combination of Shia and Moka. They were the ones who made the most impact on the Dragon Team, as they single handedly slaughtered anything unfortunate enough to cross their path with overwhelming power. Shia would twirl her giant hammer around her at high speeds to turn anything that got close to her into paste, while Moka's legs moved with deadly precision to either smash apart her opponents, or send blades of blood to eviscerate anything they hit.
As the Dragon Team watched the four girls viciously slaughter their opponents with ease, Piccolo grunted,
"To think, there were people who fought like this..." He then glanced over at the rest of Alex's girls, who hadn't made a single move since the moment the animals around them began to attack.
Instead, they had set up a picnic table and were calmly enjoying themselves with snacks and beverages while taking in the sights, while the silver haired maid and girl with white hair attended them. Even when a serpent large enough to rival Shenron appeared and was about to swallow them, none of the girls even reacted before Shizuku sliced its head off with one of her scythes.
"Hey, don't let them get so close next time~Nya." Kuroka stated irritably, to which Shia shouted back,
"Then maybe YOU should come out here yourself you lazy cat!" The teacup Kuroka was holding shattered when she heard that, before she slowly stood up with an ominous aura surrounding her body.
"It's far past time I taught you to respect your 'Queen', you stupid bunny. Prepare yourself!" Kuroka declared without her verbal tick as her body immediately vanished, before she reappeared right next to Shia and thrust an open palm directly into her abdomen.
Shia's body was then blasted away with an unprecedented force that sent her flying clear out into space itself. Then, with a wave of her hand, Kuroka bent space itself to put Shia right back next to her for another attack that sent the rabbit-girl flying in the opposite direction her body was going before.
"Wow, that cat-girl looks tough." Bardock observed from Zenith's deck, taking the chance to study the way Alex's wives fought.
"Well she should be. Despite her attitude, Kuroka IS our 'Queen' after all." Sun said as she leaned against the railing, drawing everyone's attention due to her melodious voice before the sounds of Kuroka and Shia's battle drew their gazes back to them.
"So does being the 'Queen' mean she's the strongest out of all of you?" Future Bulma asked curiously, which earned her numerous sour looks from the rest of the girls, though none of them could argue it when Sun continued,
"Well, it depends on the circumstances. But I would have to say that she is since Kuroka is able to control both Space and Time as if it were natural, plus she has mastered many types of magic, and is one of the most powerful users of any energy manipulation techniques there is."
"Energy manipulation?" Master Roshi asked curiously, to which Sun ticked off one by one,
"Firstly is Senjutsu, which allows its users to directly attack a person's own internal energies and even their life force, along with several other uses such as healing, reading their opponents movements, or even directly influencing the opponents bodies. Then there is Youjutsu, which is a type of magic that typically involves manipulating your surroundings with numerous types of techniques, such as poisons, barriers, illusions, and elemental manipulation.
"Then there is Touki, which is used in attacking and self defense similar to your and Alex's use of Ki, though not necessarily in those big and flashy blasts you all like to use. Then on top of the purification techniques she uses, Kuroka has also studied the numerous types of magic and techniques that she's encountered from the world's she's been to.
"Creation magic, Gravity magic, Spatial magic, Regeneration magic, Spirit Magic, Evolution magic, Alteration magic, Conception magic, the numerous Youjutsu techniques that she's learned from the Dark Lord, Touhou Fuhai. All of these make Kuroka truly a force to be reckoned with, and someone I would never want to have to fight seriously."
As she finished listing off all the reason Kuroka would be a tough opponent, the fight between her and Shia had finished as the rabbit-girl lost decisively due to the numerous techniques at her disposal, even if her actual physical strength was far below Shia's.
"And is this how people fight where you're all from?" Piccolo asked her with narrowed eyes, but before Sun could reply Alex interjected,
"There's so many different ways to fight, that it'd be stupid to try and criticize someone for the path they chose to pursue strength. Not everyone is able or willing to use the cookie-cutter style that you all like in this universe. I mean, screaming your head off to raise your powerlevels is fine and all, but it definitely limits what you're able to do. Well, you'll all see during the tournament."
Leaving the conversation at that, Alex finally directed Zenith's bow towards the ground in the area Whis said was 'relatively' safe. A pastoral region with rolling green hills and fields, as well as stretch of ocean right next to them.
Meanwhile Kuroka and Shia rejoined them, the former with her nose high in the air as she gloated with her 'superiority' over the latter.
"This..." Alex began as he leapt off the side of Zenith and planted his feet on Pangean soil for the first time. "... Is where we'll set up our base of operations in this universe!"
The girls were all immediately alert as Yuna asked,
"You're not going to place the gate to Asora on Earth?" Alex shook his head as he explained,
"No. I plan to make Pangea the home of any who seek strength in this universe, a planet who's very existence is to encourage those who live on her to grow. We'll make this area the only safe place on the entire planet, and even host the tournament here while also establishing a city to act in support for those who seek strength! We can even establish smaller gates leading to worlds all over Universe Seven, allowing the people who wish to to travel here whenever they want!"
As Alex continued on with his plans for Pangea, the girls just smiled wryly as they listened. A few however, Rias and Grayfia, were already contacting teams in Asora in preparation to make Alex's intentions a reality in a matter of a few short days, while Anne was also notified so that she could start collecting samples of the flora on this planet for her work as well. Hajime and the Grigori would also need to be notified so they could prepare the gate on this world for travel between Pangea and Asora, as well as a hundred other things that would need to be done.
First of all though, was making the region safe enough for them to work in. A fact that stared every single person in the face as the sea near them began to roil and churn, before a massive slimy head with glowing red eyes rose up to glare at all of them.
"Let's get to work." Alex said as he personally prepared to deal with the sea creature.

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - 455: Pupil
chapters.content:
In the days following Pangea's creation, quite a bit happened both on the planet and within Asora.
Firstly was Goku taking off with his father and brother to go train, all three of which wanted to take advantage of Pangea's brutal environment to become as powerful as possible. Much to Chichi's dismay as she confirmed that she was in fact pregnant.
Then, the day after Goku disappeared with his father and brother, Yamcha, Tien, Chiaotzu, and Krillin all took off as well to also train to become stronger. The last ones to leave were the Vegeta family, as Trunks and Vegeta Sr waited on Jr to recover from the punishment Alex inflicted on him until they too left.
What they hadn't expected though, was that Vegeta himself disappeared at some point within the night without anyone realizing it. Though Alex could have easily located him with the magic compass, the former king and Trunks decided not to do so, trusting Vegeta to survive Pangea's hostile environment despite being weakened, and believing that this was a good chance for him to work things out for himself.
Of course, what Alex didn't tell any of them was that he had designed the seals he placed on Vegeta's body to break under the right conditions. This meant that there was quite the chance of Vegeta breaking the seals on his own, and regaining his strength before the tournament.
One person who didn't journey to train themselves though, was Grant. Rather than training his Saiyan abilities like the others were, Grant had decided to further refine his Zanpakutō for the time being due to it being something utterly unique to him.
To do this, he was spending all of his time training in Asora with other sword users, and with Alex specifically as he wielded Ascalon any chance they got. Unfortunately though Alex was often too busy to spar with Grant, due to establishing a base of operations on Pangea.
Firstly they needed to establish numerous barriers to ensure that the area around the gate was safe, both for the people that would be living there and to ensure nothing got through the gate into Asora. Secondly they needed to actually build the base itself, which mostly meant housing for those who lived there to train, as well as a few small businesses to support them.
This had been the easy part though, as devil technology and magic allowed them to build at impossible speeds, establishing literally an entire city where there had been nothing the morning before. Then came the gates, which would allow people from all over the universe to come to Pangea to train.
The first gates of course were the ones leading to Earth and Asora, followed swiftly by the gate leading to the planet of the Kai's, and then New Namek. After that was Sephie's job, as the former queen of Deviluke traveled throughout the universe to establish diplomatic relations with the leaders of the various planets, as well as the galactic King of the Milky Way Galaxy.
Accompanying Sephie to protect her from any threats, like space thugs, was Shia and Shizuku. Even if they were to encounter someone on the level of Frieza, Alex had the utmost confidence in Shia being able to defend them due to her constant training with him in his SSJ4 form.
What surprised Alex was that Beerus was also putting in a fair amount of work, spending his days training Rias before visiting a planet or two to, as Alex put it, 'put the fear of God into them'. Though he hadn't actually Destroyed any of them, Beerus was making it very clear to the inhabitants of every planet he visited how much value he placed on the upcoming tournament.
Each of the five Supreme Kai's were busy as well, as the four Alex 'revived' worked to catch up on everything that had happened ever since they had been consumed by Majin Buu. Shin, the Eastern Supreme Kai, had readily returned his position to the Grand Supreme Kai after his return, and returned to governing only the Eastern quadrant of the universe as he once had.
With Pangea coming along nicely, and word of the tournament spreading, Alex was able to relax as he decided to spend some much needed time with his children, his new student, and a certain someone else.
...
"Hey Gohan! Good job on that last test!" One of the male students called out suddenly in the cafeteria, drawing the attention of the other boy in question.
"Thats right! My Gohan is the smartest there is!" Brunch proudly exclaimed before Gohan himself had a chance to answer, clinging to his arm as she did so.
"Let him breath Brunch. Gohan won't be able to do much of anything if you suffocate him so much." One of the other girls from their class said teasingly, but Brunch pretended to ignore her as she continued nuzzling Gohan's side.
Gohan meanwhile could only laugh awkwardly as he tried to continue eating his lunch, despite Brunch's closeness. This continued until there was a disturbance around them, prompting both Gohan and Brunch to look back and see Alex standing there.
"Hey. Got time for a walk?" He asked the young Saiyan.
...
A short while later found Alex strolling atop a mountain range with Gohan at his side, watching as the sun sank lower into the sky.
"So, what do you think so far Gohan?" Alex asked the young Saiyan after a while, only to be answered with a length of silence before he finally said,
"It's amazing here, but I still feel bad for leaving the way I did..." As he said that Gohan recalled his mother, and how much she was against him going to Asora to attend the Academy. Alex however smiled wryly as he replied,
"As extreme as your mother is, she just wants the best for you. What she doesn't realize though is that the best way to ensure that your child succeeds is to simply support them from behind, not to try and force them into the mold you've created for them." Gohan looked at Alex curiously at that, before asking,
"What about my dad?" This time Alex was silent for a moment before asking in return,
"Gohan, why do you train and fight?" The young Saiyan cocked his head curiously at that, as he asked confusedly,
"What do you mean?"
Instead of answering immediately, Alex picked up a fist sized rock, and threw it with enough force that it landed in a lake in the distance with a great splash. He then explained,
"I train myself because I love fighting strong opponents, because it will help me achieve my goals, and to ensure that those I care about are always protected. Why do you train?"
Gohan was silent as he tried to think about almost his entire life up until this point.
Initially his mother had adamantly refused to let his father start training him, but, after he died in the fight with Raditz, Piccolo basically kidnapped him and forced him to grow stronger in preparation for Vegeta and Nappa's arrival. Then, he had traveled to Namek with Krillin and Bulma to use their Dragon Balls and bring back everyone who had been killed by the attacking Saiyans.
After that Gohan had spent the next year and a half studying like his mother wanted, as they awaited his father's return after his battle with Frieza on Namek. However, the arrival of Trunks and his warning from the future spurred his father into talking his mother into allowing him to train in order to combat the threat. And after that, the two of them sealed themselves in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber in order to help him learn the Super Saiyan transformation.
"I train to fight whoever threatens my family." Gohan eventually answered, earning him a nod from Alex as he then stated,
"Exactly. You've always trained exclusively to face whatever threat is ahead. Your dad on the other hand learned martial arts from his grandfather, your namesake, Son Gohan. He learned it as a way of life, and survival."
Alex then looked Gohan directly in the eye as he said,
"Your father trained martial arts because he always wanted to test himself, to grow stronger. Protecting and helping others who needed it was simply a byproduct of growing stronger, a sense of responsibility regarding the strength he'd gained. And when he finally won the World Martial Arts Tournament, he retired in order to live peacefully with your mother, and you once you were born.
"It wasn't until your uncle, Raditz, showed up that Goku returned to the fight once again, and from there everything cascaded until you get to the current situation. But, despite all of that, your father's goal has never changed. What drives him isn't JUST the intention of protecting the Earth and the people he cares about, but the goal of pushing his strength as far as possible and testing his limits every chance he gets. And as far as I can tell, your father believed that you felt the same way about fighting as him."
As Alex finished speaking Gohan looked away as he tried to wrap his head around everything he had heard, and search his feelings regarding fighting himself. Eventually, he asked Alex,
"Do you teach your kids how to fight as well?" Alex chuckled at that as he said,
"Of course, but I don't expect them to dedicate their lives to it. If they want to then it's fine, but all I want out of my children is that they can defend themselves if they ever need, it, and that they could live happily." As he said that Alex got a faraway look in his eyes as he imagined his children, fully grown and living fulfilling lives of their own, a thought that was both exciting and sad.
Next to him though, Gohan was similarly thinking on everything Alex said to him. Truthfully he had only ever considered becoming a civil servant like his mother wanted, even if he trained with his father and became stronger. However that was his mother's dream, not his own.
Now that he was able to take charge of his own life though, Gohan didn't know what to make of it as everything had always been decided for him before. Eventually he said,
"I don't know what I want to do...." Though he expected Alex to be disappointed by him saying such a thing, Gohan was surprised to see him nodding with a warm smile before saying,
"That's understandable, I mean you're only eleven after all. You still have many years yet to think about what you'd like to do with your future, and the kind of person who you'd like to become. Just remember to decide something that will allow you to live your life without regrets, no matter what it is you chose." Silence permeated the mountaintop as Gohan thought on Alex's advice, which neither one broke as they watched the sun slowly sink lower.
***
After returning Gohan to the dormitory, and night fell on Asora, Alex returned to the Misty Manor to find his children anxiously awaiting his arrival, along with his new student.
"This is where you'll be doing the majority of your training." Alex said to Videl as he led her to a certain room in the manor, which merely had a series of glass orbs within it.
"A bunch of glass balls?" She asked confusedly, as she hadn't yet been in there. Alex however shook his head as he instructed her,
"Place your hand on that orb over there." Pointing to the one that was the largest out of them, Videl hesitantly did as Alex bid while the other children watched her every move.
The moment she placed her hand on the warm and smooth glass though, Videl suddenly felt her surroundings shift as she felt like she was being pulled forward by her hand. With her eyes firmly shut, Videl didn't know what was happening until she felt her feet impact solid ground once more, but then she hesitated to open her eyes.
Slowly though she became aware of numerous things that were impossible, such as the warm breeze she felt on her face, and the sound of waves crashing in the distance.
"Welcome Videl...." Alex voice suddenly said, prompting her to slowly open her eyes and see where she was. "...to the space-time orb." When she finally took in her surroundings though, Videl was stunned to see a large castle-like villa before her, surrounded on all sides by the sparkling blue ocean.
"Sorry for not telling you, but papa said he wanted you to rest for a few days before coming here." Myuu suddenly said, surprising Videl out of her reverie as she turned to see the rest of the children appearing behind her.
"What is this place?" Videl asked curiously, to which Myuu explained in her papa's place,
"It's the space-time orb, a place where space and time are both being controlled. All of this is within that small glass orb you touched earlier, and while we're in here time flows faster, so that a month in here is a normal day outside." Nodding in affirmation, Alex continued,
"We use this orb to get more time out of a normal day, spending our nights in here to train and do anything else that we can't do during the day. So after a day outside, we typically spend about a week in here overnight." As he said that, Alex led the group down the long bridge connecting the villa and the pavilion where the other sub space orbs were.
Eventually he continued,
"I've been letting you rest after the abuse you put your body though before, but now your new life officially begins. During the days you'll start attending the Academy along with Myuu, and at nights you'll come in here with the rest of us to train in martial arts." Alex then went on to explain some of the specifics regarding the space-time orb and the Academy, but Videl barely heard him as she continued looking at everything around her curiously.
What surprised her was that there was a lot of people in the villa that greeted them as they walked by, all of which were incredibly beautiful women. Some were dressed in maid outfits, others in armor, while others were dressed in weird clothes that she had never seen before.
The first place they went to was a courtyard filled with numerous long tables to eat on, which were all already laden with small mountains of food. Bringing even more out was a girl with wavy black hair that appeared to be only a few years older than Videl, who greeted Alex with a kiss, as he said,
"Hello Mikan, what's on the menu tonight?" The girl, Mikan, then listed each and every dish that was already on the tabled, as well as the numerous dishes that were still being brought out from the kitchen by many other women.
What followed was perhaps the weirdest dinner that Videl had ever had, as many of the women she had seen around the villa gathered to eat, yet there was not a single other man aside from Alex, and his sons. Instead, each of the women greeted Alex with a loving kiss or flirty look, similar to the one she had always seen women direct towards her father.
And then despite how much food they actually had before them, every single bite was consumed by Alex, his children, and the women as if they were all starving, though the women ate elegantly compared to the former two.
Then, after all of the food was gone, another woman with bobcat straight blue hair appeared with a cake in her arms. With her ALSO greeting Alex with a kiss, she then set the cake down in front of Videl while saying,
"I made this to properly greet our newest resident, and Alex's first formal student." On the cake was large swirling letters written in frosting that stated 'WELCOME VIDEL!'
What followed was a blur to Videl as many women who hadn't met her yet greeted her in various ways, from offering her their condolences about her father, to telling her to come to them if she ever needed anything. And everywhere she looked was smiling faces, most of which had looks of understanding or sympathy in their eyes as they looked at her.
Eventually she found herself in the bath with the vast majority of the other women, while Alex was in a separate bath with his children and their mothers, where a girl who called herself Asia was helping to wash her hair and scrub her back. Next to them was another girl called Erza, who was offering to teach Videl how to use weapons to use along with her martial arts, when Videl finally uttered,
"Why?" The girls around her looked at Videl curiously when they heard, before Asia asked,
"Why what?" Videl then whirred around to face her so hard that her wet hair whipped, and shouted,
"WHY IS EVERYONE BEING SO NICE TO ME!?!" By this point Videl had the attention of everyone in the bath, while Asia tilted her head in confusion as she asked,
"Why wouldn't we be nice to you?" Videl clenched her fists in frustration at the question as she again shouted,
"I PLAN TO KILL ALEX SOMEDAY! THATS WHY!"
Silence stretched at Videl's declaration, as literally hundreds of women stared at her, before Asia smiled warmly as she asked,
"Oh? Is that all?" Her words were then followed by numerous giggles and comments from the other women, several of which were them wishing Videl luck in her endeavor before they turned back to their own conversations.
This however only made Videl even more frustrated as she snapped,
"What? Do you all think I can't do it?" This time however Videl was surprised as Asia said its a giggle,
"Not at all, it's just that someone wanting to kill Alex isn't exactly news around here." Videl cocked her head in confusion at that, until another young looking girl approached her and said,
"Yeah! Let's murder that bastard together!"
"KYUUU!" Cried out a small cute-looking bat that was perched atop her head, as if cheering her on.
"Wha-" Videl uttered in confusion, as she never expected someone who would actually offer to help her kill her father's killer, before the girl eagerly grabbed her shoulders and continued,
"I'm ready whenever you are! I can't wait to pay that bastard back for all the pain and humiliation he's put me and my poor butt-"
*SMASH!*
The girl was suddenly cut off as someone kicked her square in the gut, a beautiful silver haired woman who radiated an aura of maturity, before she said while tucking a strand of hair behind her ear.
"Watch your mouth in present company Kokoa, Videl is still a child!" As she declared that, the silver haired woman raised her leg straight up in the air, apparently not caring about how exposed that made her, before bringing her heel down onto Kokoa's head, smashing it into the concrete beneath their feet.
As this happened the girls around them watched as if they were seeing a particularly amusing show, before going back to their own business when Kokoa's face impacted the ground.
"I-is she still alive?" Videl hesitantly asked as she tried to back away, to which the silver haired woman calmly said,
"It'll take more than that to kill her." Then, as if to prove her point, the woman used her foot to flip Kokoa's body over so she was facing up at them, except her eyes appeared unfocused as a steady stream of blood flowed from her nose, and she uttered in an almost incoherent voice,
"Onee-Sama's special pace.... Onee-Sama's special place...."
Grimacing in disgust, the woman wrapped an arm around Videl's shoulders as she tried to guide her away while saying,
"Let's go, there should be a better spot over there away from her."
As both the woman, who Videl learned was called Moka, and Asia guided her away from Kokoa, Moka said,
"You shouldn't take what Kokoa was saying to heart. That girl is the type that doesn't know when to stop, no matter how pointless it is. And even if she won't admit it to anyone, or even herself, she does love her...sparring matches...against Alex."
As Moka was talking the trio settled into one of the smaller baths, where the only other person was a girl Videl recognized from dinner as Yami. However Yami appeared to pointedly ignore them as she didn't even glance up from the book she was reading, even in the bath.
"Is it really not that strange that there are people here who would want to kill Alex though?" Videl asked as they soaked in the hot water, which surprisingly made Moka smirk with amusement as she stated,
"Not really, and taking in and training someone who wants to kill him IS the kinda thing Alex would do." Asia nodded in agreement as she said,
"Yep, Alex can be really hard handed sometimes... But who knows, you may change your mind after spending some time here Videl." When she heard that Videl began to glower as she muttered,
"He killed my father..... I will never forgive him for it...." Even as she said that though, Asia just sighed while making a 'it can't be helped' expression, before asking Moka about the newly established Pangea.
***
The next morning Videl found herself being shaken awake by Myuu, who was already up and dressed in her training gear, as the Dagon woman said to her,
"Get up Videl, it's time to start our training!" Rubbing the sleep from her eyes, Videl rose from bed as she asked while glancing out at the still dark skies,
"What time is it?"
"It's time to train silly." Myuu repeated, before pointing to a chair and saying,
"Papa prepared some training clothes for you over there. Hurry and get ready so everyone isn't waiting on you." Leaving it at that, Myuu then left Videl in her newly appointed room after pointing out to her a stack of clothes for her to wear. A white gi with a black undershirt, and matching black shorts.
After getting ready Videl rushed out to the courtyard, where she found Alex waiting with Myuu and several of his children that had already started training, with the youngest being Ryuuto and Shuri at just barely over two.
Just as Videl was wondering if this was supposed to be some kind of joke, Alex called out,
"Ok, now that Videl's here is everyone ready?"
"""Yeah!""" The children responded the second the words left their father's mouth, before every single one, except for Myuu, sprouted some type of wings and took off into the sky. Meanwhile the pint-sized Dagon simply lifted up into the air as she used her energy to fly.
"Let's go." Alex said to Videl, before grabbing the still stunned girl around the midsection.
"Wait! What are you doing!? Put me down! Put me down!" Videl shrieked while kicking her feet and hitting him with her fists, until Alex walked to the edge of the villa and she saw the sheer drop right in front of them.
"DON'T PUT ME DOWN! DON'T PUT ME DOWN!" Videl immediately changed her tone as she then tried to cling to Alex's body like a spider monkey, gripping his fur hard enough it was a wonder she didn't rip it out in chunks.
Chuckling in response to her extreme reaction, Alex then proceeded to step off of the ledge, making Videl scream at the top of her lungs even after he began flying through the air. Even when he touched down on the island where the kids did their training less than five minutes later, Videl refused to let go of Alex's fur as her entire shook like a frightened cat's.
"You can let go now Videl..." Alex said to her gently, but Videl just shook her head while keeping her face buried in his fur, too scared to chance looking out to see.
"No fair! I wanna ride on daddy too!" Edith cried out at the injustice, which was when Videl finally peeked out to see that they were in fact on solid ground once again.
It was also then when Videl noticed just how tightly she had been holding onto Alex, while the man himself was simply looking down at her with a warm smile.
"GET AWAY FROM ME!"
Videl shrieked with a crimson red face as she released her hold on him, and fell down on her butt.
"Ouch..." She grumbled while rubbing her now sore butt, making Alex chuckle at her expense while the rest of his children swarmed him asking for a ride. As he was trying to pacify them though, Myuu slyly walked up to Videl and asked her with a teasing voice,
"So, how'd you like being held by papa Videl?" Hearing the way Myuu put it, Videl's face turned even redder as she quickly sputtered,
"I-I-I felt disgusted! That's how!" Despite her denials though, Myuu's smirk just widened as Videl's face reddened even more, while she desperately looked anywhere else with her eyes.
Thankfully though, before Myuu could tease her some more, Alex clapped his hands loudly before barking,
"Alright! That's enough horsing around. Let's get to work!" Immediately all of the children stopped fooling around as they recognized their father entering his 'teacher' mode, making Videl also straighten up despite her still red cheeks.
"Alright, let's begin our lap!" Alex declared, before he took off at a light jogging pace with the rest of the children following him in a line. Taking up the rear was both Videl and Myuu, as the former still wasn't sure about this training, though it couldn't be THAT bad if children as young as Ryuuto and Shuri were doing it, right?
Myuu meanwhile decided to run alongside Videl, because she knew from personal experience that her papa's pupil wouldn't be able to even finish this part of the training without help.
At first Videl thought it wasn't so bad as Alex led them out of the pavilion they started in, and down to the nearby lake.
"Is that where we're stopping?" Videl asked Myuu in between her breaths, to which the Dagon just smiled wryly.
Then, Alex led the children in a loop AROUND the lake until they were right back where they first arrived to it.
"NOW we're stopping, right?" Videl asked Myuu again, except this time she had started to pant tiredly due to having never ran so much at once before.
"Nope." Myuu said simply as Alex then led them away from the lake, and towards a dense thicket of trees.
They then wove between the trees on a well worn trail for several minutes until the trunks began to thin, by which point both of Videl's sides were aching from the continuous running. Her suffering wasn't anywhere close to ending though, as they finally exited the thicket and she saw a tall mountain ahead of them.
"Please don't tell me..." She uttered in despair to Myuu, who simply nodded as she said,
"Yep."
Videl then could only watch despairingly as Alex and all of his children proceeded to run up the slopes leading to trail that would take them to the peak of the seemingly massive mountain.
...
"Ok, is everyone here?" Alex asked without even sounding out of breath as they crested the peak of the mountain, where a small monument of stones was standing. However a quick glance told him that they were still waiting on someone, as a breathless Videl slowly clawed her way up the mountain with Myuu by her side.
"F....f...finally..." Videl gasped out as she collapsed onto her back, her arms and legs sprawled out to either side as her chest heaved up and down. If she were able to actually look around though, then Videl would have noticed that not even Ryuuto or Shuri were out of breath from the morning jog.
Instead, she just closed her eyes, the dirt and rocks beneath her feeling uncommonly comfortable as she contemplated passing out right then and there. Before Videl could pass out though, she sensed and felt someone moving up to her head, prompting her to reluctantly peel her eyelids open to see a cute face framed by snow-white hair looking down on her from above, a pair of similarly colored cat-like ears protruding from her pure white locks.
"Do you need some help?" The girl, Mai, asked innocently. And though Videl wanted to say no, she still couldn't catch her breach enough to say so, so Mai simply helped herself as she sat down and moved Videl's head into her lap.
"Mommy taught me this~Nyan." Mai explained poorly as she placed her hands on either side of Videl's head, leaving no room for Videl to protest whatever she was about to do next.
What DID happen though caught Videl by surprise, as she felt a sort of energy fill her that wasn't there before, and her breath quickly began to slow to a steady and controlled pace. A minute later Mai smiled down at her innocently as she asked,
"Better?" Instead of answering though, Videl slowly rose until she was sitting, and asked Mai warily,
"What did you do to me?" Mai tilted her head to the side cutely, as if she were confused by Videl's question, before answering with a smile,
"I used my Senjutsu to help your body feel better faster~Nya! You should also have more energy now Videl." As she slowly stood up Videl couldn't help but to notice that Mai was right about her body feeling more energized and refreshed than she ever recalled it feeling before. And so, it was with a sheepish look on her face that Videl looked down at the still smiling cat-girl, and said,
"Thanks..." Despite her awkwardness though, Mai beamed at Videl's gratitude as she went back to Edith's side. This time though Alex approached her, making Videl put her guard up before he pointed at the pile of stones and said,
"We started a sort of tradition here, where when someone starts their training they add a stone to the pile. You should go ahead and add your own." Blinking in surprise, Videl looked around to see everyone else looking at her expectantly as they waited for her to add her own stone to the cairn.
Feeling like she was being put on the spot with everyone staring at her so intensely, Videl quickly picked up a decent size stone, without minding its shape, and placed it on top of the pile so that it was just a little bit taller than it had been when they arrived. As she did so Alex stealthily used his magic, like he would whenever another stone was added to the cairn, which would prevent the stones from falling regardless of how they were stacked.
He then placed a hand on Videl's head, ruffling her hair slightly while she tried to swat his hand away, and declared,
"Alright, now let's start the next warmup!" Videl's entire body became alert as she hesitantly asked,
"W-warm up?" Alex nodded as he stated,
"Yep, that was just the first part of everyone's warm ups. We still have to skip to that Mountain top, then zigzag through that jungle until we reach that one, before swimming through that bay, and then finally returning to the villa by walking on our hands from the shore. Now let's go!" Once again leading the group, Alex started skipping down the mountain with each of the children excitedly following him, while Videl seriously began to think that she wouldn't survive this training...
...
By the time they returned to the villa, Videl felt more exhausted than she ever did in her entire life, and this was just the warm ups.
Then, making her feel even worse, the rest of the children quickly broke up into groups to begin their REAL training. Some began sparring with each other, in which Videl witnessed a battle on the scale of which children shouldn't be capable of, others started strength training, lifting weights in the hundreds or even thousands like they were nothing, while the rest had begun training their magic and other abilities with their mothers.
After giving her some time to recover and catch her breath though, Alex approached Videl and said,
"Ok, now it's time we began the first stage of your training, controlling energy."
"Energy?" Videl asked warily, to which Alex nodded as he explained,
"Yes, energy. Every single living being possess it, but only those who train extensively can learn how to use it. Depending on the universe you're in though, the name they use for energy and the way they use it varies, Ki, Chi, Chakra, Haki, Touki, Senjutsu, and so on and so forth. There are also varying types of energy as well, such as Magic, Youkai, Demonic, Holy, Draconic, Divine, and so on and so forth again.
"Now for the time being though you'll only be learning how to use Ki energy, and there are several that you wouldn't be able to use regardless of how much you try, so we'll put off learning about those ones for the future." As Alex paused Videl immediately furrowed her brows as she asked testily,
"If I can't use them then why bother learning about them?" Alex then surprised Videl by asking in return,
"What is the most important thing when fighting?" The words were barely out of his mouth when Videl leapt to her feet and declared,
"Strength!"
"Wrong!" Alex said as he lightly chopped the top of Videl's head, making her rub it as she looked at him ruefully.
"How's it wrong? You need to be strong in order to fight!" She stated firmly, to which Alex shook his head as he replied,
"Not true, there's plenty of people who can fight without 'strength'. Instead they might fight with magic, speed, or even a special technique that makes strength useless." Videl glowered at Alex's answer, seemingly not impressed, before she spat at him,
"Then what is it that's most important?" Alex smiled wryly as he lightly poked the middle of Videl's forehead, and said,
"It's knowledge. If you truly KNOW your opponent, how they fight, the way they move, their little ticks and tricks, then you can KNOW how to defeat them. That's why I intend to eventually teach you about the different forms of energy use and fighting, so that you can know how to fight those who use them even if you can't."
Videl was silent as she absorbed this, even as she vigorously rubbed her forehead as if Alex had 'contaminated' it with his touch, before she finally said,
"Ok, let's start then!"
***
The next several days followed the same routine for Videl, waking up early to start on their 'warm ups', and then energy training with Alex afterwards for a couple of hours. Once she and the rest of the children concluded their training for the day, then they would be able to enjoy free time doing basically whatever, though more often than not the children would insist on spending time with their father.
Then, in the evenings they would get together with the hundreds of women in the space-time orb for dinner, followed by a daily bath. Afterwards Videl would then receive daily Senjutsu treatments from Mai's mother, an extremely busty and mature looking woman called Koneko, which would hopefully help her learn to sense and control her own energy faster.
Then several days after she began this routine, Videl was surprised when the rest of children suddenly disappeared, leaving her and Myuu alone on the island they did their training on. She then heard from Alex,
"For the rest of the 'night' outside the space-time orb, the children will be asleep in their beds in the Misty Manor so I can spend some quality time with my wives. Lately Myuu has been staying the rest of the night in here as well, but the two of you cannot leave the island during that time. Ok?" Though Videl wanted to ask what the heck this was all about, Myuu readily replied,
"Ok papa! We'll be good!" Alex nodded in affirmation as he said with a serious tone,
"I trust you will, I don't want to have to punish you again Myuu." When she head that Myuu shuddered at the memory, leaving Videl to imagine the worse case of Alex directly abusing the Dagon.
"What was that about?" Videl asked as soon as Alex flew away, leaving her alone with Myuu on the island.
"Papa likes to do 'adult' stuff with all of the big sisters in the space-time orb, but can't when us kids are around. One time I tried spying on them, but papa caught me and spanked me so bad I couldn't sit for a week." As she said that Myuu rubbed her poor butt with an expression on horror as she recalled the memory.
Videl meanwhile was recalling how HER dad also spent a lot of time with many women, and asked Myuu,
"What do you mean by 'adult' stuff?" Myuu's aggrieved expression morphed into one of mischief at the question, as she then began whispering into Videl's ear about the things she saw that night.
Slowly Videl's face began turning pink, before her entire upper body turned bright red as she shouted,
"THATS GROSS!"
In the face of Videl's embarrassment though, Myuu just snickered like someone who played a successful prank.
...
Later that night, after finally falling asleep on the bed that she was using on the island, Videl was suddenly shaken awake by an excited Myuu.
"Videl! Videl! Wake up!"
"Wha-what is it?" Videl asked as she rubbed the sleep from her eyes, while also more than a little annoyed at Myuu for waking her up. However Myuu held up a strange orange orb, with a single red star in it, and excitedly said,
"I went to go spy on papa again, to learn for when I grow up, and overheard him talking about these things called Dragon Balls! Apparently they can grant any wish if you collect all seven of them!" Immediately Videl was wide awake as she asked,
"Can they bring back my dad?" Myuu however could only shrug her shoulders as she said,
"I don't know, but maybe! Let's go!"

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - 456: Myuu's Wish
chapters.content:
"Are you sure about this?" A very naked, sexy and distracting Asia asked Alex as she draped over the bed in a provocative manner, her legs splayed out in a way that only increased her natural seductiveness.
"Am I sure about what?" Alex asked back, while also wondering when exactly he'd lost his 'pure' and 'innocent' Asia.
The former nun pushed herself up with her elbows, strands of her blond hair falling in front of her face and breasts jiggling as she did so, before she clarified,
"About sending those two to find the Dragon Balls." Alex chuckled lightly at the question even as he played with the ass of the other woman laying next to him.
"Yeah, I'm sure. This could be a good opportunity for those two." The words were barely out of his mouth when the girl who's ass he was playing with spoke up,
"Is it true that you gave the Dragon Balls you created to Ophis?" When she heard that the naked form of one of Alex's favorite sex toys rose up, her bountiful breasts bouncing enticingly with her every move as she asked,
"Is that true? Is mine God the owner of thine's Dragon Balls master?" His eyes never leaving Tio's delicious looking nipples, Alex nodded as he said,
"Yep. I figured that since I'm away from Asora so often then I should give the Dragon Balls to someone who isn't, and that they would also need to either be equal to me or more powerful altogether. So naturally I decided to ask Ophis." The girls all looked intrigued when they heard that, while Alex was pretty sure that Tio was planning to go after the Dragon Balls next after the girls were done with them.
"And Ophis accepted?" Asia asked curiously, as she was one of the people closest to the dragon God due to her affinity with dragons in general.
"Yep, I was surprised as well. But Ophis said she wanted the chance to create her own dragon from scratch. Apparently she was growing more interested after meeting so many of my children..." Alex then shuddered from the look Ophis gave him when she said that, making him wonder if she'd been becoming interested in becoming a mother herself.
Alex then put the idea out of his head by turning his attention back to the plethora of naked beauties before him. Starting with one redhead in particular who currently had her ass in the air, with the cords of numerous toys sticking out of her plainly visible puckered hole, Alex purred as he caressed the cheeks of her presented rear,
"Are you ready Kokoa? I heard you were acting rather presumptuously earlier." The 'proud' and 'noble' vampire could only whimper in anticipation, before Alex began to brutally 'punish' her presented ass.
***
"Are you sure about this?" Videl parroted Asia unknowingly, as Myuu led the way with a magic compass in her hand, neither aware that they were doing exactly as Alex wanted.
Though Myuu was directing the compass to lead them to the other six Dragon Balls, both girls were surprised to see it lead them to a sub-space orb that had been built without either of them noticing in the pavilion.
"Since when was this here?" Videl asked curiously, to which Myuu replied after a moment of thinking,
"I remember asking papa if we could put more monsters on the island to train against, but he said it'd be too dangerous for anyone who just started training..." Though Videl didn't understand what Myuu was getting at, the Dagon recalled that her papa and his wives would use their own sub-space orbs to train with monsters that lived within them.
Growing even more excited by the second, Myuu readily placed her hand against the warm surface of the orb, vanishing within as she left Videl all alone.
"Wait! Don't leave me here alone!" Videl cried out, before she too placed her hand against the orb to be sucked within.
The next thing Videl knew, she was standing in the middle of yet another pavilion at the top of a great mountain, overlooking a great valley that was enshrouded in mist.
"Look at this Videl!" Myuu's voice suddenly cried out, tearing Videl away from the mystifying view to see several large paintings hanging on the pillars around them.
Each one depicted a different scene, a sweltering desert, dense jungles, frigid snowy plains, islands surrounded by blue oceans, towering cliffs that extended up past the clouds, endless plains of tall wavy grass, and treacherous looking swamps.
Larger than all of them though was a giant painting of a map, depicting each of the same habitats that were in the other painting, along with eight markers that were spread out amongst them. Curiously though, in the area that the girls deduced they were in, the marker next to it had a bright red flag on it.
"I think that's to say 'you are here'." Myuu suggested out loud, to which Videl could only nod in agreement since that seemed the most logical answer.
"I wonder what these paintings are for though?" Myuu added as she turned her attention back to them. Knowing her papa, there was a reason they were there instead of just being to look at.
When she tried touching the painting depicting the ocean though, Myuu was stunned as the image rippled at her touch.
"Woah!" She exclaimed while quickly retracting her hand, shock appearing on both her and Videl's faces.
"What was that?" Videl asked cautiously, while Myuu's smile was growing by the second.
"I think I know what those other markers are now!" Then, without explaining anything else, Myuu rushed directly into the painting of the beach, disappearing entirely while the painting itself rippled like a pool of water.
"Myuu!" Videl cried out in alarm, before bracing herself as she too dove into the painting, only to immediately feel pleasantly warm sand on her feet.
Looking around, Videl was in awe as the sound of seagulls crying filled her ears, accompanied by the crash of the waves. Then she was alerted by the sound of Myuu crying out in joy, as the other girl quickly stripped to her underwear before rushing into the surf.
"Come on Videl! The water is amazing!" She cried out joyously, her Dagon side rearing its head as she eagerly began diving to admire the coral reef a little ways off shore.
"Come back Myuu! That's dangerous!" Videl cried out, forgetting that Myuu was literally from a race that thrived in the ocean.
Naturally, her cries were ignored as Myuu continued enjoying the warm tropical water. Giving up after several minutes of yelling, Videl decided to explore the island she was on.
They had ended up within yet another pavilion with numerous paintings hanging from the pillars, except there wasn't a beach painting amongst them. Instead, there was a painting of a forested valley covered in fog, surrounded on all sides by towering mountains.
It didn't take a genius to figure out what the paintings were and how they worked, as they were obviously portals to the different areas within this sub-space, allowing those within it to travel to the different zones in an instant. As she was thinking about that though, Videl blinked before muttering to herself,
"Something must be wrong with me if even this doesn't faze me anymore..." She then thought back to when she first arrived at the Misty Manor, when Myuu had readily showed her all the 'impossible' things that she and her siblings were capable of doing.
"Videl!" Her reminiscing was then interrupted as Myuu called out her name, prompting Videl to look over to see the Dagon returning from the surf with an armload of various types of seafood, such as oysters, fish, and even a couple of crabs.
"Let's have lunch!" Myuu said as she dropped all of the gathered food onto the beach, before going to collect the materials needed for a fire.
...
A short while later, after Myuu showed Videl how to properly clean and prepare the food she caught, the duo were snacking as they discussed their game plan for collecting the rest of the Dragon Balls.
"I've already conformed there's one near here." Myuu said, surprising Videl as she asked,
"Really?!" Myuu nodded as she stood and walked over to the large map in the pavilion, and pointed to an area of the ocean near them that was shaded darker.
"It's in the bottom of this trench here, which I'm willing to bet is home any number of monsters that papa put in here." That made Videl cock her head in confusion as she asked,
"But, we haven't seen any monsters since we've been here?" Myuu however shook her head as she recalled,
"When I was diving before I saw a few moving out in the distance, but since I'm so small they didn't bother with me. However, when I dive to get the Dragon Ball it'll be a different story since I'll be moving into their territory." Though Myuu showed no hesitation at the idea of diving into the trench to collect the Dragon Ball, despite the sea monsters, Videl couldn't help but to feel uncertain about the whole situation.
Before she could voice her concerns though, Myuu readily strapped a pair of metallic bracers to her forearms and said,
"Wait here, I'll be back as soon as I can!"
"Wait!" Videl cried out to try and stop her, but it was too late as Myuu once again dove beneath the waves, this time not resurfacing as she swam out into the middle of the ocean.
This left Videl all alone on the beach, unable to follow Myuu since she couldn't dive or swim like she could.
Minutes trickled by as she waited, with trepidation filling her more and more with each passing minute that Myuu didn't return, until finally Videl leapt to her feet while crying out,
"AHHH! If I have to wait then I might as well do something!" She then began jogging through the sand around the island, intending to work her body to take her mind off Myuu's absence until she returned.
The island itself was about the size of a small lake, giving Videl plenty of space to work her body as she repeatedly lapped the trees clustered in the middle. Though the condition of her body HAD been improving due to Alex's ridiculous training regimens, Videl was till feeling the burn soon after due to the increased burden of running solely on sand.
After running ten laps, and barely being out of breath as she finished, Videl took a five minute breather as she once again watched the waves for Myuu. With no sign of the Dagon girl's emerald green hair appearing in the surf though, Videl moved on to the next segment as she skipped around the island ten times.
By the time she was finished with those laps, set sun had noticeably sank in the sky since Myuu departed, making Videl worry even more. Just as she started to curse Myuu's foolishness though,
"HEY!" Videl nearly jumped out of her skin as Myuu's voice called out begin her, making her whirl around to see the Dagon approaching her through the trees, covered in scrapes and nursing what appeared to be a broken arm.
"Are you ok!?! What happened?!" Videl cried out as she rushed to Myuu's side, only to have her concerns waved away as Myuu said,
"I'm fine, I already drank some gods water so everything's healing." As she said, now that Videl had a closer look, the numerous scrapes covering Myuu's body seemed to be rapidly closing. Her attention was then taken as Myuu held up a baseball sized golden orb with four red stars within it, and said with a cheeky smile,
"But I got it!" Videl's mind stalled slightly as she stared at the beautiful golden orb, before she turned back to Videl and demanded,
"What happened?! I was waiting for hours, and thought the worst had happened!" In the face of Videl's concern though, Myuu just chuckled awkwardly as she said,
"Well...I started out well enough, avoiding the sea monsters and all, until I actually found the Dragon Ball." Myuu then went on to tell Videl about how a monster crab had been guarding the ball, meaning she had a hard time fighting it due to its armored shell.
With it wildly swinging its large claws at her, Myuu had been lucky it only managed to hit her once. That was how she broke her arm, and obtained the numerous scrapes and cuts on her body as she impacted the sharp rocks. But as they began preparing another meal, this time with the numerous snacks and supplies Myuu had stored in her storage ring, the bone in her arm had completely reset and mended itself.
Looking up at the skies, Myuu said as they ate,
"I think we have time to find another Dragon Balls or two today if we hurry. They shouldn't be as hard to get as this one, and we only have a few days to find them all before morning."
With her saying that, Myuu quickly finished eating while the rest of her wounds healed, and got dressed before pulling out the magic compass and returning to the pavilion to study the map within. With the compass being able to give her much more than a simple direction, Myuu used the map in the pavilion to determine where the rest of the Dragon Balls were.
Eventually she clapped her hands loudly, and declared,
"Alright! Next we're going here!" As she said that Myuu pointed to an area on the map that was to be their next destination, the jungle.
Together this time, both Myuu and Videl the dove through the painting depicting the vibrant jungle, and the crashing of the waves was replaced by the numerous cries and sounds made by the animals around them. Again they were in a pavilion, but there didn't seem to be any concern of the animals and monsters coming close as Videl and Myuu quickly took in their surroundings.
"Ok, which way?" Videl asked after a moment, wanting to get this Dragon Ball and move on as quickly as possible. Myuu responded by holding up the compass and focusing her attention on the Dragon Ball closest to them, before saying,
"It's this way! But let's hurry because it's moving!" After saying that, Myuu then grabbed hold of Videl and took off into the air.
Though she had gotten used to flying with Alex after going too and from the island to train over the last several days, Videl was still somewhat scared as Myuu wove through the trees. She was glad to be flying though when they passed some of the creatures that called the jungle home, such as overly large pythons and Jaguars.
Following the compass, Myuu quickly honed in on the Dragon Ball even as it continued its slow trek through the jungle, until her and Videl came up it and gaped at the what they were seeing.
*Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!*
With each step it took the ground rumbled, the trees shuddered as leaves fell from them, and anything that was around them fled. What Videl and Myuu were looking at, was a massive brown elephant, covered in thick layers of what appeared to be moss and other vegetation.
"There!" Myuu said as she located the Dragon Ball, nestled within the vegetation on the elephant's back.
Slowly, the duo approached the creature while trying not to startle or alarm it, but if it did notice them then it just ignored them as it continued its thunderous trek. Even when they landed upon its back, the elephant barely reacted as Myuu collected their third Dragon Ball.
"And, that's another one down!" She declared excitedly, not caring if the elephant heard them or not, even as it continued its slow journey through the jungle.
***
For the next day both Myuu and Videl traveled throughout the sub-space orb that her papa made for them, fighting monsters and collecting Dragon Balls as they went.
After finding the six star Dragon Ball in the jungle, the duo went on to collect the two star ball from the desert, the five star ball from the snowy plains, and then the three star ball from the rocky and mountainous region. In each location when they found the Dragon Balls they also found numerous monstrous animals and monsters that would typically hinder their progress, like the sand worms in the desert, the Arctic wolves in the tundra, and the flocks of giant Eagles in the rocky region.
Naturally Myuu did all the fighting, and thankfully the broken arm she got from the crab was the worst of the injuries she'd sustained during their adventure, and all she got after that were scratches and cuts. In fact, Videl began feeling more sorry for the animals as she watched Myuu fight them with the metallic weapons her bracers would change to.
And now, they were finally on their way to collect the final Dragon Ball, back in the misty forest region where they first arrived.
"Only one more left to go!" Myuu declared excitedly as they walked through the thick and misty forest, prompting Videl to ask her,
"So do you know what you're going to wish for Myuu?" The Dagon stopped when she heard that, before pivoting around to look at Videl and said with a wide smile,
"I'll wish for a strong ability, like a Devil Fruit power! I'll also want to become older to seduce papa! And maybe I'll wish to be able to use magic as well! Or maybe-"
"How many wishes do we get?" Videl suddenly cut her off, as she was growing increasingly worried that she wouldn't be able to wish back her dad like Myuu said.
Her worries were unfounded though, as Myuu readily said,
"I think we'll get three, like a genie. So I'll get two wishes, and you can have the last one to bring back your dad!" Relief flooded Videl that she'd still be able to make her wish, to which she then muttered,
"Finally..... I'll be able to see my dad again and get out here....away from 'him'." Videl was so relieved, that she didn't notice Myuu stop walking all of a sudden and accidentally crashed into her.
"Huh? What's wrong Myuu-"
*SMACK!*
The next thing Videl knew she was flying back and landed on the ground, the entire left side of her face throbbing in pain. Then, before she could figure out what had happened, Myuu was straddling Videl's stomach with her left hand cocked back, before it too impacted Videl's face with a tremendous force.
"STOP-"
*SMACK!*
"BADMOUTHING-"
*SMACK!*
"MY-"
*SMACK!*
"PAPA!"
*SMACK!*
Over and over Myuu slapped Videl in the face, holding back enough that she wasn't actually doing any damage, but it still hurt the relatively 'ordinary' girl quite a bit.
When she finally stopped Myuu's chest was heaving as tears streamed down her face, her expression contorted in anger as she said to Videl,
"I'm not strong..... I'm weaker than everyone else despite being papa's oldest... No matter how much I try I can't catch up...."
As Myuu ranted at her, Videl could only listen with tears from the pain she was feeling streaming down her face as well, before she continued,
"But then papa told me that someone was coming to stay with us, someone who lost their dad and who he wanted to help.... I was happy.... Finally there would be someone like me.... Someone who I could be friends with while we both worked to become stronger...."
As she trailed off Myuu began to sniffle slightly while guilt welled up within Videl, even before Myuu declared,
"But all you do is badmouth papa, no matter how much he tries to help you! All you want is to hurt and get away from him, like you're a prisoner instead of a guest! Even now, when you're about to see your dad again, you can't forgive papa! IT WAS AN ACCIDENT!"
As she shouted at the top of her lungs, Myuu wound up to hit Videl once more, only to freeze at the last moment.
"..."
"What was that?" Myuu demanded since she didn't quite hear what Videl said between her own sobs.
"I-I'm sorry..." Videl sobbed out as she truly broke down crying.
"I'm so sorry...." She cried, even as Myuu got off of her and flopped down off to the side.
For several minutes neither of them said a thing, the only sound coming from them being the occasional sniffle from Myuu, and the sobs from Videl. When these too eventually began to die down, Videl muttered once again,
"I'm sorry..."
"You said that already.." Myuu replied without looking back at her, making Videl flinch before she said,
"It's true..... I've been a brat. Alex has tried to help me ever since we met, and I've done nothing but criticize and insult him..." Without saying anything, Myuu nodded in agreement as she had been the one who'd listened to Videl's griping the most since she arrived.
She'd put up with it until now due to her papa telling her to be nice to Videl, which Myuu understood. But now that they were so close to collecting the last of the Dragon Balls, and reviving Videl's dad, she didn't see why Videl should continue holding a grudge against her papa, especially since her own dad died due to his own actions to begin with.
With that in mind, Myuu had had enough.
As the awkward silence stretched after Videl's earlier admission, the human girl stood up and approached Myuu. Then, despite her severally swollen cheeks, Videl got down on her knees in front of Myuu, and said,
"I-I can't take back the things I've said and the way I've acted... But, do you think it's possible for us to start over as friends Myuu?" For a moment Myuu didn't say anything, instead narrowing her eyes at Videl as if she were studying her expression for falsehoods.
Just as Videl was about to begin thinking Myuu wouldn't forgive her, the Dagon stood up suddenly and said,
"Apologize to papa when we get back. Do that, and we'll always be friends!" Saying that, Myuu smiled widely as she offered a hand to Videl, making the other girl sigh in relief as she accepted the offered hand.
"Here." Myuu said once Videl was back on her feet, as she gave her one of her vials of gods water to splash on her face so the swelling would go down a bit, as the current Videl looked a little like a bright red chipmunk.
Having learned about the gods water from Myuu since they started looking for the Dragon Balls, Videl didn't waste any time rubbing it onto her cheeks before once again following Myuu's lead.
Soon the duo arrived at the location where the last Dragon Ball was, a massive cave that was covered in moss and vines. And while the cave appeared harmless enough, the rumbling they could hear from deep within said otherwise.
"What do you think is in there?" Videl asked Myuu warily, to which the Dagon said,
"I don't know, I haven't seen a lot of the monsters we've seen in this sub-space orb before. I think they might be creatures my papa used Alteration magic on to make more powerful, so it could be anything in there."
As Myuu said, there were numerous monsters that they'd seen in the orb that she had never heard of in her home world of Tortus, or even in Spira. But by the sound of the rumbling in the cave, which she thought was snoring, the thing sounded just as big as a behemoth.
Preparing herself for a fight, Myuu said to Videl,
"Wait here, and be ready to move out of the way if needed." Nodding slowly in affirmation, Videl hid behind a tree as she watched the entrance of the cave closely, while Myuu strolled right up to it.
For nearly a minute after she entered the cave nothing happened, until a roar rang out that shook the very air around her and made Videl's teeth clatter. Soon, there was a crash as the creature that had been within the cave came rushing out after Myuu as she tried to take some distance from it.
The creature was a massive bear looking thing, with longer legs than what bears usually had, and white runic patterns covering its chest to contrast its otherwise dark grey fur. As Myuu took flight to get away, its angry eyes focused entirely on her as it moved faster than something its size should have.
Watching the runebear following Myuu, Videl glanced towards the cave it had just come out of as a crazy and stupid idea popped into her head. Confirming once again that it's back was indeed towards her, Videl took off for the cave as fast as her legs could carry her.
"What the-!?" Videl uttered, as her body moved faster than she ever ran in her life, showing her the first results of the training Alex had been putting her through for the past several days.
Putting the sudden realization out of her head for the moment, Videl quickly rushed inside the cave to locate her prize. It didn't take long though, as a golden orb with seven stars on it was fairly easy to locate when the only other things in the cave were massive piles of poop and bones.
Quickly grabbing the orb as the smell of the runebear's dropping assaulted her, Videl swiftly fled from the cave to find Myuu still fighting the thing outside.
"Myuu! I got the Dragon Ball!" Videl cried out, letting Myuu know that they already had what they came for. Except the runebear also heard her.
"KYAAAAAA!" Videl screamed as the runebear changed its target, and crashed through the surrounding trees to get at her.
Videl sprinted as fast as her little legs could carry her through the trees, while the runebear crashed through anything in its path right behind her, quickly gaining on her despite its obstacles. Soon however Myuu appeared right beside Videl as she flew through the air, grabbing onto Videl's arms as tightly as she could and going upwards before the runebear could reach them.
"Go faster!" Videl shrieked even as Myuu broke through the tree line, right as the runebear leapt up and snapped at them, it's teeth missing Videl by the slightest of margins as it fell back down to the ground.
"Phew....." Myuu let out a sigh of relief as she soared higher into the sky, angling herself so that they were headed towards the pavilion where they first arrived in the sub-space.
"Finally, we have all seven..." Myuu panted the moment they touched down, before the two girls immediately hugged each other while crying out with a girlish squeal,
""WE DID IT!""
For several minutes the duo celebrated their success, not only for acquiring the last Dragon Ball, but for so narrowly escaping the runebear that had been guarding it. Soon however Myuu settled down, and looked her companion in the eye.
"Are you ready Videl?" Myuu asked her, to which Videl nodded while her hands clenched and unclenched nervously.
"Y-yeah, I'm ready." She said, anxious for what was about to happen next. She was about to revive her dad.
As she thought about seeing him again, Videl also recalled her mother, Miguel, and briefly wondered if the dragon would be able to bring them both back for her. There was only one way to find out, as Myuu removed the other six Dragon Balls from her storage, and placed them next to the seventh on the ground.
"Ok.....now what?" Myuu suddenly asked, to which Videl suddenly fell over in shock at the question.
"You mean you don't know how they work!?!" She then exclaimed at the Dagon, to which Myuu shrugged as she said,
"It's not I could ask papa how they work while spying on him you know." Videl just sighed as she tried to figure out how to actually activate the Dragon Balls, before suggesting,
"Maybe they need a password, like 'open sesame' or something? But what would it be...?" For a moment neither of the two girls said anything as they tried to think of possible passwords to activate the Dragon Balls, before Myuu said,
"Maybe it's something simple like 'come out dragon!' Just kid-" Though Myuu wasn't being serious, the moment those words left her mouth the Dragon Balls suddenly lit up with a brilliant light.
The two girls hurried back from the Dragon Balls as they began to glow brighter and brighter, while the sky grew darker and darker. And then, something erupted out of the Dragon Balls that quickly grew to an enormous size, extending out for miles and miles, while it grew to be as big around as a mountain.
When the light finally began to fade, the two girls were standing face-to-face with a massive snake.
Covered in black scales, and surrounded by an eerie red aura, the snake seemed to glare down at them before opening its serpentine mouth, and hissing,
"I, AM THE WISSSH GRANTING DRAGON, PHOSSSPHOR! SSSTATE YOUR WISSSH!"
As they stared up at the giant and ominous looking dragon, both Videl and Myuu had the same exact thought as they uttered in unison,
""Aren't you a snake?""
Immediately a tick mark appeared on Phosphor's head as he retorted,
"NO, I AM NOT A SSSNAKE! I AM A GREAT AND POWERFUL DRAGON! NOW HURRY AND MAKE YOUR WISSSH, SSSO I CAN RETURN TO MY SSSLUMBER!"
Again, in unison, Myuu and Videl glanced at each other from Phosphor's defensiveness, and thought in concert,
'He's definitely a snake...'
This time however they didn't say it out loud, as apparently such a topic was testy to the 'dragon', and instead Videl hurriedly asked,
"Can you bring back people that have died? Even if their soul has been shattered?" Videl's heart felt like it was going to burst as she asked her question, and even more so as she awaited Phosphor's answer, before the giant dragon answered,
"INDEED I CAN! ISSS THAT YOUR WISSSH?"
With relief flooding her, Videl was about to answer that it was before Myuu immediately cut her off, and asked instead,
"How many wishes can we have?" Videl paled as she realized that they didn't even confirm how many wishes they could make, which was something they would HAVE to do before wishing for anything though. However, the answer they got was something that neither girl expected.
"ONE WISSSH PER SSSUMMONING! THOSSSE ARE THE RULESSS!"
The duo felt their hearts sinking as they realized that Phosphor was completely unlike a genie, as he only granted one wish altogether instead of three, or even one per person.
With her heart sinking even further at the realization that she might not be able to revive her parents, Videl was startled as Myuu suddenly said,
"You use the wish Videl."
"Huh?" Videl uttered as she turned towards Myuu, who smiled at her as she said,
"I told you to use the wish! I can wait, but you really want to see your dad again, right?" In the face of Myuu's selfless offer, and her radiant smile, Videl could only sniffle as she felt tears running down her cheeks.
"Th-thank y-you Myuu! I-I know I don't deserve this..." As she said that Videl recalled everything Myuu smacked into her earlier, about her bad attitude, and the way she'd been behaving towards Alex ever since she met him. And despite all of that, now Myuu was giving her her wish instead of asking for one of the any number of things she herself so desperately wanted.
In the face of Videl's gratitude, Myuu just grabbed her by the shoulders and said,
"It's ok Videl! Just promise me we'll still be friends when you go back with your dad, ok?" Videl readily nodded as she pulled Myuu in for a tight hug, and stated,
"Of course! You'll always be my friend!" Myuu then happily returned Videl's hug as the two reaffirmed their friendship, before the voice of Phosphor asked from above,
"SSSO ARE YOU GOING TO MAKE A WISSSH, OR NOT?"
Jumping apart at the voice, both Videl and Myuu laughed awkwardly as the former stepped forward to state her wish.
"I wish-" Videl began as she clearly pictured both her mother and her father in her mind, but, when she opened her mouth, no sound came out.
"YOU WISSSH..." Phosphor repeated for her, trying to get Videl to spit out what she wanted.
Shaking herself off somewhat, Videl then began again,
"I wish-" But again, nothing came out after that.
Instead, Videl suddenly heard Alex's voice in her head as she recalled one of the lessons Alex gave in the last few days.
...
"There are no true shortcuts in life, no matter how much it seems otherwise. Even if you suddenly became the most powerful person in the entire universe, you would be unable to properly wield that power due to the fact that you never trained to that extent before. You would most likely then have to take the same amount of time training to use your strength as it would've taken for you to develop it naturally.
"Not only that, but you would then never truly be able to appreciate your abilities since you never properly 'earned' them. Instead, you would only feel empty inside due to never being able to feel the gratification of overcoming your own limits, and finally taking what it is you so desperately want with your own hands. Though it may seem pointless now, when you look back ten years from now, you'll be grateful for the struggle you went to eventually get there."
...
Alex had told her all that when Videl asked if there was a way to become stronger faster, as well as being able to master using energy since she was still struggling.
