'But this and that two completely different things!' Videl angrily chastised herself in her head, even shaking it as she tried to clear her thoughts. Ignoring the looks both Myuu and Phosphor were giving her, Videl looked back up at the great dragon and said,
"I wish...... I wish..... I........" Faltering again and again at saying what she wanted to the dragon, Videl shocked Myuu as she fell to her knees and said,
"I-I can't do it...." Rushing to her friend's side, Myuu asked her,
"What can't you do Videl?" Myuu was then even more shocked when Videl looked at her with tears running down her face, and said,
"I can't take your wish Myuu..... I didn't earn it...."
Though she had gone into the cave and retrieved the final Dragon Ball, Videl hadn't actually helped Myuu at all in finding the other five. Instead, she'd been left behind at a safe place while Myuu charged headfirst into whatever danger there was to retrieve the desired orb.
"You fought so hard for these Dragon Balls, and all I did was watch..." Videl said to her while holding back her tears, until Myuu pulled her into a hug and asked,
"Are you sure? This is your chance to bring back your dad." Even as Myuu told her that though, Videl fought down the urge to accept them as she said,
"I'm sure. When I'm strong enough, I'll gather the Dragon Balls myself and make my wish. I'll wait until I can do so with my own strength!"
As she said that, the girls gave each other one last squeeze, before Myuu stood up and faced Phosphor herself.
"ARE YOU FINALLY GOING TO MAKE A WISSSH?"
Phosphor asked irritably from being made to wait for so long, to which Myuu nodded her head as she said,
"I am! I wish-"
***
"I wonder where they are..." Alex muttered to himself as he waited for Myuu and Videl to arrive on the island used for his children's training.
With Myuu's abilities he figured they should have already gathered the rest of the Dragon Balls, and made their wish. When he thought about the detail of each summoning only getting one wish though, Alex uttered,
"I hope they aren't fighting over who gets the wish..." Though it seemed like a decent idea at the time, since he didn't want people trying to abuse these Dragon Balls, in hindsight it might not have been a good idea to send the two girls to gather them when only one could use the wish.
"I'm sure they're fine." Yuna said to Alex as she embraced him from behind, the rest of the girls having already gone on ahead to start their day.
Trading a gentle kiss with her, Alex was about to stand to go and get the girls himself since they had school, when they suddenly appeared from the sub-space orb he'd left on the island.
"There you guys are-!" Alex began, before pausing as he noticed something VERY different about the two girls.
"Papa!" Myuu cried out as she eagerly rushed forward to hug him, though Alex and Yuna were both focused on something else entirely.
"What's this then?" Alex asked her while playing dumb, as he pointed to the fur covered monkey's tail that now extended from both Myuu and Videl's backsides.
"I made a wish on the Dragon Balls!" Myuu stated excitedly, before turning around and sticking her butt out at him so Alex could get a better look.
"I see that..." Alex said, completely forgetting that he was supposed to pretend to be 'mad' at Myuu for 'stealing' the Dragon Ball he had.
Surprising him even more was that Videl had stayed rooted in place ever since she and Myuu arrived, instead of the usual attitude she'd shown him since arriving. She was currently dragging the tip of her foot through the dirt at her feet, while her own newly acquired tail twitched nervously behind her.
Then, before he got a chance to ask what was wrong, Myuu quickly ran up to Videl, and shoved her forward at him with enough force that Videl practically ended up in Alex's lap. Catching her in order to prevent an 'accident', Alex asked her,
"Are you ok?" What happened next shocked him as Videl quickly got to her feet with a bright red face, and said,
"Y-yeah..... And.....I'm-" What Videl said next was mumbled low enough that not even Alex could hear it through his 'Domain', making him ask,
"What was that?" Turning even redder, Videl hesitated until Myuu poked her in the ribs, finally getting her to say,
"I'm sorry, for how I've been acting until now..." Needless to say, Alex was more than a little surprised at Videl's sudden apology, which made Myuu smirk proudly when she saw his reaction.
Placing a hand on the top of Videl's head, making her twitch at the contact, Alex then said to her gently,
"Don't worry about it. I never held your attitude against you since it was pretty justified. However, I'll be glad if things can improve between us from now on." As he said that, Alex ruffled Videl's hair slightly while both Yuna and Myuu watched on with a little bit jealousy in their eyes.
A second later however he removed his hand from her head, and said,
"Alright then! It's morning outside now, so that means the two of you need to get ready for school, and we'll have to fix your uniforms so they can accommodate your new tails now too." As he said that, Alex glanced back at both Videl and Myuu's tails curiously, while also noting that both seemed to have powered up a fair bit after being turned into Saiyans.
Thankfully though Myuu still had her webbed fingers and finned ears, meaning she didn't completely turn into a Saiyan, and Remia wouldn't try and kill him later for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - 457: Scatter
chapters.content:
After collecting Myuu and Videl, Alex's morning became fairly hectic as he then had to explain to numerous people about why they both suddenly had Saiyan tails.
Firstly were his children, who were all excited due to both Myuu and Videl matching them now, and then was Myuu's mother Remia, who thankfully accepted the transition since Myuu still had her Dagon traits like her. The rest of Alex's wives aside, he then had to inform Sona about the change due to the commotion they were more than likely to cause at the Academy; as Gohan triggered his own uproar when he attended due to no one in Asora ever seeing another Saiyan before, aside from Alex and his children.
Then, after Alex dropped the children off at the Academy and spoke to Sona, he returned to the manor and went into the space-time orb once again. Alex didn't intend to stay in there though, as he quickly entered the sub-space orb that Myuu and Videl had been in, and retrieved the now functionless Dragon Balls.
Though Ophis had wanted to make it to where the Dragon Balls had no cool down period, Alex convinced her otherwise so that they didn't have people collecting them to make a wish every few days. Now they required a period of four months to cool down after a wish was made, though that could be altered for some emergencies and such.
Dragon Balls in hand, Alex then made his way to a certain shrine that was enshrouded in towering stalks of bamboo, where he found Akeno sweeping the leaves that had fallen on the cobblestones, alongside their daughter. Both girls were dressed in the traditional white and red shrine maiden outfits, while their black hair was pulled back into matching long ponytails.
"Daddy!" Shuri cried out once she sensed his approached, running up to Alex and jumping into his arms excitedly.
"Well good morning again Shuri! And how is my little priestess today?" Alex asked as he lifted her up for a hug, to which Akeno answered,
"She's been helping me take care of Ophis' shrine. She'll make an excellent shrine maiden one day." As she said that Akeno leaned in to give Alex a kiss, but as she pulled her head back, Shuri angrily stated as she clung to Alex even tighter,
"Daddy mine!" Akeno's eyes widened briefly at that before she said with mock despair,
"Oh how terrible! I've been replaced by my own daughter...." As Akeno began to fake sob, Shuri didn't appear remorseful in the slightest. Instead, she huffed as if to say 'that's right!'
Shaking his head at the their mother-daughter antics, Alex then asked Akeno,
"Is Ophis around?" Akeno's fake look of despair vanished instantly as she replied,
"She should be sunning herself in her usual spot." Alex gave Akeno his thanks before he then began heading over to Ophis' direction, Shuri still in his arms.
Though there had been numerous other temples and shrines built in Asora in the recent months, Ophis' was still the most visited and respected out of all of them, with the sole exception of Alex's of course. Even now, this early in the day, Alex saw numerous people at the shrine to give Ophis her 'offerings' of sweets, snacks, and even small amounts of money for her to use as pocket change.
Rather than a God that was both feared and respected, Ophis was like a mascot for Asora that everybody adored.....it just so happened that said mascot was the most powerful being IN Asora, as well as their last line of defense if it was ever needed.
Even now, like the fear they once showed her never happened, Alex saw only smiling faces surrounding Ophis as people greeted her, and the dragon God casually greeted them back while gratefully accepting their offerings. She was currently laying on a special platform where she liked to spend her mornings bathing in the early sunlight, and where people could easily find her if they wanted to greet her.
As Alex approached them though, Ophis suddenly looked up at him before hopping off her platform and hurrying over to him and Shuri.
"Alex.... Did it work?" With the only thing she could be asking about being the Dragon Balls, Alex nodded as he pulled out the seven stone orbs and said,
"Yep, Myuu used them to turn both herself and Videl into Saiyans." Ophis listened intently as Alex told her about the girl's experience with the Dragon Balls, which he viewed with Regeneration magic when he went to retrieve the balls, her expression never changing despite the obvious happiness she felt.
"Phosphor is a good dragon...." Ophis finally said when Alex finished recounting the adventure, gesturing to the statue that had recently been added to the shrine.
The statue depicted the same exact dragon Myuu and Videl had summoned, Phosphor, and was the focal point between the Dragon Balls and Ophis herself, though only Alex and Elaine knew that. Through it Ophis would be able to manage the Dragon Balls as their owner, making any changes to them that might be necessary in the future.
"Are you ready to scatter the Dragon Balls once again?" Alex asked her, to which Ophis nodded eagerly as Alex picked up one of the seven stone orbs.
Shuri immediately seized one to examine curiously, while Alex grabbed another before asking her,
"Do you want to help daddy Shuri?" The little girl looked up at her father all excited as she nodded and said,
"Yes!"
Setting her down, Alex cocked back his arm with the stone in his hand, before throwing it as hard as he could into the distance.
*BOOM!*
The Dragon Ball went flying with enough force that it broke the sound barrier and alerted all of those within several miles of the shrine to the flying object in the sky. That was just the start though, as Alex then said to his daughter,
"Alright Shuri! Throw it that way!" Turning in the direction her father pointed in, Shuri then gathered energy until her long black hair broke free of it pony tail and stood straight up.
"Haaa!!" Shuri cried out cutely as she was surrounded by a powerful golden aura which, thanks to the Fallen Angel blood she inherited from her mother, was filled with potent holy energy along with the lightning that began to crackle around her.
"Oh my!" Akeno said as she sensed the rampant energies her daughter was giving off.
"Grrrrrrr..." Shuri groaned as she stepped forward while cocking the stone ball back as far as her little arm could, before stepping forward with enough force that she fractured the stone under their feet as she threw the ball forward.
*Boom!*
*KER-CRACK!*
The ball went flying so fast that it broke the sound barrier like Alex's had, but it also generated a massive lightning storm in its wake despite the clear skies, alerting the people of Asora even more.
"Yay!" Shuri cried out as she ran to Alex for praise, only for Akeno to intercept her as she scolded,
"Shuri! How dare you damage Ophis' shrine! Apologize to her!" Shrinking instantly under her mother's stern gaze, and seeing that her father wasn't going to save her, Shuri turned towards Ophis and said,
"Sowwy Ophis..." Ophis of course simply patted the little girl on the head and said,
"It's ok."
As Shuri apologized for ruining a part of Ophis' shrine, Alex picked up another couple of stones and offered one to her.
"Want to try again?" Shuri looked up at Alex's offer, and a big smile formed on her face as she happily accepted the stone ball to try throwing it again, while Alex took a stance right next to her.
***
"Well, until next time then." Freya said as she stood up, followed swiftly by a little girl that appeared to be the spitting image of her, except for her gold-furred monkey's tail.
"Bye-bye auntie Artemis!" The little girl said as she followed her mother, leaving the huntress waving after them as the duo disappeared in a flash of golden light.
The second they disappeared though Artemis let out a long and drawn out sigh, a melancholic look appearing on her face. She then stood from the dining set that she and her huntresses had set up in their main camp, and started walking back towards her tent.
"Greetings goddess." One of her huntresses said as they passed her, which Artemis returned with a nod of acknowledgement as she continued on to her destination.
They had set up their camp in a cavern equivalent in size to a football field, which possessed a large hole in the ceiling that allowed light in so that the entire inside was covered in vegetation. On top of that there was a small river that ran through the cavern, bringing Artemis and her huntresses, as well as the female Druids that were accompanying them, a constant supply of fresh water.
After they set up their camp Artemis then covered the cave with her divine authority, plunging it into perpetual night with a full moon overhead. Now it was their base, a place where her huntresses could relax and let down their guards with absolutely no men allowed whatsoever.....except one.
"Will I ever have that too....?" Artemis muttered to herself as she placed a hand on her stomach, recalling Freya's daughter Freydis as she did so.
Even now, after so long of being one of Alex's wives, she was unable to truly consummate her marriage to him. She had taken him up the butt more times than she could count, and had grown to like it a lot(something she worried was making her a pervert), but the longer she spent time around Alex and his wives, the more she desired something else.
'I want a child...' Artemis thought to herself as she entered her tent, the largest and most grand one of them all in the cavern. And within it the space was several times larger than the exterior suggested, giving Artemis more than enough room to display all of the trophies she had accumulated over the millennia, mostly antlers, skulls, and furs.
However Artemis was in no mood to admire them as she slumped down onto her bed and pondered her plight. In the thousands of years that she'd existed, Artemis had never even considered birthing a child due to her divinity over Chastity.
Instead, she had gathered together young maidens like herself who she considered akin to her daughters, and still did to this very day. But now that she was married to Alex, and had seen the other goddesses bearing him children, Artemis felt an unfamiliar longing growing within her.
"I wish there was a way I could bear him a daughter..." She muttered to herself, believing that there was no one to hear her. Almost as if something had heard her though, suddenly the entirety of the cavern began to shake as if they were under attack.
Instantly Artemis was on her feet, any of the previous melancholy she had been feeling was no longer on her face or in her mind as she exited the tent, and demanded,
"Report!" Immediately Artemis' second in command, Phoebe, appeared before her and stated,
"We aren't under attack, but our guard reported seeing something fall from the sky not far from here! Sending scouts to investigate now!" Artemis nodded as she too began to prepare to leave while saying,
"I'll lead them." The goddess then swiftly disappeared as she began looking to see what had caused such a commotion. If it were in the middle of the night then she'd know immediately, thanks to her status as a goddess of the moon(even though Yue was considered THE goddess of the moon in Asora). Since it was coming up on the middle of the day though, even Artemis could only search on foot alongside her followers and the Druids.
It didn't take them long to find the thing that had fallen from the sky though, as the huntress that had been on guard duty directed them straight to the area where it had landed, which was now a crater. Within said crater, all Artemis found was a perfectly smooth stone the size of a fist.
"What is it lady Artemis?" One of the huntresses asked as she went to pick it up, but even as she gingerly touched it nothing happened.
"It's.....a stone?" Artemis said curiously as she held it up for them to see, though none could think of what the stones true purpose could be. The only conclusion Artemis could reach was that it was some kind of item from the new world that Alex had journeyed to, but since she hadn't actually returned to the Misty Manor in months, Artemis couldn't tell if this truly was the case or not.
Deciding to think on it, the goddess pocketed the strange stone ball, not knowing there were six like it being scattered throughout Asora.
***
"Again." Beerus' cold voice stated, even as the Crimson haired woman before him struggled to remain on her feet.
"Lord Beerus, please recall that the normal training methods may not apply here." Said Whis, as he watched on with amusement.
It had been several days since Beerus brought Rias to his planet to train in the ways of the Destroyer, and needless to say that it was slow going. The biggest problem Beerus had with training Rias was that there was so little variety in the way strength worked in this universe.
It was the first time, outside of the Omni King, that either of them had encountered someone who possessed next to no actual 'strength', but a significant amount of energy. It also didn't help that neither had ever encountered Rias' Demonic energy before, so they were unsure about how to properly train her.
That didn't mean that Rias wasn't making any progress though.
If he'd been forced to admit it, Beerus would say that Rias had made a surprising amount of progress in the last few days for being as 'weak' as she was. Most of this however could be attributed to the fact that Rias was already attuned to the nature of Destruction, along with her unwillingness to give up.
Even now, as Beerus 'gently' tossed a giant boulder at her, Rias braced herself as she channeled the power of Destruction. Instead of the usual blast of dark reddish-black power that she used though, the older appeared to explode as every single piece of it vaporized.
"Ha...!" Rias exclaimed at as she Destroyed the Boulder, though wether she was celebrating using the power of Destruction or trying to catch her breath, neither of them knew. Beerus apparently decided to assume the former, and flicked a small pebble at her forehead.
"Ow!" Rias exclaimed while Beerus snarled,
"What are you celebrating Destroying a small boulder for?" Even as Rias glared at him reproachfully, Beerus sneered,
"True Destroyers possess the power to destroy planets with a whim, and even the entire universe if they so desired. A small Boulder is nothing." Even as Beerus said so, Whis immediately interjected,
"Though I'd hold off on trying to Destroy the entire universe unless you had a way to survive that yourself." As Whis chuckled lightly at himself, Rias couldn't help asking,
"If even each of the Destroyers can Destroy a universe, then how much more powerful is the Omni King than them?" As the pinnacle being of Destruction, Rias wanted to know how much of a difference existed between her and them. However both Beerus and Whis looked at her strangely, before the former stated irritably,
"That question is like asking what the difference between an ant and a human is. The difference is so great you can't even truly compare them." As Rias appeared confused at Beerus' answer, Whis quickly explained,
"While it is true that a Destroyer like lord Beerus is capable of Destroying the entire universe if he so desired, it would take nearly every ounce of his power to do so. The Omni King however could wipe out all twelve of our universes with a whim if he so wished, and wouldn't even break a sweat in the process." Rias took a moment to digest this information, before uttering,
"That's insane..." Beerus nodded in agreement as he said,
"It is, so take this warning seriously mortal woman, NEVER provoke the Omni King." Rias nodded this time slowly in contemplation, as she tried to imagine a being with such power.
But before she could think too much, Beerus decided to continue her training as he suddenly chucked another Boulder at her.
(A.N. I know it's short, but I spent the last couple days on a new series that I found, Monster Hunter International, and wanted to get the next chapter out.)

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - 458: Vanishing Act
chapters.content:
*CRASH!*
*SMASH!*
*KABOOM!*
High in the skies over Pangea, three figures were battling so intensely that they created shockwaves that buffeted the area around them for hundreds of miles. Caught between two of the figures was Goku, his hair long and blond as it stuck straight up, with lightning arcing around his body.
Fighting the SSJ2 Goku was of course Bardock, who had also acquired the SSJ transformation, and Raditz, who had yet to ascend to become a Super Saiyan.
"TAKE THIS KAKAROT!"
Raditz shouted as he created a sphere of Ki and shot it at his little brother, only for Goku to literally flick it away while simultaneously blocking a punch from his father with just a finger.
"To think there's still this much of a difference between transformations!" Bardock growled, though the edges of his lips were curled up in a smirk as he said so. Though Goku smiled back his father with humor, he then said to him,
"Yeah, but it's still not enough. I haven't even began to make my way up to the SSJ3, and Alex is way stronger than that..." As he said that both Bardock and Goku canceled their transformations, while the former shook his head and stated,
"Stronger than the rest of us and still whining about not being strong enough.... That's my son for you!" Bardock then slapped Goku on the back and laughed boisterously at the situation, while Raditz glowered at them from a distance.
"With the tournament coming up soon maybe I should go ask Alex for some tips on getting the SSJ3..." Goku mused to himself. Though he would typically never ask someone for help in getting stronger like this, he also knew that there'd be plenty of powerful people participating in the tournament that he probably wouldn't match up to without the SSJ3 transformation.
Bardock was silent for a moment as he considered things, before finally saying,
"Maybe we should use one of those space-time thingys? Then we can train for even longer before the tournament starts." Goku looked at his father and exclaimed excitedly,
"Yeah! That's a great idea dad!" Goku then laughed awkwardly from how he was still getting used to saying things like 'dad', as he never even knew he had parents until a few months ago.
As they prepared to take off Goku then turned towards Raditz and shouted,
"You coming bro?" Raditz however sneered as he responded,
"So now you two recall that I'm here?" Goku looked at his brother weirdly as he asked,
"What do you mean? I always knew you were here." Raditz however scoffed before he turned and took off in the other direction, away from them.
"What's eating him?" Goku asked confusedly as he watched his brother leave.
"He's probably sore that he's the only one who can't transform into a Super Saiyan yet." Bardock replied while shaking his head. By this point not only was he able to make the transformation along with their former king, but even Gine, who was doing her training with some of Alex's wives, was able to make the transformation.
Deciding to leave Raditz to his own devices, Goku and Bardock both began to head back to the only place on Pangea that could be settled permanently, the gate leading to Asora. With how large Pangea truly was though, it took them nearly an entire day at their top speed to finally arrive there.
When the father/son duo finally arrived, they found that the area around the gate had grown into an entire city. Dozens of species from all over the universe walked the streets, the vast majority of which possessed powerful energy levels that made both Goku and Bardock's skins crawl.
"Wow! They made a whole city while we were gone!" Goku exclaimed as he excitedly took in the sights around them, particularly the people who had high powerl levels.
"I didn't think we were gone that long...?" Bardock muttered in confusion, as it should've taken a lot longer than this for an entire city to be built.
Rather than worry about it though, the two Saiyans quickly headed for a place filled with familiar people, Bulma's new house.
...
"That hit the spot!" Present Bulma exclaimed happily as she put down her cup and relaxed into her comfy chair.
"It does indeed..." Gine agreed as she relaxed the soreness in her muscles from training with Shia all day.
Currently both Bulmas, Gine, Launch, Chichi, Shia, Moka, and Erza were all gathered in the lounge of Bulma's new home on Pangea, which she moved to in order to be closer to the gates where she could establish connections with high ranking officials from all over the universe. The fact that she also had immediate access to technology from all over the universe was a major plus as well.
"So do the two of you know when Goku and the others will be back?" The currently blue-haired Launch asked Chichi and Gine suddenly, making the former snort as she cut off the latter,
"Please! Do you really think those no-good husbands or sons of ours ever give a care about any of us? All Saiyan men care about is themselves!" Even as she huffed and puffed about how horrible Saiyan men were, Chichi blatantly ignored the numerous dirty looks she was receiving from the trio that were Alex's wives. One of the Bulmas was even convinced she heard Shia mutter "cunt' under her breath, but it was so quiet that she might've been imagining it.
Needless to say that none of Alex's wives thought highly of Chichi or her opinions regarding pretty much every Saiyan man, her own husband and Alex specifically. Their opinion of her dropped even more when they heard the story of how Goku and Chichi got married, being that Chichi essentially tricked him into promising to marry her as kids, and then guilt tripped him when they became adults.
What made matters worse was that, despite being the one to basically force Goku into marrying her, Chichi openly complained about him and his desire to train every chance she got, and would even insist that he get a normal paying job to occupy his time like a 'regular' husband. While normally the girls would agree about a husband needing to spend more time it's his family, as Alex always made time for every single one of the hundreds of women and numerous children he had, they also couldn't blame Goku for wanting to be away from home all the time if Chichi was what he had to come back to.
They had also learned that trying to debate or even argue with her regarding her extreme behavior was a moot point, as the insane woman never even considered the possibility that she was wrong.
Thankfully though, before one of them(Shia) lost her patience, Goku and Bardock both arrived from their several months of training.
"Hey everyone! How's it going?" Goku asked as he walked in with a smile on his face, followed immediately by his father.
"Kakarot! Bardock! Welcome back!" Gine immediately said as she rose to greet them, before recoiling at the smell that radiated off of them.
"Go and take a shower right now!" Gine yelled at them while plugging her nose, making both Goku and Bardock sniff themselves before chuckling awkwardly. Thankfully though, the Bulmas readily offered their guest bathroom for the two men to clean up in.
A short time later, the two Saiyans reemerged looking refreshed and presentable for the first time since they disappeared for training several months prior. Nodding in approval, Gine then said,
"Much better! I swear, it's hard to think that the two of you are seriously adult men. And then there's Raditz....speaking of which, where is he?" Looking around curiously, Gine expected that Raditz would show up shortly after his brother and father did, but he never did. Instead, Bardock sighed in exasperation as he said,
"Don't know. That brat took off somewhere after throwing some kind of fit." Seeing the look Gine gave him from hearing, Bardock then added, "He'll be fine. Raditz may not realize it, but he IS on the cusp of become a Super Saiyan. Maybe this alone time will give him the push he needs."
Though Gine still glared at Bardock for leaving their son out in the winds of Pangea alone, she also couldn't help but to accept the situation, as she knew how Saiyan men were the best out of anyone else there. So, rather than continuing to gripe about something she couldn't change, short of going to get Raditz herself, Gine then said to her husband,
"Well, speaking of sons, did you know that our second grandson was born while you three were out there?" That caught both Bardock and Goku by surprise, before Chichi then rounded on her husband, and demanded,
"That's reminds me! Why weren't you here when I gave birth to our second son?! Huh???" Goku immediately adopted a look of fear on his face as he quickly asked,
"Wait, how'd that happen?! I thought you said that the baby wouldn't get here until AFTER the tournament! Does that mean we missed the tournament!?!" As Goku despaired at the idea of them missing the tournament, Chichi seized his ear and snarled at him angrily,
"Really?! You missed the birth of our second son, and all you care about is some stupid tournament?! Some father you are!" She then dragged Goku away by his ear while giving him a piece of her mind, to which Erza asked the Bulmas,
"Didn't she enter the space-time orb and speed up her pregnancy ahead of time?" With both Bulmas, Gine, and Launch all nodding in confirmation, Shia then said in a much louder voice than earlier,
"Yep, she's definitely a cunt." The sudden profanity caught everybody present off guard, making the lounge erupt into a fit of coughing and sputtering.
"Damn, our king sure knows how to pick em." Bardock muttered approvingly as he appraised Shia, making her sit up straighter and puff out her chest proudly. Gine however began pouting at the looks her husband was giving Shia, even though she knew for a fact there was nothing suggestive about them.
"Eh-hem! So, how come you and Kakarot came back in anyways? I expected the three of you to stay out right up until the tournament started." With everyone else also looking at Bardock curiously, the man quickly answered,
"Kakarot was wondering what the trick was to obtain the SSJ3, so we came in to ask Alex about it. We also wanted to use one of those space-time things to get more training in before the tournament started." With everyone making faces of understanding at the typical reason, Bardock was surprised when Erza said to him,
"While I don't think Alex would mind helping you guys out, there is a small problem with that at the moment." Cocking his head in confusion, Bardock asked her,
"What's wrong?" Instead of Erza though, it was Moka who answered as she said,
"No ones seen or heard from Alex in three months."
***
"Pathetic." The cold voice of a certain silver haired maid echoed within the massive underground chamber, sending shivers down the spines of everyone else within.
Even as they outnumbered and surrounded her, a thousand to one, none of the other maids could even begin to try and gain an edge over her.
"I could've sworn that Grayfia wasn't even close to being this strong..." One of their newest members, Katerea, the descendant of the original Leviathan, muttered to herself in anger.
"You should've realized THAT already!" Exclaimed one of the other women dressed in a maid outfit, with her dark blue hair pulled to the right in a long bushy ponytail with numerous rings in it.
"You should have already realized that she isn't the brightest bulb in the box Rana. But instead of talking about that, let's try to think of a way to defeat the head maid." One of the other maids, Satellizer L. Bridget, growled as she retook her offensive stance.
After her everyone else began standing back as they started to surround Grayfia once more, the Dragonrace Venri, Elizabeth, Arnett, Creo, Attia, Chiffon, Ticy, the rest of the Pandora that had joined her, the necromancer Eri, Tracy, the demon Francesca, the elf Altina, Noint and the other twelve former apostles, the Oni Routier, Gyokuro Shuzen, the human weapons Nemesis and Mea, and then the goddess of night and darkness, Nyx.
"Go mama go!" Shouted the little girl watching on the sidelines, with her pure black hair and matching monkey's tail, while sitting next to her was another little girl with long silver hair and a red tail.
"You're too loud Nocta..." The other little girl said while putting her fingers in her ears, to which Nocta practically shouted,
"Shut up Lana! Today my mom will beat your mom!" Lana just gave her sister a blank look at that, before turning her attention back to the match before them, even as her mama used her magic to heal all of her opponents, including the hundreds of monster corpses that Eri used. Lana may still be really little, but she knew that no matter what, unless it was her papa, then her mama would never lose to any opponent.
As if reading her mind, Grayfia herself then said as the rest of the maids surrounded her,
"Pay attention Lana, this is the power of the Lucifuge." Grayfia then summoned a sword in her right hand, while a magic circle appeared in her left.
"Dammit..... It seems like the head maid is really intense today." Tracy, the former princess of the Hoelscher empire of Tortus, muttered in frustration after Grayfia sent her flying back with her sword.
"Well of course." Answered Noint, before adding as if it were obvious, "It's been three months already."
Anyone who heard couldn't help but to nod in agreement, as they were all starting to get worried by this point. Meanwhile, in Grayfia's mind, she was thinking to herself,
'Where did you go? Since when were you THIS irresponsible?'
At that moment the Oni Routier tried to hack Grayfia in half with her personally modified chainsaw, but Grayfia blocked the spinning teeth of the blade with her bare hand before tossing her away like it was nothing.
'Where are you Alex?'
***
"Saya! Look at grandpapa!" A handsome middle aged man with a nasty gash-like scar on his cheek said, earning him an adorable giggle from the black haired toddler before him.
"No! Look at great grandpapa Saya!" Cried out the elderly looking man with similar features to the previous one, completely destroying his image of a serious old man to those who were watching. But then again, that wasn't too strange compared to the numerous men and women also trying to play with the little girl.
"Everyone really loves Saya, huh?" Shizuku said as she watched everyone try to play with her daughter.
"Well of course." Replied the woman across from her, Shizuku's own mother, Kirino. "Saya-chan is like the little princess of the Yaegashi family now." Shizuku smiled at that, as that had been her until Saya was born. Even now her family refused to acknowledge Alex, and would try to attack and poison him whenever he came to visit due to him 'stealing' her.
As if to express her continuing dislike for the man in question, Kirino then added while cupping her cheek,
"It's too bad her own father left her and her siblings behind to go off and have fun somewhere. I feel so sad for Saya-chan." Shizuku's brow twitched when she heard that, while even the great black dog siting behind her lifted its head to look at Kirino.
"Mom. I will ask you to not talk badly about Alex in front of me, and doubly so in front of Saya." She said in a deathly calm voice. Shizuku then looked her mother in the eye and said,
"You know as well as I do that Alex would never disappear like this without good reason, and Saya doesn't need to think her father took off simply to 'have fun'." As she said so Kirino flashed of look of surprise before saying with false despair,
"Oh my adorable daughter has turned against her mother, whatever shall I do?" Shizuku just gave her a deadpan until Kirino added,
"Oh fine, I suppose you're right Shizuku. No little girl should hear someone badmouth their father, even if it's true." Though Shizuku still stared at her mother for adding that last part, she just sighed in exasperation before giving up on the subject. But then her mom added,
"So none of you know where he is at all?" Shizuku shook her head before saying,
"No, and not for lack of trying. We know he's ok at least, because so is Elaine, but not even the magic compass or Shia's Future Sight will show us where he is. All we got was a note saying he'll be back as soon as he could, and not to look for him. Of course we still did after the first month." Kirino cocked her head elegantly at that, before saying,
"Well, at least you know he's somewhat ok. But I wouldn't worry, that boy of yours is tenacious if nothing else. I'm sure he'll come back any time with a woman or two in each arm like usual or something." Though Shizuku felt like her mother was dissing Alex again, she decided not to harp on it as she replied,
"Yeah... You're probably right." The duo then continued to elegantly sip their tea while watching the entire Yaegashi dojo try to play with Saya, while the great black dog Jin watched on protectively.
***
"Ok! Let's go before Chichi gets ahold of me again!" Goku declared as he used his Instant Transmission to appear right next to his father.
"Right." Bardock nodded in agreement, also not wanting to get caught in Chichi's path. "Your friend Bulma told me where the space-time orb things are kept, and apparently they even have different ones with different training environments and levels of gravity."
"Right! Let's go!" Goku exclaimed eagerly at the thought of getting more training in.
*...*
"Huh?" Goku suddenly uttered as he looked around confusedly.
"What's up son?" Bardock asked when he realized Goku wasn't following him.
"I just thought I heard something...?" Goku responded while tilting his head in confusion. He then looked around for the source of whatever it was he heard, but found nothing. Instead,
"WHERE DO YOU THINK YOU'RE GOING!!??" Chichi's angry voice roared out, drowning out anything else as panic gripped Goku's heart.
"Let's hurry dad!" Goku exclaimed while rushing away as fast as he could, followed by Bardock as he slowly shook his head.
...
"Dum dum dum, bang the drums! Dum dum dum, bang the drums!" An alien child sang happily as he walked beside his mother on one of the many planets within Universe Seven, making his mother giggle as she commented,
"That's a funny song, did you just make it up?" The child shook his head though, as he told her,
"I'm just singing with the drums!" The mom cocked her head confusedly, and listened intently, but couldn't hear a single thing.
"Silly boy, there aren't any drums." This time the boy cocked his head in confusion, and said,
"Yeah there are! Torry and Halla heard them too!" The mom looked even more confused at that, but, deciding that it must've been some children's game, smiled and said,
"That's lovely, I'm sure the drums sound really nice." The child glared at his mother when he heard that, seemingly realizing that she didn't believe him.
"I do hear them! The drums are real!"
"Of course they are." The mother said with a smile as they walked back to their home.
...
"Huh?" Uttered a blue skinned figure with his hair pulled back in a style reminiscent of long brown dreadlocks, pointed ears, and a string of what appeared to be long pointed teeth tied around his forehead. He was also shorter than the other three with him who possessed similar physical features, one man who was significantly taller than the rest, another man who was considerably fat, and a short woman who was barely taller than he was with dark pink dreads.
"What's up Gas?" The fatter man asked curiously, as Gas rarely ever spoke unless it was necessary.
"I thought I heard something." Gas replied to his brother, Oil, who then similarly cocked his head as he tried to listen for whatever his brother might have heard.
"I think you're imagining it, I don't hear anything." The girl, Macki, said after a moment of silence as she too tried to listen intently, but heard nothing.
"You need to stop focusing on such useless things Gas, and focus on becoming stronger to defeat the Dragon Emperor... Damn, and when we were so close too." The tallest man of the bunch uttered angrily from their current situation.
They were the Heeters, a group that were in a business partnership wth the tyrant Frieza until he met his end on the planet Earth. With Frieza dead, the leader of the Heeters, the tall man named Elec, had tried using his numerous connections, vast wealth, and wide net of information in order to absorb the Frieza Force army into own to become the dominant force in the entire universe.
At least, that had been the plan before 'he' showed up. The Dragon Emperor.
With even the terrifying Lord Beerus apparently wiling to do his bidding, powerful fighters from all over the universe were coming out of the woodwork to prepare for his so-called tournament, and many of them were more than happy to target both the Heeters and the remnants of the Frieza Force to pass the time and test their strength until then.
"Gas, you need to make sure to become even stronger before this tournament starts, and while we're there, you need to kill the Dragon Emperor!" Elec then said to his little brother with a malicious sneer, drawing the other three from searching for whatever it was that Gas had heard as he obediently said,
"Very well, I will go train."
"Excellent." Elec stated as Gas walked away, but even as he left the shortest of the four Heeters was still looking around curiously, thinking to himself,
'I could have sworn I heard some drums...?'
***
"Are you having fun Edith?" Gabriel asked her daughter as the duo walked through the streets of this new Earth, dressed in long dresses that, along with Gabriel's beauty, drew nearly every eye to them.
Edith, who was currently busy licking her ice cream cone and getting numerous drops of it on her nice blue dress, happily said,
"Yep! Earth is so much fun!" Gabriel smiled warmly as she recalled everything they had done that day, from getting their pictures taken together with some costumes and backdrops, to going shopping to buy Edith some new and interesting clothes, and even stopping at a candy shop where she got her ice cream. If there was one dampener on their fun day, it was what Edith gave voice to next, as she said somewhat sadly,
"I wish daddy were here though..." Gabriel winced as Edith brought up Alex, and wondered for the ten thousandth time where he was.
It was completely unlike Alex to just bail and leave behind everyone for so long, especially his children. They had even stopped brining several of the kids, like Edith, into the space-time orb at night just so the time until their father returned wouldn't be extended from their point of view.
Just as Gabriel was wondering what she going to do about this, as part of the reason she took Edith out to begin with to take her mind off of Alex's disappearance, the little girl suddenly heard something and looked up curiously.
"Daddy?" Edith asked suddenly, making her mother look back to her curiously right as she lit up and cried out happily, "Daddy!"
"Huh? 'Daddy'? Where?" Gabriel asked confusedly as she looked around, seemingly thinking that Alex would be just randomly walking up to them in the middle of the shopping district. She then looked up, like Edith, but even as she expanded her senses to their limits she couldn't detect Alex anywhere.
"Where's daddy Edith?" She asked worriedly, making her daughter look at her with a wide smile.
"I can hear daddy!" With no further explanation, Edith continued walking with a spring in her step that wasn't there before, as she happily sang,
"Dum dut da da! Dum dut da da! Dum dut da da! Hehehehe!" With her confusion and worry growing with each passing second, Gabriel immediately contacted Anne to let her know what was going on, before turning her attention back to Edith, who was having a much better day now.

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - 459: Awakening
chapters.content:
"DAMN THEM!"
*BOOM!*
"DAMN THEM ALL!" Shouted a blue-skinned figure of relatively short stature, with a large round and black nose, as he punched whatever happened to be nearby in frustration.
He was currently sitting in what appeared to be a throne, on a beat up spaceship, in the middle of nowhere. Next to it were three other disk-shaped spaceships that were similarly beat up, all of which had the symbol for the Frieza Force emblazoned on them. They were all that remained of the once mighty and terrifying army that rule entire swaths of the universe with an iron fist.
The rest of their once vast and mighty army had been hunted down and slaughtered by the forces of the Dragon Emperor, or those who wanted to use them to test their own might for the upcoming tournament. The worst ones though, had been the 'monsters'.
First there was the one who would regenerate no matter how much she was killed, draining the life force from her opponents despite her 'cute' outer appearance. Those that she didn't drain though were killed by what could only be described as 'magic', as the elements themselves came to life to engulf their ships and even entire swaths of whatever planet they were on. Dragons made of rock, fire, lightning, and ice would descend upon them, opening their maws to suck anything in as if they were also made of black holes.
Then was the 'knight', who's impenetrable armors and deadly weapons allowed her to cut through their forces like a hot knife through butter, turning any place she visited into a massacre. Usually accompanying her was the 'Demon', a white-haired woman who would torment her opponents with sadistic glee as she fought to eliminate more people than her comrade.
Of them and the others that plagued them though, the most terrifying was the brutal rabbit, who would smash anyone foolish enough to face her apart with her bare hands like it was nothing, before going on to do the exact same thing to any planet they were on. And then there was the 'Angel of Death', who's hauntingly beautiful song would shred the bodies of those who heard it regardless of where they were in the world.
With the man on the throne shaking with both rage and fear of the 'monsters' who had decimated their armies in a few short months, one of his subordinates hesitantly asked,
"Lord Sorbert, what do we do now?" The blue man, Sorbert, looked at the subordinate who asked him that, silencing him with just that look, before saying in a deathly calm voice,
"We rebuild, that's what." Naturally there appeared to be some skepticism at what he said, but Sorbert ignored it as he continued,
"They only drove us into such a corner because the Dragon Emperor and his 'pets' caught us by surprise. Now we know better, now we can make a plan. The first thing we need to do is recruit some new blood, stretch the scouters as much as possible! Find us some new recruits!" Though they knew there was next to no chance of this working, and that they were all either going to die or waste away at the edges of the universe, the men following Sorbert followed his command as it was the only course of action left for them.
For days they kept the scouters active as the scoured the edges of the universe for any sign of someone who was strong enough for them to recruit, but as time wore on their standards sank lower and lower, until they were even willing to take in something with enough strength to hold a mop.
"Lord Sorbert, I don't think there's anything out here..." One of the men eventually told their leader as the days stretched into weeks, making him grit his teeth in anger before pointing his Bad Ring Laser at the man and shooting a hole through his chest, killing him instantly.
"Any other comments or concerns?" Sorbert asked the rest of the deathly silent crew, all of which went back to their work without another word, until,
"Lord Sorbert!" One man suddenly called out, alerting the others as he said,
"I picked up a high power level! It easily exceeds one billion!" The man's words caused quite the stir amongst the rest of the crew, and most of all, Lord Sorbert. Even Frieza at his strongest right before he had been killed only had a power level of 135,000,000(A.N. As stated on the 'perfect power level' page of the wiki).
"Trace it! We can't let this chance go waste!" Sorbert ordered without a single second of hesitation, which his men hurriedly followed as all four of the ships began moving through space towards the source of the insane power level as quickly as possible.
Moving at several thousand times the speed of light, they were able to trace the source of the extremely high power level quickly, which led them to a massive hyper giant star that appeared to be tens of thousands times larger than a typical star.
"I can't detect any habitable planets, moons, or any other terrestrial bodies near this star. There's no place for a person to hide here."
"Just the kind of environment a powerful person would want to go to!" Sorbert exclaimed excitedly as he scrutinized the area before them, which thankfully the material used in making their windows also filtered out all the harmful effects of looking directly at the star.
"Narrow down the search area for that power level!" He then ordered the man who first detected it.
"Sir!" The man exclaimed as she hurriedly began tapping the keys on his dashboard to do just that.
The rest of the crew watched the window with bated breath as they waited to hear the man's report, however what he said next stunned them.
"I-I think that the power level we're detecting is coming from INSIDE the heart of that star!"
"""WHAT!?!"""
"I-inside the star?!?" Sorbert and the rest of the crew exclaimed in shock at the power one must require to be able to reside in the heart of such a large and hot star. But with their equipment, they were soon able to confirm the crewman's claims as they actually scanned the interior of the star, and discovered the figure of a person within.
"Amazing..."
"To think there was actually someone in the heart of the star...!"
"He's got to be way stronger than Frieza ever was..."
Everyone couldn't help but to voice their awe, until one of them uttered,
"How are we supposed to communicate with them though?" That question stumped everyone, as there was no way for them to get the attention of whoever was within the star, and they also had to stay far enough away that the gravity of the star didn't pull them in.
"What to do..." Sorbert muttered to himself as he tried to think of a way to establish communication with the figure, until something else caught his attention.
"Do you guys hear that?" He asked warily, making everyone else strain their ears carefully.
"Yeah."
"What is that?"
"Drums.....a heart beat?"
Sorbert and the others searched for the source of the mysterious beat, but to no avail until one of them asked,
"Is it....coming from him?" As one, everybody turned towards the image of the figure in the heart of the star, watching it intently as if waiting for some indication that the mysterious beat was coming from him.
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DABOOM!*
Suddenly, the entire star pulsed as the entire fiery surface began to ripple.
"W-what's happening!?" One of the crew uttered with a growing sense of dread, even as the mysterious beat began to grow even louder.
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DABOOM!*
*DABOOM!*
*DABOOM!*
The star also continued rippling as the pulses increased to a rapid pace, until the entirety of the massive hyper giant became turbulent like the waves of the ocean.
"I think we should get out of-blarggagag!"
"What!?!" Sorbert uttered when one of his men suddenly collapsed while foaming at the mouth, before another, and then another.
"Lord Sorbert! The figure's power level is shooting up!" One of his men that were still conscious shouted.
"It's reached ten billion, a hundred, now a trillion! It's still climbing higher-blegergegag." As that subordinate also passed out, sorbet was left all alone with his top two fighters who were barely able to retain their own consciousness, Shisami and Tagoma.
"Lord Sorbert, we need to get out of here!" Tagoma declared nervously as he went to try and pilot the ship himself, only for most of the ship's equipment to suddenly short circuit due to the rapidly rising energy levels.
"What is going on?!?" Shisami exclaimed in frustration, even as their ship began to shake violently from the beat being produced by the star.
But Sorbert's attention was on something else. On their main monitor was still the image of the figure they had detected within the star, who until now was posed like they were in a meditative state. Now however, the figure was moving.
As Sorbert's attention was focused on the figure on the monitor, Tagoma cried out,
"Lord Sorbert, the star is shrinking!" The trio watched with increasing horror as the star the figure had been meditating in, began to shrink at an alarming rate as their sensors showed the energy from said hyper giant star to be flowing INTO the figure them-self.
The trio could only watch in horror, along with anyone who was still conscious in the other three ships, as the massive star vanished before their eyes, leaving only the person who had been meditating within it. Now they could truly lay eyes upon him for the first time instead of just his outline through their scans, and they could only grow even more terrified.
The person within the star appeared to be completely bare except for the swirling glowing tattoos that covered the majority of their upper body, and a mane of brilliant white flame that flowed how their back, matching the rings of white flame that cuffed their wrists and ankles. The part that scared the trio more than anything though, was the several meter long monkey-like tail that was also covered in white flame and swayed behind the figure.
"Get us out of here! NOW!" Sorbert ordered as he realized that the very figure he had been trying to communicate with until now, was actually one THOSE Saiyans.

"Here you go princess!" Beerus' condescending voice echoed out as he sneered at Rias, while an entire planet bore down onto her. It was only a little bit bigger than Pluto, but that didn't change the fact that it was still an entire planet.
Rias however didn't back down, and didn't waver in the face of the oncoming terrestrial body. Instead, she simply pointed at the massive oncoming body and 'willed' it's destruction.
The planetary body suddenly exploded into thousands of tiny pieces, before an even larger explosion rocked the three of them as the power of Destruction displayed its force.
Despite the vast majority of her demonic power being drained, Rias still had a happy expression on her face from successfully Destroying an entire planet, though she didn't actually begin to celebrate. Spending more than four months as Beerus' apprentice had long since taught her not to do such things.
"Hmmm. Not bad." Beerus said as he surveyed her handiwork, surprising Rias before he added, "I suppose this will work for now, though you have a long way to go until you become a 'true' Destroyer."
Confused, Rias hesitantly asked,
"Am I...done?" Beerus glared at Rias when he heard her question, making the Crimson Haired Ruin Princess flinch and stiffen, before Whis stated,
"Ohohohoho, of course! Though he wouldn't say it directly, you've passed the basic requirement to consider yourself a Destroyer. You still need to train on your own of course, but teaching you any further than this would mean you taking Lord Beerus' place in the near future."
"Humph." Beerus snored at Whis' comment, neither confirming or denying it as he looked away pointedly.
Rias however felt relief flood her at realizing that her training with Beerus was over, which meant she could return home to her son and help try to locate Alex. As if reading her mind though, Whis then added,
"Oh yes! I just remembered that Alex has resurfaced, though it appears he's returned home already." Rias perked up when she heard that, as she asked urgently,
"Really!? Alex has returned already!?!" Nodding, Whis stated,
"Yes, I detected him not too long ago, though I am curious as what it was he used to hide from even my gaze! Ohohohohoho!" As Whis began to laugh in his usual manner, and Rias prepared to leave, Beerus suddenly stopped her as he said,
"Hold on a minute." Rias turned just in time to catch something that went flying at her out of the air, which she opened her hand to see a small golden band that was about an inch wide.
"That is the symbol of those who use the power of Destruction." Beerus explained while pointing to his own ear, where a matching golden band rested.
"I see..." Rias said, before placing the band on her upper left ear as well. Though she didn't like wearing jewelry that someone besides Alex gave her, the symbolism behind the earring was another matter entirely. Nodding in approval, Beerus said,
"Now all you encounter in our universes will know you're a wielder of the power of Destruction." For the briefest of seconds Rias could have sworn she saw the edge of Beerus' lips curl upwards as he said that, but it was gone so quickly that she wondered if she imagined it.
"Oh? Beerus has taken an apprentice? I wonder what brought this on?"
"Humph!" Beerus snorted before continuing, "I just didn't want the name of the Destroyers to be-" He then stopped talking before blinking a few times in confusion, before turning to look at the person who just spoke.
Standing there, without any of the three noticing until now, was four newcomers. The first was fairly short man with his white hair slicked back, and a halo hovering behind his head. Then was the tallest two of the four, a pair of identical looking men who were attired in long purple jackets with gold trim, which covered the lower half of their blue-skinned faces.
However the one all three of them focused on was the shortest of the bunch, a figure that stood at barely two feet off the ground with blue and purple skin.
*CRASH!*
Upon realizing who was there, Beerus immediately slammed his face into the dirt at their feet with enough force to create a crater, and practically screamed,
"Greetings to the Omni King! I apologize for not greeting your eminence upon arrival!" While Beerus was freaking out, Whis calmly bowed at the waist and said respectfully,
"Greetings Lord Omni King."
Following the duo's lead, Rias then also curtsied as well as she could, and said,
"It's is a pleasure to meet you great Omni King." When Rias straightened up she continued, "I am Rias, current head of the devil Dukedom of Gremory." When he heard that the Omni King tilted his head in confusion and asked,
"Devil? Gremory? What are those?" Instead of Rias, it was the short man accompanying him, the Grand Priest, that answered,
"Devils are the beings that reside in the afterlife where evil and malicious souls go to, though I've never seen one that looks like this before..." As he said that, the Grand Priest conjured an image of the Devils found in the twelve universes, humanoid beings with skin tones of all colors, and traits like horns, wings, and even clawed nails.
"Ohhhhh..." The Omni King said while slowly nodding his head in understanding, before asking Rias, "Then why do you look so different?"
Though both Beerus and Whis tried to shake their heads at her from behind the Omni King, Rias bluntly said,
"Well that is because I'm not from any of the twelve universes. We came here from another reality." When she said that Beerus face-palmed in exasperation, while Whis gave Rias a pitying look as if she'd just made a mistake.
Rias however didn't care. The Omni King would know about them sooner or later, so it would be better to learn his stance now than have him wipe out all of Asora and its connected world's or something.
"I see..." The Omni King said slowly, before slowly raising his hand and directing it at Rias. "So you're an 'outsider'."
Rias felt alarm bells going off in her mind as the Omni King seemingly decided to erase her right then and there, but she didn't back down or even flinch at the prospect. But then Whis stuck his staff out in between them, stalling the Omni King at the sudden disruption before he asked,

"I am deeply sorry my Lord Omni King, but I cannot allow you to erase this person just yet. I am willing to take any punishment afterwards if you hear me out." To say that the four newcomers were surprised at Whis' sudden insubordination would be an understatement, and not one to be taken lightly as the Omni King asked him in a deathly serious voice,

"Indeed, but he also states that there is a being with the Dragon Emperor who he claims is as powerful as your eminence." That caught the four of them by surprise, as the two attendants began sweating with concern while the Grand Priest asked,
"Oh? He has someone that strong?" Instead of Whis though, it was Rias who stated,
"The one Whis is talking about is Ophis, the god of dragons from my universe who embodies the concept of infinity. However now she is also considered the guardian deity of our home, a world called Asora." When she said this Rias emphasized the point that Ophis was regarded as a guardian in an effort to deter the Omni King from trying to Destroy them, as well to try and put more value in protecting and nurturing than Destroying.
For a moment no one said anything as they watched the Omni King ponder on everything he had learned, before the incredibly short figure finally said to Rias,
