Her recollections were interrupted when the Grand Priest suddenly asked,
"Is that it there?" Rias looked up to see the planet of Pangea growing larger as they rapidly approached it.
"Yep, that's it alright." Rias confirmed as they moved in, while also silently hoping that Alex was already ready for their arrival.
Knowing where to go, Whis brought them down right in front of the gate leading to Asora, where Alex was waiting with an entire group of people, including a certain petite figure dressed in gothic-Lolita attire.
Rushing out the moment the bubble-like sphere around them disappeared, Rias ran to Alex before throwing her arms around him and kissing him excitedly.
"Where have you been?" She demanded the moment their lips separated, though Alex continued holding her in his arms as he gave her the same excuse he gave Anne.
"I went on a three month binge of drugs, booze, and alien hookers." Rias deadpanned at Alex's answered as she turned to look at Anne, and asked,
"Is he being serious?" Anne however only shrugged her shoulders as she said,
"He won't say anything else." Rias pouted cutely at Alex for not telling her the truth, but before she could say anything more the sound of someone clearing their throat cut her off as the Grand Priest announced,
"Presenting the ruler and supreme existence of the twelve universes, his eminence! Grand Zeno, the Omni King!" As he declared so, the Grand Priest kneeled before the Omni King along with Beerus, Whis, and his two attendants. However all the people gathered with Alex barely did more than bow or curtsy politely to the Omni King, while Alex himself released his hold on Rias and stepped forward towards the tiny King.
"Nice to meet ya, I'm Alexander Morningstar, the Dragon Emperor." He introduced himself while offering his hand, confusing the Omni King as his lack of fear and reverence.
Just as he was about to respond though, the Omni King noticed a certain someone amongst Alex's group. It wasn't the petite figure in the black dress, but a woman in a maid outfit with long purple hair that was staring at him intently.
The silence stretched as Alex awkwardly held his hand out, and the Omni King alternated his attention between Alex and the woman behind him. Eventually, realization seemed to dawn upon the short King, but not the kind of realization Alex and the others were waiting for.
"Ah!" He exclaimed suddenly while hitting his open palm with his fist. The Omni King then spoke for the first time to Alex as he said,
"I just remembered! You must be one of the people the Creator told me about!"

chapters.title: Chapter 461 - 461: Oops
chapters.content:
"""What...?"""
That was all anyone, even Alex, could utter when they heard the Omni King's remark. And it was only then that the Omni King seemed to have realized he said something he shouldn't have, as he quickly, added,
"Oops.... That was supposed to be a secret..."
*CRASH!*
Nearly everyone around the Omni King fell to the ground in exasperation at his comment, before Elaine stated,
"It would be moot point to avoid mentioning the Creator now Zeno, though I do hope you recall what he told you when you discussed the current competition." The Omni King looked at Elaine once more, the very person who's appearance confirmed Alex's identity to him, and said,
"Well.... I don't really recall everything he said since it was so long ago.... Hehe!"
*CRASH!*
Again, nearly everyone fell over at his words, while Elaine just sighed as she shook her head, before saying with a deadpan,
"Well, to summarize it, the Creator simply doesn't want you to needlessly Destroy any of the contestants."
"Ah! That's right!" The Omni King said while making another 'aha' gesture, before turning to Alex and Rias and saying with a slight bow,
"I'm sorry for trying to eliminate your wife earlier." This gesture shocked everyone present who knew the Omni King, as they had never seen him either bow or apologize to anyone, while a certain someone had a drastically different reaction.
"You tried to eliminate my wife?" Alex asked as his eye twitched slightly, to which the Omni King cheerfully replied,
"Yep! She is from 'outside', and things from the 'outside' can't be allowed in! But I'll make an exception for one of the Creator's contestants!" With an attitude that said 'thats that', the Omni King smiled widely as if he hadn't just casually mentioned erasing one of the women Alex loved.
...
*PA!*
"Please stop!"
*PA!*
"I said I'm sorry!"
*PA!*
"No more!"
*PA!*
The gathered crowds watched in shock as the Omni King, the most powerful, respected, and feared being in the Twelve Universes, was being spanked like a child by Alex.
To those who followed Alex this was just another day in their life, but for those from the Twelve Universes, this was perhaps the single most incredulous thing they had ever witnessed. Beerus, the god of Destruction for Universe Seven, was even collapsed on the ground and deathly pale, making some wonder if he'd literally been frightened to death at what was happening before him.
"Is the Creator truly such a fearsome being?" The Grand Priest asked Elaine hesitantly, as the idea of someone who stood above even the Grand Zeno was truly terrifying. The maid however readily nodded and said,
"The Creator is the one who created infinite universes and all of their inhabitants, including the 'King of All'. It's only natural that he would listen to the Creator, as the Creator was the one who granted him sovereignty over these Sixteen Universes, though there's only twelve left."
The Grand Priest was silent as he digested what Elaine had told him, but even if he wanted to doubt her words the truth was right before him. The Grand Zeno, the pinnacle of existence within all twelve of their universes, was being spanked by the man calling himself the Dragon Emperor.
Soon the spanking finally came to an end, and Alex released the Omni King from his hold as the child-like King rubbed his royally sore ass.
"That hurt..." He complained pitifully.
"Good. Maybe you'll learn not to Destroy first and ask questions later." Alex said with a bit of an edge in his voice, but the Omni King didn't say anything back since Alex could very well be his boss one day. Never did any of the Omni king's subjects truly think that one day the shoe would be on the other foot.
"Perhaps things should be left at this? Yes?" The Grand Priest suggested to Alex as he felt that spanking the King of All in front of his own subjects was a little 'extreme', especially since no real harm had been done.
Thankfully, Alex nodded in agreement as he said,
"I'd be more than happy to start over as friends if he won't Destroy me or my loved ones." The Omni King nodded as he paused rubbing his ass to say,
"Of course, I already said I'll make an exception for the Creator's people." Alex nodded as he held his hand out to the Omni King, and said,
"Ok then. Friends Zeno?" The Omni King looked at Alex's hand suspiciously at first, as he had just been spanked by it, before eventually reaching up and grasping it while saying,
"Friends!" The two then shook hands to symbolize their friendship, which mostly entailed Alex moving Zeno's entire body up and down like one would normally shake.
With that done, Alex then declared,
"Now, let's feast!" With a clap of his hands, Alex produced dozens of tables laden with food for everyone who was present to enjoy, Zeno and his attendants, Alex's entourage, and the nearby people of Pangea. It was truly a feast the likes of which a certain battle-crazed Saiyan would be very sore he missed, but no one thought about collecting him and his father from the space-time orb they were training in.
Also participating in the feast after Alex sent the OK, was his own children as they happily ran too and fro to look around and meet new people. The one they were most excited to meet though was none other than Zeno, who they readily welcomed as just another playmate while neither knowing or caring that he was the feared ruler of the Twelve Universes.
And as for Zeno himself, he seemed to really enjoy having someone to play with that didn't regard him purely with fear due to his status as the King of All. For the first time in eons, he was able to have fun and enjoy himself without being constantly reminded of his rank and position.
Nearby was Alex, keeping a watchful eye on his children of course as he reclined back on a blanket with Rias and Anne snuggled up on either side, and Ophis making herself comfortable in his lap. As the group was relaxing and enjoying themselves, a certain figure approached them that Alex wasn't quite expecting.
"Greetings Dragon Emperor. May I have a word?" The Grand Priest asked respectfully, to which Alex just sighed before crawling to his feet, much to Ophis and the girl's displeasure.
"Sure, what's up?" He asked while walking off a short ways, during which the Grand Priest was silent for a few moments, before finally saying,
"First of all, I would like to thank you."
"What for?" Alex asked curiously, to which the Grand Priest replied,
"Though he may look and act like a child, the King of All is far older than any of us can even comprehend. And in all that time I've never seen or heard of anyone who would speak or treat him like you did today." Alex cooked a brow and said,
"I take it that's a good thing?" The Grand Priest hesitated slightly before answering,
"In this case, I would say it is. Though it may be presumptuous of me, I believe i understand how the King of All has been feeling lately with his loneliness and boredom. Meeting you and your children seems to have changed all of that though."
Alex nodded slowly in understanding at the Grand Priest's story, as it was one of the oldest ones in the book. The 'all powerful being' being lonely and depressed because there's no one to understand them. It also made sense because Zeno also quickly made friends with Goku while making numerous exceptions towards his relatively rude behavior. It was also why Ophis readily accepted being friends with him as well, as she was so powerful that no one ever even considered trying to befriend her in the past.
"As cliche as it sounds," Alex began slowly. "Everybody needs a friend, or at least some kind of companion they can share their joys and sorrows with. When all you have is 'subjects', it can be hard to find such a person." The Grand Priest was silent as he contemplated what Alex said, before saying with a wry smile,
"I suppose you would also know about that, Mr. 'Dragon Emperor'." Alex looked confused at that, as he asked,
"Know about what?" This time the Grand Priest looked confused as he clarified,
"About status inducing loneliness..." Alex appeared even more confused at that as he asked,
"Why would I know about that?" The Grand Priest deadpanned as he slowly said,
"Because you're an emperor..." Alex cocked his head as he asked,
"What does that have to do with it?" By this point the Grand Priest's eye began to twitch as he stated plainly,
"Wouldn't people feel intimidated by you like they would the Omni King?" Alex just snorted when he heard that and remarked,
"Not at all. I may be the dragon Emperor, but I don't 'rule' over Asora like that." The Grand Priest only looked even more confused at that, so Alex decided to show him instead of telling him.
"Hey Joshua!" Alex called out to one of the men passing by, before tossing him a bottle and saying, "Have some sake, on me!"
The man grabbed the bottle out of the air and looked at it, before smiling wryly at Alex as he said,
"Thanks your majesty, but you know Sonya will kill me if she finds out." Alex waved away his concerns as he said,
"I won't tell if you don't." Joshua thought about it for a moment, before popping the cork in the bottle and said,
"To your health then your majesty!" Raising the bottle in a toast, Joshua quickly downed the contents as he went on his way.
The Grand Priest looked at Alex confusedly from the exchange, but before he could ask what that was all about Alex then called out to someone else in a friendly manner, asking how the renovations for their shop was going, before offering to help them out. For several minutes the Grand Priest watched as Alex talked to person after person as if they were best of friends, and they talked to him back in the same way.
When Alex finally turned his attention back to him, he stated plainly,
"I don't have 'subjects', I have 'people'. People that are loyal and even worship me, but 'people' all the same that I interact with on a personal level nearly everyday. And even if I didn't have them, then there are my MANY wives that will put me in my place if need be." Alex then looked towards Zeno, who was playing with his children, and said,
"Zeno only has 'subjects', of which only an infinitesimal amount even know he exists. Even if that didn't matter, the majority of his interactions with those that do know about him are comprised of him either commanding them in some way, or threatening to Destroy them. It's only natural that he'll eventually become lonely." The Grand Priest was silent as he contemplated everything Alex told him, before bowing to him and saying,
"I thank you for the discussion, it has been most enlightening." Alex nodded while thrusting a hand out towards the Grand Priest, and said,
"Any time." The Grand Priest looked at Alex's hand curiously for a moment, before grasping it with his own and shaking it like they were equals. After a second he then said,
"I'll be taking my leave now for a bit, as the King of All has asked me to collect the Gods of Destruction and the Kai's from the other eleven universes for a meeting. Before I go though, I want to say that if you ever need anything, don't hesitate to let me know."
Though he was going to say that he'd keep the offer in mind, Alex paused slightly before saying instead,
"Actually, there was one thing if it's not too much trouble."
***
As the hours slipped by things began to get pretty hectic on Pangea.
Starting with the arrival of the other twelves gods of Destruction, their Angels, and the twelve Kai's, as well as the Kai's of Universe Seven that Alex brought back when he killed Majin Buu. Then there was the people of Pangea that hadn't joined them yet, who gladly took the chance to relax on their training for a bit, and blow off some steam.
People even began pouring into Pangea from Asora as they heard of the Omni King's arrival and the subsequent party they were having. And as the afternoon wore on, Alex found himself wandering around the place with even his two youngest daughter's, Jade and Mochi.
The little Saiyan princesses were wide eyed as they took in all the sights and people around them, cooing and squealing excitedly whenever something interesting caught their attention. With Jade on his hip and Mochi walking beside him with her hand in his, the duo got to meet many new people, and were given numerous treats as Alex led them around.
"You really are a weird Saiyan, you know?" A voice suddenly drew Alex's attention to the side, where he found the two Bulmas standing there.
"How so?" Alex asked curiously, to which the future Bulma stated,
"Because I've never seen Vegeta or Goku spend so much time on their children the way you do. And based off of what Gine was telling us when Chichi gave birth to Goten, that's pretty standard for Saiyan men." Though he was surprised that Goten had already been born, Alex didn't question it since he correctly assume Chichi made use of the space-time orbs on Pangea to speed up her pregnancy. Instead, he simply told the Bulmas,
"I wouldn't hold that against Goku though. The guy DID retire from fighting when he got married to focus on his family, and only got sucked back in when Raditz showed up." The two Bulmas nodded in agreement, as Alex did have a point about that.
What he did next though made both Bulmas blush as he stepped forwards and said suggestively, "By the way, if you want someone to help raise baby Trunks I wouldn't mind volunteering, same with if you want to give him a baby brother or sister."
Both women turned completely red as they recalled when Alex 'broke' them, both in body and spirit. They thought they peeked with Vegeta and his beast-like attitude in bed, but Alex had proven them completely wrong.
Alex smirked playfully as he picked up little Mochi in his free arm, so that he was carrying both girls as they went to go find someplace else to play, leaving the two Bulmas with overheated minds.
...
Slowly day turned into night as Pangea's sun descended, casting a darkness over their party that was quickly dispelled by numerous lights that went up. Though they had all been tense in the beginning when they arrived, by now even the gods of Destruction had begun loosening up as Alex talked to them one by one.
The discussions went as one would assume for the most part, Alex could see evident scorn or judgment in the eyes of most goes of Destruction due to him being a 'mortal'. But when they learned of Alex's true status, that he went toe to toe with Beerus and even spanked the Omni King just earlier, they immediately became more respectful towards him. Meanwhile the goddess Heles apparently became enamored with Alex on sight due to his 'beauty', and was trying to curry favor with him, something he wouldn't necessarily mind if he hadn't been currently escorting two of his daughters.
Eventually though things had to come to an end, as Jade and Mochi both let out sleepy yawns in his arms, alerting Alex that it was time for him to bring booth them and the rest of his children into the space-time orb for the night.
Approaching Whis, Alex said,
"I'm heading home to get my children to bed. I'll see Zeno myself, but can you give the rest my regards?" Whis nodded in affirmation as he said,
"Of course! I'd be happy to help." Ale thanked him and was about to go and find the rest of his children, when someone cried out nearby,
"The moon looks so beautiful tonight!" Confused, Alex uttered,
"Huh? Pangea doesn't have a moon though?" As he turned though, Alex paused as he saw a silvery disk slowly rising over the horizon.
"Actually," Whis said as he peered into the orb at the top of his staff. "It appears that a passing terrestrial body was captured in Pangea's gravitational pull a few weeks ago. Good news, it appears as if it is capable of supporting life too!" As Whis was speaking though, Alex's mind was racing even as he swore under his breath,
"Fuck..." The vulgarity caught Whis' attention as he was about to ask what was wrong, before he noticed the two girls in Alex's arms.
"Oh dear..." He too uttered as both girls, who had been on the verge of sleep seconds before were staring wide eyed at the full moon.
"Fucking FUCK!" Alex swore in a much louder voice as he saw each and every one of his children staring at the moon with blank and empty expressions.

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - 462: The Power of Nika
chapters.content:
"WHY DIDN'T ANYONE FUCKING TELL ME ABOUT THIS!?!" Alex swore loudly as he watched the full moon rise higher, before he teleported both Jade and Mochi away to a remote part of Pangea. He wasn't worried about their safety though, as both girls had already begun growing larger in his arms.
Instead, Alex was worried about the rest of his children, as well as Myuu and Videl, as they too began their first ever Oozaru transformation. Altogether that would be twenty-one transformed Saiyans rampaging in the middle of their party, which wouldn't be that hard to handle after Alex teleported them away. What bothered him the most about the current situation though, was that no one thought to mention the appearance of a new moon on Pangea when there were several Saiyans around.
He'd cross that bridge when he got to it though, and so Alex decided to focus on dealing with the current problem first as the rest of the children began their transformation as well.
Thankfully he wouldn't have to worry about Goten, Trunks, Gine, Goku, or Bardock, as the last two were still training in the space-time orb, and the other three were staying at home with moon tinted windows. There were however four other Saiyans that were still training in the wilds, but Vegeta Sr./Jr. And Raditz had all undergone training to control their transformations, while future Trunks was with his grandfather, who Alex trusted to keep his grandson in check as he rampaged.
So, all Alex had to worry about were the nineteen children still present, as he hurriedly transferred them all to the same area where he'd sent Jade and Mochi. And once that was done, Alex magically amplified his voice before declaring,
"Attention everyone! I apologize for the suddenness, but the appearance of the full moon has prompted an...unforeseen situation to arise. Thank you all for a wonderful evening, but I will now be taking my leave."
Then without another word, Alex teleported away himself, leaving his guests stunned at what just happened.
Once Alex arrived at the location where he sent the children he was greeted with a scene of mindless destruction as twenty-one Great Apes rampaged. Some were fighting each other, others were wandering around, and the rest were actively destroying anything around them.
Among them Alex could identify nine by sight due to the 'unique' physical characteristics they inherited from their mothers. First was Myuu, who still had her fin-like ears and webbed fingers/toes. Then there was Mai with her cat-ears and patches of white fur, along with the three tails swaying behind her.
After her was Regal, who had streaks of orange and gold in his fur that marked those of the house of Phenix, as if the flames he was breathing wasn't indicator enough. Then was the duo of Yuki and Aurora, both with the greatest differences yet with their pure snow-white fur and blizzards forming around them.
Similarly to them though was the godly trio of Nocta, Freydis, and Aife, who all had pure black, gold(not SSJ gold), and fiery red fur respectively, while Nocta was surrounded by a veil of darkness and Aife by fire. And then finally was Andre, who was distinguishable from his siblings simply due to his sheer size compared to the rest.
"What is that boy eating...?" Alex uttered as he marveled at his son's size, as even in his Great Ape form he towered over the rest of his siblings.
Thankfully though Videl, Edith, Alec, Anna, Lizzy, Ryuto, Shuri, Lana, Saya, Rito, Mochi, and Jade all seemed to simply be in the standard Great Ape transformation, and didn't have any of the 'quirks' the others were showing.
"But how should I deal with this...?" Alex asked himself as he contemplated the current situation.
The quickest and easiest solution would be to either destroy the new moon or cut off the kids tails, both of which he could easily reverse afterwards with Regeneration magic. However Alex was also reluctant to do since this could also be a good chance, a chance for the children to learn how to control their Great Ape transformations for the future.
So, Alex put a barrier in place around them to keep all of the children contained in with him, and prevent them from rampaging where they could run into other. However it wasn't designed to keep people out, as indicated when someone asked behind him a moment later,
"So what now?" Alex turned to face the new arrivals, which was composed of quite the crowd that included the mothers of all the children, Remia, Gabriel, Koneko, Anne, Ravel, Serafall, Mizore, Tsurara, Rias, Akeno, Grayfia, Nyx, Freya, Brigid, Levy, Shizuku, Yui, Mirajane, and Hisui. Aside from them was Beerus, Whis, Zeno, the Grand Priest, and three of the Angels from the other twelve universes, Kusu, Vados, and Marcarita.
Though he was curious as to why the King of All had come as well, along with Beerus and the Angels, Alex put it out of his mind as he answered Brigid's question.
"Well, I'm thinking I'll use this chance to try and help them learn how to control their Great Ape transformations. The only problem is, I don't know how they're supposed to learn how to control themselves..."
If they all hadn't been flying in the air(either through their own power or Lala's mass produced artificial wings), then all of the mothers would've fallen over like they did earlier when meeting Zeno. That didn't diminish the ridiculousness of the situation though, since Alex's plan was apparently to teach the children to do something he used his 'Mental Resistance' skill to do.
"And how exactly do you plan to do that?" Grayfia asked in a less than amused tone, to which Alex was silent for a moment as he pondered how to answer, before saying with a shrug,
"I'll just beat up on them until either they take control, or dawn arrives." The mothers just gaped at Alex in dumbfoundment, while Grayfia just massaged her temples while saying,
"I suppose I should've expected as much..." Seeing her just give in to Alex's plan, Yui sputtered while awkwardly moving towards him, due to her not being used to the artificial wings,
"W-wait a second!!! You're really just going to go over there and beat up our son just like that!?! What about your Spirit magic or something?!" Alex just shook his head while explaining,
"That would certainly work for this time, but it's not a permanent fix. Even when Lauren did the same for me before, I still rampaged when I transformed next." Yui bit her lower lip when she heard that, obviously still not content with Alex's plan. But, since she didn't know the first thing about magic and transformations herself, she couldn't offer any type of solution.
However it wasn't like Alex didn't understand her point of view, after all Yui was still just a 'normal' human compared to the rest of the mothers, and had NO intention of ever entering combat herself. Knowing this, Alex pulled her close and planted a chaste kiss on her lips, making Yui turn completely red at the public display of affection as she grumbled,
"How shameless..." Alex smirked at her reaction and was tempted to tease her further, but an ear-shattering roar from one of the Great Apes drew his attention back to the main problem at hand.
"Right.... You all may want to back up." Raising their brows at his warning, the girls slowly backed away several feet, only for him to say,
"A bit more." Their eyes narrowed as they moved several more feet back, only for Alex to smirk as he said,
"Further." Their curiosity rising, the women moved backed even further and continued moving until Alex indicated that they were ok...maybe. Hoping they far enough away, Alex did something none of them were expecting as his entire body was suddenly engulfed in brilliant white flames.
"Kyaaa!"
"Get back!"
The girls cried out as they hurriedly fled the area due to the bight white flames now engulfing Alex's body, which also filled the area with an intense heat that even the Phoenix Ravel and fire goddess Brigid couldn't handle.
"What is this!?!" Gabriel demanded as the flames continued circling Alex's body, which were so bright they hurt even her eyes when she looked at them, before she and the others felt a certain type of aura coming from him.
"Do you feel that?" The shortest of the three Angels accompanying the Grand Priest, Kusu, asked. Vados nodded as she said,
"Indeed, that is the power of a god." Next to her was the remaining angel, Marcarita, who remarked,
"I haven't seen the divine power of the gods used in such a way before. This will certainly be interesting." None of the three Angels were sure why their father brought them here with him, but the current situation was definitely interesting to them. Their interest increased when a certain melody began emanating from the swirling vortex of flames, which Whis and Beerus recognized immediately alongside Alex's wives.
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
"This is...?" Remia questioned curiously, having been hearing about the mysterious drumbeats, but not yet heard them herself.
"That is the sound of the Drums of Liberation." Alex's voice answered their curiosity as the flames finally began to die down, revealing his newest and what he considered to be his most powerful form to them.
Pure white flames flowed down from Alex's head in a brilliant mane, matching the rings of flame that cuffed his wrists and ankles. Even Alex's Saiyan tail, which was usually only a few feet long, now extended behind him by several meters while similarly being coated in the white flames.
Even now, the light and heat coming from the flames made the girls uncomfortable looking directly at Alex, or even being near him, while their surroundings had completely lit up as if he were the sun itself, and it were the middle of the day instead of night.
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
With the drum-like sound of his heart reaching its loudest point yet, Alex's voice echoed as he said to them,
"This is the fully awakened power of the Devil Fruit I ate, the power of the sun God Nika." The girl's eyes widen in shock when they heard that, as Alex never told them the truth behind his Devil Fruit, only that there was more to it than being a simple rubber fruit.
Any questions they had would need to wait though, as his flashy transformation and loud heartbeat attracted the attention of the transformed children, who were all sending dangerous looks in Alex's direction, as if their instincts were telling them to eliminate him as soon as possible.
The one nearest to them, Alec, opening his mouth wide to reveal an increasingly powerful glow, that erupted into a massive and long beam of energy that was fired directly at Alex.
With a near-crazed smile on his face, Alex swiftly dodged the attack before reaching out with his extended arm, and GRABBING the massive beam of energy from the side. Though it stretched impossibly, the beam of energy snapped back to its original form and held it so that it looked like Alex was holding onto a giant pool noodle made of light.
"And for my first trick-!" Alex cried out as he ignored the stupefied expressions around him, before he turned in an attempt to hide his actions from everyone as he did something to the elongated beam of energy.
"Ta da! A giant poodle!" Alex exclaimed a moment later while holding up the mass of energy, which he had bent and shaped like a balloon into an animal.
"I-is he being serious...?" Beerus asked, giving Alex's idiocy a less than amused look.
"How curious..." Whis uttered with a different expression on his face than Beerus, as he wondered HOW Alex managed to manipulate a mass of raw energy in such a way. Then there was someone else with an entirely different reaction.
"HOW COOL!" Zeno exclaimed with stars in his eyes as he looked at the poodle with longing, making the Grand Priest chuckle wryly while looking at Alex with an amused expression, while his daughters appeared to have the same intrigue as their brother.
Alex's wives on the other hand appeared less than amused at the situation for the most part, as Levy uttered in disbelief,
"Is he having fun with this...?" Naturally with the already tense situation, several of the mothers didn't like the idea of Alex just 'having fun'. But, before any of them could voice their complaints, a new voice said,
"I wouldn't take his current attitude too seriously, that's just how Nika is." The girls turned to see that none of them noticed Elaine's arrival, before Grayfia furrowed her brows as she asked,
"What do you mean by 'that's just how Nika is'?" Elaine sighed as she watched Alex tie two of the Saiyan children's tails together, and said,
"Nika IS a sun god, but the thing he is most associated is 'freedom'."
"Freedom?" Koneko asked suspiciously, to which Elaine explained,
"Yes, freedom. Nika is considered to be the embodiment of freedom itself, and is called the 'Warrior of Liberation' who travels from place to place, liberating those who need it while bringing smiles to their faces. Their power is only limited by their imagination, as they effect anything and everything around them."
The girls were silent as they absorbed this, before Serafall asked with a wry smile,
"But can someone who's an emperor REALLY be considered a 'liberator' though?" Though several of the girls agreed with Serafall's question somewhat, they were all surprised when the cold and taciturn Elaine smirked, and answered,
"Monkey D. Luffy, the man who currently owns the original fruit in the world they come from, is a notorious pirate who gained the majority of his infamy from defeating people that have oppressed others in some way or form. In the country of Alabasta he defeated a rival pirate who planned to take over the country in a coup. In Skypia he defeated its current ruler, 'god', before he could carry out his plan to slaughter the entire population that followed him.
"Then when just a single one of his crew mates was arrested, simply for the crime of living, he declared war on the entire world and sacked one of the marines greatest strongholds just to get her back. He then defeated someone who stole a ton of people's shadows, helped free an entire auction house of slaves after one of his friends was caught, led a mass breakout in the world's most fortified prison, attacked the marine headquarters to stop his brother's execution, prevented yet another coup in the mermaid kingdom, freed numerous children who were being experimented on, freed an entire nation from the ruthless tyranny they were under without even knowing it, and much more.
"All the while he refused to be called a hero, because he was a pirate and didn't want to be considered a 'good' guy. And then he was eventually raised to the position of one of the world's four pirate Emperors due to the people that chose to follow him of their own free will, the strength he eventually possessed after so many battles, and the number of powerful people he had defeated. All the while he himself didn't want the position, nor the responsibility of the people who wanted to follow him."

What position was she even in now?
Caulifa didn't know, and she didn't care.
All Caulifa cared about was the slab of meat that was currently destroying her womb, over and over again, making her cum over and over again.
It couldn't have been THAT long though, as she felt it very clearly when Alex finally reached that point himself, and her readily filled her womb with what felt like gallons of his own cum.
By this point Caulifa was laying face down on the stone floor of her cave hideout, with Alex thrusting into her from behind. And as she felt his cum fill her, her eyes rolled back into her head as the greatest orgasm yet surged through her body, before he began to fuck her with even greater intensity than before.
Eventually Alex whispered into her ear,
"Look Caulifa." And so she did, what the Saiyaness saw was her entire bandit clan that Alex had knocked out earlier, the five women, staring at her with gaping expression of shock.
"Don't worry." Alex said to suddenly, drawing Caulifa's attention back to him as he continued,
"I'll make sure to pleasure every single one of you as much as you want."
What followed was an orgy the likes of which none of the girls ever experienced before. Yeah, occasionally they'd pleasure each other after a stressful day, but never in their lives had they ever experienced the things Alex made them experience then.
For what seemed like days he made them experience pleasure like never before, with even Vados joining in at some point, as Alex eagerly jack hammered into his blue-skinned attendant. Such was the blessing of being able to manipulate time.
However, even as he readily fucked the numerous Saiyan women, Alex couldn't help but wonder in the back of his mind,
'Where is Kale?'
(A.N. We only see female Saiyans in Caulifa's clan in the manga, which is what I decided to go off of.)
***
"FUCK OFF!" Bardock roared as he and the other four Saiyan men tried to get away from their pursuers, a literal army of Saiyans that were trying to arrest them for indecent exposure.
Though they DID try to explain the situation and ask for clothes, the Saiyan army was intent on treating them as criminals no matter what, which was growing increasingly frustrating. And so now they were fleeing around the planet, still naked, and desperately trying to find something to wear.
"This is fucking ridiculous!" Raditz swore angrily, to which his brother replied,
"I still don't see what the problem is..."
"OF COURSE YOU WOULDN'T KAKAROT!" Raditz roared back, the temptation to blast him with an energy attack rising with each passing second.
"To think....the once feared and mighty Saiyan King would fall to this..." Vegeta Sr muttered with empty eyes, having never once imagined that he'd be chased by people trying to arrest him for STREAKING of all things.
"Well...Alex did try to warn us..." Trunks said next to him, his expression even more awkward than the rest at the situation, as he was unused to being naked around other men.
But thankfully, they were able to stay away from the rest of the Saiyans somewhat thanks to their training and the SSJ form, except for one person.
"Keep up son!" Bardock called back to Raditz irritably.
"I'm trying old man! Lay off!" Raditz snarled back, angry that he was being looked down on AGAIN. But it didn't end there, as suddenly something came out of nowhere and impacted him, sending him flying away from the group while the others continued on ahead.
"Should we go back for him?" Trunks asked worriedly, to which Bardock answered,
"Nah, he's not as weak as he thinks." Deciding to take his word for it, the other three Saiyans took off once again as they tried to lose their pursuers.
Meanwhile, Raditz had been forced to crash down into some mountains that were thankfully devoid of civilization, where a single figure landed a short ways away as she stated into her communicator,
"I brought one of them down. Once I restrain him then I'll take him back to headquarters for questioning!"
"That's excellent Potta!" A voice answered her, before asking, "Do you need any backup?" The Saiyan woman looked at the dust cloud as it began to settle, and thought for a moment before reporting back,
"Nah, I got this."
As she said that though, Raditz crawled out of the crater she punched him into to see who it was that got him, only to see a tall and tough looking Saiyan woman with the sides of her head shaved down to the skin, while the top was cut short and spiked upwards. Despite how tall and tough she looked though, the woman still had a slender frame and limbs that would've caught Raditz's eye if he weren't already so pissed off.
"So even a mere woman makes a mockery of me..." Raditz snarled as his fists clenched in anger, before the woman ahead of him shouted,
"This 'mere woman' just turned your sorry ass into a meteor, so I'd hold off on looking down on her you disgusting pervert scum!" That said, Potta suddenly shot forward at him with the intention of restraining Raditz so that she could take him in, prompting him to throw his hands up in an attempt to defend himself.
*DON!*
The impact of their fists echoed throughout their surroundings while the ground began to fracture beneath their feet, but neither of them noticed it as their arms locked together while neither gave any ground.
'Tied!' Radit exclaimed in his mind as the woman didn't give at all, while she snarled at him,
"So, not just a pervert then!" Raditz however ignored her as he instead tried to figure out how to get away from her.
It was at that moment, that something clicked within his mind.
'Get away?'
The two words repeated themselves within his mind over and over, like an echo that never went away.
All his life Raditz had been playing second and third fiddle, lesser than those around him no matter how he tried. Even when he, Nappa, and Vegeta were the only three Saiyans left for twenty years, they looked down upon him and mocked him for being 'weak' every chance they got, calling him 'Raditz the Runt'.
Then he recalled that his little brother was still alive, a Saiyan so weak that he had been sent out as an infiltration baby, or so Raditz thought after his parents told him where Kakarot was. But no, even if Raditz himself was stronger than his little brother, their clash still resulted in his death due to the Namekian that killed them both.
Now, being revived after so long, he had fallen behind every single one of the Saiyans that still lived and had been brought back, including his own little brother and 'soft' mother. And here he was after several months of hellish training, falling even with some random Saiyan woman from a planet of soft weaklings like his brother and mother, and his only thought was trying to get away from her.
"No more..." Raditz suddenly uttered quietly, making Potta look up at him and ask under the strain,
"Huh? You say something criminal?" Her breath then caught in her throat when Raditz looked up in time for her to noticed his eyes flash with a golden light as he repeated in a much firmer voice,
"No more.... HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA-"
The next thing Potta knew she was being blasted back by a sudden upsurge of golden energy that was encasing the criminal's body, as his hair and tail both began changing to a bright golden color as well.
"W-what is this?!" Potta exclaimed in shock, as she had never heard of such a transformation before, when her communicator suddenly beeped,
"Potta! What is going on!"
"S-somethings happening! The criminal...is turning gold!" She cried out into her communicator, before it suddenly burst in the wake of the energy spike.
The Saiyan woman then watched as the tips of the man's now golden to hair stood on end, but not the whole thing since his hair was so long, and the ground began to rumble under her as his energy continued climbing.
"HA!"
Letting out one last yell, there was a final flash of golden light and the transformation was complete, allowing Potta to be the first Saiyan from Universe Six to truly witness the Super Saiyan transformation. And every one of Potta's instincts screamed at her that the man in front of her now severally outclassed her.
"Finally!" Raditz exclaimed in sheer excitement, pleased that he had finally managed the transformation that had eluded him for so long.
He then turned his attention to the woman on the ground before him, and smirked as he said,
"I will be leaving now. Unless you want me to test my newfound power on you, then do not follow." Without another word, Raditz turned around took off in the direction he sensed his father and the rest in, leaving Potta to watch his departure with a shocked expression.
"Well what do you know?" Bardock smirked when he felt the sudden spike in energy behind them, before a golden streak soared through the air towards them.
"Hey bro! What took you so long?" Kakarot cried out when Raditz caught up, who smirked as he flashed the first smile Goku had ever seen from him. The duo then laughed as, for the first time in his life, Raditz felt as if a great weight had been lifted from his shoulders.
"So what now? Do we try to find Alex?" Trunks asked once they finished laughing, to which his grandfather said,
"No. His majesty would more than likely head to the castle where the king of Sadala resides, so I suggest we do the same. Besides, that's probably the best way for us to try and clear up this misunderstanding." With several grunts of affirmation answering him, the group of five Super Saiyans took off so fast that they left their pursuers in the dust as they searched out the residence of this world's King.
Though it took them a while, the group finally located the largest and grandest castle any of them had ever seen, dwarfing even Vegeta Sr's from when he was king of planet Vegeta. But the curious thing was that, when they landed, no one else was around. It was like the entire castle was deserted.
"Where is everybody?" Trunks asked in awe as they looked around, as the castle didn't appear abandoned except for the lack of people, before Goku answered,
"I feel a ton of presences in that direction." Following the direction he was pointing in, the group headed towards what Vegeta Sr assumed was the throne room.
When they opened the grand double doors though, a scene unlike any they were expecting greeted them.
"Hey guys! What took you so long?" Alex asked from the great throne, where he was sitting casually as if it were simply a chair. A Saiyan woman was draping her body onto his as she sat on the armrest, and five other Saiyan women were standing around him or attending him in ways like bringing him food or drink, while Vados stood attentively behind him. Meanwhile the entirety of the castle's occupants, including King Sadala himself, were kneeling before the throne.

chapters.title: Chapter 466 - 466: Clash of the Emperors
chapters.content:
"'What took us so long'?!" Trunks repeated in indignation, while his grandfather, Bardock, and Raditz all narrowed their eyes at Alex's calm attitude.
"We've been getting chased around the entire planet as perverted streakers this whole time! And here you are, lounging on the throne, enjoying yourself!" Raditz snarled angrily, even as Alex snapped his fingers and instantly dressed the group of Saiyan men. However he snorted a minute later while saying,
"I JUST got here myself a few minutes ago." The five of them appeared skeptical of that though, so Alex explained to them,
"Vados and I teleported into the hideout of an increasingly notorious bandit clan, where I defeated the entire clan before turning them into my loyal bitches."
"Oh talk dirty some more!" Caulifla said as she nibbled on Alex's earlobe, which he ignored as he continued,
"Then, once we were done with the orgy, we immediately teleported directly into the castle to meet with King Sadala. The moment he laid eyes on me though he challenged me to a duel, in which I beat his ass. And now I'm emperor of the Saiyans of Universe Six too... Go figure."
When he finished recounting his time on Sadala, Alex had a wry smile on his face due to the fact that hadn't even been trying to take over these Saiyans as well, only establish friendly relations with them. But the moment he showed up, the effect of Alex's 'Saiyan Emperor' title reared its ugly head.
'Oh well.' Alex thought to himself since there was no point crying over it, especially since at that moment another group barged into the throne room as the one at their head cried out,
"We've finally got you cornered you damn perverts! I'm sorry for this heinous disruption your majesty, but we'll be out of you hair.....soon..." The captain of the troops trailed off as he saw the situation in the throne room, namely his King kneeling to an unknown visitor.
"That will be unnecessary captain..." The former king Sadala said in a defeated voice, before continuing, "And I am no longer King. That privilege, now belongs to our new emperor..." As he said that, Sadala gestured to Alex upon their throne, who's smile only grew wryer as he told the Saiyan captain of the guard,
"Well, I'll have to apologize about that misunderstanding. One of my wives is quite the inventor, but her creations often have unfortunate side effects. We used one of her teleporters to arrive here, and were relieved of our clothing against our will in the process." As Alex finished speaking four of the other Saiyans readily voiced their agreement and indignation at their treatment, while Goku still didn't understand what the problem was, and Vados giggled humorously.
As the rest of the Saiyan nobility and guards shuffled awkwardly at that, one spoke up as he asked,
"So what do we do now?" The question brought everyone's attention directly to Alex as they awaited his answer.
To them, there was no more frightening moment than that of suddenly having a new king. Unlike the Saiyans of Universe Seven, these Saiyans were warriors of justice that fought for good in the universe alongside one of their greatest allies, emperor Frost.
None of them truly knew what Alex wanted, but as their new emperor they were honor-bound to follow him until one rose up and challenged him in combat for his position. If he wanted to wage war against the universe, they would have to no choice but follow him into battle.
It was like everyone within the throne room was holding their breath as they awaited Alex's answer, until he finally said,
"Well...truthfully I wasn't planning on becoming king of Sadala to begin with. I simply wanted to make contact with the Saiyans of this Universe since there are so few of us left in Universe Seven. Plus, I have an offer to any interested in fighting opponents the like of which they have never seen, as well as for them visit universes beyond the twelve."
At first no one quite knew how to answer what Alex told them, until the former king Sadala uttered,
"So does that mean that our new emperor has his own world to rule already?" Alex nodded as he readily told them,
"Asora, a world that connects numerous universes through inter dimensional portals. I wasn't planning on creating one that led to Universe Six, but we can install one on planet Sadala to ensure a permanent connection between the two worlds." Unlike the silence from before, what Alex said this time sparked a wave of muttering and discussion from former king Sadala and the rest of the Saiyan nobles.
Though he could listen in through his 'Domain', Alex didn't sense any malicious intent in the discussions, so he waited until the Saiyans reached an agreement before Sadala turned back to him and stated,
"Then we will accompany our liege to this Asora, with your blessing of course your majesty." Alex furrowed his brows at that, sighing in exasperation before saying,
"Nah, there's no need for you to abandon your homeland." His words confused the gathered Saiyans, before Alex clarified,
"Just recall any Saiyans that are out in the universe, and after the announcement I'll bring the entirety of Sadala into Asora. You'll all still have your planet, and still be close enough to serve me. How's that?"
To say that the Saiyans of Sadala were stunned would be an understatement at that moment, as they tried to imagine the power it to take to move an entire planet. Alex meanwhile didn't think anything of it, as he had been collecting barren and empty planets from throughout the universes they been visiting for a while now to give the people in Asora places to train where they wouldn't cause too much collateral damage.
Plus they had been using them as a side project of sorts, regarding terraforming the planets to make them habitable for any other future uses they might have for them.
The first to recover was the former king Sadala, who slowly said,
"Alright..... I'll also notify emperor Frost while we are at it. He's been a long time ally to our people, and deserves to know why we won't be here at all times in the future." Alex frowned when he heard, as the image of said emperor suddenly appeared in his mind.
Frost was this universe's version of Frieza, the cruel and evil tyrant that ruled areas of Universe Seven with an iron fist. Frost on the other hand was known to the masses as a kind and benevolent ruler, who regularly led his forces into battle against space pirates.
However, from what Alex recalled, it was revealed during the tournament between Beerus and his twin, Champa, that Frost's entire positive image was a complete sham. He was, in actuality, exactly like Frieza from Universe Seven.
"Vados." Alex suddenly said in a serious tone, drawing everyone's attention as the Angel stepped forward to hear her lord's command. He then asked her in voice loud enough that it carried over the entire throne room,
"Is Frost as benevolent as they say?" Vados smiled as she realized what Alex was getting at, before conjuring projections of Frost in discussion with numerous figures, figures who made the gathered Saiyans bristle in anger.
"I know them..." Sadala growled in anger at seeing the figures that were happily chatting with Frost, while the rest of the nearby Saiyans emitted thick rolling waves of killing intent.
"They are the captains of the space pirates, the most notorious band of criminals in Universe Six. Many of our warriors have met their end at their hands...in battles we followed Frost into..."
The killing intent being emitted by the Saiyans multiplied when their former king said that, as they glared hatefully at the image Vados had conjured. Their rage increased when she added sound to the picture, and they heard Frost discussing his plans with them regarding attacking a planet that wasn't under his control, which would allow him to swoop in and 'save' them, before adding it to his growing empire.
Deciding that what they found was more than damning enough, Alex then said to the beautiful Angel,
"Vados, bring him here."
"Of course my liege." Vados answered before tapping her scepter on the stone floor, creating a sphere of energy as she used Spatial magic to transfer Frost from the other side of the universe to the middle of the throne room in an instant.
"And once the Saiyans-" Frost said once he appeared before them, only to cut himself off when he saw he was surrounded by dozens of very angry looking Saiyans.
"Why king Sadala! To what do I owe this.....unexpected trip?" Despite his rapid shift from space pirate to kindly emperor, there was a noticeable tension under his facade, even more so as a wave of killing intent assaulted him.
"Frost..." The former Saiyan King spat out as his aura surged in strength, while the five that arrived with Alex surrounded the emperor threateningly.
Frost was the spitting image of the same tyrant that wiped out their entire race, killed Krillen when he fought Goku on the original Planet Namek, and tried to destroy Earth before Goku could return, only to be killed by Trunks. The only difference between the two was that, while Frieze's body was grey and pink, Frost's was grey and blue.
Alex could tell that all five of the Saiyans, along with the rest of their counterpart kin, were itching to get a piece of Frost at that moment, though Goku just wanted to see how he'd compare to Frieza. Frost on the other hand had no idea what was going on, and while even Caulifla was practically bouncing in anticipation of fighting Frost as well, Alex decided to end things there as he stood, and said,
"They know Frost." The demon-like figure turned and saw Alex sitting upon the Saiyan throne for the first time, as he slapped Caulifla's butt to get her to move so he could stand up.
Though she was tempted to make a remark about his action, Caulifla decided not as she instead focused upon the show that was about to start.
"And who are you?" Frost asked Alex curiously, while also appearing not at all concerned with the strangely hostile environment he suddenly found himself in.
"I am Alexander Morningstar, the Dragon Emperor!" As he said that, Alex's own aura suddenly surged forwards, smothering all the rest as even Frost was forced to take a step backwards in surprise from it.
"I-I see..." He uttered in the face of Alex's power, before asking, "And what do they 'know'?"
Alex smirked as Frost continued trying to play dumb, stepping down from the throne as he told him,
"They know that you're actually the leader of the same space pirates that they've gone into battle with numerous times, battles that have claimed the lives of many of their kin and comrades." Frost's eyes widened briefly, before he uttered,
"Oh....they know THAT."
Instead of appearing concerned though, Frost suddenly smirked as he adopted an expression as if he were pondering something, before saying,
"How about this then! The brave Saiyan people were beset by a new threat calling himself the 'Dragon Emperor', who destroyed the planet Sadala and wiped all but the few Saiyans who were scattered throughout the universe at the time! But immediately afterwards, the great emperor Frost happened upon him and avenged the poor fallen Saiyans! How's that?"
If the Saiyan people were angry before, then they downright livid now when they heard Frost's plans for them. Meanwhile, as if to say they weren't going to let that happene, Goku, Bardock, Vegeta Sr, Trunks, and Raditz all went super Saiyan at that moment, much to the surprise of Frost and the Saiyans around them when they felt the power being emitted by the group.
"That doesn't sound like a half bad plan, except for one small problem." Alex however said in a calm voice, gesturing to the five to back off, which they did reluctantly.
"Oh? And what is that?" Frost asked with humor in his voice, until Alex said,
"There are currently seven of us here that can kick your ass six ways to Sunday, but I'm the only one needed. So, I say you can either change into your final form so I can hurry up and kick your sorry ass, or we can just skip right to the execution."
As Alex said that the five Super Saiyans(reluctantly) stepped back further, showing they wouldn't interfere in the fight as they gave Alex and Frost room. Seeing this, Frost snorted as his own aura skyrocketed, and his figure changed from his more reptilian base form with large pointed horns on the side of his head, to a slightly larger more smooth form, with a bulbous round head, and splotches of blue.
"Is this what you wanted?" Frost asked in a mocking tone, before he vanished suddenly and planted his foot in the side of Alex's face with all of his strength, causing a series of cracks to spiderweb out across the walls, floor, and ceiling.
His smirk quickly vanished though when Alex's expression hadn't changed in the slightest, as he instead uttered, "Ow?" as if unsure if he should've felt pain from the attack or not.
"H-how...?" Frost uttered in dumbfoundment, while the surrounding Saiyans also stared in awe as they behold their new emperor's true strength for the first time.
"You're too weak, that's how." Alex said as he broke the silence, stunning everyone present as Frost's expression contorted into anger for the first time.
"Oh really?" He growled menacingly, before drawing his foot back and taking a stance directly in front of Alex. "Then try this on for size! HA!"
Frost them delivered a single high speed punch directly into Alex's abdomen, which proceeded a series of high speed attacks moving so fast, that not even Goku was able to keep up with his movements.
"HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA! HA!-"
*BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!-*
Within seconds hundreds, if not thousands, of punches pummeled Alex's abdomen over and over again, the force of which even began reducing the floor below them to dust in an increasingly wider area the longer the attack went on. It was a ruthless attack that would break even the most sturdy of opponents if given enough time.
And yet...
"Haaaaaaa-! Are you done yet? I kinda have other things I need to do..." Alex said with a tone as if he were bored, while also stifling a yawn.
Frost leapt back when he spoke, allowing him to take a look at his handiwork for the first time, and see that he had done nothing to Alex's body.
"W-what! How!?!" Alex just shrugged though, as he said,
"My physical defense is stupidly high, when I'm not suppressing it, and my body is actually made of rubber, so even if I couldn't defend against them your attacks wouldn't do anything to me. It didn't feel too bad though...here, can you massage my back next?"
Ignoring the stunned look on Frost's face, Alex turned around and directed his back towards his opponent, increasing the incredulity of the situation.
'How can this be?!' Frost demanded within his mind as he began to feel truly angry for the first time in his life.
Other than Lord Champa, he had never encountered someone truly stronger than him in his life, though the assassin Hit could probably give him a run for his money. Even his current and strongest form had to be sealed away after he accidentally killed someone with it recently due to how powerful it was, lest the public opinion begin to turn against him. But now here he was against someone who considered him nothing more than a small fry, all while he was using his strongest and most powerful form.
Frost clenched his fists in anger so hard, that his blue blood began dripping onto the floor as he growled,
"Very well... If physical attacks won't work, THEN TRY THESE!" As he shouted at Alex, both of Frost's hands began to glow from his use of energy.
*KABOOM!*
*CRASH!*
*WHIRRRRR!*
Energy attacks of every variety assaulted Alex's back, from destructive spheres, razor sharp disks, and piercing rays, kicking up a cloud of dust and debris as they impacted their target.
Seeing that, Sadala tried to rush forward but was stopped by an outstretched hand, as Vegeta Sr said without looking back at him,
"From one former king to another, trust in our emperor." Sadala looked at Vegeta incredulously at that, before realization dawned on him that he was looking at his counterpart from Universe Seven.
Before he could truly absorb that though, the barrage of explosions began to slow slightly, before stopping entirely as Frost glared at the place Alex had been standing at, which was enshrouded in a cloud of thick dust.
"Haa haa haa..."
For a couple tense moments all that could be heard was Frost panting as they all waited for the dust to clear, before the figure of Alexander Morningstar once again came into view, looking no worse for the wear. As he turned back towards them though, Alex was rolling his arm before he said to Frost,
"I think you popped my shoulder, thanks for that!"
"..."
No one knew how to respond to that as Alex thanked Frost for attacking him with all he had, least of all the tyrannical emperor. But as Alex's words reverberated within his skull, he uttered with a voice dripping with venom,
"'Thanks'...?"
Alex and the rest of the gathered Saiyans looked at him curiously even as Frost repeated,
"'Thanks'?! How about you say thanks to this!"
The mad emperor then raised his hand as he began summoning the most massive amount of energy he ever had in his entire life to destroy this worthless rock and everyone on it. But, before he could so much as move a single muscle,
"Ah...."
Frost let out a single shuddering gasp as the energy he gathered dissipated, and he looked up to see that Alex was no longer standing in front of him. Instead, the Saiyans saw their new emperor standing behind with his back to him, a brilliant long golden sword in his hand and a deathly serious look in his eyes.
"Goodbye Frost." Alex said simply without any emotion, before numerous lines began to appear throughout Frost's body, when suddenly his entire figure was enveloped in brilliant golden flames.
As a species, both Frost and Frieza were incredibly resilient to the point that they could both survive in the vacuum of space without any assistance, and they could survive for at least several minutes after being cut up into numerous bite-sized pieces. As Frost's body began to fall apart though, the brilliant golden flames made the evil emperor scream as he had never before screamed in his life from the pain he was feeling.
He felt every single atom of his body being turned to ash as the divine golden flames consumed him, until there was nothing left as even his soul burned with Alex imbuing the flames with his 'Soul Break' skill to ensure that Frost never returned.
As Frost's screams died down, not a single person said anything. Instead, they were staring at the scorched spot that Frost had been standing in just seconds prior, until Alex suddenly snapped his fingers.
Not only had the sword he'd been wielding disappeared, but then the damage done to the throne room began to repair itself as if time was rewinding until everything was restored. Once that was done, Alex turned to Vados and stated,
"Vados, I want a recording of what Frost had said, as well as his death, played throughout every planet he had influence in. We will need to know just where they'll stand regarding what happen here, as well as prepare for the backlash of the space pirates losing their leader. If nothing else, now they'll probably be more daring and dangerous without him holding them in check." Inclining her head in affirmation, Vados told him,
"I figured that you would ask me to do that, so I already live streamed Frost's plans to destroy planet Sadala and frame your majesty for it, as well as his execution, across the universe." Alex nodded at her before turning his attention to Sadala and the rest of the Saiyans, and saying,
"New plans Sadala. When the rest of the Saiyans arrive here we'll announce my Ascension as planned, but before bringing you all into Asora with the planet I want you to destroy the remnants of the space pirates. Do you think your warriors can do that?" There was no hesitation in Sadala's eyes as he readily kneeled to Alex and said
"Of course my liege! Truly you have opened our eyes to how blind we were in trusting one such as Frost, and we will gladly rally to destroy the remnants of the evil he has spread throughout our universe!" When he said that the rest of the gathered Saiyan nobles similarly kneeled before Alex and parroted Sadala's words, earning them a brief nod from Alex as he glanced at Vegeta Sr for a beat.
Though no words were passed between the two, Vegeta Sr understood that Alex wanted him to remain behind to teach the Saiyans of Universe Six about the Super Saiyan transformation. This would bolster their forces significantly, while simultaneously limiting the casualties that the warrior people would suffer at the hands of the space pirates, but it would also serve as a test of sorts for Alex to determine just how strong they were as a whole.
Alex then turned towards Goku, Bardock, Raditz, and Trunks, before saying,
"As for you guys, stay and help the Saiyans of Universe Six, or return to Pangea to prepare for the tournament. I'll leave the decision up to you." The group nodded as they all began forming their own plans for the near future.
Goku and Bardock both planned to return to prepare for the tournament, deciding to leave the current situation to the Saiyans here, and because Goku was looking forward more to fighting the people of Asora in the tournament itself. Meanwhile both Trunks and Raditz elected to stay behind, the former so he could gain more experience in real battle, which he learned through Cell he was lacking in, while the latter wanted to temper his transformations in actual combat rather than simply training back on Pangea.
"What do you want me to do?" Caulifla asked from the throne, where she was still sitting on its arm while the five members of her bandit clan gathered around her.
"Go and gather your things from your hideout, and when I return to Asora you'll be accompanying me in order to undergo some 'special' training. Once that's done I'll send you back here to assist in dealing with space pirates." Though she pouted when Alex said he wanted her to help with the battle against the space pirates, Caulifla looked excited when he mentioned the special training.
It was obvious to anyone with eyes that Alex himself didn't look like a normal Saiyan, while the five that had come with him were all also interesting due to their golden haired transformations that none of them had ever heard of. So Caulifla was looking forward to learning all she could about acquiring that power for herself.
With everyone else's plans made though, Sadala looked up at Alex from his kneeling position, and asked,
"My liege, what are your plans until the rest of our kin return? If you wish then we can quickly prepare accommodations for you to relax, eat, or otherwise 'enjoy' yourself until then." As he said that Sadala glanced back at Caulifla and the rest of her clan, already having an idea of how his new emperor 'enjoyed' himself in his free time, and preparing a roster of girls to send to keep him occupied until they were ready.
Surprisingly though, after pondering the offer for a moment, Alex shook his head and replied,
"I'll decline since I have something else to do while we wait, something I can't quite put off." Curious as to what could be so urgent that it couldn't wait, Sadala couldn't help but to ask,
"What is it you wish to do my liege? And how shall we be of assistance?" This time Alex smiled wryly as he told him,
"No need to trouble yourself, I'll be more than enough. And I intend to locate a certain legend, or demon, depending on who you talk to."

chapters.title: Chapter 467 - 467: Demon? Or...?
chapters.content:
With their plans made everyone separated as Vados returned to Pangea with Goku and Bardock to deliver a status report to Alex's wives, since they now suddenly had an entire planet of people to add to their population. Meanwhile Vegeta Sr accompanied the former king Sadala with Trunks and Raditz to see the state of the Saiyan army, and begin their introductory into the Super Saiyan transformation.
That just left Alex as he went by himself to locate his quarry, using the magic compass to zero in on their location as night began to settle in on that part of the planet. Now atop a building, Alex scanned the sea of Saiyans moving too and fro as the nightlife began, but his gaze quickly settled on a single individual with a small frame that was huddled in a tattered cloak as they weaved through the crowds.
The moment he did though,
<Partner...> Ddraig suddenly spoke up with tension in his voice.
<That person, I can feel a sense of danger from them the likes of which I've only felt from beings like Ophis, or Samael before.>
That was rare, as Ddraig rarely ever displayed nervousness when Alex was around someone powerful, which only went to show just how dangerous the being he was stalking was.
...
I hurried through the crowded streets as quickly as I could, working as I did to avoid bumping into others or similarly drawing attention to myself in any way. The chilly evening wind bit into me through the tattered holes in my cloak, prompting me to try and draw it tighter around myself despite how pointless the gesture was.
Along with the wind, I was assaulted by a near endless barrage of sensations from the increasingly lively night life, from fights taking place in taverns and bars, to women trying to seduce men and find suitable partners for the night. Most torturously though, were the numerous scents wafting to me from the taverns and restaurants of food cooking.
*grrrrrrrrrr!*
My stomach loudly protested as my mouth simultaneously watered, reminding me painfully of how I hadn't had anything to eat in over three days.
While vainly trying to push my hunger down, I searched for any kind of food I'd be able to eat without needing to pay, since I was broke. The trash by the taverns and restaurants were tempting, but the owners were known for reacting viciously to beggars and dumpster divers.
"HURRY IT UP!"
I was trying to think of way to get SOMETHING to eat when a shout caught my attention, leading me to a series of spacecrafts where numerous people were unloading crates of goods that were otherwise unavailable on Sadala. Among them I noticed several crates that were filled with bulbous purple things that had half inch long spikes on them, which made me salivate at the mere sight of them.
"Daga fruits..." I uttered longingly, already recalling the sweet taste of the fruit as I bit into them, the juice running down my chin as my mouth erupted in flavor.
Despite the fact that the hundreds of crates being unloaded were heavily guarded, with dozens of guards present, my hunger overruled my caution as I reasoned that it wasn't unusual for one or two....dozen, fruits to 'fall' while they were transported.
Getting past the guards was easy, none of them noticed as I sped past them. No one ever did. The tricky part was trying to get close enough to the crates to swipe the fruits without getting caught, which I was trying to figure out from my hiding spot when the same voice from earlier cried out,
"Stay alert!" My attention turned to a Saiyan man with mid-length hair and a thick body, who appeared to be in charge as he told the guards,
"That bitch bandit and her tribe of bitches have been getting too adventurous lately! So keep your eyes peeled if anyone suspicious shows up to steal our cargo!" My heart nearly stopped right there and then when I heard that, as I looked at the fruits longingly while also contemplating running away then and there.
Of course, my hunger won out as I decided to chance it, figuring I could just run away if they caught me.
I crept up close to the crates containing the fruits, a line of drool already running down my chin as I imagined the taste of them, distracting me from the rapidly approaching shadow.
"SEE! WHAT DID I TELL YOU ALL!?!" The same man from before cried out as he seized my arm, dragging me into the light as all the guards turned to see me.
"Hmph! What are you slackers even getting paid for if you can't stop petty little thieves like this!" He sneered while thrusting me out before them all, my heart hammering in my chest as he did so.
I was about to break his arm and run away, when a new voice cried out,
"Excuse me!" We all turned to see a large framed man approaching us with long dark black hair, and red fur covering most of his upper body. The similarly red tail identified him as a Saiyan, but he was a Saiyan unlike any other I, or apparently these guys for that matter, had ever seen.
"Who are you and what do you want?!" The man who's arm I was about to break demanded angrily, to which the newcomer said politely,
"My name is Alex, and I apologize on that girl's behalf. If you'll just turn her over to me, we'll be out of your hair and on our way." Not just the guy that was holding onto me, but all of the other guards were looking at this Alex guy like he was an idiot at that, while my mind was racing on how to get out of this.
"Pft! Yeah right! This little rat is a thief, and I'm more than inclined to lock you up with her as an accomplice! You know what, do it! Take them both in!" With that the guards surrounded the man as they all prepared to fight, however the man himself appeared to be completely calm.
My eyes widened slightly as I saw him smirk at the men surrounding him, before they all suddenly collapsed while foaming at the mouth.
"W-wha- what do you do!?!" The man in charge sputtered angrily, while a shudder suddenly went through my body as the man directed his gaze at me.
I had never in my life felt more intimidated than I had in that moment. Seeing Alex look up at the man holding onto me, my instincts all screamed at me that this man was dangerous as he slowly began to approach us.
"I'm warning you!"
"Back off!"
"I mean it!"
"I'm very well connected at the palace! You'll be wanted throughout the entire universe if you do anything to me!" Even in the face of all his threats though, Alex didn't stop approaching them until he and the man were face-to-face.
"Try it." Alex said calmly, never breaking eye contact with the man the entire time. However he did something that I think surprised us both, and spat into Alex's face.
"T-try it you filthy vagrant! I-I'll have you and your little whore here both thrown into jail for the rest of your life!" Seemingly regain his earlier pomp and bravado, the man tried to threaten us both as Alex wiped the spit off his face.
"I see..." Was all he said as he looked back at the man, before I suddenly didn't feel his hand on my arm anymore.
Looking down at it, I was greeted by the sight of the man's arm, mangled and twisted beyond comprehension.
"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH-"
The echoes of the man's cry rang out and alerted everyone nearby to what was happening. But as they watched him stumble and try to crawl away from the scene with a mangled arm, the front of his clothes damp with piss, they smartly decided to mind their own business.
Did I do that?
I thought to myself, my breathing becoming ragged as i tried to recall when I did that to the man, but was unable to figure out when I did it.
"H-hey, are you ok?" The other man, Alex asked worriedly as I began to hyperventilate.
"I-I was only going to break his arm...!" I stuttered, saying much than I normally would in my hysteria. Just as I was about to run off though, Alex suddenly took my hand in his before pulling me towards him as he wrapped his arms around me.
"It's ok Kale..." He whispered into my ears, his voice strangely calming as my breathing began to slow.
"You didn't hurt him. I did."
What was that? I didn't hurt him?
As this fact slowly filled my mind I began to calm down even more, my breathing becoming more steady with each passing second.
***
'What did the word 'safe' mean?'
If someone asked Kale that a few hours ago, then she might've asked if it was something she could eat. That was how foreign the concept of being 'safe' was to her.
Now however? She would probably give a notably different answer.
After Alex got her to calm down, he used something he called Instant Transmission to bring them both to Capitol city of Sadala, allowing Kale to see the palace for the first time. He then led her up and down the streets of the Capitol, after promising that he'd take her somewhere to get something to eat.
Normally Kale wouldn't go along with someone she literally just met, as her instincts would try to warn her away from them. But now that the guards and man who trying to arrest her were no longer present, she felt no threat from Alex anymore. Instead, she felt safe.
That was such a foreign feeling for Kale, as she had never in her life felt 'safe' due to living on the streets for as long as she could remember. She didn't even know what her parents looked like, their names, or where they were.
Kale didn't consider that any great loss, she never had time to think about them as she struggled to survive after all. And now that she met Alex, something about him drew her to him like a magnet.
Even as they walked through the streets, Kale didn't leave his side while even one of her hands was holding onto the fur at his side, as if she were worried he would disappear if she let go of him. Of course, she was also trying her hardest not to rip said fur out, but also didn't seem to notice it stretching slightly if she did pull it.
Alex of course pretended not to notice her grip on his side as he led Kale through the streets, greeting people they passed and talking to them as if they were his long time friends. Saiyan women called out and flirted with him, which made Kale feel uncomfortable for some reason, while men tried to challenge him as they instinctively sensed his strength.
When he knocked them back on their ass though, they got right back up and clapped him on the back while laughing loudly with those around them, and Alex joined them as everyone enjoyed themselves. Even Kale managed the slightest of smiles as she watched Alex interact with the people(not the women of course), her eyes barely leaving his figure as he led her to who knows where.
She soon found out though, when Alex led Kale into a relatively well kept tavern as a beautiful Saiyan woman greeted them. The duo were then led to a table that had already been prepared after Alex called ahead earlier, which was already piled high with dozens of plates and dishes that made Kale's stomach release a mighty roar when she saw it.
As they were seated though, and Kale had to reluctantly release her hold on Alex's fur, the Saiyan woman looked over her tattered appearance before saying to Alex with a flawless smile,
"Make sure you pay properly for you food sir, or I'll have to break your kneecaps and smash your balls!" Kale's body shivered from the threat, which she could tell under the Saiyaness's professional exterior she was completely serious.
