Alex however didn't skip a beat as he produced a sizable bag, and said while flashing his own flawless smile at her,
"I believe this is more than enough to cover the cost of our meal, and any more we might order." While the woman was skeptical at first, as Alex had ordered two of everything on their menu, when she saw what was in the bag she quickly closed it before looking shadily at her surroundings, and saying,
"We thank you for your patronage! If you require 'anything' else, then please let me know~!" Kale didn't know why, but for some reason she didn't like the way the woman said that as she fluttered her eyes at Alex, and she liked it even less when he winked back at her while saying,
"I'll be sure to keep that in mind miss." Giggling at his remark, the woman finally left them to eat, though Kale noticed her butt and tail swaying in a way that drew the eyes of every other guy in the tavern.
"Well, dig in!" Alex said suddenly, drawing Kale's attention back to the veritable mountain of food before her.
"C-can I?" She barely whispered anxiously, as she had never been able to eat food like this in her life. Alex however nodded at her and said,
"Of course! That's why I ordered two of everything!" As he said this Alex grabbed some food from one of the dishes, a sizable chunk of meat with a bone sticking straight through it, and eagerly tore into it with his teeth as he ripped a piece off.
Following his lead, Kale hesitantly pulled the second of the same dish towards herself, wary of Alex watching her every move. She then slowly picked up the chunk of meat by the bone and, after one more glance at Alex, bit into it.
"!!!"
Immediately a burst of flavor like she never experienced before flooded her mouth with the meat and gristle, shocking her so much that her entire body froze.
when was the last time she ate something this good?
When was the last time she ate anything WARM?
Kale didn't know the answer to either of those questions, but what she did know was that this was best thing she had ever tasted in her life.
"What's wrong Kale?" Alex asked her suddenly, bringing her out of her trance-like state as Kale noticed two streaks of moisture running down her face.
"I-it's nothing..." Kale whispered as she quickly tried to wipe away the tears, before taking another bite of the delicious meat.
What followed was like a blur as Kale ate more food than she ever had in her entire life, while Alex ate across from her.
She didn't know what she would or wouldn't like, so she tried a bit of everything and decided she liked it all as she tried to eat as much as possible. And the entire time Alex would tell her she should try this or that, and each dish he recommended her tasted better than the last.
Even when the Saiyan woman returned to refill their cups and openly flirted with Alex, Kale barely noticed as she prioritized stuffing as much food into her face as possible.
And finally, the dreaded moment came when she could eat no more.
When that happened Kale was at a loss for words, as for all she knew this was the last time she would ever be able to eat good food like this again, so she wanted to eat as much as possible. Unfortunately though, she couldn't eat another bite.
It was at this time that Alex cleared his throat, drawing her attention back up to him as he said,
"Ehem, I think it's time we discussed why I found you Kale." That confused her, as Kale hesitantly asked in her almost inaudible voice,
"Y-you were looking for me...?" Alex nodded slowly as he asked her,
"Do you know what you are Kale?" The young Saiyaness cocked her head to the side confusedly as she quietly uttered,
"A-a Saiyan...?" Alex however shook his head as he told her,
"No. Well, at least not an ordinary one." Kale's heart nearly stopped as she realized where this was going, and Alex paused as he took a deep drink from the cup of alcohol in front of him, before continuing,
"Tell me Kale, have you ever heard of the Legendary Super Saiyan?" Kale quickly shook her head to show she hadn't ever heard of it, which Alex nodded in affirmation as he went on,
"It's not surprising. The LSS is almost a myth to most people, except it is in fact true. The way it goes is that every thousand years or so a warrior is born with the power of the LSS, making them stronger and more powerful than their normal Saiyan counterparts."
As Alex paused Kale felt her breath hitch as she realized where he was going with this. Nodding in encouragement, Alex asked her,
"Tell me Kale, have you ever shown strength or abilities that outclassed those around you?" Though she wanted to deny it, Kale couldn't.
For years she'd known she was faster and stronger than the other Saiyans around her, using her speed to steal when she needed, and her strength to escape if she were ever caught, like she had been planning earlier that night.
Seeing her think on his words, Alex nodded slowly again, and continued,
"This is just the tip of the iceberg though, as when the power of the LSS is truly activated, they become powerful enough to rival even the strongest beings in the universe with minimal to no training. However this power comes at a great price, as if it is untrained it turns the user into a mindless berserker who would kill all of those around them, as their power continuously grew until it eventually killed them as well."
With each word Alex spoke Kale's dread grew, as she imagined such a power sleeping within her. But then he said something that drew her out of her dread, as he told her,
"Of course this doesn't have to happen. Like I've been learning to control my own LSS strength, you can as well to avoid going berserk and losing control of you power." When Alex said that Kale looked with more alertness than he'd seen in her all night, as she asked, him,
"Y-your own strength?!" The edges of Alex's mouth curled upwards in a grin as he nodded, and said,
"Yes Kale. Like you, I'm also a Legendary Super Saiyan." Alex then pointed to his upper chest, at the area below his neck that didn't have fur, and said as his finger traced the swirling lines of his tattoos,
"I created these to help me control my strength while my body adjusts to it, preventing me from accidentally breaking things or hurting people around me. If you want, I can also teach you how to control your strength, and we can help you learn techniques to control yourself when you transform."
Though he didn't mean to, a wave of pain surged through Kale's heart when Alex mentioned hurting people around him, as she recalled the one friend she did have when she was younger, until she accidentally hurt him and he called her a monster. That had been why she freaked out earlier when she met Alex, as Kale believed she had let her strength hurt someone yet again, though she did plan to break one of the bones in the man's arm to begin with.
With him promising to help her control her strength though, Kale couldn't help the giddy feeling filling her chest as he replayed his earlier words within her mind, 'like you'.
'He's like me...!' She thought to herself happily, as a feeling she never felt before filled her heart, and her cheeks began to feel warm.
Especially after hurting her friend, Kale had always thought of herself akin to a monster or a freak, and she never once thought she would find someone 'like her'. Now that she had though, Kale felt a fluttery feeling in her stomach, and her cheeks burned even more as she glanced up at Alex, who was still waiting for her answer regarding him teaching her.
Of course, there was only one thing she would say to such an offer.
"P-please teach me!"
Seeing how earnest the usually timid and meek girl was, Alex smile warmly at her as he nodded once and said,
"Of course I will."

chapters.title: Chapter 468 - 468: The Emperor of Saiyans
chapters.content:
Over the next hour after Kale agreed to learn from him, Alex and young Saiyaness continued their discussion as he tried to learn more about her. Well...Alex talked, Kale's usual timid and meek personality, coupled with the bashfulness from her newfound crush made it nearly impossible for her to get more than one or two words at a time.
With what he COULD get though, Alex learned quite a bit about Kale's life up until this point. And it was truly sad.
He learned that the young Saiyaness was only in her early teens, if that, and had been alone for pretty much her entire life. She had no idea where her parents were, or if they were even alive, and had no intention of finding out, even when Alex offered to find them.
Her entire life she had pretty much been living on the streets alone, which Alex could tell due to her tattered and dirty clothing, the splotches of dirt on her face and arms, as well as how unruly and dirty her hair was, even for a Saiyan. On top of that she was scared and hesitant to use her strength unless it was to escape a bad situation, like the situation before, due to a trauma she suffered when she was younger, in which she had accidentally hurt the only friend she had, who then called her a monster.
In short, Alex concluded that if he hadn't found her, or Caulifla in the original timeline, then chances were that the Saiyans of Universe Six would have quickly followed their cousins in Universe Seven into extinction.
Unlike the rest of the Saiyans around her, who would have to undergo strict training to be able to transform, Legendary Super Saiyans like Kale were able to achieve the Super Saiyan transformation once their body naturally became strong enough, they would only need the proper trigger. And with even the meekest and most timid people having a breaking point, it was only a matter of time until Kale found hers and transformed before going berserk, and destroying planet Sadala itself along with its inhabitants.
That would have to be one of the things Alex brought up with the former king when they met back up, along with some other things he had noticed while out of the palace.
With that thought, Alex glanced at the time before standing suddenly, and saying to his surprised guest,
"There's something I need to go and get ready for. Are you coming?" Kale paused for a moment as she looked at Alex's outstretched hand, before taking it with reddened cheeks as she too stood, and followed him out of the tavern.
"Come again!" The Saiyan woman who served them called out as they left, to which Alex waved his hand in recognition and thanks.
Once they were outside Alex looked to his new protege, and said,
"I'll be using Instant Transmission again to take us to our destination. If you study and train hard, then you'll also be able to use this technique in the future." Kale's down turned eyes lit up when she heard that, before their surroundings suddenly shifted, and she found herself in a location that was completely alien to her, the royal palace.
Looking around in surprise at the brightly lit and highly decorated hall, Kale's attention went back to Alex as he called out, "Vados."
Instantly a tall blue-skinned woman appeared before them, shocking Kale as she tried to hide behind Alex, though the woman smiled warmly at her before turning to him and saying, "Yes my liege?"
If she were shocked by the woman's appearance, then Kale was downright flabbergasted when she heard that, and even more so when Alex replied while gesturing to her,
"This is Kale, my new student. I have some matters to attend to regarding the impending announcement, so can you look after her and take her to get cleaned up while I'm doing that?" The woman, Vados, nodded as she replied,
"Of course my liege." Nodding himself in affirmation, Alex then looked back to Kale and said,
"Kale, this is Vados. She's one of my attendants, as well as one of my teachers. She'll also help teach you how to control your powers, along with other techniques she may think you should learn." As he said that, Vados bowed to her and said,
"It is a pleasure to meet you miss Kale. If you'll please follow me, we'll see about getting you cleaned up and dressed in some proper clothing." Though she was tempted to make a comment about Alex essentially making her a babysitter, Vados held her tongue due to her sensing the amount of power within Kale's body.
Kale herself however seemed the most reluctant with the current plan though, as she clung to Alex tighter instead of going with Vados. Thankfully, after having to deal with Champa for who knew how long, Vados was quite patient with the young Saiyaness and her stubbornness.
Though it took a bit of convincing, Kale eventually, and reluctantly, went with Vados to the royal baths so the servants could clean her, leaving Alex alone once again. To reassure Kale however, Alex stood there watching the duo make their way down the hall, his expression one of encouragement to the scared Kale.
Once they turned the corner though, Alex's expression changed into one of seriousness as he located the former king Sadala, who was with Vegeta Sr, Raditz, Trunks, and several of his higher ups.
With a thought, Alex used Instant Transmission to instantly arrive in the room they were gathered in, which was a study of sorts, where the group was discussing thr specifics of the Saiyan Warriors future training and the battles to come.
"Your majesty!" Sadala exclaimed when Alex appeared, bowing as he did so with the others following his lead. Alex however ignored the niceties, as he said to the former king,
"Sadala, we need to talk." Immediately the former king straightened his back, as he hesitantly asked,
"Your majesty...?" Alex approached the table they were gathered around without saying anything, taking in the maps and diagrams they had drawn up, before he then stated,
"Did you know that if not for my intervention, the Saiyans of this universe would probably have been wiped out in a few years time?" THAT got their attention, as Sadala and his advisors looked at Alex incredulously, while Vegeta Sr and the other two looked serious.
"W-what do you mean your majesty?" Sadala eventually asked, to which Alex asked in return,
"Tell me, have any of you ever heard of the Legendary Super Saiyan?" For a moment no one said anything as the group absorbed Alex's question, and he watched their expressions, the most notable of which was Vegets Sr's as he paled at the mention of the LSS.
"Pft! Isn't that just that old myth?" One of the advisors asked with a smirk, before said smirk vanished as Alex told them,
"Nope. I just found said LSS wandering the streets, starving and homeless. And before you say anything, I personally witnessed her use physical abilities greater than those of your formally trained guards, so I know she's the real deal." Silence greeted Alex's words as everyone took in what he said, before Trunks asked,
"What's a Legendary Super Saiyan?" Before Alex could speak up though, it was Raditz who answered,
"It's the legendary warrior who appears only once in a thousand years. It was also the reason Frieza wiped us out, as he was scared of the legend being real and an opponent stronger than him appearing. Then years later Kakarot showed up and became that very warrior he was scared of." Though he couldn't stand his little brother and his 'soft' ways, Raditz still reluctantly told Trunks about how he had fulfilled the legend while opening the gates for the rest of them.
However not even then was Alex allowed to speak up to correct him, as the former king Vegeta said in a solem voice,
"That's not entirely true..." This time everyone turned to the former king, as even Alex's look demanded answers, to which Vegeta Sr sighed before saying,
"Years ago, around the same time Kakarot was born, another Saiyan child was born who possessed a power level higher than any other we'd seen as an infant, a staggering 10,000."
As the former king told his story, only a single thought was going through Alex's mind with the revelation, 'FUCK!'
This meant that Legendary Super Saiyan Broly existed, which confused Alex since Broly was never canon due to being exclusive to the movies, like Frieza's brother Cooler, or Lord Slug.
From what Alex recalled, king Vegeta was fearful and jealous of Broly's potential as the LSS, and gave the order for both him and his father to be executed. Broly's strength however allowed him to survive as an infant, as both he and his father escaped planet Vegeta, and ironically the destruction of the rest of their race.
Normally Alex would be more than eager to fight a strong opponent, however Broly wasn't an 'opponent', Broly was a psychotic slaughter machine that radiated pure 'fuck you and everyone in the same galaxy as you' energy.
As far as Alex was concerned, Broly could fuck off on whatever planet he was on, and stay there.
Kale on the other hand was still young, and had the time to train and learn how to control herself before her powers awoke. If she hadn't been willing to train though, then Alex would've had no choice but to try and seal her powers before they could awake, as regrettable as it would've been.
Alex's thoughts were so chaotic at learning Broly existed, that he nearly missed when Vegeta Sr continued,
"Because of his high power level though, I worried for the future of our race and sent the young boy to a deserted and vicious planet. His father fought me on this of course, insisting that he would become a great asset to our people that could even help us throw off the chains of servitude that Frieza placed on us.
"But I still had to, especially then since Frieza definitely would've punished us if he learned of Broly's existence. Now that I think about it, I wonder if that was the reason he did wipe us out, if someone got word to him that the Legendary Super Saiyan was born..."
When Vegeta Sr finished speaking everyone was silent as they thought upon what he told them, before Trunks hesitantly asked,
"Is it possible that Broly is still alive since he wasn't with the rest of the Saiyans when they were destroyed? If he is, then shouldn't we invite him to join us?" Though Vegeta Sr was about to answer that it was unlikely, since he had Broly sent to a hostile and uninhabited planet as an infant, Alex firmly stated instead,
"There will be no attempts to contact Broly of any kind!" That drew everyone's attention back to him, prompting Alex to clarify,
"I know what Broly is like, and I have absolutely no intention of initiating contact with him of any kind. After his father followed him to that planet, I'm sure he spent his entire life listening to him rant and slander the king that exiled him, and if they got the chance then Broly's father would immediately try to get revenge.
"Broly himself is fairly calm and docile for a Saiyan, but if he awakens his power he will turn into a being of pure destruction and slaughter that will go berserk as he tries to destroy everything around him. If he were as young as Kale then I could try and teach him to control his transformations, but with his current age and the life he's lived, that would probably be impossible."
The rest of the gathered Saiyans were silent as they digested Alex's warning, before Sadala asked,
"Is Kale the name of the LSS you found, your majesty?" Alex nodded as he then told them,
"She's currently here in the palace, being cleaned up after spending her entire life on the streets. When I return home I'll be taking her with me, and there she'll learn how to properly control her powers. I don't know if she'll ever join the front lines on any battles with her meek personality, but at least we won't have to worry about her going berserk when her powers eventually awaken."
That made the Sadalan Saiyans breath a sigh of relief, as, with everything they'd heard about the LSS in the last several minutes, they didn't want any on their planet to cause problems. Of course, if any of them had voiced this then Alex would've had no choice but to laugh since he himself was a LSS.
Instead though, a new voice that Alex hadn't heard before called out from outside the study, making the former king of Sadala pale when he heard it.
"FATHER!"
"Oh no..." Sadala uttered, right before the door to the study was thrown open suddenly, and a woman stormed in with her aura raging around her chaotically.
She appeared to be in her late teens, like the current Caulifla was, and was built similarly as well with a petite frame and slim figure. Unlike Caulifla, or any other Saiyaness Alex had met so far though, she appeared to have her black hair tied into a thick braid that came forward over her should, a braid that was held in place with several metal bands.
With narrowed eyes the woman scanned the room, her gaze lingering on Alex for the barest of seconds, before she finally zeroed in on the former king Sadala. She then demanded with obvious agitation,
"Father! What is the meaning of this?! Not only were we all called back from an important battle against the space pirates, but now the guards are saying that I'm no longer the princess! What is going on!?!"
Sadala sighed as he rubbed his temples, seemingly anticipating an oncoming headache, before finally saying,
"Your majesty, I would like to introduce you to my daughter, Sala. Sala, this is Alexander Morningstar, our new emperor." Anything that Sala looked as if she was going to say vanished on the tip of her tongue, as she directed an incredulous look at Alex, who merely nodded at her and said,
"Pleasure to meet you." The next minute or so was fairly entertaining as they watched Sala go through a variety of expressions and emotions, before she turned and looked back at Alex and demanded with narrowed eyes,
"Are you also the one who spread that disgusting slander about emperor Frost? On the way here I received a transmission stating that he was in league with the space pirates, which is the most ridiculous lie I'd ever heard of! Emperor Frost has always been, and always will be, our most steadfast ally in the fight against evil!"
Alex cocked a brow at that while Sadala sighed once again, before saying,
"Please excuse us for a moment your majesty, I feel the need to explain a few things to my daughter."
Alex waved them away to give his approval, as he himself always prioritized his family over all else. When the door closed behind them as the father-daughter duo left the study though, Alex and the others were treated to listening to them argue loudly through it.
Sadala tried explaining everything that happened to his daughter, while Sala seemingly refused to believe the things he was saying. Alex had to give her some points though, as Sala argued that the revelations of Frost's true nature was too coincidental after Alex defeated Sadala in combat, though the man argued that Frost outed himself when confronted with his treachery, and tried to blow up planet Sadala as a result.
After several minutes of arguing though, Alex was somewhat, but not really, surprised when the door burst open yet again, and Sala stormed through as she declared,
"I challenge you to a duel! If I win, then the crown goes back to my father!" Alex fought the urge to roll his eyes as he turned back to them, while Sadala said from behind her,
"I'm sorry your majesty, but she just insists on testing your strength for herself..." Alex smiled wryly as the replied,
"It's alright. I have daughters myself, and I'm not sure what I'll do when they get to this age..." He then turned to Sala and said with a serious voice,
"Are you sure about this?" Sala nodded as she stated firmly,
"As a member of the Saiyan royal family, I have a duty to my people to ensure the best possible future for my people!" Alex fought the urge to roll his eyes at that, but he still turned towards the former Saiyan Princess and said,
"Very well, let's discuss the terms of the duel first."
***
Kale was in hell. Or was it heaven? It depended on the moment.
On one hand this was the first ever actual bath she'd ever had, with the only thing that came close to it being when she occasionally tried washing herself in the freezing creeks and rivers. On the other though, she had been under a constant assault by the female servants with all manner of cleaning instruments.
They used everything from sponges, to even steel wool and brushes on her, scrubbing her skin raw until she was practically glowing pink, even in her most private of places. Once they were done with that, the servants began working on her hair, yanking and pulling on it with brushes and combs, and scrubbing it with cleansers until it was the softest Kale ever recalled her hair being.
Once they had cleaned every single inch of her body, including her tail, Kale was finally allowed to enter the main baths, which was heavenly to her. For the first time in her life she was able to feel completely warm as she submerged her entire body in the hot water.
"Are you enjoying the hot water?" Vados suddenly asked her, the attendant having stood back as she was cleaned and watched silently until that point.
Kale simply nodded silently as she slid further into the water until it came up over her nose. Vados giggled at that before she told her,
"Well, as Alex's student you will be able to take baths like this and eat nice hot food every day." That got a reaction out of her, as Kale whirled around to face Vados and asked,
"R-really?" The Angel nodded as she said,
"Yes, really. Several of Alex's wives lead a team that cooks enough food for him, the rest of his wives, the hundreds of women following them, and his children daily." Kale's eyes widened when she heard that, before she hesitantly asked,
"W-wives? Children?" Vados nodded as she used her scepter to produce an image of hundreds of women and several children, before she continued,
"Yes. Alex has collected quite the number of women in his travels, several of which have borne him children." As Kale looked at the many women that Alex had 'collected', for some reason she felt a bitter frustration well up within her.
"Are you sure about this big sis?" A voice suddenly asked, drawing Kale's attention to a group of six women who suddenly entered the royal baths.
"Welcome back Caulifla, did you already pack everything you needed up?" Vados suddenly asked the girl in the lead of the group, drawing Kale's attention to her as well as she strutted up to the baths.
"Yep! There wasn't much for us to pack anyways, but those storage ring things are pretty cool!" As she said that most of the girls around her voiced their agreement, while the one who had been speaking when they walked in was silent.
"Is there something wrong?" Vados asked her curiously, to which the Saiyaness hesitated for a moment, before saying,
"I just ain't so sure about us going with a man who we just met today, and leaving everything we've been building behind..." Vados cocked a brow at that, but then Caulifla snorted as she crossed her arms beneath her bare breasts,
"We'd be idiots not to join Alex! The guy is a beast, and fucks like one too." She then flopped down into the hot water without washing her body, and continued,
"With him in charge we'd probably be either arrested or killed within the day, plus my intuition tells me that he'd be a better ruler than Sadala anyways. Besides, I didn't hear you voicing any complaints when he was shoving that meat log he calls a cock up your ass." Smirking at the end, Caulifla looked up at the Saiyaness in question to see her face was red as she brought back memories of when Alex made them his 'bitches'.
Caulifla smirked at that thought as well, as she liked that particular label instead of something boring like 'wife', 'lover', or 'concubine'.
Then however, Vados suddenly looked up as something seemingly caught her attention, before she tapped the butt of her scepter against the floor of the baths. Appearing instantly before them was a Saiyan woman that looked to be about the same age as Caulifla, who had her hair in a tight braid.
"And who is this?" Caulifla asked when she saw the newcomer, to which Vados answered,
"This is the former princess Sala, who wagered herself in a duel with his majesty, and is now his concubine." When she heard that Caulifla grinned evilly as she stood up from the water, and faced the former princess.
"Oh this is going to be so beautiful! I definitely want a front row seat to when the 'oh so perfect' princess takes that meat log for the first time!" Sala narrowed her eyes as she looked at Caulifla, the five girls that were with her, Vados, and then Kale.
"And who are you supposed to be?" Sala demanded of Caulifla with undisguised hostility, making the former bandit smirk as she said,
"My name is Caulifla, and WE are Alex's loyal bitches!" As she said that Caulifla gestured to the five other Saiyan women around them.
"Caulifla?" Sala repeated, before her expression warped into one of hostility.
"You mean that filthy bandit criminal who's been stealing the cargo transports for the people of Sadala!?" Caulifla snorted at that as she remarked,
"Oh please! We give those supplies to those who need them, unlike the FORMER King who only gave them to those he dreamed worthy!" Sala glared at Caulifla's accusation and ground her teeth, but was unable to refute it.
They were warriors, not farmers or engineers. The only way for them to sustain their people was to hunt or hire themselves out to earn the money needed to buy the necessary resources, which meant they had to prioritize giving them to the people who could fight. The problem with hunting though, was that they could easily wipe out all other life on their planet if they hunted for food without restraint.
"Humph! That's what I thought!" Caulifla smirked at Sala's silence, considering it her victory over the princess.
It was then that Sala noticed Kale watching the exchange with wide eyes, and she lashed at her instead as she demanded,
"And who are you?! Hm?!" With everyone else turning to look at her, Kale desperately wished she could vanish in that moment as she tried to shrink back. Caulifla then asked her as well,
"Are you another of Alex's bitches? Like me and the prissy princess here?" Sala glared at Caulifla as she said that, and was tempted to snap back at her. But before she could, Kale asked hesitantly
"U-um.....what's a b-bitch?"
(A.N. Poor Kale, feeling like she's behind the curve when she only needs a week of training to curb stomp them all. Also about Sala, I created her because I wanted to give Caulifla a rival instead of just being the only badass Saiyan of Alex's harem)
***
"Haaaa..." Alex sighed as he lounged in his own bath, while numerous Saiyan women that were also in the nude scrubbed his body for him.
They had been handpicked to serve him by the former king Sadala, meaning they were all the most attractive amongst the palace servants. If it weren't for the fact that Alex already had eight Saiyan women he was bringing home with him, then he might have been more tempted.
As it was, the most intense thing that happened in the bath was when three of the women decided to use their mouths to clean his cock and balls. And when they were all drenched in the resulting 'shower', Alex then got a pretty good show as each of the Saiyan women licked his cum off of each other's bodies.
Once the erotic bath was over with, Alex was dressed in a 'formal' pair of shorts, a cape that hung from a cord around his neck, and numerous golden bracers and bands that clasped onto his wrists and biceps. To finish off the outfit, a circlet of gold and jewels that was the sign of Sadalan sovereignty was placed on his forehead at the base of his bangs, indicating to all who saw him that he was the planet's new ruler.
Once he was finished getting ready, Alex then went to meet with Sadala and the rest of the officials, along with Vegeta Sr, Trunks, and Raditz. There he also saw his own personal entourage of Caulifla, her followers, Sala, and Kale.
Caulifla was dressed in long and spacey purple harem pants with a pink band that only covered her breasts, along with matching grey wristbands on her arms. Sala went the more decorative approach, wearing harem pants like Caulifla, except they were blue with gold patterns, matching the golden necklace, and bracelets on her wrists and ankles, while a similar band covered her breasts as well.
And then there was Kale, who Vados dressed in the uniform Alex gave gave her that matched the ones his children and Videl wore, signifying that she was his student. The difference though was that Kale's uniform was a brilliant golden-green, a color that seemed unusual to everyone except Alex. Like the anime though, her hair was now tied up in a high ponytail while a single strand hung down in front of her face.
Though Caulifla and Sala were glaring at each other, and Kale fidgeted from how uncomfortable she was around so many people, everyone else looked ready as Alex asked,
"Are we ready for this?" Sadala nodded as he said,
"I've sent the guards to spread the word that there is to be an announcement to the entire world from its king, so everyone should be listening even if it's night." Alex nodded as he adopted a serious expression, and said,
"Alright, let's get this over with." That earned him a few snickers, but Alex ignored them as he willed this whole thing to hurry up. He hated these types of official occasions, and just wanted it to be over with despite the necessity of it.
Sadala nodded as he went out to the main balcony, overlooking the city below, and received great cheers from the people who had gathered to hear his announcement. While he greeted the masses, Alex turned to Kale and said,
"You're looking a lot better Kale. How do you like the uniform? I made it myself." When she heard that Kale blushed furiously while fidgeting even more, before she stuttered,
"I-i- l-like it...!" Alex smiled when he heard that, as he patted her head and said,
"Im glad. When we return home I'll take you shopping so you can have a whole wardrobe of clothes to choose from." Kale's blush only deepened at that as she eagerly awaited their 'date', making Caulifla roll her eyes in exasperation from the display while Sala wondered if she should ask for a 'date' as well.
"U-um..." Kale then said, as she tried to speak up, but before she could one of the attendants approached Alex and said,
"Sire, we're about to reach your cue!" Alex nodded at them seriously before turning back to Kale and saying,
"Sorry, but I'll have to take care of this. I'll listen to anything you have to say once this bullshit is over with." Giving her an apologetic smile as he said that, Alex turned and headed towards the balcony as he awaited his cue.
...
The people had gathered to hear their king speak, all around the world as numerous projections showed them his image. They were hoping that he would answer some of the questions they had, like the group of streakers that had flown all over the planet earlier, or the damning rumors that were spreading about their ally, the emperor Frost.
What he told them involved neither of these things though, as he said once he made his appearance,
"My fellow Saiyans, this has been a busy day! Today a stranger appeared in my halls, and ever since he arrived there have been waves after waves caused by him that could only strengthen and empower our people! Unfortunately, I can not watch the results of these waves as your king."
the moment those words left Sadala's mouth there was a minor uproar all over the planet, as the position of King had been handed down through Sadala's family line for generations. Theories flew within seconds why this was, ranging from him handing the throne to his daughter, Sala, to a usurper stealing the throne from them.
But before the theories could get too extreme, Sadala voice echoed out,
"SILENCE! I will explain the meaning of my words now! When the stranger came to my halls, I could feel the power and influence he was exerting, and challenged him myself to a duel over the future of the crown, a duel I instantly lost."
Again the murmurs erupted all over the planet at the news, before Sadala continued,
"And now I present to you all our new emperor, ruler of numerous world's and races from even different universes, ALEXANDER MORNINGSTAR!"
As his declaration, a figure stepped forward to take his place, wearing the Royal circlet no less, with his entire upper body covered in what appeared to be a bright red coat, but everyone realized was instead fur. This in itself caused a minor uproar in the places Alex had already visited that day, as numerous people recognized his eye-catching fur and large figure. Among them was the woman who served him and Kale at the tavern, who was now cursing the missed opportunity, and the man who been overseeing the arrival of their cargo, who had gone deathly pale as he recalled spitting into his face earlier.
Again rumors and theories flew as everyone discussed what this new emperor would do to them, and what the future would hold. But when Alex raised his hand for silence, it was like a blanket had descended upon the planet as every single Saiyan instinctively hushed.
"I know that many of you have questions regarding who I am, and what may happen to you now that I am your emperor." Alex began, speaking in a calm yet slightly raised voice.
"Firstly, I am a Saiyan that has come here from the dimension of Asora! There resides the seat of my empire, along with gates that lead to the other worlds and universes where my influence extends!
"Originally, I planned to move the planet Sadala into the dimension of Asora, bringing the Saiyans closer to myself and the rest of my subjects, but then something was brought to my attention!"
As he paused for dramatic effect, Alex then produced an image of Frost when he continued,
"I learned the truth about the 'good' and 'benevolent' emperor Frost, that he was the leader of the very same space pirates that the Saiyans of this universe have been fighting so valiantly against!" Though there was brief outcry from those who protested the claims Alex made against their ally, they were quickly silenced when he replayed the scene of Frost conspiring with the captains of the space pirates, as well as his intentions to destroy planet Sadala when he was confronted with the truth.
As the Saiyans watched the recordings numerous feelings welled up within them, the primary of which was rage for those who had been injured or killed in battles Frost led them into. But then Alex showed them the scene of himself killing Frost, instantly at that, and declared,
"As you have all seen, Frost is dead by my hand! But that is not yet the end of it!" Alex then conjured an image of the same captains Frost had been meeting with, and continued,
"Before I take you all into Asora, I want the Saiyan people to prove they are worthy! Show me you deserve to be my warriors, by wiping out all of the remaining space pirates in the entire universe!"
Though normally asking that would be considered idiocy since the pirates had several powerful warriors within their ranks, the Saiyans didn't care with their flaring emotions, and they all cried out in their anger and grief for those who had been lost to the pirates.
"Before that though!" Alex cried out, subduing their outcries slightly, another figure stepped forward to stand next to him.
Gesturing to the man next to him, Vegeta Sr, Alex then stated to the masses that were watching,
"There is a transformation that only the most powerful and skilled Saiyans are capable of performing, one that multiplies their power by several times their original level to give them the strength to defeat even the strongest opponents! The Super Saiyan Transformation!" As Alex declared that, Vegeta Sr then demonstrated said transformation for the people as his aura and hair turned to a brilliant gold, and those around the world felt the massive source of energy as it spiked ever higher.
"THIS IS WHAT I OFFER YOU ALL! PROVE YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES!" Alex declared with passion in his voice As Vegeta Sr's energy spiked even higher, until he was just shy of elevating to the second stage, which they decided not to show just yet.
And with the increase in energy, the passions of the spectating Saiyans skyrocketed as well, which Alex capitalized on as he shouted,
"WHAT DO YOU SAY!?!"
"""LONG LIVE THE EMPEROR!!!"""
In response to Alex's declaration, the masses shouted their support of their new emperor, who brought them this new technique to use to enact their fury of the space pirates.
"""LONG LIVE THE EMPEROR!!!"""
"""LONG LIVE THE EMPEROR!!!"""
"""LONG LIVE THE EMPEROR!!!"""
Over and over again they cheered, to which Alex flared his energy so that all of them could feel it throughout the entire planet. But as he did so, Alex did a little something else.
Tucked away in an alley as they watched the announcement, dressed in rags and covered in scars, an elderly Saiyan snorted as he waved his right arm in dismissal, which ended in a stump. Or at least it was supposed to.
When the man waved his arm, instead of the stump he'd seen the last twenty years he saw his hand there. Tears welled up within his eyes as he moved his new fingers in disbelief, before standing and strutting out of the alley with renewed strength, and purpose.
With strength he hadn't felt since his prime, the elderly Saiyan roared out along with his people as similar miracles appeared all over planet Sadala. No matter who they were, Saiyan men and women who bore crippling injuries that had drove them from the battlefield stood with straight back for the first time in years, strength they long forgotten filling their limbs as their injuries healed.
All over Sadala energies flared, and Saiyans began firing blasts into the skies in their excitement, making the planet appear like a miniature star with how bright it was becoming.
Smirking at how successful his introduction had been, Alex flared his cape dramatically and strutted back into the palace, where he found Sadala and every other Saiyan there kneeling before him. Even Sala looked at him with a reverence that hadn't been there before.
"Your majesty..." Sadala uttered in awe as Alex stood before him, before his emperor decreed,
"Vegeta, I expect several of our warriors to be able to make the Super Saiyan transformation within the week, and only then will they attack. The entire planet is united in their desire for justice to be done, and I doubt we will be able to reignite their enthusiasm this effectively again in the near future. Make the most of it."
"Of course your majesty." Vegeta Sr said as he bowed deeply, knowing full well that there should be at least a few Saiyans that can make that kind of timeline.
Alex then added while he also looked at Sadala,
"I'm also making the two of you my generals, since you both have the most experience leading out of everyone else here. If I'm not around, then you two are in charge."
""Sire!"" Both former kings saluted, knowing full well that Alex didn't need to give either of them a position of authority. But both were deeply appreciative of the opportunity.
Alex then turned to Caulifla, her followers, Sala, and Kale, and said,
"You all will return with me. Kale will begin training to control her powers, while I expect the rest of you to begin training to achieve the Super Saiyan forms as well. In a week you'll be sent back to help in upcoming battle."
Though Caulifla just smirked in anticipation, Sala bowed deeply at Alex's command while Kale looked hesitant when he mentioned her training. Seeing her, Alex's expression softened and, since he didn't have anything else to do right at that moment, asked her,
"What was it you wanted to say earlier Kale?" The young Saiyaness blushed as she steeled herself, before telling Alex as clearly as she could,
"C-can you p-please make m-me your b-b-BITCH!" Yelling the last word due to her embarrassment, the word 'bitch' seemed to echo through the palace halls as Alex and the male Saiyans froze.
'Well....' Alex thought himself as he looked down at the determined Kale. 'That's one way to end a speech...'

chapters.title: Chapter 469 - 469: The Demonic Rabbit
chapters.content:
(A.N. A reminder that Alex only knows DBS up to the beginning of the Tournament of Power, and doesn't know the things that happened after it. As far as he's aware the only Broly that exists is the DBZ version, who he doesn't want to go near because he is like a force of raw power that a fight with could destroy entire galaxies, and would create more collateral damage than he wants to risk. People like the gods of destruction and other enemies control their strength, Broly doesn't.)
***
"And this is Pangea, a world that possess habitats and creatures from all over the twelve universes. It's where the portal to Asora in these universes lies, and is used a nexus for fighters from all over Universe Seven to gather. Perhaps in the future we'll also bring in fighters from all twelves of the universes as well."
Having left planet Sadala behind, Alex had Vados take them to Pangea first so that he could show the eight Saiyanesses all the different options for training they'd have in the future.
"The people here.....they're strong!" Caulifla exclaimed as she eyed several of the people around them, all different races from all over Universe Seven, and more than ninety percent of which were fighters that had come to Pangea to train.
"You're free to fight them," Alex began, before saying seriously, "but only if they accept a challenge from you, and only in the colosseum. I don't want to hear of people fighting randomly in the streets and disturbing others, and most of all I don't want to hear of a killing."
Though Alex didn't believe any of the women with him would outright kill anyone, he still wanted to make sure they knew how things worked on Pangea, and accidents were always possible. At least at the colosseum they had equipment and people in place for such an 'accident'.
It was also where Alex intended to have the tournament in a few weeks time.
With Sala on his right, Caulifla on his left with her group behind her, and Kale clinging to the fur on his back, Alex led the group of women through Pangea, pointing out locations and answering questions as they went.
Then he did the same when they entered Asora, where Sala and Kale were much more interested since it was Alex's actual home. Caulifla's interest of course was in the number of powerful people were there too, as she silently came to the conclusion that following Alex was the right idea with how many strong opponents she'd get a chance to face around him.
But here they saw another side to his character as they walked the streets of Asora, and nearly everyone stopped and talked to Alex with smiles on their faces, and questions about the numerous girls that were following him. There was quite a bit of attention to their tails in particular, as numerous people seemed interested in the prospect of more Saiyans in Asora.
"Are Saiyans really that rare here?" Sala asked after she heard several people comment about what they were, to which Alex nodded as he explained,
"Yes, until recently I and my children were the only Saiyans in Asora, and they're all hybrids. Meanwhile the Saiyans of Universe Seven were wiped out decades ago by the tyrant Frieza, of which only two were left until I revived four more. Vegeta Sr, Bardock, his wife Gine, and their son Raditz were all revived by me, while their other son Goku, aka Kakarot, was a survivor, and Trunks is a human/Saiyan hybrid of the other survivor, Vegeta Jr."
As Alex trailed off the girls all adopted thoughtful looks, except for Kale as all the information went directly over her head. Sala on one hand was thinking about the Saiyans of Universe Seven, and wondered if they were similar to the Saiyans of her homeland since she hadn't interacted with any of them outside of Alex.
Caulifla meanwhile was wondering how strong this Frieza was, and by extension the Saiyans that Alex already had under him. She already got a glimpse when they squared off with Frost earlier, but she was more than eager to try her hand against them after training with Alex for a week.
But that would come later, as they finally arrived at Alex's home, the Misty Manor.
"So I get you have some other bitches already, but are any of them strong?" Caulifla asked tauntingly, making Alex snort as he told her,
"They and the majority of Asora have been training specifically to fight opponents like, or as strong as, Super Saiyans for years. I can guarantee that more than a few of the people here can knock you on your ass with little more then a twitch of their finger."
Rather than seeming discouraged, Caulifla smiled widely at the prospect of so many people who were stronger than her, on Pangea, in Asora, and even within Alex's harem. Even Sala looked excited at the idea as, even if she wasn't as much of a battle junkie as Caulifla, she was still a Saiyan deep down.
They were then greeted by said harem, or at least a part of it, as numerous women came into view.
"I thought it was just supposed to be a quick trip to the world of Saiyans..." Anne groaned as she looked over the eight women with Alex, before her gaze settled on Kale.
Alex just shrugged though, as he replied, "Don't blame me, Saiyan women apparently have a defeatist fetish."
There was a collective hum from the girls around Alex as he said that, but as they all joined his harem after he defeated them in combat, none of them refuted his words while Kale was just wondering what he was talking about. She looked up at him though when Alex placed a hand on the top of her head, and told his empress,
"Besides, this one's just a student until she can at least control her powers." Anne cocked a brow at that while Kale just sulked, already having the same discussion with Alex after her earlier request.
Alex had been really surprised to learn that Saiyans didn't have a general age when it was appropriate to have sex, and they just apparently started screwing when they began going through puberty. When he thought about it though, Alex figured it made sense since even the Saiyans of Universe Six didn't widely use practices such as marriage, as less than ten percent of 'mated pairs' on planet Sadala were even married.
So instead Alex told the disappointed Kale that she would need to wait until she had mastered controlling her powers, as her emotions could trigger a transformation and make her go berserk. That of course just made her more eager to master her powers as soon as possible, which Alex wasn't going to complain about.
Of course, Alex's claim that Kale was a student earned him numerous looks, which he knew he'd be explaining after he got the new girls settled. It also directed everyone's attention to the meek Saiyaness, which made her cling to Alex even more while trying to hide behind him.
"Let's get everyone settled within the space-time orb, and then we'll catch up on everything that happened." Alex said eventually, earning him an exasperated nod of agreement from the rest of his gathered wives while the Saiyanesses were wondering what the space-time orb he mentioned was.
So, after collecting the children since it was nearly night in Asora, Alex soon found himself surrounded by his wives once dinner was over. Sitting next to him on either side was Caulifla and Sala, while an anxious Kale had been dragged off by Myuu and Videl.
"Alright, what do we need to know...?" An exasperated Grayfia asked as eyed the group of Saiyanesses, to which Alex smiled wryly as he generalized what happened on planet Sadala.
"Well, Vados and I arrived in the middle of Caulifla's bath, so I beat up and fucked the entire group while Bardock, Vegeta, Raditz, and Trunks were all chased across the planet as criminal streakers. Then when I finally went to see king Sadala he challenged me for the crown, and made me the new emperor of the entire population of Saiyans in Universe Six.
"Then after that I went and located Kale, the Legendary Super Saiyan, before returning to the palace and adding the former princess Sala to my 'collection'. Then I finally announced my Ascension as emperor to the rest of the Saiyan people, and gave them the order to wipe out the space pirates of that universe to prove their worth to me. Currently Vegeta Sr, Trunks, and Raditz are still with them to help them learn the SSJ transformations and help in the war."
As he finished speaking Alex took a sip of the tea that one of the maids, Chiffon, brought him, while everyone else tried to absorb everything he just said.
For a moment there wasn't a single sound, with the only exception being Alex sipping his tea, and the occasional slurp or suck from the head of dark red hair bobbing up and down in his lap. Acting as if Mea wasn't currently sucking and licking him right in front of them though, Moka asked,
"So what is a 'Legendary Super Saiyan' anyways?" Taking one last sip, Alex looked over the girls around with complete seriousness as he told them,
"The LSS is basically a monster that will rampage and destroy everything within its sight if their powers awaken. Even Kale, as weak and powerless as she appears, will rage and destroy everything around her if she can't learn how to control them. That's why I'm teaching her, as the only other alternative will be to either seal her powers or kill her, both of which I'm not sure will work if she encounters a powerful enough trigger."
Though he left it unsaid, that was also why Alex wouldn't risk sealing or killing Broly, as the lightest miscalculation and he'd be locked in battle with someone capable of wiping out everyone and everything around them without the slightest bit of hesitation. In a way, Broly could even be considered a bigger threat than the Omni King with his strength and feral attitude. (A.N. Again, people like Beerus or the Omni King can be reasoned with, a transformed Broly can't.)
"Is she stronger than us?" Caulifla asked with interest, to which Sala also perked an ear up as she listened intently. Alex however smiled wryly as he said,
"In terms of raw power and physical capabilities, yes. But!" He quickly added before Caulifla could get too interested. "If either of you were to fight her then you'd win, easily."
Alex then looked out over his wives as he said seriously,
"Kale has had a hard life, growing up on the streets alone for as long as she could remember. Not only that, but she also possesses a trauma related to her strength after she accidentally hurt the only friend she had in her life. She developed an attachment to me after I helped her and told her how alike we were as fellow Legendary Super Saiyans, but I'm hoping that being friends with Videl and Myuu helps her become less introverted."
The wives nodded in affirmation at that, as they had all seen how attached Kale was to Alex firsthand. As she nodded though, Shia cracked a smile as she said,
"But to think, you'd even lie about being a LSS to get a girl to follow you... How devious Alex!" With several more of his wives nodding in agreement with Shia's comment and giving Alex pointed looks.
Back when they first acquired Evolution magic and Alex used it to evolve some of the girls to make them more powerful, as High Humans, Super Devils, etc, they had also asked him if he planned to evolve himself as well. Alex however told them about the dangers of the LSS then, and how he didn't want to risk losing control of himself in he turned himself into one.

***
*Earlier*
Francis, of the planet Atlas, had a neutral expression as his fleet of space pirates approached the doomed planet of Sadala, where the soon to be extinguished race of Saiyans resided.
They were fifty thousand four hundred seventy six warships strong, carrying a total of seven billion warriors collected from the multitude of planets under their control, along with the vast majority of the most wanted criminals in the entire universe. It was a force like none the universe had ever seen before, and it had been brought together for two reasons.
The first was that, since Frost was dead, they no longer had to skulk and scheme or play the pathetic game of cat and mouse he had them do to bolster his image. They needed to make a show of force to remind the rest of the universe that they were not to be fucked with.
The second reason was HOW Frost got killed.
The man in the projection that appeared all over the universe. Not a single one of their data banks had ANY information on him, where he was from, who he was, where his allegiances were. NOTHING!
The only things they did know is what he looked like, and that he was powerful enough to even kill Frost, the one person who was strong enough to keep the entirety of their criminal organization in check. And this person killed him like he was swatting a fly.
So Francis had pulled out all the stops.
While the other two captains marshaled their forces and prepared for galactic war, he was taking every warrior readily available to planet Sadala to use the Saiyans to make an example, and to deal with Frost's killer through their sheer overwhelming numbers.
"Captain!" One of the crew members in charge of communications called out suddenly.
"We're detecting a transmission between planet Sadala and the empire!" That caught Francis' attention, as any call for help would usually at least be encrypted or hidden instead of leaving it open to be intercepted.
"Play it over the speakers. I want to hear these Saiyans beg as they cry out for help." Francis said with sadistic glee, reveling in the distress that the Saiyans must be feeling. But then his subordinate hesitantly said,
"Um.... The transmission isn't from Sadala... It's from the empire..." Francis' mental facilities stalled at that, before he demanded,
"Play it now!"
Hurrying to do as he ordered, soon the ship was filled with the voice of a man bursting with pride as he declared,
"General Jama to king Sadala! General Jama to King Sadala! We have received word that an invasion force of unprecedented scale is swiftly approaching planet Sadala, and were are on our way to intercept!"
Though Francis' face twisted in disgust when he heard the voice of General Jama, the so-called hero of planet Atlas and the strongest candidate to take Frost's place as emperor, his expression turned to shock when they heard the reply.
"Sadala to general Jama. Firstly its GENERAL Sadala now, not King. And secondly, we politely refuse your offer of assistance."
No one spoke as they registered that, before even general Jama hesitantly replied,
"Come again ki-general Sadala?" Sadala's voice then sounded again as he repeated,
"Again, we do not need assistance. This is OUR war, given to us by our emperor. So kindly butt out!"
For a time no one said anything as the transmission was cut off, not anyone on the bridge of Francis' ship until the captain himself uttered an astonished,
"What the fuck...?"
Sadala's voice hadn't been one of resignation or submission, but one of arrogance and surety of their victory, even against such overwhelming odds. And the more Francis replayed that conversation in his head, the angrier he got.
"How DARE he mock us!" Francis declared as he gripped the arms of his captain's seat harder. He then looked out the front of their ship, through which he could see planet Sadala, and declared to all of the ships under his command,
"Begin the attaaaack!"
As one, the thousands of ships descended upon planet Sadala as the troops they were carrying prepared to go to battle. And once they entered the atmosphere of the planet, those same troops began disembarking in the tens of thousands as the skies of Sadala were filled with clouds of impending death.
"Make it slow and painful! We will teach these beasts the meaning of respect before they die! I will have Sadala on his KNEES!" Francis roared throughout the entire fleet, his fury evident as he eagerly anticipated the slaughter.
Well...there was in fact a slaughter.
As they began their attack, hundreds of figures flew up from the planet to meet the space pirates in combat, figures with bright golden hair who radiated an immense power. Francis watched as these golden haired warriors tore through his forces like they were nothing more than wet paper, either ripping them apart with their bare hands, or wiping them out in the hundreds with impossibly powerful energy attacks.
"What is this...?!" Francis snarled as he watched the most notorious and vicious criminals in the universe being taken out like yesterday's trash.
"Who the hell are they!?!" He demanded angrily, as no one had ever heard of golden haired Saiyans before. Yet, the long golden tails they possessed were identical to the same brown ones that the Saiyans usually had whenever they clashed before.
So Francis couldn't help but to wonder, were these warriors that had never left planet Sadala and acted as its last line of defense, or was this some kind of trump card that the Saiyans had never revealed until now? He was more inclined to believe the former, as he had personally killed numerous Saiyans in their previous battles, and they would've used such power if they were in that case.
But his confusion increased as their monitor zoomed in to show the ones leading the Saiyans in their charge, one of which he recognized as the former king, Sadala. Like the others, Sadala also had golden hair as he tore through any enemy that was dumb enough to cross his path.
With each passing second Francis became increasingly mad as he watched his forces being decimated one sidedly, by none other than a handful of Saiyans at that. He had been about to give the order to prep the anti-planetary weaponry, when one of the crew suddenly shouted,
"Captain! We're detecting seven sources of power that far exceed any others on planet Sadala rapidly approaching!"
'There are more!?!' Francis thought to himself, even as he noticed the seven mentioned golden figures as they came in at high speeds.
Feeling their power for himself, Francis was dumbfounded as he wondered where these powerhouses were coming from. But he could wonder that later, as he commanded,
"Send out the Yogu Force!" At Francis' command, five powerful figures swiftly departed the same ship he was personally commanding, their energies dwarfing the rest of the army's significantly.
As the seven warriors were slaughtering their way though his forces unimpeded, having even destroyed over a hundred ships carrying still more soldiers, the two stronger ones broke off as they made a beeline directly for Francis' ship.
The Yogu Force naturally tried to intercept them, but they were intercepted instead by the remaining five warriors, who were all women. The two that broke off then proceeded to destroy every single ship and kill every single person near them as if they were monsters possessed, before the front of Francis' ship suddenly caved in as they smashed their way into it.
"Gah gah!" Everyone coughed and chocked on the dust and smoke from their entrance until it cleared, to reveal two Saiyan women that were surrounded by the now hated golden aura as the rest of them, except theirs felt eerily stronger. But as he got a better look at them, Francis was surprised as he began,
"Princess Sala-"
"Ha!" The other women suddenly shouted, cutting him off as she declared, "I destroyed ninety eight ships prissy princess! Beat that!"
In the face of her companion's confidence, Sala just snorted as she coolly replied,
"I destroyed ninety nine ships bandit bitch, most of which hadn't unloaded their cargo yet while yours were mostly empty. My kill count is higher." Neither of the women seemed particularly concerned that they were currently surrounded by dozens of the strongest fighters that captain Francis had brought with him, short of Yogu Force of course.
"You stupid bitches! take that!" One of the crew members shouted as he fired his ray gun at them, only for Sala to 'swat' the Ray away with the back of her hand as if she were swatting a fly.
"Eh?" That was all the subordinate had time to utter, before her hand lit up and a hole had been blasted through his chest, killing him almost instantly. Sala didn't even look At him as she said to her companion,
"Make that another one that I've already killed. Try to keep up bandit bitch, it's no fun otherwise."
"Why you little puffed up-" the other woman snarled as he literally butted the princess with her head, seemingly ready to throw down with her then and there, when,
*CLAP!*
Frank's clapped his hands suddenly to get everyone's attention, the women who'd been about to fight, and the men who'd been about to try and subdue them.
"Ladies! Perhaps we can come to some sort of agreement! After all, regardless of how powerful you two are, this is still just a mere faction of our total strength. So how about it, would either of you be willing to join us and survive the inevitable slaughter of your kind?"
Though it was only his people being slaughtered right now, Francis still believed in his inevitable victory with their superior numbers, as there was no way the Saiyans were able to keep using such power indefinitely. Plus, with how strong they were, he hoped at least the woman fighting with princess would see things his way, and join them.
""Ha?"" Both women snarled though, before they got a good look at Francis for the first time and blinked as they looked at something above him.
Tilting his head in confusion, Francis looked up, but didn't see anything there, making him wonder if they'd been looking at his antenna.
Though the people of his race varied in color, Francis himself was a lovely light blue with matching hair and a slim figure, which was betrayed by his significant strength and the power in his body. But, sticking up from his long hair, were two antenna that rose up about a foot before ending in small balls.
And as those same antenna twitched from being stared at for some reason, Sala suddenly said in an eerily calm voice,
"Hey Caulifla.... I don't know about you, but I'm suddenly feeling strangely annoyed right now..." Though he probably should've noticed the use of the other woman's actual name instead of the offensive nick name, Francis was a bit more concerned with the rising killing intent the two were suddenly directing towards him as the other woman, Caulifla, replied in a similarly eerie voice,
"What a coincidence.... I was beginning to feel the same way Sala..."
What followed instilled true fear into Francis for the first time since the invasion began, as the killing intent coming from both women seemed to reach a boiling point as they both unleashed feral screams.
""HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!""
And as they screamed, the killing intent and power being emitted by both women suddenly rocket up even higher as bolts of lightning began arcing around them, which were composed of pure concentrated energy. Francis' horror then increased as he watched their already golden and spiky hair become even wilder and longer to match their combined fury, as their already rampant energies began tearing his ship apart without either of them even needing to do anything.
The last thing he saw was the duo moving in complete synchronization as their fists approached his face in what appeared to be slow motion, but no matter how much he tried to do so, Francis' body refused to react before the fists connected, and his vision went completely dark.
...
"KEEP IT UP MEN! KILL THEM ALL!"
Sadala, former king of the Saiyan people, cried out as he led his men into battle alongside Vegeta Sr and his grandson Trunks, while Raditz and one of their defense soldiers, Potta, led the charge on the other side.
"Still I can't believe this power..." The former king found himself muttering, as opponents he would've struggled or been bested by a week ago were easily dispatched by his hand. And the fact that the same power resided within all of his people was truly amazing.
Drawing on their emotions after Alex's speech, and the revelations of Frost's true nature, Vegets Sr had skillfully helped Sadala and hundreds of his best and strongest soldiers draw out the hidden power in the short time they had.
Now, despite being severely outnumbered by the most powerful and notorious criminals in the universe, they were more than holding their own with only a few hundred fighters. Of course, they couldn't hold out like this forever.
Even if they hadn't been able to achieve the Super Saiyan transformation, there were still tens of millions of warriors on the surface of planet Sadala ready to join the fight, which they would once the former king and the other SSJs finished eliminating the strongest of the space pirates.
But there had been something that shocked even the former king to his core, which was the changes that occurred within his daughter during the short week she was away.
Though she had always possessed the potential to surpass him, Sala had always been weaker than her father due to his vast experiences in combat. Now however, Sadala didn't think it'd even be a competition if they fought, and he'd lose instantly.
"Just what did he do to her...?" The former king uttered in amazement, as Sala and the bandit Caulifla destroyed the flagship where Francis had been hiding, before proceeding to rapidly destroy every ship they could as the two women tried to outdo the other.

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - 471: The Days Before the Tournament
chapters.content:
*crunch crunch crunch*
Orange and brown leaves crunched underfoot and a crisp chill filled the air as a group walked through a similarly colored forest.
One of them was a young teen with Crimson red hair, roughly similar in age as the other young man with black hair, and a monkey tail extending from his backside. His matched the tails of the other three people, a young boy who excitedly ran ahead of the others with darker skin, the only full grown man of the group that was covered in bright red fur, and the youngest boy of the lot with fiery orange and gold hair that was happily riding his shoulders.
Alex led the boys, Millicas, Gohan, Alec, and Regal, along the woodsy path as they wandered aimlessly amongst the fallen leaves.
While usually he took them fishing when he wanted to spend time with them, Alex decided to try something different this time by taking them into the woods to admire the fall time atmosphere, though Alec seemed to be more interested in kicking leaves.
Alex had long since gained proper control over the seasons of Asora so they weren't dependent on the world they currently occupied. Thankfully this meant they also had much shorter and milder seasons instead of an entire year of burning summer heat, or freezing winter cold.
Currently they were in the cusp of autumn, the favorite season of the Youkai, Devils and Fallen Angels due to the excess of supernatural energies in the air.
It was also the favorite season of Alex's most recent wife to carry his child, Artemis, as it was the prime season to hunt dear and elk as they entered their rut. With her fresh into her pregnancy, the goddess of the hunt had still been excitedly bringing them plenty of venison to eat before she would be forced to rest for the remainder of her term.
Alex meanwhile, was simply enjoying the serene fall atmosphere with his sons and the two older boys as they walked, until he suddenly asked Gohan,
"So how's school going?" The young Saiyan adopted an awkward look at that, before he answered,
"It's ok I guess. I've been getting challenged a lot lately though..." Alex smiled wryly when he heard that, while also directing a look upwards at the planet that now hovered above Asora, planet Sadala.
Almost immediately after they killed the space pirate captain Francis, Sala and Caulifla led the charge as they each attacked the other of the two captains in an effort to outdo the other, ending the war within a few days. After that Alex did as he promised, and moved the entirety of planet Sadala to the space above Asora, allowing the Saiyans to be closer to better serve him.
"Ever since those other Saiyans started attending the Academy, they began challenging me almost every day... The guys keep calling me Aniki(big bro) even if they're older, and the girls keep trying to flirt with me, though Brunch seems to be taking care of that."
Alex's smile only grew wryer as he 'peeked' at said girls, only to see Brunch educating them on who reigned at the top of the hierarchy of Gohan's apparent harem. Though harems were a complete unknown to the Saiyans of earth, it appeared Brunch took a page from Yukari's book and decided that the more women Gohan was with, the better his status.....so long as she was the main wife. The guys on the other hand would simply keep bugging Gohan due to the vast gap in strength, as he was the only Saiyan his age that had attained the SSJ2, which they all aspired for.
It wasn't as if Alex was completely without his own problems after moving the Saiyans to Asora though, as more or less the same thing was continuously happening to him as well, especially after everyone saw the difference in Sala and Caulifla's strength after only a week with him. The Saiyan men wanted to become his direct subordinates or students, while Alex had received what amounted to a proposal from several hundred Saiyan women in the short time since they became settled.
Alex of course had turned them all down, as the seven Saiyan women he currently had were enough for him, though Sala intended to form her own female squadron to compete with Caulifla's clan. On top of that, Kale's desire to join his harem hadn't waned in the slightest since she began her training and started attending the Academy. In fact, her desire seemed to be increasing by the day as she worked harder and harder to master her powers as quickly as possible.
So, knowing perfectly well what Gohan was going through, Alex ruffled his hair and said,
"I know exactly how you feel, and all I can say is that I know you can handle it!" Gohan laughed dryly at that, while Millicas got a far off look in his eyes as he recalled the problems he was experiencing with his own Peerage/harem. Then, as if he suddenly remembered something, the young Gremory said,
"Oh yeah! Miss Sona also offered Gohan his own Peerage recently too!" That caught Alex's attention, as he raised his brows and looked at the younger Saiyan pointedly. Gohan however flinched lightly, and said,
"Yeah..... But I'm not sure if I want a Peerage..." Having spent his entire life being made to study by his mother to become a civil servant, or training with his father to protect the planet, Gohan had never put much thought into what he wanted to do in the future until Alex asked him before. But even after all this time, he still didn't know.
Surprisingly though, Alex ruffled Gohan's hair again, messing it up as he did so, and said,
"That's alright. You're still young enough that you can take your time deciding what you want to do. Take this time while you're in school to explore what you like to do, and start from there. The only real wrong answer is one that makes you unhappy." Gohan was silent as he contemplated Alex advice, and for a while no one else said anything until Alec cried out,
"Dad, look!" Alex looked up and smiled as he sighted one of the very animals Artemis loved to hunt most, a truly massive bull elk.
The bull stood at the crest of a small hill in the clearing ahead, staring at their group as if studying them. He stood nearly seven feet tall at the top of his head, with an extra five feet just from his antlers alone.
*HUFF*
The bull breathed out heavily as it stared at their group, exhaling a cloud of steam in the chilled air and kicking one of its forward hooves as it did so. The body of the bull was covered in a light brown/tan fur, while the shoulders and head were darker in color, and thicker in length.
The bull then threw back its head, and released a deep yet high pitched bugle that echoed everywhere around them for miles. Then, as if answering its call as the bull turned to walk away, well over a hundred smaller cow and calf elk flooded out from the tree line as they made to follow the bull.
The boys were wide eyed as they gazed upon the herd of elk, while Alex then lifted Alec up alongside his brother so both of them could get a good look.
For several minutes the air was filled with the sound of the herd's thundering hooves as they followed the lead of their bull, with several of them turning back to look at the guys curiously before continuing on their way. Even as Artemis made the most of the rutting season, the vast majority of elk and other game animals have had minimal to no contact with people in Asora for their entire lives, so there was no fear in them whatsoever as they watched Alex and the boys.
When the last calf disappeared within the tree line, trotting along playfully behind its mother, Alex looked at the boys as he quietly asked,
"So, what did you think?" Regal was still stunned since he had never seen such a thing before, while Alec slowly uttered,
"That....was....AWSOME!"
Though Alex wanted to reprimand his son for being too loud, as he'd scare away any of the more skittish animals they might encounter, he decided to do so later so as not to ruin his excitement. Millicas and Gohan meanwhile were both still silent, as neither had ever seen such a sight themselves either.
While Millicas had grown up the heir of the Gremory family, and hadn't gone on many trips like this before in the past, Gohan actually lived in the mountains away from civilization all his life. Despite this though, he had never seen such a thing before since dinosaurs tended to rule the wilds, making it hard to find the smaller game like deer and elk.
Setting Alec on his shoulder alongside Regal, Alex placed a hand on the other two's shoulders as he began to silently lead them to their next destination.
***
"Good job out there today Kiwi, Apricot." A certain beautiful girl with long green hair said as she caressed the beaks of two Chocobos, who happily squawked back at her.
""KWEEE!""
The girl, Run Elsie Jewelria, smiled at their excitement as she fed them some of their favorite Gyshal Greens. She was the princess of the planet Memorze, and the 'childhood friend'(rival) of the despicable Lala after being subject to numerous troubles by the other princess when they were growing up.
Now however she was an idol of Asora, working under Ingvild while also not being a part of her peerage due to the fact that she wasn't truly good at combat. Someone who did however join Ingvild's peerage, was Run's best and closest friend who was currently in their shared dressing room, Kirisake Kyoko.
Kyoko was a Flamian/human hybrid that was born and raised on earth, who eventually went on to star in her own television show, Magical Kyouko. After the idol Run guest starred on her show as a new villain, they quickly became friends with Kyoko also appearing on stage with her numerous times to sing, just like she had tonight.
Now Kyoko once again had her own show under Serafall's network, and she even guest starred on Serafall's own show, Magical Girl Levia-tan, numerous times and vice versa.
Returning to her dressing room, Run found said Kyoko as she finished undressing and said,
"Thank you for joining me tonight, it was a lot of fun!" Run said excitedly, to which Kyoko replied with a smile,
"No problem. It's nice to get back on stage occasionally, and Kiwi and Apricot were both really cool, you did good work with them." Run puffed out her chest proudly at the praise, as she did work hard training the two Chocobos to appear with her during her performances, which they both also loved.
Even tonight, the duo had danced and used their abilities to create a spectacular show for her audience, like using the ability Meteor to create a star shower overhead. Meanwhile Kyoko had also used her fire powers from being half Flamian to also add numerous special effects to the show.
