As she trailed off, each of the instruments Marcarita summoned began to create a loud and jarring noise as they buffeted the duo before stopping suddenly after Edith clamped her hands over her ears.
"...they don't sound good." Marcarita said as she finished her earlier thought, before the instruments began playing themselves again a second later, but this time it was a much better sound as each one complimented the others.
Waving her hands like an orchestrator Marcarita smiled as she finished,
"However, if all of the instruments are playing in unison, then they can create a symphony that would amaze all who hear it. Your powers are the same, as if you can figure out how to properly draw out their full potential, and manage to mix them together in a proper manner instead of brute forcing it, then your strength will escalate like none other's."
...
Edith frowned as she recalled what Marcarita had taught her, as she hadn't been able to properly mix her powers like the Angel suggested. With her needing more power now though, Edith decided to try again even as the vortex surrounding Millicas began to die down.
"This looks interesting." The Grand Supreme Kai said as everyone watched Edith dispel her transformation as she closed her eyes to concentrate, while even Millicas watched her instead of taking advantage of this moment to take the victory for himself.
Edith of course ignored them all as she tried to attain the state Marcarita told her about. Instead of thinking about her Devil, Angel, Saiyan, and Dragon powers though, Edith imagined the same four instruments that Marcarita had used for her demonstration.
"What is she doing?" Alex asked out loud from their private viewing room, which Marcarita said from behind him,
"I believe she is trying to put what I taught her into use." Alex looked back at the Angel questioningly, but she only winked at him in response, before directing his attention back to the arena.
There, Edith was channeling her holy Angel powers as she pictured the harp playing in her mind, before she then added the cello to symbolize her Devil powers. At first the result was a turbulent mixing of the two opposing energies, but when Edith managed to mentally 'tune' the cello in her mind, the energies began to clam down before blending into a perfect synergy.
"I can't believe it!" Azazel exclaimed as he watched what was happening before him, but he wasn't the only one as Ajuka too appeared speechless.
The only actual case of someone successfully blending holy and demonic energies to date was Kiba after he achieved his Balance Breaker to create the holy/demonic sword, while every case of the union afterwards was due to research based off of his newly created sword. However now they were witnessing an actual person achieve the same thing, which was amazing even before the power of dragons was added into the mix.
As the drums in her mind synchronized with the harp and cello, Edith's power began skyrocketing as draconic energies became infused with the holy and demonic energies in her body, but she wasn't finished yet. Next was the tuba, which was the trickiest to deal with yet, but after stubbornly trying to get it to work, it too was synchronized with the other three instruments.
Though she still felt as if something was missing, these four 'instruments' was enough for Edith, as she opened her eyes to reveal a eerie violet light.
"HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!"
The little Saiyaness cried out as violet energies swirled around her into a vortex similar to the one Millicas had been hiding within earlier, except hers radiated holy and demonic power instead of the eerie mass of Destruction. Even Millicas was forced to retreat a few steps due to the potent holy energies that made his skin crawl, before the vortex began to fade to reveal the newly transformed Edith.
Her hair stood straight up on end like the typical SSJ transformation, except now it was violet to match the flames that covered her halo, while similarly colored scale patches appeared on her arms and one of her cheeks.
"RAAAAAAAA!"
Edith cried out as she rushed forward once the transformation was complete, sinking her little fist into Millicas' stomach before he had the chance to defend himself, before she followed it with an axe kick that sent him into the stage beneath them.
"Ok, that's new." Alex stated as he admired Edith's new form, especially since there hadn't been a purple haired Saiyan form before. He then turned his attention to Marcarita and asked,
"So what exactly did you teach her?" The Angel smiled as she explained,
"I taught her to try and combine her different powers into one to work together, instead of just forcing them all. I used a few different musical instruments to teach her what I meant about working together, like an orchestral symphony." Alex was silent for a moment as Edith swiftly turned the match to a complete reversal of earlier, where she now had Millicas on the ropes instead of the other way around, before uttering thoughtfully,
"So it's like a 'Super Saiyan Symphony' transformation(SSJS)?" Marcarita blinked as she thought about the name, before smiling as she replied,
"Yes, I think it's exactly like that."
Alex was silent at her confirmation as he watched Edith fight, wondering if any more of his children would also be able of achieving the SSJS with the variety of bloodlines they possessed.
Back in the arena, Millicas felt a cold sweat make its way down his back as he tried to stay ahead of Edith's dangerous attacks, even as the pain from the few hits he did take still hurt.
'Thankfully I started training my body more...' The young Gremory thought to himself as he flashed back to the hellish training he asked his mother to put him through, which toughened his body up so he wouldn't be glass cannon.
But even that training wouldn't help if he let Edith get another hit or two on him during their match, so he had to end it as quickly as possible.
Millicas resolved himself to become more ruthless even against Alex's daughter as he used one of the hidden weapons he had been saving for the finals, cornering himself on one side of the stage as Edith closed in on him, before using Spatial Magic to instantly teleport to the opposite side.
"I'm sorry about this Edith!" He stated sadly, before every single one of the magic circles he had created at the start of the match began to glow.
Edith had barely turned around and focused in on Millicas yet again, before the magic circles unleashed a hailstorm of reddish-black 'bullets' at her.
"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!"
Edith's cries of pain rang out as the literal wall of Destruction left her nowhere else to turn, before her body was assaulted by dozens of 'bullets' that erased anything they touched, be it her skin, muscle, veins, or even bone.
In an instant Alex was at the edge of the arena as he forcibly dispelled the barrage of Destruction, and took Edith's hole-filled body in his arms. Millicas had avoided her vital areas, like her head and chest, but her arms and legs especially looked more like bloody Swiss cheese by this point than actual limbs.
"Edith forfeits! Millicas wins!" Alex announced to the colosseum while hurriedly healing his daughter, which was deathly silent at the bloody and brutal display.
Though he too was stunned at what happened, the announcer coughed lightly before declaring,
"AND WE HAVE OUR FIRST FINALIST LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, MILLICAS GREMORY!"
Though at first no one knew how to react to the announcement, a few people began to slowly clap, before eventually genuine applause began to shower him as it became apparent that Edith was ok after Alex healed her. In fact, the only one who still appeared hesitant was Millicas himself, who uttered to Alex's retreating figure,
"Alex...I...I..."
"You don't need to say anything." Alex cut him off suddenly, making Millicas gulp and sweat anxiously, before Alex turned around and continued,
"This is a tournament Millicas. Nothing you did violated the rules, and it was Edith herself who wanted to be in it. So don't you fucking dare apologize." His eyes hardened at that as he stated firmly, "Be a man and hold your head high and proud. You won, Edith lost. That's all there is to it."
Millicas was stunned at Alex's words, as he feared that maybe he had angered him due to how protective Alex was of his children. But seeing that wasn't the case, Millicas let out a sigh of relief and did exactly as Alex told him to.
He held his head high as the audience showered him with praise and cheers, before slowly leaving the stage to make way for the next match to determine who he would be facing in the finals.
"WASN'T THAT AN EXCITING MATCH? BUT THERES STILL MORE BEFORE WE GET TO THE LAST ONE LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, AND THIS ISN'T EVEN THE MAIN EVENT!" Pausing for the cheers that answered him, the announcer then continued,
"AND NOW GIVE IT UP FOR OUR OTHER SEMIFINALISTS, ALEC MORNINGSTAR AND SON GOHAAAAAAAAAAAN!"
The cheers that followed Millicas' exit from the stage were practically deafening as the two whose names were called made their way into the arena. One of them stopped however as he passed his father and older sister, and said with a cheeky smile,
"Don't worry Edith. I'll beat up Gohan and then Millicas for you in the finals!" Edith returned a small smile at her little brother as she said,
"I'll cheer for you Alec." Striking a pose for his older sister, Alec then left her and his father behind as he rushed out onto the stage, missing the part where tears began to fill Edith's eyes.
"Sob...hic...." Edith began to sniffle in her father's arms, drawing his concern as Alex urgently asked,
"What's wrong Edith?! Does it still hurt somewhat ere?!" Checking her over for any injuries he might've missed, Alex was surprised when Edith sobbed,
"N-no.. I-it doesn't h-hurt d-daddy..... I-I'm j-just sad that I lost!" As she declared that the waterworks truly began as Edith came to terms with the first ever real loss she ever had.
Realizing what was wrong, Alex smiled wryly as he held his daughter closer, allowing her to cling to his fur like a little blonde koala as he watched the next match.
On stage Alec was excitedly getting ready for the match, while Gohan was doing the same across from him. As the duo stretched and got ready for their match though, the announcer cried out above them,
"A BIT OF TRIVIA FOR THOSE WHO AREN'T AWARE! AS MANY OF YOU KNOW ALEC IS THE OLDEST SON OF NONE OTHER THAN THE DRAGON EMPEROR THAT CREATED AND IS HOSTING THIS GREAT TOURNAMENT, BUT! HOW MANY OF YOU ARE ALSO AWARE THAT SON GOHAN IS THE THE FIRSTBORN SON OF A PREVIOUS CHAMPION OF THE WORLD MARTIAL ARTS TOURNAMENT ON EARTH? SON GOKU!"
As the projections showed Goku alongside his son, who many of the people recognized from the few seeded people that already had a place in the tournament, there was a mild uproar as they discussed this news in surprise. There were even many amongst them that thought this particular matchup should have been the finals instead.
Their musings were interrupted though when the announcer cried out,
"ALRIGHT THEN, FIGHTERS READY?!"
Both boys nodded as they got into their respective stances, to which he cried out,
"LET THE MATCH BEGIN!!!!!!"
Again there was no immediate rush as both boys instead activated their respective SSJ transformations, Gohan directly into SSJ2, while Alec was merely in the base SSJ. Unlike Gohan though, Alec also possessed patches of golden dragon scales, claws, and a pair of antler-like horns poking up from within his golden hair.
Surprising his opponent though was the Phoenix flames that sprung to life along Alec's arms and around his hands, leftovers from his match against Regal.
Gohan wasn't daunted by them though, as he and Alec rushed each other at the exact same moment. When Alec leaped to deliver a powerful axe kick at Gohan's head, the older Saiyan used his superior speed to dodge it as he instead swung his own leg at Alex's exposed chest.
"Ga!"
Alec spat up blood as he was sent flying back to the edge of the stage, where he had to balance precariously while trying not to fall out. Before he could get away from the edge though, Alec had to put his guard up as Gohan rushed him to try and force him out of the ring.
Dragonfying his feet as well to dig the claws down there into the stage, Alec crossed his arms in front of his chest and inhaled as Gohan delivered a punch directly into them.
"!!!"
With the hit forcing the air from his lungs, Alec added a bit of something extra to it as he proceeded to breath Phoenix/draconic flames out directly into Gohan's face, forcing the older Saiyan back.
Being forced to take a distance from the extreme heat of the fire, Gohan swiftly placed both of his hands above his head with the base of the palms together, and shouted, "MASENKO!"
Thrusting his hands forward as he cried out the name of his attack, a powerful beam of yellow energy was fired at Alec from a distance, but the younger Saiyan smirked when he saw the attack rushing towards him.
His claws raised to receive the attack, Alec rushed towards it as he caught the energy in them and tried to hold it even as Gohan continued firing the beam, before opening his mouth and taking a bite.
"AND HERE WE SEE THE POWER OF THE OMNI SLAYER ONCE AGAIN!" The announcer cried out, before shuddering as the sudden chill he felt as Zeno looked at him. Not sure what it was though, he continued,
"FIRST IT WAS PHOENIX FIRE, AND NOW IT IS RAW ENERGY! IS THERE ANYTHING THIS YOUNG MAN CAN'T EAT?!"
Anne smirked at the question, and internally recalled the time Alec ate an actual rock to gain stone properties, before turning her attention back to the match as Gohan swiftly canceled his attack.
The damage was done though as Alec sucked the last little bit of energy Gohan used down his gullet, before swallowing the energy audibly and belching loudly.
"BRAAAAAAAAP! That was gooooooood!" Alec exclaimed while patting his belly in satisfaction, before something happened.
*THUMP!*
His entire body pulsed as the energy coursed through him and began to surge.
"HAAAAAAAAAA!!!"
Alec began crying out from the amount of energy his body was trying to absorb, making several people worry that he'd literally bitten off more than he could chew. At the edge of the arena Edith looked up from Alex's chest as the two of them watched what was happening to Alec, the latter preparing to intervene and end the match if he needed to.
However, something happened that none of them were expecting, as the golden energy around Alec began to surge in size and intensity.
"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!"
The little Saiyan screamed as his energy surged higher than it ever had before, his golden hair growing longer and more wild, while a single strand of it fell in front of his face. Meanwhile the patches of scales covering parts of Alec's body began to spread until they were twice as big, while the antlers on top of his head grew even longer.
There was a collective dropping of jaws as it became apparent what was happening to Alec, while Anne even leapt up from her seat with an ecstatic expression on her face.
"I-IS THIS WHAT I THINK IT IS!?!" The announcer asked as Alec's transformation neared its final stages, to which Anne excitedly nodded as she stated,
"Yep! Alec is ascending to the SSJ2 form! Until now NONE of Alex's children have reached this stage!" There was an apparent smugness in the way Anne spoke, due to the pride she felt in her son's growth, though his ascension was mostly due to him eating Gohan's energy.
No one was going to say that though as Alec finally finished his transformation, with the energy rolling off of him in much more powerful waves than before as he faced his opponent with a almost feral grin.
"ALRIGHT! LETS GO GOHAN!" Alec cried out as he rushed forward at him with speed that he didn't possess before, as he brought a fist down onto the stage that Gohan had just barely managed to dodge as he ducked to the side.
*KABOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!*
The entire colosseum shuddered from the force of the impact, forcing Alex to deploy several barriers and magics to keep the battle contained even as he grinned like an idiot from the sudden development.
"No fair!" Edith cried out in indignation from her little brother getting SSJ2 before she did, making Alex chuckle as he remarked,
"You're one to talk with that cool new transformation you used earlier." Alex punctuated his comment with a kiss on Edith's brow, however the little Saiyaness just pouted while feeling like her brother just one upped her with his own transformation.
Meanwhile Gohan felt stupid both for using an attack that Alec could 'eat', and letting him fully absorb it to manage the ascension to SSJ2, though then again the audience would probably be pretty angry if he interrupted the transformation.
Instead of focusing on his mistakes though, Gohan focused on winning the fight as he tried to come up with ways to win against Alec.
Normally he'd still feel confident since he attained SSJ2 months ago, and would be stronger than one who just got it a minute ago. In this case however Alec also used Dragon Slayer magic, which made his attacks significantly more destructive, and also made him much more durable due to his scales. Not to mention his claws and antlers.
The only edge Gohan had against Alec now was the many experiences he'd built up in actual battles ever since he was only five, and the fact that Alec was still unused to his newfound capabilities. The longer the fight dragged on however, the more time he would have to adapt.
'I need to finish this as soon as possible...' Gohan thought to himself as his mind raced for ways to defeat Alec, even as the younger Saiyan turned his attention towards him once again.
Pure energy gathered on Alec's hands even as he took in a deep breath, before releasing it in a powerful beam of energy that swept across the stage as Gohan leapt above it. That was a trap though as Alec quickly rushed him in the air with his claws at the ready, forcing Gohan to use his energy to launch himself forward since they couldn't fly during the match for fairness.
*CRASH!*
The duo collided in air as Alec lashed out at Gohan with his claws, while Gohan tried to angle his body so that he could avoid the deadly claws while delivering a powerful kick right into Alec's stomach.
Gohan then used Alec as a springboard as he tried to launch himself back into the stage, while sending Alec out of bounds. Instead though he felt something tug on his leg to keep him from moving, which was Alec's tail as the younger Saiyan smirked.
Together they began falling back towards the ground, increasing Gohan's franticness as he tried to escape Alec's grip, before he decide to throw his hands up above his head a second time.
"MASENKO!" Gohan cried out as he fired a second powerful beam of energy at Alec, confusing many people since Alec could just eat this one as well to become even stronger.
But as Alec predictably caught the beam of energy at point blank range, and Gohan continued firing it, the power of it forcing Alec's tail to release Gohan's leg as they were sent flying apart from one another. With no way to stop his momentum though, Gohan aimed the beam so that it carried Alec directly out of bounds, making him lose the match as he canceled the attack and landed safely on the stage.
"AND WE HAVE OUR SECOND FINALIST EVERYONE! SON GOHAN!"
The announcer cried out as the audience screamed their excitement from the match, and Alec tried to figure out what just happened. Gohan however just smiled as he canceled his transformation and approached Alec, his hand held out as he said,
"Hey Alec, good match!" The younger Saiyan looked up at him as the realization that he lost dawned on him, but instead of appearing disheartened Alec smirked as he too canceled his transformation and said while taking Gohan's offered hand,
"Yeah it was! But I won't lose next time!"
Nodding in affirmation, Gohan and Alec began to leave the arena as the announcer cried out,
"HOW EXCITING LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! AND ITS NOT OVER YET! AFTER A THIRTY MINUTE BREAK TO GIVE OUR FINALISTS A CHANCE TO CATCH THEIR BREATH, JOIN US HERE ONCE AGAIN FOR OUR FINAL MATCH, IN THE JUNIOR CUP OF THE UNIVERSAL GRAND TOURNAMENT!"

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - 476: Gohan vs Millicas
chapters.content:
Though many of the audience members wanted to complain about the thirty minute intermission before the final fight, their full bladders and empty bellies silenced such opinions as they hurried to finish their business before the time was up.
But as they crowded the corridors under the stands, many of the spectators were filled with awe as they suddenly found themselves face-to-face with the Dragon Emperor himself.
"Daddy! Can I have some candy?" Edith asked in a cutesy voice from her position in Alex's arms, to which the doting father readily answered,
"Of course you can! Here's some cotton candy, licorice sticks, 'every flavor jelly beans', and kettle corn!" Instead of going through the long lines, Alex just waved his free hand as the selected merchandise disappeared from the respective stalls, and reappeared in front of Edith. The vendors of the various stalls didn't complain though, as Alex left a very generous amount of money in place of the items he took, much more than they were charging for them.
Meanwhile Alec, who was walking alongside his father and Edith, grinned in satisfaction as he rubbed his belly while recalling the taste of Gohan's Masenko attack. His satisfied expression quickly became strained though, when people noticed their presence and quickly surrounded them.
"Ara ara."
"Oh my god! You're so cute!"
"I could just eat you up! Yes I can!"
"You're exactly the same age as my daughter! Should I introduce you to her?"
Alec immediately found himself surrounded by women from all over the universe as they cooed and fawned over him, before one of the more daring among them actually pulled him face first into her breasts, smothering him in their softness.
Alex and Edith were in no different circumstances though, as many of their admirers surrounded them, the women pressing themselves up against Alex, feeling his muscles, and running their fingers through his fur while also trying to fawn over Edith. The little girl didn't care for their attention though, as she glared at the surrounding women that dared tried to steal the attention of her daddy.
But soon her glare turned into a smirk as two certain figures approached them, both of whom were radiating an intense killing intent when they saw the scene.
"And what....do we have here?" Gabriel asked with a smile that didn't reach her eyes, while Anne said next to her,
"It appears that a pack of tramps are harassing our husband and children Gabriel." As she spoke, the killing intent radiated by Gabriel and Anne spiked to an all time high as the shadowy figures of a dragon and biblically accurate Angel behind them.
The crowds of fans quickly scattered in the face of the two demonic(lol) women, leaving Alex chuckling at their expanse while Alec and Edith both cried out,
"Mama!"
"Mom!"
Alec readily ran into his mother's arms and buried his face into her breasts, having long since concluded that there was no better pillow, while Edith waited for her mother to approach them before scrunching up her face in contention as she patted her head.
"You did well Edith." Gabriel told her warmly, while also trying not to recall the image of her daughter riddled with holes from Millicas' use of Destruction. Anne meanwhile hugged her son tightly as she said,
"To think, my little Alec was the first to reach SSJ2!" Though Edith pouted when she heard that, Alec smiled widely and posed proudly as he said,
"Haha! I AM the omni slayer after all!" Alex smiled wryly as he ruffled his son's head, opting not to tell him about how Zeno didn't seem too thrilled about him calling himself such, as it sounded like he wanted to slay the Omni King. Instead, he did tell him,
"We'll have to see if you can still do it during training tonight, since you managed to make the transformation due to eating Gohan's energy blast." Alec pouted this time when he heard that, though Alex secretly felt that he didn't have anything to worry about.
Even though he couldn't make the transformation yet before eating Gohan's energy, and normally it would only be a temporary power up, Saiyans were quite literally built different. It was far more likely than not that Alec's Saiyan cells would recall the levels of power he previously achieved, and would allow him to make the transformation regularly with a little bit of training.
Meanwhile, a certain someone who was watching the interaction between the mothers, father, and their children, clenched his fist in frustration.
'What was it all for...?' Vegeta questioned within his mind, recalling the last several months of hardship he'd gone through.
Ever since he was born, Vegeta had possessed an amazing talent and potential amongst the Saiyan race, a talent that had gone unmatched amongst his kind up until that fateful day that he traveled to an insignificant planet known as earth. Then he encountered the freak of nature known as Kakarot, his half breed son, and the mysterious anomaly called Grant.
From there Vegeta had experienced impossible battles one after another, all while strengthening himself in order to keep up with Kakarot, until he too managed to become a Super Saiyan. But then the greatest freak of all appeared, Alexander Morningstar.
The man was everything Vegeta believed Saiyans shouldn't be, yet he was more powerful than any of them ever thought was possible. But then Vegeta pushed him too far, and for the first time in his life he was stripped of his strength and power.
That was the first Vegeta experienced true struggle, as in the wilds of Pangea he fought for survival day after day with less strength than he'd ever possessed before. Forced to fight with his all just for survival, Vegeta experienced growth like he never had before, along with a newfound appreciation for what he had.
Then came that fateful night, when the full moon arrived on Pangea for the first time.
Apparently Alex didn't take THAT into consideration when he sealed Vegeta's strength and power, and after the transformation wore off the next morning the seals were undone, and Vegeta felt more strength in his body than he ever had before. Within a matter of days after recovering his strength, he managed to pull off the transition into the SSJ2 for the first time.
Spending the rest of his time training his transformation and strength, Vegeta returned to the tournament with a feeling of triumph at his progress. But all of his effort meant nothing when Vegeta witnessed a mere CHILD manage to make the SSJ2 transformation right before his eyes, a boy young enough that he still smelled of his mother's milk.
While the old Vegeta would curse the brat and rage at the unfairness, the current Vegeta had matured a fair bit during his isolation and struggle. Instead, he turned on his heel and made to find some place to train himself so as not to fall behind.
"Going somewhere?" A voice suddenly said while a hand firmly grasped his shoulder, making Vegeta whirl around to find himself face-to-face with Alex.
"What do you want?" Vegeta demanded instead as he shrugged off Alex's hand, though Alex could tell that the same rage that once fueled him was there no longer.
Shrugging at the question, Alex replied, "I just thought that you would be interested in meeting someone who might help you become stronger."
Vegeta's eyes widened at the comment, before his fist clenched and he said in a resolute tone, "I'm not looking for a handout."
Alex just smirked at this as he stated,
"Oh it's not a handout. You'll be working your ass harder than you ever have in your entire life. Come on." Without another word Alex turned and left along with his two wives and children, leaving Vegeta to determine wether or not to follow along.
After a moment of thought, the former Prince quickly followed after Alex and his family, all the way back to their private viewing room. There he quickly drew everyone's attention, but they dismissed him just as quickly when the gathered gods, Angels, and women decided he wasn't worth their time. At least, until Alex called out to a certain duo,
"Whis, Beerus, heres someone who I think would benefit greatly from any training you might offer." The duo looked Vegeta up and down with a look of appraisal, before Beerus stated,
"Eh, he's alright....for a mortal. But I don't see the appeal of bothering to train him." Beerus replied dismissively as he looked away, though Whis remarked with a playful smirk,
"Now now lord Beerus, I think that young Vegeta here would make an excellent playmate for you." Beerus narrowed his eyes dangerously at that, as he practically snarled,
"Are you patronizing me Whis?"
Though the Angel was about to assure his lord that that wasn't the case, he was cut off as another God of Destruction, one who's appearance resembled a clown, stated plainly,
"Well it wouldn't matter anyways even if you did train him Beerus." Beerus narrowed his eyes at the rival God, and asked him in a low voice,
"What do you mean by that, Belmond?" The clown smirked as he remarked plainly,
"Just that if THIS is the best that Universe Seven has to offer, then it'd be best to throw in the towel before the rest of us can have our own fighters participate in the next tournament." Though he wasn't speaking for them, the rest of the Gods of Destruction adopted smug looks as they mentally compared Vegeta to their own fighters, finding him severely lacking in terms of strength.
Vegeta snarled in irritation when he heard the god's insulting remarks, but before he could say or do anything, Beerus stood up suddenly as he stated,
"If you want to talk so much smack then I'm game! Come on Vegeta!" Beerus then began to lead Vegeta away to begin his training, no longer caring about appearances as he instead focused on wiping the smirks from their faces.
Before he could leave though, Kusu stopped them with her scepter held out, and offered them,
"If you'd like Beerus, since my lord was the one to suggest yourself and my brother training Vegeta to begin with, then I can send the two of you to a separate space within my scepter. Time will flow at a much faster pace, with roughly an entire earth year to a single day out here, and it is stocked with all sorts of delicious foods from Asora and it's connected world's."
Hearing that there was delicious foods that he'd never tried before, Beerus readily agreed to Kusu's offer while Whis said slyly,
"Perhaps I should be the one to train young Vegeta. After all, I think it's safe to say I'm the with the most patience between the two of us." Beerus however just snorted as he stated in accusatory tone,
"Don't lie to me Whis, you just want the delicious new treats all to yourself!" Whis covered his mouth as he gasped drastically, and declared with a wronged expression,
"I would never lord Beerus! I just simply want to ensure young Vegeta receives the best training possible!'" Beerus just snorted with obvious disbelief in Whis' words, but the impending argument was dissolved before it even began as Alex said to them,
"Then how about Whis trains Goku while Beerus trains Vegeta? If it's in the roll of the dice, they might even be able to fight one another in the tournament."
When they heard that both Beerus and Whis looked at each other, before smiling eerily.
"Then may the best 'God' win Whis!" Beerus said challengingly.
"Ohohohohoho! I believe you meant 'may the best ANGEL win' lord Beerus." The deal struck, the God of Destruction readily took his new charge into Kusu's scepter to begin training him, while Shia hesitantly asked Alex,
"Uh, what just happened?" The man just smirked as he replied,
"I do believe I just slingshotted Goku and Vegeta's development into hyper overdrive. This will be interesting." Alex's smirk slowly transitioned to a full on shit eating grin as he thought about how much stronger Goku and Vegeta would become during the duration of this tournament.
One unspoken rule in the Dragon Ball franchise was that ones growth would be slow going unless either there was an opponent that forced the main fighters to suddenly grow stronger, like Cell or Frieza, or they became aware of a new hurdle to overcome.
Already several members of the Dragon Team were showing greater levels of strength just a few months after Cell was defeated, than they did in over eight years when Majin Buu emerged. And while Goku had yet to ascend to SSJ3, his strength and mastery of SSJ2 were enough that all he needed was the correct trigger.
Alex figured that even if Goku couldn't find that trigger during his training with Whis, then he would during the tournament, and it was possible Vegeta might as well. And of course the sooner they attained the SSJ3, then the sooner they could transition up to the SSJ4 and beyond.
Shia however shuddered at the idea of more SSJ4s running around, and resolved herself to keep using Sala and Caulifla as stress relief when she needed it. Thankfully though her attention was brought back to the arena as the announcer cried out,
"AND WELCOME BACK EVERYONE, TO THE JUNIOR CUP OF THE UNIVERSAL GRAND TOURNAMENT!"
Echoing cheers met his declaration as people rushed to return to their seats, not wanting to miss out on any of the action. As they did, both of the finalists also made their way out onto the stage at the center of the arena, both of which had been refreshed to tip top shape after their previous fights.
"AND NOW PRESENTING OUT TWO FINALISTS, SON GOHAN AND MILLICAS GREMORY!"
The cheers were deafening as Gohan and Millicas were projected throughout the colosseum, and the entire universe. Chief amongst those cheers were the screams of teenage girls who adored the two boys, with Millicas looking like the stereotypical pretty boy with his crimson red hair and fair features. Gohan meanwhile had let his hair grow out somewhat for the first time in his life, keeping it trimmed just enough to prevent it from going wild, and wore a purple gi matching the one Piccolo wore that showed off his muscular figure that didn't belong to a boy his age.
With one being the typical teenage heartthrob, and the other appealing to the women who were attracted to the 'wild' type, there were quite a few high pitched shrieks that lasted long after the rest of the cheers died down. And when they finally did, the announcer jokingly said,
"IT SOUNDS LIKE OUR TWO FINALISTS ARE PRETTY POPULAR WITH THE LADIES! HEY, THROW SOME OF THAT MY WAY!"
There were a wave of laughter at the announcer's expense due to his joke, and as they waited for it to die down Millicas suddenly said to his opponent,
"Gohan.....I plan to win." When he heard that Gohan fixed Millicas with an intense stare, before smiling as he replied,
"I'm looking forward to it Millicas!" In comparison to Millicas' seriousness though, Gohan seemed to be taking the current match lightly.
The two were actually quite close in the Academy, and had even sparred against one another several times by now. This meant that both of them knew what the other was capable of better than almost anyone.
Despite seeing Millicas' power of Destruction up close and personal though, as well as how good he was at controlling it, Gohan didn't seem concerned at all. After all, he had never lost a single match between himself and Millicas.
The two boys squared up as they awaited the start of the match, which only came when the laughter of the crowds died down in the face of the serious atmosphere.
"FINALISTS READY FOR THE FINAL BOUT?" The announcer asked to ensure they had everyone's undivided attention, before declaring,
"BEGIIIIIIIIIN!"
*WHOOSH!*
As was the case with the rest of the previous matches, Gohan began by swiftly transitioning into his SSJ2 form, before rushing Millicas at his top speed.
'That's what I expected though...' Was all Millicas thought, as in all of their matches Gohan had never changed his approach.
That was why the young Saiyan was surprised when Millicas suddenly disappeared, confusing him for a split second before his instincts screamed at him to dodge. But, even when Gohan leapt to his right, he felt an almost unbearable pain on his left arm that was followed by the sound of something hitting the ground.
"I-I CAN'T BELIEVE THIS FOLKS!"
The announcer cried out in disbelief while the cheers went silent, and Gohan instinctively grabbed at his left arm with his right hand, but grasped nothing.
"CONTESTANT MILLICAS HAD COATED HIS OWN HAND IN THE POWER OF DESTRUCTION, AND USED IT TO CUT OFF CONTESTANT GOHAN'S ARM!"
"GRAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!" Gohan cried out both from the pain and realization that he had actually lost an arm, distracting him from Millicas disappearing yet again before he came at him from the other side.
"!!!"
Gohan just barely managed to twist his body to face Millicas as he leapt back, now somewhat fearful of the hand covered in the sinister reddish-black power of Destruction. He didn't go only on the defensive though, as Gohan then followed up by spinning while bringing his foot up in a wide kick.
"Guh!" Millicas groaned as the powerful kick impacted him, but instead of sending him flying like Gohan expected, Millicas only slid a few feet before he disappeared yet again.
This time though Gohan was prepared for it as he instinctively leapt back and turned to face his blind side, only to see nothing as Millicas wasn't there. Instead, Gohan was surprised yet again when a fist connected with his face that carried traces of the power of Destruction, making him reel back in pain as a part of his cheek was erased.
Thankfully though Millicas had restrained his power of Destruction so that it did minimal damage to Gohan's face, as his goal was to win the fight, not to kill his friend.
"How come you've never fought like this before Millicas?" Gohan asked him suddenly as he alternated between cradling his bleeding stump, and the missing flesh of his cheek.
Millicas, who was breathing heavily from the drain of fighting in such a way, told him,
"It's a fighting style I developed just for you." Gohan wasn't the only one surprised at Millicas' answer when he heard it, as no one was expecting that. Millicas however continued,
"You taught me my shortcomings that I hadn't learned while fighting alongside my peerage, namely my low physical capabilities. They act as my shield when we fight together, but when it's me by myself I turn into a glass cannon. So I developed an alternate way to fight to use against people like you who could beat me before I fire off a single spell."
As he trailed off, Millicas tossed away his top to reveal a muscular figure that, while not as impressive as Gohan's, still surprised many of the spectators as he took a martial stance with light flashes of Destruction radiating from his arms and hands.
Seeing the look in Millicas' eyes, and how much he prepared for this match, Gohan couldn't help but to chastise himself as he realized his folly. He'd regarded this match lightly due to how often he'd won against Millicas in their spars, whereas Millicas had used each and every loss he suffered from him to learn and adapt his fighting style.
Clenching his fist at his side, Gohan looked up at Millicas and took a stance as he declared,
"Let's settle this then!"
With Millicas nodding in agreement, Gohan moved his sole arm to that his hand was pointed in front of him with an open palm, while Millicas mirrored his arms into a matching position in front of him.
"KA ME-"
Gohan began as he drew his hand back and began gathering as much energy as he could into it, while Millicas did the same with the power of Destruction instead of energy.
"-HA ME-"
The two attacks grew even larger and more powerful as the two boys poured every single ounce of energy they could into them, Gohan's shining brightly like a miniature sun, while Millicas' seemed to draw in any light around it.
"-HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!"
Gohan cried out as the two released their respective attacks at the exact same moment, which then collided in the space directly between them as they began a battle for supremacy between the bright energy, and dark Destruction.
"AAAAAAAAAAAH!!!" Gohan cried as he poured every single drop of power he possessed into his attack, trying as hard as he could to overwhelm Millicas' power of Destruction.
"..." Millicas on the other hand was completely silent as he poured as much Demonic energy as he could into his attack, willing it to erase every single bit of Gohan's attack as he continued firing it.
Typically there would be no way Millicas could go head to head with a SSJ2 in terms of a power struggle, but with the earlier injuries he dealt Gohan taking their toll, and him erasing Gohan's Kamehameha instead of actually fighting it, he was managing for the moment somehow. However with each passing second it was becoming increasingly obvious that he'd run out of power first.
"HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!" Millicas suddenly cried out as the power of Destruction began to radiate from every inch of his body, as if it were oozing out of his pores themselves and his skin began to turn red.
"W-WHAT IS THIS!?! LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, IT APPEARS THAT MILLICAS GREMORY HAS BEGUN TO TRANSFORM!"
The announcer cried out as Millicas' figure grew slightly larger, while horns sprouted from his head, and his skin turned blood red. Curiously enough though, his hair also began to turn silver during the transformation, though hardly anyone was paying attention to that at the moment.
The reason was because the power of Destruction began to pour off of Millicas' body in thick suffocating waves, which were slowly but surely eating away the stage around him to further limit the area that he and Gohan could fight. But that didn't matter as his attack increased in intensity as he slowly began to overwhelm Gohan's Kamehameha.
Seeing this, Gohan gritted his teeth as he made to stepped forwards towards the point where the two attacks had collided, all while yelling as loudly as he can to follow Saiyan rule number one, 'when in doubt, shout it out'.
Millicas, now looking completely demonic in his Super Devil form, responded similarly as he growled menacingly, and stepped forward to match Gohan. The closer the two got though, the more intense the collision was as arcs of Gohan's energy struck their surroundings like bolts of lightning, while more and more of Millicas' surroundings was becoming erased as his power of Destruction continued to increase.
The standoff continued until Gohan and Millicas were right in front of one another, firing their respective attacks from point blank range, until,
*KABOOOOOOOOM!!!*
The volatile energies exploded outwards and kicked up a cloud of dust and smoke that covered the entire stage, veiling the two contestants from view.
"DOES ANYONE SEE ANYTHING? WHAT IS GOING ON?"
The announcer cried out, giving voice to the thoughts on everybody's minds as they desperately tried to see through the smoke and dust, before Anne used her control over the winds to clear it away, revealing the scene below them.
"I-I CAN'T BELIEVE IT LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! OUR WINNER OF THE JUNIOR CUP IS, MILLICAS GREMORY!"

chapters.title: Chapter 477 - 477: The Roster is Announced
chapters.content:
"I-I CAN'T BELIEVE IT LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! OUR WINNER OF THE JUNIOR CUP IS, MILLICAS GREMORY!"
As those words rang out, the ones declaring the victor in this match, the crowds cheered the loudest they had gone yet as the cleared dust and smoke showed them the scene below.
Millicas, who had been blasted back by the explosion was nursing several injuries and had barely managed to avoid being knocked off of the stage. Gohan on the other hand had gotten the brunt of the Destruction of the explosion, and along with his arm and cheek, he had also lost a leg while chunks of his flesh had also been erased from his body, resulting in a slowly expanding pool of blood.
With the former being the only one capable of standing though, he had been declared the winner while Gohan had lost.
With the declaration though, all of Millicas and Gohan's wounds began regenerating with even the latter's arm and leg being restored like nothing had happened to him.
Sitting up, Gohan looked towards Millicas to see the young Gremory approaching him with a wry smile as he offered a hand and said,
"Good fight Gohan! Better luck next time." Gohan just looked at the offered hand for a moment, before issuing a wry smile himself and saying as he grasped it,
"Yeah it was. You taught me something important Millicas, I won't lose next time." Millicas nodded in affirmation as he pulled Gohan up to his feet, making the crowd go nuts as they watched this, and the announcer cried out,
"AND WHAT A GOOD SHOW OF SPORTSMANSHIP THIS IS LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! LETS GIVE THEM AN EXTRA LOUD ROUND OF APPLAUSE!"
Somehow the applause grew even louder then, as people stood in their seats and cheered on their winner and runner up. Meanwhile, up in their viewing room, Rias and Grayfia were both ecstatic at seeing Millicas win the Junior Cup.
"I'm so proud of him!" Rias exclaimed happily as she held Ryuto up to ensure he could see his cousin down below, while Grayfia stepped up next to her and added,
"He has improved so much..." She was so overwhelmed with emotion, that the usually stoic and professional maid broke character as she watched her son celebrate his triumph over Gohan.
"I still can't believe Millicas managed to beat a SSJ2 though..." Shia uttered as she watched him from beside Rias and Grayfia, earning her a look from the two as she said so. Alex was silent however as he stood up to make his way down to congratulate Millicas on his victory.
He had somewhat expected this outcome based off of Gohan's track record when it came to the serious fights he'd fought in the Dragon Ball series. Twice he'd gone to end the main antagonist at the time once and for all, Cell and Majin Buu, but both times he ended up blowing it due to over confidence.
While Gohan did end up defeating Cell in the original timeline, it was only after Goku had to sacrifice himself, and Cell returned from his supposed self destruction stronger than ever. With this loss, and through training and learning at the Academy, Alex hoped Gohan would break this bad habit before it truly came back to bite him in the ass in the future.
This wasn't the time to focus on that though.
Alex teleported himself down directly into the middle of the arena next to Millicas, grasping the young man's arm and throwing it upwards while crying out,
"AND NOW WE HAVE OUR FIRST OF TWO CHAMPIONS! MILLICAS GREMORY!"
The cheers that had begun dying down were quickly reignited, and grew even louder when Alex conjured a great trophy cup out of mid air, presenting it to Millicas as he said,
"PRESENTING THE PRIZE FOR WINNING THE JUNIOR CUP! A CUP FULL OF PRECIOUS METALS AND GEMS, AS WELL AS THE TITLE OF STRONGEST YOUTH IN THE ENTIRE UNIVERSE!"
Accepting the cup from Alex, and being careful not to spill any of the gold and gems in it, Millicas hoisted the cup up in triumph as he celebrated his victory. Meanwhile Gohan, as the runner up, got nothing, leaving him to trudge off stage as people cheered for their champion.
Gohan understood where he had gone wrong in the match. He believed that since his opponent was Millicas, who'd he'd beaten every time they sparred, that he would win this time too, and hadn't taken the match as seriously as he should have. Knowing this, a bitter feeling welled up within Gohan at how he had lost, which only increased when he saw his father waiting for him in the corridor leading away from the arena.
*Sniff*"I lost..." Gohan said plainly as he wiped away the tears that had begun forming at the corners of his eyes, though Goku showed no disappointment at the momentary sign of weakness. Instead, he smiled warmly at his son as he said,
"I know." Though Gohan wanted to comment about his father's bluntness, he didn't get a chance as Goku clapped him on the back and continued, "Don't worry about it though since all you can do is get better for the next tournament! It took me three tries before winning my first tournament!"
Gohan looked up sharply at that, as he asked incredulously,
"Really?!" Goku nodded as he recalled fondly,
"Yep! In my first tournament I lost to an old guy who was REALLY strong and skilled, he could even use the Kamehameha! Then in my second tournament, I got a ring out just barely before Tien did in the finals. I only won a tournament after being trained by Kami for a few years, and then finally winning against Piccolo when he was still bad." Gohan was silent as he absorbed this, before a goofy grin formed on his face.
So he ended up losing his first tournament just like his dad huh?
Something about that cheered Gohan up tremendously as he walked alongside his father down the corridor away from the arena. But as he started thinking about the next tournament, and what he wanted to do after this, Gohan finally decided something as he said suddenly,
"Dad. I'm going to get my own peerage, and become a great warrior and leader in Asora." Goku glanced down at his son curiously at his sudden declaration, before smiling widely and ruffling his hair as he said,
"Whatever you want to do, I'll support you all the way!" Gohan smiled as he got his dad's acceptance, even if he didn't quite know what a peerage was or anything. But before Gohan could explain a bit of what it all was, a certain figure approached them with a bundle in her arms.
"Grandma..." Gohan uttered as Gine approached them with a smile on her face, though he was still unused to calling her as such because he didn't have a grandmother growing up. Plus her and his grandpa Bardock were both closer to his parents in age, to the point where the father and son duo would often be confused for brothers by strangers due to how similar they appeared.
But whatever else he was about to say was caught in Gohan's throat, as Gine got closer and he could see that the bundle in her arms contained a mini Goku.
"I'm so proud of you Gohan." Gine said as she pulled him into a one armed hug, but Gohan's attention was on the baby in her other arm as Goku said,
"That's your baby brother, Goten. He was born a few months ago when your mom went into a space-time thingy to speed up her pregnancy. Little guy looks just like me, doesn't he?" Saying the last part with pride, Goku offered a finger to the little Saiyan that was wrapped in blankets, who gripped it with more strength than what a baby should have, and giggled happily at his family.
Gohan was stunned silent as he realized that he'd been further out of touch with his family ever since going to the Academy than he'd thought. But then again, that was to be somewhat expected given how his mother reacted to his leaving.
Recalling her suddenly, and noticing she wasn't present, Gohan asked his father,
"Dad, where's mom?" Goku's expression cramped a bit when Gohan mentioned his mother, and even Gine had a hard time keeping a straight face at the mention of her daughter-in-law, but then as if to answer his question, Chichi's voice suddenly cried out from down the corridor,
"Gohan!" Everyone whirled to see Chichi slowly but surely making her way towards them, despite the numerous chains that were trying in vain to hold her down to several giant balls of metal that were slowly being dragged behind her.
"Gohan! It's ok, mom's here finally! Now let's go home together and you can resume your studying before it's too late! I'll save you from that horrible place!"
The three Saiyans stared at Chichi weirdly as they watched her slowly but steadily approach, before a new figure suddenly appeared before them, standing taller than them with blue skin and long white hair. They then turned toward Goku and said suddenly,
"Greetings Goku-San. I'm not sure if you remember me, but I'm the personal attendant of Lord Beerus, Whis." Goku nodded slowly at the Angel, keeping a fearful eye on Chichi's approach as he did so, and said,
"Yeah, I remember you. What do you want with me?" Whis smiled widely as he told Goku,
"I want to train you of course! I figured you'd want to watch your son's match, and so I waited until it was over to approach you. But now that's it's over, would you like to-"
"Yes! Let's go now!" Goku exclaimed as he clung to offered lifeline, as he definitely didn't want to deal with the current Chichi, even though he wasn't the one who chained her up to keep her from interfering in Gohan's matches.
"DON'T YOU DARE GOKU!" Chichi snarled as she pulled on her chains to try and speed up, but neither Whis nor Goku listened to her as he hurriedly said,
"Anyways, good fight son and better luck next time! By mom, take care! And I'll see you later Chichi!"
"GOKUUUUUUUUU!" Chichi roared as he and Whis vanished, the latter teleporting them both directly into Vados' scepter to begin their training under a similar time dilation as Beerus and Vegeta.
"U-um.... I think they're calling me back out there! I got to go now! Talk to you later grandma, Goten! Bye!" And like that, Gohan followed his father's example as he too hurried away from his mother, leaving Gine to deal with her even as Chichi cried out,
"WAIT GOHAN! COME BACK! GOHANNNNNNNNNNNN!"
***
Back out in the center of the arena, after celebrating Millicas' victory and presenting him with his prizes, Alex raised his hand and gestured for quiet, which swiftly descended upon the colosseum in response to him.
"Now then..." He began in a quiet voice that still reached every corner of the universe.
"You've now had a taste of what's to come in the tournament, but I guarantee that there are even better fights to come in the next several days!"
The buzz of talk started up once again as people began discussing the upcoming battles with excitement after seeing what the mere children of Asora were capable of, until Alex indicated for silence once again. When he had it, Alex continued,
"And during the Junior Cup we were not idle, as the preliminaries between thousands of contestants occurred during that time in a separate space! Indeed, maybe some of you watched those battles as well as the Junior Cup', but now that the children have had their share of fame, maybe it's time we started the main event!"
This time cheers greeted Alex's declaration as thousands of people suddenly began flooding out from within the space-time orb, which had been controlled specifically so that the preliminaries within ended at the same time as the Junior Cup. Now they had their other fifty four contestants, and it was time announce who they were.
"PRESENTING OUR CONTESTANTS, OF THE FIRST EVER UNIVERSAL GRAND TOURNAMENT!"
Alex cried out, as the names and image of every single contestant were projected so they were seen throughout the entire colosseum, Asora, Earthland, Spira, the Underworld, Heaven, and Universe Seven.
***
1. Shia Haulia
2. Vali Lucifer
3. Sairaorg Bael
4. Nagumo Hajime
5. Grayfia Lucifuge
6. Pikkon
7. Son Goku
8. Vegeta Jr

10. King Cold

13. Gildarts Clive

16. Brigid
17. Moka Akashiya

23. Golden Darkness(Yami)
24. Tien Shinhan

27. Gajeel Redfox

31. Thor Odinson

58. Tio Klarus
59. Rana Linchen
60. Bova
61. Koneko Toujo
62. Cookie
63. Dulio Gesualdo
64. Gasper Vladi
***
As everyone took in the appearance of the contestants, Alex cried out,
"These are the few worthy individuals, chosen to participate out of the thousands of rivals spanning across not just Universe Seven, but also Asora and the other dimensions connected through her!"
As Alex paused people began murmuring and talking amongst themselves with various reactions to the revealed contestants.
Some were frustrated that no one from their own worlds were able to make it to the main tournament, while others grew excited seeing the faces of those who were going to compete. Then of course there were those already forming fan clubs and attractions towards certain individuals that were competing, primarily towards the numerous cute or hot girls that were being shown.
The biggest discussions of course though, were who everyone thought was going to win the entire tournament.
Naturally Alex didn't discourage betting or wagers on the results of the different fights, or who people thought were going to the finals. Instead he had actually encouraged it quite a bit since it made things more exciting, plus the betting stations were ran by his people, so there was absolutely no chances of foul play or scamming within them since Alex would severely punish anyone dumb enough to try under his nose.
But after giving them a moment to digest the entire list, Alex declared,
"And now that we have our sixty four contestants, I believe it is time to say goodnight, for now! For we will return in the morning, to determine who would be a part of our four brackets, and proceed to truly begin this great tournament with the first of our four displays of strength, skill, and sheer power!
"And so my dear guests! It is time I must say, GOODNIGHT!"
***
With that final declaration, the projections cut off and the people who currently lived on planet Cereal, the Sugarians, all began to happily disperse and discuss the tournament as they eagerly awaited the continuation of it the next day. All but one person in particular who clearly wasn't a Sugarian.
"B-Bardock is alive!" An elderly Namekian exclaimed as he recalled one of the names listed amongst the contestants, with the image that clearly showed his old friend along with someone who looked exactly like him. The X shaped scar on his cheek was unmistakable, but the Namekian couldn't help but wonder why it appeared as if Bardock hadn't even aged since that day thirty years ago.
But there was something worrisome about that list too, the fact that the Namekian had also noticed the name and face of the same young boy he'd been raising since the day the Saiyans wiped out the rest of his people, and the Heeters killed his mother.
Gripping his walking stick tightly, the Namekian approach one of the Sugarians and urgently told them,
"I need a ship to take me to Pangea as swiftly as possible!"
***
Back on Pangea, a certain short statured blue skinned individual made his way to the expensive hotel room reserved for him and his siblings, where his older brother told him to meet up with the rest of them after the preliminaries.
"I made the main roster brother." He declared as he entered the room, only to unexpectantly find it empty as he opened the door.
"Brother?" The man, Gas, called out hesitantly, before adding when he received no answer,
"Maki?! Oil?!" Again there was no answer, prompting Gas to turn on his heel as he slammed the door shut, and set out to discover what happened to his siblings.
***
*Meanwhile in the space-time orb*
"Haaaaa... Finally, relaxation...." Alex sighed in contention as he settled down in the veritable sea of softness that was the naked bodies of his wives and lovers.
Though there were a few wandering hands and fingers amongst the many naked bodies, there was nothing too risqué going on as they instead enjoyed each other's company, and relaxed while watching the various matches that took place during the Junior Cup, and preliminaries.
"Would you like a refreshment master?" Asked Alex's newest slave maid Maki, as she brought them a tray of drinks to choose from that Mikan and Haruna had made. Of course, she too was naked thanks to the teasing and provoking of some of Alex's other lovers.
"Not right now, thanks Maki. But I'm sure some of the girls would love one." With Alex passing up the drink, the tray was quickly cleared as several girls grabbed the one they wanted before turning their attention back to the projections just in time to see Akasha get shot by a contestant who tied to get through using guns.
"I bet that hurt Akasha." One of the girls said as they watched her take the guy out almost immediately after, before which the wound finally started closing since the match was over.
"Nah, I'm used to wounds even worse than that. It WAS a but different since it didn't start healing right away though." Akasha replied as she rubbed the spot where she got shot, which was in her right shoulder.
At that moment the projection changed to show Irina being knocked out by a SSJ2 Trunks, who then clicked her tongue in annoyance as she grumbled,
"All my training and I STILL can't beat even a SSJ2..." Xenovia smirked at her irritation as she said smugly,
"Maybe you should ask Hajime to make you a new sword or two to switch between. I mean, not all of us can have a weapon as powerful or versatile as Excalibur." As she said that, the scene changed to show Xenovia use the power of Excalibur Ruler to completely dominate her opponent by turning his own attacks against him, securing her place in the roster of the main tournament itself.
"Yeah!" Shia suddenly spoke up, drawing attention to herself as she pointed accusingly at Alex and said,
"We need an equalizer against the Saiyans! We all know they're practically just a bunch of dirty rotten cheaters in tournaments like this! Especially when you got Beerus and Whis to personally train two of them!" Though Alex, Sala, and Caulifla were all about to dismiss Shia's accusations, they were all instead surprised when the rest of the girls suddenly spoke up their agreement.
"I agree. With how adapted they are for battles, Saiyans might as well be living cheats when it comes to direct combat like in this tournament." Even Grayfia said suddenly, making Alex at a loss for words as he looked around at everyone questioningly.
While they had all long since accepted Alex's absurd strength and growth rate due to him being a living anomaly, as well as his children, they all quickly learned that wasn't quite the case when the Saiyans Alex had recruited in Universe Seven, and even those in Universe Six, all showed similar or even more extreme levels of growth ever since Alex stepped into the picture.
With nearly everyone in agreement about them, and the only ones in disagreement being the present Saiyans themselves, Alex shook his head as he asked out loud,
"Lauren, is there something in the shop that can help them?" Though he didn't need to ask Lauren out loud, Alex did so so that the girls would know he was talking to her about their concerns, and therefor taking them seriously as he searched for something to help them.
While Alex didn't get his hopes up about finding something for ALL of them, as if he DID buy them something in the shop he'd only be able to buy one thing at a time, he was surprised when Lauren replied after a few moments,
'There is something actually, though it'll take two store purchases so no one but you would even consider it. And even then, you wouldn't be able to profit off of it directly anyways, making them an even more unlikely purchase for others.'
His curiosity piqued, Alex looked over the store options Lauren pointed out to him, and widened his eyes slightly in surprise at what they were.
[Omniversal Chatroom: a special chat room that would be connected to the user's system, allowing them to chat with people even throughout all of Creation. Upgradable.]
[Omniversal Chatroom Upgrade: grants the users of the Chatroom special quests and missions to complete, and allows them access to the Chatroom's special store. NOTE! Participants of the Contest of Succession will have restricted access to the store function, and will only be able to purchase minor items.]
(A.N. I'll go more into detail about it later, but by 'minor' items I mean like Anne for example won't be able to buy new powers, but she'd be able to buy scrolls detailing different bending forms since she has Avatar powers, etc. Alex meanwhile would be able to buy manuals for different martial arts to learn, or further upgrades to the Chatroom. The chat store is mostly for Alex's wives and lovers to become stronger without having to entirely rely entirely on weapons, abilities, and power ups they'd receive directly from him. And NO, they won't have access to his system and 'Jobs' by joining the chat.)

chapters.title: Chapter 478 - 478: Omniversal Chatroom
chapters.content:

"HA!"
