Not only were the clothes part of different uniforms typically worn only by young girls, but they were also wearing or holding different accessories such as wands, cat ears, and automatic tails that disappeared into their skirts.
What Roshi saw next was the most traumatizing thing he'd ever seen in his entire life, as a random wind blew through the tunnel to display the contents of their skirts to him, making him regret seeing panties for the first time in his long life.
"Wow! Those are some tough looking girls!" Goku exclaimed as he watched them approach, to which Roshi roared back at him,
"WHAT PART OF THEM LOOKS LIKE A GIRL!?!" Goku however looked confusedly at the older looking man, and said as if it were obvious,
"They're wearing skirts and have their hair done up like girls, so they must be girls." Not just Roshi, but Tien, Yamcha, Krillin, and even Piccolo looked at Goku like he was an idiot, before Krillin stated,
"They're not girls Goku. They're guys who are wearing girl clothing!" Goku just looked at his oldest friends weirdly at that, before waving away Krillin's words as he responded,
"Why would guys wear girls clothes? That doesn't make any sense Krillin!" Dismissing his friend's claims about the true identity of the crowd approaching them, Goku was more interested in the intense pressure being exerted by them as they got ever closer.
"Nuhooooo! Is this darling old man Mil-Tan's opponent? He reminds Mil-Tan of her Grandpapa~Nyo!" The lead figure cried out in a girlish fashion, despite it's deep and booming voice.
"You better be careful Mil-Tan, you don't want to accidentally hurt him!" Cried another one of the things behind Mil-Tan, before the entire group turned about after seeing it off.
"Come on Grandpapa! It's time for our fight~Nyo!" Mil-Tan declared as it grabbed Roshi by the collar of his black gi with white trim, and dragged him out into the arena despite him looking like a standing corpse.
And as the duo made their appearance in the arena, the sound of confused applause met them as everyone got a good look at Mil-Tan for the first time, while even the announcer was stunned silent for a moment. Quickly recovering himself though, the announcer declared,
"LET'S HEAR IT FOR OUR TWO COMBATANTS LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!"
An awkward applause followed the declaration, which Mil-Tan seemed unaware of as it happily waved to what it believed were its adoring fans. The announcer cleared his throat as he watched them approach, before stating,
"AND NOW FOR THE ARENA THEY WILL BE FIGHTING ON!"
As he said that, the projection of the list of different fighting arenas grew larger so that everybody could see it, before the hundreds of selections began to light up one after another in rapid succession. When they finally began to slow down, everyone watched with bated breaths until the light finally came to a stop.
"THE RING ON THE WING!" The announcer cried out as the image of a massive whale with outstretched wings, who was dancing through the skies, appeared.
Like several of the arenas on the list, this one restricted flying so the entire fight would have to take place on the back of the large whale, even as it flew through the air at high speeds. Then, as if the high winds buffeting them wasn't enough, there was also the restriction that if either Mil-Tan or Jackie Chun fell off or were blasted too far away from the whale, they would be eliminated.
"NUHOOOOOOO! SUCH A CUTIE PIE!" Mil-Tan squealed when it saw the whale they would be fighting on, all while Roshi was desperately trying to get away from it's hold on his collar.
Despite his best efforts though, both of them are swiftly transported onto the back of the giant whale that was over a hundred and fifty feet long, with a wingspan that went even wider. And with the roar of the wind filling their ears as it threatened to tear them off of its back, Mil-Tan had to release Roshi's collar as the duo separated and braced themselves.
"FIGHTERS READY?" The announcer's booming voice asked as the duo took their respective stances, before declaring,
"FIIIIIIIIIIIIIIGHT!"
As the start of the fight was announced, a dangerous gleam appeared in Roshi's eye as he said to himself, "I must do my duty to this and all worlds by eliminating this 'thing' before it multiplies even more!"
His resolution made, Roshi made to charge Mil-Tan with everything he had, only to have most of his momentum stolen as the skin of the whale beneath him gave way to his foot.
'Damn!' Roshi swore in his mind at the realization, before the harsh winds took him as he leapt off of the whale's back, sending him directly at Mil-Tan at breakneck speeds out of his control.
'It's a pain, but I can work with this!' Roshi thought to himself as he angled himself mid-flight to make the best of his situation, while Mil-Tan prepared to intercept him.
"Sorry Grandpapa, but Mil-Tan intends to win~Nyo!" Mil-Tan exclaimed as it cocked its own hand back, before its eyes turned serious.
"Magical Friendship Punch!" Mil-Tan exclaimed as it swung its right fist out at Roshi's own attack.
Sensing danger from the relatively basic attack, Roshi immediately kicked and propelled himself to the side as the beefy fist rushed past him, and buried itself into the whale's back to create a bloody fountain.
"BUOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!" The whale bellowed in pain as its massive body shuddered, making Mil-Tan fret as it hurriedly pulled its fist free of the massive body and squealed,
"Mil-Tan is soooooooooooooo sorry Mister Whale!" As it apologized even Roshi couldn't help but feel sorry for the whale as it cried in pain, but unknown to them a disclaimer appeared at the bottom of the projection as a voice quickly said to everybody,
"NOTICE! No flying whales were harmed during the course of this match!"
Though the notice soothed some of those who were distraught at the whale's cries, they weren't quite convinced when they saw the blood gushing and pooling around the large wound. The two contenders were even less convinced without the notice as the blood began to spread in the high winds, and Mil-Tan declared,
"Mil-Tan needs to finish this quickly so Mister Whale wont get hurt anymore!" Saying so, Mil-Tan reached up the back of its skirt to grab something, with its hand coming away while holding a pink wand-like object with a heart shaped jewel on top.
"Behold the power of Mil-Tan's Dressphere! TRANSFORM!"
As it cried out, the jewel in the crown of the wand began to glow, before Mil-Tan's entire body began glowing with a magical light. Within the light the spectators noticed numerous changes forming on Mil-Tan's body, before the light shattered suddenly to reveal the new transformation.
If Mil-Tan looked revolting before, it was positively repulsive now with a shorter skirt, tighter crop top, and gaudier accessories that adorned its body like a large ribbon on its lower back. Thankfully the image of Mil-Tan's new outfit had been edited on the fly to prevent it from traumatizing the poor children and people who were watching the match, however Roshi had no such defense.
"BLAG!" Roshi gagged as he beheld Mil-Tan in all its 'glory', before blowing chunks all over the whale's back to go along with the blood, though that was censored too.
"Fighting in the name of magic, friendship, and justice! Presenting Magical Girl Mil-Tan!" The thing declared as it struck a 'cutesy' pose, though there was nothing cute about it.
And though Roshi once again threatened to blow chunks, he held it down as he readied himself to attack, already desperate to end the battle as soon as possible. As he retook his stance though, Mil-Tan waved its wand and produced numerous heart-shaped masses of energy.
"Magical Friendship Barrage!" Mil-Tan cried out, before each of the hearts shot at Roshi for an area of effect attack.
With his focus on Mil-Tan's attack instead of Mil-Tan itself though, Roshi was able to focus properly as he used the skills he'd cultivated over the course of several hundred years. Having long since developed a technique to counter the use of firearms, Roshi used the same principle to either cancel or redirect each one of the pink hearts that assaulted him.
His movements made Alex cock a brow, as they appeared similar in principle to the FFWCR that he had recently learned, though there were elements lacking as all Roshi did was redirect the threat while eliminating the offensive capabilities. The whale didn't think so though, as each of the redirected attacks impacted the whale's back, and created several more wounds that bled profusely.
"Oh no! Mister Whale!" Mil-Tan cried out in distress, before turning its attention to Roshi and stating, "Mister Whale is hurt because of you Grandpapa!"
Though the injuries to the whale were caused by its own attacks, Mil-Tan didn't seem to realize that as it tried to attack Roshi once more, only to slip on the blood that was now covering the majority of the arena.
"I see..." Roshi uttered in realization as he watched Mil-Tan slip and slide. "If we are careless with our attacks then it could come back to bite us in other ways by making it harder for us to fight."
Even as he said that, Roshi felt his footing grow even more unstable as the whale began to tilt to the side, a result of one of Mil-Tan's stray attacks hurting its wing as well.
"Time to end this!" Roshi declared as he flexed his body, turning his frail and elderly appearance to one of a person with hulking muscles that put even Mil-Tan to shame, before he put his hands together.
"KAAAAAAAA-"
As Roshi prepared his ultimate attack, the move he himself created so long ago, Mil-Tan similarly prepared to end it as it cried out, "Don't worry Mister Whale, Mil-Tan will finish this now so you can get better!"
Then, as if to answer Mil-Tan's declaration, the whale let out a long bellow that made its entire body vibrate intensely, which the magical thing took as affirmation. In actuality, it was more along the lines of the whale trying to tell Mil-Tan that it was only hurt because of it, and to get the fuck off of him.
Unaware of the whale's thoughts though, Mil-Tan readied it's fist as a soft pink glow began to surround it.
"MAGICAL-"
"-MEEEEEEEEEEE-"
"-FRIENDSHIP-"
"-HAAAAAAAMEEEEEEEEEEE-"
"-ULTIMATE-"
"-HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!"
"PUUUUUUUUUUNCH!!!"
As the same time the duo released their respective attacks right at the other, with Roshi using a powerful blast of energy, while Mil-Tan charged him with its fist glowing with pink magical energy.
"HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!" Roshi roared as he put his all into this attack, intending to eliminate the scourge that was Mil-Tan from existence once and for all, while the magical thing responded by punching the Kamehameha with it's own attack, the Magical Friendship Ultimate Punch.
The two attacks collided and produced a powerful shockwave that, surprising quite a few people, showed Mil-Tan standing its ground against Roshi as it began to push back on the Kamehameha.
Seeing this, Roshi responded by pouring as much power into his attack as possible, which began shredding Mil-Tan's outfit even as it pushed harder to resist his attack.
"Magical Jump!" Mil-Tan suddenly cried out as it leapt above the Kamehameha, surprising everyone even further as it swung its pink fist right at his opponent. Roshi however was unable to respond to the attack, his body refusing to respond to him as shock filled him from what he was forced to witness beneath Mil-Tan's ruined skirt.
And as his body froze from the horrific sight, Roshi was unable to move as Mil-Tan's great leap carried it further than expected, helping Roshi to avoid its attack, but not something else.
The Kamehameha was suddenly cut off as Roshi and Mil-Tan descended to the whale's back in a heap, before the Magical Girl leapt up and spun around to continue the fight, only to see his opponent passed out while foaming at the mouth. And with this also being visible to everyone else, the announcer began counting,
"1, 2, 3! MIL-TAN WINS!"
Even as the announcement rang out though, it was met with silence from the audience at what they had just witnessed, even though most of it was censored from their eyes.
"To think...." Alex began with a cramped smile. "...the great Master Roshi was defeated by a teabag..."
Then, to distract himself from the horrific scene he'd just witnessed, Alex proceeded to bury his face into Rikku's butt, missing what happened next as Roshi and Mil-Tan were ejected from the arena, and the whale dissolved into numerous partials of light to show it hadn't even truly existed to begin with. Alex didn't even lift his face from the comfort of Rikku's butt/pussy, until he heard the announcer state,
"AND FOR OUR NEXT MATCH, PIKKON VS HERACLES!"
This time there was a bit of scattered applause, as people desperately tried to forget what it was they had just witnessed. But Alex did look up in time to see both Pikkon and Heracles make their way to the center of the arena, where the location of their match was about to be decided. Right as they were teleported to their destination though, the Barren Globe, Alex noticed something through his Domain that drew his attention.
Unceremoniously rolling Rikku off of him, Alex surprised the girls by getting up as he said, "We have company."
Alex had just barely conjured a large curtain to cover the half of the room where the naked girls were relaxing, when the door to the room burst open to reveal a short figure with blue skin, dark purple dreadlocks, and pointed ears.
As Alex stared down at the youngest of the Heeter family, Gas glared at him with barely contained fury as he snarled,
"Where is my family?"
Not at all concerned that he was currently face-to-face with the strongest of the Heeters, while also buck naked, Alex just shrugged before saying in a casual manner, "Well I learned Elec was planning to assassinate my children, so I toured and killed him before enslaving Maki and Oil."
Apparently Gas hadn't been expecting such a blunt answer, as his expression slackened for a brief second in surprise, before rage retook him as he shouted,
"HOW DARE YOU!" The young Heeter then charged Alex while his energy formed numerous weapons around him, a sight that peaked Alex's interest as he simply stood there.
Even when the weapons were less than an inch from his skin Alex didn't react, simply applying Armament Haki to the locations where they were going to hit him, allowing them to thud anti climatically against his skin. Even as Gas followed up by trying to attack Alex alongside his weapons, Alex didn't flinch when his fist impacted his face, which did nothing against his rubber body.
"Finished?" Alex asked calmly to Gas' incredulous expression, before he then casually flicked each of his conjured weapons, shattering them instantly before he lightly tapped Gas on the forehead, sending him flying backwards as if he'd been punched.
Impacting the wall beside the door, Gas struggled to move his limbs in order to retaliate, but was unable to do so thanks to Alex holding him in place with telekinesis. Even as the young Heeter glared at him hatefully though, Alex calmly stated,
"Maki, Oil." In an instant both of Gas' siblings appeared between the two of them, making them look around confusedly before seeing their brother.
""GAS!!"" They exclaimed as one, to which he demanded,
"Are you ok?" Surprising him, both Maki and Oil nodded as the former said,
"Yes, master has been surprisingly kind to us." Agreeing with her, Oil added,
"Yes, though we are 'slaves' we aren't mistreated or abused." As he said that Oil recalled what his new duties were, which was mainly cleaning and maintaining the colosseum.
Maki on the other hand glanced at Alex as she thought on what she had experience last 'night' in the space-time orb. Especially after he obtained the Chatroom, she had quickly learned that Alex didn't treat his slaves as 'slaves', they were instead regarded as maids who simply bore the slave make so they couldn't rebel or harm anyone.
She had also learned from her fellow slaves though that they were actually quite privileged due to the fact that they served one of the most powerful men in the Omniverse, as stated by Nyx who was an actual goddess. Adding in the training they received from Grayfia, access to the Chatroom and its shop, Maki was in fact feeling VERY privileged.
Gas meanwhile wasn't quite sure how to feel about how well his siblings were apparently doing, until he exclaimed,
"What about Elec?!" Surprising him even further, both siblings tilted their heads as Maki asked,
"What about him?" Oil nodded as he added,
"Master showed us how worthless it was to follow Elec, he had so many plans to rule the universe, but never acted on them or anything. All he did was put a target on our backs by angering master, who was kind enough not to kill us."
With Maki nodding in agreement, Gas could only look at his brother and sister in shock of how easily they accepted their brother's death, while he had spent the entire night desperately searching for the three of them. Alex however chose that moment o speak up, as he asked Gas,
"If your that upset about Elec's death, then how about a wager?" Gas gave Alex a sharp look, as he spat at him,
"What king of wager?" Alex just shrugged before responding,
"How about....... If you win the entire tournament, I'll bring Elec back to life and free Maki and Oil." To say the trio was surprised would be quite the understatement based off of the looks they gave him, while Gas demanded,
"Just like that?" Alex just smirked at his skepticism though, and said with a snort,
"Of course. BUT, that means that you'd have to beat opponents as powerful and even stronger than Frieza." With the tyrant being the considered the epitome of strength in the entire universe, Gas realized the difficulty of the challenge Alex presented him with, before he asked,
"And if I lose?" Alex gestured at Maki and Oil as he stated simply,
"Then you join these two in becoming one of my slaves, and Elec stays dead." As he said that Alex released Gas from his telepathic hold, and held out his hand as he asked, "Deal?"
Gas glared at Alex's hand suspiciously as he thought on the wager, before saying curtly, "Deal."
Shaking on it, Alex nodded as he said,
"Good, but before your name gets called I should probably fix you up." Without giving Gas time to argue, Alex waved his hand and all of the fatigue and tiredness Gas was feeling from spending the entire night awake vanished, making him glower at Alex for his interference. But before he could say anything,
"AND PIKKON WINS!"
The sound of deafening cheers immediately followed the announcer's declaration, signaling the end of the match between Pikkon and Heracles, before he stated after a moment,
"AND FOR OUR NEXT CHALLENGERS, SON GOKU VERSUS GAAAAAAAAAS!"
Alex looked at the small Heeter, and said to him,
"Better get out there." Gas just snorted at Alex's comment though, before turning around and making his way out of his room, and down to the arena.
***
As the tournament continued on to the fourth match, a certain group of women throughout the Omniverse were having their minds blown as they watched the awe inspiring fights.
"Amazing...." Cynthia uttered to herself, even as she replayed the previous three fights in her head.
Though she had began her journey several years ago, and had witnessed numerous intense battles between her own Pokemon and her opponent's, Cynthia had never even considered seeing two people do battle in the same way. Yes, there were tournaments and matches between martial artists that trained alongside their fighting type Pokemon, but no human that she'd ever heard of could fight in the way the people in Alex's world could.
And as she flew to the region of Honnen for a conference between Champions, Cynthia was fully absorbed in the live stream that Anne was projecting for them for the remainder of her flight.
...
"This is so exciting!" Hestia squealed as she eagerly grabbed another potato chip and crunched on it.
She was currently laying on her new and incredibly comfy bed, her bare feet kicking the air behind her as she excitedly watched the live stream being projected before her. By her side was an assortment of snacks that she had bought from the Chatroom shop, and was becoming somewhat addicted to as she experienced the new tastes and sensations for the first time, the most impactful one being something called a 'soda'.
Despite her carefree and jovial attitude though, Hestia was somewhat seriously paying attention to the live stream due to her recognizing a few of the names that were projected earlier. Alongside several of Alex's wives, who she had met through the Chatroom, there were also the names of certain figures that she knew from her own world, Zeus, Thor, and even Heracles.
Having already had quite a few discussions with the other goddesses in the Chatroom, Nyx, Athena, Artemis, Freya, Brigid, and her own counterpart, Hestia was amazed to see the differences between them and goddesses she knew with the same names. So, with two gods and a hero who's names she also knew from her own world, Hestia was quite interested to see what they were like as well.
...
'What's with this ridiculous lineup!?!' A certain girl with her pink hair tied up into twintails exclaimed within her mind, even as her expression remained completely neutral in the classroom.
Sun Wukong, Typhon, Surtr, Bael, Lucifer, Cao Cao, Zeus, Thor, Heracles, Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo, Krillin. They were all names that Saya Takagi either knew from the numerous myths of her world, or from a certain anime she had somewhat watched growing up, not to mention Cynthia with the Pokemon.
And now here they were, duking it out right in front of her...well in a projection that was right in front of her.
'I really have to stop being shaken at every little thing.....' Saya said to herself in a mental deadpan, as she wouldn't be surprised if her hair had already begun turning grey from everything she'd been learning recently, from the Omniverse, gods, humanoid races, magic and monsters, to learning of her own world's impending doom.
In fact, with everything she'd been exposed to and learned recently, Saya had even lost all motivation to attend school since it would be a moot point in the near future. She had to keep up appearances though, as if she acted too out of line or told others what she knew, she'd definitely end up in an asylum.
So Saya tried not to think too much about what she was watching, even as the teacher fumed from her obvious lack of attention in his class.
...
"Epic!" Yang exclaimed as she watched the contestants beat each other up, to the point where the last guy, Pikkon, smashed the entire planet they were on to pieces with a single hit.
"Gaaaa! Why can't I watch as well Yang!?!" Her younger sister, Ruby, demanded with a pout, annoyed that she couldn't see the fights she sister got to watch. Yang of course just glanced at Ruby, and told her the same thing she had been for the last several days,
"Because Rubes, I'm not going to let you join the Chatroom because of how mature it is." Ruby just fumed as she exploded,
"I'm plenty mature!" Yang just dead panned at her little sister though, who had even been nicknamed the 'cookie monster' in her family due to her childish obsession with cookies. Knowing she wasn't going to give up asking her though, Yang said after a moment of thought,
"Ok then, how about this? I'll ask Alex to add you to the Chatroom, when you get into Beacon Academy." Ruby shot up at that, but then went back to pouting as she stated,
"But that's two years away!" Other than whining though, Ruby didn't otherwise try to convince Yang to let her join the Chatroom, making the eldest sister chuckle at her dismay, even as the next pair walked out into the arena.
Though, if Yang had asked Alex more about the plot of her world's 'story', then she might've rethought the condition she gave to her sister.
...
Of the group of women watching the live stream, perhaps the most incredulous one aside from Saya was Tatsumaki, who was wondering if she were imagining things when she saw the scale of the fights.
Though the old man and the thing that reminded her of Puri Puri Prisoner weren't anything to talk about, the man she'd just watch shatter a planet with a single punch had sent chills down her spine. Chills Tatsumaki hadn't felt in years.
"Humph! What am I getting worked up so much for? Against my powers they'd all be nothing anyways!" Convincing herself as such, Tatsumaki went back to watching the live stream, having told the Hero Association not to bother her for the day.
...
"How exciting! This is completely different from Bending!" Ty Lee excitedly stated, even as she was preparing for her performance for the night. Nearby was a small pile of flowers and other gifts she'd received from the boys that had seen her walking around town.
Normally Ty Lee would be thrilled to receive such gifts, but right now she was more interested in the Chatroom and the tournament Anne was 'streaming' for them. She still wasn't quite up to speed on all of the cool things they had in Alex's world, but all of it looked really amazing to Ty Lee.
She was eagerly waiting for the day Alex would come to her world and show her all of these things.
"Ty Lee! You're on!" Hissed one of the other acrobats, making her leap up as Ty Lee prepared to perform her act, which was typically tightrope walking.
...
Of the seven women though, one in particular wasn't too invested in the tournament, but then again who could blame her considering what she and her crew were currently trying to do.
"Hey old man! Are you sure it's around here?" Her captain, Luffy, whined as they waited, to which the old man in question, Mont Blanc Cricket, stated,
"Yeah I'm sure, we just need to wait and the Knock Up Stream will send us to sky for sure kid." Luffy just snickered when heard that, while eagerly awaiting the massive pillar of water that would send them, and the two other ships by them into the sky.
Those two ships belonged to a group known as the Saruyama Alliance, a group searching for an ancient lost city of gold that was thought to either be completely made up, or sunk to the bottom of the ocean centuries ago.
Robin however, using the hint Alex gave her about bringing the old man and after learning who he was, convinced him and his allies into joining them in their journey to the skies.
***
1. Son Goku
2. Bardock
3. Mil-tan
4. Jackie Chun❌
5. Sun Wukong
6. Kimari Ronso❌
7. Rana Linchen
8. Krililn
9. Gas
10. Granolah
11. Pikkon
12. Sting Eucliffe
13. Kokoa Shuzen
14. Caulifla
15. Surtr Second
16. Heracles ❌
***

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - 484: The End of the Heeters
chapters.content:
With Maki and Oil beside him, Alex returned to the other side of the curtain as his wives finished redressing themselves to watch the next match. This time they were taking things a bit more seriously due to the wager Alex made, though the man himself appeared relaxed as he didn't even dress, and seemed distracted as Gas and Goku entered the arena.
A minute later however, a new figure suddenly appeared in the VIP room that caught everyone else off guard.
Meanwhile Goku and Gas were currently face-to-face with each other for the first time, worsening Gas' mood after seeing the same face that had defeated him more than twenty years prior. The only thing missing was the X shaped scar on the cheek.
Clenching his fists at all of the frustrations he was experiencing that day, Gas decided to take them out on this lookalike before him. Goku however appeared unable to read his opponent's attitude, as he excitedly stated, "Finally! Now I can see what other people in the universe are capable of!"
Goku then extended a hand towards Gas and continued, "I'm Goku, nice to meet ya!" Gas however responded by smacking away Goku's hand while glaring at him with undisguised hostility, making Goku wonder if he'd done something to make him mad or something.
Before he could ask the announcer cried out,
"NOW TO DETERMINE WHAT THEIR ARENA WILL BE!"
As usual, the list of the numerous arenas began to flash as the light moved between the different locations for nearly a minute, before it began to slow until it finally came to a stop once again as everyone beheld a hellscape featuring an endless sea of corpses, broken war machines, and weapons.
"AND WE HAVE THE BATTLEGROUND!"
The words were barely out of his mouth when both Goku and Gas were transported to the Battleground, where they were in the only clear space within the seemingly endless sea of death and annihilation.
"FIGHTERS READY?" The announcer asked, prompting Goku and Gas to take their respective stances, before he declared, "FIIIIIIIIIIIIIGHT!!!"
The second the fight started Gas rushed Goku while forming a bladed gauntlet on his hand, learning from his scuffle with Alex, as he snarled as he aimed it directly at Goku's heart,
"I WILL save Elec, and clean the stain from that day!" Goku, not knowing what Gas was talking about, caught the blade of the gauntlet with his hands before it could reach his chest. Surprisingly he was pushed back several feet from the force of Gas' attack, pushing him right to the edge of the ring of cleared space, before he put enough force in his hands to break the blade into pieces.
"I don't know what you're talking about, but let's just enjoy ourselves!" Gas was about to tell Goku to stop talking nonsense, but before he could Goku vanished as he used Instant Transmission to disappear and reappear behind him.
Before gas could even turn around Goku delivered a kick right into his side, sending him flying through the field of weapons, receiving numerous cuts and injuries before finally sliding to a stop.
...
"Damn it! Get up and hit him back you worthless piece of shit!" Shouted a certain figure in the VIP room, who watched the fight anxiously as he saw his little brother get sent flying lie a rag doll.
"Seeing the brotherly love there Elec." Alex said in a deadpan, before looking down and adding, "Then again, I shouldn't be surprised considering you don't even care about me using your little sister as a sex toy either."
As he said, Alex was watching the fight with his hands on either side of Maki's hips, holding her up in the air as he pumped her cunt up and down his cock even with two of her brothers on either side of him. Elec glanced down at her when Alex said that, before snorting in disgust as he sneered,
"Don't worry, when I come back to life I'll have her passed around like the whore she wants to be." Elec then glanced over Alex's wives before adding with sinister sneer, "Along with your wives and daughters of course."
Surprisingly, Alex didn't react to Elec's taunt as he continued fucking his little sister in front of him. Meanwhile the wives and even Oil looked at him with undisguised scorn in their eyes at Elec's sheer stupidity.
Even Oil and Maki had come to realize how stupid their brother was after spending some time under Alex. Elec had taught them that with enough wealth and knowledge that even the most powerful beings in the universe could be toppled, which was ther plan to take the Frieza empire from the tyrant.
What they had learned from both Alex and Frieza though when the former killed their brother, was that power was an essential necessity when it came to conquering and ruling. Though wealth and Intel did indeed go a long way to ruling, power was needed to protect what was yours, and to take what you wanted. The other two typically came along with it.
The duo had learned that when Alex casually tortured and killed their brother, before sending a group of his combat maids to collect the vast fortune hey had built up over the last several decades.
The Heeters had been amongst the wealthiest group in the entire universe due to their numerous transactions as they literally sold entire planets, and manipulated the economic state of entire galaxies through their assassination and bounty contracts. Yet that entire fortune had been seized from them within a matter of hours, despite being hidden and protected with the best security money could buy, by the servants of a man who appeared completely indifferent when he saw the dozens of zero's that had been added to his own vault afterwards.
With his empire spanning numerous worlds and tens of billions of people, amongst which were kings, powerful monsters, and even gods, the taxes and tributes he received regularly had made Alex's already vast wealth explode in size. And then there was the numerous businesses and territories ran by his wives, which also contributed to the increasing size of his vault.
Unlike other rulers or dragons who hoarded their wealth though , Alex actively looked for ways to get rid of it in the most beneficial manner possible. Not only did he lavishly spoil his wives, lovers, and children(within reason) whenever he got the chance, but Alex also personally funded many of the organizations and projects within Asora such as the Hospital, The Grigori institute, and the Academy. On top of that he would also make numerous anonymous donations to orphanages, schools, hospitals, as well as fund numerous projects to increase quality of life in the various territories he ruled over.
And despite all of that, as well as the usual expenses he paid regularly to Asora's public workers and so on, the actual amount of wealth Alex possessed only seemed to grow without end. Then again, it wasn't that surprising with all of the plunder he and his wives seemed to 'stumble' upon.
But if the Heeters ever found out how much wealth Alex actually possessed, they were liable to keel over from shock in response.
At the current moment however there was only a growing disdain for their eldest brother at his sheer arrogance and ignorance of his current situation. Elec was, of course, still dead, as evidenced by the halo floating above his head, yet ever since hearing about the deal made between Alex and Gas he had been acting as if he were untouchable.

It requires extremely precise energy control and a supremely strengthened body in order to utilize properly, and even then the drawbacks are nearly impossible to mitigate."
As the Grand Supreme Kai trailed off, everyone turned their attention back to Krillin on the projection, which proved his statement about the drawbacks of using the Kaio-Ken. On top of the extensive damage caused to him by Rana already, Krillin had damaged and worn himself out even worse in order to land a single hit on her.

Bardock could feel Granolah's piercing glare of course, but chose to ignore it.
"AND NOW LETS SEE WHERE OUR TWO CONTESTANTS WILL BE DUKING IT OUT!"
The announcer shouted as the list of different arenas began to light once again, flashing between the hundreds of locations before settling on a certain one.
"AND IT'S THE MISTY WOODS!!!"
That was the last thing Bardock or Granolah heard before they were transported to a wooded region filled with massive trees, and incredibly thick fog.
Granolah smirked as he examined their battleground, as a region like this perfectly suited his people with their special eyes, which, combined with their unique equipment, made them all the best snipers in the universe... Or they had been.
So when the match officially began, Granolah's first move was to leap backwards in order to fade into the dense fog, removing him from Bardock's line of sight immediately. Seeing this, the Saiyan in question just smirked as he recalled the day they wiped out the Cerealians, and the way they fought.
Thinking about it, Bardock realized he could have very well been the only person in the universe who had real experience fighting the Cerealians left. And this came into play when numerous small intense blasts of energy came out of the fog at every single one of his blind spots.
Even as the deadly attacks approached him, Bardock's smirked never wavered. He wasn't the same Saiyan that had attacked planet Cereal all those years ago.
While before he needed his scouter to be able to detect energy, Bardock had long since learned to sense it like his son and his friends could. So without even budging from his position, Bardock raised his hand and effortlessly deflected every single blast directed towards him.
*BOOM BOOM BOOM BOOM BOOM!*
Numerous explosions rocked the misty woods as the condensed and powerful blasts of energy hit many of the trees surrounding Bardock, blowing the trunks to pieces as the rest of the trees them-self came crashing down around him. Even as one started coming down right on top of his head, Bardock didn't budge as he simply held a hand up, and caught the giant tree effortlessly.
"Here's a present." Bardock said with a bit of humor, as he tossed the tree in the direction he could feel Granolah's energy coming from, surprising the Cerealian when the saw the massive shadow swiftly approaching him through the fog.
"Shit!" He exclaimed while hurrying out of the way as quickly as he could, before the sound of the bark scraping and wood shattering echoed as the tree crashed through the woods.
"Saiyans do not mess around..." The voice of Granolah's long time partner, Oatmeel, said in his ear, to which the Cerealian nodded as he looked in the direction Bardock was in.
With the special trait of his right eye, combined with the assistance he received from the lens in his eyepatch, which was also where the Artificial Intelligence Oatmeel resided, he was was able to see right through the fog to locate his target. Except, Bardock wasn't there.
"Above you!" Oatmeel exclaimed suddenly, drawing Granolah's gaze upwards where he saw Bardock, flying above the tree canopy with dozens of spheres of energy beside him.
His urge to flee triggering, Granolah was about to try and book it out of range of those energy spheres when he saw Bardock's lips moving, forming the words,
Sorry kid, but I don't intend to play hide and seek.
Bardock had barely finished speaking before the spheres of energy started hurtling down at he ground, causing massive explosions over and over again as he carpet bombed the arena while focusing on where he could feel Granolah's energy. Soon,
"GRANOLAH IS UNABLE TO CONTINUE FIGHTING! BARDOCK WINS!"
Immediately after the announcement rang out Bardock found himself transported back to the colosseum, alongside an unconscious and horrendously wounded Granolah. Thankfully though he too was taken to the infirmary along with those who had also sustained injuries too serious to be healed instantly when they returned.
Bardock only stayed long enough to watch Granolah being taken away, before he too turned and left the arena, deaf to the applause and cheers he was receiving.
He was a Saiyan, and Saiyans did not fight for prestige or adoration, they fought for the thrill of the battle and the desire to win. Wether the audience hated or adored him meant nothing to Bardock, only that he emerged victorious while his opponent fell.
That didn't mean he was devoid of emotion though, as Bardock already planned to visit the infirmity once Granolah woke up to have a chat with him.
Back in the arena of the colosseum, when the cheers that Bardock had been receiving finally died down, the announcer declared,
"AND SO ENDS THE FIRST ROUND OF MATCHES, BUT IT IS FAR FROM OVER LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! NEXT WE HAVE A BRIEF BREAK SO OUR FIGHTERS CAN RECUPERATE AND EVERYONE CAN REFRESH THEMSELVES, BEFORE WE COME BACK FOR THE FIRST MATCH OF THE QUARTERFINALS! AND TO GIVE YOU ALL A TASTE OF WHAT TO EXPECT,"
At his cue, the list showing the eight remaining contenders began to flash as it cycled between them, before eventually coming to a stop on the names of the first two fighters to appear in the quarterfinals.
"SUN WUKONG VERSUS SON GOKUUUUUUUUUUUUU!!!"
***
BRACKET ONE
1. Son Goku
2. Bardock
3. Mil-tan
4. Jackie Chun❌
5. Sun Wukong
6. Kimari Ronso❌
7. Rana Linchen❌
8. Krillin
9. Gas❌
10. Granolah ❌
11. Pikkon
12. Sting Eucliffe ❌
13. Kokoa Shuzen
14. Caulifla
15. Surtr Second❌
16. Heracles ❌
***

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - 486: Power Pole 2.0
chapters.content:
After the break started everyone quickly dispersed to quickly finish whatever business they had so the fights could resume. But as the majority of the spectators were waiting in line for the bathrooms and stalls, one could hear numerous conversations as the people talked about the tournament.
"Dude! Did you see the way that Rana chick went berserk?!? I think I'm in love!"
"I'm betting my money on the old man Wukong winning it all! Experience beats out brute strength any day!"
"What!? Come on! Pikkon's got this tournament in the bag! The dude shattered a planet with a single punch!"
"You're a complete moron if you think the Kaoi-Ken is better than the Super Saiyan!"
"And YOU'RE just a stupid simp for Saiyans! Pikkon with the Kaio-Ken would wipe the entire tournament with one hand behind his back!"
These conversations and arguments over which technique or fighter was better were taking place everywhere as the people tried to hurry up their business. While a certain group was reacting to the tournament in their own way, as they excitedly ran up and down the halls of the colosseum.
"HA! I use a energy blast to blow you all away!"
"Well I turned into a Super Saiyan, and blocked it!"
"RA! I'm a vampire that's gonna suck your blood, trash!"
Numerous children were running around as they pretended to be the different people they thought were cool from the tournament. One kid who was fairly short ran around with a foam sword while pretending to be Gas, another stuck his hair up and out as he pretended he was Goku, and a little girl was running around acting as if she were trying to suck their blood to try and be a vampire like Kokoa.
As they and others eagerly discussed the matches they had seen so far, a certain figure with relatively plain features watched on with a warm smile on his face. He was in fact, Sun Wukong.
Using one of his transformation techniques to remain anonymous, Wukong was watching to gauge the general reaction to the tournament so far, and liked what he was seeing.
While he did agree somewhat with Piccolo and the others about how unnecessarily showy and gaudy this tournament was, Wukong also understood the reason for it as well. After all, the whole point of this tournament was to display to the people of the universe and beyond just how powerful the average person could make themselves, and to throw away the belief that there was a limit to what a person could achieve.
Most of all, it was to inspire the younger generations to grow and pursue dreams that they would've otherwise been unable or unwilling to. Now, seeing people who could perform feats that would be widely regarded as 'impossible', such as flying, being super strong, and using energy, children and those who dreamed of performing similar feats all over the universe would learn that they too could do it.
And as he watched the children play Wukong smiled while envisioning what the future had in store, before a certain someone arrived.
"Look! It's Goku!" One of the children cried out, drawing everyone's gazes to the Saiyan as he arrived.
"Woah!" Goku exclaimed as he was suddenly surrounded by a ton of people, before he adopted a troubled expression as they tired to ask for his autograph and other favors.
Not quite sure how to deal with crowds, Goku was trying to figure out how to politely ask them to leave him alone, when an old man with a plain looking face arrived and told them, "Leave him be! Can't you see yer suffocating the poor man!?"
Goku looked to the old man like he was his savior before escaping the crowds, who for some reason listened to him as they dispersed. Approaching, the Saiyan gratefully said,
"Thanks for that!" The plain looking man nodded as he replied,
"Not a problem, but I would recommend learning to disguise yourself if you don't people to recognize you." As he said that the man's figure began to shimmer with a golden light, before it shattered to reveal none other than Goku's next opponent, Sun Wukong.
"Hey! You're the old man who fought that cat guy!" Goku exclaimed in shock as he recognized Wukong, making the old man chuckle as he said,
"You're forgetting, I'm also your next opponent." Goku just smirked when he heard that, before stating,
"I know! I'm looking forward to it!" The Saiyan's expression then turned to that of a battle junkie, ready to face his next opponent with no hesitation or holds barred as he anticipated the match between himself and this old man.
A similar expression appeared on Wukong's face as he anticipated fighting against the young man before him. He didn't know why but, aside from their names, the young man in front of him reminded Wukong A LOT of himself when he was younger. He was even considering taking him on as a disciple after the tournament was over if he was interested, the first after Alex in fact.
(A.N. For those who are unaware, Goku is the Japanese translation of Wukong's name.)
***
Meanwhile in the infirmary, Krillin began to stir as he awoke from the short nap inflicted onto him by his and Rana's last attack.
Sitting up, Krillin was wondering just how long he'd been out when a a shriek startled him.
"Kyaaaaa! He's awake!" Looking up sharply, Krillin saw a trio of cute women circling his bed with expressions varying from concern to excitement as they chattered. His confusion growing, Krillin asked them hesitantly,
"And who are you guys?" The girl that cried out before, who the other two seemed to defer to, blushed heavily while avoiding eye contact with Krillin as she said,
"I'm Ribrianne, leader of Universe Two's Kamikaze Fireballs that came to escort lady Heles!" As she said that the rest of the girls also hurriedly introduced themselves as Roasie and Kakunsa, before all three stated at once,
"""We're your biggest fans!!!"""
Krillin's expression slackened when he heard that, his thoughts indiscernible from his expression, before he uttered, "Either that last hit killed me and I finally ended up in heaven, or she hit my head worse than I thought..."
Though the trio didn't know what Krillin was talking about, they could see that he didn't believe them. So the leader of the Kamikaze Fireballs, Ribrianne, quickly said,
"Really! We're all your fans! Not only are you strong, but your bald head, no nose, and pleasingly simple features...." As she got to that point Ribrianne trailed off, annoying Krillin at how they dug at his looks, as he stated irritably,
"Look, if you want to make fun of how I look there's better-"
"YOU'RE JUST SO GORGEOUS!" Ribrianne suddenly cried out, silencing anything else Krillin might have said as his mind went blank.
Though his fist instinct was to immediately deny that he was 'gorgeous', and that the three girls were simply making fun of him, anything he might've said about it died in his throat as he watched all three of them squeal and blush deeply like a group of maidens.
...
Their squeals were so loud, that the trio of women were soon reprimanded by the nurses in charge of the infirmary, while another one of the contenders sent there opened his eyes as he too awoke.
"I lost...." Granolah uttered to himself in a lifeless voice, to which Oatmeel replied,
"Yes you did, one sidedly at that. Maybe next time you'll stick to assassination instead of entering an asinine tournament." Granolah smiled in a self deprecating manner at Oatmeel's biting comment, before scowling as he recalled that it was a Saiyan he lost to.
Not just any Saiyan, but one that directly contributed to the death of his people, and his mother.
As Granolah clenched his fists in frustration of how strong the targets of his revenge were, not to mention Frieza himself, the door to the infirmary opened suddenly to admit the one who sent him there in the first place, Bardock.
Murderous intent poured off of Granolah as he glared at the Saiyan, who made a beeline straight for him when he found him.
"We need to talk Granolah." Bardock said as he approached the bed, to which the Cerealian snarled,
"We don't have anything to talk about Saiyan!"
Despite the hostility shown at him though, Bardock didn't react as he simply asked, "How's Monaito these days? The old man still kicking?"
Granolah shot up in shock when he heard the name of the Namekian who raised him since the day his people, and mother, were slaughtered.
"How do you know Monaito!?" Granolah demanded as numerous thoughts raced through his head, none of which were good.
Bardock sighed at how troublesome this was, and was about to explain the whole story to Granolah, when a new voice said,
"Bardock is the one who save you and your mother from the slaughter, and left you in my care afterwards." The duo turned in shock to see the Namekian Bardock had just referred to standing there, looking tired after the long and rushed flight he'd just gotten off of.
"Monaito?!" Granolah exclaimed with surprise, as the Namekian in question slowly approached them and said,
"I'm glad to see you're doing well after your defeat Granolah, and I am truly glad to see you again Bardock. We were told all of the Saiyans died years ago from a meteor strike." Bardock scoffed when he heard that, before stating irritably,
"It wasn't a meteor strike, but Frieza himself who wiped us out, and almost all of us did die. Only. A handful of Saiyans who weren't on planet Vegeta at the time survived, including my sons." Granolah looked at Bardock in surprise, not knowing they had been betrayed and killed by Frieza as well, but then he was confused as he asked,
"Then why are there so many Saiyans running around Pangea then?" Bardock smirked this time as he said,
"The Dragon Emperor brought a few of us back from death, and made contact with a planet of Saiyans that still existed in another universe. Six months ago the only ones left were my son Kakarot, and the former Prince Vegeta." Both Monaito and Granolah looked up sharply when Bardock mentioned Alex bringing him back from the dead, as the latter exclaimed,
"He can do that!?! Do you think he'll bring back my people?!!" Bardock shook his head though, and stated,
"You can ask, but I doubt it. He won't jump because someone asked him to do something, and I don't know what the specifics of his abilities are." As he said that though, the gleam in Granolah's eyes didn't fade as he saw hope to see his mother again for the first time, while Monaito didn't see any good coming from this.
***
In another part of the colosseum, a certain goddess was making her way through the halls with a specific destination in mind. She had brought a group of fighters from her universe with her for the day to act as her escort, but after seeing one of the matches they took off to go and meet the man who had fought in it.
Now Heles, the goddess of Destruction for Universe Two, was also going to meet a man.
This man was remarkably different from the one her escorts went to go see though, in almost every aspect. Of course, Heles' escorts were from a planet with markedly different standards of beauty from the rest of the universe, as they had collectively considered someone like Alex as 'disgustingly ugly' despite him being the most beautiful man Heles had ever seen.
And Heles definitely had no intention of letting a man as beautiful as him slip away from her without a fight.
So, the goddess opened the door to Alex's private VIP room to try and use her charms on him, only to find the entire room engulfed in a haze of lust and sex. Naked bodies littered the room as they tangled themselves up in one another, with a certain Saiyan covered in red fur at the center of them all.
"Heles. To what do I owe the pleasure?" Alex asked as he turned to face her, even as he continued fucking Kurumu's mouth and throat.
The goddess however was stunned silent as she took in the scene around her, in which no one minded her presence as they continued indulging in their debauchery.
"Ehem!" She coughed after a moment, as if trying to clear her throat, before saying,
"I was wondering if I may be able to spectate the tournament alongside yourself, seeing as my escorts abandoned me to see to one of the other contestants..." Heles trailed off at the end of her request, as she notice that three of the women partaking in the debauchery were angels as well, Vados, Marcarita, and Kusu.
"Is that so?" Alex asked as he pulled the entire length of his cock out of Kurumu's throat, allowing Heles to see it in all its glory for the first time.
Her entire body then stiffened as Alex began approaching her with his erect cock still out, coated in saliva and other fluids from its previous exploits, until he came to a stop directly in front of her.
"I'll give you a choice then Heles." He said suddenly drawing the goddess away from her admiration of his body, as she looked up at him. Alex then continued, "Either you walk out that door by the time it closes, or you get down onto your knees."
The door that had been left open behind Heles then began to close slowly of its own accord, beginning the time limit Alex gave her to make her decision. But even as the opportunity to leave dwindled she didn't even look back at the door, her heart pounding in her chest the entire time as she looked the Saiyan in the eyes.
He was big, unimaginably powerful with limitless potential, and most of all, he was the most beautiful man she had ever seen. As someone who checked every single box she had Heles couldn't leave even if she wanted to, not to mention the fact that he was said to potentially increase in power and status beyond even the omni King.
So, with more reasons to stay than not, Heles didn't budge a single inch until the door slammed shut behind her with more force than it should have, and Alex said,
"Times up Heles."
So, the goddess slowly began to kneel down until she was on her knees, and she wordlessly opened her mouth to do as the Dragon Emperor wanted.
...
When the fifteen minutes given for the intermission came to an end everyone rushed back to their seats as the next match was about to begin. Meanwhile the two contestants made their way to the arena together as they had been happily talking, but were now prepared to fight.
As he approached the mouth of the tunnel though, Goku paused as he saw something leaning up against the wall that drew his eye.
It was a five foot long red pole with golden decorations adorning its body and ends, with a piece of paper stuck to it that read,
'Goku,
I thought you might want something to replace the Power Pole you used when you were younger, so I had this prepared. Be careful though, it's heavy.'
With no indication of who it was from, Goku hesitantly gripped the staff around the middle before lifting it, surprising him at the weight especially, as well as how perfectly it felt in his hand.
His uncertain expression soon shifted to a smile though as, despite its insane weight, Goku twirled the staff in his hands to test it, before suddenly gripping it with the other hand as well as he made a strike.
"It's perfect!" He exclaimed to nobody in particular, though Wukong was watching the entire thing, and was fairly certain who it was that had given Goku the staff, as well as the other things it was capable of as he glanced at his own.
"If you're finished testing her out, I think we have a match to fight~" Wukong said playfully as he turned back towards the arena, while Goku hurriedly caught up to him.
The two men, both with monkey tails and wielding staves, walked out into the arena together as the audience applauded their entrance, and the announcer cried out,
"AND WE ARE BACK LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!"
(A.N. So I'm not sure how many of you have checked it out, but I have another series call 'The Dungeon Diver'. Thanks to the fact I've received no feedback on it though, I've considered deleting the chapters and changing it to another fanfic(thanks to issues with Webnovel in letting me create another series). It'll be a Pokemon fic that'll be secondary for me to write on, and will mostly be for me to shift focus when I'm experiencing a block on this one. Let me know what you think.)

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - 487: Son Goku vs Sun Wukong
chapters.content:
As Goku and Wukong walked out into the arena, the audience deafened them with cheers as they eagerly awaited the start of the next match.
"AND HERE THEY ARE LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! SON GOKU AND SUN WUKONG!"
The duo reacted amicably to the crowd's adoration towards them, with Wukong nodding politely back at them, and Goku waving and smiling. At the announcers signal though the applause came to an end, and he stated,
"NOW THEN! THE MOMENT YOU'VE ALL BEEN WAITING FOR, THE STAGE UPON WHICH THEY WILL FIGHT!"
As he said that the list of locations flashed and lit up, before settling upon the one they would be fighting in.
"AND IT'S THE SOLITARY MONASTERY!"
The announcer cried out as the the image of an abandoned and decrepit monastery appeared, which stood alone on the peak of a sheer drop. Along with the image was a notice stating that this arena forbid flight, right before Goku and Wukong were teleported there suddenly.
"Wow it's so creepy here..." Goku uttered as he looked at the area around them, before his teeth began to clatter as he stuttered, "A-and c-c-cold t-too!"
Wukong just smirked as he watched Goku shiver in the freezing cold wind, while his own robes not only acted as his armor, but also helped in regulating his body for the area around him. Wether he was in the hottest desert, or the frozen tundra, he would stay nice and comfortable.
Even as Goku was shivering, the announcer cried out,
"FIGHTERS READY?"
The duo quickly took their respective stances, despite the cold winds.
"FIIIIIIIIIIIGHT!"
The very second the fight began, both Goku and Wukong moved as they swung their respective staves at each other with the exact same movement.
*KABOOOM!!*
The force of the impact created a shockwave that fractured the stone buildings and walls around them, while entire chucks fell off into the abyss below.
"You're strong!" Goku exclaimed as he and Wukong stalled while their respective staves were pushing against the other.
"Well thank you, as are you young one." Wukong replied with a cheeky smile.
Ever since he lost against Alex in the battle that had been recorded as 'Ragnarok', and had his youth restored, Wukong had been training to increase his strength so he didn't fall further and further behind his student. However he could tell that Goku was just testing the waters before he got serious, as he hadn't even used his SSJ transformation.
But the semantics of the battle didn't register in Wukong's mind at that moment, as instead he decided to enjoy fighting against his opponent. And based off the cheeky grin on his face, Goku was having the same thought as the two broke contact and moved to strike each other once again as the battle escalated.
"WUKONG DOES A DOUBLE BACKFLIP!"
"GOKU DEFENDS!"
"WHICH IS THE REAL ONE?!"
"OOH, THATS GOTTA HURT!"
The scene before them, along with the announcers running commentary, had nearly everyone on the edge of their seats in anticipation, with both Goku and Wukong moving so fast that the projection needed to be slowed slightly so they could see what was going on.
Goku and Wukong meanwhile had large grins plastered on their faces as they continued to fight, both possessing skills and strength that could've ended it a while ago, but both choosing not to use them as they instead tried to beat the shit out of the other in little more than a brawl with sticks.
Up in his VIP room Alex was smiling as well as he watched the scene below, recalling as he did the original Dragon Ball series, where the fights were all settled with strength AND skill instead of just power levels and screaming. Goku also seemingly recalled the way he felt back then as well, as he locked staves with Wukong once more, with the tip of his pointed at the former Monkey King, as he said,
"Try this! Extend!" The next thing Wukong knew, the tip of Goku's staff went flying directly at him as it extended endlessly.
Needless to say that Wukong was not used to being the one on the receiving end of that particular trick, as the tip of Goku's staff impacted him and drove him back, through the crumbling wall, and out over the edge of the precipice.
"Heehee, give up?" Goku taunted the older monkey playfully, to which he responded,
"Not yet!"
Wukong then surprised everyone as he dropped from the end of the staff that was keeping him from falling, and began to plummet into the abyss below.
"HAS WUKONG GIVEN UP!?! IS THIS THE END OF THE LINE FOR THE MONKEY KING!?!"
The announcer shouted as the audience clenched their fists, willing Wukong to somehow make a comeback. However, despite his apparently hopeless situation, the smirk never left Wukong's face.
Instead, illusionary wisp of golden vapor began to appear around his feet, before they condensed to form an actual cloud that supported his weight, and carried him back up to safety.
"Hey! That's not fair!" Goku exclaimed, since the rules said they were restricted from flying.
His comment made Wukong pause, as both waited to hear if anything would be said about it or not.
Meanwhile, outside the arena the commentators, Anne, Azazel, Ajuka, and The Grand Supreme Kai, were discussing that very thing to determine if it should be allowed or not. Eventually they made a decision, which was whispered to the announcer to reveal.
"AND THE COMMENTATORS HAVE DECIDED, THAT SUN WUKONG'S FLYING CONTRAPTION DOES NOT BREAK THE RULES! THE ONLY TOOLS AND ITEMS BANNED ARE HEALING ITEMS, THEREFOR IF ONE POSSESSES AN ITEM THAT ALLOWS THEM TO FLY IT IS ALLOWED!"
Though there was a mixed response from the audience at the declaration, the people who agreed with the ruling far overshadowed those who disagreed. Meanwhile Wukong and Goku also heard the decision in the Monastery, making the older monkey smirk as he darted around Goku in circles.
"Come and get me boy!"
Frowning at the taunt, Goku answered by firing numerous blasts of energy at his opponent, which Wukong either dodged or deflected with his staff like it was a bat.
*BOOM!*
*BOOM!*
*BOOM!*
*BOOM!*
*BOOM!*
Explosions echoed as each sphere of energy detonated, some lighting up the skies like deadly fireworks, while others were reflected back at the monastery.
Goku's teeth clattered from each attack of his that was reflected back at the monastery, destroying more and more of it as massive chunks and slabs fell into the abyss below.
"You know, you should really be more careful with your footing." Wukong told him suddenly, confusing him until the elderly monkey suddenly swung his staff AT the mountain itself.
"Enlarge!" Wukong cried out mid-swing, makings the staff grow until it was the size of a large building.
Then entire mountain shook as Wukong's attack took out a massive chunk of it, leaving the entire thing balancing precariously. Then, after it shrunk back to its usual size, Wukong aimed his staff like it was a pool stick before saying, "Lengthen!"
The staff shot out without leaving Wukong's hands, extending to an impossibly long length in less than a second, and smashing a sizable hole through the small part of the mountain still holding the monastery up.
"HEY!"
"Shorten, lengthen!" Wukong cried out despite Goku's protests, making his staff shrink before it shot forward once again, taking out another large chunk of the mountain.
"Shorten, lengthen!"
"Shorten, lengthen!"
Over and over again Wukong struck the mountain with the tip of his staff, destroying more and more of it in less than a minute until finally, the scant remains rock began to give way.
*crrrrrrr-*
With a low groan, accompanied by the sound of stone shattering, the entire peak of the mountain with what remained of the monastery began to topple over, taking Goku with it as it began to plummet into the abyss.
"No faaaaaaaaaaaaiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiir!" Goku cried out as he fell, not at all wanting to be eliminated from the tournament like this.
But as he fell, Goku noticed something as he looked up at Wukong, or rather what he was standing on.
"Haaaaaaaaaa...." Taking in a deep breath, Goku then shouted as loudly as possible,
"FLYING NIMBUUUUUUUUUUUUUUS!!!"
No one knew what Goku was doing, no one but his closest friends who knew him before he could fly, but as he was about to fall through the abyss and be disqualified, a living piece of cloud appeared out of nowhere.
"Yeah!" Goku exclaimed happily as he landed on the cloud, before it shot up towards Wukong as he took a stance on it.
"I knew I could count on you buddy!" Goku praised the flying nimbus, which puttered happily at being praised and ridden for the first time in a while.
And while everyone is shocked at the sudden development, none are more shocked than Wukong himself, who can't believe what he is seeing. Though it takes a moment, realization dawns on him and he says as Goku approaches,
"So you're the me of this universe, huh?" Goku just tilts his head in confusion at that, not understanding what Wukong is talking about, so he explains,
"According to Alex, in the different universes there are different versions of certain people. One example you might know about would be that Frost fella he killed a while back." When Wukong mentions Frost Goku suddenly looks like he gets it, as he says,
"So you and me are the same people from different universes, like Frieza and Frost?" Wukong nodded as he said,
"That's right, and I'm willing to bet that little brat knew about it and didn't say anything."
As Wukong said that, Alex was suddenly the center of attention in the VIP room, to which he simply said,
"Hey, I can't spoil EVERYTHING in the Omniverse. Plus we're already on speaking terms with TWO Hestia's, how is THIS surprising?" The numerous girls shrugged as they acknowledged Alex's point, though the odd one out, Heles, couldn't help but be somewhat confused by what he was talking about. Then again, she swiftly lost interest once Alex resumed pounding away on her cervix, brining her more pleasure than any of the lovers she had taken in her life.
Back in the match Goku took a moment to ponder what Wukong was saying, before he told him,
"Well.... I don't quite understand the complicated stuff, but I do know that you can't run away anymore!" Saying so as he took an offensive stance, Goku shot forward at Wukong suddenly to resume their battle.
Now however the match turned into a game of cat and mouse as Goku chased Wukong around the arena, before the latter split into a dozen copies that scattered. Instead of being disoriented though, Goku immediately chose one clone in particular to chase after while ignoring the rest.
"Are you sure that's the real me?" One of the Wukong clones asked tauntingly, to which Goku replied,
"Nope! But if I beat it up then I know to go after another one!" As he said that Goku sent a blast of energy at the Wukong he was following, blowing it out of the sky even as he swiftly switched targets.
"Huyah!" The ten free clones cried out as they all encircled Goku, intending to surround him as he focused on the one.
"Gotcha!" Goku exclaimed as he suddenly grabbed one specific Wukong, and threw him out into the open air.
"Huh...!?!" Wukong uttered as he fell, before he passed through the abyss and was disqualified.
"AND SUN WUKONG FALLS OUT OF BOUNDS! SON GOKU WINS!"
As the announcement rang out the duo were brought back to the colosseum, where they were showered in cheers from their fans.
"How'd you know which was the real me?" Wukong asked Goku as they exited the arena, to which Goku replied as he pointed at his nose with a cheeky smile,
"You were the only one who smelled!"
Not at all expecting that answer, Wukong hesitantly sniffed his robes to see if he did in fact smell.
As he was doing that, the announcer cried out,
"AND NOW WHO ELSE IS READY FOR THE NEXT MATCH?! CAUSE I KNOW I AM!"
And as the audience cheered the announcer pointed to the list of participants, which flashed for half a moment before settling onto two names.
"MIL-TAN VERSUS PIKKON!"
Those who had become really big fans of Pikkon exploded in excitement as the two aforementioned fighters entered the arena, though the man himself appeared completely neutral to their cheers.
"Mil-Tan is so excited to be your opponent mr Pikkon!" Mil-Tan said to him energetically, to which Pikkon stoically replied,
"You shouldn't be." Ignoring Mil-Tan after saying that, Pikkon heard the announcer say the name of the location they would be fighting, before he and his next opponent were transported there.
The sound of crashing waves filled his ears as the duo found themselves on a tropical beach covered in white sand and palm trees as far as they could see.
"Ooh! Maybe we got sent on a vacation instead!" Mil-Tan said happily while seemingly forgetting they were supposed to be fighting, until the announcer cried out,
"FIGHTERS READY? FIIIIIIIIIIIIIGHT!"
"Mr Pikkon is really strong, so I'm going to go all out from the start!" Mil-Tan exclaimed while brandishing its wand.
"TRANSF-"
*BOOM!*
Without waiting for it to complete its transformation, Pikkon backhanded Mil-Tan with enough force that it's face was caved in while being sent skipping over the water.
"A-AND PIKKON WINS!" The announcer said after a second, when it was apparent that Mil-Tan was not going to resurface.
Within a couple minutes after being sent away, Pikkon found himself back in the colosseum where he was greeted by the obnoxious cheers. Scoffing at them, he then turned his back and exited the arena without pausing to see if his opponent was ok.
"W-WELL THAT WAS OVER QUICKLY, BUT LETS HOPE THE NEXT MATCH MAKES UP FOR IT! PRESENTING...... BARDOCK VERSUS KRILLIN!"

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - 488: Last of the Quarterfinals
chapters.content:
"BARDOCK AND KRILLIN, COME ON DOWN!" The announcer cried out as the spectators cheered for the next match, while Bardock casually strolled out of the tunnel into the arena.
Dismissive of the cheers he was receiving, Bardock made his way to the stage where they would stand before being sent to their actual arena, but as he did so everyone began to wonder,
Where is Krillin?
There was no sign of the short human anywhere as people began looking for him with a growing sense of urgency, while the announcer declared,
"IF YOU WILL GIVE US A MOMENT LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! WE ARE WORKING ON LOCATING CONTESTANT KRILLIN RIGHT NOW!"
Bardock clicked his tongue from annoyance and impatience as he just wanted to fight, while there was also growing unrest from the spectators as well the longer it took for Krillin to make his appearance.
"I'm here!" Krillin's voice suddenly shouted, drawing everyone's eyes to the tunnel, where the majority then twitched noticeably.
After all, there was Krillin, hurrying to tie his Gi back into place, and with different colors of lipstick all over his bald head and neck.
"S-sorry about that..." Krillin apologized sheepishly, even as he shrunk under Bardock's piercing glare.
"I'm sorry, did we disturb you?" He growled angrily, not at all understanding how someone would potentially miss an important fight for such a stupid thing. Krillin however could only silently turn red from shame and embarrassment.
"Ah young Krillin, thou still needs to properly cultivate the dao of shamelessness." Alex said sagely as he watched the interaction with a humorous smirk, while ignoring all the pointed looks he was receiving as Heles bounced up and down in his lap.
The goddess of Destruction acting like a common whore aside, Krillin squirmed from embarrassment until he heard someone cry out his name.
"""Krillin!"""
Looking up, Krillin saw the three girls from the Kamikaze Fireballs cheering him on in the stands. His heart warming from their encouragement, Krillin lightly slapped his own cheeks as he cried out,
"Ok then! Lets go!"
Even a s his opponent got pumped up for their fight, Bardock snorted while the announcer declared,
"ALRIGHT THEN EVERYBODY, LETS GET THIS MATCH STARTED!"
As he said that the list of different arenas began to flash, before finally settling on one named 'The Endless Blue'.
"AND THERE WE HAVE IT LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! LETS GET THIS MATCH UNDER WAY!"
As he said that both Krillin and Bardock found themselves standing on two of numerous floating platforms that bobbed in the seemingly endless ocean around them. Instead of remaining on them though, both Krillin and Bardock took flight into the air as they stared the other down.
"FIGHTERS READY? FIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIGHT!"
"Here I come! Kaio Ken times three!" Krillin cried out as he swiftly powered up, knowing that he couldn't take Goku's dad lightly.
As his opponent powered up though, Bardock just hovered there silently, a glower on his face as he waited.
"HAAAAAAAAAAAAA!" Krillin cried out as he rushed Bardock, moving at speeds that far exceeded his usual limit.
*thud*
"Eh?" Krillin uttered as his attack was casually caught by Bardock.
"Is this it?" Bardock sneered down at him, while Krillin slowly looked up at him like his neck was on a rusty hinge.
"Hehe....." He chuckled awkwardly, before Bardock's grip tightened on his hand painfully.
"Is that all you can muster?" Bardock asked again, his glare deepening as Krillin tried to free his hand from his grasp.
*BOOM!*
The next thing Krillin knew he was flying backwards after a single hit from Bardock, before he began skipping across the ocean below painfully until he ultimately slowed and sank down into it.
Bardock slowly descended down until he was just above the surface of the water, watching the surface while scanning for any signs of Krillin or his energy. Despite finding neither, Bardock never dropped his guard as it was obvious Krillin was still conscious since the match was still ongoing.
Then he suddenly detected a small bit of energy hurrying away from him, prompting Bardock to give chase as he tried to end the match.
"HA!" Krillin suddenly cried out as he emerged from the water from directly under Bardock, wreathed in the red energy of the Kaio Ken that he'd just activated.
"GA!" Bardock exclaimed as Krillin's fist sunk into his stomach, knocking the wind out of him as he was launched back up into the air.
"Hiyah!" Krillin cried out as rushed Bardock before he could recover, his leg swinging wide to deliver a powerful kick.
Bardock however was having none of that, as grabbed Krillin's ankle before it could connect without effort.
"Shoulda stuck to surprise attacks." Bardock growled at him, making Krillin gulp nervously before his opponent fire a ki blast at him from point blank.
"AND KRILLIN IS DOWN! BARDOCK WINS!" The announcer cried out as the duo reappeared in the arena, with a team of healers ready to once again take Krillin to the infirmary as the trio of women follow them.
As before Bardock exited the arena without a care for the fans he has in the audience, merely wondering how long until his next match. As he left though, the Saiyan passed the last two contestants of the second round, Kokoa and Caulifla.
They were the only ones who hadn't fought yet, so it stood to reason they were next up even if their names hadn't been called yet.
"AND HERE WE HAVE THE LAST TWO CONTENDERS FOR THIS ROUND, KOKOA SHUZEN AND CAULIFLA!"
The audience cheered at the two girls as they stepped up onto the stage, both looking ready for battle as they anticipated fighting the other.
"Vampire and Saiyan, both tribes that revel in battle and revere strength. This is going to be an interesting match." Azazel said with an eager grin, while Alex and the girls watched on excitedly from their room.
"How do you think Kokoa's going to do?" Rikku asked Moka curiously. The vampiress pondered her answer for a moment before saying,
"With her healing sealed? Kokoa will probably lose, but she'll definitely put up a good fight until then." Alex nodded in agreement before smirking as he added,
"Well with an ass like this waiting here for her, maybe she'll win!" Smacking Moka's ass as he said that, Alex earned himself numerous eye rolls despite no one refuting his remark.
[DING!]
Cynthia: seeing how strong everyone is makes me want to train with my Pokemon more...
Bestia: I'd like to see that annoying Loki's face if just one of you joined my familia😈
Ty Lee: SO COOL! 😍
Tatsumaki: ...
Yang: HELL YEAH! BEAT THE SNOT OUT OF EACH OTHER!
Saya: I'm curious Alex, why aren't YOU participating?
Yang: 😳
Bestia: 😳
Ty Lee: 😳
Cynthia: 😳
Alex: simple, I'm literally too strong to participate. That's why I'm doing an exhibition match on the last day.
Alex: but I can change that if you don't want to wait.
Shia: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!!!
Moka: don't you dare!
Akua: well, there goes any chance any of us had at winning...
Alex: see?
Saya: point taken...
Shia: so you're NOT going to participate?
Alex: no, and even if I wanted to the participants are already decided.
Moka: crisis averted
Nemesis: you're all pretty scared for 'powerful' warriors😏
Shia: you can always tell when SOMEONE hasn't actually fought Alex before.
Yang: is he really THAT bad?
Shia: he doesn't hold back, even against his own wives...
Alex: equal rights equal fights. Besides, I do hold back enough to not kill them.
Akua: like that's reassuring
...
Alex smiled wryly as he watched the girls chat, before turning his attention back to the match as Kokoa and Caulifla took their respective stances.
They were in the Craggy Valley arena, a dry rocky area with numerous chasms, spires, and caverns large enough they could house an entire city.
The two girls were entirely focused on the other though as they awaited the start of the match, with Kokoa's Kou bat sitting on her wrist to transform at any moment.
"FIGHTER READY? FIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIGHT!"
The second word left the announcer's mouth both Caulifla and Kokoa moved as a giant hammer appeared in the latter's hand.
*CRAAASH!*
A shockwave spread out from the point where they impacted that shattered the massive boulders surrounding them into dust, before the duo separated and clashed over and over again.
Moving faster than the majority of the audience could follow, Kokoa and Caulifla clashed with enough force that they completely destroyed their surroundings each time. But with each clash neither seemed to gain the upper hand as they both quickly broke off to try again.
"Gauntlet form!" Kokoa cried out right as she and Caulifla broke off yet again, prompting the Kou Bat to change its shape as it clad her right hand in a vicious looking gauntlet with spikes.
Caulifla didn't recoil from the new weapon though, as she readily drove her fist into Kokoa's with all her strength.
The result was Kokoa being pushed back as she became overwhelmed by the Saiyaness, but at the same time Caulifla also took damage from the numerous spikes on the gauntlet. Ignoring the numerous puncture wounds on her hand, Caulifla watched as Kokoa skipped across the craggy landscape, before finally coming to a stop as she kicked up a cloud of dust.
The vampiress meanwhile had come to a stop in a comical fashion with her face in the dirt and her panty-clad butt in the air, though these panties were different from the strawberry ones everyone had seen earlier, instead having a cute bat character on the butt.
Either not knowing or not caring that she was flashing everyone her panties, again, Kokoa stood and brushed herself off while cradling her right arm, which had numerous bones broken from the force of Caulifla's hit. Though not a stranger to the pain of being wounded, Kokoa was unused to it not healing within a matter seconds, a couple minutes at the most.
"Tch! That bastard and his stupid rules!" Kokoa swore as she recalled her previous match as well, where Sting's holy energy burned her skin as it tried to purify her. That didn't mean she was without options though, as Kokoa activated her Shinso bloodline.
