"HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!" She cried out as blood began to ooze from her pores, covering most of her body in a seek, but powerful, black armor that similarly reinforced her arm without healing it. At the same time her strength began to skyrocket as the Youkai energy radiating off of her began to multiply.
As Kokoa finished powering up and reinforcing herself, her Kou bat returned as it automatically transitioned into the weapon Kokoa used most in this form; a massive and sinister looking sword longer than she was tall, and was a foot wide. By this point Caulifla had made her over to see the changes to her opponent, and had a large grin on her face as she felt the energy being radiated by Kokoa.
Kokoa meanwhile smirked when she saw and smelled the blood dripping from Caulifla's hand, licking her lips as if she were anticipating a meal.
"You want some? Come and get it!" Caulifla declared when she saw Kokoa looking at her like a predator does its prey, not at all concerned with having her blood drank.
Kokoa's grin only widened as some of her own blood traveled down the length of her colossal sword, before she suddenly disappeared from her current position and reappeared next to Caulifla.
The Saiyaness just barely managed to put her arm up to block the attack, only for Kokoa's sword to slice clean through it as if it were butter. Caulifla then watched as her arm soared through the air, spraying blood as it did so, before Kokoa then snatched it up.
"Thanks for the meal!" She said with a taunting smirk, before licking at the bloodied end of the arm.
Though she grimaced and recoiled form the pain of losing her left arm, Caulifla otherwise kept her cool as she was more than used to fighting with injuries, thanks to Shia. Without the Gods Water to stop the flow of blood though, Caulifla knew she was on a time limit before the blood loss made her pass out, costing her the match.
"Time to get serious!" The Saiyaness declared as she powered up, enveloping herself in a brilliant golden aura as she went right into SSJ2.
Kokoa barely had enough time to throw the arm away and put up her sword to guard, when Caulifla planted a foot into it with enough force that she got sent flying back even worse than before. With her colossal sword flying out of her hand, a pair of bat-like wings spread from Kokoa's back as she halted her somersaulting, and regained her footing.
When she looked up though, Kokoa saw Caulifla holding her sword with her remaining hand, not even seeming bothered by its extreme weight, before throwing it away with all her strength. Even if Kou could just fly back to her in his bat form, it would take quite some time for him to do so.
Disarmed of her weapon, Kokoa got creative as she manipulated her blood to form spikes on her knuckles, just like her earlier gauntlet.
When she tried to attack though, Caulifla effortlessly evaded every single one as if to show the difference between them now, before planting her fist directly into Kokoa's gut.
*SMASH!*
Breaking right through the hardened blood armor covering her body, Caulifla's fist went completely through Kokoa's abdomen and out the other side, creating a grisly scene as Kokoa hung there while impaled. The scene only lasted a split second though, as Caulifla retracted her arm and allowed Kokoa to fall face-first into the ground.
"ONE!"
The announcer began the countdown as it appeared that Kokoa wasn't getting up while Caulifla stood over her. The Saiyaness however watched as a small vial appeared in the other girl's hand, filled with a dark red liquid.
"TWO!"
As the announcer shouted the next number, Kokoa knew this was it. She either drank what was in the vial in her hand, or she lost the match.
Clenching her fist over it, Kokoa threw the vial away with what strength she could muster so that it shattered against one of the nearby rocks, just in time for the announcer to cry out,
"THREE! CAULIFLA WINS!"

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - 489: Goku vs Bardock
chapters.content:
Under a storm of cheers Caulifla and Kokoa reappeared in the middle of the colosseum, the former supporting the latter despite her missing arm.
The second they reappeared though the numerous wounds Kokoa had began to immediately close, while a team of healers appeared to reattach Caulifla's arm as it returned with them. Meanwhile the previously thrown away Kou Bat also returned, and settled on its usual perch atop Kokoa's head.
As they were being seen to, the announcer cried out,
"LETS GIVE IT UP FOR OUR FOUR SEMIFINALISTS!"
As he said that, the images of Goku, Pikkon, Bardock, and Caulifla all appeared in the middle of he colosseum.
This sparked numerous debates as everyone discussed who among the four of them was more likely to win.
To several Pikkon was the more likely since he had displayed the most raw strength, while several others argued that they hadn't seen any of the Saiyans truly get serious yet. Though they had seen Goku and Caulifla both use their SSJ transformations, they both almost immediately ended the match after doing so.
Even as they discussed potential winners though, almost everyone agreed that it would be either Goku or Pikkon, as they were both seeded contestants. But with the other two also being Saiyans, one of which was Goku's own father, people were expecting that the remaining matches to be exciting.
After allowing the audience a few minutes to debate amongst themselves, the announcer continued,
"ALRIGHT THEN! LETS SEE WHO THE FIRST OF OUR SEMIFINALISTS TO DUKE IT OUT WILL BE!"
The spectators waited with bated breaths as the remaining four names rapidly flashed with light, before finally coming to a stop on the two that appeared to be identical.
"AND THE NEXT LINEUP IS, GOKU VERSUS BARDOOOOOOOOOOOOCK!"
As the announcer declared who would be fighting next there was flurry of muttering and discussion. After all, with the general information available regarding each contestant, it was fairly well known that Goku and Bardock were father and son.
Some believed that the lineup had been rigged to give Goku better odds, since there was no way a man would fight his own child at full strength. Those who knew about Saiyans disagreed though, and were more than eager to see the two of them duke it out.
"Guess that's us dad. Good luck!" Goku exclaimed as he started heading out to the arena, with Bardock following him as he quietly uttered,
"You too son."
Together the father-son duo stepped out of the tunnel to be welcomed by the roar of cheers and applause, which Goku responded amicably to while his father remained cold and stoic. This attitude however had actually earned Bardock numerous fans of his own, especially amongst the female demographic.
As the duo stepped up onto the stage the announcer declared,
"AND NOW FOR THE STAGE THEY WILL FIGHT UPON... THE SLEEPLESS CITY!"
As the projection showed a futuristic city at night with numerous skyscrapers, and roadways on different levels, Bardock and Goku found themselves instantly transported to the top of the tallest building around. The lights of the city spread out below them clear until the horizon, making it seem as if it truly was endless.
"I hope we don't hurt anyone..." Goku uttered as he looked around at all the people going too and fro, making Bardock sigh while he shook his head in exasperation. It was obvious they weren't real people since he couldn't feel any energy coming from any of them, but it was apparent that Kakarot didn't realize that.
"FIGHTERS READY?"
At the prompt the duo got in their respective stances, both eyeing the other for signs of openings.
Goku and Bardock had been sparring against one another constantly ever since Alex revived the latter, and both had learned nearly everything about how the other fought. There was no room for messing around or testing the waters here.
"FIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIGHT!"
The second the fight started both Saiyans instantly transformed into their SSJ2 forms so that they became beacons of light in the dark night, lightning arcing off of them as their clashing energy created a superstorm.
*KABOOM!!!*
Thunder sounded to match the lightning as the two clashed, vaporizing the top of the skyscraper from the force they produced while the entire night sky lit up in a brief flash that illuminated the two of them before they disappeared.
*KABOOM!!!*
*KABOOM!!!*
*KABOOM!!!*
*KABOOM!!!*
Over and over again the night sky was filled with light when Goku and Bardock clashed, thunder echoing a second later as the force of their clash wrought destruction upon the city below them.
Sirens wailed and people screamed as destruction rained down upon them, reaping their illusionary lives as the 'gods' continued their clash above.
It was when Goku was briefly distracted by the carnage they were causing below that there was a shift in power, and Bardock landed a hit on his son that sent him flying down into the ground below.
*BOOOOOOOOM!!!*
A shockwave spread out from where Kakarot hit that leveled more buildings and claimed more fake lives, before Bardock followed up by carpet bombing the area around the crater, destroying and claiming many more lives.
"STOP! Can't you see the destruction you're causing!?" Kakarot cried as he crawled out of the rubble, only for Bardock to suddenly appear directly in front of him.
"So?" He answered calmly, as Goku crossed his arms to block his next hit, which sent him flying back even more.
*CRASH!*
More buildings came crashing down as the younger Saiyan was blasted through their lower levels, kicking up storms of dust from the debris that was quickly dispersed by the pressure of Bardock's energy as he casually walked through the destruction.
...
"Man... Goku's getting his butt kicked..." Krillin uttered as he watched the projection alongside the rest of the Dragon Team, as well as with the Kamikaze Fireballs.
"Kakarot's losing because of how weak and soft he is. He had no one else to blame but himself!" Sneered Goku's own elder brother, Raditz, who didn't seem concerned at all about his baby brother's predicament.
Krillin rounded on Raditz as he exclaimed, "big talk for a guy who couldn't even get into the tournament!"
Raditz snarled back at Krillin for the dig, but, before he could respond, someone else said,
"He's not entirely wrong though." Everyone turned to see Vegeta Sr approaching them with future Trunks at his side, both watching the projection intently.
"You just wanna say you're better than Goku too." Krillin scoffed at the former king, who surprisingly shook his head as he stated,
"Not at all. Kakarot is one of, if not THE strongest Saiyan that exists outside of his majesty's family. However he IS too soft if he allows something like this to impact his fighting." There was a moment of silence as everyone thought on the former king's words, before Piccolo uttered,
"Maybe he's got a point though. I mean, Goku isn't exactly a killer like the other Saiyans are." Krillin however surprisingly waved away Piccolo's comment as he stated,
"No no, Goku has killed quite a few people..... Literally an army's worth at least." Yamcha nodded in agreement as he added,
"Remember when he singlehandedly wiped out the Red Ribbon Army? We all got ready and geared up to go to war, and only got there to find out he had already destroyed them..." Tien also agreed as he said,
"He's never been too remorseful about when he does it either. Remember when he killed my master's brother, and didn't care at all about the consequences of doing so?" The stories told by Krillin, Yamcha and Tien surprised the Saiyans and Piccolo, as they couldn't imagine the 'soft' Goku taking a life, while the only person Piccolo knew he had killed was his own father, the evil King Piccolo.
"W-what happened then?" Vegeta Sr. asked, as he couldn't figure out why Kakarot would grow softer as got older.
At first no one had an answer as they watched Goku take a beating from his father, until Piccolo surprised them by saying,
"Actually.... It might be mine and Kami's fault Goku got so soft..." With everyone looking to him for answers, Piccolo groaned before explaining,
"The entire time Kami was training Goku it was specifically to fight me. But, if Goku killed me then he also killed Kami. It's possible Goku began trying to find ways to avoid killing his opponents because of that."
Though it took them a moment to think on Piccolo's theory, Krillin, Yamcha and Tien all released a groan when they realized the truth in his words. Someone else however refuted them, as Raditz stated,
"Bullshit! Kakarot had no problem killing me at the time! And I'm his actual brother!" Piccolo however looked at Raditz like he was an idiot as he said,
"No, I killed you. Goku just held you in place so I could do so." Krillin nodded as he stated irritably,
"Plus you didn't really give us the option for an alternative at the time!" With Yamcha, Tien, and Chiotzu nodding in agreement with while giving Raditz dirty looks, the Saiyan just scoffed while looking away pointedly.
Vegeta Sr however just nodded slowly, as if he expected as much.
"That sounds about right. I've been learning more about Kakarot's past to investigate his strength and background, and to me it sounds as if he's been repressing most of his Saiyan instincts his entire life."
Surprisingly, Raditz spoke up again as he added,
"He also hit his head as a child. It was one of the first things I confirmed after seeing he hadn't taken over that pathetic little planet." Vegeta Sr groaned as he massaged his temples, and said,
"That's gotta be it, or at least the main reason."
As he said that they all turned their attention back to the projection to see Goku take another hit from Bardock, which sent him skipping through numerous buildings into a fresh area of the arena to be destroyed.
"Why is the matter of Goku's Saiyan instinct so important? Gohan and I don't have them and we're ok." Trunks finally spoke up after some thought, to which his grandfather replied,
"Except there is a difference. Saiyans are powerful warriors that will draw out every single drop of their strength when needed. Kakarot however is holding himself back due to his softhearted nature, even if he doesn't realize it."
...
"Is that all?!" Bardock demanded as Goku struggled to get back up onto his feet, his clothes shredded while numerous wounds bled openly across his body.
"I'm so.....disappointed Kakarot." He said in a low voice, before sending his son flying yet again with a kick.
Bardock didn't know what the people watching this fight thought of it, but in his mind it couldn't be considered anything but bullying. However, to him this would only go on for as long as Kakarot refused to fight seriously, and Bardock was merely using this chance to teach his son a lesson.
"H-how? How can you be so cruel to ignore this?" Kakarot asked as Bardock approached him once more, indicating the numerous people running from them and screaming from the destruction.
"I'm a Saiyan." Bardock answered bluntly, before putting an arm up to block Kakarot's wide punch. And as the duo became locked into place, the son said to his father,
"So am I!" Bardock however sneered at his son, and said,
"No, you're not." He then buried his fist into Kakarot's gut, sending him flying backwards yet again as he skipped across the rubble.
"I have cultivated my strength and will from hundreds of battles in which I could've lost my life, and participated in the extinction of numerous races that fought back against their doom just as fiercely as you have. Tell me Kakarot, how many such battles can you say you've fought in? Two? Three? I've fought in hundreds!"
Declaring so, Bardock shot forward an grabbed his son by the neck as he flew up into the air, and pinned him to one of the buildings that were still standing with such force that the entire side of it caved in, raining shards of glass down on them both.
"I've been watching you ever since we reunited Kakarot. You fight for fun, merely to test your strength and see where you measure up, no matter if you'd be the stronger or not. No Saiyan would fight for such a flimsy reason. When you fight, YOU FIGHT TO WIN!"
Shouting at his son, Bardock sent Goku flying through the building yet again, making it come down around him as it crashed to the ground below. The last thing to come falling down was a giant metal statue of a man holding up a large globe, which Bardock caught with one upraised hand.
Scanning the region where Kakarot landed, Bardock took careful aim before tossing the globe up, and kicking it as hard as he could.
Goku was trying to pick himself up from the rubble yet again as he struggled to find his footing, every word his father said ringing through his head as he did so. Goku understood that he knew nothing about 'being a Saiyan', but he had always rationalized that they were cruel and evil anyways.
To Goku fighting was about testing his strength, not proving himself superior, or simply eliminating his enemy. It was his passion, literally what he lived and died for.
If he was the weaker one then he'd just accept that and try harder the next time, unless the fate of the world hung on him winning. There was nothing wrong with that, with accepting a loss and knowing there was room to grow.
Was there?
Goku's mind was so filled with his father's words as he tried to rationalize himself, that he hadn't noticed the giant globe that honed in on him like a deadly missile, until it hit directly in the back of the head.
"OOOOOOOOOOOOH! THAT ONE LOOKED LIKE IT HURT! WILL SON GOKU MANAGE TO GET UP AFTER THAT?!"
The answer apparently was no as Bardock casually walked towards his son's unconscious body, tapping him lightly with his foot as the announcer began the countdown.
"ONE!"
'Is this it Kakarot?' Bardock wondered silently as he waited to see if his son would get up.
"TWO!"
'Apparently so.' Bardock thought to himself as he turned to walk away.
"THR-"
As the announcer began to say the last number though, he cut himself off as something latched on to Bardock's leg.
Looking down, Bardock saw Kakarot's hand holding onto his ankle firmly, as if refusing to let go. When he tried to shake off the hold though, he found himself stunned to feel the grip tightening, almost to the point of breaking his bones.
Just as suddenly though Kakarot released his hold on his ankle before slowly and steadily rising to his feet, his face shrouded in shadow as he did so.
"What is this Kakarot? Some last desperate struggle? It's too late for that!" Swinging his fist with intention of ending the match then and there as he said that, Bardock was stunned further when Kakarot caught it without even looking up.
"I think..... I understand.....now..." Kakarot uttered as Bardock tried to pull his fist away, only for it to remain unmoving in his son's solid grip.
"No......that's not it...." Looking up to reveal his expression for the first time since getting up, Bardock saw an intensity in his son's gaze that he had never seen there before, as he stated with his grip tightening even more,
"I remembered...!"

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - 490: Saiyan Pride
chapters.content:
"Uh, yeah! Of course you missed his birth! Do you have any idea how many months you've been gone?"
"Oh! That explains why your tummy's flat again!"
"I swear...do Saiyan men have anything resembling emotions?"
"The little guy's in the incubator back there. Think you can help me pick out a name?"
"What's wrong now? You've seen a baby before!"
"..."
"Kakarot... We'll call him Kakarot."
"Kakarot! Sure! That's a fine name! Grow up big and strong my little Kakarot!"
...
"You have to stay alive..."
...
After being hit in the head numerous images and voices flashed through Goku's mind as he laid there nearly unconscious, images and voices he now knew belonged to when he was a baby.
He could hear the day he was given his name, given to him by his father.
He recalled the day he opened his eyes while in the pod to see his father returning injured, but even then he placed his hand against the pod and smiled upon seeing his son.
His father leaving on another mission while his mother and a child Raditz saw him off.
His mother working around the house, or when other Saiyan women would visit her. And when she'd fall asleep at the table waiting for Bardock to come home.
The final set of memories going through his mind was of Bardock and Gine taking Goku out of the incubation pod, dressing him in Saiyan battle armor, and placing him into a space pod to be sent away.
"Stay alive..."
Those were the last words he'd ever heard from his parents before they died, and before he hit his head to lose all memory of them, until they were revived decades later.
Even then though Goku hadn't remembered his life before being sent to planet Earth, where he was raised as a human.
But now, now everything was coming back him with crystal clear clarity, and several pieces that he hadn't even known were out of place righted themselves within him.
"Kakarot?" Bardock asked him as Goku held his fist with a tightening grip.
Goku looked up at his father, smirked, and punched him with his free hand to send him flying.
"AND WHAT A COMEBACK! SON GOKU HAS NOW RETURNED FIRE LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!" The announcer cried out as people leapt up in surprise from the sudden reversal, while some others said it was just a lucky hit.
As his father was sent flying, Goku shook out his arms and legs to loosen them up again after the beating he'd taken. He then took in a deep breath before re-tensing the muscles in his body.
For quite a while now Goku had been struggling with something, and he had no idea what he was supposed to do to get to the next level. Now however, Goku felt as if he could pull it off as he began channeling his energy.
"Haaa, AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA-"
Roaring at the top of his voice, Goku's energy exploded outwards as he became enveloped in golden light so intense, it was like he had become a miniature sun. The effects of his transformation didn't stop there though, as the entire arena began to shake in response to Goku's rapidly rising energy levels, while the colosseum outside also began to shudder slightly.
Alex looked up in alarm as he watched the phenomenon taking place, a large smile forming at what Goku was doing.
"Finally." He uttered in excitement at how much closer Goku was getting to him, before saying to Whis via telepathy,
"Goku should have a much easier time with his training now."
"Indeed. It looks as if Goku-San managed resolve the conflict in his heart. Perhaps we should eat some delicious food together to celebrate?" For a moment Whis was left standing in silence as he awaited Alex's answer, while he also started salivating at the thought of the delicious he saw and smelled in Alex's room earlier.
When he was beginning to think he was being ignored, Whis suddenly received a message on his scepter that he quickly opened to see if that was a yes. Unfortunately for him though, the message was a picture from his sister Kusu that showed her sitting on Alex's face while Vados bounced up and down on his cock, and Marcarita was eagerly licking the place where they were connected.
"A simple no would've sufficed..." Whis grumbled to himself after seeing the picture, his appetite suddenly gone.
Though the picture was taken earlier, Whis had no way to know that as he turned his attention back to the projection of Goku's still ongoing transformation. The brilliant light of the golden sun had slowly begun to die down after sustaining itself for several minutes, and when it finally faded entirely the projection showed Goku in his new form.
"And this-" Anne began as everyone saw the changes that Goku had undergone, "-is the the Super Saiyan 3."
As the projection focused and did a close-up on Goku himself, it showed him with an exaggeratedly extended brow ridge, and a much greater muscle volume than he had before. Most noticeably though, was the golden hair that now flowed down his back all the way to his butt.
Even as he seemingly stood there doing nothing, powerful waves of golden energy radiated from Goku's body that pierced the veil of night to turn night into day, while arcs of lightning continuously sparked to life around him.
"You actually did it Kakarot..." Bardock uttered in amazement as he returned after recovering from the earlier hit, before smirking as he asked, "so what did you 'remember'?"
This time Goku smirked as he looked up at his father, before saying bluntly, "my pride."
Bardock could only blink at that, but in the microsecond it took for his eyes to do so, he opened them to see his son's fist directly in front of his face.
*KABOOM!*
Again, Bardock was sent flying back from a hit unlike one he had ever taken before, a hit that had instantly shattered several of his bones. The hit was so powerful, that Bardock was sent flying back past the area they had originally started fighting, and to an entirely new area where his body smashed through dozens of buildings.
Before he could crash into the ground below though, Bardock was suddenly hit again to be sent flying in an entirely new direction, carving a new path of destruction with his body until he was hit again. And again.
With Kakarot moving at speeds he couldn't even process, Bardock was completely helpless in the face of the might of a SSJ3. And, despite his best efforts, soon lost consciousness when he was kicked directly down into the ground below.
"L-LADIES AND GENTLEMEN... SON GOKU WIIIIIIIIIIIIIINS!"
The announcer cried out with a voice full of shock as the two Saiyans were returned to the colosseum, and Bardock was immediately carted away for medical attention with Goku not too far behind him.
There, they were quickly met by Gine with Goten in her arms as she hurried to her husband's side.
"Bardock...." Gine uttered as she watched over Bardock, who had already been treated by Anne's exceptional team and was simply still asleep.
Goku, who had also similarly been treated, stood by her while even Raditz arrived and stoically stood opposite them.
"Kakarot....." Bardock muttered as he regained consciousness, alerting everyone as Goku stepped up and said,
"Yes dad?"
Seeing his son, Bardock smiled and said while gripping his forearm,
"Good match son. You made me proud today." Similarly gripping his father's forearm, Goku replied,
"Thanks dad..... For reminding me what Saiyan Pride means." When he heard that though, Bardock just snorted as he said,
"If you remembered that then you better win this tournament. Anything else is unacceptable for a Saiyan." Tightening his grip as he said that, Goku nodded in affirmation as he said,
"I will." Seeing and hearing a conviction in his son's tone and eyes that hadn't been there before, Bardock smiled as he released his grip and said while laying back,
"Good then."
***
As the family was relaxing after two of them fought a hard match, the next and last round before the final was getting under way as both Caulifla and Pikkon stepped up to the arena.
"AND HERE WE ARE LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! THE FINALE BEFORE FINALE! THE SECOND OF OUR SEMIFINAL MATCHES, BEFORE WE MOVE ON TO TODAYS FINALS! CAULIFLA VERSUS PIKKON!"
The entire arena shook with the cheers from the audience as they eagerly welcomed the next match, and the images of the two contestants were projected so that they looked like Giants in the middle of the colosseum.
Along with them was the image of the place they were going to fight, and endless field of long green grass that waved in the wind.
Immediately Caulifla and Pikkon were both transported to the arena, where the latter simply acted in his usual stoic manner while Caulifla casually swung her arms around to loosen them up.
"Try not to lose too quickly!" She taunted with a smirk, to which her opponent replied stoically,
"I would ask the same of you, Saiyan. Though, unless you can use the same transformation as Son Goku, I will not be expecting much." His comment made Caulifla's brow twitch as she asked irritably,
"You wanna know the difference between myself and Goku?" Pikkon wordlessly tilted his head in curiosity, even as the announcer told them to get ready.
"My training partner is a bimbo bunny."
"FIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIGHT!"
The moment the fight started Caulifla transformed in an instant and shot forward, viciously sinking her fist into Pikkon's stomach.....or so she thought.
"Perhaps this will be interesting after all..." Pikkon uttered as the muscles in his body tensed, before he returned Caulifla's attack back at her.
...
People watched with awe-filled expressions as the battle between Caulifla and Pikkon went on, as neither backed down even after nearly an hour had passed.
Every time Pikkon knocked Caulifla down she would simply get back up stronger than before, even as her body accrued more and more injuries, and returned the favor with interest as her opponent received his first injuries in the tournament.
The arena they had found themselves in had long since gone from an endless pastoral green field, to a ragged battleground that had been ravaged beyond repair.
But even as they both sustained horrific injuries, and the landscape around them was devastated, neither fighter backed down as they fervently tried to defeat the other, pushing themselves literally until the brink of death.
It was only after the hour marker passed that the match finally came to an end, but even then the losing party remained standing despite losing consciousness, their sheer will refusing to bow even now.
"I-I CAN'T BELIEVE IT LADIES AND GENTLEMEN.... CAULIFLA WIIIIIIIIIIINS!"
The announcer roared as the Saiyaness heaved her chest, her body on its last legs with more bones broken than not, and vicious lacerations crisscrossing much of her body. But despite that all, Caulifla had a massive smile on her face with the knowledge that she won, before she too lost consciousness as the strength left her body and she fell forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - 491: Return of the Ancients
chapters.content:
When Caulifla's eyes opened she bolted straight up in the infirmary bed, surrounded by the women who were a part of her clan, and demanded, "Did I win?"
"Of course you won big sis!"
"Next up is the final match between you and Son Goku."
"There's an hour long break before the next round starts, so you can relax big sis."
Even as her five followers tried to relieve her concerns, Caulifla barely heard them as she opened her Chatroom quest page.
There Caulifla saw that she had completed the sudden quest she had received during her fight with Pikkon, and when she saw the amount of shop points she received from it a wicked grin formed on her face. She had gained just enough points to buy the one thing she wanted from the Chatroom shop, and apparently had the time to buy it before she fought against Goku.
Leaping up from the bed she was in, Caulifla swiftly left the room without so much as a backwards glance as she declared, "Don't follow me!"
Leaving her clan behind, Caulifla immediately set out to find an unoccupied room in which to make her purchase, which she quickly found as a door automatically opened right as she was about to pass it.
A brief nod of her head conveyed Caulifla's thanks to Alex as she entered the room, and sat down to open the Chatroom shop once again. With a thought she arrived at the item in particular that she had wanted, a malicious smile forming on her face.
While Caulifla thought it would've taken her forever to build up the points needed to buy it when she first discovered it, she had quickly racked up plenty of points by taking on every single quest she could since getting access to the Chatroom. Still falling quite short of what she needed though, the sudden quest she received from fighting Pikkon had given Caulifla the final push she needed to attain it.
And now, when she was about to face a SSJ3 as a mere SSJ2, Caulifla knew this was the perfect chance to buy it and power up.
So, without any pomp or ceremony, Caulifla confirmed her purchase as she prepared for whatever came next. Unfortunately for her, Caulifla was instantly subjected to the most intense pain she ever experienced as every single cell in her body was broken down.
***
"AND WELCOME BACK EVERYBODY, AS WE FINALLY ENTER THE FINAL STAGE OF THE TOURNAMENT TODAY!"
The announcer cried out as deafening cheers answered him, before he continued,
"AND NOW WE WILL SEE WHO WILL BE THE FIRST TO GO ON TO FIGHT ON THE FINAL DAY OF THE UNIVERSAL GRAND TOURNAMENT! WILL IT BE OUR REMAINING SEEDED CONTESTANT, SON GOKU?????? OR WILL IT BE THE DARK HORSE THAT DEALT SUCH A DEVASTATING DEFEAT TO OUR OTHER SEEDED CONTESTANT? CAULIFLA!!!!!!!!!"
When Goku entered the arena he was welcomed by a storm of cheers and applause as flower petals rained down onto him from above, however he behaved more like Bardock in that he was focused entirely on the impending match.
As Goku made his way to the center stage though, his opponent wasn't anywhere to be seen.
"CONTESTANT CAULIFLA?" The announcer inquired hesitantly as people began to note her absence, their minds immediately going to Krillin earlier as they began to grumble irritably.
Just as the announcer was about to ask for a search party to find her, a single figure exited the tunnel leading to arena.
"AND HERE SHE IS LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! CAULIFLA!"
Though there were a few scattered applause at Caulifla's entrance, the majority of spectators were focused on how the Saiyaness currently looked.
Her movements were sluggish while also seeming unsteady on her feet, and her skin was unnaturally pale while her breathing was ragged. Curiously though, her hair seemed darker in color and wilder, while the irises of her eyes had become a piercing red.
Something else that only Goku and those who were close enough to her noticed was that Caulifla's Ki had changed entirely, and now felt alien and sinister to him.
"What happened to you?" Goku asked her with traces of worry in his tone, which made Caulifla sneer as she replied,
"I'm gonna kick your ass, that's what happened to me!" Goku furrowed his brows at her snide remark, but didn't say anything else as he got ready for their fight. While his 'pride' wouldn't allow Goku to fight someone who wasn't at full strength, if Caulifla was still so confident though, then he'd fight her at his full strength.
Up in his VIP room, Alex was sitting up a little straighter as he watched every one of Caulifla's movements carefully.
While he was privy to what she bought on the Chatroom shop, Alex knew nothing about it beyond the description given in the shop. Needless to say he was VERY interested in the fight that was about to happen.
"AND NOW, LET THE FINAL MATCH BEGIN!"
As the announcer declared that both Goku and Caulifla disappeared, before appearing on a square stage floating in the skies, reminding Goku of Kami's lookout on earth. Thankfully, unlike the similar arenas that had been shown so far, their ability to fly wasn't limited on this stage.
"Just a word of advice..." Caulifla said to Goku as the announcer told them to get ready. "You might want to go all out from the start."
"FIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIGHT!"
"HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!"
The moment the match began Caulifla released a feral cry as the sinister Ki Goku had sensed within her body exploded outwards to give her a reddish-black aura, nearly forcing him off the stage as a suffocating pressure descended upon him.
Goku watched as Caulifla started to grow taller as her energy increased, her muscles growing in mass while her hair grew longer until it reached the back of her knees, and a single strand of it came down in front of her face.
Back in the colosseum, the Grand Supreme Kai stood up from his seat in alarm as he watched Caulifla transform, uttering as he did so, "An Ancient Evil Saiyan..."
"What was that?" Azazel asked him, not having heard exactly what the Grand Supreme Kai said.
With the attention of everyone turning towards him, the Grand Supreme Kai explained,
"It appears as if miss Caulifla has somehow turned herself into an ancient variant of the Saiyan race, the Evil Saiyans to be exact.
"Existing far into the past, the Ancient Saiyans of Universe Seven began a civil war as they split into two factions, the Evil and God race. The God race of Saiyans were descended from a legendary figure that managed to achieve godly Ki, and followed their ideals of justice and righteousness.
"Though they never attained the same divine Ki their ancestor did, the God Race Saiyans devoted themselves to following their ancestors ideals, and strove to obtain the same divine power. Unfortunately they were few in number, and were wiped out by their Evil cousins who later simply referred to them as 'the defeated'. It was also these Evil Saiyans that the modern day Saiyans of Universe Seven are descended from."
The Grand Supreme Kai had a concerned look on his chubby face as he watched Caulifla make her transformation, showing how worried he was of the return of the 'Evil Saiyans'.
Meanwhile, within the space-time orb, Sala was clenching her fists as she watched her rival ascend to a higher level, her frustration growing. Closing the Chatroom, Sala turned about and went to complete her current quest in order to earn more points, the drive within her to buy the godly Ki in the shop growing even more to catch up with Caulifla.
...
As he watched Caulifla transform before him, and felt the power she was radiating, Goku's heart began to pound in excitement as he quickly channeled his own Ki to go straight to his SSJ3.
Instantly golden light combated Caulifla's Evil Energy as they clashed, creating a swirling and violent storm that tore apart the stage they were standing on.
*KABOOOOOOOOOOOOM!*
Suddenly an impact so intense that it tore apart what little remained of the stage they were on, while even the colosseum outside of their arena began to shudder from the force. While a few people grew alarmed from the sudden shaking they were feeling, everyone else was focused intently on the projection before them as the previously tranquil blue skies were filled with hundreds of shockwaves.
Again and again two similar figures, one shrouded in darkness while the other was shrouded in golden light, clashed with enough force to shake the heavens themselves, both moving too fast for the spectators to follow.
*BOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOMBOOM*
Again and again Goku and Caulifla clashed with enough force that even the colosseum shuddered as they fought for supremacy, until they finally clashed one last time to lock hands and engage in a contest of raw strength.
"I don't know what technique you're using.....but it's really powerful!" Goku gritted his teeth as he struggled against Caulifla's strength, before he was shocked to feel himself getting pushed back.
"You better hope....that I don't learn how to use it too quickly!" Caulifla smirked back at him, as she had spent each second of the fight so far adjusting to her newfound strength, and was eager to see just how far it went.
Before Goku could figure out what she was talking about though, Caulifla's dark energy seemed to come alive as it moved away from her body to form an appendage with five fingers. As his mind briefly stalled at the sudden development, the fingers closed in on themselves to create a fist that sucker punched Goku in the face with just as much force as Caulifla herself, if not more.
With his concentration slipping, Caulifla used the opening to bring her knee up directly into Goku's chin, stunning him as she brought her feet together and slammed the bottom of them into his chest to send him flying back with the force of the impact. Then, before Goku could recover, Caulifla hit him again, and again as her speed and strength seemed to continue to rise.
"AMAZING! CAULIFLA, WHO COULD BE CONSIDERED THE DARK HORSE IN THIS MATCH, IS BEGINNING TO COMPLETELY TOY WITH THE SSJ3 SON GOKU NOW! JUST WHERE WAS SHE HIDING THIS STRENGTH BEFORE!?!"
Oblivious to the announcer's amazement, Caulifla began to rain down a series of blows upon Goku without giving him a chance to recover, dealing a devastating amount of damage to his body as she did so. And as she delivered a beating upon her opponent, Caulifla was getting increasingly used to her newfound strength as the Evil Ki surged through her body, and filled her with strength.
"HA!" Goku suddenly cried out, as Caulifla felt his energy assault her body while it tried to seal her movements.
The effect lasted only a mere second or two due to it surprising her, but it was long enough for Goku to put his hands together to gather energy as he quickly cried out,
"Kamehame-"
Before he could finish his attack though, Caulifla broke free of her restraints as she too gathered her Evil Ki to fire it at Goku, crying out as she did so, "TASTE THIS!"
Right as her attack was about to connect though, Goku suddenly vanished from her view along with his prepared Kamehameha, only for a voice to cry out directly behind her,
"HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!"
Caulifla didn't even have time to turn around as the mass of pure energy struck her from behind, shooting her forwards like a rocket while she couldn't escape.
With enough energy to vaporize a galaxy behind her, Caulifla soon found herself being shot out of the far off boundary of the arena, and the announcer's voice cried out,
"CAULIFLA IS OUT OF BOUNDS! SON GOKU WINS!"
Having expended every drop of energy in his body with that attack, on top of the insane Ki consumption of SSJ3 to begin with, Goku involuntarily reverted to his base form looking exhausted, but pleased with himself as he raised his arms victoriously.
The next moment Goku found himself back in the colosseum alongside Caulifla, where the duo were greeted with a hail of cheers as people applauded the amazing match. While they were all celebrating and congratulating Goku though, a certain Saiyaness was glaring daggers into his back.
With dangerous thoughts passing through her mind, Caulifla began to channel her Evil Ki into a strike at Goku's exposed back, only for someone to suddenly grab her wrist in a firm grip, while dispelling her Ki.
"Let g-!" Caulifla started to snarl as she whirled on the one who grabbed her, only to see Alex standing there with a stern expression, and disappointment in his eyes.
"Do not let it control you Caulifla." He said in low but firm voice, shocking the Saiyaness as she thought back to what she was about to do.
With her teeth and fists clenched, Caulifla yanked her arm free of Alex's grasp before storming off and away from the colosseum. Thankfully, she was on her way to space-time orb, where she intended to fully master the user of her new powers, without risk of them using her instead.
As she stormed off though, Alex turned to Goku and said apologetically,
"Sorry about that. She's just learning how to use her new Evil energy." Though he nodded in understanding, Goku then asked him,
"Aren't you worried about her becoming evil with that power?" Surprisingly, Alex just smirked as if he found the question humorous, as he replied,
"If she can't control it, then I'll take the power away until she can. But no I'm not worried, she'll have some good teachers watching over her." As Alex spoke, he could feel Vados following Caulifla in order to do just that, as he fully trusted the angel to handle any potential 'complications' with the Saiyaness' newfound powers.
"But that's not important right now." Alex then said suddenly, before grabbing Goku's arm and throwing it up in a celebratory manner, and crying out,
"PRESENTING, THE FIRST SEMIFINALIST OF THE UNIVERSAL GRAND TOURNAMENT! SON GOKUUUUUUUUUUUUU!"

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - 492: It's the End of the World as we Know it!
chapters.content:
As the first actual day of the tournament came to a close, there was a buzz of excitement throughout Pangea as people discussed the days events, and what the next four days held for them.
The biggest topic of course was the fights they had already seen that day. There had been many opinions and comments thrown around regarding the results of the first day of the tournament, ranging from some fighters being cheated, or others cheating like Caulifla.
There was no shortage of people who called her victory against Pikkon a 'fluke', while several others were insisting that she(or Alex himself) must've cheated in the final round to be able to fight on par with the SSJ3 Goku. Many of the Saiyaness' fans however argued on her behalf, claiming that if she cheated she would've been caught, and even insisted that she must've been hiding her true power for the final round.
With how heated these and other discussions would become, there was no shortage of excitement as numerous fights broke out outside the colosseum. Thankfully the Valkyries and Saiyans from Sadala were on patrol, so any issues were quickly resolved.
On the other hand, numerous merchants had also popped up throughout Pangea as they tried to sell a number of different products and souvenirs based off of the tournament. Masks, figurines, toy weapons, fake vampire teeth, and even artifacts that mimicked the SSJ transformation were being sold all over, courtesy of the vendors belonging to the Phenix and Gremory families.
There was even a certain trio of women who were also taking advantage of the crowds to sell merchandise of a more dubious nature, Dragon Dick Dildos.
Suzu, Aika Kiryuu, and Momioka Risa were out in force as they tried spreading as much of their merchandise as possible throughout Universe Seven. Exclusively to female clientele of course, Alex would never forgive them if they sold their products to men of a certain persuasion.
With their entire stock selling out in under an hour, the three girls had to resort to accepting orders from their customers that would be sent to them after they could make the product, which they only later realized meant tons of paperwork for them.
And then there were the actual contestants who fought in the tournament.
While several had slipped away for one reason or another, those who hadn't were being swarmed by their new fans. With the tournament being broadcasted throughout Universe Seven, Asora, Earthland, Spira, and the DXD realms, it wasn't an understatement to say they were probably the most famous celebrities in any of the world's histories.
Those who managed to escape the swarms though included Goku, who had resumed his training with Whis within Kusu's scepter, and the girls as they swiftly retreated to the space-time orb alongside Alex for the rest of the day and evening.
Inside, everyone aside from the patrolling Valkyries was gathered within the courtyard of the villa, while Mikan and Haruna had rallied the cooks to prepare a great feast to celebrate the first day of the tournament, as well as those who participated in it.
"Alright everyone! Let's raise our glasses to Rana, Kokoa, and Caulifla for their efforts today!" Alex cried out as all the ladies and children followed his lead, even as the three girls in question sulked.
"Rub salt in it, why don't you?" Kokoa snapped due to her wounded pride, while Caulifla was irritable from being pulled away from her training, and Rana felt disappointed since she was knocked out in the first round.
Alex however shook his head as he told them,
"No mater the results, all of you should feel proud of yourselves. Each one of you showed entire universes what you were capable of, and the only reason any of you got knocked out was because of chance circumstance. None of you should let the shame of losing fester unhealthily, instead use it to improve yourselves for the next time, and show them all what you're capable of!"
As Alex said that both Kokoa and Rana seemed to actually pep up a bit, while Caulifla became increasingly dejected.
She had already confirmed that she had become stronger than Goku in his SSJ3 form when she used her Evil Saiyan form, but because she had no time to adapt to her newfound strength, he was able to last long enough to get a lucky shot that sent her out of bounds. Even now, a short while after the match had ended, Caulifla knew that if she fought Goku again it would have a VERY different result.
The only reason she was even at this feast was because she had been dragged here by Vados, and knew that Alex wouldn't let her get up and storm off like she wanted to.
Even as Caulifla's mood soured because of her match, everyone else's spirits lifted as they ate and drank their fill. Eventually though, even Caulifla's mood lifted somewhat as the children badgered her about her new form and powers, all of them talking to about how cool she was.
As minutes and then hours slipped by things became increasingly festive around the villa as everyone celebrated the success of the tournament, until the children were eventually taken to bed for the night. Then things REALLY started getting out of control as food started getting thrown around, and clothes started coming off.
It was only much, MUCH, later that things started settling down as Alex and the girls were reclined back, while a few were licking any remaining frosting off his balls.
Those that were still awake, and weren't religiously licking Alex's scrotum, were idly messing around on the Chatroom when a certain someone suddenly popped up on it.
[DING!]
Robin: hello everyone, have I missed anything interesting?
Alex: there you are. I was wondering why you were so quiet today Robin.
Robin: we were quite busy today...
...
Robin then surprised everyone by posting a series of videos showing the things she and her crew mates had been experiencing throughout the day, while they had all been watching the tournament.
Firstly was them simply sitting in an empty stretch of ocean as if they were waiting for something, when a group of people on a raft sailed close to the three gathered ships. There was a bit of back and forth between the two groups, as the ones on the raft showed Luffy and the swordsman, Zoro, their new bounties, before the sea beneath them began to rumble.
Before a fight could break out though, the ocean below the Straw Hats and the two ships belonging to the Saruyama Alliance exploded upwards as the rare phenomenon known in their world as the 'Knock Up Stream' sent the three of them flying skywards.
While the vast majority of ships and crews would be battered to death by this experience, the Straw Hats amazing navigator Nami barked her orders to the three ships as they sailed up the massive pillar of water.
Soon the water pillar shot them through the clouds, up to a sea of white filled with alien species of fish that were light and buoyant.
What followed was a rapid series of events as the crew sniper, Usopp, nearly swam through the bottom of the White Sea, the three crews were attacked by a masked guerrilla. They were then saved by an elderly knight on a flying horse called Gan Fall and Pierre, before moving on to a place known as Heavens Gate that marked the entrance to Skypiea.
After interacting with a few of the locals, people with small angel-like wings on their backs, the three crews were then marked as criminals for not paying the entrance fee at Heavens Gate. The three ships were then taken to the nearby island of Upper Yard, where the god of Skypiea resided, while several members of the three crews had to follow them from Angel Island while being forced to undergo one of the Ordeals created by the god Enel's followers.
Robin and the others who were captured however, had been taken to a Sacrificial Altar in the center of Upper Yard, which they then decided to explore while their doctor Tony Tony Chopper, guarded the ships.
After exploring and several battles, the three crews reunited and shared their information to confirm that the island Upper Yard, was in fact formerly a part of the island they had just been at, Jaya. They had also concluded that the fabled city of gold that the infamous lier Norland was executed for, was located somewhere in Upper Yard instead of at the bottom of the see like Cricket, Norland's descendant, thought.
Robin: after we concluded that, old man Cricket broke down in tears before we began talking about finding the city to take the gold.
Alex: well, pirates will always pirate
Robin: 😊
Gabriel: phony angels and God...
Alex: it's not actually God, in Skypiea it's just a title like King or emperor. Enel is just batshit crazy though.
Robin: regardless, I hope we don't run into him tomorrow. According to Gan Fall, he's practically invincible.
Alex: he has the Goro Goro No Mi Devil Fruit powers.

"All clear up here my lady!" Kota replied lightly, though the occasional gunshot that came from him didn't help them stay quiet at all.
Between them, the girls of the class were anxiously looking around and wringing their hands, but thanks to Saya and Kouta, none of them had to worry.
Kouta had spent a month in America learning under a civilian militia known as the Black Hawks, giving him the training needed to expertly handle firearms, as well as the knowledge to check every room they passed to avoid ambushes. Saya meanwhile had only a few days of practice with firearms, but with her intellect she picked up everything she needed within a few hours, and even if she wasn't as accurate as Kouta yet the scatter of the shotgun she used covered her accuracy for her.
"We got a group ahead!" Kouta cried out after a while, making Saya and her shotgun switch places with him, before she pointed it at the group of living corpses.
"Eat shit." She growled at them while bracing herself, before pulling the trigger and creating a shower of gore and bone as the bodies exploded.
Saya smirked at the destruction she caused, but it swiftly turned into a frown as several more corpses started lumbering towards her.
"Persistent cockroaches." She muttered while loading the next shell, before letting the shotgun bark two more times.
By this point all of Them that had been a part of the group had been completely destroyed, casting an eerie silence on the hallway before the door that They had been gathered at slowly opened. Saya quickly brought her shotgun up to aim it at whatever was coming through the door, but caught herself just before pulling the trigger when she saw a group of girls coming out.
"Is it safe?" One of them asked cautiously, before they all eyed the gun in Saya's hands. And though she lowered it slightly, Saya never took her finger off the trigger as she barked at them,
"Were any of you bitten?" All of the girls in the group quickly shook their heads as one of them stated,
"No! None of us were bitten, we ran into the bathrooms to hide from the crowds when everyone stampeded!" With the rest of the girls behind her nodding in affirmation, Saya was inclined to believe them. But she recalled from zombie movies that she had watched in the past that people were prone to lying about being bitten, despite knowing that there was no hope for them.
"Strip." She ordered them, making the group look at her dumbly, before Saya cocked her gun and repeated, "I said strip!"
Flinching in the face of the gun, tears formed in the girls eyes as they slowly started undoing the top part of their uniforms.
"U-um Takagi-San..... Is this necessary?" One of the girls behind her asked warily, to which Saya replied without taking her eyes off of the group ahead of them,
"Of course. People are prone to lying if they think it'll help them, even if they're obviously doomed. I'm not going to blindly believe them just to have someone take a bite out of me." Saya's logic, combined with the gun in her hands, made it impossible to argue with her. Though the girls also wished she had more understanding, as Kouta was unable to peel his eyes away from the strip show taking place before him.
Soon enough the girls were standing there in just their bras and panties, not a single scratch on their smooth skin. It was only then that Saya relaxed the tension in her body as she said,
"I'm sorry, but I had to be sure. Get dressed and we'll keep moving." The group of girls sighed with relief as they quickly put their clothes back on, and soon they were on their way once more to the nurses office.
As the group traveled they encountered numerous groups of Them, though they were eliminated in short order by the guns says and Kouta were using, the narrow halls making it like shooting fish in a barrel for them. They also encountered a few more groups of survivors, who had taken refuge during the mass panic that got the majority of the students killed.
Curiously enough, all the survivors they encountered were girls, but Saya couldn't think about that just now as a commotion up ahead drew her attention.
"That's the nurses office!" She exclaimed as they all rushed forward, about thirty girls and Kouta in all, only to find that the fighting had ended right before they could arrive.
"Oh? Reinforcements?" One of the two women in the room asked coolly, her straight and long dark purple hair flowing to her thighs. Standing nearly half a foot shorter than her, Saya recognized the girl as the captain of the kendo club, and one of the people Alex told her to find, Busujima Saeko.
Behind her was the school nurse, doing justice to the ditzy blond archetype, Shizuka Marikawa, another one of the people Alex told her of. But beside her, on the ground, was one of their male classmates who was covered in bite marks.
Kneeling next to him, Saeko said,
"I'm captain of the kendo club, Busujima Saeko. What is your name?" The man looked at her confusedly for a second before saying,
"K-Kazu Ishii." Nodding in affirmation, Saeko continued,
"Ishii-Kun. You showed great courage in protecting Marikawa-Sensei, but you've also seen what happens to those who are bitten. Do you want your family to see you that way?" Ishia shook his head at her, making Saeko nod her head slowly in affirmation, before standing and readying her wooden Bokken sword.
"I have never killed someone before, but I will help you."
"Wait! What are you doing!?" Shizuka demanded as Saeko prepared to kill the boy, while several of the girls behind Saya gasped and averted their eyes.
"Marikawa-Sensei, I'll have to ask you not to interfere. Protecting a man's honor, is the very source of pride for a woman." Saeko said with finality, Ishii smiling up at her with gratitude in his eyes that he wouldn't turn into one of Them.
Her sword raised, Saeko swung to deliver the killing blow only to stop short of killing Ishii. Or rather, something made her stop.
"Well put." A man's voice said, drawing everyone's attention to the source. Standing there to the side was a hulking man covered in red fur with a wild mane of pitch black hair.
The second she laid eyes on him the edge of Saeko's mouth curled up in a half grin, her sadistic instincts sounding the alarms as she felt a killer's energy radiating from him.
'What a man...' Was all she thought, as she unconsciously licked her lips.
Someone else however was having a notably different reaction.
When she saw Takashi earlier Saya thought her heart had skipped a beat or two, but this time she KNEW it did, while a fluttery sensation filled her belly. The next thing Saya knew she was rushing towards him and crying out,
"ALEX!"
If that had surprised them, nothing would've prepared the group to see the large man suddenly move faster than any of them could follow, meeting Saya halfway as he leaned down to her level, and kissed her.
Jaws dropped and eyes were as wide as dinner plates, though Kouta was sobbing, as Saya and the man, Alex, made out like lovers reunited after years apart, when in fact this was their first time meeting. And even though he had been the one to kiss her, Saya surprised even herself as she reciprocated it entirely, not even once thinking about Takashi.

Alex smile warmly at her, before his entire demeanor shifted as he held her close, one of his hands shamelessly grabbing her ass in front of everybody as he did so, before he told her,
"Of course. I told you already, I was coming for this booty. And now I intend to collect."

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - 494: Samurai of the Dead
chapters.content:

So, seeing her acting a like a meek little kitten in the hands of the mysterious, and handsome, stranger, the crowd of spectators couldn't help but have their curiosity peaked. However, they would have to wait a bit longer for answers as a round of horrendous coughing drew everyone's attention back to the dying Kazu Ishii.
"Right. Forgot you were dying there." Alex said as he broke off the kiss and looked at Ishii, before adding, "can you take care of him Yuna? I want to see if the White Mage is effective here."
It was only then the group that had been following Saya realized there was another group with Alex, notably smaller with only four people, two of which they recognized. The other two however were completely unknown to them, though many of the female students had their breath taken away by how beautiful they both were, particularly the doll-like girl who was currently reading a book.
The other girl however rushed forward urgently, her braid swaying behind her as she hurried.
"Stay with us!" The girl, Yuna, exclaimed as her entire body was suddenly engulfed in light, before it shattered to reveal an entirely different set of clothes on her body.

Even Marikawa-Sensei, who he'd literally given his life for to give her a chance to escape, hadn't even known his name.
Taking his right hand in both of hers, Ishii instantly fell in love as she seemed to pray with all her might,
"Esuna!"
Ishii was so close to death, that he imagined a bright light surrounding the beautiful woman as she prayed. The scene was so serene and beautiful that he felt as if he were being healed as he sat there, with the pain ravaging his body lessening drastically.
Ishii believed he was imaging the whole thing even as the woman then said as the light surrounding her intensified,
"Curaga!"
Ishii's entire body was bathed in blinding light as she declared that, and the remaining pain he was feeling disappeared entirely as he ascended to Heaven... Or not.
Instead of dying and going to Heaven like he thought, the light around Ishii died down to reveal that the numerous bite marks on his body had disappeared, leaving smooth and unblemished skin under the bloody holes in his uniform.
"Huh? I'm not dead?" He uttered as he examined his body, suddenly having marginally more energy than he had a second ago.
"It worked!" Yuna happily exclaimed as she let go of his hand, and leapt up and down excitedly.
Alex meanwhile nodded as if he had confirmed something, while Yami glanced up in passing interest before returning her attention to her book. Everyone else though, they all gaped at the miracle that had taken place as Ishii stood up and looked himself over in disbelief.
Finally seeming to realize that he was no longer dying, Ishii tried to thank his goddess only to see her skip back to the large and strangely hairy man, who then kissed her in front of everyone.
"Well done Yuna." Alex told her after breaking off the kiss, making Yuna sway her body shyly from the public affection, though there was a happy smile on her face.
Ishii on the other hand felt his heart shatter into a million pieces as he watched his goddess swoon in the arms of another man.
"U-um, sorry to interrupt.... But who are you? And are you here to save us?" One of the girls asked curiously, hope in her eyes after watching Yuna cure someone who had been bitten.
Looking up, Alex saw her and every other girl present, both in the office and in the hallway, looking at him hopefully. Alex smiled back at them, making their smiles widen before he said,
"Nop~e."
Alex ignored their shocked expressions as he conjured a cushy armchair to sit in, with Saya sitting in his lap while Yuna took one of the armrests and Yami sat on the back.
Then, with a snap of his fingers, Alex used Spatial magic to drastically expand the nurses office so there was more than enough room for everyone. At the same time all of the watching students found themselves suddenly seated in comfy chairs, while tables of food magically appeared before them as well.
Ignoring the dumbfoundment at the numerous displays of magic, Alex stated,
"I was brought here solely for Saya and her comrades, Takashi, Rei, Saeko, Shizuka, and Kouta. The rest of you are pretty much just extras." Every single one of the girls along with Ishii looked at Alex with horror at how little he valued them, while Yuna grabbed his cheek and pulled on it while saying with a pouty voice,
"Be nice." As she was chastising him though, Saeko asked curiously,
"What makes us so special? I never met anyone you listed before a few minutes ago." With Kouta, Rei, and Takashi all nodding in agreement, while Shizuka appeared at a loss from the conversation, Alex explained,
"Lets start from the beginning. I, the Dragon Emperor, am one of the few people that can travel to different worlds and universes as a part of an Omniversal battle royale. And in each universe there is a particular 'story', complete with a specific 'protagonist' that other universes may know about through stories and such." Pointing to Yuna, Alex continued,
"On the world known as Spira, Yuna was considered the protagonist as she fought to end the reign of terror by the being known as Sin. In this world, during the apocalypse, Saya and the others would be the protagonists."
Glancing to Saya as he trailed off, Alex planted a quick kiss on her lips before continuing,
"Originally I had no plans to travel to this world since there was so little for me to gain here, but that changed after I acquired an ability that put me into contact with Saya. After that I decided to come to this world to help when the apocalypse started, since I was involved now, and told Saya what to expect so she could make preparations."
As he finished speaking Alex took a plate of food for himself and his wives, seemingly not caring about the numerous bombs he just dropped on everybody as he, Yami, Yuna, and even Saya causally began eating. Eventually however, one of the girls sitting opposite them asked frantically,
"So does that mean you're going to let us die!!?!" Alex cocked a brow at her question, which merely worried the others around her even more before he said with undisguised exasperation,
"I never said that. I just said I'm not here to save you." Alex then made to stand up, making Saya get up as well as he removed numerous things from the numerous stores of supplies he kept on himself at all times.
"I will be in this world for one month. In that time you and everyone other survivor will need to adapt and learn how to take care of yourselves, so that you could either continue living once I'm gone, or so you can adapt to my empire if you chose to follow me. That doesn't mean I won't provide the tools necessary to do so though."
As he said that, Alex made several of the materials he'd removed from his storage float into two sets, before using Creation magic to give them form and enchant them.
One took the shape of a sinister looking Katana that was as black as night, with slight serrations on the edge that reminded those that were watching of teeth. The other set of materials began elongating into a pole five feet long, with another foot forming into a wavy pointed blade with two wings on either side.
The sheathed katana and spear slowly drifted towards Saeko and Rei respectively, while Alex said,
"This is Gōmon(Torture) and Rōzupōkā(Rose Poker). Both are made with the densest and most durable materials within every universe I've been to, and enchanted to never chip, dull, or break.
"On top of that the former has been enchanted to not only inflict unbearable pain with even the slightest scratch, but also has a slight chance to inflict numerous statuses upon those it is used on, such as petrification, poisoning, paralysis, even death, and much more. The latter however can extend and retract at will, allowing its weirder to even attacks enemies from afar, and can leave rippling waves in its wake to slice whatever touches it before it fades."
Even as Rei accepted the spear with awe and reverence on her face, Saeko had a look akin to ecstasy as she gripped the hilt of Gōmon and unsheathed it to admire the sinister blade. She even ran her hand along the blade lovingly as she did so, scaring everyone present with the description Alex gave them.
No one but Alex expected the sadistic expression on Saeko's face as she admired the blade, but even he was surprised when she suddenly re-sheathed Gōmon and knelt while seemingly presenting it to him.
"I, Saeko, heiress of the Busujima clan, do hereby pledge my sword and services to the Dragon Emperor and his empire for the rest of my days. Should I ever fail in my duty, I swear to commit suicide to atone for my sins."
Needless to say Alex was surprised that Saeko so readily swore her fealty to him, especially since they had just met. But in a way it also made sense as, despite her extreme sadistic nature, Saeko was also strict follower of the samurai code. So, rather than refuting or accepting her outright, he asked,
"Are you sure Saeko? I'm not a 'good' person or a 'hero'. I'm a sadistic monster that has slaughtered people in the millions, and tortured numerous others. Is that really the kind of emperor you want to follow?" As Alex spoke Yuna shook her head at him, already coming to terms by now about his habit of making himself look bad to others, mainly because he hated being seen as a hero.
Saeko however didn't hesitate as she stated with her head still bowed,
"My family has served and protected the throne of Japan throughout history. In the modern day however our duty has faltered due to politics, and we are now samurai without a master. To serve one so powerful would be amongst the greatest of honors."
Nodding in affirmation, Alex took Gōmon from Saeko's hands and unsheathed it manually. He then tapped the side of the blade on each of Saeko's shoulders, before said,
"Then rise, samurai of Asora."
Though it wasn't the usual Japanese ritual for appointing one as samurai, Saeko accepted it all the same since in one month she would no longer be residing in Japan anyways. But as she rose, Saeko also found herself facing a strange floating projection that stated [Alexander Morningstar has invited you to the Omniversal Chatroom. Do you accept?]
Seeing her confusion, Alex explained in a voice that carried to everyone,
"That is the ability that let me get in touch with Saya, a Chatroom that allows communication even between different worlds and universes. Along with that, it also possesses a quest and shop function, allowing the users to acquire points that can then be used to purchase new abilities and equipment. Naturally, I only extend invitations to my wives and lovers, but I don't think you'd have a problem with that, right Saeko?"
Even before Alex finished speaking Saeko had hit [accept], joining the Chatroom and cementing her position next to him as she stated,
"Of course not. I shall serve my lord to the best of my abilities in all matters. I am his property, mind, body, and soul." Saying her piece, Saeko then went to stand behind and to the side of Alex, showing just how seriously she was taking her position as his samurai.
"I wonder what Shizuku will think..." Yuna whispered to Yami, making the assassin look up from her book briefly as she too pondered how the meeting between the ninja and samurai will go.
Alex pretended not to hear the hushed conversation going on behind him as he turned to everyone else, and said while producing a number of small glowing spheres,
"Let's move on!"
***

Starting with Saya, Alex handed out dozens of Dresspheres to the group to give them a greater edge in defending themselves. The genius girl received three of the spheres to start with, the Alchemist, Gun Mage, and Psychic Dresspheres that would be boosted with her intellect since the Alchemist allowed one to create items in the middle of battle to fight, while the Gun Mage allowed the user to scan their opponents and use attacks specified for them.
If Saya put the two of them together properly, she could even create weapons capable of wiping out her enemy with little to no collateral damage.
Saeko was next, as she received the Warrior, Samurai, and Dark Knight Dresspheres. While she preferred to use only the katana Alex gave her, she accepted the three Dresspheres only so that she could have the extra power if she needed it to better serve her lord. When she learned of the abilities of the three spheres though, an interested gleam appeared in Saeko's eyes after learning what the Dark Knight was capable of.
Then was Kouta, who only received the Gunner Dressphere, but acted as if he had been given the greatest gift in existence as he immediately began trying out the different abilities it granted him. And with Saya transferring several of the weapons she had in her storage ring over to him, Kouta had probably turned into the most dangerous firearm user in this world.
Rei meanwhile received two Dresspheres, the Dragoon, which granted the user dragon-like heavy armor and a thick shield to act akin to a tank, while the Valkyrie was made lighter for more movement and speed, while also giving the user a small buckler on their left arm to deflect attacks without getting in the way of using their spear.
The Dressphere Takashi received though was a recently developed one that was rather.....unique. It was a sphere called the Yankee, dressing the user like the thugs that could occasionally be found in Japan, and arming them with a powerful metal bat. This particular sphere granted the user a power Hajime had called 'guts', or 'fighting spirit', which increased the user's strength the longer the fight went on, and the more damage they took.
Then there was Shizuka, the most surprising out of everyone. Naturally she got the White Mage Dressphere due to her position as a nurse, but she also received the Black Mage sphere as well so she could obtain some offensive ability. What was surprising was that after those two, Alex also ended up giving her a third Dressphere to see how she'd do with that one as well, the Paladin.
They quickly ended up with an overly excited Shizuka who was swinging around a giant hammer with glee, and was given enough strength from the Dressphere to send even vehicles flying with a single swing. And with the Paladin's capability of using White Mage spells as well, she was also able to perform her healing at the same time with slightly less effectiveness than when using the other sphere.
After the 'main cast' had received their new Dresspheres, Yuna had begun teaching them how to use them as the rest of the girls, along with Ishii, also obtained their own sphere.
The mopey environment from when Alex said he wasn't there to save them had disappeared entirely as they did what he told them, and adapted as they learned how to fight. It didn't mean that they were prepared to enter battle, but they were all certainly a bit better off than they had been beforehand.
With Alex distorting time within the room to give them all a few hours to practice their new abilities, the man himself was busying himself with some VERY important business that was crucial to everyone's survival.

FOR ONE HOUR: PERFORM ORAL SEX
