It's windows were so dark they were impossible to see through, and there wasn't even a scratch along the pristine surface of its body from the numerous rounds of cannon fire it had taken.
Just as the confusion regarding the vehicle had reached an all-time high, a door opened on the side that was facing the couple, making them blink in surprise, and wariness.
"Wow! Do you greet all your guests with such hostility? It'd make someone think you didn't want anyone to visit!" Exclaimed the man that stepped out from the open door, a hulking beast of a man that appeared to be covered in bright red fur, matching rings around his eyes, and a flowing mane of pitch black hair.
Naturally no one knew how to react to the man's presence, with a silence stretching that was broken only by the groaning of the oncoming infected.
"Mom! Dad!" A high pitched voice suddenly cried out, drawing everyone's attention to the next figure to exit the vehicle, one that the majority of those who were gathered were familiar with.
""Saya!!!"" Both Yuriko and Souichiro exclaimed when they saw their daughter, alive and well.
"How...?"
"Why...?"
They asked her while checking over her for any injuries or other signs of potential infection.
"I think we can save the questions for the time being. We're about to have company." The hulking man said as he turned towards the advancing hordes.
"Right! Men, FIRE!" Souichiro declared as he recalled the thousands of infected bearing down on them, now that the vehicle was apparently no longer a threat. But before anyone could pull a single trigger, the man declared,
"That won't be necessary. I can clean up my own mess, thank you very much!" As he said that the man did something that stunned those who were watching, as he slowly rose up into the air above them.
"Impossible..." The woman who had been criticizing Souichiro earlier exclaimed, before the man extended his hand forward, and produced a small ball of flames seemingly out of nothing.
Then, before anyone could say anything, the small fireball turned into a raging inferno that shot out to envelope all of the infected that were bearing down on them, all while radiating such heat that the surrounding buildings that hadn't been knocked down even began to melt.
The group watched in amazement as the infected that spelt their doom was instantly dealt with, being reduced to a state where not even ashes were left within seconds. But the man didn't stop there.
After there were no more infected bearing down on them, the man produced several more fireballs around him, before they were suddenly shooting at the buildings and districts surrounding the Takagi estate.
The sound of numerous deafening explosions rang out as the man destroyed everything surrounding the estate, reducing it to a raging sea of fire.
"WHAT ARE YOU DOING!?!" Souichiro demanded angrily, as ALL of their defenses were destroyed in the infernos as well, leaving them essentially naked when the flames died down.......if they didn't consume THEM as well.
"Father! Trust Alex, he knows what he's doing!" Saya exclaimed as she grabbed onto his arm, shocking Souichiro as he looked down at her.
"Alex?" He uttered quietly, before turning his attention to the shrine maidens who had also gathered there earlier, all of whom were on their knees as they stared up at the figure floating above them, reverence in their eyes.
A feeling of foreboding welled up within Souichiro, but before he could say or do anything regarding it, he realized the infernos around them were rapidly dying down, leaving a charred and barren landscape in their wake. But the mysterious man, Alex, didn't stop there.
The moment the land was cleared he started doing something else, projecting glowing circles from his hands that made Souichiro even more confused, before the land itself began to move seemingly to his whim.
Materials appeared of thin air to accompany the twisting and churning landscape as it all joined together to create what appeared to be numerous buildings, all of which appeared to be something straight out of a movie about medieval Europe. Surrounding all of them was an impossibly tall and thick wall that seemed to be made of stone, which would be more than sufficient to keep the infected from infiltrating the perimeter.
And finally to top it all off, from the wall a massive done of light that shimmered with the same glowing circles that Alex was producing came to life, enveloping all of them before slowly fading, though Souichiro could swear he still saw the air shimmering slightly.
When all of this was done, Alex finally began to slowly drift back down to earth, looking no worse for the wear after the impossible feats he had just performed. And while Souichiro wanted to demand some answers from him, he was cut off as Alex suddenly stated in a voice everyone could hear,
"Greetings! I am Alexander Morningstar, the Dragon Emperor!" His introduction sent waves of muttering through the group, as everyone had heard that name by now from the fanatic shrine maidens that were with them even now, praying to the one they considered a god.
Ignoring the commotion he was causing though, Alex walked straight up to Yuriko and Souichiro, and continued while holding out his hand to shake,
"Alternatively, I'm also the man who's fucking your daughter."

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - 502: Dead World Order
chapters.content:
Saya was in hell.
She had to be after Alex, the man she had decided on, introduced himself in such a way to her parents.
Why?
Why?!
WHY!?!
Why would he literally walk up to her father, and introduce himself as 'the man who's fucking your daughter'? And in front of EVERYONE she grew up around as well!
Of course, if Alex's wives in Asora weren't currently frozen in time, then they'd have been able to warn her in advance about Alex's tendency to butt heads with their fathers.
Thankfully though, Saya's father hadn't taken the news too bad. His only real reaction was to look at the two of them for a moment, before uttering a simple 'I see'.
I SEE!?!
Saya didn't know if she should relieved or infuriated that that was all her father had to say regarding her relationship with Alex. Relieved because the man chosen hadn't been outright rejected, not that Saya thought that would happen, and infuriated since her father's response made it seem as if he was indifferent to her choice.
Weren't fathers supposed to be opposed to their 'little girl' being taken away?
But of course, that was all put on the back burner as Alex led them to one of the buildings he'd created, a literal stone castle that he'd placed right beside the Takagi manor, dwarfing it in size.
"Humph..." Souichiro snorted when Alex led them within, not amused with the newest addition to his estate.
Within their group was Alex, Yami, Yuna, Souichiro, Yuriko, Saya, Rei, a few of Souichiro's most trusted men, and the group organizing the dissenting faction. Following them were the women who had accompanied Alex on the way there, who had Alice with them, and the group of shrine maidens.
As they all entered the castle though, Alex immediately took a sharp right turn into a side door, leading the group with him inside while the women all went to explore the castle, and the shrine maidens settled themselves in the entrance hall outside the door, waiting for their god's command. The only one to accompany Alex's group was Yua, who was considered by her sister shrine maidens to be something akin to a High Priestess since she had been the first one to be blessed.
Inside the room was a long table with numerous chairs sitting around it, and with a wave of Alex's hand, the table lit up to show a 3D projection of the Takagi estate from above.
"Is this...?"
"A live showing of the estate and the surrounding areas from above? Yes it is." Alex said as he took a seat at the head of the table, pulling Yami into his lap as he did so.
And while the petite assassin glowered at him for doing so, she didn't get up as everyone else took their seats, Yuna to Alex's left with Rei on the other side of her, while Saya sat to his right with her parents sitting on the other side of her. Yua took the seat on the other side of Rei, with Souichiro's men filling the rest of the seats, except for the far ones opposite Alex that were taken by the group leading the dissenters, who had an air of importance about them as they sat down.
"Now then..." Souichiro began the moment everyone was seated. "I take it that, based off this eyesore you built right next to my home, you plan to stick around?"
Alex readily nodded before saying, "let me start from the beginning regarding my involvement. A little over a week ago, I obtained an ability that put me into contact with a person on this world, Takagi Saya." Saya's parents look to her in shock, but their daughter avoided their gaze due to her continuing embarrassment as Alex continued,
"Originally I already knew of the fate in store for this world, but had no intention to come here personally for numerous reasons. After accidentally getting into contact with Saya though, I became involved.
"I warned her of what was in store for this world, and she began making plans in anticipation of it. I also began making plans to travel here myself in order to help protect her when the apocalypse started, but unfortunately I wasn't aware of the exact date it would start. Originally if it hadn't started before then, I would've gotten here roughly a month after Saya and I began talking, in your time of course. If it had started before then though, then I would've traveled here ahead of time.
"Unfortunately that wasn't the case, and I was sent here automatically when the apocalypse started alongside two of my wives, Yami and Yuna. Now the three of us are here for a month, and when we leave I'll be taking those who want to go, and who I approve of, back with us to my home world, a land called Asora. Until then I plan to stay here, which is why I fortified the estate and its surroundings, and I'll be taking over command. Any questions?"
When Alex finally finished speaking there was no immediate response as everyone took in the things he'd said. Eventually it was Yuriko who spoke up first as she asked,
"When you say you're going to take people you approve of back with you, what do you mean? What is it you have to approve?"
"It's simple, I'll accept those who are flexible and able to adapt to the world as it has become. Asora is full of what you lot would consider to be supernatural and fantasy beings like gods, Devils, Angels, Youkai, dragons, and much more that an inflexible person would regard as 'monsters'. And if a person is unable to adapt to this world, then I won't have them come to Asora to cause trouble and be a burden on us."
As he said that, Alex turned to look pointedly at the group representing the dissenting faction, making them blink as the woman who seemed to be their leader asked incredulously, "you mean us!?!"
Alex nodded as he told them in a solemn but serious tone, "exactly you. Even as your world is both figuratively and literally burning down around you, you and those you're convincing to follow you are merely burying your heads in the sand to ignore reality. The world as you knew it no longer exists, and those THINGS out there are no longer human. Either adapt and learn to live with these two truths, or die due to your own ignorance and arrogance."
When he finished speaking Alex reclined back in his seat to relax his body, as he had been unconsciously shifting forward with every word until his chin was practically resting on top of Yami's head. The woman however appeared as if she were on the verge of bursting as she glared at Alex angrily.
"Just because I won't go out there and kill innocent people who merely have a CONDITION, doesn't mean YOU get to determine if I live or die as well! You may have fooled everyone else with your 'holier than thou' attitude, but I see you and HIM for what the two of you truly are, MURDERERS who want nothing more than to spill as much innocent blood as possible!"
Looking between Alex and Souichiro as she ranted, the woman then turned and stormed from the room with the rest of her people following her, though Alex was sure a few of them were looking between him and her as they did so.
"If you really want to take over here, then good luck." Souichiro stated to Alex as they watched the group leave.
"Oh? I thought you'd be resistant to the idea of me taking control." Alex said curiously, to which Souichiro shrugged as he replied,
"Yeah, I am hesitant. But this means you'll have to be the one to deal with those loons, and I want to see how capable the man my daughter chose is."
As he said that Souichiro looked to Saya directly, making her blush yet again from embarrassment as she tried sinking into her chair. Alex however shrugged since he didn't mind if Souichiro approved of him or not, though it would make things a bit smoother in the future if he did.
With the annoyances out of the way though, Alex quickly leapt into explaining the changes he'd made to the surrounding areas. He told the group what each building he'd built was for, and outlined areas that he wanted to use for agriculture since he planned to use time-based magic on the fields to accelerate the growth rate of the crops.
Altogether Alex had built ten dorm halls, each capable of housing up to a thousand people comfortably, and were separated by gender to prevent any kind of 'incidents'. Along with them he'd built a barracks, library, mess hall, gym, school, and a couple lounges for relaxation.
Even though he was leaving in a month, Alex intended to ensure the place would last for any of those who were left behind, or elected to stay.
He also drew up a draft of the schedule he intended for the people they were sheltering to follow, which dictated that everyone they were housing would go through a rotation every day of various chores to keep the place running, daily combat and physical training for those over the age of fourteen, and finally plenty of time for them to relax aside from the work. Meanwhile those that were already trained and combat ready would go on regular trips outside the walls to search for survivors, which they would then bring back to the estate.
Alex also informed Souichiro and his men about the two groups that were currently making their way to estate as they spoke. Rika's group, which should arrive in the next day or two, and Saeko's group, which had just departed from the Busujima clan estate earlier that day after officially burying their former lord. As a student of the former lord Busujima, Souichiro respectfully bowed his head for a moment as he uttered his respects to his former teacher.
And for their first assignment, Alex ordered Souichiro and his men to make their way to the nearby mall, police station, and elementary school where Takashi's mother worked, along with his and Rei's homes. The brunette lit up with anticipation of seeing her own mother and father again soon, whom Alex had already confirmed were still alive.
After ironing out a few more details the group stood to leave in order to implement the changes Alex intended to make, but as they were leaving Yuriko stopped her daughter and asked once everyone else had left,
"By the way Saya, should I have the cooks prepare red rice tonight?"
"MOM!!!!!!!" Saya screamed in embarrassment as she stormed out, leaving her giggling mother behind.
Hurriedly exiting the castle Alex had built, Saya suddenly found herself facing a large crowd of people with the woman from earlier at their lead.
"WE REFUSE TO BOW DOWN TO A BEING THAT TREATS THE LIVES OF OTHERS WITH SUCH INDIFFERENCE! WE WILL NOT BE SLAVES TO THIS PRETEND GOD!!!"
As the woman riled the crowd up with her slander and declarations, Alex merely watched them with a bemused smile on his face even as the group of shrine maidens bristled with fury.
"How dare she....."
"To insult our god!"
"Such treacherous lies!"
The only thing keeping them from attacking the woman and her cohorts was the will of their divine lord, who watched the spectacle with amusement until he decided the chanting they had started was giving him a headache.
"If you don't like my decisions, then you're free to leave at any time." Alex said as he flew up where everyone could see him.
The women however just snorted as she demanded, "and why should WE be the ones to leave!? If anyone needs to get out, it's all you murderers that readily kill when you don't need to!"
Several people cried out their agreement with her as the woman spoke, to which she adopted a smug look as she sneered at Alex. However he just shook his head at their behavior before looking at Yuriko, and saying,
"See why I won't let just ANYONE come to Asora with me?"
The words were barely out of Alex's mouth when he suddenly appeared right in front of the woman, making her jump in surprise. But before she could say or do anything, Alex plunged his hand into her chest and wrapped his fingers around her heart, before ripping it out.
"KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!"
Screams tore through the evening air as the group watched someone being killed right in front of them, and every single person who had gather tried to flee only to find their bodies would not move according to their will. Alex however was completely calm despite the bloody heart clutched in his hand as he ran his gaze out over the crowd, before declaring,
"SILENCE!"
With divine power fueling his voice, everyone became silent instantly as they all looked to him in fear.
Alex then knelt down to the corpse of the woman he'd just killed, and tapped her with a finger in his other hand.
"Haaaaaaaaaa!" She gasped while taking in as much air as she could, before looking around in confusion until her gaze settled on the heart in Alex's hand.
"Heeeeeeeeeeeeee!" She cried while trying to back away in fear, every single second of her death and what came after burned into her consciousness, and that was before Alex proceeded to toss her own heart to her.
Ignoring the hysterical woman, who hadn't even noticed the hole remaining in her shirt that was revealing one of her breasts to all of them, Alex then stated to the crowd before him,
"I have said before, and I'm getting tired of repeating myself. This is NOT the world you all once knew.
"If so inclined I could kill you all here and now, and none of you would even be able to fight back while whatever remains of your government wouldn't give a single shit. However I don't wish to do that.
"Anyone that cannot bear to follow my lead and learn how to survive in this new world will be exiled, allowing you to see what it is like outside those walls for yourself!" Alex then pointed to the woman before him, and continued,
"She has already earned her banishment! Whoever wishes to follow her make yourselves known!"
Alex wasn't sure if he should've been surprised or not when no one immediately raised their hands to join the woman in exile, though after a minute a few did, followed by a few others.
Altogether there were about forty people out of the several hundred present that decided to go into exile, a number that did surprise Alex before he nodded in acknowledgement.
"Very well. You all are hereby banished, to live or die as you see fit out there!"
He then snapped his fingers, and the entire group found themselves outside the walls, where they could truly see the damage done to their city for the first time.
"Come on! We need to find some kind of shelter!" One man yelled to the others as he tried leading them along, jogging down the road a block or so to try and get their bearings, only to turn the corner and find himself face-to-face with a dozen or so infected.
"OH MY GOD!" The man yelled in horror as he actually saw the infected for the first time, their rotting grey skin, dull unliving eyes, and the horrendous injuries they all possessed that didn't belong to anyone living.
And as he yelled in horror of seeing them up close for the first time, every single one of them turned towards before lunging at him as quickly as their rotting appendages allowed. The man froze, never once having experienced the flight or fight response in his entire life, and though he desperately wanted to flee, he was unable to do so as the first set of rotting hands grabbed on to him.
"KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!" One of the women in the group shrieked as she watched him being torn to pieces, drawing the attention of that group to her along with every single one of the infected in the area.
"WE HAVE TO GET OUT OF HERE!" Another man in the group shouted as he tried leading them in a different direction, only for another group of infected to appear from a side alley, blocking their path after being drawn in by the noise.
For a moment it seemed as if they would all perish as the infected closed in on them from both sides, before someone cried out, "IN HERE!"
The group quickly fled to one of the buildings lining the road, even as the infected nipped at their heels.
"Damn it!" One of the men swore as the jaws of death snapped shit mere inches from his flesh.
His body then moved on instinct as he reached out to the woman in front of him, grabbing her by the collar of her shirt, and yanked her back into the clutches of the undead.
"NOOOOOOOOOOOO!!! HELP ME!!!"
She cried out in anguish, even as the infected began to bite into her flesh. And though several people looked back at her, none of them so much as slowed down as they rushed into the building, and slammed the door shut behind them.
"Y-you killed her!"
"Shut up! I saved our lives! You all should be thanking me!"
*crash!*
The infected immediately smashed through the window at the front of the shop, surging into it and swarming them without giving any of them a chance to fight back.
All the while the same woman who Alex had killed to make his point was watching in horror from behind the counter, until she noticed a single infected coming towards her.
The woman focused on a little girl, no older than five or six, slowly shuffling towards her in what remained of her school uniform. But what was most chilling about her was the fact that her stomach had been torn open, and her guts were dragging in the floor around her feet.
"N-now little girl, you don't need to do this! I can get you help! You don't have to kill people! Let's show them all!"
Her words however fell on deaf ears as the girl honed in on her location through the sound of her voice, and bared her teeth as she prepared to enjoy her meal. And as she was almost upon her, the woman frantically grabbed a knife that was nearby and sank into the girl's chest, right where her heart was.
The little girl didn't even flinch though as she lunged at the woman, her hands clutching empty air greedily as her teeth repeatedly snapped ravenously.
"RAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!" The woman cried it as she freed the life from the girl's chest, before lunging at her as she sank it right into her eye.
"DIE! DIE! DIE!" She screamed hysterically while repeatedly stabbing her in the face.
"I TRIED TO HELP YOU! YOU DID THIS! THIS ISN'T MY FAULT! HAHAHAHAHAHAHA! THATS RIGHT! IT'S ONLY SELF DEFENSE! HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA-"
The woman began to laugh hysterically with an insane look in her eyes, her mental state completely shattered as more undead hands clutched at her body. She didn't even register them though as she continued laughing insanely, even as the first set of teeth sank into her still exposed tit.
...
Back at the Takagi estate, those who had remained behind watched the projection in the sky with horror as the people who had been beside them mere moments ago were mercilessly slaughtered, before eventually rising to join the ranks of the undead.
Alex had created the projection so that the people could see what it was truly like outside these walls. Men, women, even children were all forced to watch the scene with horror and revulsion, as numerous people even threw up from the graphic gore that was being shown to them, while the children screamed and cowered into their mother's bosom.
Alex genuinely felt bad showing the scene to them as well, but the fact was that EVERYONE present need to realize just how different their world was. Though the children should be sheltered from experiencing it firsthand, unfortunately they too needed to see what the new reality was like.
"Y-you killed them!" One man declared as he looked up at Alex in horror, a thought many shared even as Alex said to them,
"No I didn't. THEY decided to leave on their own, and did everything they could to get themselves killed like the idiots they were."
With a wave of his hand Alex conjured up a second projection that showed the same scene from above, while the first one rewound itself to the beginning, making people turn green as they realized they were going to have to watch it again.
Alex then went through exactly what happened with all of the people present, explaining how the group had been responsible for their own deaths.
First he showed them how many of Them there were in area when he teleported them there, a number that the people couldn't believe after watching the footage the first time. He then explained how the group then proceeded to doom themselves by shouting and speaking loudly, which then drew the attention of every single one of Them in the surrounding blocks, when they'd have even been able to easily avoid being noticed by being quiet. Saya even chimed in to state that They were blind, so even if the group had walked right in front of Them they wouldn't have been noticed.
Alex then pointed out how their first response after announcing their presence was to run, when in actuality they had been trapped the moment they started shouting to each other. According to him they obviously should've fought against one of the smaller groups with any of the items around them that could've been used as a weapon, and used the opening to escape the encirclement forming around them.
One by one Alex discredited every single accusation and claim made by the group before him, until they couldn't think of a single thing to accuse him of.
Literally the only thing Alex did 'wrong' was sending them out away from the safety of the walls, but then again they had been the ones who decided to leave to begin with.
When no one else could think of something to use against him, Alex stated to the group,
"I am not trying to be cruel, or malicious to anyone here. I am just trying to help you all realize the reality of what your world has become. I have no intention to control or rule over you all, unless you decide to follow me when I return to my own home in one month, but help you prepare for this new world you live in."
As he spoke Alex's eyes shimmered slightly with magic, but no one noticed it as he then explained to them the same things he'd told Souichiro and the others a few minutes prior.
***
"Haaaaaaa... That was annoying..." Alex uttered even as he sighed in contentment from the nice hot bath water he was currently soaking in.
With him were all of the women that had joined them on their journey, as well as the shrine maidens as they devotedly washed their God's body and hair while pouring him sake, and even servicing him as Yua slowly moved up and down in his lap. Something Alex gave in to since he knew it was an eventuality.
"Still, I'm surprised you managed to get them to listen to you." Saya said as she washed her long hair at one of the wash stations nearby, making Rei nod in agreement as she added,
"True. I thought it be a while before anyone trusted Alex, especially after he banished those people to die."
Alex just chuckled before taking a nice long drink from the bowl of sake, and answered, "that's the beauty of the Devil's Charm. In times like this it works like....well like a charm!"
Chuckling at his own joke, Alex took another drink after his bowl was refilled as Saya asked him incredulously, "you can Charm people!? Is that why you're so popular with the women!?!"
Her words caused a bit of a stir amongst the group of women that Alex had 'picked up' as he traveled through this world, though both Yami and Yuna directed dirty looks at her for the implication. "Hey hey, don't slander me like that! The devil's Charm is powerful if used and trained properly but it's not THAT strong!"
Turning to look at Saya directly, Alex explained, "what you're referring to is a typical Charm ability, or the Succubus Charm, which makes those of the opposite gender their slave. The Devil's Charm is much more subtle, and nowhere near as powerful.
"It's used when they make deals to make what they have to say to potential clients seem more appealing. If the person being charmed was against what the charmer was saying completely, then they'd be able to resist it altogether. But if they were merely wavering slightly, and needed a little 'push', then the Devil's Charm would give them just that. You can't use it to 'control' people."
His piece said, Alex turned back to his original position as he admittedly enjoyed being pampered by his dedicated shrine maidens, when Yami asked curiously, "Didn't you use the Devil's Charm to turn an entire world against their God?"
EVERYBODY looked at Alex in alarm at that, while he smiled warmly at the memory as he said, "Yeah....we did. Good times those were."
Though everyone was burning to ask more about it, Alex cut them off as he suddenly said in a serious tone,
"By the way, all of you who haven't officially joined my harem." The women in question flinched when Alex referred to them, all knowing EXACTLY who he was talking about, since those who were officially a part of his harem were a part of the Chatroom.
"It's ok for tonight, but tomorrow I want you all to make your decision on if you're going to officially join, or leave. It was one thing while we were traveling, but now that were settled for the next month, I'm not going to let all of you hang around for benefits without committing. Understand?"
The group of women, which mostly consisted of the mothers and sisters of the students that had fled the school with them, nodded slowly in understanding as they started thinking on if they wanted to stay or not. Alex meanwhile decided to leave them alone with their thoughts as he took another swig of sake, making him thankful he enchanted the bottle so it'd never run out.
The reason he was making them choose was mostly because of how Grayfia, Rias and Ravel regarded his harem back home. They had long since learned that the number of women around Alex wasn't going to stop growing any time soon, but they had decided, and ingrained into him, that each and every one of them needed to contribute in some way, no matter how small.
Even if Alex brought back hundreds of women with him from this little trip, while they'd definitely be annoyed, their biggest concern would be if the women were merely freeloaders who thought spreading their legs for Alex brought them the easy life. And if that was the case, then they'd quickly get a reality check from his official wives.
So Alex decided to clean house before then to make their jobs easier. And all of those who decided to stick around would start their official training in the morning, alongside the rest of the people living on the estate.
But Alex just kept that to himself for the time being, allowing them to somewhat enjoy the night before then.

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - 503: Invasion of the Dead
chapters.content:
In the days following Alex's somewhat hostile takeover of the Takagi estate there had been many changes to the way things were going, and surprisingly the people there adapted fairly well. Much better than they initially thought when they first learned that Alex was taking command.
The first order of business was to have everyone within the estate register themselves to Souichiro's people, who were being led by Saya. There they were required to input every bit of work experience they had to determine their share of responsibilities on the estate, as well as any combat skills they had learned before now.
As far as combat went only a few people in the group had learned a form of martial arts or 'combat' through clubs when they were in High school, but for many of them that had been years ago, decades for some. That was where Alex's first act of 'divine benevolence' came into play, according to Yua and the other shrine maidens.
In order to help the people become combat ready as soon as possible, Alex used Regeneration Magic, not to reverse their age, but to return their bodies to their most fit state they had ever been in. For numerous people this meant going to bed with the same aches and pains they'd been living with for years, and waking up to a rejuvenated body and muscles they had long since forgotten they had.
Alex didn't stop there though.
Similarly to when he had gone to planet Sadala and rejuvenated the Saiyan people that were crippled and unable to fight, Alex repeated his past feats as he healed all the people suffering from debilitating injuries or illnesses through Regeneration and Alteration magics. This resulted in a massive uptick in approval for Alex in the eyes of the people, which was also helped by how humble and causal he acted around them.
As he was used to regularly interacting with his people back on Asora, Alex would readily get to know the people staying on the estate at a personal level, helping them if they needed it, and providing what he could to make their jobs easier. This didn't at all fit how one would see a person who claimed to be an emperor, let alone who also happened to be a god.
The one thing Alex did have a problem with after they arrived at the Takagi estate, was how much the belief in him soared once more people joined them.
With Rika and her group arriving the day after Alex, Saeko and her clan another day after them, and Souichiro returning with people from the locations Alex gave him in the beginning, the population of survivors on the Takagi estate quickly shot upwards before they reached the thousands.
Now that society had effectively collapsed, Alex began marking all the locations he'd found survivors to give to Souichiro to rescue. And when there was no more reason(loot) for him to continue searching Japan, Alex began sending groups of people from mainland Asia back as he began looting that too.
As he continued moving westward Alex would continue finding more groups of survivors, which he'd send back with artifacts to eliminate the language barrier between the different groups. And surprisingly they all adapted to his rules and requirements fairly well.
Soon Alex even had to expand the walls surrounding them to allow more room for the survivors, as well as all the livestock he'd been finding so that there was a steady supply of animal products.
The biggest problem for him though was how Yua and the rest of the shrine maidens actively sought to increase the number of followers he had, as per the condition he had unintentionally given them in his trance-like state during their blessings. And with the number of survivors they were housing soaring upwards, the number of believers Alex had was also shooting up as more and more people turned to him in this time of crisis.
When the world ended and all the other gods they had believed in all their lives ignored their prayers, Alex had answered.
When their gods had seemingly left them for dead in what many considered to be the end of times depicted in almost every religion, Alex had saved them.
While many of them had been born with conditions or left crippled after an event in their life that would've proved fatal in this new world, Alex had cured them to give them a fighting chance.
Though he never thought any of the things he was doing were anything special, more and more people flocked to the church the shrine maidens had built with every 'miracle' he had performed.
It eventually got to the point where Alex could rarely be found at the estate as they entered his final week on that world, as he instead spent all his time looting and sending survivors back. Of course, this only served to increase the amount of followers he was accumulating even more.
***
"Haaa..." I sighed in boredom while reaching for a bottle of water to quench my thirst.
"Stop that shit already! You're giving me a headache!" The man sitting next to me snarled in irritation.
"I'm sorry, but it's just so boring sitting up here. Especially in this heat!" As I said that I tried fanning my face to cool myself down, even as the merciless sun continued to beat down onto us. But then again, what else would you expect from Los Angeles in late spring?
The guy next to me groaned in irritation once more, but didn't say anything else as he went back to quietly brooding while ignoring me.
The two of us were part of the survivor group that had fortified themselves in one of the tall buildings that dotted the city, though unfortunately we were given lookout duty.
Altogether we numbered about a hundred people that were just barely on the edge of losing it as we waited for help to come.
"Man.... I wish something would happen already..." I grumbled while glancing down at the city streets below us. Which were completely crowded by the walkers.
*WHOOSH*
Suddenly, at that moment, I watched in both awe and fear as a massive swirling vortex opened up near the Hollywood sign.
And as it did so, a sickening wave of decay and death spread out from it that killed all vegetation, presumably all animals, and caused rapid deterioration in everything it touched as it quickly made its way to us.
*crash*
Both my partner and I, who had stood up suddenly in alarm, then crashed to the floor as the strength left our bodies, leaving us feeling increasingly drained as the seconds slowly ticked by. It was only with a great feat of will that I managed to pull myself up enough to peer over the edge of the building, and what I saw chilled me to the bone.
What seemed like legions of soldiers were marching out of the vortex, legions that, when I looked through my binoculars, didn't appear to be living. Their armor was warped and covered in rust spots that resembled blood, weapons in no better condition as they were chipped and broken from abuse.
What I could see of their actual bodies left in me a combined state of both revulsion and confusion, as the people wearing the armor all appeared to be walking corpses in various stages of decomposition, yet were marching in formation. What truly confused me though, was that the vast majority of people marching didn't even appear human.
Among them I saw people with all kinds of differing skin tones and body shapes, some with elongated ears, warped features with rotting green skin, and even elongated tusks protruding from their mouths. Amongst them were also people that were significantly shorter than the rest, many being only roughly four feet tall, while others were even shorter while varying between green and regular skin tones.
The strangest thing yet though were those who were completely covered in fur and other animalistic features, some possessing notable wolfish features, others looking like bulls that were walking upright, and were even complete with horns, while there were even dragon-like people and PANDAS that were standing upright and wearing armor.
Burying my amazement at what appeared to be real life fantasy races, something about them was bugging me immensely...
They all appeared to be races of people from a game I liked to play before the world ended, an online game that involved two sides locked in a perpetual war against one another.
My suspicions were quickly confirmed when a large number of creatures I recognized from said game suddenly appeared from the vortex as well, undead monsters and animals that could be fought, tamed, and even used as mounts in the game I used to play. They were followed by something any fantasy nut would jizz their pants to see, dragons.
Though they weren't living breathing dragons, there was still a number of the famous fantasy creatures that appeared from the vortex in various stages of decomp, including several that were completely skeletal even as they too flew through the air.
The entire time I was ogling the undead fantasy people and creatures my body continuously grew weaker with each passing second, however I stubbornly refused to let myself fall as I watched the mixture of Horde and Alliance pass through the vortex.
Eventually I noticed a smaller group of individuals that were scattered throughout the marching army, people of the various different races that were dressed in better maintained armor and were armed with better weapons, riding on what appeared to be demonic horses as they directed the undead army.
Soon however a group of them splintered away from the rest as they galloped in our direction, making my weakening heart hammer in my chest as I watched them approach. In the lead was the largest of the group, a bull-like person that was so large that I felt sorry for his horse.
"A Tauren..." I uttered in awe, before the group came to a halt right in front of the building we had been taking shelter in.
The rest of the group made to draw their weapons, but the Tauren stopped them before he dismounted his poor horse.
*crunch*
The asphalt cracked from the apparent weight of Tauren as he landed on it, while I also felt as if the building beneath me shuddered a bit.
Trepidation built up within me as I watched the Tauren stamp its hoof while lowering its head, before it released a powerful bellow that made the air itself vibrate from its intensity. And then it charged directly at the building.
I could feel the earth shudder with each powerful step the Tauren took in its charge, a storm of gunfire barking as the other survivors tried to kill it before it could reach, only to be answered by the clang of metal as they ricocheted off of its armor.
*CRASH!*
I could hear the destruction being wrought down below as the Tauren tore through our defenses as if they were made of paper mache, making the entire building groan and shake. For a brief moment I could hear the continued gunfire as the other survivors tried to bring the Tauren down, even as he seemingly tried to bring the entire building down around him, but none seem to meet their mark.
*kaboom!*
I then heard the concussion of a RPG going off, only to be answered by an angry, or perhaps annoyed, bellow.
That however seemed to be the straw that broke the proverbial camel's back, as the entire building started to pitch treacherously.
As the entire building began to pitch to the side from the strain on its ground floors, I tried to scream but was unable to let out more than a hoarse utterance as we began gaining momentum on our rapid and deadly trip to the ground.
I closed my eyes while bracing for the impact, but surprisingly felt very little if anything. Perhaps because of how drained and weak my body was when I died.
But the next thing I knew I was ascending 'upwards', a sensation that filled my heart with elation even before I was able to behold the sight of the Pearly Gates.
I felt as if my eyes were filling with spectral tears as I beheld Heaven, and just on the other side of the gates was my family, waiting for me despite me having to bash their heads in after they became infected. I reached my hand out towards the gates, anxious to pass them and enter Heaven, but before I could I felt a sudden pain in my spectral heel.
Looking down, I saw a spectral hook piercing my flesh, attached to a rope that was in the hands of twisted spectral women who pulled me and several dozen others back towards her like a school of fish.
"Nooooo!!!" I screamed in horror as I desperately tried to claw my way to the pearly gates, to what I perceived as safety. But what happened next was even more terrifying.
I watched as the Gates of St. Peter were torn away from their place, leaving Heaven open as thousands of spectral figures rose up from below to invade it. I heard a series of majestic and beautiful horns echo as hundreds of angelic beings rose up to do battle with the invading wraiths, shades, and Val'kyr.
But even as they fought several of Val'kyr used their spectral hooks to capture hundreds, and then thousands of souls that had been secure behind the Pearly Gates, dragging all of us away from the battle and to another spectral figure that dwarfed all the others.
"Submit!" The figure declared in a commanding tone. "Submit yourselves to the glory, of the Lich King!"
I then felt a presence invading my mind, twisting and corrupting it with perverse and sinister thoughts as it shattered my very being.
I have no idea how much time had passed, but when the pain vanished I felt....complete.
I felt whole in the presence of HIM.
Power filled my spectral body, power that I would use in HIS name! To destroy HIS enemies!
"For the glory of the Lich King!" I wailed along with my fellow newly reborn brethren, before we turned and joined the battle against the forces of Heaven, the filthy mongrels that dared to defy HIM.
...
Meanwhile, back at the still lingering vortex, a certain figure sat at the throne of his castle, perched atop the floating fortress of Acherus, otherwise known as the Ebon Hold.
The figure was attired in cold and biting metal armor, while the Helm of Domination covered his head.
He was none other than the Lich King, ruler of the Scourge and commander of all the dead. Even now, mere moments after entering this world, his forces were already doing battle with the forces of Heaven and Hell to add the souls within to his own ranks. And power.
Meanwhile his remaining forces were converting all of the mindless bags of meat outside to his side. They may be the weakest of undead, due to how weak this world was in general and no longer possessing any part of their soul to draw on for intelligence, but they made for good materials to build stronger undead and abominations.
And with literally billions of bodies on this planet for them to work on, the Lich King was looking forward to seeing what his butchers came up with.
And with each body and spirit that joined their ranks, his power only grew even further by leaps and bounds. That was before one considered his ability to draw in all of the energy from his environment, which constantly drained the life out of those who were within a thousand miles of him, regardless of if they were plants, animals, or people.
Under his helm the Lich King smirked as his army slowly advanced at his command, while above them a storm was forming that had already grown to cover nearly a quarter of North America, and was only rapidly increasing as it covered the land in a layer of freezing snow.
Soon he would turn this world into a freezing wasteland, devoid of any life as they were all conscripted into his ever growing army, before moving onto the next.
***
"Keep your guard up! It doesn't matter good you are, a momentary lapse in concentration is deadly!" Souichiro cried out in a stern tone.
After they had located just about all of the survivors on Japan, Alex had placed Souichiro and the others who were in charge of rescuing survivors on the task of clearing Japan of all the undead. At the same time, they were also giving their fellow survivors real combat training once they reached a passable level in their skill.
Accompanying Souichiro and the thirty men and women he was looking after was a small team of his own men, and someone who he had ended up befriending due to the shared connection between their daughters, Miyamoto Tadashi, Rei's father.
Currently he was directing the trainees as they fought a group of Them for the first time, while his men and Tadashi were staying on lookout to ensure they didn't get surrounded.
After several weeks of slaughtering every one of Them they could find, Souichiro and his team had to take the team several hours north to find a suitable population of undead to kill. The lengthy travel times aside, this was a good thing since it meant that they were making headway in making the entirety of Japan safe again.
But then that begged the question, should they stay in Japan, or go with Alex when he returned home?
Souichiro and his wife had that very discussion numerous times in the past days, since they both knew their daughter intended to follow Alex when he returned to Asora.
It happened right then.
*whoosh!*
A massive swirling vortex formed out of nowhere right in front of Souichiro and the others, alarming every one of them as they hurriedly tried to regroup.
"What is tha-!"
"AWOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!"
A bloodcurdling howl echoed in the air as dozens of large things rushed out of the vortex faster than Souichiro, Tadashi, or their men could follow.
"AHHHHHHH!!!" One man screamed as he was attacked by one of the things, and all Souichiro could see was blood spraying as his limbs went flying.
"I've got to help him!" Exclaimed one of the men that was with their group, someone Alex granted the White Mage dressphere to.
"No!" Souichiro declared as he grabbed the young man by the arm, holding him back from rushing forward.
"Take the others and return to the estate! Let them know what's going on here!" He commanded before shoving the man back in the other direction.
"W-what about you?" The man exclaimed worriedly.
"I'll hold them, buy you some time to get away. NOW GO!"
As he said that Souichiro took a stance with his katana at the ready, the rest of trainee group rushing past him as they returned to the military vehicle they used to drive there. Staying however were the men he had fought alongside before time and again.
"No matter what, we're with you sir!" One of them said as they stood to his back, while Tadashi similarly didn't move from his station on the roof from a nearby building. Instead, he began shooting at whatever it was that had come through the vortex and began attacking them.
Souichiro and his men stood back-to-back as they prepared to face whatever new monster this was, which growled threateningly while they circled around them.
"They're toying with us..." One man uttered grimly.
"Well, then we should teach them not to play with their food!" Another guy exclaimed as he hefted his grenade launcher and fired a few rounds into their surroundings.
*boom!*
*boom!*
*boom!*
*boom!*
The final blast was followed by a pained whine that drew everyone's gaze in that direction.
"..."
"!!!"
*crack!*
As everyone turned one rushed out and grabbed one of the men by the throat, killing him and dragging his body away before anyone noticed, only for Tadashi to fire off a shot at it before it got away. Another whine answered the shot as Souichiro demanded, "Talk to me Tadashi! What are they!?!"
For a second the man with the rifle above them didn't say anything, before hesitantly saying, "I think...these are werewolves....."
"..."
No one immediately said anything to Tadashi's observation, until Souichiro declared, "Very well. This is nothing surprising for men who've been fighting walking corpses for the last several weeks!"
As he said that, Souichiro's body suddenly lit up as his pristine military clothes disappeared, and was replaced with a full suit of traditional Samurai armor while his katana became longer and thicker.
Swinging the heavier blade with minimal effort though, Souichiro ready cast several of the abilities unique to the Samurai dressphere.
"Hayate! No Fear! Nonpereil!"
With the activation of his abilities Souichiro felt the limits of his physical body being pushed to their limits as he increased his strength, sight, reflexes, and speed, while two illusionary spheres formed around him to protect him from physical and magical attacks.
"Call them out Tadashi!" He ordered.
"Nine o'clock." Tadashi replied a second later, making Souichiro pivot on his heel while slashing his katana in a wide arc, slicing the werewolf in half before it could attack him.
"Four o'clock"
"Eleven o'clock"
"Six o'clock"
As if they were machines Souichiro and Tadashi worked in unison to kill the werewolves from beyond the vortex, slaughtering the supernatural creatures with strength and focus that no ordinary human could hope to match.
The more they killed though, the more that traveled through the vortex in endless waves until it wasn't just werewolves that they saw.
"I-is that a bear!?!"
"lions!"
"Boars!?!"
"Alligators???"
As more time passed more and more creatures exited the vortex, until something appeared that stole the breath away from everyone present, including Souichiro and Tadashi.
"ROAAAAAAAAAAAAAR!" Bellowed a dragon that was as black as night and so large its blotted out the sun, it's body covered in jagged spikes and hooked claws.
Most curiously though was that there was a person riding atop the dragon as it circled them, along with a number of severed heads that were tied to its various spikes.
Instead of being able to admire the dragon in awe though, a symphony of roars tore through the skies as over a hundred dragons filled it, all flying lower than the one that had first appeared as its rider directed an appraising look at Souichiro and the others.
"Zun Haal Viik!" One of the dragons suddenly roared at them, in a way that almost seemed like a shout, as the weapons were automatically torn from Souichiro and his men's hands. Most shocking though was that the Samurai dressphere was also dispelled from Souichiro at the same time, as the sphere was sent skittering across the asphalt beneath them.
"GAH!" Tadashi cried out suddenly, drawing their gaze to him just in time to watch as one of the werewolves tore out his heart, and proceeded to eat it before them.
Souichiro clenched his fists as he watched the light leave his friend's eyes, but before he could say or do anything, the black dragon that dwarfed all others present landed in front of them with a great earth-shaking crash, leveling every building that had the misfortune to be beneath it as the rider stared down at them.
He was a fair looking man with long bright red hair tied into a Nordic braid, and a crown decorated with numerous claws or sharp teeth sat upon his brow. His body however was attired in scale-like armor that appeared eerily similar to the scales of several of the dragons around them, while he wielded a black blade that glowed with sinister red runes, and a shield made of the same scale-like material as his armor hung from his saddle.
The man looked down at the group with an appraising eye before he said in a dismissive tone, "kill them. I have no need of people from this world."
The words were barely out of his mouth when one of the dragons turned its maw at Souichiro and his men.
"You Toor Shul!" The dragon roared as a great inferno poured out of its gullet, the last thing Souichiro saw before his body was instantly turned into ash as the fire from the dragon vaporized anything in its path.
The man riding the black dragon turned away from them as he directed his gaze south, where his system told him a group of them were escaping.
Should I give chase?
A message appeared before him suddenly, from one of his MANY subordinated 'party' members.
"No Aela, follow them for a time to see where they're going." The man then turned his attention to the sphere that had been dropped by one of the men he'd just given the order to kill, and picked it up with Telekinesis magic.
"Something tells me that there is an interesting 'game' to play here, and as a 'Gamer' I would be remiss to not enjoy it to its fullest." The she-wolf that had been beside the black dragon as he were speaking nodded in affirmation, before taking off along with a group of her pack-mates to follow the vehicle back to its home.
The man smirked as he watched them leave, before blinking in surprise as a notification suddenly popped up in front of him.
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
NOTICE! TWO QUESTS ADDED!
...
THE LICH KING:
DIFFICULTY: EX RANK
OBJECTIVE: kill the Lich King and eliminate or subjugate his undead army!
REWARDS: ??????
...
THE ONE TRUE DRAGON EMPEROR
DIFFICULTY: EX RANK
OBJECTIVE: eliminate the Dragon Emperor, Alexander Morningstar, and either subjugate or destroy his forces!
REWARDS: ???????????
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Even as he looked over the EX ranked quests, which was the highest difficulty quest he could receive that surpassed even SSS ranks, the man smiled in anticipation.
As he was reading the description of the quests he had received, an army had begun appearing through the portal behind the man, as people of all races marched in the name of the emperor.
Altmer, Bosmer, Orismer, Dunmer, Khajiit, Argonian, the various races of humans, and even the races considered by many to merely be 'monster', such as Falmer, Goblins, Giants with their mammoths, and Reiklings. Along with them marched numerous creatures and animal that COULD be considered monsters, giant frostbite spiders, Draugr, Chaurus, Dwarven Automations, armored Trolls, bears, wolves, sabre cats, and dogs.
Aside from them were beings that were considered to be literal demons, the Daedra.
Dremora, Lurkers, Atronachs, Seekers, and even the godlike and powerful Daedric Princes.
"This world seems so....distasteful..." Sneered one Daedric Prince as she stepped through the portal, a beautiful woman dressed in flowing robes with angelic wings sprouting from her back.
"Don't say that Merida, I can already tell there's lots of glorious cheeses for me to sample here!" Exclaimed another arrival, a well-dressed man with neatly trimmed hair and beard that was nearly white in color.
"There....is......also great...wells of knowledge.......to be found......here." Drawled what appeared to be a disembodied mass of eyes and tentacles.
One by one the sixteen widely known Daedric Princes appeared through the portal before they collectively approached the man riding the dragon. They then reluctantly kneeled before the man, as his 'voice' had long since grown so powerful that he could even bend their wills to his whims.
The man didn't even look at them as he stated,
"The undead of this world belong to my army to kill so they can level up. Anyone still living though is to be split between each of you, but there are two people we need to watch out for, someone calling themselves the Lich King, and another by the name of Alexander Morningstar. They belong to me, but once they're out of the way you're all free to do as you wish. Do you understand?"
Though they wished to curse and condemn him for ordering them about like his dogs, none of the sixteen gave voice to such desires. Instead they all chanted as one,
"""Understood, great and mighty Dragon Emperor!"""
***
Alex was feeling fairly accomplished as he exited his latest looting target, the vaults of the Vatican.
They had been completely filled with items and texts from throughout history that had been squirreled away by the church for 'protection', while other artifacts were hidden down there to further their agenda. Well, they certainly had no more need for any of them.
Alex had even found it fairly funny that the undead pope had been standing in his way when he tried to enter the vault, and couldn't help but to comment out loud that if this were any other world, he'd be a boss level enemy.
Alex chuckled as he recalled what remained of the pope, before stopping suddenly as he sensed two things appearing nearly simultaneously. One was to the west, presumably in America from what Alex could feel, while the other felt as if it was back east, more than likely in Japan.
"Haaaaaaaaaaaa..." Alex sighed deeply as he contemplated what to do.
While the natural decision would be to return to Japan to deal with the threat there before traveling to America, Alex could feel the entity in America growing significantly stronger with each passing second. Not to mention that that one felt significantly more 'sinister' compared to the one in Japan, meaning that it wouldn't be wise to let them grow any stronger than they already were, which facing the one in Japan would only take up more time.
Quickly making his decision, Alex turned westward while deciding to trust in Yami and Yuna to keep things from falling apart until he returned. But as he did he uttered,
"One of these days I'm gonna find Fate-Chan, and fuck her up the ass to see how she likes it for once..."

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - 504: Wolves of the Dead
chapters.content:
"What's wrong mom?" Saya asked as she noticed her mother's body tense suddenly.
"I don't know, I was just filled with a feeling of dread for some reason..." Yuriko uttered as she looked up in confusion.
"You too?" Asked the woman sitting across from her, a more mature version of Rei with shorter light brown hair, Miyamoto Kuriko.
The third woman at the table looked up from her cup of tea when she heard the other two speaking, Busujima Ichika, and frowned slightly. Their comments had filled her with a sense of Deja vu, but she didn't want to give voice to her concerns so as not to worry her friends unnecessarily.
After the Busujima clan and the survivors from Rei and Takashi's neighborhood were brought the estate, the three of them had quickly become friends due to their shared son-in-law, and their rather colorful backgrounds. Yuriko had been a stockbroker on Wall Street before she met Souichiro on vacation, and proceeded to marry him the very next day. After that she became in charge of the Takagi estate funds, and significantly increased their wealth over the years.
Kuriko was once the leader of a prominent all-girls gang before she changed sides to become a police officer. She was so effective at her job that Kuriko soon became feared amongst all of the gangs in the area, and they even began referring to her as 'Precinct Kuriko'.
Ichika meanwhile had joined the Busujima clan when she was young, where her talent with a sword flourished, and she eventually caught the eye of the next clan head. With her skill there was no contention to their intent to marry, and she had helped her husband run the clan ever since, right up until she was notified of his passing, and Saeko took over.
All three were women with rather extraordinary backgrounds, with three amazing daughters of their own who were also present as they enjoyed lunch together.
"How long until the trainee group returns?" Yuriko asked.
"A few more hours yet." Kuriko replied, as both women were waiting on their husband's return.
The rest of the lunch passed as the women shared some small talk and nibbled on their food, though it was obvious that none of their hearts were in it. At some point even Rika and Shizuka joined them as they returned from their patrol, though they both quickly realized that the table didn't have its usual easygoing atmosphere.
The only lively member of the group was little Alice, who was busy playing with Zeke after she had quickly finished her own lunch.
Just as Yuriko was about to call an end to the lunch,
*AROOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!*
The horn signaling the return of the trainee group sounded, making the women leap to their feet as Saya exclaimed, "they're early!"
The group quickly rushed to the northern gate as it opened to let those who were returning in, with even Yami and Yuna arriving as well from their own things. While Yami would usually disappear somewhere in pursuit of interesting books, Yuna was nearly as famous as Alex within the estate due to her willingness to help people and kind heart.
Right now however both girls were tense as they flew to the northern gates, which told Yuriko and Kuriko that there was definitely cause for concern.
"What happened?" Yami demanded before her feet even touched the ground, even as the White Mage of the group exited the military vehicle.
"W-we were attacked!" He exclaimed, confusing everyone present as one of the guards grunted,
"You were out there for combat training. No shit you were attacked." The White Mage however just looked at him with undisguised panic as he exclaimed,
"No! You don't understand, it wasn't THEM!"
THAT got everyone's attention, prompting Yuna to step forward and gently cup the man's face in her slender hands.
"Tell us what happened." She told him gently, making the man relax somewhat as he recounted everything that had happened, the vortex opening, and the numerous shapes that emerged from it that they had been unable to identify, even as one of the men with them was butchered.
When he mentioned how Souichiro, Tadashi and the others stayed behind the buy them time there was a sharp intake of breath from the two wives, but thankfully they managed to maintain their fortitude instead of simply breaking down, clinging to the VERY slim possibility that their husbands were still alive.
Just as the man finished recounting their story, Yami suddenly held up a hand to shush them, making everyone go silent as they even unintentionally held their breath.
"Yuna!" Yami eventually declared, before sprouting her white feathered wings and taking off, followed by Yuna as she summoned her Devil wings.
The two girls flew up and over the walls, passing through the barriers Alex had placed as if they weren't there, and down the other side. There, Yami noticed a group of fur covered beings that had been trying to hide amongst the rubble that had formerly made up the city.
"AWOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!" One of them howled when they realized they had been spotted, but instead of running they readily charged the two girls.
"Werewolves. We need to capture them." Yami coldly stated even as her hair morphed into numerous hammers.
Yuna meanwhile transitioned to her Thief dressphere as she moved faster than them while using the ability Borrowed Time, making them freeze in their tracks as her ability inflicted the 'stop' status upon them. Those she didn't freeze were quickly subjected to Yami's hammer hair, of which a casual swing had the force to level entire city blocks.
Wether because she was holding back to capture them, or because they were just that sturdy, Yuna didn't know. But she didn't just stand around and watch to see if they'd get up, as she transitioned to the Gun Mage sphere to Scan one of them. It was then that she made a startling discovery.
"They're being controlled!" Yuna exclaimed, shocking Yami as she watched the werewolves she'd knocked down get back up.
Though she knew she'd have to fight back, Yami suddenly found herself hesitating as numerous bad memories came back to her from before she met Alex, and HOW exactly she'd met him. Thankfully she wasn't alone as Yuna readily transitioned to the White Mage dressphere, and cast Esuna while adding Spirit magic to try and sever the connection to the one controlling them.
The werewolves slowed until they halted right in front of Yami, clarity appearing in their eyes for the first time along with the ones Yuna had stopped, before they all began shrinking down as their fur disappeared.
Soon there was a group standing before them of humanoid races, mostly human, but a few types of elves along with a few covered in green skin, and even a couple more curious people like the ones completely covered in fur with catlike features, and a similar one who appeared reptilian instead.
All of them were naked though, and at their head though was a woman who didn't seem to mind the number of men around her, her bare breasts heaving and red hair matted as she looked around before focusing on the two girls.
"On behalf of the Companions, I truly thank you two from the bottom of my heart." She said in an assertive, yet thankful tone while bowing her head slightly, along with the rest of the werewolves around her.
Once she straightened up, the woman continued,
"I am called Aela the Huntress, member of the Circle amongst the Companions. Our two most respected members are....no longer here though...." As she trailed off two of the werewolves behind her approached, nearly identical men, before one said,
"Greetings honorable shield maidens! I am Vilkas, and this is my brother Farkus, also members of the circle." As Vilkas finished speaking his brother uttered a curt grunt in greeting as well, before several of the people behind them also uttered their thanks and greetings, the majority being part of the group called the 'Companions'.
When they finished Yuna stepped forward, and said, "I am Yuna, and this is Yami. I'm glad we were able to return your group to your senses, but I have to ask, who was controlling you?"
The expressions of the group darkened at her question, before Aela spat out, "an evil and dishonorable man who hid for years behind a facade of friendship and loyalty! He earned our trust before killing our Harbinger, Kodlak, as well as one of our most senior members, Skjor!"
"He's taken control of every nation of Tamriel, turning all of its citizens into his brainwashed puppets!" Vilkas snarled wolfishly.
"He's even turned the dragons and Daedra to his side, along with the Daedric Princes!" Farkus growled angrily, before all three stated at the same time,
"""The Dragon Emperor!"""
The moment they heard that Yami and Yuna looked at each other questioningly, both immediately wondering why, and when, Alex would've had time to do something like this, before dismissing such thoughts entirely. He wasn't the type to commit such atrocities unless he had a VERY good reason to.
With them both arriving at the same conclusion though, Yuna told them, "come with us. We need to talk."
...
After making sure the group was dressed, the two girls brought them into the estate to learn all they could about this 'Dragon Emperor', who they both determined was definitely another reincarnator like Alex and Anne. They used magic to take them directly into the meeting room of the castle Alex built for himself and his harem until he could return home, as they didn't want to deal with the group who had escaped from their claws right inside the walls.
There, Yuna went to go fetch everyone who was considered to be a higher up of the estate, which included Rika, Shizuka, Saya, Rei, Saeko, and their moms, along with several others like Yua, and Souichiro's Sergeants. Yami meanwhile messaged Alex to call him back, only to receive a surprising response.
She was still gaping at it in disbelief when Yuna reappeared with the others, among which those who also had access to the Chatroom couldn't believe what Alex had said.
"So these are the werewolves..." Yuriko said as she entered the room alongside Kuriko, who readily thrust the point of her spear until it was directly in front of Aela's face, and snarled,
"Tell me bitch, where is my husband?!"
For a moment no one moved or said anything, as the two women directed different looks at one another, one of fury, the other sorrow and pain. Finally, Aela opened her mouth as she said, "If he wasn't with the group that we followed back, then he was killed with the others..."
The moment she heard that Kuriko's furious exterior crumbled, while even Yuriko's lower lip began quivering before she asked in a small voice, "how?"
Aela directed a firm look at the two women, and said,
"They died fighting. The one with the sword and armor killed many of our kind before the Dragon Emperor ordered his death. They have both earned their place at Shor's table in Sovngarde."
Neither woman knew nor cared of what Aela was talking about, as they both began sobbing silently as they mourned their husbands, while their daughters merely seemed to be in a state of shock. Neither one had ever truly considered the possibility to truly losing their fathers.
"Yuna!" Rei exclaimed suddenly as she looked to her with hope in her eyes. "You can bring them back with your White Mage skills, right?!"
Unfortunately though, Yuna shook her head as she explained, "I'm sorry Rei, but I can't. While I DO have an ability to revive the dead, Raise works similarly to Alex's method in that it won't work if too much time has passed..."
Rei eyes immediately darkened when she heard that, as her father had surely been killed long enough ago that they couldn't revive him anymore, and that was before one thought about the rest of the enemy. However, something Yuna said did catch Yuriko and Ichika's attention, as the former asked,
"Where is Alex? Shouldn't he return if we are under attack?"
Rather than answer answer verbally, Yami activated the table that showed them a live projection of the estate from above.
"What manner of magic is this!?" Aela exclaimed in awe, making her smirk slightly despite the situation.
However Yami's expression soon turned serious as she positioned the map over the region Alex called North America, but all she could see was a massive storm system covering the entire continent.
A hushed silence descended upon them as they beheld the truly massive size of the storm, before Yami tried to zoom in to see what lay underneath it. And when they saw the landscape beneath the storm, the room was filled with gasps and declarations as they beheld an army unlike any other they had ever seen.
"Troll's blood..." Villas swore, giving voice to how everyone felt at that moment.
Undead of every size, shape, and form marched in the billions, ranging from humanoids, animals, monsters, spirits, and even dragons, all marching through a snowy and frozen wasteland.
"Yours?" Yuriko asked Aela and the others icily, but it was Yami that answered,
"No, it's another one. Alex went to go deal with them, so we just have to keep the other ones busy until he can get back."
"Is that all..." Rei asked sarcastically.
"Can he really handle them though?" Ichika asked as she looked over the vast army, doubting that Alex would be able to defeat ALL of them, despite being considered a god.
Yami and Yuna just looked at each other when they heard that, before both girls smiled wryly.
"What is it?" Ichika asked, not sure why the two girls seemed to find her question humorous.
"Alex isn't called a god for no reason. If he so desired, he can simply deal with both groups with a snap of his fingers, along with the entire continent they're on as well." Yuna stated as if it were obvious, stunning the women that THOUGHT they knew Alex, while Aela and the other werewolves paled at the thought.
"P-please, almost the entirety of the Dragon Emperor's forces are beings who's wills he controlling, like ours!" Vilkas exclaimed fearfully, not wanting to see those who had no choice slaughtered like animals.
Thankfully for him, Yuna waved away his concerns as she said, "don't worry, Alex won't needlessly kill those who don't deserve it if he can help it. That's probably why he can't be here for us right now."
Though a sense of relief filled Vilkas the and the other members of the Companions, Yuriko frowned as she asked with narrowed eyes, "I've been wondering this, but by 'Dragon Emperor' they're not talking about Alex, are they?"
Though the werewolves looked confused at her question, both Yami and Yuna shook their heads as the latter said, "no, they're not. Alex would never do the things they've described unless he had a VERY good reason for it, and even then he'd find some alternative method if he could."
Yami nodded in agreement as she added, "I was once like them, until Alex saved me and those who had been enslaved to 'that man's' will like me. He would never do the same to those who don't deserve it."
Though she still had her doubts, Yuriko decided to hold them for now until they knew more about what was going on. Yami then decided to do just that as she moved the map back to Japan, but north of their position where she found a great army that was marching towards them.
"Oh my god....." Rei swore as she beheld the army, which contained any number of people and creatures unlike what any of them from that world had ever seen before. And even more intimidating were the dragons flying around the army as they marched, the greatest of which was a massive black one that dwarfed all others around it.
On its back was a human wearing scale-like armor, who Aela readily pointed to as she said, "THAT is the Dragon Emperor. Not only is he an exceedingly powerful Dragonborn, but he's also acquired the ability to bend the wills of others to his own. The dragon he's riding is none other than Alduin, the World Eater who myths and legends have been sung about for thousands of years, telling how one day he would devour the world to bring it to an end."
Aela then gave Yami and Yuna brief explanation of what she knew of their forces, the different races, their numbers, how many mages they had, and what she knew of the Daedric Princes, demonic gods that were largely considered to malevolent, with only a scant few being considered otherwise. Vilkas and Farkus also threw in their input every now and then, but more than anything they warned the group of the danger of the Dragon Emperor's 'voice'.
According to them he could use an ability called the Thu'um, a powerful form of combat where the user could utilize any number of Shouts to create different effects. According to them there were Shouts that not only summoned the elements like fire and frost, but also ones that could create powerful tornadoes, disarm their opponents, summon dangerous lightning storms, and even steal the life force of their opponent.
Not only were there any number of additional ways the Thu'um could be used, but the use of it wasn't only limited to the Dragon Emperor. According to the Companions, there were several masters of the Thu'um amongst his ranks, which included the usually peaceful hermits known as the Greybeards. And on top of that, the Thu'um was originally the language used by the dragons of their world, meaning each and every one of them could use it as well.
In all...the situation did NOT look good in the slightest.
Even if they had over ten thousand people that Alex had saved, and they were trained to fight, all of their training had been to combat Them, while the sole exceptions were Yami and Yuna. Even if they had firearms and artillery, the other side had all sorts of magical abilities and enhancements that were completely alien to the two girls, and the Companions couldn't help since they despised using magic themselves.
On top of that Alex only made the barriers he put up strong enough to withstand missiles, bullets, and Them. They would collapse almost instantly under the assault of over a hundred dragons, on top of the mages AND the reincarnator.
"Our best bet is to move all our heavy weaponry to the north side of the wall, where we can try to use them to keep the dragons at bay. We'll also place all of our ranged fighters up there as well, Gunners, Black Mages, Gun Mages and so on. Saya, I also want you and the other Alchemists to work on enhancing our artillery in any way you can." Kuriko stated in a commanding tone, drawing on her knowledge of the 'battles' she'd fought in the past while leading her gang in turf wars.
"We should also participate." Ichika said to her daughter, to which Saeko nodded as she looked over the map.
"The Busujima clan will fight at the base of the walls alongside any of those who are willing to join us. We can't just stay on the defensive the entire time until Alex returns." As she said that Vilkas spoke up,
"The Companions will be your vanguard since we have experience fighting the people of our world." As he said that the rest of the werewolves behind him cheered their agreement, though Yuriko looked at them coldly as she asked,
"And how can we trust you won't betray us to this Dragon Emperor of yours?"
For a moment no one said anything as the others looked back and forth between Vilkas ad Yuriko, before the former said, "You can't.... But the same can be said about each of you."
Naturally Vilkas' comment angered more than a few people, but before any could act on their anger Aela stated,
"We've already said the Dragon Emperor possesses the ability to bend others to his will. He could just as easily turn any one of us to his side at a moment's notice. However I doubt that'll happen."
