Alex then began to explain to everyone who he was and how they all got the Chatroom invite, while several of those already connected to it similarly introduced themselves.
It was quickly confirmed that Ruby, Winter and Pyrrha were all from Remnant along with Yang; Nami, Hancock, Shirahoshi, and Yamato were from One Piece along with Robin, who was currently recovering from her own scuffle with Enel; Flannery, Sabrina, and Nemona were all from the Pokemon world along with Cynthia; Liliruca, Haruhime, and Ryuu were all from Danmachi with Bestia; and finally Katara, Princess Yue, and Suki were from the Avatar world along with Ty Lee.
That particular confirmation then opened a whole new can of worms when the three of them realized Ty Lee was from the Fire Nation, which they were all technically at war with. Hermione meanwhile was from the completely new world of Harry Potter.
Aside from that, everyone of course had varying reactions to what Alex told them. Some, like Hermione, flat out refused the possibility of other worlds and the existence of people who could travel between them.
Hancock meanwhile dismissed everything Alex said purely on the basis of him being a man. A few, like Ruby, Katara, Shirahoshi, Yamato, and Princess Yue, all believed Alex for one reason or another. Several however were skeptical for the most part.
It was understandable though, as not EVERYONE had heard of the multiverse theory, or the omniverse.
Of course, there was one person who didn't particularly care.
[Nami: that's cool and all, BUT IT DOESN'T HELP ME RIGHT NOW!]
Alex paused as he realized Nami DID need help, as 'plot' usually ensured Luffy didn't beat his opponent until the last possible moment. The problem was, how could he help her?
Enel was a Logia Devil Fruit user, meaning he was immune to all physical attacks aside from rubber. Alex of course could beat him easily, because he was made of rubber and could use Armament Haki, but Nami was another story since she had no real fighting skill like the rest of the Straw Hat pirates.
She was an exceptionally skilled navigator, the best in the world Alex had no doubt. But Nami's main method of fighting was using a tool their sniper, Usopp, made for her that could manipulate the-
Alex suddenly face-palmed himself as an idea of how to help Nami came to mind, though it would probably require him to sacrifice the vast majority of points he had just earned from the quest to protect Saya, along with those he'd stockpiled.
'Would it work?' Alex mentally asked Lauren, who was silent for a second as she contemplated the answer.
'It should work, an it'd be the best thing to give her.'
Alex nodded slowly to himself even as he told her, 'do it.'
***
"Haa Haa..." Nami panted as she focused all of her attention on surviving.
Currently she was atop the massive flying ship made out of gold, Maxim, where she was staring down the self-proclaimed 'god', Enel.
Enel was currently trying to wipe an entire island, and its inhabitants, out completely, and he was succeeding due to Maxim bolstering his Goro Goro no Mi powers. Meanwhile it was taking Nami everything she had not to be instantly killed by him, as she very narrowly redirected every blast of lightning he sent her way.
This was only possible due to the weapon she wielded in her hands, a three piece staff called the Clima-tact that allowed her to very slightly manipulate the weather around her. It's effect was weak, but usable in a situation like this. Especially with how knowledgable she was about the weather and its patterns.
And of course, as she was fighting to survive, some stupid thing popped up in front of her face that clouded her vision. In her effort to clear it away she apparently accepted an invitation to something called a Chatroom, where people that were supposedly from different worlds had gathered, as well as several people from her world, including one of her own crew mates.
Though she planned to question Robin about it later, for the moment she focused on surviving and begging for help from the people that she was supposedly talking to. Not only did none of them help her though, but several of them even distracted and nearly killed her as they posted naked pictures of themselves on it.
All in all, Nami was getting increasingly pissed as time went on, and she was getting cornered more and more by Enel with no help coming in the foreseeable future.
[DING!]
Another notification from the stupid Chatroom suddenly blocked her vision once again, which Nami immediately tried to dismiss only for an object to appear out of nowhere and land on her hand. An object that appeared to be a fruit.
It wasn't just any fruit though.
The fruit in Nami's hand was shaped like a pineapple, but instead of the usual little section a pineapple had each one depicted a different symbol. Numerous different types of clouds, lighting, snow, sun, wind, all aspects of weather covered what Nami knew to be a Devil Fruit.
Thankfully the sudden appearance of the fruit even caused Enel's attacks to cease, as he watched her curiously without any caution or alarm whatsoever. After all, there was no way Nami could be a threat to him, she wasn't made of the despicable rubber like the idiot from earlier had been.
Just as she was wondering what to do with it, as Nami had never wanted to eat a Devil Fruit and lose her ability to swim, another notification came across the Chatroom that she read this time. A message from this Alex guy, which said,
[Alex: eat it Nami. It's a Weather Weather fruit that will grant you complete control of the weather around you without needing the Clima-tact. With your skills, I have no doubt it'll make you one of the most powerful people in your world.]
Nami ignored the numerous other notifications she was receiving from the rest of those in the Chatroom as she looked at the fruit in her hands, her mind and heart both racing as she contemplated eating it.
Did she really want to give up her ability to swim for the ability to control weather with a mere whim?
The answer was surprisingly easy for her to arrive at less than a second later.
Yes.
Yes she did.
Without another thought, and before Enel could resume his numerous attacks, Nami bit into the Devil Fruit, and the most horrendous taste she'd ever experienced filled her mouth.
(A.N. The translated name for the weather fruit is apparently the Ara Ara no Mi, but I just went with the English version so people didn't think it was a fruit that turned you into an onee-San.
Also, regarding Yamato. Before anyone tries claiming she's trans, I'm going to say right now she's not. If Yamato merely wanted to be a 'man' then she WOULD be trans, but that's not the case. She only considered herself to be a guy because she idolizes Kozuki Oden, who was a man, and wants to become him. So the way I see it, she's just larping instead of actually being transgender.)

chapters.title: Chapter 516 - 516: In the Omniverse
chapters.content:
"Ha..." Alex sighed in relief when Nami informed him she HAD in fact eaten the Devil Fruit, which he knew would be more than enough for her to defeat Enel on her own.
Though normally it would take some time for a person to adapt to their Devil Fruit powers, Nami was already capable of reading, using, and manipulating the weather better than anyone else in their world. Add to the fact that Enel was a lightning man, which was an actual part of the weather she could now control, and Alex almost felt sorry for him. Almost.
Of course, this little maneuver didn't come without a price.
Alex had Lauren transfer nearly all of the Chatroom shop points he possessed to Nami, where Lauren then bought the Ara Ara no Mi on her behalf. It was a price well paid though, as Nami was bound to become a world class powerhouse with the powers of Ara Ara no Mi, and her own knowledge of weather.
Now there was only the rest of those Alex was in touch with.
Wether or not they themselves were aware of it, several of them needed help in some way or another. And now the ability to send each other items through the Chatroom was open, so Alex cracked his knuckles as he got to work.
***
Princess Yue was in trouble.
Her entire life she had lived within the confines of the Northern Water Tribe's city, living by their traditions and restrictions not just created by her gender, but also by her status. Everywhere Princess Yue went she was escorted by both guards and attendants, and every facet of her life was planned out.
Even as a water bender she was unable to properly use her talents, as only men in their tribe were allowed to fight, while the women were only able to learn the healing arts of water bending.
And yet...
Despite the restrictions on her life, Princess Yue had been content. She had grown up learning about her duty, and her importance to her tribe. Even when her engagement to the warrior Hahn had been arranged, Yue hadn't complained or gone against it at all spite Hahn's reputation as a womanizer. Or him openly boasting about the 'perks' he got by marrying her.
Today however, something had changed within her.
It started with the appearance of something called the Chatroom, within which were numerous people from either around her world, or different worlds entirely. And NOT the Spirit World either.
And then something she'd never expected happened as the girl called Ruby posted a picture of her most private of places.
It was the most scandalous thing Yue had ever seen, yet she couldn't tear her gaze away from it either.
That first image was followed by several others, before Yue found herself getting a brief moment of privacy, in which she too hiked up her furs to flash the others.
That had given the sheltered Princess the greatest thrill of her life as unknown feelings welled up within her, and an itch she'd never felt before formed between her legs.
Upon returning to her private quarters, Yue stripped off her furs and flopped down onto her bed. Her room was still freezing, especially since everything in the Northern Water Tribe was made of ice and snow, but Yue had long since grown accustomed to the cold, having lived there her entire life.
This particular moment however she felt hot. REALLY hot.
And the heat grew Yue slowly moved her fingers to the hottest part of her body, the place she had exposed earlier between her legs. And once there, her fingers began to explore experimentally as they traced her hidden folds.
Yue didn't know what she was doing, she had never done something like this before. But whatever IT was, it felt so right to her.
The entire time she could hear numerous notifications going off on the Chatroom, but was ignoring them all as she focused on the mysterious waves flowing through her body at the moment. But then, some force made her open her eyes just in time to see something the likes of which put what she'd seen earlier to shame.
It was a picture of a extremely large man, but he was completely covered in bright red fur with a thick mane of pitch black hair flowing around his shoulders. He was sitting upon a chair as if it were a throne, and most embarrassingly of all, he was completely naked.
Having never seen a man naked before, Yue was transfixed as her fingers furiously pumped her folds harder and faster, seemingly with a mind of their own.
Even if she'd never seen the real thing, her education of course had included wifely duties, above all was producing an heir for the royal family. So even if she'd never seen what she was seeing now before, she knew exactly what it was for as she imagined it pumping in and out of her, stirring her up before finally filling her with its life-giving seed.
A rush suddenly enveloped Yue's body as her fingers were suddenly bathed in a shower of fluid, and she involuntarily cried out in ecstasy.
"Princess! Is everything ok?!" The guards outside her door yelled as they heard her cry.
"I-I'm fine!" Yue exclaimed as she tried to keep them from barging in and finding her in her compromised state.
With a flick of her wrist she gathered up all of the moisture covering her body and flicked it away to dispose of it, before quickly dressing with reddened cheeks as she recalled the image of the man, who she could only presume was Alex.
...
On the other end of the world another young woman was going through a similar struggle.
Unlike the Northern Water Tribe, which was still a stronghold that had resisted hundreds of raids from the Fire Nation over the last hundred years, the Southern Water Tribe was nothing more than a small collection of a few tents surrounding a large igloo.
A hundred years of raids from the Fire Nation had not only wiped out all but one water bender, but all of the able bodied men had departed years prior to assist the Earth Kingdom in fighting back against the Fire Nation.
Now the small settlement was populated only by elderly, mothers, and a few young children. The only able bodied ones in the entire village were Katara and her older brother, Sokka, who was in fact the tribe's only remaining Hunter/warrior, while Katara herself was the only remaining water bender.
And while Yue had lived her entire life being restricted by her tribe's traditions and her role as a princess, Katara had spent her entire life taking care of the village while her talents as a water bender went to waste, due to no one being able to teach her. In fact, certain members of her own tribe, such as her brother, even regarded Katara akin to a freak for being able to water bend.
So she too was excited to get an invitation from the Chatroom, and had readily participated in it despite the questionable activities of its members. After all, this was the FIRST time she had actually been able to interact with people similar in age with herself outside her brother.
But the best part had yet to come.
Soon Katara saw someone posted an image of a man that was supposedly the one who ran the Chatroom, Alex, completely naked as he lounged on a chair as if it were a throne.
The photo, which was the same one Yue had masturbated to, was the picture Alex had taken for the competition from when he first acquired the Chatroom, and therefore showed him with his 'Peerless Beauty' skill in full effect.
Seeing a naked man for the first time in her life, Katara was completely transfixed by Alex and his appearance, though she still had several questions regarding exactly WHAT he was.
Before she could ask any of them though, she suddenly received a notification from someone named Anne, which Katara readily opened only for a small wooden box to appear out of midair in front of her.
Surprised at something just appearing in front of her, Katara tentatively opened the box since she was within the privacy of her tent, and was stunned at what she found within it.
"It can't be...!" Katara uttered emotionally, even as she picked up one of the scrolls and opened it, to reveal a drawn figure going through numerous motions while controlling what appeared to be a stream of water.
"Water bending scrolls!?" She gasped as her suspicions were confirmed, making her heart pound in her chest as she looked the same scroll over again and again to make sure she wasn't seeing things.
And a quick check through all of them confirmed that every single scroll depicted moves and techniques associated with water bending in various difficulties.
Despite it quickly growing darker out, and colder, Katara swiftly exited her tent and took off with the box of scrolls tucked under her arm. The fact that it was night didn't deter her, as the full moon was out and provided enough light that she was even able to make out the figures drawn on the scrolls.
...
A few hundred miles north of Katara at the South Pole, a young woman with shoulder length auburn colored hair was conflicted.
As first she was interested in the Chatroom after the invitation appeared before her, but her interest waned when she realized it belonged to a pervert who wanted them to post naughty images of themselves on it.
And then the man behind it all, Alex, asked her a strange question. To use the Chatroom to send him a set of all the equipment she and her comrades used for combat. The sacred attire and weapons of the Kiyoshi Warriors.
Attired in green armored kimonos and metallic headdresses, and armed with metal fans, retractable shields, and katanas, the Kiyoshi Warriors could trace their legacy back several centuries to none other than the great Avatar Kiyoshi herself. They were a female exclusive band of warriors, who had long since protected the island of Kiyoshi from outsiders and invaders, including the Fire Nation.
Suki was naturally hesitant to send a set of their armor and weapons to a pervert like Alex, but she eventually relented anyways. Though a pervert, Suki quickly realized Alex didn't possess the same sexist beliefs as most men about women fighting, and wondered if he simply wanted to let one of them try their style of fighting for themselves.
What Suki never expected was for Alex to send her the armor and weapons back a short while later with Alex's thanks, only for it to be followed by a hundred other identical sets of armor and weapons.
And as if that hadn't been surprising enough, Alex then informed Suki that each and every one had been 'enchanted', whatever that meant. But according to Alex, all of the armors were impossible to tear, and were completely resistant to heat and fire, meaning they never had to worry about being wounded by fire bending ever again.
Their weapons meanwhile had all been enchanted to never dull, and were far sharper than any of them had ever been before. To the point where Suki even sliced through rocks and bars of metal as if they were paper.
To call Suki amazed would be an understatement, to say nothing of how her comrades felt when they learned of their new equipment. Naturally Suki didn't tell them where she got it.
The only thing that worried her about the whole situation though, was what this was going to cost her in the future...
***
Liliruca Arde glowered a she stared at the screen that was being projected before her eyes, still trying to decide what to think of it.
Naturally she was suspicious of it. After all, she had quickly learned to not trust anyone in her life, including her own parents, but most of all adventurers.
With both of her parents being born into the Soma Familia, Lili was a member of it from birth, meaning she had been trapped within the familia her entire life. At first she had been used to make money by her parents, but when they died within the Dungeon she had been left to fend for herself within a Familia that cared nothing for her.
Like many others in the city of Orario Lili had turned towards the Dungeon herself to make money to survive, but soon discovered she had no aptitude to be an adventurer. So she turned to being a supporter for adventurers instead, only to constantly take years of abuse and mistreatment from them.
What made matters even worse for her was that Lili was a Pallum, a race of people that strongly resembled humans, but were short and often resembled children throughout their entire lives(Hobbits). Because they were considered to be the weakest race, Pallum men and women had a long history of being oppressed and even enslaved, and were often turned into sex slaves for the more degenerate of nobility and such.
Lili had also been forced to deal with her fair share of perverts, but thanks to her general distrust of everyone around her, and her magic called Cinder Ella, which allowed her to transform slightly, she had been able to avoid being 'spoiled'.
So with an entire life of being mistreated and used behind her, she was skeptical at best about the Chatroom. But, thankfully there was in fact a way for her to confirm its existence and determine its worth, as she approached an abandoned and crumbling church.
This was the home of the goddess Hestia, who was also a part of the Chatroom where she went by Bestia for some reason.
Just as she was about to reach for the door, Lili heard soft footsteps echoing off the alley walls around her.
Whirling around with her crossbow at the ready, Lili found herself looking at a Elven woman with green hair and a similarly colored maid uniform, who stared at her impassively.
"It appears we had the same idea." The elf said in a calm voice, making Lili pause before she hesitantly asked,
"Ryuu-Sama?"
The Elven women nodded slowly before approaching her so they were both standing at the door leading to the church.
As she approached Lili was completely alert, studying every single movement the elf made, and what she saw scared her. Ryuu was no ordinary elf.
That was what Lili's instincts, after being around adventurers her entire life, were screaming at her as Ryuu got closer to her, until they were side by side. Even as Ryuu raised her hand to simply knock on the church door, Lili's eyes never left her, and the tension never left her body.
*knock*
Ryuu''s knuckles wrapped on the solid wooden doors once, and before she could knock again they swung open suddenly to reveal a woman who stood a foot taller than Lili, who was only a little over three and a half feet.
She had coal black hair tied up into long twin tails with ribbons that had bells on them, and her bright blue eyes scanned the two of them excitedly. But both Ryuu and Lili's eyes were drawn entirely to the girl's absolutely massive chest, which bounced and boinged with each movement she made.
"Ryuu? Lili!? Hi! I'm Hestia!" The diminutive goddess exclaimed excitedly from seeing them, before she glanced around curiously. "Haruhime isn't here..." She added sadly, having expected all three of them to show up.
"So I wasn't imagining it..." Ryuu uttered quietly, having gotten confirmation from both Lili and Hestia that the Chatroom did exist.
"Sorry we aren't enough for you." Lili stated however, annoyed at Hestia's apparent disappointment.
"O-oh! It's not that! It's just that Alex and I were talking about her a bit, and we were worried..." Hestia quickly said.
Based on the short bit of information he'd gotten from her, Alex had his concerns regarding Haruhime. Naturally, not being in the same universe as her just yet, he shared his concerns with Hestia in the hopes that the goddess could help him help the fox girl.
Hestia had been hoping Haruhime would come to her church so they could actually talk, but it appeared she'd have to rely on the 'secondary' option Alex gave her.
For the moment however she focused on Lili and Ryuu, leading the duo into her ruined church only for them to gape as they beheld all of the brand new and luxurious furniture within it that didn't match the exterior.
"Tea?" Hestia asked as she prepared a pot of tea for them, using the brand new tea set Alex had sent her.
Hestia had been receiving LOTS of gifts from Alex ever since he had unlocked the ability for them to send physical objects through the Chatroom. Things ranging from food items, items for her day-to-day use, and even treasures and valuables.
The way Alex saw it, Hestia wasn't supposed to spend her immortal life in the mortal realm working just to survive. And it cost him nothing to ensure she had what she needed to live comfortably.
So it was only after Hestia brought the two of them tea that Ryuu asked her seriously, "How much do you really 'know' about this 'Alex'?"
Hestia silently set her tea down on the table between them before looking both Lili and Ryuu in the eye at the question. The two girls leaned forward tensely as they saw Hestia take in a deep breath, before she exploded,
"He's the most AMAZING person there is! Alex is an emperor that has built a massive family with hundreds of wives and dozens of children, and does everything in his power to keep them safe from harm! One time, one of his daughters was kidnapped, and Alex mobilized his ENTIRE empire to get her back!"
Just as Hestia was about to launch into story mode to tell Ryuu and Lili all the amazing things she'd learned from Alex's wives ever since she got the Chatroom, there was a sudden notification that distracted her before an entire stack of papers appeared out of thin air and landed on the table next to her tea.
Curious, Hestia picked them up as she read the top sheet of paper, which read,
-Hestia,
I prepared these to deal with a few problems I know are over there, and hopefully whatever is going on with Haruhime. If none of them work for her then let me know and I can make something else.
-love, Alex.
Hestia's heart leapt when she read the letter from Alex, making her squeal in excitement at the end when he mentioned 'love', much to Ryuu and Lili's annoyance.
"What is it?" Lili asked irritably, making Hestia flip through the rest of the papers curiously.
"Let's see... What the-!?"
The second Hestia made contact with one of the papers it lit up suddenly, before a brilliant golden sword erupted from the page and shot upwards to pass through the ceiling before it disappeared.
"Ok.... And what was that?" Ryuu asked Hestia, who read the back of the page immediately.
"Ascalon?" The goddess replied hesitantly, though she didn't know why Alex would send that item in particular.
The page under it though had Hestia sitting up in excitement as she read what it did, right before it too lit up and filled the church with light.
"Again!?!" Lili cried out in irritation as she shielded her eyes from the light, before it died down to reveal a fox-girl with long golden blonde hair, who was completely naked.
"Eh?" Haruhime uttered in confusion as she took in her surroundings, not at all aware of what was going on. But when she realized she was naked, her entire face turned beet red as she tried to cover herself while crying out, "KYAAAAAAAAAA!!!"
Rather than react though, the rest of the gathered girls dead panned at her as Lili retorted,
"Why are you so shy? Haruhime-Sama already showed everyone before..."
"It's not the same!" The embarrassed fox-girl cried, before demanding, "and why am I here!?!"
The three girls looked at each other and then at the stack of papers on the table, before saying in unison,
"""Alex."""
"Well why am I naked!?!"
"Alex." Hestia stated plainly, having already heard all about his 'Lucky Pervert' skill from the rest of his wives. She had no doubt this little incident was probably caused by that very same skill.
The titty goddess quickly got up to check the wardrobe for something for Haruhime to wear, only returning with a robe since all of the clothes were tailored to fit her size, and were too small for Haruhime. And even without that none of Hestia's clothes were designed for those with tails, so Haruhime's butt was constantly being displayed whenever she moved.
After a few minutes and some tea she finally managed to calm down enough for Hestia to try and explain things somewhat, namely that she had been looking at a stack of papers that Alex had sent her, and accidentally summoned Haruhime when she touched one.
Just as she reached out to pick the stack up again, Lili quickly swiped them instead as she stated coolly, "Maybe I should be the one to look through these Hestia-Sama..."
Though Hestia wanted to protest she couldn't, seeing as she had accidentally activated both pages she touched without meaning to. So, she could only sit there in silence and sulk as Lili shifted through the pages for them.
"!!!"
Lili's heart suddenly felt as if it had stopped beating entirely as she came across a certain page amongst them. One that, if she was reading the description correctly, could remove the 'blessing' of the gods, the Falna.
A Falna was a blessing from gods to mortals that would empower them beyond their wildest dreams if used correctly, while also marking the receiving mortal as a part of the god's 'family', or Familia.
As a member off the Soma Familia from birth Lili obviously had his Falna upon her back, but in her case it was more like a curse than a blessing. And to have it removed she would be required to hand over a fortune to her God to fund his 'hobby'.
Truthfully, Lili also planned to scope out those connected to Chatroom to see what they had worth stealing to add to her coffers to leave Soma Familia, but actually meeting Ryuu in person completely ruined such plans early on. It was a shame too, as Hestia and Haruhime seemed like easy marks to her.
Looking at the page before her though, tears began to form in Lili's eyes as she realized she didn't need to save up a fortune to leave Soma. But now she had to find a way to 'steal' this page, since she doubted this Alex person would give it away so easily.
"What's wrong Lili? You got quiet all of a sudden?" Hestia asked her suddenly, startling Lili out of her reverie
"Nothing Hestia-Sama! I was just reading this!" Lili said dismissively, before using one of the tricks she'd picked up to steal from adventurers to slip the page into her sleeve, with none of the others being the wiser. Or so Lili thought.
"And what is this?" Ryuu asked as she moved faster than Lili thought possible, swiping the page from her and holding it up to look at it.
"Give it back! I need that!" Lili exclaimed with panic evident in her voice, surprising everyone present as she lunged for the page, disregarding her earlier misgivings regarding Ryuu's strength.
However for Ryuu it was child's play keep the page out of Lili's reach, and reading it to herself as Hestia and Haruhime watched on with interest.
"Removing the blessing of the gods? Why would you need this?" Ryuu asked Lili curiously, to which the distraught Pallum retorted with tears in her eyes,
"Shut up! You don't know anything! You don't know what it's like being weak and unable to do anything! Always being treated like trash for being a supporter! Always being mocked, beaten, and taken advantage of! Never being able to leave or escape! You don't know anything!"
By this point Lili was hysterical as she tried taking the page back from Ryuu, desperate to get her hands on it so she can quit being a member of Soma Familia for good.
What she never expected was to be enveloped in warm softness as Hestia suddenly pulled Lili into her breasts, smothering the Pallum girl as she embraced her.
"It's ok." Hestia told her softly, before the sound of Lili sobbing came from her breasts.
"That'll never happen again." Hestia continued as she slowly began to pet Lili's head soothingly as the Pallum girl shuddered in her embrace.
"Alex will never let someone hurt you again." The goddess told her, not in a soothing tone this time, but with a conviction that didn't match her earlier careless and happy-go-lucky attitude.
"Either of you." Hestia added suddenly as she looked up at Haruhime, who appeared startled to be included in the goddess' declaration before her heart skipped a beat.
After all, she had loved reading fairy tales where a brave knight or prince would come and save her, a slave who was forced to work in a brothel as a part of the Ishtar Familia. But, as much as she loved the idea of being freed from her position, she also knew she didn't deserve it as a prostitute.
Ryuu meanwhile remained silent as Hestia comforted the distraught Lili, setting aside the page the Pallum had tried to steal for her later, and looking through the rest curiously.
Surprisingly, Alex had included a few more pages dedicated to removing the Falna of the gods in case they needed them, as well as several other things that made even her cool and collected mind race.
Amongst them were one time use spells for 'defense', yet they were on the level of a cataclysm if what Ryuu was reading was correct. There was also another spell that would conjure a barrier more powerful than any she had ever seen before, and even several pages that would supposedly allow them to teleport directly out of the Dungeon if they needed to.
Such a thing was impossible... Wasn't it?
Luckily for Ryuu's sanity, she did not see all of the weapons, treasures, and other equipment Alex had sent Hestia, and were stored in a spatial storage ring.
***
"Soooooooo..... I'm Ruby....." Ruby Rose said awkwardly to their two house guests, Winter Schnee and Pyrrha Nikos.
The two of them had arrived a short while ago in an airship piloted by Winter after she took a temporary leave from the Atlesian army, picking up Pyrrha on the way to Yang and Ruby's house on the island of Patch.
And currently the four women were sitting there awkwardly staring at one another, not knowing what to say. Well, everyone else was sitting, Ruby insisted on standing for some reason.
Winter was a woman in her early to mid twenties, with pure white hair that was tied back in a bun with a fringe of bangs covering a part of her face, and stern blue eyes. Pyrrha meanwhile had long red hair that was tied back in a ponytail, and was attired with numerous metal accessories on her body.
"So, what is this Chatroom?" Winter eventually demanded from Yang, her tone filled with authority and dignity as she intended to get to the bottom of this whole situation, even as she completely ignored Ruby.
"Well..." Yang began slowly, as she tried to find a way to explain it.
"It's kinda like a scroll in which we can talk to each other and stuff through it, but it also lets us talk to people in other universes and stuff as well." Yang stated quickly, before Winter asked skeptically,
"And you believe that?"
Yang nodded as she said seriously,
"Yes I do. The things I've seen on it, they can't be done on Remnant."
"And how do you know we aren't hallucinating or something?"
"Because of this."
As she said that Yang swiftly exited the house with the three of them on her heels, where she walked up to a large Boulder and proceeded to pick it up and spin it on her finger as if it weighed nothing.
"Remind me not to fight you." Pyrrha uttered quietly in awe, while Ruby beamed at her big sister with pride.
"A-and that's not a part of your Semblance?" Winter asked again, trying desperately to deny the existence of the Chatroom and the Omniverse.
"Nope~! My Semblance is called Burn, and turns energy from attacks I take into power. I can't just activate whenever I want like this." Yang explained with more than a little smugness to her tone. She then continued explaining,
"The Chatroom has a store with items and abilities we can buy with points earned by completing quests from it. Certain quests can also directly reward us with certain things, like the Superhuman Strength I got when I first joined the Chatroom!"
"And what kind of quest did you do to get your Superhuman Strength?" Winter asked in response to the explanation Yang gave them, making the energetic blonde falter as she dropped the rock.
"W-well it's not really THAT important... But the main thing is that we can actually get rewarded for doing things as simple as killing Grim and stuff!"
Winter narrowed her eyes at Yang's blatantly desperate attempt to dodge her question, and she was about to repeat herself when Yang, Ruby and Pyrrha all looked up at the same time.
"Awesome!" Ruby exclaimed excitedly, right before her weapon Crescent Rose, a scythe that turned into rifle, appeared out of thin air, along with Yang's Ember Celica, a pair of gauntlets that were also shotguns, and Pyrrha's Miló and Akoúo, a lance/sword/rifle and shield.
Winter was left watching as the other three girls were reunited with their weapons after sending them to one of the girls in the Chatroom, Lala, at Alex's request. She however didn't trust them enough with her beloved swords just yet.
But what she never expected was for two more items to appear after their weapons, a small capsule-like thing with a button, and a ring. With one of each appearing for all three of them, they readily examined the objects before Yang stated,
"Hey! I think these are those storage ring things Alex said they had! They use them to store tons of objects so they can carry them around easily!" And a quick check was all Yang needed to confirm that she was right, and that that each of the storage rings contains tons of various materials and other items that could be used to upgrade their weapons.
*poof!*
"Wah!" Ruby cried out in alarm after she pushed the button on the capsule curiously, only for it to 'explode' in a cloud of smoke that cleared to reveal a strange machine sitting where she had been standing.
Immediately the screen lit up to reveal the face of a pink haired girl with a bubbly appearance.
"HELLO~! It's so nice to finally see all of you!" The girl on the screen exclaimed excitedly, making Yang gape in dumbfoundment as she uttered,
"A-are we actually seeing you right now!?!"
Lala nodded energetically as she said,
"Yep yep! I thought to myself that maybe we'd be able to communicate outside the Chatroom if I sent one of my machines to one of you, and it turned out I was RIGHT! Yippie!" Lala then celebrated the success of her experiment as a small robotic figure also congratulated her, leaving the four women confused as they watched her.
Unknown to them, Lala made it a habit to spit in the eye of the laws of reality on a daily basis.
"So what is this thing?" Ruby asked as her excitement overrode her confusion.
"It's Mobile-Mobile Lab-Chan! It's a mobile lab that can go anywhere and do anything! It's already loaded with scans and plans for modifications for Crescent Rose! The other two are filled with designs for Ember Celica and Miló and Akoúo, while all three have blueprints for armor and stuff!
"Just put the materials into the tray, select the design you want, and with a 'swoosh', 'clang', and 'boom', it'll be done! Just like that!" Jumping at the end of her explanation, numerous questions filled the minds of the four women.
Why would an invention go 'boom'?
Would it really be that simple?
And why, just WHY, was Lala naked?
These and other questions floated through their minds, with the last one being the most prominent as Lala backed away from the screen so they could see more than her face, only to instead get an eyeful of her bouncing boobies.
None of them even registered the tail swirling in the air behind her. And when they finally did, it only added to the list of questions.
Winter rolled her eyes as Yang and Pyrrha both activated their own capsules to see what designs Lala came up with for their own weapons, leaving her alone since she didn't send her weapons to be examined or upgraded.
So instead Winter opened the Chatroom shop that Yang told her about, and looked through it to see if there was anything in there worth her time.
Winter's heart practically froze when she saw what was on there.
Something that was impossible.
"All of the Maiden Powers...." Winter uttered in disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 517 - 517: In the Omniverse pt2
chapters.content:
"Wow! This Chatroom is so interesting!" Exclaimed a girl with crimson red hair that was soaking in a steaming hot bath.
She was Flannery, the Pokemon Gym Leader of Lavaridge town in the Hoenn region.
As one would expect from a Gym Leader of a town at the base of a volcano, Flannery specialized in fire type Pokemon. None of which were with her now of course, as they didn't like getting wet AT ALL.
So she was taking the moment of solitude to familiarize herself with the Chatroom and what was on it.
In the shop Flannery was amazed to find several items that could make her Pokemon stronger, increase the results of their training, TMs to teach them new moves, and even Pokeballs. Amazingly, there was even a Pokeball with a one hundred percent catch rate called a Master Ball on there!
What surprised Flannery most of all was that there were even Pokemon eggs on there as well, meaning she could quite literally buy the Pokemon she wanted from the Chatroom!
To be able to do that though she needed to complete quests.
The quests Flannery had to take though were quite interesting to say the least. Amongst them were quests related to defeating trainers, catching Pokemon, and even challenging other Gym Leaders!
While the idea itself was interesting, Flannery couldn't help but grow anxious at the idea of facing the other Gym Leaders in battle. She herself had just recently became the Gym Leader of Lavaridge town, so she wasn't sure about challenging the hardened veterans that had been Gym Leaders for several years already...
But then there were also quests that involved her defeating members of the group's known as Team Aqua and Team Magma, names that sounded vaguely familiar, but Flannery didn't recognize them from anywhere around Lavaridge town.
But, based off the name, there was one place nearby where Flannery guessed she might run into members of one of the groups.
The fiery redhead glanced upwards at the massive volcano that loomed over Lavaridge town in contemplation, before standing up suddenly as she declared to no one in particular, "Alright! Let's go check out the volcano and train while we're at it!"
She then quickly dressed and gathered her Pokemon Blaziken, Camerupt, Torkoal, and Magcargo, all fire types, and headed out to complete some quests.
...
In another region, another Gym Leader was deep in meditation as she focused her psychic powers to the extreme alongside her Pokemon, throwing her mind into the currents of time as she tried to divine the future.
Unfortunately all she could find was a cloud of fog. Fog that was growing thicker with every passing second.
The fog had started forming several days ago, clouding the currents of time and making them increasingly difficult to discern. This had been a great source of stress for the woman, Sabrina, as she could only divine such an omen to mean that the world itself was threatened.
Thankfully that didn't entirely seem to be the case after she was invited to something called the Chatroom, which she quickly learned that the Sinnoh League Champion was already a member of. And after talking to her a bit Sabrina had concluded that the fog had begun the day Cynthia joined the Chatroom.
This meant that the fog was developing as a result of their world becoming involved with the Omniverse, which was making the future harder to divine as they became more involved with one another.
Though knowing the source of the fog itself was a relief, Sabrina was still worried since that meant she and other psychics would be unable to divine possible disasters and such. Not to mention the lack of information regarding the man in charge of the Chatroom, Alexander Morningstar.
His entire existence was completely alien to her, as was the rest of his 'wives' as he referred to them. Though Sabrina couldn't help but to wonder what kind of man needed hundreds of wives, and was still apparently adding to the 'collection'.
With so many unnknown variables, and her being unable to divine the future due to the Chatroom's existence, all Sabrina could do was study those who used it to try and learn more about them, and their motives. Specifically Alex himself.
Of course, even as she concluded that, Sabrina didn't have someone posting a naked picture of apparently Alex in mind. She had to admit though, his figure and features were unusually attractive.
...
"Yeah! Let's go!" Cried out a young tanned woman with her black hair tied back in a ponytail, except for her signature green streak.
Currently she was working with her team to help them get stronger, despite the fact that there was no one in the entirety of the Paldea region that could match her. Even their Champion, Geeta hadn't been a true match against her team.
Now the girl, Nemona, was hoping that the Chatroom would give her the chance to truly push herself and her team as much as possible.
This seemed likely as one of the members of the Chatroom was the Champion of the Sinnoh Region, Cynthia, who was notorious for being a prodigy at training Pokemon.
The only part of the Chatroom and different worlds that bummed Nemona out was that apparently they didn't have Pokemon, but on the other hand that just provided its own unique challenge in itself.
So, with something so exciting and unknown to look forward to, Nemona was training her team to be able to handle anything in preparation.
...
"Haa..." Cynthia sighed as she contemplated wether or not to try the Chatroom's new function to send items to one another.
Ever since she had first acquired the Chatroom Cynthia had been collecting Pokemon to be introduced to Asora, or that was the best idea she had for all of the Pokemon the Chatroom quested her to catch. But now she was torn as she contemplated sending a Pokemon in a Pokeball through the Chatroom.
Now they were capable of sending objects to one another, but Cynthia was terrified about sending a Pokemon since she wasn't sure if they would survive the transition. An empty Pokeball was one thing, a Pokeball with an actual Pokemon in it was something else entirely.
She had been discussing the situation with Alex when he suddenly sent her a new message.
[Alex: send one to me. If something happens to it I'll use all of my available magics to try and save it.]
Cynthia felt as if she was going to throw up at the thought of willingly doing something that could literally destroy an innocent Pokemon, and contemplated just telling Alex no at trying to send any Pokemon through the Chatroom.
But with him literally recreating scenes of him bringing people back to life to prove his capabilities to her, Cynthia eventually closed her eyes and pressed send.
The seconds that ticked by afterwards felt like an eternity for each one as Cynthia silently begged and pleaded whoever was listening that the Pokemon she sent was alright.
[DING!]
Cynthia jumped as the notification went off and her anxiety skyrocketed as she debated on wether or not she REALLY wanted to open the Chatroom.
Eventually her morbid curiosity got the better of her, and Cynthia opened the Chatroom to see what the result was of their experiment. And what greeted her was picture of Alex with an excited Chimchar clinging to his hair as it danced atop his head.
"Oh thank Mew!" Cynthia exclaimed in relief that the Chimchar she sent was fine, and appeared to be fairly attached to Alex already if the next few pictures he sent was any indication.
And so now, the Dragon Emperor was officially a Pokemon trainer.
***
"HAHAHAHAHAHA! I AM 'GOD' NOW!" Declared an orange haired girl who posed victoriously.
""All hail God! All hail God!""" Chanted the three before her, a short statured reindeer/human hybrid, a long nosed coward, and a man wearing a straw hat, her own captain.
"NAMI-SWANNNNNN~! YOU'RE ALWAYS MY GODDESS~!" Cried out a well dressed blond man who currently had hearts for eyes as he worshipped the young woman, Nami.
"Looks like they're having fun." A black haired woman said with amusement.
"Yeah. But how did she 'suddenly' get a Devil Fruit? A fruit that conveniently lets her control the weather at that?" Questioned the green haired swordsman at her side.
The woman, Robin, looked at the swordsman, Zoro, slyly at his observation. She of course learned all about how Nami got the Devil Fruit from Alex, and approved of her getting the fruit since it had helped them out against Enel. Even if Nami was acting all arrogant and such now, it was mostly just her messing around in the wake of not only getting her own powers, but also from her beating a major opponent on her own.
And all around them the survivors from the battle, both the Skypieans and the Guerrillas that were descended from the Shandians that originally lived on the island of Jaya, were celebrating the defeat of Enel, their own survival, and the relative peace they had for the first time since the Shandians were sent to the sky more than four hundreds years prior.
In the center of the celebration was the Straw Hat pirates, as they were the ones who did the most in defeating Enel and his priests. However Zoro was the only one in a non-celebratory mood as he pondered just HOW Nami had gotten the Ara Ara no Mi.
"You know something." Zoro said to Robin, who smiled knowingly as she replied,
"Perhaps, but that is for miss Navigator to tell." Zoro scowled at Robin's answer, but didn't press further. He himself still wasn't sure about her, as Robin was originally their enemy.
So all he could do wait until he could ask Nami herself, but with the way party was going, that would take quite a while.
...
"Oh! This is so much fun!" Shirahoshi exclaimed excitedly as she played around on the Chatroom.
For the past eight years she had been locked up in the most impregnable tower of their castle for fear of her safety after a constant stream of threatening letters and marriage proposals on behalf of a Fishman known as Vander Decken the ninth.
The only interaction she'd had with others in that entire time was her pet shark, Megalo, and when her meals were delivered.
So this was the most Shirahoshi had gotten to 'talk' to others in years, even if she embarrassed herself in her earlier excitement. But she wasn't expecting that when she received a notification from Alex, a jeweled necklace appeared before her.
"How pretty..." Shirahoshi exclaimed as she admired the necklace, nearly missing Alex's next message as he explained its function.
[Alex: it's a necklace that's enchanted to protect the wearer from all manner of threats, physical, toxins, mental manipulation, and everything else I was able to think of. With this, you shouldn't have to worry about the threats from Vander Decken.]
Shirahoshi felt as if her heart stopped as she read what Alex did to the necklace he gave her, before tears began to form in her eyes.
Eight years.
That was how long she had lived cooped up in this tower. Living in fear of the constant threats and marriage proposals from Vander Decken. Growing increasingly terrified of the outside world.
Now.....
Now she was safe.
Though there was no basis that Alex had been telling the truth, or that his enchantments would work, Shirahoshi didn't doubt them in the slightest as she slipped the necklace over her head so that it came to rest right between her breasts.
[Shirahoshi: thank you mr. Alex-Sama....
Alex: don't thank me just yet. This necklace comes with a price Shirahoshi. I want you to tell your father the truth about your mother's death.]
Shirahoshi's breath caught in her throat as she read the reply from Alex, as she recalled the information she thought only she knew.
Eight years ago Shirahoshi's mother, Otohime, had been killed.
Otohime was a frail mermaid who had dedicated her entire life to helping others, and always believed in the best of people even when it plainly wasn't there.
A large portion of her life had been dedicated to trying to gain mermaids and Fishman a place on the surface, where they were hunted and enslaved. And while many people thought her crazy for trying to believe in humans, soon her persistence began to pay off as more and more of their people began to agree with her.
The biggest change had been when she nursed a Celestial Dragon back from the brink of death, earning them the chance to have their voices heard by the world government above along with the rest of the kings and queens of the world.
However, just as Otohime had managed to gather enough signatures to show their sincerity, she was murdered.
By a human.
All of the effort in her life had been wasted as a deep seed of hatred towards humanity took root in everyone's hearts from her death, a seed that persisted even now, eight years later.
But Shirahoshi knew the truth.
Her mother hadn't been killed by a human like everyone thought.
Shortly after her mother's death, Shirahoshi had been told by Megalo, who had witnessed the entire thing, that her mother had been murdered by a Fishman. A member of the Neptune Army, Hody Jones.
For eight years Shirahoshi had known the truth about her mother's death, and told no one. This was due to one of her mother's final wishes, which was to hold no hatred for her killer.
But now she was being asked to reveal the true identity of her mother's killer.
[Shirahoshi: mr. Alex-Sama... I can't tell my father the truth. He'll kill them if I did...
Alex: Shirahoshi, I'm not asking you to condemn and execute them or anything. But you need to remember that by killing someone, Hody broke the law. Even more so after he killed the queen of Fishman island.
Alex: not to mention, how would you feel if he hurt or killed more people because no one knew the truth about him? Would your mother want that?]
Shirahoshi was silent as she contemplated what Alex told her.
Truthfully, she understood completely what Alex was saying, but she also did not want to turn her back on her mother's final wish.
Shirahoshi was still thinking about what to do, when another notification sounded as Alex said,
[Alex: what if I told you that in two years, Hody was planning on killing you, your father, and your brothers in a bid to take over Fishman island, and then declare war on the humans?]
"!!!"
Fear filled Shirahoshi at the thought of what Alex said, as she didn't want to see anyone she loved being hurt or killed.
"I-I'll do it! I'll tell my father!" She declared suddenly, seemingly forgetting that Alex couldn't hear her, before she threw open the large door to her room that protected her.
The second the door opened though a large battle axe came flying right at her, making Shirahoshi freeze in fear before the necklace around her neck came to life.
With a flash of light a blue sphere formed around Shirahoshi's entire body, deflecting the battle axe and sending it flying away at greater speeds than it had been approaching her at.
"Ha...." Shirahoshi sighed in relief that the necklace Alex gave her worked, before feeling as if a giant weight had been lifted from her shoulders as she realized that she'd never have to worry about Vander Decken again!
What Shirahoshi didn't realize was that would be the last time Vander Decken would send anything to her, as the battle axe that he had sent to her was reflected right back at him by Alex's barrier. And now all that remained of Vander Decken the ninth was a bloody smear on the deck of his ship.
...
"This is so cool~! But is ok for a man like me to be on here?" Asked a certain horned woman as she sat atop one of the buildings on the island of Wano, her attention entirely upon the illusionary screen before her.
At the moment she was scrolling through the numerous items available in the Chatroom shop, which she would only be able to afford by completing quests to earn points. Amongst the buyable items though were even things like regaining her ability to swim after eating a Devil Fruit, the ability to eat more than one fruit, and even Devil Fruits themselves!
There was even a selection of weapons she could choose from, including Kanabo clubs like her own Takeru.
Unfortunately completing quests and earning points would be fairly difficult for her, as Yamato had shackles around her wrists that hindered her ability to fight, and would explode if she tried to leave Wano.
But the answer for that arrived faster than she ever would've thought possible, as she received a notification from Alex that was revealed to be a single large key, and a piece of paper with drawings unlike anything she had ever seen before.
[DING!
Alex: this is a key that'll open any lock, and the piece of paper is a teleportation circle. It'll take you to the island Water Seven, where you can either acquire a ship or take the Sea Train to start your journey.
Alex: go out and explore for a while. When I make it to that world I'll meet up with you, and we can go defeat your father together. How's that sound?]
Yamato's heart began to pound in excitement at the thought of finally leaving Wano, and getting to explore the world like she'd wanted her entire life.
Though she felt bad abandoning the people of Wano to continue living under her father's tyranny, she also knew she stood chance against him. Yamato firmly believed that only Joyboy could defeat her father, but if it was someone from another world, then maybe it would be possible?
[Yamato: ok then. I'll hold you to that!]
Making her decision, Yamato readily used the key to remove her shackles, and disappeared in a flash of light as she activated the magic circle on the piece of paper.
...
"Hmmm..." Boa Hancock hummed lightly as she examined this 'Chatroom' thing in the privacy of her own room.
She was the empress of the island Amazon Lily, an island free of the disgusting things known as men, where every baby born would be a woman. Without exception.
Their island was situated within the Calm Belt, a stretch of ocean separating the Grand Line from the rest of the world, where wind never blew and no currents existed. As if that wasn't enough, it was also a breeding ground for the Sea Kings, meaning that any who strayed there would face a certain death.
For centuries the women of Amazon Lily would go out and steal whatever they couldn't make or grow on their own, being the only ones capable of traversing the Calm Belt with their ship pulled by Yuda, serpents so poisonous that not even Sea Kings dared attack them.
However in recent years the Marines had made numerous advancements that also allowed them to traverse the Calm Belt as they pleased.
As a result, Hancock had accepted their invitation to join the Seven Warlords in order to protect her people, lest they face annihilation at the hands of the Marines for their piracy.
While the Kuja Pirates, as they were called, prepared for their next voyage, Hancock was familiarizing herself with the Chatroom out of curiosity.
At first she had been interested in it because of its novelty, but when she learned it was used by a filthy man to fuel his disgusting habits she became disgusted by it. Even now she was only using it to determine if it was a threat to her and her people or not, and to see if there was any way she could make use of it.
The Pirate Empress had been quite excited to learn she could use the shop on it to become more powerful, and several of the quests things she'd have to do to earn points involved things she typically did anyways.
The only problem was the frequency the filthy man was on there as he interacted with the rest of the new members, making Hancock sneer at their foolishness to listen and trust a man.
They were all selfish animals incapable of thinking of anything but their own desires. And she hated Alex specifically even more since she learned he went by the title of 'Dragon Emperor', which automatically equated him to the Celestial Dragons in her mind.
The Celestial Dragons were the gods of their world, descended from the original families that founded the world government eight hundred years ago. They looked down on all of humanity from their 'Holy Land', Mary Geoise, an entire city that operated solely on slave labor.
Hancock in particular hated the Celestial Dragons, as she had once been one of their slaves herself alongside her sisters, Sandersonia and Marigold.
They had all been freed when a Fishman by the name of Fisher Tiger rebelled against the Celestial Dragons and freed hundreds of slaves, but had spent the years since hiding the truth about their past.
This had led to them creating an elaborate ruse on their own people, claiming that they had killed a horrible monster known as a gorgon, which subsequently cursed them to turn all who saw their backs into stone. In actuality they wished to prevent anyone from learning of the brands upon their backs that marked them as slaves.
Not only did Hancock fear to lose the respect and admiration of her own people if that happened, but if word got out then the Celestial Dragons themselves would order her capture and return to slavery. She was doubly worried about the second outcome, as she was easily the most beautiful woman in the world. A fact Hancock herself was well aware of and used often.
So Hancock felt nothing but disdain for Alex, even as he acted nothing like the Celestial Dragons she despised so much.
But then something happened that completely caught Hancock off guard, as she received a notification from the Chatroom right before a piece of paper appeared right in front of her.
Hancock reflexively grabbed the piece of paper before it could flutter to the ground, which then lit up the second her hand made contact with it.
"What the-!?" She cried out as flash of light blinded her, putting her on guard as she awaited whatever was happening. But even as the light died down and the paper disappeared, nothing else happened.
[Hancock: what did you do?]
She demanded through the chat, knowing that Alex must've done something to her.
[Alex: nothing~ by the way, mind if I wash your back tonight in the bath?]
The moment she read those words Hancock felt as if a bucket of ice had been dumped into her gut.
T-that was impossible....
H-he couldn't know....right?
Hancock's expression became deathly pale at the possibility of her worst fear being realized, and someone else knew her secret.
B-but that way of talking.... Did Alex do something else to her back?
Motivated by her rising fear and anxiety, Hancock quickly stood and made her way to her mirror, loosening the shoulder straps of her dress as she did so and turned around while picking up a smaller handheld mirror to see through.
Using the two mirrors, Hancock shifted her long black hair to side to examine her back to see what Alex had done, only to see something she never would've expected in a million years.
"Ah!"
*CRASH!*
The sound of glass shattering echoed throughout her room as the smaller mirror fell to the floor, alerting those outside her room while Hancock herself stood frozen in shock.
"Big sis! Is everything alright?!" Sandersonia demanded as she and marigold charged into Hancock's room, only to see her standing there topless.
"Do not enter! The empress is not proper!" Marigold quickly shouted as she stopped any of the other guards and attendants from entering the room, lest they discover the brand.
"It's ok...." Hancock's small voice suddenly said, startling them as one of her sisters asked,
"Big sis?"
Rather than answer though, Hancock slowly turned around to show them ALL of them her back, making her two sisters panic until they noticed what had shocked their sister so badly.
"B-big sis! Y-your back...there's no mark!" Sandersonia exclaimed in shock as they all beheld the jade smooth skin of Hancock's pale back, which was without a single blemish.
What followed was barely registered by Hancock as numerous women congratulated her on being freed of the 'Gorgon's curse', while only her sisters knew the truth. But as a new notification came across the Chatroom, she immediately focused on it as she demanded an explanation.
[Hancock: what did you do!?!
Alex: I used a powerful form of magic to reverse time on your back, returning it to a state before you received your brand. Now you don't have to worry about the Marines learning about it. Also here's this.]
As she finished reading Alex's message, Hancock was surprised to find a ring this time appearing out of thin air, which was a storage ring that contained everything else Alex decided to send her.
[Alex: in that ring is another couple pages with the same magic on them, to use on your sisters, along with a few other things I think you might need. Some of them can also be used to protect your ship and island, so you don't have to listen to the Marines as a Warlord anymore.]
The next few hours after that passed in a blur for Hancock as she struggled to adjust to the fact that her greatest shame existed no more, even when she passed along the other two pages to her sisters, and the same thing happened to them.
But the greatest shock had yet to come, when one of the girls in the Chatroom posted Alex's picture from the previous competition. The same picture Princess Yue was masturbating to.
In it all of the seals Alex had placed on his 'Peerless Beauty' skill had been removed, leaving Hancock stunned as she beheld a man more beautiful than she was.
'H-He's too beautiful!' Hancock exclaimed in her mind, as her heart began racing and she was unable to tear her gaze away. Even with Alex's completely erect thing and sack on display as well.
'So this is what it feels like...' She thought despairingly to herself.
'This is how it feels, to be ugly...'
***
Hermione Jean Granger was torn.
Just a little bit ago a strange screen, reminding her of a television screen, appeared before her that only she could see.
At first she had been utterly fascinated by it, especially since it appeared to put her in contact with other people like a telephone. But now she was filled with utter disgust at it when she learned it was used by a man for his harem.
A HAREM!?!
REALLY!?!
Hermione was appalled that such an archaic and sexist practice still existed, and even more appalling was that so many women were participating in it.
She was still fascinated by the Chatroom and some of the people on it, but now her fascination was accompanied by disgust that only grew anytime an inappropriate picture was posted on it.
And as the bell rang to indicate the next class was starting she put the Chatroom out of her mind as she rushed to Charms class.
Arriving just in time, since she'd been distracted by the Chatroom, Hermione quickly found her seat as class began and professor Flitwick began speaking.
"What happened? You never cut it so close." Muttered the boy next to her under his breath.
"Nothing." Hermione muttered back, before glancing at him out the corner of her eye.
She then planted a quick kiss on his cheek when the professor wasn't looking, and took his hand into her own lovingly. And while he was confused by her actions, the boy squeezed her hand in return even as they both focused on the lesson, with professor Flitwick once again emphasizing the importance of their upcoming NEWT exams.
And while Hermione paid her professor the utmost attention, she also couldn't help but to wonder why anyone would agree to be in a harem. She herself could never imagine sharing the man she loved, Harry James Potter.

chapters.title: Chapter 518 - 518: Apocrypha
chapters.content:
(A.N. I was out of town for the last week with no internet, but I'm back now.)
Hermione, for probably the first time in her life, was anxious for classes to end.
There were two reasons for this.
Firstly was, of course, the Chatroom. While she so desperately wanted to study and examine it, despite its disgusting and sexist nature, she couldn't ignore her classes to do so.
The second reason was because this was the last day of school before they went on their winter holiday, and Hermione had plans for the holiday.
While normally she would be returning home to spend the holidays with her parents, Hermione had decided to remain at Hogwarts for her final Christmas in the great castle. Once she graduated in the spring, chances were Hermione wouldn't be coming back until her own children were attending in the far future.
Plus, she had plans for this final Christmas at Hogwarts.
Hermione had already confirmed that the vast majority of her fellow Gryffindor students would be returning home for the holidays, meaning there would be very few, if any, of them around the school during that time. So Hermione was planning to use that privacy to give the greatest gift she could think of to her boyfriend, herself.
Though they had been dating for a couple years now, Harry had only ever been a gentleman. He had never once pushed her into doing anything she wasn't ready to do, but now Hermione was ready to try and push their relationship to the next level.
Meanwhile Hermione couldn't believe the 'looseness' and depravity of those in the Chatroom, as even with her trying to focus on her classes, she was continuously being distracted by the various comments and images being posted on it.
The worst had been when one of them posted a picture of this Alex guy, who had been so breathtakingly beautiful that even Hermione had a hard time focusing on her lessons, despite his nudity.
After what seemed like an eternity they FINALLY got to their final lesson of the day, but unfortunately for Hermione that lesson was a history of magic, the dullest class they had.
Even for her this particular class felt like torture as their teacher, the ghostly professor Binns, droned on and on in his dull and monotone voice. It took all of Hermione's self control not to just get onto the Chatroom entirely then and there, and even then her only reasoning was the worry that she'd accidentally cause a scene from seeing something on there.
"You ok? You seem out of it today." Harry whispered to her as quietly as possible.
"It's nothing... Just looking forward to the holiday." She whispered back half truthfully, not daring to tell Harry the truth regarding the Chatroom just yet.
But just as Harry took her hand and squeezed it comfortingly, the door to the classroom was opened suddenly as a man marched in, his shoulder length black hair seemingly especially greasy, with pale skin and a hooked nose.
"I apologize for the interruption professor Binns." The teacher, Severus Snape, said in quiet and contained voice.
"Professor Snape! Well this is most unusual!" The ghostly professor Binns stated irritably, as he was VERY rarely, if ever, interrupted during his lessons.
"Yes it is." Snape answered in his usual drawl. "As I said, I apologize. But the headmistress has requested Potter and Malfoy to meet her in her office. Something about a fight?"
Hermione felt Harry squeeze her hand as they both recalled the event Snape was referring to, in which Malfoy had insulted Hermione for being a 'Mudblood', a derogatory term used for a person with non-magical parents like her.
"Harry..." Hermione said anxiously.
The amount of fights between Harry and Malfoy had been escalating ever since they started school, which was worrying Hermione since Harry had more to lose than Malfoy did. While Malfoy was a Slytherin Prefect, Harry was the Gryffindor Prefect, Quidditch Captain, AND Head Boy.
She didn't know if it was possible, but Hermione feared Harry facing a harsher punishment or being stripped of the privileges he'd earned over the last six years. Even if his aunt was the headmistress, it didn't mean she would show favoritism towards him. And this was already the TENTH time he had been called to her office since the school year started.
But all she could do was watch as Harry and Malfoy followed professor Snape out of the classroom, before professor Binns restarted his lesson as if nothing had happened. And within minutes everyone was starting to doze off once again. Everyone but Hermione.
When class finally ended Hermione hurriedly made her way to the Great Hall for dinner, where she hoped Harry would be waiting for her. Instead all she found was the entire student body as they ate and prepared to depart the next day.
With her boyfriend nowhere to be found, along with Malfoy, Snape, and the headmistress, Hermione assumed they were busy with whatever punishment was decided for the duo. So she quickly ate her meal before hurrying back to their dorm room, pausing only to give a look of disgust at the Weasley boy who was messily stuffing his face as if he hadn't eaten in weeks.
When Hermione was isolated within her dormitory, as everyone was saying goodbye to one another since they were leaving in the morning, she decided to put her attention to the Chatroom while awaiting word on Harry.
Waiting for Hermione was a notification from the Chatroom, which she hesitantly opened only for a large black book to appear out of thin air and land on her bed in front of her.
"How curious..." Hermione muttered as she examined the book, which was bound in a thick black leather, and had an ominous image on the front of a creature with numerous tentacles and lobster-like claws.
And while the book reeked of dark magic, there was an allure to it that prevented Hermione from tearing her gaze away from it.
In what many would consider to be an exceptionally foolish move, especially for one so intelligent as herself, Hermione opened the book to reveal pages of twisted and swirling text that appeared to be alive. And as ominous as the pages and text were, Hermione's eyes darted across them, not at all being able to understand what they said, but still feeling as if information was flowing into her mind.
She was so drawn into the text of the book, that Hermione hadn't noticed as several tentacles erupted from the book and wrapped around her head and neck as her vision began to darken.
...
When her vision returned to her Hermione had awoken in a strange and alien place.
There was a seemingly endless sea of what appeared to be greenish-black ink, numerous large tentacles appeared from random portals spread throughout the realm, and there were literal mountains of books while pages swirled and flew around her.
The scent of old parchment and ink filled her nose as Hermione looked around the alien world in awe, before her gaze settled on the only other people there.
"Hello Hermione." Greeted the only man amongst the group, whom Hermione assumed was Alex based off of the earlier picture.
However her expression immediately cramped when she saw that Alex had his hands on the waist of a woman with chin length black hair, and glasses, thrusting into her repeatedly as she tried to restrain her moans.
And gathered around the two of them were several other women, all naked even as they poured over the thousands of books present.
"JUST WHAT IS GOING ON HERE!?!" Hermione shrieked with righteous fury.
...
"Just a second..." Alex told her with a grunt, before giving one last thrust as he filled Sona with copious amounts of semen.
"Ngh..." Sona groaned as she desperately tried to keep her voice from leaking, even as white fluid leaked from her stretched holes.
Alex then slowly pulled his dual cocks out of her, which Sona felt like a torturously slow process that he was purposely drawing out, before conjuring a comfortable bed for her to lay in. He then turned towards the indignant and furious Hermione, his cocks melding together as he did so, and said,
"Welcome to Apocrypha, the realm of knowledge and fate."
Hermione didn't care to hear what Alex was saying though, as she demanded, "Have you no shame!?! ANY of you!?!"
Her words drew everyone's attention as they collectively looked up at her, allowing Hermione to see their faces for the first time.
Amongst them was Lala, Lucy, Levy, the Bulmas, Saya, Irene Belserion, Athena, Brigid, Mavis, Ruby Tōjō(Rosario Vampire), Yami, Rossweise, and of course, Sona.
Every single one had come with Alex to Apocrypha to learn the secrets of Tamriel, or to further their own area of expertise, like Brigid learning the secrets of Tamrielic smithing and how to work their materials. Rossweise wanted to learn about their types of magics, Lucy was speed reading to add as much information as possible to her 'Archive', Yami was just interested in a new world's literature, and so on.
Hermione had been an experiment to see if the Black Books could summon people from the different worlds of the Chatroom, which had been a resounding success. Of course, she wasn't entirely 'there' at the moment.
The 'real' Hermione was still back in her dorm room with the Black Book open before her, in a semi-spectral state with her mind itself in Apocrypha in a faux physical state. But Alex had drastically sped up time within Apocrypha while they were there, so hopefully when Hermione returned no time will have passed, and no one will discover her semi-spectral body or the ominous Black Book.
Even if she were to learn any of that right now though, Hermione wouldn't even give a damn as she watched numerous feminine figures from various backgrounds rise to their feet.
