Of course, it was quite the shift for the trio of Amazons, Aisha, Samira and Lena, to suddenly start taking orders from Haruhime as their new Captain. But none of them complained, with Aisha often helping her learn every chance she got.
Now however the six of them, as well as the numerous Pokemon they had been sent, Chansey, Growlithe, Vulpix, Flareon, Fennekin, and Zorua, the latter two belonging to Haruhime and Lili respectively, were taking their seats while advertising that they knew Ryuu.
Syr looked at Ryuu with wide eyes from her friend being caught in her lie, while the elven woman stared at them pointedly in annoyance.
"Twig twig!" Turtwig eagerly called out as it approached its fellow Pokemon, leaving her no choice but to sigh as she made her way over to serve them.
"Wow! This place is really nice Ryuu!" Hestia exclaimed as she looked around in awe, along with both Haruhime and Lili. Neither had ever gotten to eat at such a nice place before.
"I recommend these dishes Hestia-Sama." Samira said as the boyish Amazon listed off several she'd tried in the past.
While the group listened to Ryuu list off their specials and the different dishes they had, they all missed the numerous anxious looks and whispering that started once they walked in the tavern. After Ishtar and the Soma Familia attacked, and were destroyed, Hestia had gained a rather infamous reputation.
"Ok! We'll have-"
Hestia then listed off everything that her group wanted, not worried about the cost since she had quite a bit of wealth ever since Alex began sending her things through the Chatroom. In order to ensure things were 'proper' though, most of them had been a few 'cheap' weapons and decorative pieces he'd made in his spare time.
Alex had her sell these items to Hephaestus, which in turn earned Hestia enough money to purchase almost all of Orario if she so desired.
"You should come sit with us when you get a chance Ryuu!" Hestia exclaimed as the elf began to walk away with their order, making her sigh yet again at having her relation with Hestia revealed.
It had nothing to do with Hestia herself, but rather Ryuu didn't want to risk dragging them into her problems. She WAS a wanted woman after all.
As she worried about the future though, the door to the tavern opened yet again to admit a single feminine figure with wavy red hair, and an eyepatch covering her right eye.
The goddess merely had to glance around the tavern before she spotted the one she was looking for, Hestia, and began making her way towards them.
"Hephaestus! Join us!" Hestia happily exclaimed from seeing her friend, however Hephaestus' mood was more like she was attending a funeral than anything.
"I'm sorry Hestia, but I can't. I'm only here to deliver a message to you." Hephaestus told her in a low voice, making the oppai goddess curious.
"In one week there will be a Denatus that every god within Orario will be required to attend, in order to determine wether or not to kick you and your Familia out of Orario..."
(A.N. Anyone else up to date on One Piece manga?)

chapters.title: Chapter 526 - 526: Preparation for war
chapters.content:
When Alex awoke, three hours exactly after he'd fallen asleep, he felt completely refreshed and ready to get to work.
Of course, that didn't mean Reiri was ready to do the same.
Glancing at the woman still slumbering at his side, Alex quickly conjured the newest product that was being sold by Suzu, Kiryuu and Risa, the Dragon Emperor body pillow line.
It was a body pillow as long as Alex was tall, and was covered in thick red fur that replicated his own exactly, smelled like him, and even emitted heat equivalent to Alex's own body. They had become popular instantly, spreading like wildfire in and out of Asora. Even the majority of Alex's own wives had gotten their hands on one.
Swapping himself out for the pillow, Alex instantly dressed himself via magic before sensing a gaze upon his back.
Turning curiously, he found the cat he had summoned laying down while seemingly glaring at him for some reason. Confused, Alex approached the cat and made to pet it, only for it to start growling at him in irritation.
"Who pissed in your milk?" Alex pouted at its sudden shift in behavior, before turning around and bending space.
"You coming?" He asked the cat before stepping into the rippling portal he'd created. Surprisingly, the cat leapt down to follow him, though Alex noticed it appeared to be walking bow legged for some reason.
It still however followed followed him through the rift, and into the room of three young girls. It was the room shared by Myuu, Videl, and Kale.
There was of course more than enough space for them all to have their own rooms if they wished, they just preferred sharing.
As he approached one of the girls Alex didn't notice the look the cat was giving him, which was of incredulity.
Based off of what she'd observed, and experienced firsthand, there was only one reason she could think of for him to be approaching three young girls so late at night. And if he so much as laid a single hand on any of them in front of her, then she'd have no problem taking it off.
Unaware of the misunderstanding going on behind him, Alex gently woke one of the girls.
Kale's eyes shot open in surprise as the instincts that had been drilled into her activated, only to ease when she recognized Alex above her. He then put a finger to his lips to indicate silence, which Kale slowly nodded as she got the message.
"Is this the 'night visit'?" Kale asked quietly with growing excitement, making Alex deadpan at her.
"No it's not. We're going to be training." Alex told her sternly, changing Kale's excitement to disappointment.
"Get ready." He ordered quietly, so as not to wake Myuu or Videl.
Kale nodded slowly as she threw the covers off of herself to do just that, revealing her naked figure along with ALL her tattoos to him.
"Why are you sleeping naked?" Alex asked her in an unamused tone, making Kale fidget anxiously under his gaze.
"Myuu said we should always be prepared for any possible night visits..." Kale uttered in a small voice, making Alex groan.
Of course it was her....
A quick check told him that both Myuu and Videl were naked under their covers as well, making Alex shake his head in exasperation.
Myuu was....expected if Alex was being honest, as she had always wanted to become one of his wives. Videl on the other hand was a complete surprise considering how she was towards Alex when they first met. Then again, Myuu was more than likely pushing her into it.
Promising himself to spank Myuu later, Alex waved his hands and all three girls were suddenly dressed, Myuu and Videl in nightgowns as they continued to slumber peacefully. Kale meanwhile was dressed in compression shorts and a sport bra, as Alex meant it when he said he was taking her to train.
With another wave of his hand Alex and Kale were transported to a new location along with his cat, who had her opinion of Alex raised slightly.
Their destination was Alex's personal floating island, which Kale eagerly looked around to examine everything she could since this was her first time there. All there was to see however, was a solitary fighting ring surrounded by a serene forest.
Alex meanwhile led her into the forest itself, so Kale quickly followed until they arrived at a clearing that held only a single space-time orb.
"Is that where we're training?" Kale asked hesitantly, to which Alex nodded as he told her,
"It was specially made by Elaine, Kusu, Vados, and Marcarita, and designed to contain more power than all the others combined. It would take someone on the level of Ophis or Zeno to destroy it."
Kale looked between Alex and space-time orb in awe, before she hurriedly put her hand on it when she saw him doing the same. The two of them, along with the cat, were sucked inside where the four aforementioned Angels were waiting for them.
"You all did well. Good work." Alex said as he looked around the space they were in.
They didn't need the same fancy environment and creatures as the other sub-space orbs, so Alex had the Angels go with the same design as the Hyperbolic Time Chamber from Kami's Lookout. There was a single small villa surrounding the orb where they would be able to rest, sleep, bathe, and eat, while the surrounding area was an endless sea of empty white space.
Kale also looked around in awe of the seemingly endless white space, before asking, "how far does it go?"
"It's still growing." Vados answered.
"It's constantly feeding off of the energy being emitted within it by us. The longer we're in here, the larger it'll grow." Elaine added.
Alex nodded to let her know he heard her, before saying, "that's good, so long as we don't risk breaking it."
Kale cocked her head curiously as she asked, "how would we break it?"
Alex directed a serious look at her and said, "because, we will be training to fight Markus in here."
Kale paled at Alex's declaration, and she hesitantly asked, "y-you want ME to help?"
Alex nodded seriously and knelt down before her, and said, "Kale, you and I are our secret weapons to use against Markus. We both have something that no one else does."
As he said that Alex stood and turned to walk away, and Kale watched as his fur began to recede until Alex was in his base form. However, she then watched as the tattoos decorating Alex's body also began to fade, until all she could see was his smooth skin.
"Vados, watch over Kale and instruct her. Kusu, Marcarita and Elaine, you're all with me." Alex commanded as, with the disappearance of his tattoos, the power radiating from his body began to spike upwards.
Goosebumps formed on Kale's skin as she felt the power coming from Alex rise, and rise, and rise some more until it rivaled, and then even surpassed the power she'd felt coming from his SSJ4 form. And he was still in his base form.
And then, when his power finally stopped rising, the three aforementioned Angels surrounded him as they all prepared to do battle.
"Remember Kale..." Alex said while taking in a deep breath through his nose. "THIS is the power we possess!"
And with that as his declaration, golden-green light radiated from Alex's body as his already tremendous power skyrocketed even further.
***
Rias' chest heaved as she panted exhaustedly, but her opponent gave her no room for rest.
"Stop moving bitch!" Snarled the man trying to hit her.
"No!" Rias declared as she yet again flashed away from her previous position.
As the two continued their game of cat and mouse, a singular figure watched over them with a bored gaze.
"Rias is powerful, but her body lacks development for physical combat. She's essentially a glass cannon..."
"Vegeta meanwhile has yet to even awaken his own Destructive potential, but he has the raw physical strength and power to compensate. If Rias hits him with even a single blast of Destruction though, then he's as good as dead...."
The figure, Beerus, muttered to himself as he watched the two fight.
He had already been training Vegeta for the upcoming tournament when Rias barged into the space within Kusu's scepter, and demanded more training herself after explaining what had happened outside.
Beerus hadn't cared in the slightest about Markus or the threat he supposedly posed to all of them, while Vegeta had immediately gotten fired up about facing such a powerful opponent.
Now Vegeta and Rias were sparring with one another at Beerus' command, though it hardly seemed like a spar from where he was sitting.
"Enough!" Beerus suddenly declared, making the two stop in their tracks.
"Tch." Vegeta clicked his tongue in annoyance as he canceled his SSJ2 transformation. He STILL hadn't managed to get to the next stage, even after all his training with Beerus.
"Haaa..." Rias however sighed in relief, as it had taken every little bit of her focus and attention just to avoid Vegeta's attacks at the very last split second.
Her relief and Vegeta's frustration were short-lived though, as Beerus told them, "this isn't working... We need to up the ante."
Beerus then smiled evilly as he activated one of the functions available to him within the scepter, and summoned projections of numerous figures.
"These are projections of different fighters from throughout Universe Seven's history. And if what she told me about this thing is correct, they're ALL as strong and skilled as the originals."
Both Rias and Vegeta went on the alert as the figures moved, all taking offensive stances in preparation to fight.
"Oh, and they're all going to be trying to kill the two of you. So good luck!" Beerus smirked maliciously.
He also had the capability to revive the two of them if they did somehow die with the controls he had in the scepter, but Beerus didn't see the need to tell them that. Instead he just watched as Rias and Vegeta fought for their lives against some of the biggest powerhouses that had ever existed in Universe Seven.
Rias' expression was grim as she fought the projections, who she was able to use her power of Destruction against, but they just simply reformed afterwards.
She in particular was bound and determined to become stronger, as she suspected that her power of Destruction would be critical in dealing with with this Kryptonian, Markus.
***
"..."
In one of the subspace orbs a large group of women were gathered around a particularly majestic and large waterfall, all sitting beneath the cascading water in silent meditation.
Nearby a little girl that looked to be a little older than a year sat playing, her black hair tied up into pigtails while her red monkey-like tail swayed behind her.
"Mama!" The little girl suddenly cried out, alerting one of the women who was meditating. And as she opened her eyes, the raven haired woman beheld a slinking feline type monster slowly approaching her daughter.
Instantly, the woman moved from her position as her hand slid into her shadow, only to draw a sinister black blade that appeared to draw in all of the surrounding light. And while those who could, barely, follow her movements saw her swing her sword, they were still amazed at what happened next.
They watched as she swung her sword one time, so fast that the monster couldn't even react. Instead, all of the gathered women watched as that one swing of her dark blade bisected the monster, before it suddenly separated into thousands of neatly sliced pieces.
The cuts were so clean that there wasn't even a single drop of blood until the pieces hit the ground, at which point the little girl happily cried out while going, "Gan mama! Gan!"
The woman, Shizuku, smiled wryly at her daughter's gleeful laughing, knowing she was demanding that she do it again.
"Not right now my little flower blossom." Shizuku said softly as she picked her daughter up to cradle her lovingly.
Meanwhile the blade she'd used to cut the monster dissolved into shadows before reforming into the figure of a great black dog.
"Jin! Jin!" Shizuku's daughter, Yeagashi Saya, cried out excitedly as she made to grab at the dog. It was perhaps the word she was best used to saying alongside 'mama' and 'dada'.
With a smile, Shizuku set her daughter down onto Jin's back, where she grabbed two fistfuls of his shadowy fur before he started trotting around with her on his back.
The once serene and peaceful atmosphere was filled with joyful shrieks as Saya squealed her glee from riding around on Jin, while Shizuku and her followers watched on. Under her warm smile though, the Knight of the Dragon Emperor was thinking.
Despite her skills more resembling that of a ninja, Shizuku had devoted herself to the way of the sword for Alex's sake ever since he made her his Knight. And in return, she was happier than she'd ever thought possible while following such a path.
Now however there was someone who threatened that happiness, Markus.
Shizuku had been thinking long and hard ever since they'd learned of his existence, and of everything they'd seen in the projection of Grant's memories. And finally, she had made a decision.
Shizuku was going to start completing quests from the Chatroom, and use it's shop to buy her own Zanpakūto.
Though Jin was everything she needed in a weapon, the opponent this time was a being unlike anything they'd fought before. So, rather than throwing her skills at Markus and potentially having all her efforts be for naught against him, she decided to acquire a weapon that she'd already seen work on him.
Mentally communicating to Jin to watch over Saya for her, Shizuku turned about and walked off to get started.
As she did so she left behind her students and followers, who were still in awe of Shizuku's earlier demonstration. After all, it wasn't every day they watched their teacher/master slice a mountain in two just to kill a single monster.
***
*CRASH!*
*BOOM!*
*SHING!*
Within one of the subspace orbs, the sound of battle rang out as two titans faced one another.
One, a warrior maiden dressed in thick plates of metallic armor that somehow still appeared erotic on her, a massive battle axe in hand. Her scarlet red hair trailed behind her in a long ponytail adorned with numerous bands of metal.
The other a Demon, her long white hair flared upwards like she had gone SSJ, hands and feet in the shape of lethal claws with what appeared to be plated scales covering her limbs up to her elbows and knees, horns protruding from her forehead, and a thick tail extending from her backside.
There was a slight pause in the duo's dance of carnage and destruction as they stared at one another, before they suddenly rushed at each other yet again.
"Promotion, Queen!" The Demon cried out, increasing all of her stats tremendously as she bared her claws along with a powerful surge of magic.
"Goliath." The warrior maiden stated calmly, even as she surged forward.
The armor covering her body shimmered as it changed into a set that was significantly thicker and heavier, eliminating her speed. Meanwhile her axe changed into a mighty hammer, which she swung in a wide arc while planting her foot into the ground.
The warrior maiden pivoted as she transferred all of her momentum into her hammer, swinging it in a wide circle before bringing it back around to meet the Demon's claws head on, blasting her away with its force.
Rather than taking any significant damage from the attack though, a set of wings sprouted from the Demon's back that halted her flight. Her own form then shimmered before her appearance too changed, with black armor plating covering her arms, legs and stomach under her breasts.
Power began to radiate from her that turned her surroundings to dust, the 'evil' power of hundreds of Devils that had lived for millennia while consolidating and increasing their strength.
Several sinister dark orbs began to form around her that also radiated power, which she then shot at her opponent ruthlessly.
The warrior maiden was unable to avoid the attack, weighed down by her heavy armor that sealed her speed, so she vanished within an explosion of darkness and shadows.
*KABOOOOOOOM!*
The resulting explosion rocked the subspace orb, destroying the land along with the creatures who called it home for hundreds of miles around while the Demon watched on impassively from the sky.
And once the attack was over, an eerie silence settled on the land as the Demon watched the dust settle.
Not a single thing was left standing for miles around, leaving only a barren wasteland that was devoid of life, vegetation, mountains, and even rubble.
Not a single thing standing, save for a dome of metal right in the middle of the devastation.
The Demon watched as the metal retracted into a single small shield, wielded by the warrior maiden who had donned yet another set of armor that had heightened her defense.
"If I didn't know any better Mirajane, I'd think you were seriously trying to kill me right then." The warrior said to the Demon.
"Erza please, you know we'd have to go at LEAST that seriously if we want to improve enough to face Markus and his armies." The Demon said with a hint of humor to her voice.
A hint of a smile graced the warrior's fair lips in response to the comment, as her armor changed yet again.
"Very well. Let's fight to the death then."
The Demon smiled viciously at that as she landed right before the warrior, allowing them to look the other in the eye, before they resumed their match with relish.
***
While the others were in different subspace orbs or training grounds, a certain golden haired assassin had asked Alex for a different form of training.
"Hehehehehehe..."
"I knew you'd come back to me!"
"Let's relive our best memories together!"
"I've missed you so much, Yami."
Dozens of overweight men who appeared identical surrounded Yami, their disgusting things erect and ready for action. Meanwhile numerous slimy and disgusting tentacles appeared out of nowhere to bind each of her limbs, before they slithered into her clothes to rub their mucus covered selves against her flesh.
In a second Yami was stripped as the tentacles tore her clothes off, before forcing her legs apart so that she was completely exposed.
Yami tried to will her arms and legs to move, to transform, to do ANYTHING!
But none of them followed her command as her nerves and terror reached an all time high.
The slimy tentacles then began to rub up and down her slit and down her butt crack, rubbing their mucus onto her holes to lubricate them while others began to play with her nipples.
And STILL the terror overpowered her will to resist, despite her disgust and revulsion as numerous memories flooded her mind. Memories of her days as 'that man's' pet.
At the same time the numerous copies of 'that man' moved closer to her, stroking their dicks as they did so while one stepped right up in between her legs.
"Just like old times, right Yami?" He sneered down at her, pressing the head of his cock against her opening.
"!!!"
All of a sudden Yami was in her bed, panting and sweating as she awoke from the horrifying nightmare.
And while others would feel relief that what she was going through was 'just' a dream, she instead only felt frustration.
"Let's call this off Yami. I don't like watching you go through that." Said the voice at her side, drawing Yami's attention to Kurumu.
The succubus was attending to Yami during this particular 'training', as she worked to overcome her past trauma and weakness.
"No. I need to do this." The petite assassin declared firmly, her will resolute now that she was awake.
Even Alex had gone so far to help her, using his new authority over the power of Dreams and Nightmares to attach her consciousness to the Quagmire, the realm of nightmares.
This ensured she would only see and experience the things most horrific to her every time she fell asleep, giving her the chance to overcome them and perfect her own Ultra Instinct.
Yami decided to focus on this aspect of her training after the Daedric Prince Vaermina used her own trauma against her back in the HOTD world, which had instantly created the opening for her immediate defeat.
Kurumu of course was here to ensure she didn't actually go through the horrors conjured within her mind.
"Again." Yami stated as she laid back down as if she were going to sleep.
Kurumu just sighed as she used her powers to help Yami relax and rest, before returning to her front row seat as she watched the assassin being assaulted.
***
Of the many different sub-spaces within the space-time orb, there was one unlike any of the others.
It was in fact not a subspace, but an entirely different dimension created by a certain budding goddess of Time and Space. And within this realm, tens of thousands of her loyal subjects had gathered to worship and praise her.
Among them were thousands of cat-like beings such as the Exceed from Earthland, the Snackians of Universe Seven, the Khajiit from Tamriel, and even the Werecats that Alex had created after obtaining his Lycanthropy divinity. The vast majority of their population however was made up of the thousands of house cats that she had been collecting for several years now.
Every single eye within the realm was directed at the same location, a massive temple upon which a single figure rested, the energies of Space and Time bending around her. Ready to answer her bidding.
She sat cross legged with her eyes closed, feeling the energies flowing around her, flexing her fingers to play them as one would an instrument.
Most importantly, she could feel the power flowing into her. The power of the belief of the tens of thousands gathered below her as they prayed to their goddess.
Suddenly, the power flowing around her reached a tipping point as Time and Space both folded in on themselves.
Every second that passed was an eternity, and an eternity passed in a second as knowledge and power both flowed into her, saturating every single cell of her body with divine energy.
And when she opened her eyes, they radiated with a brilliant golden divine light that illuminated the entire realm.
Seven cat-like tails danced behind her, all the pitchiest of black before, but now lined with numerous golden rings at the tips, matching the golden fur now also tipping her cat-like ears.
After years of determination and working towards her goal, a new goddess was officially born.

chapters.title: Chapter 527 - 527: Monster Meat
chapters.content:
In the darkness of the night, on a specific island within the space-time orb, a certain figure could be seen slowly walking through the hundreds of different flora that were present.
Her bare feet made no sound on the grass underneath, and the veils and loose clothing she wore made no sound as they lightly fluttered in the cool night breeze.
Anne Morningstar made sure not to make a sound as she made her way around her island, which was also home to every type of plant she had collected in her travels, as well as those brought to her by numerous people. Even the people of Tamriel and Azeroth had brought her different types of floral specimens from their home world's, which she had rejuvenated with Regeneration magic before cultivating them as well.
But right now Anne had a VERY different project in mind as she wandered through her garden.
Before working on that though, Anne had to check in on the other few people on the island.
She made her way to a more tropical area of the island, the region that reminded her most of the world that had been her home before meeting up with Alex, and where she had set up her workshop. It was also Anne's personal living quarters for when she wasn't spending the night with Alex, and were the only other people currently on the island were sleeping.
In the corner was a large creature with a long neck, and leafy green wings, a Pokemon she was given that was called Tropius. And curled up on Tropius' body, snuggling together as they slumbered, were Anne's two beloved children, Alec and Anna.
Anne smiled warmly as she looked down at her sleeping children, a protective instinct welling up within her despite how strong they already were themselves. Especially Alec, who was still the only one amongst his siblings to achieve the SSJ2 stage.
And then there was Anna, who wanted to follow in her mother's footsteps as a warrior of the earth and air. She was even starting to learn about druidry alongside her training as a Saiyan and Anne's own Dragon Slayer training. Thankfully Anna had an inborn draconic ability thanks to both her and Alex.
"Nh..." A groan on the other side of the room drew Anne's attention to the other two people in the room, Momo and Nana.
Anne shook her head wryly as the two girls, who were normally like fire and water with the other, were also snuggled together closely on the bed Momo had made from super soft alien grass.
With only Tropius stirring from her presence, though she quickly went back to sleep herself, Anne silently departed since everyone was doing ok.
Once outside she made her way to a certain location, a cherry blossom tree, and gently placed her hand against its rough surface.
The second Anne's hand was in contact with three she began injecting Spirit and Alteration magics into it. She had been doing this for days now, attempting to spark a true consciousness in it, or bring out whatever consciousness it already had according to Momo.
Anne didn't know how long she was channeling magic into the tree, but it must've been hours as the sky began to brighten when it finally happened.
"!!!"
Shock filled Anne as she felt it, something responding her prodding and magic before a whirlwind of cherry blossoms suddenly formed around her.
"This is-!" Anne uttered as she broke contact with the tree in amazement, before watching as the blossoms began to come together to create a humanoid outline.
***
"Wahooooooooo!" Cried out the voice of an excited young woman.
"Lap lap!" Cried out the creature a short ways away from her.
At its command, the creature raised the level of the ocean around them so that it's water and the chunks of ice floating in it rose up in a mighty wave.
The creature then began to ride the wave like it was surfing, while the young woman near it did the same with a surfboard made of ice. The duo then made a game of dodging the massive ice flows as they raced down the wave, each trying to outdo the other in terms of speed and close calls.
And when the wave appeared to be settling down, the woman created another one by moving in a way reminiscent of the creature.
Though not nearly as large, the young woman was able to create the wave she was after as they resumed their game of dodge the iceberg.
It was only when the sun was almost set that they decided to call it a day, returning to the ice shelf close to home. The girl stepped off her surfboard onto the thick ice she called land, before turning back to the creature and saying with a smile,
"That was fun Lapras! My bending has really improved ever since I started trying to mimic your movements!" Katara told the Pokemon excitedly.
"Laaaaaaap!" The Lapras trilled happily while playfully slapping its fins on the water.
Katara then noticed a flash of silver in the water, which she used her water bending to flush up onto the ice shelf in front of Lapras. The result was a small pile of fish that the Pokemon happily began to gorge on for its meal.
Katara smiled as she gently patted Lapras on its neck, thankful she had received such a Pokemon. Not only did she now have a friend, but she was able to better her bending by watching Lapras when it used its moves, like Surf.
There was only one small problem with having Lapras around.
"HAAAAAAA!!!"
A shout alerted Katara and Lapras as the former splashed up some water, and latter quickly dove under water to escape.
It then poked its head up out of the water a second later to see a young man, a couple years older than Katara, frozen in place with only his head showing.
"Really Sokka, AGAIN!?!"
"Don't 'really Sokka' ME! You know as well as I do that thing can feed the entire village for a week!"
"She's not a 'thing', she's Lapras!"
"I don't care what you named it! That's THING is a monster, and monster meat probably tastes better than fish!"
Whatever Katara was going to say her brother next died in her throat, as a new voice cried out,
"Noooooo!"
"Don't eat Lapras!"
Several of the village kids ran up to them as they crowded around Lapras protectively, as if Sokka was going to break free from the ice at any moment to attack her yet again.
"What are you all doing men!" Sokka demanded of the children."You're the Warriors of the Southern Water Tribe! That THING is a threat to the tribe, so destroy it!"
"Don't wanna!" One kid declared while picking his nose.
"Lapras too cute!" Another kid stated while hugging her neck.
"I REALLY gotta go potty!" Another kid pleaded while dancing in place.
Katara had to bite back her laughter as the kids all defended Lapras, while a certain vein on her brother's head looked as if it were about to pop.
Instead, she turned to the children and asked then, "who wants to take turns riding on Lapras' back?"
"""Yay!"""
The children all cheered excitedly, while Lapras also happily cried out as she splashed her fins in the water. She loved giving rides on her shell.
Sokka meanwhile was grinding his teeth in frustration, trying to move his entire body to get free of the ice binding him.
"!!!"
Sokka grew excited as he suddenly felt warmth through the biting cold covering his body, making him wonder who had decided to free him.
"!!!"
What he saw instead, was the same kid who had to go potty. And he was doing just that on the ice covering Sokka's leg.
"STOP THAT!" Sokka shrieked angrily, even as the kid danced away to join the others in playing with Katara and Lapras.
Meanwhile, several hundred miles north of them...
"Ninety seven!"
"Ninety eight!"
"Ninety nine!"
"One hundred!"
Suki sighed as she and the rest of the Kiyoshi warriors lowered their swords, along with a certain small brown creature wielding a piece of bone, and wearing a skull upon its head.
"Good job Cubone." Suki told her Pokemon proudly.
"Cu cu bone!" It replied back to her happily.
Suki smiled down at her Pokemon from how happy it seemed from her praise. But she couldn't help but to feel sorry for it in her heart after learning the background on Cubone from Cynthia.
According to her, all Cubone had lost their mothers and were known for wearing her skull upon their head. They were also known as the 'lonely' Pokemon, which Suki realized upon finding it outside crying in the middle of the night several times.
During the day however, Cubone only showed them its determination as it trained with them in their combat classes, and honed its unique fighting style that Suki could only think of as Earth Bending. Naturally, the entire village was excited at the prospect of having an Earth Bender around in case the Fire Nation showed up, even if it was such a 'unique' creature.
***
"Ahhh!" That's the good stuff!" Caulifla exclaimed as she slammed back a mug of alcohol, before wiping the foam away with the back of her hand and belching loudly.
"Disgusting..." Sala remarked as she sipped from her own drink, which was nice and refreshing after she'd spent the entire day training.
"Oh? Did I hear something miss AVERAGE Saiyan?" Caulifla mocked her with a sneer.
Sala gripped her mug so hard that, had it not been a specially made unbreakable mug by Lala, it would've shattered. But she couldn't say anything back.
This had been the norm ever since Caulifla managed to get enough points to buy the Ancient Saiyan bloodline through the Chatroom shop, while Sala was still lagging behind in trying to buy the ability to use Divine Ki.
Of course, the only reason Caulifla jumped ahead of her was because of her participation in the first round of the tournament. Every match she participated in granted her a high level quest, which granted her an increasing amount of points for every round she won.
The only downside had been when she fought against Goku in the final round, and lost to his SSJ3 due to still being inexperienced with the power of the Ancient Saiyan bloodline. If she'd had even an hour to adjust to her new powers, then the outcome of the match would have been completely different.
But now the difference between Sala and Caulifla was like heaven and earth, with the former princess having already received numerous losses from the former bandit.
To add salt to the wound, there was this whole business with Markus going on. And while Sala would like nothing more than to participate in the battle against such a villain, it had already been shown that a SSJ2 was nothing before him.
She was quickly becoming useless, and Sala didn't like it one bit.
Then, as if the universe itself was answering her woes, Sala suddenly glimpsed something she was familiar with, and traumatized by. A pair of fluffy blue rabbit ears.
Her eyes followed the rabbit-girl Shia warily, as she suppressed a shudder from recalling the seven months of hell she endured at her hands. But, they were seven months that helped to turn her into one of the most powerful warriors amongst her people.
And then, further reinforcing the idea of the universe listening to her grumbling, Sala blinked as numerous notifications alerted her to several new quests she was receiving from the Chatroom.
Land X amount of hits on Shia Haulia!
Last X amount of time in a sparring match against Shia Haulia!
Take X amount of hits from Shia Haulia!
Numerous quests involving different aspects of sparring with Shia appeared before Sala, each one rewarding her with lots of points depending on the difficulty. There was even one at the bottom that would reward her with Divine Ki itself if she won a match against her!
Before Sala knew it she was on her feet, her drink forgotten as she rapidly approached Shia.
And as she moved, she drew the eye of every other Saiyaness there.
"What's she doing?" One of Caulifla's clan members asked curiously, before they all froze when they saw her talking to Shia.
"She isn't?!"
"Don't tell me!"
"I can't believe it!"
The group then watched as Shia and Sala departed the courtyard together, the latter's expression severe while the former had a sinister smirk.
*clang!*
The group jumped before turning to see Caulifla slamming down her latest drink, completely empty, as she snarled, "come on! I'm not gonna let that prissy little princess outdo us!"
She then led her clan out of the courtyard as well for yet another round of training, as the rest of Caulifla's clan worked to also acquired the Ancient Saiyan Bloodline, and the Evil Ki that came with it.
***
*Boom!*
*Boom!*
*KABOOM!*
In another location thunder rumbled and echoed in every direction as a storm seemed to be brewing. Within that storm however, one would find two women locked in a heated battle.
"Lightning Thrust!" Cried out a beautiful woman with violet eyes and black hair tied back into a long ponytail, as the spear in her hand crackled with energy that she directed at her opponent.
On the other side, another beautiful woman with silver hair and red eyes deftly dodged to the side, before delivering a powerful kick to her opponent's midriff.
*FLASH!*
*KABOOM!*
The flash from the Lightning Thrust combined with power of the kick simulated lighting and thunder as the entire sky around them lit up, followed immediately by the thunderous roar.
Jade, the Heliadorian Princess, was sent flying back onto an island down at the sea level, where she carved out a trench with her body. Moka meanwhile hovered above her momentarily, her vampiric wings spread to keep her aloft as she surveyed the scene below her.
When Jade didn't reappear she flew down to make sure she hadn't kicked her new friend too hard, only for the princess to suddenly appear beneath her.
"Harvest Moon!" Jade cried out as she back flipped to deliver a powerful kick, which, incredulously, sent Moka flying up into the air from the force.
"That was a cheap shot!" A young looking vampire cried out indignantly, her bushy red twintails flaring in her anger. "That hussy would never have sent big sis flying like that otherwise!"
"Per-lease!" Answered a blond haired woman in her late teens, who's identical twin sister stood beside her. "Harvest Moon is a move that deals significantly more damage against flying opponents. Blame your big sis for giving her the opportunity to use it!"
The duo, Veronica and Kokoa, glared at the other challengingly as they fought over who was better, Moka or Jade. Meanwhile Serena, Veronica's twin sister, was desperately trying to keep the peace between them so that they didn't start fighting themselves.
Their argument was brought to halt however as they noticed a sudden surge of power from the island where Jade was still at, which revealed that the princess had transformed.
Jade's pale skin was now a grayish-purple while almost vampiric looking fangs appeared in her mouth. And her attire had changed from her green travel/combat clothes into a sensual one piece suit that her sensual body threatened to spill out of in various places, complete with high heels, bunny ears, and fishnet stockings.
"What is that?!" Kokoa asked incredulously, as Jade's power had noticeably shot up, combined with her sensuality.
"We call it Re-Vamp!" Veronica smirked smugly. "It increases all of Jade's physical abilities, makes her more resistant to different types of damage, and it increases her allure!"
Kokoa meanwhile appeared even more pissed than before, as no one could look at the current Jade and think anything other than 'vampire'.
"That's it!" The vampiress cried out as she reached for her Kou bat, which immediately transformed into a large sword. "Let's go bitches!"
Kokoa then rushed at the twins while swinging her sword wide, only for a metallic clang to answer her attack.
"Excuse me, but, while I may not be as strong or skilled as Jade, I do have SOME ability with the spear." Serena said in a kindly tone as she smiled apologetically.
'Some skill!?!' Kokoa swore in her mind, as never in a million years did she believe a weak looking HUMAN would be able to parry one of her attacks.
Kokoa clenched her teeth angrily at the realization, and began attacking Serena wildly in her vampiric rage, while the seemingly weak girl effortlessly parried or dodged every one of her attacks.
"STOP DODGING DAMN IT!" Kokoa screamed in her rage.
"Okay!" Serena said after dodging one last time, surprising Kokoa before she noticed Veronica in the background with her staff.
"How about a Kafrizzle!" She asked with a smirk, before a massive ball of flame rushed at Kokoa.
Though the vampiress could have easily dodged out of the way, her pride refused to let her as she became determined to prove to these two humans just how weak they were.
"Wait... She actually took that!?!" Veronica exclaimed as Kokoa vanished within the flames, which then exploded into a pillar of fire with the vampiress trapped within.
Serena also became worried as she put down her spear and pulled out her wand to hurriedly heal Kokoa if needed. But it was unnecessary.
When the flames from Veronica's attack died down, they saw what appeared to be a carbonized figure that had been burned down nearly to bone. But they were still standing and moving.
"You bitches..." Kokoa snarled as her flesh began to rapidly reform, along with her hair. And of course, her clothes didn't reform along with them, leaving her standing there completely naked once she finished healing.
"I'M GONNA FUCKING FLAY YOU!" Kokoa screamed as she rushed the two girls, who readily reacted as they began to battle her two on one.
Moka and Jade meanwhile had halted their own battle, and were now watching the three of them with interest.
"Break time?" Moka asked Jade.
"Sure. I could use a rest." Jade cooly replied as she canceled her Re-Vamp transformation.
"That transformation of your is interesting." Moka said suddenly, surprising Jade before the princess replied,
"Thanks. I got it from the elder of a tribe known as the Watchers. I don't quite know what he meant by it, but he said it was a power of another time..."
Jade then fell silent as she pondered on what the elder had meant, as everyone in their group had received power at that moment. Power that felt really familiar to them for some reason.
"'Watchers'?" Moka asked curiously.
Jade then began telling Moka about the world of Erdrea, the people there, the places, and mostly about her friends that she had traveled with while they fought to defeat the lord of all evil, Calasmos.
(A.N. Before people complain about how Jade, Veronica and Serena are all 'too strong', they were all summoned AFTER beating the final boss of the game, and are basically lvl 99+ with maxed out stats.)
***
"Focus Kale." Vados told the young Saiyaness patiently.
"I'm trying..." Kale murmured back to her, as she tried to ascend to the SSJ1.
Unfortunately her concentration slipped at the last moment, and all of the energy Kale had gathered dispersed into nothing. Seeing this, Vados told Kale with the voice of an instructor, "try again. And concentrate."
Kale could only nod slowly and bashfully, as this was already her twentieth failed attempt, TODAY.
Thankfully, Alex was too busy to see her fail so many times as he trained to control his own strength. But knowing he was working is hardest while she was failing was also dispiriting her.
While Kale was working Vados frowned slightly as she contemplated how to best help the young Saiyaness. The SSJ transformations were unlocked through intense emotion, typically anger, which Kale truthfully seemed unable to do with her subdued nature.
The only methods Vados could think of that could possibly trigger the transformation in Kale were manipulative and borderline cruel, but with every failed attempt it was seeming more and more like the only option.
As Kale tried to gather energy to herself yet again, Vados used her staff to peek at Alex's training with Kusu, Marcarita, and Elaine. Thankfully that appeared to be going well at least, so hopefully Alex would be able to return soon and help her train Kale.

chapters.title: Chapter 528 - 528: Might Versus Magic
chapters.content:
As the days passed within the space-time orb everyone busied themselves with one thing or another as they prepared for the coming battle.
Those with access to the Chatroom worked to complete as many quests on it as possible to obtain the powerful rewards they offered, along with whatever they were after on its shop. Meanwhile the new arrivals that Alex had summoned were working to familiarize themselves with Asora and the people they were with.
Some buried themselves into work, either training or studying the different skills and magics that were now available to them. Megumin for example was learning everything she could about Explosion based magic in Asora, while simultaneously completing as many quests as possible to acquire the Bomu Bomu no Mi.
Veronica and Serena meanwhile were studying the different types of Magic Asora had, and were already making plans to challenge the replica Great Labyrinths as soon as possible. Hermione was of course doing the same thing, though she was more or less coming to grips with the fact that the laws of magic she knew in her world did exist in Asora.
Then there were those like Eris, who were still trying to come to grips with everything that was happening. What had especially alarmed her was when the people of Asora already began to pray to her newly built statues, despite only being up for a few hours according to Grayfia.
Of course, there were also those who were having a harder time adjusting, like the Amaterasu team.
Every day they were away from their home world made them all increasingly worried of if it will even still be there when they got back. Plus, they had also received the order from their commander to start a sexual relationship with the man who had summoned them.
"I swear! How much more ridiculous can this situation be!?" Hayuru demanded, even as she scrubbed herself in the massive bath, still incredulous at the sheer idiocy of the situation.
Not only had she been pulled into this world alongside Aine and Yurishia, but now they had been ordered by their commander to do lewd things with the guy who summoned them. The entire mess was enough to boil her blood.
"I actually agree Hayuru..." Yurishia sighed tiredly from the side, while feeling more than a little anxious on the inside of what was happening back home.
"Well I for one, unlike your pea-brained selves, see this as a great chance to obtain more power!" Aine declared with an intense look in her eyes. She, unlike the other two, was more than willing to perform the HxH(HeartxHybrid) if it meant acquiring more power and being able to fight more.
"I agree. This whole situation is utterly nonsensical." Replied a certain bushy-haired know-it-all.
"RIGHT!?! I mean, why would you make a goddess, such as myself, into a MAID! It's ridiculous!" Aqua declared angrily, though there was actually no argument against THAT particular decision based off what they'd seen of her so far.
"I don't mind being a maid... But I wish master were around more..." Darkness said after her, before a slovenly expression appeared on her face as she thought of being used by her new master.
Everyone else meanwhile grew curious, as none of them had seen or heard from Alex in the last week.
"By the way, where IS that guy?" Veronica asked curiously, looking to Alex's gathered wives as they all bathed to prepare for the day.
"Training, would be my best guess." Erza said immediately.
"Training? For a whole week?" Serena asked, surprised that no one would hear from him just for that.
"It's not too surprising. Alex disappeared for three months without a word one time." Mirajane stated as she thought back.
"He even tried to tell us that he spent the entire time on a binge of booze, drugs, and alien hookers!" Anne exclaimed as she thought back to that incident.
"How do you know he didn't?" Jade asked them curiously.
"Because he can't get drunk, can't get high, and Alex would NEVER abandon his own children for three months just to play around with hookers. A night maybe, but not three months." Grayfia stated mater-of-factly.
Hayuru opened her mouth to say something what SHE thought of him, but as she did so everyone suddenly went silent.
"What's wrong?" Serena asked curiously.
"Alex!" Lala stated happily, while everyone else had markedly different reactions.
Incredulous, awe, fear. These looks and more appeared on everyone's faces as they seemed to notice something the new girls hadn't.
"Oh come on...." Shia groaned in defeat, which would've shocked Caulifla and Sala if they both weren't feeling exactly what she was.
"Don't worry Shia. I got to properly test my strength out already." Said a manly voice suddenly, making everyone jump as they realized Alex was suddenly in the bath with them. Completely naked.
"""ALEX!"""
"""KYAAA!"""
Two different cries rang out at Alex's sudden appearance. First was the wives who were glad to see him, and stunned at his current look/strength. Second were the newcomers, who hadn't expected him to suddenly appear IN the bath with them.
"Filthy! Lascivious! Indecent! Pervert!" Hayuru exclaimed accusingly with an incredulous expression, while quickly trying to cover herself.
"Haaa... Takes you back, huh Yui?" Momioka Risa said teasingly to a certain former head of the disciplinary committee of their school.
"I have no idea what you're talking about Momioka." Kotegawa Yui stated, even as she turned away with reddened ears.
While Hayuru was screaming at him though, and the rest of the newcomers were trying to cover their bodies, Alex's wives were all gaping at him incredulously.
"So he doesn't seriously train for how long? And when he does THIS happens!" Moka exclaimed irritably. Though her frustration was understandable.
Currently Alex was in his base form instead of his SSJ4 form that he'd been remaining in for so long. However, none of the tattoos that had been present on his body for so long were there, and the power they could all feel coming from him felt even greater than when he was in his SSJ4 form.
"You know, I think I liked it better when you WEREN'T training." Shia shamelessly griped at him.
"Sheesh! 'Train'! 'Don't train'! You guys are giving me whiplash." Alex said, though it wasn't like he couldn't understand their frustrations.
After all, Alex had gotten to the point where he no longer needed to keep his strength in check with his tattoos in only a 'week'. But what the girls didn't realize was that time dilation in the orb they had been using on his floating island was quite a bit more extreme than this one.
"All the muscles in the world won't do anything for you against 'real' magic though." Hermione said suddenly, drawing Alex's attention to her as she conjured a set of robes on her body to cover it.
"Is that so?" Alex asked with a growing smirk.
"Try it then." He challenged as he began walking towards Hermione slowly.
Panic began to set in on Hermione as she hurriedly raised her wand, before crying out with a flourish, "Petrificus Totalus!"
For some of those who could see it, they noticed a flash of magic that shot from the tip of Hermione's wand at Alex. And for anyone unfortunate enough to be hit by this particular curse, their entire body would freeze in the shape of a board until the counter-curse was used.
Or that's what SHOULD have happened.
Instead, the flash of magic ricocheted off of Alex's skin to hit Shia instead, who's entire body went rigid as a board as she fell face first into the hot water.
"Oops." Alex said with a flinch, before waving his hand to undo the curse on the rabbit-girl. He then teleported Shia away before she could go berserk, before turning his attention back to Hermione.
"Next?"
"Furnunculus!" Hermione screamed, only for Alex to effortlessly flick the spell away from him, where it wouldn't hit anyone else this time.
"Locomotor Wibbly!"
"Slugulous Eructo!"
"Impedimenta!"
"Titillando!"
"Levicorpus!"
Hermione tried every curse, jinx, and hex she could think of against Alex, but none of them worked as he continued his steady advance. Every single one was either deflected or bounced off his skin with such minimal effort on his part, that it was frankly insulting.
Eventually Hermione got so fed up, that she even tried Stupify against Alex to stun him. The result was of course Alex GRABBING the burst of red light, stretching and playing with it for a moment as if it had physical rubbery form, before dribbling it like a basketball and shooting it into an imaginary hoop.
By this point Alex was right in front of Hermione with his confident smirk still plastered on his face, as if daring her to keep going. And while Hermione briefly entertained the idea of using one of the Unforgivable Curses on him, she quickly banished the thought since that would be going WAY too far.
Of course, Alex intended to ask her to perform them so he could see how they worked at some point, just not right now.
Instead, he placed his arm on the wall that was now right behind Hermione, pinning her to it as he inched his body ever closer to her own, his eyes taking on a seductive hue.
"S-stay back!"
"I'm warning you!"
"I-I'll use an Unforgivable!"
Hermione threatened and bluffed nervously as she tried to halt Alex's advance, but it was no use as he gently grabbed her wrist and pinned it above her head, knocking her wand out of her grip as it clattered to the bathroom floor.
Hermione's breath hitched in her throat as Alex inched ever closer, to the point where she could feel his breath upon her face, and she was sure he could hear her heart pounding in her chest.
"Please..." She breathed out, though that was all that could escape Hermione's lips as Alex suddenly sealed her mouth with his own.
Everything that came afterwards was like a blur to Hermione as Alex's lips and tongue ravaged her mouth. She hadn't even noticed when he slipped her robes off her body so that she was naked yet again.
Hermione only realized when she felt Alex's hands kneading her breasts and butt, and even then she was too weak to stop him.
How many kisses had she shared with Harry? Hundreds? Thousands?
NONE of them made her feel the way this one kiss with Alex was.
The only one that came close was their first kiss during the Yule Ball in their fourth year, but that one was NOTHING like the kiss she was experiencing right now.
"Ehem!" A voice suddenly said, interrupting the kiss before it could get even more heated than it already was.
"Yes?" Alex asked as he turned away from Hermione to see Aine standing there, naked as the day she was born.
"Can we do Heart Hybrid now?" Aine asked with an intense look in her eyes. She REALLY wanted the power up they were supposed to get by performing it.
Alex looked at her, before looking back at Hermione to see her in a daze from their kiss, and then back to Aine.
"Sure. I think Hermione has had enough for right now. But let's be a bit more efficient."
As he said that Alex waved his hand, and Hayuru suddenly appeared beside him along with Yurishia.
"Wha-!?" Hayuru exclaimed, before Alex grabbed the two of them by the waist and pulled them close.
"Think I'd forget about you?" Alex asked them with a smile.
Hayuru was about to snap at him for his deplorable behavior, but then Alex's hand smacked her butt, and her voice suddenly sang a VERY different tune. One that made Alex smile widely at her.
And the entire time Hermione stood there beside them, dazed, confused, and more turned on than she'd ever been in her entire life.
...
A short while later Alex and the girls exited the space-time orb along with their new arrivals, after a very 'interesting' experience in the bath.
Not only had Alex successfully managed to perform Heart Hybrid with the three girls, replenishing their energy and unlocking what was called their Corruption Armament, but he had also discovered what made them all 'tick'.
For Aine it was 'shame' and 'humiliation'. Alex toying with the proud her in front of so many people, even if they were his wives, had sent her over the edge immediately.
Yurishia, surprisingly, was a masochist. When she left the space-time orb for the first time she had numerous red welts all over her butt and breasts, along with a collar that marked her as Alex's newest sex slave.
Hayuru, had been the most fun for Alex to play with. Despite being the most uptight and strict of the three, all it took was Alex massaging her butt cheeks and tickling her butthole a little before she sang like a Jigglypuff. Except Hayuru certainly wasn't putting anyone to sleep.
Though Alex was certainly looking forward to discovering more interesting plays with the three of them in the future, especially with Lala's Love Room at their disposal, it was time to become serious.
After greeting Remia and helping the children prepare for school, Alex led his group outside as they made their way to their first destination.
Accompanying him was Altina, Francesca, Tracy, Tio, Moka, Akasha, Kokoa, and Jade. The first four were returning to Tortus in order to assume control of their native factions, the Demi-humans, Demon race, the Hoelscher Empire, and the Dragon Clan. The three Vampiresses were also returning to their own world to enlist the help of the Youkai that lived there, while Jade was accompanying them.
After wandering through the streets of Asora for a bit, where Alex pointed out the various places of interest to Jade, they arrived at a massive rectangular archway with a keyhole in one of its pillars.
"Is this it?" Jade asked curiously.
"Yep." Alex said while pulling out his Skeleton Key(not the one used by Nocturnal). "Unfortunately I can only use these to access world's I have already been to, or those who are considered 'neighbors' of one of those world."
What Alex left unsaid was the possibility of Jade's home world of Erdrea being one of those 'neighbors', as the creator of Dragon Ball also worked on it. But that would be for later.
<BOOST!>
Cried out a red gauntlet that suddenly appeared on Alex's left arm, startling Jade slightly since this was her first time seeing it.
<BOOST!>
<BOOST!>
<BOOST!>
<BOOST!>
<TRANSFER!>
After Boosting his power enough times, Alex Transferred all of the energy into the Skeleton Key so that it began to glow with an intense iridescent light. Alex then slid the key into the keyhole on the right pillar of the arch, making the entire thing light up as the portal formed within it.
The moment the portal filled the entire archway, a small army of magic drones built by Hajime rushed through to quickly construct the archway on the other side, stabilizing the portal on both ends.
"Ok. You're good." Alex said to the quartet of princesses behind him, who eagerly stepped towards the portal.
"Mine liege, this one will'th dost her best to meet thine's expectations!" Tio declared with the mannerisms and appearance of a proper noble lady. One wouldn't realize she had barbed wire wrapped around her body in bondage fashion, and an ass full of anal beads.
Oddly enough, Alex had long since learned that princesses and perversion went hand in hand. Altina was another masochist like Tio, though not as intense of one, Francesca liked it so rough she was borderline masochistic, and Tracy, while not a masochist, loved being dominated by Alex or dominating others when he wasn't around.
But they were all also focused and committed when they needed to be. Alex had a job for them to do, and they were all gonna do it, regardless of the toys and whatnots they currently in or on their bodies.
With the other three also voicing their intention to do as Alex requested of them, they all stepped through the portal onto Divine Mountain, where Alex had decided to place the other end of the portal.
With Tortus taken care of Alex, turned his attention to the next portal that needed to be opened.
A snap of his fingers and the entire group was there, with Jade feeling slightly disoriented from the sudden shift. And once there Alex repeated the process to open a portal to Moka's home world this time.
After saying their goodbyes Moka entered the portal along with Kokoa, Akasha, and Jade. Thankfully, the Heliodorian Princess had already been shown and taught about the 'modern' world, so she shouldn't freak out too much.
"Nya?"
"Where have you been?" Alex asked a certain black cat with golden eyes as she approached him.
"Nya?"
"Well, let's go see a friend." Alex told her as she leapt up onto his shoulder.
He then headed towards Anne's hospital with determination in his eyes, going straight to the room he wanted, where he found a certain Saiyan laying in bed.
"Yo Grant." Alex said in greeting.
"Alex... Hi..." Grant muttered in a dispirited reply, his expression empty and eyes hollow.
"I take it you're still not doing that well." Alex stated bluntly.
"Well of course not!" Beth snarled from Grant's bedside, which she had refused to leave from the moment he'd been brought there. "Do you really expect him to be ok after what happened to him!?! What if YOU had to experience that?!"
"I'd want revenge." Alex stated immediately and bluntly, leaving Beth at a loss for words. "And right now, I want something from you, Beth."
"Why the hell should I give you whatever it is you want?" Beth snapped at him angrily.
"Because, it's to help prepare for when Markus attacks us. And no one should want to see him fail more than you right now." Alex told her seriously, which actually made Beth think on his comment for several minutes.
"Fine." She stated finally, standing as she did so. "I'll be right back." She told Grant in a much softer voice, taking his hand and squeezing it slightly as she did so.
The two then exited the hospital room while closing the door behind them, leaving Grant all alone. Or so it seemed.
"How pathetic." A voice suddenly stated.
"Huh? Who's there?" Grant asked in a low voice, lacking any urgency.
What he wasn't expecting, was a black cat with golden eyes to jump up onto his bed.
"I said you were pathetic." The cat told Grant bluntly in what sounded like a masculine voice.
For the first time life filled Grant's eyes since Alex revived him as he stared at the cat in realization.
"Y-you.... It can't be!"
"Oh, but it is." The cat smirked, having already suspected that someone with their own Zanpakūto would recognize her.
There was an explosion of steam in the room that made Grant cover his eyes, before it cleared to show him the naked form of a beautiful dark-skinned woman.
"Y-Y-Yoruichi!" Grant exclaimed in shock, his mind racing to try and explain why she was here. He was so shocked, that he couldn't actually register that she was completely naked.
Casually taking a hospital gown for herself, Yoruichi donned it before casually approaching Grant.
"That's my name, but let's focus on you."
As she said that Yoruichi looked Grant over, and was surprised to discover that he actually had quite the spiritual powers. Probably because he'd had his Zanpakūto for so long.
Smirking evilly at him, Yoruichi declared suddenly, "you'll pass."
"P-pass for what?" Grant asked nervously.
"I'm going to turn you into a Shinigami."

chapters.title: Chapter 529 - 529: Trial of the Gods
chapters.content:
"What are we doing here sir?" Asked a tired looking man dressed in a perfectly maintained suit, his hair combed back and posture pristine.
"I told you Simon, I want a front row seat for the show!" Declared an elderly looking man who was dressed weirdly compared to their surroundings.
While everyone else around them was dressed in more traditional clothes or robes made from wool or cotton, or even armor made of metal or leather, the elderly man was dressed in a colorful button-down shirt made of silk, with numerous floral patterns on it, and a matching pair of shorts.
He was even holding a hollowed out pineapple in his hand that had a straw and mini umbrella in it.
Despite his 'particular' dress though, none of the people around him even seemed to register the existence of either of them. Which was curious considering that they were all unconsciously making a wide berth around the two of them.
"So where is it you ere wanting to watch the show, sir?" Simon asked wearily.
"Up there of course!" The old man said while pointing at the top of the tallest structure in the entire city.
Meanwhile, at the bottom of the structure, a Denatus was taking place that would've left most mortals in awe if they were peer in on it.
Every single god that resided in the city of Orario had gathered at the request of the oldest and most powerful God in the city, Ouranos. And every single one was giving their undivided attention to the goddess responsible for the Denatus that day, Hestia.
Even with well over a hundred gods staring down at her, Hestia didn't seem anxious in the slightest as they prepared for her trial. An attitude that differed greatly from that of Haruhime, Lili, Aisha, Samira and Lena.
They, as a part of the Hestia Familia, were the only mortals present aside from Ouranos' personal attendant, Fels.
Everyone else was a god or goddess, all seated in raised stands on either side of the room instead of at the usual long table they typically used. And every single one was muttering and discussing what they thought was going to happen that day.
Some wanted the immediate expulsion of Hestia from the city, while others were mostly neutral. The latter having only showed up because Ouranos ordered it, and because they were curious about the rumors circulating of Hestia lately. The ones saying that she might've found a husband.
Very few of the gods gathered were truly on her side, hoping she wouldn't be expelled from the city. Amongst them were Hephaestus, Takemikazuchi, Miach, Astraea, Ganesha, and(though she would never admit it) Loki.
"Are we ready to begin?" Ouranos asked suddenly, making every single God and goddess present go silent as they all gave him their undivided attention.
"In case anyone is unaware of why we are here." Ouranos started. "We are gathered to listen to the grievances of the goddess Ishtar and the God Soma, both of which had their Familia's decimated by the Hestia Familia. And, depending on our decision, Hestia may be forced to permanently leave Orario along with her Familia."
There was a buzz of activity when Ouranos finished speaking, but a flash of his sky-blue eyes was enough to silence them all yet again.
"The aggrieved may step forward, and state their case." Ouranos declared, opening the floor for the two aforementioned gods to show themselves to the court.
And as her eyes swept across the courtroom, Ishtar was immediately able to garner the favor of several gods as they caught her Charm full blast. Soma meanwhile appeared disheveled and unkempt, with his long black hair that covered even his eyes, as he dedicated every possible moment to his hobby as a brewer.
"My fellow gods and goddesses." Ishtar began dramatically. "We all live and work alongside one another in harmony because we all believe in following order. Yet, there are some who believe they are above that order."
As she said that Ishtar turned towards Hestia and looked at her in an accusatory manner, which didn't bother the shorter goddess in the slightest. Instead, she looked back at Ishtar with a wry smile since she fully believed that whatever was decided here today didn't matter. Not when Alex finally came to get her.
Narrowing her eyes at Hestia's casualness, Ishtar continued,
"Not only did Hestia STEAL a member of my Familia from me, but when I tried to get her back, she orchestrated the slaughter of my 'children'!"
"Pft!" Hestia snorted at her declaration as she retorted, "yeah right! If you weren't showing me any hostility, then Ascalon wouldn't have reacted. And besides, aren't you also going to mention how you wanted me to work in your brothels for a hundred years?"
Hestia's words triggered numerous mutterings and exclamations, but not from her refuting Ishtar's claims.
"You mean to say that sword truly is THE Ascalon!?!" One of the gods exclaimed with urgency.
"Yep! My hubby Alex sent it to me in case I needed the protection! I can't use it, but it'll react to any hostility directed towards me!" Hestia declared proudly, before going 'iyaaa' like a love struck maiden.
However many of the god's minds were racing, as they absorbed the knowledge that one of THE legendary weapons had been found.
"It must be a fake!" One of the gods declared in disbelief, which began to calm the others before another God spoke up.
"There was no way THAT was a fake. If not the famous dragon slayer sword, then that thing was definitely a god slayer."
Every eye turned towards the speaker in shock, to find none other than Hermes standing there with an uncharacteristically serious expression on his face.
"Forgive me if we don't all believe you Hermes. You're not exactly known for your honesty." One of the gods snorted.
"What about me?" Asked another God suddenly, making everyone look to him in shock since he almost never spoke in a serious tone.
"I was there as well, and felt the power of that sword." Ganesha stated to the shocked gods. Naturally, his testimony had much more credibility.
But then Ganesha flashed his typical smirk as he declared, "But what I'm REALLY more interested in are those strange monsters you had helping you Hestia!"
Hestia returned his smirk as she proudly declared, "they're called Pokemon, and they're a lot friendlier and easier to tame than normal monsters!"
"'Pokemon'?" Ganesha asked curiously, while the rest of the gods also paid close attention to everything Hestia was saying.
"Yep! Not only are they friendly when tamed, but if they're trained right then they can become really powerful! Plus some, like Chansey, are even capable of healing others!"
There was a small commotion at Hestia's words, as healers alone were so rare they were practically nonexistent.
"And where do these 'Pokemon' come from?" Ouranos asked Hestia, bringing silence to the hall once more.
"I got them from one of my hubby's other future wives." Hestia stated without any hesitation, causing yet another commotion.
"Right... This Dragon Emperor, Alexander Morningstar." Ouranos trailed off as he thought on this particular matter. "Ive had the guild investigate him, but there is no mention of any Dragon Emperor in any of our records."
Hestia nodded as she answered, "well of course since he's not from this world."
THAT got the biggest reaction yet from the surrounding gods, as while they were aware of the possibility of world's from 'outside', this was the first time they had actually heard of proof.
"So that's why..." Loki uttered to herself as she spoke for the first time.
Now everything going on with Hestia for the last few weeks was starting to make sense. But that still didn't explain how she was able to communicate with someone from 'outside'.
"Well that still doesn't matter." Snarled Ishtar, making everyone look back at her.
"Hestia stole from me, and she caused the slaughter of almost all of my 'children' while the rest abandoned me. I demand compensation!"
"Yeah!"
"She's right!"
"It doesn't matter!"
One by one, numerous gods agreed with Ishtar's declaration as a result of her earlier Charm, swinging the majority against Hestia in an instant. Ouranos of course was aware of this, but he only shook his head at her without saying anything.
"There's also the matter of Liliruca and my Familia." Soma stated after her, though no one cared as much about him. Not only were only Charmed to care about Ishtar, but his Familia had always been viewed in a negative light as addicts.
"Lili never joined Soma-Sama's Familia!" The Pallum stated suddenly, drawing every eye to her. "Lili's parents had her branded as an infant and she was used like a slave! Then, she was never allowed to leave without paying a fortune to do so!"
Lili's declaration earned her the sympathy and pity of several of the gods present, as some genuinely cared about their 'children' and couldn't imagine treating them like that. Others of course couldn't care less, as they usually saw mortals as possessions or tools to use as they saw fit.
One such goddess sneered at Lili, before declaring,
"Yes well, that may the be the case for yourself. Haruhime however, is another matter."
Ishtar then held up a piece of paper for everyone to see, and stated, "Haruhime was bought by me years ago. She is officially my property, regardless of wether or not she carries my Falna."
Ishtar's declaration created a whole new storm of murmurs and discussions, as now Ishtar had a genuine claim towards Haruhime that Hestia had disregarded.
Though typically frowned upon, slavery itself was not necessarily illegal in Orario. And with Ishtar having proof of her purchasing Haruhime, then there was no arguing who the Reynard belonged to.
"I am sorry Hestia." Ouranos stated solemnly. "But Ishtar does have a point."
Hestia frowned when she heard that, while Haruhime's heart began pounding anxiously in her chest.
"Starting the reparations towards Ishtar, Hestia must return the Reynard Haruhime to her." Ouranos declared, making Ishtar smile widely while Hestia frowned.
"Come here Haruhime." Ishtar commanded her, but the fox-girl didn't move from her current place.
"I said come here." Ishtar stated in a firmer voice. And again Haruhime didn't listen, as Aisha Samira and Lena all moved as if to protect her. Lili did as well, but no one noticed her due to her short stature compared to the other three girls.
"I SAID-"
*CRASH!*
Just as Ishtar was about to lose her temper, the doors to the courtroom were blasted open revealing a musclebound man with wild black hair, attired only in a pair of shorts with a monkey tail extending from his backside.
"And if she doesn't want to?" The man asked with a voice that carried both power and authority.
Every eye turned to him wondering what he was doing, when an elderly and fat elf stormed up beside him.
"How dare you! A lowly mortal, interrupting the Denatus!" The elf declared arrogantly as he tried to stop the intruder.
"Sorry, are you doorman? Here's my jacket." The intruder said dismissively to his arrogance, conjuring a jacket from nowhere and tossing it to the elf.
The jacket covered the elf's head where it had been draped, but when it fell all he was able to do was sputter incredulously at the AUDACITY of the man before him.
Everyone else however was wondering who this mortal was, as they could feel the power radiating off of him in thick rolling waves, while Freya, goddess of love, was currently trying to contain a nosebleed after taking a glimpse at this mortal's soul.
"Alex!" Hestia declared as she left the stand and rushed to him, throwing herself into his embrace as he caught and lifted her up.
And then, every God was stunned as Hestia readily kissed the newcomer, the man she claimed was Alex.
For over a minute the duo made out in front of everyone, with Hestia wrapping her arms and legs around his body to cling to him possessively. But when the duo finally separated for air, Hestia looked him over before asking,
"Where's your fur?"
The man, Alex chuckled at her question before telling her, "I don't have it in my base form. But if you want, I can use magic to regrow it later."
"Yes! Yes! Yes!" Hestia declared, as she had long since been determined to snuggle and bury her face in Alex's fur.
"Excuse me!" A voice suddenly demanded from the side, making the duo look over to see Ishtar standing there glaring at them.
"And just WHO are you supposed to be?" She demanded while looking Alex up and down. Normally he'd be WELL within her strike range, if he didn't have the insufferable big-boobed loli hanging onto him.
"Alexander Morningstar, the Dragon Emperor." Alex stated casually, stunning Ishtar and the rest of the gathered gods, despite Hestia calling him Alex earlier.
Even as he said that though, Alex set Hestia down before turning to give Ishtar his full attention. "And no need to introduce yourself. You must be Ishtar, the goddess that wanted MY Hestia to work in your brothel for a hundred years."
Hestia squealed by herself yet again as Alex declared her 'his', while Ishtar was finding it harder and harder to remain standing in Alex's presence as his aura pressured her more and more.
"And so what?" Ishtar demanded, trying to hide her growing fear.
"And so, I think you need to be punished." Alex told her as if it were the simplest thing.
"Please don't." Ouranos suddenly said, his own pressure coming down in the room to rival Alex's.
This made nearly all the gathered gods flinch while also regarding Ouranos with awe, as their Arcanum was sealed when they descended to the mortal world, yet Ouranos was STILL this powerful while simultaneously keeping the monsters from escaping the Dungeon.
The only one not to react was Alex, who looked at Ouranos as if he'd found the god's attempt to pressure him amusing.
"Sorry, but she brought this upon herself." Alex said, before all of Ouranos' power vanished to be replaced by his own, stunning and horrifying all of the gods.
Alex then turned his attention towards Ishtar, who was no longer trying to hide her fear as she fell back on her butt, and tried to crawl back away from him. However Alex had no intention of letting her get away, as he used his Telekinesis to bring her back before him.
"Since you wanted MY Hestia to work in your brothels for a hundred years, you'll get a similar punishment." Alex told her before snapping his fingers, and instantly shredding Ishtar's clothes so she was completely naked.
For Ishtar being naked in public wasn't that big a deal. She WAS the owner of a brothel where those who paid top dollar and that she recognized could even spend the night with her. What DID worry her though, was when Alex continued,
"Your punishment will be to become one of my slave maids for the next hundred years." As he said that, Alex carved his slave brand on Ishtar's butt, officially making her his slave.
"And as your new owner," Alex continued as he held up the piece of paper Ishtar showed to prover her ownership of Haruhime. "I now free Haruhime from your ownership."
As he said that the paper caught on fire and burned to ash, a sight that made Haruhime choke on a sob emotionally.
With that done, Alex turned back to Ouranos to discuss what was going to happen next.
Before he could say anything though...
"There you are!"
Alex turned to see a tall Amazonian woman glaring at him from the doorway he had just busted open, dressed only in a chain mail bikini top and a matching set of strips that hung down to barely cover her pussy and butt crack.
"And you are...?" Alex asked her curiously, only for the mysterious woman to declare,
"YOUR WORST ENEMY!"
The woman then shot forward so that she appeared before Alex in the next instant, during which he made sure to move Hestia and Ishtar away for their safety, before the woman's fist impacted his chest.
"REJECT X 1000!"
