chapters.content:
The woman sat upon the cold concrete blocks, her arms handcuffed and chained to the shackles behind her back as she was forced to listen to the obnoxious gloating of the man sitting at the luxurious desk.
"WAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! Behold Funkfreed, the golden transponder snail capable of triggering the Buster Call! And it's all MINE!"
The man then continued his cackling even as the elephant in the room continued snacking on fruits. And the man, either unaware of being ignored or not caring, continued gleefully,
"This snail, given to me by Admiral Aokiji, grants ME the power of an Admiral as well! The power to summon an entire fleet of warships, that will make an entire island disappear at the push of a button!"
The man then sneered behind the leather mask that covered half his face, before directing a look at the women as he leered, "and yet, the power of even the Buster Call pales in comparison to that of the ancient weapons. Right, Nico Robin?"
The woman, Robin, looked away indignantly from the man and his victorious smirk. And why wouldn't he feel victorious?
She was the only person in the world who could read the runes that would allow the resurrection of the ancient weapons. She, who had been evading the World Government for twenty years, and yet was now in their hands after she gave herself over to them.
"Hmph!" The man, Spandam, snorted at her with indifference before going back to his gleeful gloating.
"Hey Nico Robin, stop sulking. Your friends are on their way, aren't they?" Said her fellow captive, and man with thick chains wrapped around his body to restrain him.
Though he couldn't read the same runes she could, the man was the only other person in the world capable of reviving one of the ancient weapons, Cutty Flam. Or as he went by today, Franky.
Franky was the latest in a line of shipwrights that possessed the blueprints for one of the ancient weapons, secretly passed down from master to apprentice through the centuries. And so, upon learning of his survival after an incident that should've led to his death years ago, the government assassins she'd surrendered to also captured him to interrogate in order to learn of the blueprint's location.
"That's the problem though Franky..." Robin said with a shaky voice. "I don't want them to come here..."
Franky just gave her a level look, but didn't say anything else since he'd seen her fighting rescue from her comrades for the past few hours now, and he more or less knew her story.
Robin had surrendered herself to the Marines willingly after the covert assassination squad, CP9, made contact with her. The reason was because the head of CP9, Spandam, had been granted special authorization to use the Buster Call by the Marine Admiral, Aokiji, specifically for her and her crew mates, the Straw Hat Pirates.
Robin had experienced the Buster Call as a child, the only survivor when the Marines wiped out her homeland of Ohara because they dared to research what the World Government considered taboo, the Void History. A hundred years of nothing in their world records, truly the holy grail for archeologists to study.
But it had seen them all destroyed. All of them, but her.
The result was an unimaginably large bounty being place upon her head when she hadn't even been ten years old, a bounty that had haunted her her entire life since.
Every single group and organization she had joined had been destroyed by either the Marines, or those chasing after her bounty. And every single one of them turned their backs on her to try and save their own skins.
Robin had long since learned not to trust anyone. At least, until she joined the Straw Hats.
Though suspicious of her at first, they readily treated her as one of their own. For the first time in a long time she could relax herself, smile, and even enjoy the little things that she hadn't been able to until then.
But then she also received an invitation to something completely new, the Chatroom.
Though she merely found it amusing at first, Robin was surprised to find the Chatroom becoming an increasingly large part of her life, just like how the Straw Hats had worked their way into her heart.
Even if she didn't spend every moment on it, like Hestia seemed she was, Robin was still amazed at how interconnected she was becoming with the lives of those who used it.
The perverseness of the Chatroom aside, the women who used it would often post pictures or videos of themselves in their daily life for others to see.
Lala would often post about some new invention she had made, which would then immediately show some kind of defect that resulted in nakedness or sexual situations in some way. Meanwhile her sisters, Nana and Momo, would often post about the plants and animals they were taking care of at the moment.
Erza would usually post videos of herself fighting for everyone to spectate, and even offer their advice on how to improve her movements. Though Robin had noticed that Erza would pointedly ignore anything Mirajane would say, which was usually some kind of snide or vicious remark one wouldn't expect the motherly looking woman to make.
Kuroka would show everyone her cats, Lucy all of the spirits and monsters under her control, Mikan and Haruna were both posting videos of themselves working in the kitchens, during which they would also take any requests for the next meal. And most of all, the mothers of Alex's harem, and Alex himself, would post hundreds of pictures and videos about their children.
The more these women posted about themselves, the more Robin learned about them and became involved in their lives. A prospect that both excited and scared her.
And that was exactly why she had not used the Chatroom at all ever since she gave herself up. She didn't want to distract any of them with her problems.
Not just Alex, but every one of his wives were working towards facing a threat looming over all of them, and Robin COULDN'T be the one to distract them from it. She WOULDN'T!
If she had to list any regrets about her choice, it was that she couldn't spend more time with her crew mates, and that she would only be able to use the Chatroom from prison from now on, in between what she was sure to be numerous 'interrogation' sessions. Robin was already sporting several marks and bruises where Spandam had slapped her several times across the face, and kicked her in the stomach.
Her body was tougher than an average person, but she had been unable to even defend herself with her hands cuffed behind her back.
And now, though the sea stone handcuffs prevented her from using her Devil Fruit power, Robin was being forced to 'watch' through her Observation Haki as her crew mates desperately struggled to reach her, along with one of her Pokemon, Deino.
"Skull?"
As if summoned by her thoughts of her other Pokemon, a small head with a skull-shaped mask peeked out of her shadow curiously. It was her only other regret in being captured, her second Pokemon, Duskull.
"!!!"
Franky nearly shouted out as Duskull appeared, but a look from Robin silenced him before she looked to her little Pokemon worriedly.
"You should get out of here Duskull. I don't want to sentence you to a life in prison with me." She whispered to it urgently, while also keeping an eye out to make sure Spandam didn't notice anything.
"..."
Duskull however only shook its head defiantly, before rising up out of her shadow further to nudge her head with its own affectionately.
Rather than comfort though, Robin only felt a sense of guilt and urgency to try and get Duskull to leave her. It deserved someone better.
Before she could think of anything though, hurried steps could be heard before the door was thrown open suddenly.
"Chief! There is a situation to report!" A Marine declared urgently.
"WAAAAAAAAH! DON'T SCARE ME LIKE THAT YOU IDIOT! I ALMOST ACTIVATED THE BUSTER CALL!" Spandam shrieked at the Marine.
"I'm sorry sir! But we were unable to get through to report about the current situation developing on Enise Lobby!" The Marine declared with a salute.
"Why didn't you just call me? Oh! The receiver's off the hook! Who keeps doing this!?!" Spandam raged when he realized the state of his transponder snail, which was of course because of him to begin with.
But even as he raged at his own unintentional incompetence, Spandam immediately regained his cocky demeanor as he turned back to the Marine that was waiting to deliver his report.
"Anyways, you wanted to deliver a report? Go ahead. Wait! Actually, I want Nico Robin to hear this as well!"
Sneering down at her as he approached them, with Duskull once again hiding within her shadow, Spandam gloated as he mocked,
"How many casualties did we hear before? Five? AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! What pathetic pirates to attack one of the Navy's headquarters and only being able to take out five men!" Spandam laughed at Robin nastily at her increasing misery from his taunting, before finally turning to the Marine and saying,
"Go ahead and give your report now. Let me guess what it is though, all those filthy pirates have already been put to death?"
Even as Spandam acted casually about the situation, the Marine was practically bouncing out of his boots as he waited to give his report. So, when he was finally able to do so, he practically screamed,
"Sir! There are about sixty pirates that infiltrated Enies Lobby! They breached the main gate, and have made steady progress across the island before arriving just outside the courthouse! Furthermore! The captain of the Straw Hat Pirates, Monkey D. Luffy, seems to be engaged in battle atop the courthouse, AND the giant gatekeepers have turned to the other side, and joined forces with the Pirates! Currently they seem to be running amok throughout the city! Altogether, our casualties amount to at least two thousand men, half of which could be attributed to Straw Hat Luffy! This event is quickly becoming the biggest disaster in the entire history of Enies Lobby!"
Throughout the Marine's report Spandam was growing paler and paler by the second, and when he heard about Luffy battling atop the courthouse, he rushed to the massive window behind his desk to look out the city for himself.
"Blueno.... What are you doing over there...?" He asked quietly, as he witnessed one of his agents engaged in battle with Luffy.
And looking out past them, Spandam just now realized how dire the situation was as he saw smoke rising up from all over Enies Lobby, dozens of ruined buildings. And hundreds of people still fighting in the streets as the Marines desperately tried to subdue the attackers. But, as he was looking out over the island, Spandam was suddenly plunged into shadow that made him look up, and see that black clouds now covered the island of perpetual sunlight.
"W-WHAT IS GOING ONNNNNNN!?!?!?!?!?!?" Spandam shrieked as fear grew within him.
"GO AND GET CP9!" He hysterically ordered the Marine.
"Sir!" The Marine saluted as he hurriedly left to carry out his orders.
Spandam then turned his attention back to the fight between Luffy and Blueno, and tried to calm himself by thinking the situation over 'calmly'.
And once he did that, Spandam recalled that CP9 was one of the strongest assassination groups within the Marines, there was no way they would fall to a bunch of no-name pirates here. Sure, the Starw Hats may have gotten lucky so far, but that was all it was. Luck.
That was what Spandam decided on as he watched the fight between Straw Hat and Blueno below him, which he now knew was the pirate's last few minutes of futile struggling. But, he wasn't going to chance them getting lucky again.
"MEN!" He cried out.
"""YES SIR!"""
"Open the Gate of Justice!"
"But sir! The convoy isn't here yet?"
"I know it isn't! But they came here for Nico Robin and Cutty Flam! If we get them on the other side of the gate, then anything they've done will be in vain! Now HURRY!"
"""YES-"""
"ROOOOOBIN!"
"HIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII!!!"
Spandam shrieked upon hearing Luffy's cry, making him rush to the window to see Straw Hat standing alone on the rooftop, with an unconscious Blueno behind him.
"Blueno LOST!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!"
"Gyahaha! Dumbass!" Cackled a man with his black hair tied into numerous bands.
"So we were called for only Straw Hat?" Asked a seductive woman dressed in black leather.
"Yoyoi! Just being~ able to get this far~, is worthy of~ respect!" Declared a large man with long pink hair that moved as if it had a mind if it's own.
"That's what he gets for just bar tending for five years." Sneered a man in a top hat with a pigeon on his shoulder.
"He still shouldn't lose that easily." Replied a man with squared features.
"Chapapa~! He lost!" Declared a man who's body was a large sphere with limbs, and a zipper for his mouth.
Spandam looked back to see the six figures he most wanted to see at that moment, the rest of CP9.
"Good! You're all here!" Spandam exclaimed as a sense of relief filled him, before going over to stand before the window to look out at the confused Straw Hat Luffy.... Or not, since he was busy stuffing his face with some meat...
"Firstly, I want you all to kill-"
*KABOOM!*
Lightning suddenly flashed as it blasted through the window to strike him, blowing out the side of the building while frying Spandam to a crisp.
"Straw.....Hat...Luffy..." He wheezed out with a puff of smoke.
"Divine retribution for sexual harassment." The woman said while adjusting her glasses.
"What sexual harassment...?" He whimpered pitifully while slumping down on the spot.
Rather than help him, all six of his subordinates walked past Spandam to the now open window to stand on the balcony outside. As they did that, they watched as all six of the Straw Hat Pirates similarly gathered beside their captain after a big commotion.
"Robin's up there?" Asked their cook, Sanji.
"I see pigeon guy, so yeah, she should be there." Luffy stated seriously.
"Man... We sure got lucky getting here... And good thing Yamato is keeping all the Marines back for us..." Nami sighed, though she also couldn't help but to worry.
The scale of their battle this time far exceeded anything they had done before. And that was exactly why she had sent a message to 'him' asking for help, despite knowing he would most likely bill her further. But Nami didn't care. If it was for the sake of her crew, then she would make as many deals with the devil as she needed.
"Meow~!"
"Form form!" Meowth and Castform both declared alongside her, both ready to fight as well to get Robin back. Even Robin's Deino had come with them with the intention of getting her back.
And as she watched the tower before them carefully, Nami also began controlling the clouds above them to prepare another bolt of lightning that was even stronger than the last one. But she couldn't drop them as much as she wanted, not with Robin still being captured.
"They're all gathered!!!" Spandam exclaimed as he recovered from being struck by lightning, looking down to see them all gathered there below him along with three weird.....things.
"What are you lot waiting for? GO AND blagarga..."
"""???"""
Every one of them looked back at Spandam confusedly at his garbling, only to see him foaming at the mouth with his eyes completely white as he passed out.
"Is that...?" The pigeon guy, Rob Lucci, uttered as his eyes narrowed from the obvious use of Haki. The only question was, who used it?
...
"Hold them back!" Yamato commanded the allied forces of Galley La and the Franky Family, the most notorious gang of Water 7.
Currently they were outside the courthouse of Enies Lobby that all criminals brought to the island passed through, all of who were found guilty before being taken to the navy prison, Impel Down.
She was holding all of the Marine forces back from attacking Luffy and the others from behind, as he and the rest of his crew wanted to be the ones to face CP9 themselves.
"Guilty!"
"Not!" Yamato replied as one of the guilty jurors swung a massive iron ball at her, which she sent flying back at him with a swing from her Haki infused Takeru.
"There's no end to them..." Sabai, second in command of the Franky Family, complained tiredly.
"Yeah, especially when Yamato and those two giants are doing most of the fighting." Pauline stated irritably at Sabai's complaining, before using his rope techniques to restrain several more Marines.
Sabai was going to respond to the jab, when suddenly they all felt a horrible pressure bearing down onto them. A pressure that made every single defender of Enies Lobby pass out while foaming at the mouth.
"Haki!?!" Yamato exclaimed in awe, having never felt such powerful Haki that surpassed even that of her father's.
She looked around to try and identify the source of it, before looking up at the sky. And there, amidst the thick rolling storm clouds, was a ball of pure white light that mimicked the same intensity of the sun.
Yamato stared up at the light in awe for a brief second, before...
*BOOM!*
Black lightning filled the sky that spread out in every direction as far as the eye could see, but what followed it wasn't thunder.
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - 540: The Drums of Liberation
chapters.content:
*The country on a bridge located in East Blue, Tequila Wulf*
*CRACK!*
"MOVE FASTER YOU LAGABOUTS!" Screamed the warden as he cracked his whip across the back of a child, making him cry out in pain as he staggered forward.
*CRACK!*
*CRACK!*
*CRACK!*
"I DIDN'T SAY YOU COULD REST!" The warden screamed as his whip cracked several more times, making the kid scream with each one.
"How horrible..." One of the men uttered under his breath. But as he did so, the slight puff of steam that exited his mouth in the freezing air gave him away.
"HUH? YOU GOT SOMETHING TO SAY?!" The warden demanded as he turned his attention to the man.
"N-no sir! Nothing!" He quickly said while bowing his head in submission.
"Yeah? Well maybe you need a lesson just in case!" The warden sneered down at him as the rest of the slave laborers watched in horror.
The man closed his eyes as tightly as he could in anticipation for what was to come, but it never did.
A few seconds later he hesitantly opened his eyes, to be greeted by a sight like nothing he had ever seen before.
Black lightning filled the skies above them, painting a scene as if it were the end of the world itself. However, accompanying the Lightning was not thunder, but instead was the beat of a drum like nothing the man had ever heard before.
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
The most amazing part though was that the warden, along with all of his men, had all collapsed while foaming at the mouth.
For a moment no one said anything as they just stared at the scene, before the man realized something as he hurriedly rushed forward to take the warden's whip and gun.
"NOWS OUR CHANCE! LETS TAKE OUR FREEDOM!" He roared out while raising the gun high for all of them to see.
Normally his fellow slaves would hesitate after spending so long as laborers. Many of them were criminals or prisoners of island nations not aligned with the World Government, and many more had actually been born into their enslavement as they all labored to build the great bridge. Any will to act would've been stamped out of them a long time ago.
Now however, as the black lightning filled the sky above them, and the beat of the drums reverberated within them, the slaves all felt a sense of hope that they thought had long since been lost.
"""FREEDOM!!!!"""
With a great cry, the slaves all rushed forward while seizing as many of the unconscious guard's weapons as they could, each and every one desperate to take this chance to become free.
***
*Sabaody Archipelago, at the foot of the Red Line*
*BAM!*
"And sold, to the nobleman of the Lulusia Kingdom for a whopping five million Berries!" Proclaimed the auctioneer as he slammed his gavel onto the podium, before a couple men came in and took the 'merchandise' away, a beautiful young woman.
She was then escorted to the back of the auction house to await being picked up by her new master, during which time he would also deliver payment for her.
"And now for our next item!" She heard the auctioneer declare even from backstage, where she saw her fellow slaves that were being prepped for their own auction. One of them however was an older man with loose clothing, and long silver hair with a short trimmed matching beard.
"Such a shame for lovely young lady like yourself." The man said with wry smirk, making her feel even worse about where her life was about to go.
But right then, the man's expression turned oddly serious.
"Looks like it's your lucky day." He told her a second later, before she felt a weird sensation along with everyone else within the auction house, and Sabaody Archipelago as a whole.
The next thing any of them knew, all of the auction house workers slumped over as they passed out while foaming at the mouth.
"Eh!?!" She nearly screamed in surprise.
"I wouldn't worry about them if I were you. Instead, I'd take this chance to escape." The old man said, while pointing to the keys the employee had dropped when he passed out.
The next few minutes were a scramble for freedom as all of the former slaves unlocked the explosive collars from around their necks, and fled the auction house when they saw that all of the guards and patrons as well had passed out.
"How interesting..." The old man mused to himself, even as he pilfered the money from every single patron present, as well as the auction house safe.
When he finally exited the building, without appearing at all rushed or concerned, he could distinctly hear drums in the distance where he felt the Haki come from. And glancing that way, the man saw black lightning and a bright light on the horizon, like that of the sun.
***
*The New World*
Dressrosa. The land of passion and flowers, and it was currently engulfed in chaos.
"What is happening?" The current king of Dressrosa, one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea and Celestial Dragon, Donquixote Doflamingo, asked 'calmly'. Though, the numerous veins pulsating on his forehead showed anyone around that he was in fact, not at all calm. He was livid.
Everything had been fine, another day of ruling his country and living the life of luxury his station afforded him. But then 'that' happened.
A pulse of what he knew to be Haki swept over the entire island, incapacitating every single one of his guards, and most importantly, Sugar.
Sugar was one of the key people on Doflamingo's crew, who's Devil Fruit power allowed her to turn those she touched into toys, and command them in any way she wanted. But as an added bonus, any of those she turned into toys were completely forgotten about, erased from the minds of all who knew them.
Thousands of toys had populated Dressrosa ever since he rose to power. Husbands, wives, parents, children, Pirates, animals, and anyone unfortunate enough to make an enemy of him.
But that pulse of Haki had knocked out even Sugar, and the result was ALL of the toys within Dressrosa returning to their original forms, and now running wild throughout the country.
And of course, upon realizing who was behind it as memories of forgotten loved ones returned to them, the entire population turned on their once loved King.
The same voices that once cried his name in love and adoration, were now filled with hatred and vengeance.
This didn't concern Doflamingo though of course, it just annoyed him that all of his hard work had been undone so quickly, and he still had no real idea of what had happened.
"Assemble the entire Donquixote Family and get them moving. I want the entire country back under control as soon as possible." He ordered 'calmly', to which his highest ranking officers, Trebol, Pica, and Diamanté, nodded in affirmation.
Meanwhile, down in the city, a single legged man was hopping furiously towards the castle.
Scarlett...
Rebecca...
With the names and images of his wife and daughter in his mind, the former of which was killed years ago, while the latter was currently living in hiding, the man hopped furiously towards the castle in the hopes of killing Doflamingo and ending his reign on Dressrosa for good!
As he was charging forward though, a sudden shift in his body made the man stumble awkwardly, before looked down to see that the leg he had lost so many years ago had returned.
"!!!"
"How!?!" He exclaimed in shock.
"You are a man my lord believes would be of help. Of course he would help you in return." A feminine voice suddenly declared, making the man look up to see a trio of beautiful women standing there amidst the chaos.
The first appeared too young to be on such a battleground, her blond hair drifting in the wind around her petite body, which was attired in a black leather dress.
She appeared completely calm and collected, like the second woman who stood stoically despite the chaos around her, her hand on her katana while a large black dog growled at her side.
And finally the third one was a woman with scarlet red hair, adorned in metallic armor as she glared up at the castle where Doflamingo awaited them.
"Stand and fight Kyros, or was my lord wrong about you?" She asked him in a stern voice.
Though speechless at their appearance, the man, Kyros, stood as he put his weight on both legs for the first time in eight years.
"I know not who this lord of your is, but if he is the man who granted us this chance after eight years of tyranny, then he has my eternal gratitude!" He declared while charging forward into battle.
***
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
As the sound of drums filled the air along with black lightning, the people of a certain country became filled with a raging fire within their chests.
"BRING DOWN THE SHOGUN! DOWN WITH KAIDO!"
The people of the isolationist nation Wano cried out, despite enduring nearly twenty years of abuse and servitude at the hands of the Beast Pirates and their current Shogun, Orochi.
They had no weapons.
They were forbidden to learn how to fight.
And they were outnumbered, outmatched, and headed for complete defeat.
Yet for some reason, the entirety of Wano's citizens suddenly felt at that moment that they NEEDED to fight back, they NEEDED to bring down their oppressors.
"FOOLS!" Roared out a massive dragon as it raised up into the sky, intending to bring their pathetic little rebellion to an end, and find the fool that used Haki on his men to give them the opening that caused the rebellion to begin with.
It didn't help that the dragon, Kaido, was drunk at the moment, and had entered his angry drunk faze. And now the citizens of Wano would be the ones to face his wrath.
Coincidently, the Shogun Orochi had also been affected by the Haki, and was completely passed out in his castle.
"DO NOT FALTER!" One of the men cried out, even as the still conscious members of Kaido's crew, the Beast Pirates, similarly rallied to enter the fray. Almost all of them possessed Devil Fruit abilities of some kind, either natural Devil Fruits, or the artificial Smiles that they were receiving from Doflamingo.
"IF YOU'RE SO DETERMINED TO DIE, THEN DIE!" Kaido roared as he gathered a mass of intense flames within his mouth, intending to end the rebellion in one fell swoop.
"I DON'T THINK SO!"
*BOOM!*
Suddenly, out of nowhere, a massive hammer struck Kaido below his chin to force his mouth shut, and preventing him from unleashing his flames upon the people of Wano.
"""WHAAAAAAAAAAAT!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!"""
Both the rebels and the Beast Pirates had the same reaction as they saw the King of Beasts sent reeling from the attack, before the hammer suddenly flew back to the hands of the one who threw it.
"Humph! What 'King of the Beasts'? Isn't he just an overgrown lizard?" The wielder of the hammer harrumphed irritably, even as Kaido recovered and turned towards her threateningly.
"And who are you?" He snarled, both in anger and in eagerness as the drink cleared from his mind.
"I'm a bunny!" The girl declared while pointing to her fluffy sky blue ears and puffy tail, as if it were obvious.
"I see..." Kaido said, though he couldn't care less about the details. All he knew was that the hit he received from the girl's hammer had been the hardest he'd received in a long time. It made him excited to fight her.
"Open the gate of the Black Dragon, Bahamut!" Cried out another new voice, directing everyone to a flash of light that turned into the massive figure of a pure black dragon.
"GYAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!"
It roared challengingly while directing its attention towards Kaido, making him even more excited.
But the surprises didn't end there, as the girl raised up numerous keys that lit up as she channeled magic power into them. And in an instant the empty field she had been standing in was occupied by an army of creatures the likes of which none of them had ever seen before.
"You may be 'King of the Beasts', but I'm 'Queen of the Monsters!" The blond haired woman declared as her army surged forwards.
By this point no one knew what was happening anymore, but the rabbit girl then pointed her hammer at Kaido as she declared, "DO YOU WANT FREEDOM? THEN TAKE IT WANO! FIGHT WITH US!"
As the rabbit girl mentioned them regaining their freedom, the people of Wano recalled the desire to fight that had filled them earlier, and surged forwards alongside the monsters who apparently were on the same side as them.
"Even if you have the numbers to match ours, it is futile..." Declared a figure that rose up over the rest of the Beast Pirates, covered in black leather that hid his entire body, with matching wings extending from his back.
"""KING!"""
Roared the Beast Pirates at the arrival of their second in command, as he gathered a ball of powerful flames and prepared to unleash upon the army of monsters advancing towards them.
"I suppose that's my cue, isn't it?" Said yet ANOTHER new voice as a figure appeared right in front of King, and delivered a powerful kick that sent him flying back down to the ground.
"!!!"
"""KING!!!"""
The Beast Pirates all cried out yet again, but this time with urgency since they had never seen King get blown away. This led many of them to fearfully look up into the sky to see a demon floating there, her wings spread wide while her tail danced in the air behind her.
"Don't go dying too quickly now. I want to have some fun~!" She purred sadistically while licking one of her claws.
"What is this?" Kaido demanded as he looked over the three strangers curiously.
"This, is the end of the Beast Pirates!" The rabbit girl from earlier declared, before she leapt up into the air to do battle with him.
***
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
"..."
While the rest of the world was descending into chaos from the black lightning and the sound of the drums, a certain figure silently looked up into the sky when he heard it.
"Nika..." The man uttered slowly.
He was massive compared to other people, and made all who stood against him tremble in fear by virtue of his name alone. And those who still stood to fight him, they soon tasted despair by his overwhelming might.
Despite all that he took no pleasure in his work, as it was just that. Work.
He was seen as a man without emotions by many, but even if they didn't show on his face, numerous emotions filled the man as he listened to the sound of the drums echoing around the world.
"Can you hear them father, Bonney? The drums of liberation." He said to the empty air around him.
"I have never heard anything so beautiful..."
***
In the mists of the New World, a massive figure lumbered through the oceans with legs so long, that they even reached the sea floor.
With the appearance of an elephant, the creature was so large that it carried even an entire civilization upon its back as it wandered the world. And while it wandered aimlessly, it paused as a certain sound reached it through the mists.
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
'This sound...!'
The feeling of nostalgia filled the elephant as he it heard something it hadn't heard in eight hundred years, a sound that filled it with more elation than it had felt in that entire time.
'Is it truly you....my comrade...?'
***
"This power!?" Exclaimed an elderly woman as she trembled from the extreme Haki that made the very air around her vibrate, and filled the sky with black lightning.
Not just her, but every woman on Amazon Lily trembled from the overwhelming power they could feel. All but one.
"I know! Isn't it amazing~?" Exclaimed the only person who seemed thrilled to feel the power. Their empress, Boa Hancock.
"Sister... Could this be...?" One of Hancock's sisters asked hesitantly.
"Yes! It's 'him'! Oh how I can't wait to see him!" She declared lovingly while hearts floated in their air around her.
Elder Nyon however was feeling an entire different emotion as waves of Haki continued rolling over their little island.
None of their people had passed out from the Haki, but she knew from how powerful it was that that was simply because the one using the Haki had such control over it that he was only targeting those he wanted to. How far such an effect extended, she didn't know.
But the mere fact that he had managed to encompass their entire island when they weren't even the targets made her tremble in both fear and awe.
"Quickly! Prepare a feast to welcome 'him'! I want everything to be perfect for when 'he' arrives!" Hancock ordered her people, before heading to the kitchens herself to personally prepare a mountain of food for the one she had been so anxious to meet.
***
"This is an emergency!"
"Yes, I understand!"
"Please wait a moment!"
Even as the entire world plunged into chaos, the worst of it was at the Marine Headquarters and the holy land, Mary Geoise, as reports of what was happening around the world poured in.
"All of the slaves at Tequila Wulf have escaped!"
"The Sabaody Archipelago is in chaos after the 'clients' at the 'employment offices' escaped! Several of them have even injured or killed visiting nobility and royalty!"
"Gecko Moria is reporting an army of corpses attacking Thriller Bark! On top of that, the entirety of his own army has turned against him!"
"Banaro Island has been leveled following a battle between unknown entities! Witnesses state that they identified two women, one with silver hair, and one with cat ears and tails, possibly from eating a model of the Neko Neko no Mi!"
"Our undercover agents are reporting that Wano is in the midst of a war between the natives, Kaido, and an unidentified group of women!"
"Totto Land has been engulfed in a series of disasters! Some islands have been frozen while others endured tsunamis, raging fires, lightning, and even tornadoes! No word yet on the status of Big Mom!"
These reports and more continued pouring in without any signs of stopping, but the absolute worst came last.
"THE CELESTIAL DRAGONS ARE BEING ATTACKED!"
That single sentence was something none of the Marines ever thought they would hear, especially after the Fisher Tiger incident several years ago.
"Akainu, Kizaru! Mobilize at once!" Ordered the Fleet Admiral Sengoku.
""Right."" The two Admirals answered as they prepared to leave.
One of the primary duties of the three Admirals was to answer the call of the Celestial Dragons if they were endangered or defied, so both were ready to arrive at the holy land as soon as possible. And what they found waiting there was pure chaos.
Numerous women were running around the holy land and gathering up all of the slaves that were trying to escape, and directing them to a wall of mist while also defending them against the Royal guards and Marines that were still conscious.
Chief amongst the defenders though were the God's Knights, the super elite combat force whose sole responsibility was to guard Mary Geoise and the Celestial Dragons. And their Supreme Commander was none other than one of the saints, Saint Figarland Garling.
Incredulously, the attackers were even able to hold their own against Saint Figarland and God's Knights while continuing the evacuation of the slaves, with a massive green dragon being at the center of the attack.
"Oooh? Wasn't there a dragon on Wano as well~?" Asked one of the Admirals as they surveyed the situation.
"Doesn't matter. We kill it just for the crime of attacking the Celestial Dragons." The other answered gruffly, before the duo moved to attack.
The former raised his leg up in the air and began gathering power as it began to shine brightly. When he unleashed the gathered power at the dragon with a kick though, a figure appeared between them to take the attack head on.
She was wearing bright white armor with a large shield and sword in either hand, the former of which he used to deflect the blast of light to the side with minimal to no effort.
"Hey hey hey. My attacks aren't supposed to be so weak you know~." The Admiral, Kizaru, exclaimed in surprise to seeing his attack deflected.
But even more surprising was when the woman's figure shimmered before her clothes changed before them, equipping thick black armor with a large and menacing looking sword.
"Promotion.....Knight!" She declared before shooting forward and slashing the sword at him threateningly.
And while Kizaru usually didn't even bother dodging attacks, he felt a sense of danger from the approaching blade that made him lean back slightly, allowing it to graze his chest.
"..."
Kizaru looked down to see that his suit had been torn from the attack, while there was also a thin line of blood.
"Oooh? How did you manage to cut me without Haki~? Hmmm~?" He asked without at seeming concerned about his injury.
However a cloud of darkness formed around the girl as her heterochromatic blue and green eyes focused on him.
"Light and dark are opposite each other, right?" She asked as if it were obvious.
"Oooh? I guess you're right~." He answered after giving it some thought, before resuming his attack on the girl.
Meanwhile, Akainu continued rushing towards the dragon and the numerous women surrounding it, all of which were dressed like maids, when he suddenly sensed something approaching him from the side.
"HAAA!" Screamed a girl with long pink hair as she made to punch him, which Akainu had to actually defend against.
But even as he defended himself, Akainu was blasted back through numerous buildings as her attack ignored his Devil Fruit.
Instead of being bothered by it though, he just looked at her as she approached him and asked, "how did you hit me without Haki?"
The girl just 'humphed' though before holding up her hands to display a pair of metallic gloves.
"With my Grab-Grab Anything Gloves, I can grab anything I want that can't usually be grabbed onto, like fire, air, water, and even hot lava! Which also means that I can hit meany heads like you!"
Sticking her tongue out at him as she said that, Akainu began to grow enraged that he had been hit by a....child.
"Little girl... You should really learn to tell who you should fight, and who you shouldn't..." He growled irritably as most of his body began to transform into magma.
But even as Akainu and Kizaru prepared to fight, neither one of them noticed the other girl that was singing in the background, her voicing carrying over all of Mary Geoise to spur those who were suffering into action, while also steadily doing slight damage to the God's Knights and Royal guards. But over time the damage would increase to the point where even the slightest attacks would deal critical damage to them.
And as the world descended into chaos, a certain figure sat silently upon a grand throne with the Five Elders kneeling before them.
Even as the destruction occurred outside, and all of the slaves escaped from Mary Geoise, the figure did not stir. Instead, they and the Elders focused entirely on the sound that could be heard even through all of the fighting.
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
And as that sound echoed throughout the entire world, the figure only narrowed their eyes hatefully as they sneered a single word in disdain.
"Joyboy."

chapters.title: Chapter 541 - 541: Wanted
chapters.content:
"Haaa..." Alex sighed contently as he reclined against the headboard behind him, with a naked and exhausted Robin and Nami curled up next to him on either side.
And as he listened to the steady rhythm of their breathing, Alex recalled the events of the last day.
While training with Kale he had received a message from Nami about Robin giving herself up to the Marines, which coincided with what Alex recalled of their original plot. He had been surprised to learn she would still do so though, especially after gaining access to the Chatroom, but that also just showed how deeply her trauma ran.
So, in the face of such a deeply rooted trauma, Alex decided to respond in the way he knew best.
He had his wives disperse around the world, and pick a fight with all three of the major powers.
In this world there existed three groups that created an uneasy balance of power between them. They were the Seven Warlords of the sea, the Four Emperors, and the three Admirals.
The Seven Warlords, currently six, were all pirates that were notorious around the world for one reason or another. However, they had all also accepted pardons from the Marines that removed their bounties, and gave them free reign to do as they wished, so long as they fought in the Marine's interest when called.
The Four Emperors on the other hand were four of the most notorious and powerful pirates in the entire world, with each one commanding an army with territories large enough to be considered genuine emperors. As such, their positions and strength made it to where even the World Government hesitated to take action against them.
And finally were the three Admirals, the second highest authority within the Marines under the Fleet Admiral. The three of them were like a living force of nature on their own, each one being capable of striking fear into all they appeared before, with the exception of a select few like the Four Emperors.
Of the Warlords Alex had his little necromancer, Eri, attack Thriller Bark where Gecko Moria resided, and was building an army of zombie soldiers with his Shadow Devil Fruit. Just by setting foot on the island though, Eri had released all of the shadows Moria had enslaved to his will, and taken control of his army of zombies while also resurrecting those he had yet to raise, like the colossal Oars.
Meanwhile Erza, Yami and Shizuku had gone to Dressrosa to confront Doflamingo, and remove him from his position as king of the country while also taking him and his entire crew captive. And from the clips Alex saw of the battle, it was quite an interesting one with Yami combating Doflamingo's String Devil Fruit with her transform abilities, namely her hair.
While those two particular Warlords were being taken care of, Yue had taken several of her vampires to attack one of the Four Emperors, Big Mom. She, unlike Doflamingo and Moria, controlled an entire chain of islands called Totto where she sought to create a utopia where all the races of the world could live together in 'peace'.
Kaido meanwhile ruled over the island of Wano with the current Shogun being nothing more than his little puppet. So, Alex hadn't hesitated to send the bugged bunny Shia to deal with him, along with Mirajane for added muscle, and Lucy to bolster their numbers against his army.
And while Alex didn't necessarily mind the Marines, as their ultimate goal was to protect the innocent people from the vicious pirates that populated the world, they unfortunately served the World Government as their loyal dogs. So, Alex hadn't hesitated to send San, Lala, Yuna and the Combat Maids to free all of the slaves residing in Mary Geoise where the Celestial Dragons lived, which turned the entirety of the World Government against him in one fell swoop.
Alex then proceeded to personally attack Enies Lobby in order to rescue Robin, regardless of whether she wanted to be rescued or not. And in the process he destroyed the colossal Gates of Justice, leveled the entire city, and rendered the entire defending forces unconscious with his Haki.
After saving Robin, and promising to make her enjoy her life from now on regardless of if she wanted it or not, Alex then gave the members of CP9 a message to pass on to the World Government on his behalf.
'Gather the entirety of the Marine's strength, and all of the might that could be mustered by the World Government. In one week, I WILL personally attack Mary Geoise, and I WILL slaughter every single Celestial Dragon.'
He then sent all of the agents back to Marine headquarters, barring one of them, after performing a little experiment that left all of them shocked to their core even more than after receiving his message.

"I already said I'm going to make her my slave, and so she'll work from now on as my maid as well. Or would you rather I strip her of her Devil Fruit and kill her like the rest?" Alex asked her in a borderline condescending tone, while everyone else had various drastic reactions.
"You're going to kill us!?!"
"What do you mean by stripping us of our Devil Fruits?!"
"That's impossible!"
Just as Alex was about to magic to silence them like he had Teach and the others earlier, he didn't have to as numerous ghostly figures entered the room and passed through their bodies.
"I don't deserve this power anyways..."
"I just want to die and reincarnate as a slug..."
"Such a power is wasted on me..."
In an instant all of them became depressed and slumped over without supporting their bodies, unwilling to continue resisting whatever Alex was going to do to them.
"Horo Horo Horo Horo! That's what you all get!" Perona declared as she reappeared from the ceiling.
"Thank you Perona." Alex said to her, making the ghost girl puff her chest out in pride.
But after that he focused on Monet, and asked her, "so tell me Monet, would you like to join the rest of them, or join me alongside your sister?"
"I'll stay with Sugar." Monet answered immediately, to which Alex nodded in affirmation.
"Good. It'd be a waste to have to do away with such a beautiful woman." He said while shamelessly stepping up, and similarly removing her shirt to place the brand on her stomach.
"Oh!" Monet exclaimed from the sudden compliment, her cheeks turning slightly red as Alex released her cuffs.
"You little traitors." Doflamingo cursed the pair of sisters angrily, even as his expression and voice remained calm.
But he was just ignored as Alex made his way down the line of pirates, removing the Devil Fruits from those that had one without any fighting back thanks to Perona. But then he reached a young woman wearing a maid style outfit complete with a frilly bonnet and apron.
"Baby 5." Alex said as he recognized the woman, truly one of the only ones he sympathized with amongst Doflamingo's crew.
"What? Are you going to take my Devil Fruit next?" She snarled defiantly.
"Not at all." Alex answered, confusing her. He then stepped closer at an intimate distance, and said sensually in her ear,
"After all, I REALLY need you and your power on my side."
"!!!"
Immediately her entire face was filled with a heavy blush as she sputtered, "y-you need ME!?!"
Alex nodded as he readily unshackled her, and said, "of course Baby 5. You are a very beautiful woman, with a great ability. Not only do I NEED you, I would be honored if you were to become one of my brides."
The effect of Alex's words was instantaneous as her eyes practically became hearts, and she swooned before him like a maiden.
"What just happened?" Lucy asked incredulously as Alex caught Baby 5, and handed her off to Grayfia to take care of.
"For some reason, Baby 5 has a powerful desire to be useful to anyone around her, even if they're 'enemies'. I recall in the original timeline when Doflamingo was brought down, Baby 5 very nearly committed suicide simply so she could be of use, even in death."
"""!!!"""
Everyone looked to the woman in shock when they heard that, none of them being able to imagine what living such a life was like.
"I'll take good care of her." Grayfia said with a sincere voice, to which Alex nodded as he added,
"Yami can help too, since the fruit Baby 5 ate gave her the same abilities as her."
"!!!"
"Human weapon?!" Yami asked incredulously.
"In a sense. If I recall right she can turn any part of her body into a weapon, even guns and cannons. I'm curious to see if she can do so with modern weapons as well." Alex explained as he continued making his way down the line of prisoners, even the only other one he felt sorry for, Senor Pink.
But the majority of his suffering was a result of his own actions, which put his wife in a vegetive state after they lost their son. So Alex wasn't as ready to give him another chance, though he did promise the man that he'd use his abilities to help his wife recover when he got the chance, which Senor Pink was very grateful for.
As he went down the line Alex had collected numerous Devil Fruits, some of which were powerful, and others which seemed marginally less so. Amongst them he got the Sui Sui no Mi, which allowed the user to swim through solid matter as if it were water(though they still couldn't swim in actual water). The Guru Guru no Mi, which allowed the user to turn parts of their body into propellers.
The Pamu Pamu no Mi, which gave the user the ability to make anything they touched rupture and explode. The Ton Ton no MI, which allowed the user to increase and decrease their own body weight by metric tons. The Ato Ato no Mi, which allowed the user to turn anything, person or otherwise, into abstract art.
The Ishi Ishi no Mi, which allowed the user to merge and assimilate with stone to control it. Alex personally couldn't help but wonder how it'd turn out if he gave this particular Devil Fruit to a certain Blind Bandit when he finally went to that world.
Then there was the Hira Hira no Mi, which allowed the user to make anything they touched ripple and wave like a flag or clothing. And finally there was the Beta Beta no Mi, which let the user create and control mucus. A particularly disgusting power if Alex was being truthful.
The most powerful Devil Fruit he collected from them though was the Gasu Gasu no Mi, which was a Logia type fruit that allowed the user to create, control, and even turn themselves into any types of gases that existed.
And then finally there was the Ito Ito no Mi that Alex collected from Doflamingo himself, which allowed the user to create and control strings.
"So what now? Are you gonna kill us?" Doflamingo asked the moment Alex finished removing the Devil Fruit from his body.
"Well, not necessarily." Alex started cryptically.
"I have one last thing I need from you, and then you all will go to your eternal torment."
***
"Sir! Marines from all over the world are on their way to Mary Geoise! All of our forts and bases are being emptied out, and even Marineford is only manned by a few hundred men to act as a resupply point!" A Marine man declared to not only the Fleet Admiral, but all three of the Admirals, AND the Five Elders.
"Excellent. That'll be all sailer." The Fleet Admiral, Sengoku, stated solemnly, to which the man saluted before departing.
"All of the Marines are coming to Mary Geoise... Won't this leave the rest of the world open to pirate attacks?" Asked the third of the Admirals who hadn't been present when the attack on the Celestial Dragons took place, Aokiji.
"The only thing that matters is the safety of the Cestial Dragons. They are the gods that built this world, and as such, they have priority over the rest of the world's population." One of the Elders declared.
"That's also why we are having them evacuate the holy city in secret." Another stated as they looked out over the city below them.
The Dragon Emperor had them attacked by only a handful of people, and now he was going to come at them with his everything when he attacked. They HAD to be prepared for the worst case scenario, which included the complete destruction of the holy city.
Buildings could be rebuilt, but they'd never be able to live it down if ANY of the Celestial Dragons perished in the fighting. So every single one of them was evacuating temporarily to a safe and undisclosed location with a portion of their forces to protect them. The rest of the Marines, including the Admirals and the Elders, would remain at Mary Geoise in order to keep up the ruse as long as possible, and to try and defeat the Dragon Emperor.
But, right as they began going over their plans yet again, Sengoku noticed something.
"What is it, Fleet Admiral?" One of the Elders asked when he noticed that Sengoku appeared distracted.
"Was that there a moment ago?" He asked while pointing to something on a nearby table.
"""!!!"""
Alarm spread through both the Admirals and the Elders when they all noticed a present that sat on the table, perfectly gift wrapped with a large red bow on top.
And at once they were all on guard.
"How did it get in here?" One of the Elders demanded, as it definitely hadn't been there a moment ago, and none of them had noticed anyone bring it in.
Slowly, and tentatively, Sengoku approached the present while remaining wary of any possible traps. But nothing happened as he stood right before it, or even when he reached out towards it.
Regardless, none of them lowered their guards for even a moment as he picked up the card that was on top and read it out loud.
"One down.
-Alexander D. Morningstar."
The tension in their bodies increased when they heard that, and then some more as Sengoku pulled the ribbon to open the present. And as he did so it revealed a wooden box.
Opening the box cautiously, when he saw what was inside Sengoku paled grimly.
There was no danger, but what was actually in the box made him much more tense than he had been a moment before, as he mechanically picked it up and held it so everyone else could see what lay inside.
And there, on a cushion of purple velvet, laid the severed head of none other than a man whose father relinquished his entire family's status as Celestial Dragons, Donquixote Doflamingo.

chapters.title: Chapter 544 - 544: The Charlotte Family
chapters.content:
As Alex awoke the next morning he found himself entangled in a massive mess of limbs, which made him fondly recall the events of the last few 'days'.
After killing Doflamingo and sending his head to the World Government, Alex went to go and deal with the relatively massive crews of the Big Mom and Beasts pirates, with a somewhat surprising end result.
When he had gone to see the Big Mom pirates, Alex was surprised to see Big Mom herself, real name being Charlotte Lin Lin, incredibly skinny due to not having been able to eat while she was locked up.
Instead of fighting or resisting, she had only begged for food while her crew, composed almost entirely of her son's and daughters, similarly begged him to save her.
And while he had been tempted to just let her waste away, Alex relented and gave her a little bit of Mikan and Haruna's food. The result was Big Mom nearly flooding the room with tears of joy.
After that Alex had been about to repeat his actions of the previous two groups by recruiting the women into the combat maids, and sending the men along with Big Mom into one of the realms of Oblivion. But when she realized what he was going to do, Big Mom offered him another idea.
If Alex wanted women, then he was more than welcome to her as well if she got more good food.
The mere idea of that suggestion made Alex gag a little, as Big Mom was the very image of anything BUT attractive. Naturally Big Mom took offense to Alex's reaction, and told him how she had been a great beauty when she was younger(though she thought she still was).
Soon after Alex used Regenration magic on her out of curiosity and returned Big Mom to her prime, making her look like a completely different person than she had a moment before. Even her own children didn't recognize her aside from the eldest amongst them.
Originally she had been an morbidly obese old woman, with matted pink hair while standing at nearly thirty feet tall. Now however, she stood only slightly taller than Alex, with an incredibly slim figure, fair features, and her hair had turned into glossy waves that cascaded down her back.
After that a deal was struck between Alex and Big Mom, namely that every one of her thirty six daughter's would join his combat maids, while she and her son's would resume pirating, but on his behalf. And Alex accepted once they were all branded with his slave marks, which would keep them from rebelling.
After that he went to go and deal with the Beasts pirates, led by Kaido with the former Shogun of Wano, Orochi.
In their case Alex repeated his earlier actions since Kaido had more than deserved death for what he did to Wano, basically enslaving the entire nation to build weapons while simultaneously starving and poisoning them. Even now, Anne was leading the restoration efforts on his behalf on Wano to remove the pollution and restore the land while providing treatment to the people.
The worst thing they did though was feed the defective artificial Devil Fruits to the people, Smiles. They had gotten their name from the fact that the defects made the eaters only smile and laugh, no matter how miserable they were.
And because of them, men, women and children were all only able smile and laugh whenever their loved ones died, or were even executed, being unable to properly mourn them.
Alex wasted no time extracting the Devil Fruits from the men of the Beasts pirates, while applying his slave brand to the women. The sole exception was was a young man by the name of Page One, who was an officer and younger brother of another officer named Ulti, who became one of his maids.
Unlike the Devil Fruits Alex had collected earlier though, all of those used by the Beasts Pirates were the transformation type Zoan Devil Fruits, which was how they got the name of course. And while the vast majority were standard animals known throughout several world's, mammals, birds and reptiles, there were also several of the rare prehistoric Devil Fruits.
And from Kaido himself, Alex collected the mythical Zoan fruit, Uo Uo no Mi: model Seiryu, which allowed the eater to turn into the mythical azure dragon. Then there was the other mythical Zoan fruit, the Hebi Hebi no Mi: model Yamata no Orochi, which had been eaten by the shogun Orochi and allowed him to become the eight headed dragon.
Most of these fruits he'd probably make available to the people of Asora, as Alex couldn't imagine his wives eating several of them. But with the mythical and ancient Zoans, he'd probably find someone who'd eat them.
And so in the end, Kaido was sent along with his crew and Orochi into the Badlands where Alex had sent Teach and his crew earlier. There they'd be 'taken care of' by the numerous Daedra that called the Badlands home, before their souls would be warped and twisted in Daedra as well.
But that was a process that would take centuries, by which time they would more than likely forget all about their past years as pirates.
And once that was all done, Alex returned to Asora with the entirety of Thriller Bark and all of those who were on it, after sending Big Mom's sons back to Toto land.
A 'night' later, and here Alex was, in the space-time orb and surrounded by all of the new women he'd 'recruited' the day before.
"Mamamama! You really don't know what 'self restraint' means, do you!" Big Mom, Lin Lin, laughed boisterously as the only other person who was conscious alongside Alex.
"What is this 'self restraint' you speak of? Is it edible? Or is something I can stick my dick in?"Alex asked eagerly, making her laugh some more.
He had to admit, Alex liked this younger version of Lin Lin much better than before. Not only was she easier on the eyes, but her attitude was completely different as well.
Rising, the duo then made their way to the bathroom connected to Alex bedroom to wash up for the day. As Alex sat at one of the wash stations though, Lin Lin readily crouched before him and took his cock into her mouth.
"Someone's hungry." He commented wryly, but she didn't respond as Lin lin instead seemingly tried to suck the life out of him through his cock.
Apparently she had grown someone addicted to the taste of his cum, stating it was the best thing she'd ever tasted. Aside from Mikan and Haruna's cooking of course.
But if they wanted to take things further then they both had to be careful, as Lin Lin was quite literally built different. The first time Alex had fucked her was back at Thriller Bark, and they had nearly sank the ship while making the entire castle crumble around them.
...
"Humph! I can't believe mama would do this!"
"I know! This is totally unlike her!"
Two young girls stated back and forth, the two youngest amongst their large family, Charlotte Pudding and Flampé.
They were currently within the kitchens of the villa inside the so-called space-time orb, along with most of their sisters after their mama had given them all to the Dragon Emperor. Though both Pudding and Flampé were still too young for him to 'claim', despite their mother's insistence otherwise, at fourteen and thirteen respectively.
As a promising prospective chocolatier, Pudding was put in charge of producing the chocolate sweets for the Dragon Emperor and his family, while Flampé was her assistant. Though her skills still fell far short of those who already worked in the kitchens, due to the skills they'd bought through the Chatroom shop.
"But don't worry Flampé, everything will go back to normal soon!" Pudding suddenly declared to her younger sister.
"You mean big brother Katakuri is going to beat up that pathetic 'Dragon Emperor'?!" Flampé asked expectantly, her eyes shining as she thought of the amazing big brother that she adored.
"Maybe.... But just in case I prepared this!" Pudding declared as she revealed a massive chocolate cake.
"There's enough poison in a single bite of this cake to even give mama indigestion for an entire week! I'm sure there's more than enough for that stupid Dragon Emperor!" She declared haughtily with an evil smirk, with even the third eye in the middle of her forehead narrowing in excitement for when that bastard sampled her cake.
And the sooner the better as she looked around, and so desperately wanted to escape this weirdness to get back to Toto Land.
After all, for the some reason the standard uniform for all of the girls working in the kitchen was to wear an apron, and NOTHING ELSE!
Everywhere Pudding and Flampé looked it was naked butts as these women shamelessly flaunted their bodies, with some even wearing aprons that allowed their breasts to hang freely out of it. Even her own sisters were participating in the strange attire!
As she thought that, the two sisters watched as their elder sister and one of the four Sweet Commanders, Charlotte Smoothie, walked by wearing nothing but an apron. Even worse was that Smoothie was a fifteen foot member of the long leg tribe, so the apron did NOTHING to hide her unmentionables.
Smoothie wasn't the only one acting out of place though, as EVERY one of their older sisters were not only acting uncharacteristically, but several of them had even drastically altered their appearances like their mother had. And now all of them were strutting around almost in the nude like the other girls and Smoothie.
"Kya~!"
A cry suddenly rang out, making everyone turn towards the girl that made it, one of the so-called Pandora, but there was nothing there.
"Ahn~!"
"Hyan~!"
"Nooo~!"
One after another several woman cried out in surprise and pleasure from nothing, before it was one of the head chefs turn, Mikan.
"What are you doing Alex?" Mikan asked as a pair of invisible hands groped her breasts.
"You're no fun Mikan." Alex said with a pout as he became visible before all of them. Though, he still massaged Mikan's breasts and pulled her close so her bare backside was rubbing up against his front.
"Mmn... Maybe I oughta prove you wrong then." She said in a sensual tone with a smirk to match.
"Oh? Please do~." Alex smirked back as his groping became much more vigorous, while one of his hands began creeping down his backside.
"I don't think so." A voice said as someone grabbed Alex by his ear.
"Sexual harassment is not permitted at this time." Kalifa stated firmly, to which Alex cocked a brow at her.
"Really? Are you serious right now?" He asked incredulously.
"Of course." She stated seriously while adjusting her glasses.
"And the moment's over. Another time then~." Mikan purred as she slipped out of Alex's grasp, and sashayed away with her bare butt moving alluringly.
"The little vixen..." Alex groaned, mentally promising to repay the cocktease later. As for Kalifa....
"Here! This is for you!" Pudding declared suddenly, interrupting Alex's thoughts as she readily presented a large chocolate cake to him.
"Oh! That looks delicious Pudding!" Lin Lin declared as she suddenly appeared, and salivated as she eyed the cake hungrily.
"Sorry, but this is mine!" Alex declared as he opened his mouth much wider than humanly possible, thanks to his rubber body, and scarfed the entire cake down in a single bite.
"""!!!"""
Needless to say everyone was stunned by both the display and gluttony Alex showed, while Lin Lin was torn between anger that Alex hogged all the delicious cake, and envy that he was able to open his mouth so wide to take such huge bites.
"Delicious!" Alex exclaimed once he swallowed all of the cake, before smacking his lips in contemplation as he added, "try not to go so heavy on the poison next time Pudding. It takes away from the flavor."
"""!!!"""
Every eye turned towards her three in alarm when they heard that, while Pudding herself turned deathly pale from learning Alex knew of, and survived, her attempt to kill him.
Immediately her mind started running numerous horrible things Alex would probably do to her for trying to kill him, starting with something like the roulette wheel her mother used for anyone who dared to try and leave her crew.
"W-what are you going to do to me?" Pudding asked with a shaky voice, to which Alex smirked evilly.
"Let's see...." He drawled on as if he were thinking about it.
"How about...nothing!"
"Huh???"
Pudding couldn't help the stupid sounding voice that leaked out at Alex's answer, as it had been the last thing she'd been expecting from him.
"Well yeah! I mean, all you did was try to kill me. It's not like it was anything major." Alex explained as if it were obvious, making Pudding, as well as several of her sisters, wonder if his head was screwed on right.
The only one not confused was Lin Lin, who nodded in agreement as she said to herself, "true... After a while any attempts on your life just seem like any other day..."
Alex nodded in agreement with her before suddenly adopting a serious expression as he looked at Pudding.
"However, while I may shrug off an attempt on MY life..." He began while stalking closer to her menacingly, making Pudding shiver in fear even as her feet refused to move.
"I'll have to get VERY cruel and unusual on anyone idiotic enough to target my wives or children. Understand Pudding? Flampé?"
With every word Alex spoke an increasingly unbearable pressure radiated from his body, making him glow with a golden-green aura that scared the hell out of every member of the Charlotte family present, including even Lin Lin and especially the two girls it was being directed at.
And by the time he had finished speaking, both Pudding and Flampé had collapsed, the latter out of the very air, and yellow puddles formed under them as she slowly nodded in understanding.
"Good then~!" Alex said cheerily as the pressure he'd been emitting vanished instantly, and the two girls were able to release the breath they hadn't realized they'd been holding.
"Now Kalifa, please take the two of them to get cleaned up." Alex said to his assistant.
"And why should I be the one to do that?" She asked distastefully.
"Aren't you the one who literally has soap powers?" Alex asked her, pointing out how she'd eaten the Awa Awa no Mi, making her a soap woman who could clean ANYTHING.
And while Kalifa had been quite pleased with her powers at first, that was before she entered Alex's employ and his wives began trying to aggressively recruit her into his combat maids.
Now she was definitely less than pleased with his request, even as she collected both Pudding and Flampé before taking them to the baths to be cleaned up. Alex meanwhile vanished the mess on the floor with a quick wave of his hand, before departing the space-time orb with Lin Lin at his side.
"So now what?" She asked as they entered the manor, then Alex transferred them both to Water Seven, where her son's were waiting after the party they'd all had the night before.
"Now, I'll return you and your sons to Toto Land. From there you can prepare your forces before sailing on to the holy land, Mary Geoise." Alex stated, surprising her.
"You mean you're really going to go through with it? Attacking the Celestial Dragons?" She asked him.
"Of course." He said with a firmness that surprised her, before a massive grin spread across her face.
"Sounds like fun. I haven't messed with the Celstial Dragons since the God's Valley incident thirty-five years ago!" She declared with enthusiasm.
"God's Valley incident?" Alex asked curiously.
"Yeah. It was back when I was still a member of the Rocks crew, along with brat Kaido and Whitebeard. The Celestial Dragons were having their human culling competition, where they round up thousands of humans and slaughter them for sport to see who gets the most points. But we crashed the place, and I stole the grand prize of the Uo Uo no Mi before giving it to the brat. MAMAMAMAMAMA!"
With Lin Lin desolving into laughter from the memory, Alex led her down the streets of Water 7 as they headed for the villa where she children had stayed the night. But even as they walked, they both couldn't help but to acknowledge just how different the city looked.
The night before they had all had a blast drinking and partying, with Luffy and his crew being the life of the party while the entire Charlotte family and even the workers of Galley La joined in. And thanks to a bet Alex had made with the drunk Pauly, he ended up using his magic to raise the entire city up out of the water.
Unlike other islands in this world, Water 7 was more like a city that had been built in the middle of the ocean. This was due to the island they had originally called home sinking slowly under the sea, and they had been constantly building on top of it ever since.
So, Alex ended up using magic to make the entire island rise up out of the sea, before using Creation magic to solidify the island foundation to keep it from sinking again. Now Water 7 was more than tens times larger than it had been before, and it was perfectly restored to its pristine condition thanks to Regeneration magic.
So naturally there was quite a bit of hustle and bustle as Alex and Lin Lin walked the streets, so much so that no one even bother paying attention to either of them as they hurried.
Eventually the duo parted as Lin Lin reached the villa where her son's were staying, and Alex gave her a scroll that would return all of them to Toto Land. Of course, she also had a magic key that Alex gave her so that she could return to Asora at any time, and would only allow her through so her son's couldn't follow.
Alex didn't stick around to talk to them though, seeing as all of her son's and EX-husbands weren't too thrilled with him.
Instead he made his way to the Straw Hats, where he found Luffy lounging around with Zoro and Chopper.
"Hey! Monkey guy! You got any more of that good food?!" Luffy demanded immediately, making Alex shake his head wryly before stating,
"No. But it's time for you guys to start training."
As he said that, Alex waved his hand and a new space-time orb that he'd prepared the night before appeared, making the three of them look at it curiously.
""Ooooo...."" Luffy and Chopper exclaimed in awe of the sphere, neither one knowing what it was.
Instead, Chopper looked around confusedly before asking, "um... Where are Nami, Robin and Sanji? Aren't they going to train with us?"
Alex shook his head as he explained, "Nami and Robin are going to stay with me while everyone is training. Don't worry, they'll be training as well, just in a different location. And as for Sanji.....well let's just say I made up a 'special' training program for him. But, I do have a couple things for you guys."
As he said that, Alex materialized a katana that he had stored away from Thriller Bark, and tossed it to Zoro.
"Here Zoro, this is a special katana that was once used by a legendary samurai of Wano. Keep it as a back up, or switch it out for one of the ones using now. Whichever works for you."
As he said that, Zoro was absentmindedly admiring the katana, which was made with a special black metal that felt heavier in his hands than normal,.
"Thank you." The swordsman said respectfully, seemingly deciding Alex wasn't a bad person.
"And here YOU go Chopper." Alex said, before tossing the little reindeer a backpack.
"Huh? But I already have a backpack?" Chopper said as he pointed out his own.
"True, but that one is special in that the inside has been expanded with magic, so you store a lot more things in there. Plus it's already got numerous stores of alchemical ingredients that were prepared by one of my wives, and Empress, Anne. Plus there also numerous books in there about different medical practices, and the use of every one of those materials."
With every word Alex spoke Chopper's eyes got progressively brighter, until both were practically gleaming in excitement to try out all kinds of new recipes and medicines.
"Woah! What did you get me?!" Luffy demanded when he saw the present both Zoro and Chopper got.
"Put your hand on this orb next to me. Your present is inside." Alex stated, to which Luffy readily complied before getting sucked in.
"You two as well. Time flows differently in there, so you can get plenty of training in before Franky finishes your new ship. Go in and take a look, I'll send Yamato in as soon as she shows up." Alex said to Chopper and Zoro, who both readily did as he instructed, and disappeared as well.
With them inside, and Yamato still a few minutes away from him, Alex then spread his senses to locate the last of the Straw Hats on Water 7. And with a wave of his hand, Alex made him appear out of thin air right in front of him.
"W-what's going on!?!" Usopp, 'former' sniper of the Straw Hat Pirates demanded as he looked around nervously, before focusing on Alex.
"Ah! You're that dragon guy!" He declared dramatically and fearfully. Even if he was a Straw Hat, Usopp was a complete coward.
"Boo." Alex said while taking a step towards him, making Usopp jump in fright before falling back into the space-time orb after Luffy and the others.
He then placed a seal on it to prevent anyone from leaving the Space-time orb for the next hour, which should give Usopp plenty of time to apologize and make up with his former captain.
A minute later Yamato appeared, prepared to help train Luffy and the others in the use of Haki.
"Hey Alex." She said in greetings.
"Hey Yamato. I sent everyone else inside already to check it out. But just to warn you, I sent Usopp in as well. So there might be some drama."
"Right..." She said in a non-committal manner, while also avoiding Alex's gaze.
"There's something else as well." Alex said as an evil grin formed on his face.
"!!!"
The next thing Yamato knew Alex was right in front of her, towering over her as she was pinned to the wall.
Wait...
Was he always this tall?
Yamato couldn't help but wonder such even as her heart began to flutter.
No!
It wasn't!
She was a man, just like Kozuki Oden!
That was what she kept trying to tell herself, until Alex suddenly held something out to her.
"Here. This is for you." He said while offering her a key.
"A key...?" She asked confusedly.
"Of course. It'll open a door directly into my home, Misty Manor."
"!!!"
"W-why are you giving me this!?" She asked with a higher pitched voice than usual.
"???"
"Why not?" Alex asked as if he were confused this time. "Why wouldn't I give it to one of my future wives?"
"!!!"
Yamato had no idea how she was supposed to respond to that, and even less so when Alex suddenly stole her lips in a brief, and tame, kiss.
Separating from her, Alex stepped back and walked towards one of the hundreds of canals spiderwebbed throughout Water 7.
"I've got some things to do, but I'll see you later Yamato."
Saying that, Alex's features warped suddenly as he turned into a shark and dove into the water. He then shot away through the canals and out into the open sea, leaving behind a VERY confused Yamato.
'I think this is the first time I've actually used this transformation...' Alex thought to himself as he darted through the water, having turned himself into a Wereshark with the divinity over lycanthropy that he'd acquired from Hircine. Similar to how he'd turn himself into a vampire whenever he felt like it.
And when he thought about it, Alex realized he could use this form to spend some quality time with Myuu and Remia when they went on one of their swims in the oceans of Asora. He was sure they'd love that just as much as Artemis had when he'd joined her on her last hunt, or when he went running with Aela and the other werewolves.

"Why are we loading up to leave again?" One Marine asked another.
"Haaa... Don't you EVER pay attention?" The other Marine asked him with undisguised exasperation. "We are being sent to Mary Geoise in order to help fight back against the Dragon Emperor and his forces when he invades the holy city."
"But...is it really ok for us to go?" The first Marine asked worriedly, while glancing back at the massive fortress behind them.
"Well...not really. No." The second Marine admitted, with similar concerns on his mind considering what their typical duties were. "BUT, orders are orders! And vice warden Hannyabal is going to remain behind to watch the prisoners."
Despite how strong and dependable their vice warden could be, when he wanted to be, both Marines still couldn't help but to worry considering some of the people they were holding here at the world's greatest prison, Impel Down.
It was the most secure place for the most dangerous prisoners in the world, with six levels extending down from the fort behind them to the sea floor, making escape impossible. Officially there were only five, but they were five levels of various types of hell and torture for anyone imprisoned there, depending on their crimes.
The first level was known as the Crimson Hell, where everything was made of blades and needles that would cut and stab those present as they were made to run through forests stained red from blood. The second level was known as the Beasts Hell, where prisoners were allowed to run free as they were chased by terrifying and vicious beasts, like Manticores, a Basilisk, and a Sphinx.
The third level was known as the Starving Hell, where the prisoners were given the barest amount of food and water to keep them in a constant state of near death. The forth level meanwhile was the Blazing Hell, where a massive cauldron of blood was kept boiling at all times to make the heat on the entire level unbearable, which would also rise up through the floor to make the third level even worse.
The fifth and last 'official' level was the Freezing Hell, where the temperatures were so cold that people regularly froze to death, their food was frozen solid, and numerous wolves too vicious for the Beasts Hell roamed.
