And beneath that was the Eternal Hell, where prisoners who were the biggest threat towards the World Government were kept while they were officially 'erased' from history. No one would ever be released from this Hell once sentenced.
With the dangerous inmates especially on levels five and six, the Marines couldn't help but to worry with the vast majority of their guards and the warden himself being sent away. What if there was an escape attempt in the time they were away?
Unfortunately for them though, they wouldn't need to have such a worry for much longer.
"Sea King!" A lookout suddenly cried, drawing attention to a fin racing towards them in the water.
Sea Kings were nothing new to Impel Down, since it was located in the Calm Belt. But this one was obviously heading straight towards them.
Every man rushed towards their battle stations while the few Vice Admirals present also stepped forward to deal with the beast.
"I don't get what the fuss is about. It's just an overgrown fish." One remarked while drawing the saber at his side.
"To us, perhaps. But remember these men don't even know how to use Haki yet." Stated another beside him that was adorned in a Dalmatian hood.
"..."
"That isn't a sea King!" A third declared as they too readied themselves.
Just before the fin reached them it disappeared under the calm surface, before an explosion of water splashed over all three of them as whatever had been approaching erupted out of it. And every eye focused on the source as they stood before them.
At first glance it appeared to be one of the fish-men, one with the heritage of a great white shark. But then they all watched as, like a Zoan Devil Fruit user, the fish-like features began to disappear to reveal a muscular figure, wild black hair, and a....monkey tail?
Though confused by the tail, none of the Vice Admirals were any less alert as they all recognized the man before them, even as a set of robes appeared to adorn his naked body.
"The Dragon Emperor!" The Dalmatian hooded man declared with hostility, already making the transition for his transformation to do battle.
"Everyone! Retreat within the prison!" Another Vice Admiral declared, directing his orders to the rest of the lower ranking Marines around them, as they'd all be useless against this foe.
"Alert Warden Magellan, and send word to the World Government!" The third declared.
"There's no need for that." Alex said as he casually strutted up to the trio of Vice Admirals. "I'm just here to handle some business, and then I'll be on my way. No need to worry yourselves about me."
"Are you kidding!?"
"We will stop you here and now, and then throw you into the deepest pit here at Impel Down!"
Two of them declared before rushing Alex suddenly.
"Haaa.... The hard way it is then..." Alex said as if it were unfortunate.
...
"EVERYBODY INSIDE!"
"DROP THE PORTCULLIS!"
"SEAL THE GATE!"
"DO NOT LET HIM IN HERE!"
Shouts echoed and hundreds of Marines and guards hurried too and fro as they tried to fortify Impel Down against the Dragon Emperor.
"Where is warden Magellan!?!"
"He's in the bathroom again!"
"Call the Vice Warden!"
Every defensive line was drawn, every Marine and guard armed, and all available forces throughout Impel Down were brought to the upper levels in order to fight. No one knew what the Dragon Emperor was actually capable of, but he commanded people who were able to take down several of the most powerful factions in the world with minimal forces.
They were NOT going to take any chances.
"What is the situation?" Magellan, a tall demon-looking man demanded as he finally emerged from the bathroom, holding his stomach as he did so due to it being upset after him eating poison for lunch again.
"Damn... And I thought this would be my chance to show off by defeating the Dragon Emperor while the useless Magellan was in the bathroom, and claim the seat of the Warden for myself!" Declared a man wearing a fox styled headdress reminiscent of an Egyptian Pharaoh.
"What was that?"
"Nothing!"
Despite the duo's banter they both prepared for battle, as both of their necks would be on the line if they were unable to stop a single intruder. Just as the last of the guards got into place though...
*BOOM!*
The entire fortress shuddered fro the force that hit the front gates, and dust rained down onto them from above.
*BOOM!*
The entire fortress shuddered again as numerous cracks spiderwebbed throughout the walls and ceiling.
*BOOM!*
*CRASH!*
This time the entire gate fell forward and crashed to the floor, startling all of the Marines and guards since the entire prison was made with seastone, which was supposed to be as hard as diamond.
And in through the wreckage walked a single person who looked around awkwardly, and said,
"Sorry. I only meant to knock on it 'gently'."
"FIRE!"
At Magellan's command, hundreds of guns and cannons that were being aimed at the entrance were fired all at once.
Hundreds of seastone bullets, dozens of iron cannonballs, and tens of seastone nets were all fired at the intruder, Alexander D. Morningstar, as he just casually stood there.
To the disbelief of everyone present though, the bullets and canons all just bounced harmlessly off of his skin. Thankfully however all of the Nets successfully managed to wrap around his body, entangling his limbs and trapping him.
"Now! While he's unable to move!" Cried one of the Marines, raising his sword up high as he rushed the trapped Dragon Emperor, along with over a hundred fellow Marines.
"Everyone remain on your guard!" Magellan ordered without moving, not daring to risk showing an opening against such an opponent, even if it appeared like he was already defeated.
"Good call man. This guy is REALLY tricky after all."
"I am not 'man', I am WARDEN to you." Magellan stated firmly.
"Eh... Debatable when I'm done with you." The voice from before said, making Magellan look to him irritably before whatever he was going to say died in his throat.
Leaning against one of the walls casually, munching on a carrot and evidently NOT being skewered by a hundred or swords while trapped in a bunch of nets, was the Dragon Emperor.
"Eh, what's up doc?" He asked playfully to the prison Warden.
...
"🎶🎶🎶"
A lighthearted tone echoed throughout the now quiet halls of the prison as a certain figure sauntered down them, whistling while swirling a ring of keys around his finger as he did so.
"Well, I'd say that was productive. You think so you two?" Alex asked the two following him as he finished his whistling. Both were naked women, tied up in turtle shell bondage style, with ball gags in their mouths.
They were the former vice head jailer and head guard, Domino and Sadi, who Alex decided to take as his sex slaves under Akeno after they both tried to whip him into submission. And while one would think they were being forced against their wills, Alex knew otherwise when he'd seen how wet the ropes wedging into their crotches were after he tied them up, and whipped THEM into submission.
That's what they got for trying to subdue the 'Super Sadist'.
As for why he considered his infiltration of Impel Down productive, it was because he'd harvested numerous Devil Fruits from Magellan and the rest of the Marines and guards present after he'd defeated all of them. The former of which possessed the Doku Doku no MI, making him a poison human that was able to create and control all types of poison, while also rendering him immune to them.
Surprisingly, thanks to Magellan, Alex's own 'Poison Resistance' skill went up by a level when he fought the Warden, before removing the Devil Fruit from his body.
But that one was just the most powerful amongst the numerous Devil Fruits Alex had obtained from the Marines, before sending them all to Mary Geoise to prepare for his attack. Now, Alex planned to make his way through the numerous levels of Impel Down to obtain any that the prisoners here had, before either killing them all or releasing some of them. It would depend on his mood.
The first notable person Alex discovered was none other than Buggy the Clown, a recurring antagonist/gag character throughout the One Piece series with the power to separate his body into numerous sections. And from what Alex recalled, he would escape Impel Down alongside Luffy in the original timeline and go on to become one of the Warlords due to his reputation increasing so much.
Since he hadn't done anything to warrant killing him though, Alex settled for stripping him of his Devil Fruit and letting him out of his cell to escape Impel Down.
Alex then continued on his way collecting more Devil Fruits from the prisoners until he made his way down to the second level, the Beast Hell. There he encountered another former antagonist, Number 3 from the Alabasta arc.
Alex then repeated his earlier actions of collecting his Devil Fruit, which had turned him into a candle man, before sending him up to join Buggy if he so wished.
It was only when he reached level three, the Starving Hell, that Alex encountered someone he more than considered capable of redemption.
"Hey hey~! Who are you~!?" A man asked who was wearing heavy makeup and performing ballet despite being severely starved and the sweltering heat coming up from the floor below.
"Nice to meet you Bon Clay. My name is Alex, and I'm a friend of Luffy." Alex said as he introduced himself to the man, a former ally of Number 3 from the Alabasta arc, who turned into an ally of the Straw Hats after Sanji said they MIGHT have been able to be friends.
But not only that. Bon Clay went above and beyond what any friend, especially one who was just made, would be asked as he and his entire crew disguised themselves as the Straw Hat Pirates in order to let Luffy and the others escape the Marines swarming them at the time. Then, when Luffy infiltrated Impel Down in the original timeline, Bon Clay became his greatest ally by risking his life for Luffy's time and again, before sacrificing himself once more in order to ensure the Gates of Justice would open and they could escape.
His Devil Fruit also allowed him to take the physical body of anyone he had touched with his hand, making him one of the best infiltrators in the world. But Alex had no intention of taking it from him.
"You're a friend of Straw-Chan!?!" Bon Clay exclaimed the moment Alex told him that, before spinning excitedly on his toes.
"Yep~" Alex said while popping the p, before adding, "I have an offer for you though."
"Oh~? And what do YOU want to offer ME~?" Bon Clay asked in his dramatic voice, continuing to spin on his toes as he did so.
"How about escape from this prison, and a chance to join the Straw Hat Pirates?" Alex asked him.
"!!!"
"Really!?!?" He asked as he stopped spinning in surprise.
"Of course. I can't make any promises on their behalf, but I think they wouldn't mind letting you join them after you sacrificed yourself for them before." Alex told him sincerely, which made Bon Clay's face light up at the idea.
But then his expression darkened as he stated, "thank you! But I must refuse for the moment since there is someone within the prison I intend to free!"
"The revolutionary, Emperio Ivankov. Right?" Alex asked him.
"That is RIGHT~!" Bon Clay declared as he began to spin once more.
"Well I'm planning to free him as well anyways, so you can come along if you want." Alex said, making him even more excited as he agreed.
With Bon Clay joining Alex along with his two newest sex slaves, he went around collecting even more Devil Fruits from this level before going down to the fourth level, the Blazing Hell.
Alex had no problem with this particular level, as he could even swim in magma and meditate within the heard of a star without issue, but he did create a cooling barrier around Bon Clay, Sadi, and Domino.
He then repeated his earlier actions of collecting Devil Fruits, with the most notable one he collected being the Supa Supa no Mi, which would turn the eater into a blade human, before journeying down to the fifth level, the Freezing Hell.
Doing the same thing as on the previous levels, Alex then went somewhere else entirely before heading down to the sixth level, level 5.5, Newkama land.
It was a secret level between five and six where many prisoners had disappeared to from level five, and was ran by none other than the person Bon Clay wanted to meet, Emperio Ivankov.
"Oho~! So you ave made your way ere, Dragon-boy!" Ivankov declared as Alex stepped into Newkama land.
Ivankov was a massive man who's head took up more than half his size, dressed in drag with a massive purple Afro and copious amounts of makeup applied to his face.
"Yo, I'm here to send you back to the Revolutionaries." Alex said to him, making the overly large man blink his exaggeratedly large eyelashes in surprise.
"Really? You are not going to strip me of my power like all the others?" Ivankov asked curiously, as they had watched Alex make his way down there through their own surveillance network.
"Nah, I don't have a reason to. But, I figure there's a good chance that the Revolutionaries would make an appearance when I slaughter the Celestial Dragons in a few days, so they'd want all of their comrades present as well." Alex said casually.
*CRASH!*
Ivankov jumped when he heard Alex casually mention slaughtering the Celestial Dragons, smashing a hole in the ceiling above them with his head as he did so, before pulling himself out of it as he declared dramatically,
"Y-y-y-you really mean to!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!"
"Yep~!" Alex said while popping the p again, making the overly large man gape at him in disbelief.
"Oh yeah! I've also got some people to introduce you to afterwards as well. Their not 'Okama' per say, but they are men who dream of becoming magical maidens that fight in the name of peace, love, friendship, and Justice." Alex added, while inwardly shuddering at what might happen when he introduced these two groups.
"I vill look forward to it! But for now ve should depart, to make it in time for the coming battle!" Ivankov declared, ordering every one of his followers to prepare for departure.
"I'll handle that. But while you guys are getting ready I'll go and deal with the prisoners on level six, and then I can send you directly to Dragon." Alex told him.
"Oh? You know vhere Dragon is?" Ivankov asked curiously.
"No, not exactly. But you'll see how when you leave." Alex said before turning to leave. He then paused momentarily though to add, "I'll also send you to the Straw Hats at the same time Bon Clay."
"THANK YOU!" He cried while spinning, before turning to both his hero and idol, Ivankov.
Alex then made his way down to the lowest level of Impel Down, the Eternal Hell. And once there he did something quite different than what he'd done on the other levels.
He still collected all of the Devil Fruits that had been eaten by the prisoners, which included the Suna Suna no Mi that had been eaten by Crocodile, but afterwards Alex removed his Death Scythe from its dimensional storage.
"..."
The scythe hummed from being held in his hand, eager to reap the lives of those around them. And Alex did just that.
Level six was comprised of the most powerful, heinous, and dangerous criminals in the world today, so Alex had no problem reaping their souls to add to his army that was stored within the jewel in his scythe.
Once he had finished with that, Alex proceeded to punch a small hole through one of the walls so that water could flood into the prison from outside, slowly filling it to render the entire complex unusable.
It would also drown all of those within the prison, but Alex didn't care. He had personally confirmed that none of those he had seen here, outside of the few he'd released aside from Buggy and Number 3, were worthy of salvation.
If they were released upon the world, they would only cause as much mayhem and carnage as possible.
With the water level rising, Alex returned to level 5.5 where the Okama had finished their preparations to leave.
"Now then! Shall ve journey upwards~?!" Ivankov declared as Alex returned.
"Not necessary." Alex said as he retrieved the magic compass and skeleton key, using the former to locate the secret base of the Revolutionary Army, and the latter to open a portal to it.
"Vat in the world!?!" Ivankov exclaimed in shock at the portal.
"Go through here, and it'll take you straight to Dragon." Alex explained to him, surprising the Okama even more.
"Very vell, I vill take you word for it!" Declaring such, Ivankov was the first to step through the portal before all of his followers followed suit, leaving Alex alone with Bon Clay and his two sex slaves.
When the last of the Okama had departed, Alex closed the portal before opening another one that led directly into the space-time orb Luffy was training with Zoro, Chopper, and Usopp inside of.
"This portal will take you to Luffy and the others. The entire crew isn't there right now, but they're all training so that they can take on the strong people of the New World." Alex explained to him.
"Thank you soooooooo much~! I will never forget this~!" Bon Clay declared as he too went through the portal, leaving Alex alone with Sadi and Domino.
As for them, well Alex couldn't really take them with him to his next destination. So he sent them directly to Akeno to begin their training.
With that done, and the water level continuously rising within Impel Down, Alex made his way back to the surface before transforming into a shark once more and taking off.
He had one more stop before heading to Fishman Island, but thankfully that stop was directly above it, and was the place that all of those who were journeying to the New World needed to stop at on the way. The Sabaody Archipelago.
The Archipelago was a grove of massive mangrove trees that grew directly beneath Mary Geoise, which was situated on the Red Line. It was exactly the halfway point for anyone traversing the Grand Line.
And upon arriving there, Alex was surprised to learn that the rest of the eleven Super Rookies aside from Luffy and Zoro were present.
The eleven Super Rookies were all rookie pirates that had accumulated bounties over a hundred million, though several would have a few times that by this point. Luffy and Zoro would also be counted amongst their number, if Alex hadn't interfered in their battle with Cp9.
Amongst them there was only one or two that Alex was actually interested in meeting with, like Law. Other than him though, the one Alex was most curious about was the only girl amongst the group(not for the typical reasons), Jewelry Bonney.
Though he couldn't recall the details, Alex did know she had a relationship with Bartholomew Kuma, and the upper ranks of the Marines were interested in her for some reason.
Figuring he'd see if there was anything interesting to know about her, which there undoubtedly was knowing this world, Alex decided to have a little chat with Bonney before he went to Fishman island. Instead of going to her directly though, he decided to try a different approach.
One he arrived at the archipelago, Alex quickly made himself comfortable atop the branch of one of the massive mangroves. Once there, he produced one of his fishing poles alongside a chunk of what people would commonly refer to a 'manga meat'.
This wasn't just any manga meat though, it was specially prepared by Mikan and Haruna, and gave off an aroma that Alex himself almost couldn't resist.
Steeling himself against the alluring smell of the roasted meat, Alex tied the end of his fishing line on the bone in it before casting it further into the grove as bait.
For a moment nothing happened, as the line sat still. But then, Alex felt a jerk on it before something pulled on the line hard enough that his pole bent, and the line started getting dragged out at high speed.
"Woah there!" He exclaimed while grabbing the reel, and trying to bring whatever he had 'hooked' in.
Then began a battle between Alex and his catch as he tried to reel in his quarry without snapping the line or breaking the pole. And surprisingly, despite them being reeled in, whatever he had hooked didn't let go of the bait.
The minutes slowly ticked by, and then finally Alex caught a glimpse of his quarry as a flash of pink hair appeared. He then hurried reeling it in, before he held his line up to see a beautiful and bodacious woman who appeared to be in her early twenties dangling from the line, even as she growled like a dog.
"Jewelry Bonney I presume." Alex asked as he set her on the branch in front of him.
"Who's asking?" She growled while taking another gluttonous bite of the meat as if she were starving.
"The Dragon Emperor, Alexander D. Morningstar." Alex replied, making her pause slightly.
"Really?" She asked while narrowing her eyes suspiciously.
"Really."
"I thought your hair was white and stuff." She pointed out, referring to his wanted poster since they used the image of when he had transformed.
"It was at the time they took the picture. But that's the appearance I get when I use the awakened formed of my Devil Fruit, the Hito Hito no Mi- model Nika."
"!!!"
The moment she heard that Bonney's entire demeanor changed as she looked at Alex incredulously.
"You're Nika!?!"
"???"
"Yeah? I dint expect anyone else in the world to know that though, since the World Government has been trying to keep that information hidden for eight hundred years." Alex said, confused on how Bonney would know about Nika.
"Well of course I know about Nika! My dad told me all about him!" Bonney exclaimed, even as she looked Alex up and down, her eyes shining like he was some kind of idol.
"Really?"
"Yeah! He told me about how Nika dances and brings smiles to everyone around him as he sets them free from oppression! That was you too right!?! The one who set all of the slaves free the other day!"
"Well... The only ones I actively had freed were the slaves of Mary Geoise. The rest just made use of the opening I created with my Haki." Alex explained, but then Bonney surprised him as she grabbed the robes he had donned upon his arrival desperately, and pleaded,
"Pease, save my father!"

chapters.title: Chapter 547 - 547: Jewelry Bonney
chapters.content:
Bartholomew Kuma. The 'Tyrant'.
He was a 'character' of great interest and mystery within the world of One Piece since his first major introduction.
After the Straw Hat crew defeated the Warlord Gecko Moria, he appeared before them with the intention of taking Luffy's head to the World Government. With his great strength and the power of his Nikyu Nikyu no Mi he managed to defeat them almost effortlessly, only to be dissuaded from taking Luffy's head from Zoro offering his own in his place.
Though Zoro barely managed to survive from the deal he'd struck with Kuma at that moment, they encountered him again soon after that instance at the Sabaody Archipelago. At that time the Straw Hats were on the verge of destruction after Luffy punched one of the Celestial Dragons, and brought the might of a Marine Admiral down onto them, along with the might of the Pacifista cyborg units that had been based off of Kuma.
Using the power of his Devil Fruit, Kuma seemingly decimated the Straw Hat pirates by sending them all to the four corners of the world, separating them from one another for the next two years. The last to be sent off was Luffy, who Kuma told they would never meet again.
After that he reappeared at the battle between Whitebeard and the Marines over Ace's life, but he showed no sign of life or self any longer after having his entire body turned into that of a cyborg, including his mind. And as nothing more than a mindless puppet of the World Government, he began to ruthlessly attack even his own comrade from the Revolutionaries, Ivankov.
Two years later he appeared again, when the Straw Hats reunited and Franky returned to their ship, the Thousand Sunny. Franky then discovered Kuma guarding their ship, full of wounds and barely seemingly to function after two years of doing so.
The last Alex recalled of Kuma, he'd been turned into a shared slave by the Celestial Dragons, where they'd take turns owning and abusing him day after day.
Bonney however, painted a very different image of the Warlord.
Apparently he had raised her from infancy within a church on an island that housed the Sorbet kingdom, but due to a sickness she possessed called Sapphire Scales, she had never been able to leave the confines of the church for the majority of her life. The disease had also claimed the life of Bonney's mother, in which direct exposure to sunlight and moonlight would cause sapphire-like scales to form on her skin.
And while Kuma had seemingly been completely robotic and emotionless in every one of his appearances in One Piece, he was apparently the exact opposite to Bonney growing up. He would often laugh, sing and dance to cheer her up when she was down because of her disease, and would bring her books to discuss various places that she'd like to visit once she was cured.
He would even refer to the scale she had developed on her face as 'jewels', which she stated was where she got the inspiration to call herself 'Jewelry' Bonney.
Then, after she had somehow eaten the Toshi Toshi no Mi, he took her to the island of Egghead to meet with the mad scientist Vegapunk, who managed to somehow cure her disease.
What Bonney was asking for Alex's help for was that, if something wasn't done, things would develop just like they did in the original timeline. Kuma was already undergoing numerous procedures to become a cyborg, and if they weren't stopped soon he'd just become a mindless puppet again.
"Don't worry Bonney. I won't let that happen to your father if I can help it. And if I'm too late for whatever reason, then I promise to reverse whatever it is they do to him." Alex promised once she was done telling her story.
"Really!? You will!?" She exclaimed excitedly.
"Of course." He readily stated.
Alex already knew that there had to be more to Kuma's background than what was portrayed of him as 'The Tyrant'. And he knew to take anything the World Government said with a grain of salt.
"Perhaps we aught to continue this conversation elsewhere." Alex suddenly said, surprising Bonney.
"Why?" She asked curiously.
*KABOOM!*
A explosion of light suddenly destroyed the branch the two of them were sitting on, sending them both plummeting through the air to the ground below. Alex was calm as he fell, but Bonney was screaming as she clung to him tightly, smothering his face in her breasts unintentionally.
And when the two of them hit the ground, it gave way and stretched beneath them harmlessly before bouncing them back up into the air. They bounced a few more times up and down before coming to a stop, at which point Alex lightly patted Bonney's butt to get her attention.
"Huh?" She uttered when she realized they were no longer falling, before pulling away from Alex hesitantly.
"Not that I'll complain, but you can let go of me now if you want." He said while giving her butt a light squeeze.
"Pervert!" Bonney exclaimed with a red face as she let go of him and stood on her own.
"What was that?" She asked while looking around for whatever it was that had caused the branch to be destroyed.
"I'm guessing it was one of those." Alex said casually as he pointed out no less than twenty identical figures surrounding them, accompanied by a man who's appearance was not unlike that of a sumo wrestler, with a massive battle axe slung over his shoulder.
"Dad!?!" Bonney exclaimed when she saw them, all hulking men that stood over twenty feet tall.
"No. They just look like him." Alex stated as he focused on the odd man out of the group.
"Dragon Emperor! I am Sentomaru, Captain of the Marines science unit, and the most tight-lipped man in the world! We have come to investigate after one of the Pacifista units detected your arrival, and will now take your head!" The sumo wrestler looking man declared as he pointed at Alex with his battle axe dramatically.
"Oh? And how exactly do you plan to do that?" Alex asked with a smirk.
"Simple! PX-7!" Declaring such, one of the Pacifista units suddenly rushed Alex with its hands raised, light gathering in its palms. The same light powers used by the Admiral Kizaru.
"Now this is just insulting." Alex uttered as the solitary unit attacked him.
Just as he stepped forward to deal with it though...
"Please don't!" Bonney cried as she grabbed his arm. She couldn't actually hold him back, but Alex still stopped and looked back at her curiously.
"And why not?" He asked without any worry, even as a powerful blast of light was fired at him, which Alex casually swatted away with a backhand.
"Because-"
*KABOOM!*
"-that's my dad!" She declared with teary eyes.
"No it's not." Alex stated as he grasped the Pacifista with his telekinetic powers, and ripped it apart to show her the circuitry underneath.
"It's a bastardization of your father created by the Marines to use as their own weapons. And merely seeing them should make you want to destroy them!" He declared harshly, making Bonney genuinely start crying.
"You-! PX 1-10, get him!" Sentomaru declared after seeing Alex casually destroy one of their units.
"FREEZE!" Alex commanded, his voice echoing throughout the entirety of the Sabaody Archipelago, and even reaching clear up to Mary Geoise above them. And every single person, Pacifista, beast, and even sea King that heard his decree froze, their hearts seizing within their chests as they began to sweat uncontrollably.
Sentomaru, as the one directly in front of Alex felt it the worst.
In a mere second he went from a prospective Marine who had cornered the greatest villain in the world, to a VERY small man before a mighty emperor. And Sentomaru knew right then, nothing he could do would make any difference. If Alex willed it, he'd die right then and there.
And suddenly Alex began to approach him, making his heart beat faster as his life began to flash before his eyes, believing his death to be approaching with every step Alex took closer to him.
And with every step Alex seemed to grow in size, until he stood right in front of Sentomaru and towered over his nine foot self.
"You will turn around." Alex then stated in a calm voice, yet a voice full of authority. "You will turn around, and return to Mary Geoise with all of your Pacifista. If not, then I WILL destroy you all. Do you understand?"
"Y-yes, your majesty..." Sentomaru uttered, not even noticing the slip of the tongue as he bowed his head both from awe and fear.
Without a second thought Alex turned and walked away from Sentomaru, not at all concerned about being attacked from behind. Instead, even the Pacifista had all turned to return to Mary Geoise at his command, despite Alex not at all being authorized to give them orders.
He himself returned to Bonney, who was staring at him dumbstruck from the display, until Alex suddenly threw her over his shoulder.
"Wait! What are you doing!?!" She demanded almost fearfully as Alex began walking towards the edge of the archipelago, to the ocean. If he threw her in or something, then she'd drown.
"I'm going to Fishman Island, and I'm going to take you with me since we still need to talk." Alex stated as he playfully slapped her ass without a care.
"WAIT A SECOND!" Bonney tried to protest, before Alex leapt into the water with her suddenly.
What he hadn't been expecting was for her to suddenly slip from his grasp as her entire figure shrunk suddenly, combined with her struggling to avoid getting in the water.
Before Bonney could drift too far from him though, Alex stretched his arm towards her and grabbed her by the waistband of her booty shorts, that were now too big for her smaller figure. Thankfully she was wearing suspenders though, which caught on her shoulders to avoid the usual scenario where Alex would accidentally strip her of her shorts and panties without meaning to.
But he was still curious about her sudden change in size, and hurried down to Fishman island so he could properly ask her about it.
Normally he'd just teleport in this situation instead of going through the trouble to bringing Bonney with him, since he had to protect her from the intense pressure and help her to breath the entire way down, but Alex wanted to make sure things leading to Fishman island were ok.
The two things he was checking for were signs of Hody Jones and Vander Decken around Fishman island, the former of which killed the former queen and would be planning to take over the island before waging a war with the surface, and the latter of which was a Fishman pirate that was obsessed with Shirahoshi.
Both of them should already be taken care of to an extent, as Alex gave Shirahoshi a pendant to return one of Vander Decken's weapons to him, while she also revealed the truth regarding Hody to her father after some encouragement from Alex. But it was better to be safe than sorry.
And when he located no sign of either, Alex immediately headed to the giant bubble that encased Fishman island.
The interior of the bubble though looked like a massive coral reef that had been turned into a city, while there was also a section outside of the bubble that housed a massive ship known as Noah. This was the Fishman district, a lawless region where Alex recalled Hody and his group based their plans from.
Alex ignored Noah for the moment though as he headed straight for the bubble, and emerged from the ocean with an sputtering and irritable Bonney on his shoulder.
"YOU BASTARD!" She screamed the moment Alex set her down, while she was trying to keep her soaking and oversized clothes from slipping off of her.
"What? I said we were going to Fishman island." Alex said as he looked around.
"What about my ship and crew!?!"
"I can send you back when we're done. But by the way, why did you shrink yourself when I jumped in the water?" Alex asked her curiously.
He knew Bonney had the power to influence the age of those round her, as well as herself. The first time it showed her using this power was when she took the form of a little girl when she prevented Zoro from killing a Celestial Dragon, and cried about her 'big brother' dying from his gun.
But she had also used the same ability to turn a group of Marines into both children and old men when they tried to capture her.
"Humph! I didn't use my powers! YOU canceled them out when you jumped into the ocean with me! By the way, how can you swim?! You said you ate a Devil Fruit too!"
Bonney then started going on about Alex not making any sense, but he didn't hear any of it as he realized what Bonney was saying.
She hadn't used her powers, the ocean CANCELED them when he'd jumped in. That meant she'd been using them when they met, and the Bonney before him was the real Bonney. A little girl who looked no older than ten years old, that he'd been fondling and groping before.
*DONK!*
"OW! WHAT'D YOU DO THAT FOR!?!" She screamed when Alex knocked her on the head.
"YOU DESERVE THAT YOU PIECE OF JAILBAIT! ARE YOU TRYING TO GET ME ARRESTED OR SOMETHING!?" Alex screamed back at her, stunning Bonney as she wondered what he was talking about.
The duo continued arguing for several minutes about the use of her powers, during which Alex told her to stop using her powers to look older, and she called him a perverted old man even as he also used magic to make her clothes fit properly.
"Excuse me!" A self important voice said to the side.
""What!?!"" The two of them asked irritably at being interrupted, only to see a few dozen spears made of shells pointed at them.
"Who are you, and why have you entered our kingdom illegally?" The man from before asked, who was actually a merman now that Alex and Bonney got a good look at him.
"My name is Alexander D. Morningstar, and I didn't know where the official checkpoint was." Alex stated truthfully.
"""!!!"""
"The same Alex that the Princess Shirahoshi speaks so fondly of!?!" The man exclaimed in shock.
"I didn't know she spoke of me, but yeah. Probably."
"Report to the castle immediately!" The merman declared to one of his subordinates, before saying to Alex, "I'm sorry, but I'll have to keep you here until the princess can verify your identity."
"Alright, I'll wait." Alex said while conjuring himself a comfortable chair to sit on, making everyone look at him weirdly.
"Hey old man, where's my chair?" Bonney asked him irritably.
"There's plenty of rocks laying around, jailbait."
"Stupid old pervert!" She cried while kicking one of his legs.
"Do that again, and I bend you over my knee and tan your ass in front of all these people." Alex said without looking at her.
"Do that and I'll tell people you kidnapped me!" She declared while sticking her tongue out at him.
Rather than respond, Alex decided to shut her up by giving her mouth something else to do. So he conjured one of Mikan and Haruna's lunch boxes.
"!!!"
His plan worked as Bonney immediately began to eagerly scarf down the food, living up to her epithet as the 'Big Eater'.
The minutes passed as Alex lounged on his chair, and Bonney ate. And when she'd finished one lunchbox, he'd conjure another for her to keep her busy.
"Mr. Alex-Sama!" A shrill voice eventually cried out, drawing their attention to a massive and beautiful mermaid with light pink hair. Surrounding her was not only the royal procession that was composed of her father and brothers, but also a large shark, a Milotic, Gyarados, Sharpedo, and a Seadra.
"Shirahoshi-" Alex began as she approached him, only for him to suddenly be tackled.
"I'm so happy to meet you!" She cried while literally smothering him in between her MASSIVE breasts excitedly. Hard to believe she was still so young herself...

chapters.title: Chapter 548 - 548: Sailing to War
chapters.content:
*SLAM!*
"Just what is wrong with the world!?!" Fleet Admiral Sengoku demanded as he slammed his hands on the table in frustration, due to the numerous reports he'd been receiving all day long.
One hundred and seventy nations made up the World Government, all hailing from North Blue, South Blue, East Blue, West Blue, Paradise, and the New World. But no matter the region they were from, reports were pouring in that chilled Sengoku's heart.
Eighty of these nations had defected from the World Government, while another fifty were in open rebellion against the monarchies that wouldn't defect. The remaining kingdoms were silent so far, but it would only be a matter of time before they too followed the trend.
"That is the plague that is 'freedom'." One of the Five Elders suddenly said, making Sengoku look up at them in alarm. He held back anything he might've said though, as he did not want to offend the Elders with his insolence.
"BWAHAHAHAHAHAHA!"
Meanwhile a certain someone else was laughing his ass off as he happily crunched on his snacks.
"You find this amusing, Garp?" One of the Elders asked in an unamused tone.
"Disregarding your obvious disdain for the gods of this world..." Another Elder spat at him, "even YOU should be worried about the upheaval the Dragon Emperor is causing right now. It puts even your son to shame!"
Referring to Dragon of the Revolutionaries, Garp sobered up a little bit, but he still had a shit-eating grin on his face.
"Yeah? What I care about is justice and the people, and as far as I can tell he's only gone out of his way to help them." Garp answered truthfully.
He may be a Marine, but he didn't give a shit about the Celestial Dragons. It was the only reason he hadn't advanced any further in the Marines from the position of Vice Admiral, because then he'd become a direct subordinate of them.
"Don't tell me you're turning traitor!?" One of the Elders growled angrily, before massive amounts of Haki began to pour off of their body.
Garp however just shrugged it off, and said back at them with a smirk, "of course not. I just find this all amusing! Personally, I can't wait for the chance to cross fists with that brat myself!"
As he said that Garp recalled the most recent report they'd gotten, along with all of the Marines that had been sent to them from the notorious prison, Impel Down. That was the real reason why the Elders were so tense right now, as word had reached them that another pillar of the World Government had fallen, completely. They wouldn't even know how extensive the damages were until they could send someone to check up on the prison.
But that hadn't been the most concerning report.
The first thing Magellan had reported to them after the fall of Impel Down, was that the Dragon Emperor had the ability to remove a person's Devil Fruits powers.
The Elders quickly placed a gag on that information to shut it up, as the last thing they wanted was for their ability users to flee for fear of losing their prided abilities. Garp of course couldn't care less, since he didn't believe in Devil Fruits to begin with. All a man needed was his Haki!
*Knock Knock Knock*
A knock at the door drew all of their attention as one of the Elders answered, "enter."
The door opened to reveal Rob Lucci, the de facto leader of CP9 since Spandam was missing in action after meeting with Alex. One of the only real Marine casualties, though secretly no one actually considered him a Marine.
"Sirs! I have a report from the undercover agent, Kalifa." He declared.
"""!!!"""
"Tell us then!" One of the Elders ordered, eager to finally get the upper hand against the Dragon Emperor for once.
"According to her report, both Big Mom and the Pirate Empress have joined forces with the Dragon Emperor!" Lucci declared, stunning everyone present.
"Is that all?" One of the Elder nearly spat, before dismissing Lucci when he nodded in affirmation.
As the door closed another spat, "at every turn its like he's mocking us! Just when we thought two of the Four Emperors were gone, he goes and recruits one of them!"
"AND he somehow got the Pirate Empress on his side. I just want to know how he did so..." Another stated.
"It doesn't matter HOW he did it. But it's done. Boa Hancock has decided to bite the hand that fed her."
"Indeed. I believe it's time we reminded her of her place, if she doesn't want to serve as a Warlord any longer."
"Her place?" Garp asked curiously.
"Indeed. Her place as property of the Celestial Dragons."
""!!""
Needless to say both Garp and Sengoku were surprised, as neither of them could imagine that haughty and beautiful woman as a slave. But one of the Elders slipped them a sheet of paper, and explained,
"This is a registry of escaped slaves from the Fisher Tiger incident. On it you'll find the names Boa Hancock, Boa Marigold, and Boa Sandersonia."
"When Hancock resurfaced as the empress of the Kuja Pirates, we decided to let her retain her freedom if she accepted a position amongst the Seven Warlords. Either way, she would serve the interests of the World Government."
"But now that she's turned traitor, it's time to make her remember that she is merely our possession."
"Indeed. Send word to Vice Admiral Momonga that he is no longer summoning Hancock to participate in the coming battle. He is instead to apprehend her, and the entire population of Amazon Lily to deliver to the Celestial Dragons."
"Good idea. That might get them to stop crying about all of their slaves being freed."
Sengoku's brow twitched as the Elders began discussing their next step, scarcely daring to believe they were now expected to enslave an entire race after their empress turned traitor. Garp meanwhile just flat out left the room, no longer having the stomach to stick around. They made his food taste bad.
Just as he was about to pick up the receiver on his transponder snail to call Momonga though...
*BANG!*
The door was thrown open as a Marine rushed through, his chest heaving as he hurried to Sengoku.
"SIR!"
"What is it Marine?" He asked irritably.
"Marineford has been sacked!"
***
*Shortly after Alex left Amazon Lily*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
War drums thundered as any remaining Marines in Marineford poured out of the fortress to get a good look at the approaching ships.
Normally only Navy ships would be able to approach the crescent-moon shaped island, but an exception was being made this time for one of the Warlords. Especially when they needed all of the help they could get for the coming war.
But the reason so many Marines were hurrying to see THESE ships, to the point that they were flooding the docks that the ships were headed to, was because they were the much rumored crew of only women, the Kuja Pirates.
"Let me see!"
"No way!"
"Get your own telescope!"
"ORDER! YOU ARE MARINES!"
Arguments could be heard as numerous Marines used telescopes to get the first look at the Kuja Pirates and the famous Pirate Empress, all while the few Vice Admirals present tried to restore order.
"They do realize she's a pirate, right?" Growled one man with numerous lit cigars in his mouth.
"I don't think they care at the moment sir... But then again, I've heard the Pirate Empress is beautiful enough to sway even women..." Answered the woman next to him, as she tightened the grip on her sword.
"Anything you want to get off your chest Tashigi?"
"No sir, Commodore Smoker!" The woman, Tashigi declared as she saluted, making the man, Smoker, smirk before glancing back to the approaching ships worriedly.
"Still.... Vice Admiral Momonga was sent to recruit her for the battle against the Dragon Emperor, yet she's here already with all of her forces, and no Momonga in sight... Something stinks..." He muttered to himself as his eyes scanned the three ships as they prepared to dock.
At the head was their largest ship with Hancock at the head, while the other two appeared smaller with her sisters commanding them. All the while numerous Kuja could be seen pounding war drums as they pulled in towards the docks.
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
*DUM DUT DA DA🎶!*
The men below however were all fixated with catching a glimpse of the elusive Pirate Empress, the most beautiful woman in the world.
But she wasn't all they wanted to see.
Every single one of the hundreds of women aboard the three ships was incredibly beautiful, and several of them even had their breasts exposed for all to see. But three out of four men still had their eyes glued to the Pirate Empress as the ship finally came to a stop, and she stepped forward.
"I hear that the Marines are calling for the aide of the Seven Warlords against the Dragon Emperor." She declared with a haughty voice.
"Indeed, that is the case. But where is Vice Admiral Momonga? He was supposed to contact and retrieve you." Boomed a massive Marine in a custom cloak, John Giant.
"We must have missed one another. But I am here now."
"I see..." John Giant said slowly as he narrowed his eyes at her. She may be one of the Warlords, but he still didn't trust her. She WAS a pirate after all.
"Is that a problem?" Hancock asked while cocking her head, a small smile gracing her lips that captured the hearts of every single man and woman present.
In an instant every single heart was captured by her. Men and women, they all wanted her. They desired her. They NEEDED her.
"N-no.... Not at all...." John Giant said in response, with even his cheeks reddening slightly in the face of her beauty.
"Love-Love Beam~!"
Hancock's voice echoed throughout the plaza of Marineford as she brought her hands together in the shape of a heart, which then created numerous heart-shaped beams that enveloped the crowds before her. And every single Marine, including even John Giant, was instantly turned to stone.
"HANCOK!" Smoker yelled as he rushed forward to combat her, while Tashigi went to rally whatever Marines were left to fight.
"KUJA PIRATES, ATTACK! RAZE THIS ENTIRE ABOMINABLE ISLAND TO THE GROUND!"
"""YES EMPRESS!"""
With a cry of affirmation, hundreds of women flooded out from the Kuja ships at their empress' order, their bows cocked before they prepared to do battle.
"Marines, battle formations!" Another Vice Admiral cried, trying to rally what forces were left after most of their men were turned to stone.
Thankfully Marineford was designed specifically to entrap any pirate stupid enough to sail right up to their doorstep. Elevated walls encircled their docks, all of which were armed with hundreds of cannons.
"""FIRE!"""
*BOOM!*
Cannon fire rang out and smoke filled the air as balls of metal hurtled towards the Kuja fleet, though not all of them were fired due to their lack of personnel.
"Slave Arrow~!" Hancock cried as she blew out a massive heart-shaped balloon, before pulling back on it to release hundreds of pink heart-shaped arrows.
Using the move in rapid succession, Hancock fired arrows in every direction that turned the cannonballs to stone, and halted their movement in midair. Not only that, the arrows that didn't hit the cannonballs continued on until they hit the cannons themselves.
Meanwhile all of the remaining Marines had rallied and were trying to push back against the attackers.
"FIRE!" A Vice Admiral cried, before musket fire filled the air as they shot at the army of women.
"Like that'll work!" One of the Amazon's sneered as all of those at the fronts had their skin ripple, briefly flashing different shades of serpent scales, before all of the bullets bounced off of them.
"Wha-!?!"
"They're ability users!?!"
"Switch to the seastone bullets!" The same Vice Admiral cried bitterly, as the seastone bullets were hundreds of times more expensive to make compared to a regular bullet after all.
But as the next round of shots rang out, again the bullets were deflected by the armored serpent skin of the Amazons.
"What devilry is this!?!" One of the Marines cried, while even the Vice Admirals began to grow pale.
"Draw swords, and ATTAAAAACK!!!"
With the new command the Marines dropped their muskets and drew the blades they all carried, before charging into battle with the Amazons. If it could be called such.
With strength far surpassing what their slender frames would suggest, the Kuja Pirates effortlessly tore their way through the remaining ranks of the Marines armed with only bows, and their daggers.
The Marines became even more demoralized and disorganized when several of the Kuja began to transform after the two younger of the Gorgon Sisters entered the battle. All of them into serpents of some kind, and all of them growing even stronger after they transformed.
Hancock meanwhile was traveling through the battlefield leisurely after dealing with all of the cannons surrounding them, by turning them all to stone of course, riding on her own snake weapon, Salome.
"Pistol Kiss~!"
With her hands making a gun-like gesture, Hancock fired small hearts all over the battlefield as she rode about on Salome, turning all of those she hit into stone to join the other Marines.
"Hancock!" Roared a gruff voice as white smoke suddenly filled the area, before it condensed into the humanoid figure of Smoker.
"Man." Hancock sneered at him with disdain. To her all men were filth, with the sole exception of her beloved.
"Tell me Hancock..." Smoker began as he removed the seastone tipped jitte from his back and pointed it at her. "Why would YOU turn against the Navy and attack us?"
As his question echoed over the battlefield several Marines listened in, as they also wanted to know the reason behind this unprovoked attack against Justice.
"Hmmm..." Hancock hummed lightly at the question, tucking her hair back behind her ear in a cute gesture that made several of the remaining Marines blush, despite the ongoing battle.
"Because..." She began with a voice full of softness, a slight blush adorning HER cheeks now that made her even more beautiful, before she declared, "LOVE IS A HURRICANE!"
...
"Load it all up!" A woman cried as she directed several others who were boarding the Kuja Pirate ships, all carrying arm loads of all the food, supplies, materials, weapons, and anything they could loot from Marineford.
Meanwhile, mountains of treasure and money were being loaded onto Hancock's ship, all of which was either confiscated from pirates, or were a part of Marineford's vast finances.
Despite the vicious battle that had just taken place though, there were no bodies to be found anywhere. This was because Hancock turned them all into stone, and stored them within the spatial storage ring she had received from Alex until later.
Not everyone had been turned into stone and stored away though, as a line of a few dozen women stood shackled before the ships like products. Most notable amongst them were the Ensign Tashigi, and the Captain Hina, both of which had their own secret fan clubs amongst the Marines.
"Hina is disappointed with herself..." The captain groaned as she came to terms with not her own, but their loss as a whole.
"Don't worry Captain Hina, justice will always prevail!" Tashigi uttered next to her hopefully, until they saw several Kuja bringing the next group of statues to be stored away, with included the petrified Smoker.
"Ladies!"
All of them immediately directed their attention to the one before them as she barked at them, Hancock, as she lounged leisurely on Salome.
The serpent was slithering up and down the line of women, giving Hancock a chance to observe them all, including the giant woman at the end. And when she was done, Hancock nodded in approval as she declared,
"You all have a choice to make! To be turned to stone like your comrades, or to join us as members of the Kuja Pirates!"
"""!!!"""
Every single one of the captured women was shocked as the shackles were removed from them, which would allow them to attack Hancock if they so wished. But none moved to do so.
Every single one of the Kuja had displayed power far beyond what a normal human was capable of, power that apparently even rendered them immune to the usual weakness Devil Fruit users had.
"I will join!" One woman said as she stepped forward.
"So will I!" Declared another.
One by one they stepped forward and declared their willingness to accept Hancock's offer, even the giant woman, until it was only Tashigi and Hina that remained.
"How can they betray the Marines so easily!?!" Tashigi uttered under her breath in indignation.
"Hina will accept as well." Hina suddenly said, stunning Tashigi further.
"Captain Hina! How can you do that after what they did to Commodore Smoker!?!"
"Be quiet Ensign. This is not a situation that Hina can help. So, instead of dying here, it is better to join them and be able to fight at a later date." Hina declared, surprising Tashigi at the plan.
"But... We'd have to be pirates..."
"A necessary evil..." Hina answered, equally disgusted by the thought. But, if by going along with the Kuja, they were able to gain the upper hand, then it would be worth it.
Soon Tashigi noticed every eye on her as they awaited her decision, making her bite her lower lip in frustration before she choked out,
"I-I accept..."
"Very well!" Hancock declared, before nodding to the Kuja behind them.
Suddenly came the sound of the tearing of cloth as their clothes and uniforms were torn from their bodies. Shirts, bras, pants, panties, shoes, socks. Even any accessories they were wearing had to be moved until every single one of them were standing there completely naked.
Though it may seem like harassment from the outside, it actually wasn't.
This was an important ceremony for those who were to be inducted into the Kuja Pirates, as they were stripped of everything they had and were before. They would start their future as Kuja with nothing but their names, and what THEY gave them.
So, after forcing the women to stand there for a moment in the nude, Hancock snapped her fingers and several women appeared from the ship carrying several spare leather and fur garments in their hands for the new recruits.
Tashigi and the others were extremely grateful as they quickly donned the admittedly provocative clothing, though the giantess had to settle with a loincloth that was too small for her, while her breasts were exposed for all to see.
Nodding in approval as they finished dressing, with the rest of her people loading up into the ships, Hancock cried out,
"Kuja Pirates, let's return home!"
There was a cheer in response to her declaration, before all of their new recruits were ushered aboard their ships to begin their new lives. Despite being handed mops and buckets, or being assigned several menial chores, all of them couldn't help but to look back forlornly at Marineford as they sailed away from it.
"Fire!" Hancock ordered suddenly, and a single flaming arrow was loosed.
They all watched as it sailed impossibly far before landing somewhere within the island.
*KABOOM!*
*BOOM!*
*BOOM!*
*BOOM!*
Numerous explosions were set off, as what was likely to be ALL of the fuel and gunpowder on the island was ignited. Soon they all watched as the island was engulfed by flames, before they were in turn engulfed in fog that delivered them directly to Amazon Lily.
***
"And a toast, to the man responsible for liberating my daughter from the continuous assaults of Vander Decken, as well as helping to expose the truth of Hody Jones! Alexander D. Morningstar!" Declared King Neptune, as he raised his glass.
A great cheer sounded out as every official and noble on Fishman island toasted Alex, followed by the clanking of glasses before they all took a drink.
Alex as well drank from his glass, though it was a bit awkward for him to do so thanks to his current position, which was in Shirahoshi's lap. It was made more so since his head was right between her massive breasts, which were already exceptionally large for her age.
Next to them sat Bonney, who was still her actual age at the moment as she continuously scarfed down as much food as possible without a single care that they were in the presence of royalty.
Also at the feast was Shirahoshi's three brothers, Fukaboshi, Ryuboshi, and Manboshi, the former of which sat on Alex and Shirahoshi's other side as he tried to engage him in conversation.
Mostly Fukaboshi was telling Alex how he and his brothers had trained themselves for years to be powerful warriors in order to protect their little sister from Vander Decken. But, while they may be powerful compared to other merfolk, the three of them were still really weak in the grand scheme of things.
"I don't know much about the fighting styles of the merfolk, but there are numerous paths available to peruse strength in Asora if you wish."
"Asora... Shirahoshi told us of that place. A land where all walk freely under the sun, without fear of capture and enslavement... A place like that sounds too good to be true."
There was a forlorn look to Fukaboshi's face as he spoke, which told plenty about the mistreatment that Merfolk had suffered from for centuries.
Since they were not a part of the World Government, the Merfolk and Fishmen were considered lesser beings that were actively enslaved, hunted, and feared by most people. Despite this, all Merfolk and Fishmen longed for the surface and its wonders, which made things dangerous for their youth when they'd sneak up to the surface as children.
"It may sound too good to be true, but that doesn't mean it is." Alex told him before taking a bite of food. Unfortunately the Merfolk didn't eat meat...
"Asora is a world for those who either have no place in their own, or have no place to go themselves. The first residents we had belonged to three different races that had been locked in an endless war for several millennia, along with a fourth race that hadn't been involved in the war.
"The next group to move there were a people not too unlike yourselves, the Dagons. They are a seafaring people that were lumped into a much larger collection of people called the Demihumans, which were ostracized and enslaved by the other races, humans and demons.
"The Dagons weren't actively enslaved like the others, but that was only because they performed a valuable service to a human kingdom. If the circumstances were any different though, they would have been enslaved like the rest of the Demihumans.
"Now they, and all of those who have joined us since, live in Asora in peace. We've even got some other mermaids there as well."
Fukaboshi could only gape at Alex in awe of what he had just described, which his brothers and father had also been listening in on as well.
"Yep! Mr. Alex-Sama is an amazing person who helps a lot of people! I hear from his wives all the time of the good things he does! Even more, he's preparing to fight someone who tried to kill one of his friends!"
With Shirahoshi adding her two cents into the conversation, everyone else was giving Alex various looks as well since her words were more credible with him right there in front of them. Alex of course just wanted to sigh, since he despised being seen as anything resembling a 'hero'.
"Speaking of these 'wives' of yours..." King Neptune began after his daughter. "Do you intend to add Shirahoshi to their ranks?"
Now every eye on Alex had a different look as they awaited his answer, but he instantly replied, "of course, but only when she's old enough."
"""!!!"""
Needless to say everyone was shocked at his immediate answer, while King Neptune asked testily, "and what of my daughter's opinion on this?"
Looking to her for her answer, they were all surprised to Shirahoshi acting bashfully at the idea of her becoming Alex's wife. So much so, that he had to answer in her place.
"Shirahoshi's opinion is irrelevant. I intend to 'collect' her regardless once she is of age, and I will ensure she is happy for the rest of her life."
Again, shock filled everyone present at Alex's straightforward answer, while the king looked between him and his daughter repeatedly.
"I see... Rather tyrannical of you, wouldn't you say?" He said as an observation.
"Naturally. After all, I am NOT a benevolent or 'good' person. I am a tyrannical despot that needlessly conquers all that he can, plunders every source of wealth within reach, and adds every little flower that catches his eye to his collection of wives."
"..."
"..."
"..."
Once he finished speaking, Alex entered a stare-off with Neptune as the king tried to divulge the truth behind his declaration.
He knew what a despot looked like, they had nursed a Celestial Dragon back to health when he was on the verge of death after all. But Alex did not strike him as the same type of man.
The more Neptune studied Alex, the more he was convinced that he wasn't such a person. He may not be the 'ideal' ruler, but none could ever truly claim such a things. As a king himself, Neptune could honestly say that anyone who thought they ruled perfectly was instead a failure.
*BANG!*
"King Neptune! I have some urgent business to discuss with you!" Declared the new arrival, a human man with green hair that was tied back into a long ponytail, and sharp features.
His sharp eyes scanned the dining hall instinctively upon entering the room, before they focused on a single person in particular. Alex.
"YOU!" The man exclaimed in shock, before his body began to grow as green scales formed along his skin.

chapters.title: Chapter 549 - 549: The Green Dragon vs the Dragon Emperor
chapters.content:
"So who's that?" Alex asked without any sense of urgency as the party crasher transformed into a dragon right before their eyes.
"Ef hg da heen hagon."
*Bonk!*
"Don't talk with your mouth full." Alex told Bonney after hitting her with Sir Bonkers.
The little girl just glared at him ruefully while rubbing the top of her head, before saying after swallowing her food, "You stupid old man, he's the Green Dragon, Francis D. Drake. A super rookie from a few years ago that's made quite the name for himself. People even say he's going to replace one of the Four Emperors one day."
Alex cocked a brow when he heard that, before looking to now fully transformed dragon as he muttered under his breath, "couldn't you have picked a less obvious name?"
Drake didn't hear him though, as he turned his deadly maw towards Alex with liquid fire dripping from his teeth.
"Hiding behind women? You coward!" Drake snarled at him, making Alex's brow rise even higher as if to say 'really?'
With a flick of his wrist both Shirahoshi and Bonney were teleported to the other side of the room, beside the former's father, and Alex said, "I'm not hiding, I was just enjoying myself. Now let's just get this over with."
"Gladly!" Drake roared as he unleashed a inferno of dragon fire right at him.
"Mr. Alex-Sama!"
"My food!"
Shirahoshi and Bonney shrieked at the same time, as the fire engulfed that entire side of the room with Alex nowhere to be found.
"Drake! There had better be a good reason for this!" King Neptune roared as all of the Merfolk readied their weapons, with the three Prince's at their lead.
"King Neptune! This man is not what he seems! Please trust that I did only what was necessary to protect Fishman island from the chaos and destruction that he brings!" Drake pleaded with him urgently.
"I see... And was offering my people a future where we needn't worry about being enslaved THAT horrible!? Was him helping my daughter be free of the curse of Vander Decken THAT bad!?! Or how about when he convinced her to tell me the truth regarding her mother's death!? I trust THAT was a part of his heinous plan as well!"
As he raged King Neptune lifted his great trident up high, and slammed the butt of it down onto the ground with enough force that the entirety of Fishman island shuddered.
Drake was struck dumb at their reaction, since he was only trying to help them! But how could he explain that without telling them the truth about their place in an 'anime'?
Just then...
*RUMBLE.*
<"...">
<"BWAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!">
*CRASH!*
Demonic voices roared with laughter from within the flames before a massive scaled claw extended out to seize Drake by throat, choking him as his large draconic body was effortlessly lifted up off the ground.
<"When has a dragon last been foolish enough to challenge us?">
As the voices sneered at him, Drake was horrified to see the flames from his breath swept away suddenly to reveal a truly massive dark red dragon that easily dwarfed him, with glowing green eyes.
<"What's wrong little dragon? Cat got your tongue?">
In the face of the taunting, Drake's mind raced as he tried to figure out what to do. WHAT he was fighting.
<"Neptune, we will be taking our leave. But we shall return shortly.">
Saying such to the king of the Merfolk, the giant red dragon then threw Drake back towards the entryway like he was less than a sack of potatoes. Instead of a door though, a wall of mist appeared in the doorway that he flew through.
And on the other side, Drake found himself in an expansive desert filled with numerous cliffs and canyons. Before he could get his bearings though...
<"Now little dragon, come and fight us!">
Standing to its full height, Drake estimated that his opponent was roughly four times larger than himself, which was outrageous considering his dragon form was nearly fifty feet tall.
But what was that saying? The bigger they were, the harder they fall?
And Drake planned to make him fall, HARD.
With flames gathering in his mouth a second time, he rushed at his opponent with his claws raised up. Drake strained his wings to the limit to maximize his speed, his target being the other dragon's head.
With a bored look on its face though, the other dragon lazily flicked its tail at him in an attempt to bat him to the ground. Instead, the tail passed right THROUGH Drake while leaving a path of flames. Just like a Logia Devil Fruit.
<"Oh?">
"Takes this!" Drake roared at their curious look, raking his Haki-infused claws across its face in an attempt to tear it open.
Drake's claws were the terror of the Devil Fruits users all across the world. They could tear into the flesh of even Logia users, as well as the 3rd Division Commander of the Whitebeard pirates, Jozu, who had a body made of diamond after eating the Kira Kira no Mi.
And they WILL tear through the scales of the dragon before him. Drake believed that with all his being.
<"Tough luck, little dragon.">
Drake couldn't understand what the other dragon was talking about as it smirked down at him, until he looked down at his prided and feared claws, to see them completely shattered.
Meanwhile the other dragon's face was without a singe blemish.
<"Our turn. PENETRATE!">
Before he could even register the truth that his claws hadn't been enough, Drake found himself suddenly hurtling backwards after taking a hit from the other dragon's tail. A hit hard enough that he spewed up a massive amount of blood instead of fire.
*CRASH!*
An entire craggy mountainside crumbled and came crashing down as he hit it, burying Drake under the rubble as boulders the size of houses came down on top of him.
For a moment there was only the rumble and crashing of the boulders, before it all went still and quiet as the last of the rocks fell to leave only the slight haze from the dust in the air.
*CRASH!*
Drake exploded out of the rubble with enough force that small rocks were sent flying like shrapnel, his furious gaze focused on the other dragon as he roared,
"ENOUGH!"
His entire body then shimmered and gleamed as it turned into diamond, just like Jozu's, as he seemingly dared the other dragon to harm him now.
The larger beast however just smirked, before whipping its tail yet again.
The result was Drake being launched back into yet ANOTHER mountain as his diamond transformation was forcibly undone, doing nothing to protect him from the whip-like tail.
"H-HOW!?!" He demanded angrily while coughing up yet more blood. As far as he could tell, there had been no Haki in either of those attacks!
One of Drake's cheats allowed him to use Devil Fruit powers of those who's DNA he'd consumed, which had earned him a vast array of powers after all of the people he'd fought over the years. Paramecia, Zoan, Logia, he had several abilities from all three branches of Devil Fruit powers, each with its own uses for each situation. He even had the power of the Yami Yami no Mi from Teach.
Yet no matter what power he used, they were all worthless against the foe before him.
Any defensive abilities granted by Logia or Paramecia fruits were useless, while the numerous offensive powers were either deflected or ignored by his opponent completely. Even the Noro Noro no Mi he got from Foxy was useless, as all the other dragon did was 'move faster' to counter the slowing effects of the beam.
As if it was that easy!
Soon Drake found himself kneeling before the larger dragon, beaten and breathing raggedly. His scales were torn and bloody, his claws shattered, teach dulled, wings ripped.
"W-what are you?" He growled In frustration.
<"WE, are the Dragon Emperor!">
***
<We should really use that form more partner.>
"Yeah, but it's a royal pain with how large it is."
<Perhaps, but it's worth it.>
"Depending on the situation. The same could be said of my Oozaru form."
Alex and Ddraig debated as they returned to the palace where they'd left the Merfolk waiting.
"Sorry about that. Where were we?" He asked as if nothing had happened.
"Are you ok, Mr. Alex-Sama?" Shirahoshi immediately asked worriedly.
"I'm fine. Just a bit of light exercise to work off my meal!" He declared, before waving his hand and restoring the state of the feast hall with Regeneration magic.
"Amazing..." Fukaboshi uttered as he watched magic at work for the first time.
"My food!" Bonney exclaimed again, except this time in joy as she readily began eating yet again.
"This girl..." Alex said while wryly shaking his head. He then couldnt help but to wonder who would win in an eating contest between her, Luffy, and Goku.
Questions for later.
"If I may, what happened to Drake?" King Neptune asked him suddenly.
"I'll deal with him as I see fit." Alex stated seriously. "Shirahoshi is aware of the circumstances somewhat, but Drake and I belong to the same group of people. I'll have to be careful in how I deal with him, and it was the same reason why he attacked me on sight."
"I see..." Neptune said as he contemplated what Alex said.
Shirahoshi had basically told him all about the Chatroom and the people on it, though not the perverted nature of it. So he might've had an idea of what Alex was referring to regarding his and Drake's circumstances.
"That being said..." Alex began, regaining his attention.
"It IS about time for me to be returning home for the night. I just came back to let you all know that everything was resolved, and to clean up the mess here."
Alex then looked to Shirahoshi and added, "would you like to come with me Shirahoshi? It would let you meet the rest of my wives so you all could get to know each other."
"Eh!?! Can I really!?!" She exclaimed with excitement.
Shirahoshi had never left Fishman island before, and had spent the last eight years locked in a tower due to Vander Decken. To say she was eager to see and experience new things that she had been unable to until recently, would be a contender for understatement of the century.
She turned her pleading eyes to her father for permission, who also happened to be the only person present larger than her.
"Hmmm..." Neptune hummed in contemplation for a moment.
It was obvious he was reluctant to grant his daughter's silent request, which made sense given her history.
"Very well then." He eventually agreed with more than a little reluctance. Alex had already made clear his intention to 'claim' Shirahoshi as one of his wives in the future, and Neptune had no objection to their eventual union.
"Thank you father-Sama!" She cried joyfully, which was joined in by the Pokemon that had been sent to her.
A moment later Alex had collected her, and Bonney, before returning to Asora as a cloud of mist enveloped them.
"Please pardon my tardiness!" A new voice declared as a well known figured entered the dining hall.
"Boss Jinbe!" One of the Prince's declared when they saw the Fishman that arrived. One of the Seven Warlords, the Knight of the Sea, Jinbe.
***
"Thank you all for coming."
"What thanks?! You just suddenly summoned us here!"
"""Yeah!"""
Everyone protested Alex's greetings, which was understandable after he forcibly summoned them with magic to the Misty Manor.
Upon arriving in Asora he sent Shirahoshi and Bonney ahead into the space-time orb, and called a meeting to share information and discuss how the preparations for war were coming. And naturally, not all of them appreciated being summoned so suddenly.
"Can't you at least give us warning before summoning us like that?" Sephie, former queen of Deviluke, asked tiredly.
"But I did give you all warning." Alex said with a grin, making everyone glare at him since his warning had come RIGHT before he summoned them.
"Anyways, let's get this meeting started!"
Saying such, Alex waved his hand yet again to conjured a small feast before his 'guests' to pacify them somewhat. He then said with a more serious tone, "let's begin."
Though still annoyed, the rest of those present quickly launched into giving their respective reports.
Sephie began with a detailed reports of every kingdom in the One Piece world that had joined them or rebelled against the World Government. They weren't requiring every nation to join them, but the primary goal was convincing them to no longer support the World Government to cut their influence off at the knees.
Of course, there were still numerous kingdoms that remained steadfast in their support of the World Government, but they were almost entirely corrupt nations that regularly mistreated or took advantage of their own citizens. Unfortunately for them, it was practically child's play for a team of Devils to discover and air out every single piece of dirty laundry the corrupt nobles and royalty had, and then turn their own citizens against them in open revolt.
After Sephie they listened as Hajime detailed his progress on the Lambda status system, which he hoped would be done in a matter of days. The only real problem with it was that there weren't a lot of reliable ways for people to earn the experience points needed to improve their status in Asora. Something Alex would have to think about.
They then received the updated reports from the leaders of the various races of Asora regarding their own preparations for the looming war against Markus.
As per Alex's orders, only volunteers would fight on his behalf outside of their actual militant groups, such as the peerages and Valkyries. Most of his people had initially migrated to Asora due to conflict to begin with, so Alex would never force those who were unwilling to fight. The sole exception being their collective imminent annihilation.
Of course, there were exceptions to this rule.
Saiyans for example were a tribe that thrived on battle alongside the Ronso, the tougher the better. The same could be said of the races that once made up the Horde, while many warriors of the former Alliance were also refining their skills for the coming war.
And then there were the Nords and Orsimer of Tamriel, both of which valued honor and battle prowess. The former especially was drifting back to how they used to be before the empire made them soft, as their new High King Balgruuf encouraged ALL Nords to learn the secrets of their nearly lost art, the Thu'um.
Alex couldn't wait to see how they'd all grow once their new system was online!
Once they finished giving their reports regarding the people currently living in Asora, they then moved on to those living the various world they were connected to, DXD, Earthland, Tortus, Rosario Vampire, Spira, Universe 7, and Danmachi.
Throughout these worlds several groups were readying themselves for war, while several others were unable to do so for one reason or another.
Earthland was still in recovery after the actions of Darius and his cronies, so the only support they could offer was the few mages guilds that were already making their own preparations. Spira meanwhile was not filled with nearly so many combatants as it seemed, as most of its citizens were civilians, while their greatest assets for battle no longer existed, the Summoners.
Rosario Vampire was quite possibly the world least suited to helping them since its main population was just regular humans from modern society that would never be able to comprehend a war the likes of which they were repairing for, even after the existence of Youkai was revealed several years prior. However, Issa Shuzen did return with Moka, Kokoa and Akasha, and promised the help of all the vampires he'd been able to subdue in various regions around the world. Though he had yet to bring them all under his control, as Yue commanded him.
Contrasting these worlds though, all of the factions in DXD were busy preparing their forces for battle, which included the different pantheons, the Underworld, Heaven, and the Youkai. The same could be said of Tortus after Alex sent Tracy, Francesca, Altina and Tio back there, as they brought the Demon race, empire, Dragon-Kin, and Beastman races under their control.
Meanwhile in Universe 7 the tournament was winding down with its final day being tomorrow, and the four finalists that were participating were Goku, Frieza, Shia, and Vegeta Jr. Aside from them though, Sephie had already traveled to several entire planets within Universe 7 to secure their aid, which they all readily offered in an attempt to prove themselves.
Unfortunately they couldn't rely on any help from the Gods of Destruction from any of the twelve universes, as they couldn't become involved in conflicts outside their pocket of the Omniverse. Something that Heles in particular seemed upset about when she informed them over the Chatroom.
"Ok, now let's hear about Orario." Alex said, turning his attention to Cara and her entourage from that very city, Loki, Riveria, Ais, Tione and Tiona.
"Well..." Loki began as she organized all the going one of the last few days in her head.
