"To start with, there is already work being done on Daedalus Street to make room for the shops and businesses of Asora, along with the portal you wanted to make. But our attention has been on something else over the last few days."
"What's that?" Alex asked, noticing the tension building within her body.
"For some reason, all travel into Orario has stopped. There's been no merchants or travelers of any kind entering the city, which is hurting some of the businesses somewhat, but we've already sent out scouts to see what's wrong. Were just waiting on them to return."
Alex nodded slowing in acknowledgment, even as he began considering sending his own scouts to verify what was going on. Just as he was thinking of doing that though...
"Perhaps I could be of some assistance, my master..." Drawled a sensual voice as a chill filled the room, before eight insectoid appendages began to wrap around his body from behind possessively.
"Mephala." Alex said as he greeted one of the few Daedric Prince's he'd allowed to live, the lady of plots and secrets, Mephala. She was also his chief spymaster thanks to her former divinities.
"I have been stretching my legs into each of these lovely world's around us... Such succulent secrets, ripe for the picking..." She continued with her slow and sensual voice, which Alex tell was inducing arousal in most of the men gathered there, despite her spider legs that were wrapped around him.
"And? What secrets do you have about this incident worth sharing?" Alex asked her.
"Just that a self-proclaimed God of war is marching onto the city, and preventing anyone from entering it as he does so."
"""!!!"""
"Ares!" Loki groaned, more from annoyance than anything at the news.
"Rakia is on the move." Cara added afterwards to Alex, who vaguely recalled her mentioning Rakia before.
"What's the big deal about this Rakia?" Azazel asked curiously.
"They're not THAT big of a deal, just an annoyance more than anything to be honest." Loki started explaining.
"It's an entire nation under the control of a God of war, Ares. He's not the king himself, but the king does answer to him since he's made the entire nation his Familia."
"They've attacked Orario several times already, but they have never even breached the walls surrounding the city."
Cara and Riveria supplied one after the other, all appearing fairly casual about the word of an impending attack. Though Cara WAS slightly worried since it was coming ahead of schedule, and Bell had yet to even arrive in Orario.
"Hmmm... And if I mentioned that this Ares is spreading the most terrible rumors about my master? And is using them to amass the largest army this world has ever seen?" Mephala added with a smirk.
"""!!!"""
"That might actually be a problem..." Loki uttered as her closed eyes parted slightly.
"Not really." Alex said, his hand moving beneath the table as he sent a message to a group that not even any of his wives knew existed, the Nightingales.
Karliah, Tess, and Garona.
All three of them were the best of thieves and assassins after receiving numerous blessings from Alex, and drew their power directly from the Evergloam, the realm of Oblivion that once belonged to Nocturnal.
Aside from himself, Nocturnal, Mephala, and Boethiah, no one even knew they existed. Not even Alex's own wives, the Haulia, or Brynjolf, the current leader of the Undercity that Alex had Hajime make for their thieves and assassins.
Without giving away what he was doing, Alex gave the three of them orders to infiltrate Ares' camp and locate any info regarding his plans and allies. He also told them what to do with the info once they obtained it, while continuing as he said to the rest of those gathered,
"I'm still dealing with the World Government in the home world of Nami and Robin. Can I leave the matter of Ares to you, Sairaorg?"
"Of course!" The other man declared confidently, his voice practically booming through the room.
With that decided they went over the few last things in the meeting, during which Alex also mentioned who he wanted to assist him when he destroyed the World Government. Then began another discussion between him and Sairaorg as they divided up which groups would be a part of which battle, as he also wanted some men ready to fight Ares when he made his attack.
It was only when they were wrapping their meeting up that Alex added as if it had almost slipped his mind, "oh yeah! I also defeated another reincarnator just a bit ago."
"""!!!"""
"You WHAT!?!"
"Yeah. There I was, just hanging out and feasting on Fishman island, when all of a sudden this guy bursts in and attacks me. He completely ruined my meal!" Alex stated irritably, which garnered him various reactions from those around him.
Cara was just gaping at him in disbelief, while others were either shaking their heads wryly or chuckling at the poor guy's expense.
"Did you kill him?" Hajime asked curiously.
"Nah, not yet. He doesn't seem like a bad guy, since as far as I can tell he was trying to protect his homeland like Cara had been. If I can get him to listen then he might be able to join us." Alex answered casually, to which several people nodded slowly in contemplation.
With only a few more things left to discuss, they all soon dispersed as Alex let them go. However the women amongst the group stayed behind, including Loki and Riveria as they joined Alex and his wives into the space-time orb. The latter because she wanted to see more Asoran Magic firsthand, while the former had less than honorable intentions...
"Look at all the tatas!" Loki declared upon seeing Alex's wives for the first time, her expression being perfectly in line with that of a perverted old man as her hands made groping motions in anticipation.
"Bad!" Ais declared in a monotone voice as she chopped her hand down atop Loki's head, but the goddess of mischief didn't even seem to notice since she was too busy ogling all of the women.
It was almost understandable though, as Alex's collection of wives was quite diverse in appearances and backgrounds, with there even being several amongst them that belonged to races completely alien to the goddess. Like the Draenai.
She wasn't the only one though, since Riveria, a proud High Elf of royal blood, even found herself feeling slightly intimidated by the numerous elves she saw wandering around, from both Azeroth and Tamriel. She still couldn't help but to ask Alex,
"Do you REALLY need so many 'wives' though?"
"But of course! Hell, ask any of them and they'll tell you there still isn't enough!" Alex declared, surprising both Loki and Riveria. And while it was true that many of Alex's wives thought there were too many of them, they also knew they needed all of the help they could get with Alex's rapidly developing skills in the bedroom, combined with his newfound divinities.
"My beloved!" A new voice cried out, making all of them turn around right as Alex found his face sandwiched between a pair of breasts.
"Oh my darling! How I've missed you since our departure so long ago! My heart has ached like no pain I have ever endured before, and I counted the seconds even as they turned into minutes, hours and days!" The woman cried emotionally, even as tears of joy welled up in her eyes.
"It's nice to see you too Hancock, and it's only been a few hours." Alex said in a muffled voice from within her breasts, though he didn't make any notable attempts to escape them.
"Greetings Dragon Emperor." Gloriosa said as she appeared from behind Hancock, appearing marginally younger since she accepted the gift of becoming a wereserpent.
She still appeared elderly though.
"We bring you a gift!" Boomed Sandersonia, who stupefied many of the women within the space-time orb since they had never seen a woman so tall before. Well, those that hadn't met Shirahoshi in person yet.
But Alex's attention was on the numerous Kuja that approached him with chests and barrels in their arms, each one practically overflowing with treasure. That wasn't all that caught his attention though, as one woman appeared within the space-time orb as she tried to bashfully cover her exposed breasts. Quite the feat considering she was a literal giant, towering over even Sandersonia and Marigold.
"She's new..." Alex muttered quietly, before a pair of faces that he recognized also appeared with the rest of the Kuja. Tashigi and Hina of the Marines.
"After you left we readied our fleet, and used those new gadgets you put on them to sack Marineford within a matter of hours! Not only did we get so much loot, but we also secured plenty of supplies for Amazon Lily to last us for quite a while, AND we picked up some new recruits!" Marigold helpfully explained.
"Well.... Ok then..." Alex uttered, not really knowing what else to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 550 - 550: They Grow up so Fast!
chapters.content:
Alex was more than a little exasperated at Hancock's actions.
Though he did appreciate what she'd done for him, the fact was that their main enemy in this world was the World Government, not the Marines. Just like the Revolutionary Army.
The reason being that the majority of Marines genuinely believed in the ideals of Justice, and were necessary to protect the people of their world from the thousands of pirates that sailed their seas. Marines like Garp.
Only a few of them were truly corrupt, or believed that their standing as Marines allowed them to do whatever they wanted under the name of 'justice'. There were even some Marines, like the Admiral Akainu, who believed that their position allowed them to slaughter innocents and even other Marines as they believed fit.
The biggest problem was they directly served the Celestial Dragons, and have no choice but to obey their orders whenever given. If the Celestial Dragons wanted a woman brought to them to become their next wife, then the Marines would readily obey, or be severely punished for defying them.
Even the Admirals, the highest rank within the Marines under the Fleet Admiral, were their direct subordinates. If any civilian were to directly defy or rebel against them, they could readily call one down to deal with the offender.
That was part of the reason why Alex DID plan to get rid of the three of them when he did attack the World Government, since the three of them readily traded their humanity for a higher standing, unlike Garp. And of course, Akainu was at the top of that list since he'd readily stoop to any low in order to win, as an agent of 'justice'
"Hancock..." He asked her slowly.
"Yes?" She asked with a giddy feeling welling up in her from hearing Alex say her name.
"Did you kill ALL of the male Marines defending Marineford?"
"Of course not!" She declared, surprising Alex before she waved her hand to produce several statues before them. One of them was even a statue of Smoker, his cigar still in his mouth.
"I knew you were collecting Devil Fruits, and because you could never know who has one and who doesn't, I made sure to petrify them all to do with as you pleased!" Hancock declared as she obviously desired praise.
"That's good. I'm proud of you, Hancock." Alex said, praising her since what she had done WAS a great feat. Plus she did it without killing the Marines in her way.
"SMOKER!" Cried a new voice, one that was full of urgency as its owner tried to push her way forward.
"Halt newbie! You weren't given leave to speak up!" Cried out one of the higher ranking officers of the Kuja crews.
"But-!"
"Let her through." Alex suddenly said, and the officer stood down as the speaker, Tashigi, readily examined Smoker's statue while accompanied by Hina.
"He's still alive." Alex told the two of them. Though normally only the one who turned them all to stone could turn them back, being Hancock in this case, all Alex would have to do is use Regeneration magic to return them all to the previous state. Not that he was going to right this second.
WHEN he turned Smoker and the others back, he planned to have a nice long talk with them to determine their next course of action.
"Then turn him back!" Tashigi readily demanded, to which Alex readily replied in turn,
"No. I have no reason to do so at this moment."
"You-! You really are just criminal scum, even if you think yourself to be an emperor!" She stated indignantly, while Hina and the rest of the former Marines just watched the exchange from the side. Each one gauging and examining Alex.
One person however, was NOT amused or interested in the way Tashigi had spoken to Alex.
"YOU!" Hancock roared at her.
"I HAVE NEVER FELT AS ANGRY AS I AM RIGHT RIGHT NOW! HOW DARE YOU SPEAK THAT WAY TO MY BELOVED!"
"EH!?!" Tashigi exclaimed in shock at Hancock's sudden rage, as the latter moved faster than the former could follow.
"Now now, there's no need for that Hancock." Alex said as he appeared between the two faster than either could follow, his hand on Hancock's raised heel to prevent it from caving Tashigi's skull in.
"B-but I have to defend my beloved's honor!" Hancock pleaded desperately.
"I can defend my own honor if need be. Besides, I have absolutely no intention of censuring anyone in Asora, unless absolutely necessary." Alex said in return, making her gape at him in surprise.
For a moment Alex thought she would tell him how ignorant and stupid he was for such a thing.
"How amazing! The magnanimity and open-mindedness of the man I love! Such an inspiration for all!" She declared with reddened cheeks as she fawned over him.
It was only then that Alex recalled that this was Hancock he was dealing with, who would see no wrong with literally anything and everything he'd do.
So, Alex turned his attention back to Tashigi, who appeared to still be registering what had just happened.
"Anyways, you should keep in mind that I AM in fact an emperor Tashigi. One with more power and influence than even the Celestial Dragons could ever dream to wield."
Even as he said that, Alex still didn't expect Tashigi to understand where he was coming from. He was not some 'evil entity' like the pirates she was used to dealing with. He was a foreign power that had officially declared war against her reigning government.
The realization of this could be seen in the eyes of the rest of the former Marines, but not Tashigi. That was ok though.
Tashigi may be a bundle of idealistic justice, but Alex knew she could be flexible when she was required to be, as she willingly worked together with the Straw Hats on two separate occasions in the original timeline, and then let them go afterwards. Even when she could have easily captured them the first time around.
Turning about to leave them alone for the moment, Alex added as he walked away, "and another thing to keep in mind, the idea of 'justice' differs depending on where you go. Something considered 'good' in one place is considered 'evil' in another, and vice versa. Just some food for thought."
Though Tashigi wanted to say something to Alex's comment, a single look from Hancock was enough to make her keep silent. She did NOT want Alex saving her again, and it was obvious she was no match for the former Warlord. Especially when her prided katana was taken from her in the earlier battle.
"Make sure to store everything in its proper location!" Hancock told the rest of her tribe, referring to all the treasure they'd brought with them, before following after Alex as he walked away.
Her heart was pounding in her chest anxiously just from being beside him, despite how far they had already gone in their relationship just earlier that day. The moment was almost enough to make her swoon.....if only the other two weren't here.
"So where to now?" Loki asked him as she and Riveria continued following Alex around.
"You're free to explore as you like, just don't cause any trouble." Alex told her as he headed to specific location. "I on the other hand, am going to spend some time with my children."
Saying so, he opened a door that led to where his children currently were before they'd go to their personal island for training. Except on the other side there was no children.
"I'm so big now!"
"I am too!"
"Neither of you are bigger than Andre though."
"Hey... I'm not THAT big..."
"..."
Alex went white as ghost as he beheld a room full of adults where his children should be, all adults that LOOKED like his children, but they couldn't be. He especially seemed to take critical damage when the woman that looked just like Gabriel, except she had a golden monkeys tail, turned towards them so suddenly that her massive bust bounced around exaggeratedly. Obviously she wasn't wearing a bra.
"""DADDY!"""
"Kuh!"
Alex coughed up a mouthful of blood as they confirmed they WERE in fact his children, even as several of the girls rushed him excitedly for a hug. The result though, since they were all taller than usual, was him getting the breasts of all his daughters in his face as they dog piled him.
"I though they were supposed to be kids..." Loki muttered quietly to Riveria and Hancock, the former of which was watching the scene curiously, while the other was jealously biting her lower lip from all of the other women piling onto her beloved. Apparently she hadn't heard that they were his kids, or she just didn't care.
"They're supposed to be..." Alex uttered with the voice and eyes of a dead man, as tears threatened to spill from them.
He was thinking of all the moments he had apparently missed from his children suddenly growing up. Playing catch with the boys, teaching the rest of the younger ones how to fish, and even all of the potential tea parties he had missed with the girls.
"Bonney made us bigger~Nya!" Mai stated in an attempt to be helpful.
"She said it'll wear off though." Said a masculine voice that turned out to be Alec.
"!!!"
Once he heard that Alex bolted upright and looked to the corner of the room, where a now adult Bonney was sitting cross legged with several empty lunch boxes piled around her, a smirk on her face as if she had pulled off a successful prank.

"Who....are you?" Hody growled at the interloper, while everyone else watched in amazement.
"I am Sanran of the Dagon. Student at the Academy, loyal citizen of Asora, and a devoted follower of our emperor." The youth stated.
"Dagon?" Hody asked in confusion, before he noticed that Sanran's ears were shaped like fins, and there was webbing between his fingers.
"Indeed. We can be considered the Fishmen of the world we originally came from." Sanran declared.
"""!!!"""
Shock spread throughout the vicinity at his declaration, while Hody stepped back from Sanran's in contemplation.
"Hmmm... You call yourself a Fishman, but you look almost exactly like a human." Hody sneered at him.
"Perhaps, but that didn't matter where we came from." Sanran stated, before slamming the butt of his trident into the ground. As a result, the entirety of Fishman Island began to shudder and rubber from the impact.
It had long since been ingrained into his people's minds that, while they did look notably more human than those gathered before him, they were NOT. And the only reason they were not actively enslaved and mistreated by humans or demons was because they were considered useful. If that had ever changed, then they would've been clapped in chains and turned into slaves like every other 'Demihuman'.
This had been why Alex brought Sanran with him, as he was the one who could sympathize and get through to the Merfolk and Fishmen the most. Whereas if Alex had fought Hody himself, they would've more than likely considered it more 'human' oppression towards misbehaving Fishmen.
"If you wish to continue going after his majesty, then WE will be your opponent." Sanran declared to all of the New Fishman pirates.
As he said that, numerous other Dagon stepped forward while readying their weapons to fight. They were all members of Sanran's peerage, which he decided to consist entirely as Dagon in order to be an inspiration to their whole species.
There were two Knights, one who wielded dual katanas while the other used a massive sword, two Rooks that were twins armed with spiked gauntlets, and two Bishops that were armed with Dresspheres since Dagon couldn't naturally use magic. The rest of his peerage were Pawns that were armed with any number of weapons or martial techniques, including the FFWCR, while his Queen was a Dagon that had also become a Wereshark.
"You got this?" Alex asked Sanran without any sort of worry.
"Of course, your majesty!" Sanran declared without taking his eyes off of Hody and the others.
This was the first task ever given to him by his emperor. He will NOT fail!
"Good. I expect nothing less." Alex told him, before turning back to another of the people behind him. "If any of them try to escape into the ocean through the bubble surrounding the island, can you take care of them?"
"Of course." Ingvild declared, before she used her power to create numerous massive pillars of water that morphed into dragon heads.
The entire atmosphere of the city froze as the massive dragon heads loomed over them menacingly, creating an oppressive atmosphere over the entire island. What also didn't help matters was that Tamao and the other mermaids in her peerage prepared to help if need be, while Ingvild's massive leviathan Levi was also waiting just outside the island to pick its teeth with anyone that tried to escape.
"Now then." Alex said to the royal family. "Shall we return to the palace since they've got things settled here?"
Without waiting for an answer, Alex waved his hand and transported everyone but Ingvild, Sanran and their peerage members back to the palace.
"Your majesty.... I am deeply sorry for our failure..." King Neptune said apologetically.
"Your back?" Alex asked with a deadpan.
"..."
King Neptune didn't want to say it, but his back was still incredibly sore from the show of strength he did to intimidate Drake the day before.
"Here." Alex said with another wave of his hand, as he readily fixed the Merking's back for him.
"Ah.... Thank you your majesty!" King Neptune exclaimed as he readily bent and stretched himself to test his new back.
While he was at it, Alex also healed the three Prince's of their injuries.
"Think nothing of it. You all would've won if it hadn't been for the drug they were using." Alex said while waving away his thanks. And he wasn't just being kind either. The ONLY reason Hody and the others were a threat was because of the drug.
"Perhaps..." King Neptune said in contemplation, before he noticed the final person Alex had brought with him.
"Oh? And this is?" He asked.
"Greetings your majesty. I am Sephie, one of Alex's wives and the head of foreign relations for Asora." Sephie said while bowing her head respectively.
"Ah..." Neptune uttered to her greeting, suddenly becoming bashful from Sephie's beauty and regal bearing. She HAD been the queen of the Devilukian empire after all.
"Sephie here is to help negotiate the possibility of the Merfolk and Fishmen migrating to Asora. Not only can we create a brand new home for your people somewhere on the ocean itself, maybe an island or something, but they could also reside nearly anywhere is Asora that they may wish."
"Indeed." Sephie said as she picked up where Alex left off.
"If there are any concerns you have with relocating, feel free to let to me know and I can address them to the best of my abilities. But if the idea of complete relocation is completely off the table, then we can also discuss connecting Fishman Island to the new island with a portal. That way anyone who wants to move is able to, and those who wish to stay here can stay in contact with them."
"O-oh..." King Neptune uttered, more than a little overwhelmed with everything Alex and Sephie were saying.
But he also understood that they weren't going to make everyone leave Fishman island. That was the best thing in his opinion, due to the agreement made between Joyboy and the ancient mermaid princess, Poseidon.
This way his people would be able to move to a safer home full of opportunity, and they wouldn't need to completely abandon Noah, or their promise to Joyboy.
"I don't quite understand everything you're telling us, but I thank you for your understanding of us." Neptune said to them, making Alex and Sephie smile.
"Not a problem. But now I must leave you in Sephie's more than capable hands." Alex said, giving the Charmian a quick kiss on the cheek, before approaching Shirahoshi as well.
"I'll see you later, but it's time for me to finally enter the New World. I've got some business there before we assault Mary Geoise." Alex told her.
"O-ok!" She said unsurely, before Alex proceeded to give her kiss as well on her forehead.
Immediately Shirahoshi's entire head turned bright red from embarrassment, and Alex could even see a cloud of steam forming over her.
Without another word, Alex proceeded to change into a Wereshark before all of them, stunning all of the Fishmen and Merfolk who hadn't seen it before, before he leapt up and burst through the bubbles surrounding the palace into the open sea. Obviously, Levi let Alex by while maintaining a watchful eye on Hody and his goons.
...
*Later*
"Jomun....." King Neptune sighed tiredly after all of the work and discussion was over with.
Well, maybe not.
"You wanted to see me father?" Fukuboshi asked as he hesitantly opened the door to the king's chambers.
"Yes. Come in my son." Neptune said while gesturing to his eldest child.
Fukuboshi entered the room and closed the door behind him, wondering what his father called him for.
"Tell me, what do you think of all of this?" Neptune asked him.
It didn't take a genius to guess what the king was asking about, as Fukuboshi answered, "it's all happening so fast... Part of me believes it's an amazing opportunity for our people, but I also feel as if this isn't the future my mother hoped for us..."
King Neptune nodded in agreement as he said, "indeed. But with the world changing the way it is, we can either change with it, or fall behind."
The goal of King Neptune's late wife, Otohime, was for them to join the World Government to establish themselves as the equals of humans, and to live alongside humans on the surface. She had been so dedicated to this goal, that she personally accompanied a wounded Celestial Dragon to the holy land Mary Geoise, and placed herself in the position of greatest danger to show that they could coexist.
By accepting Alex's offer though and moving to Asora they would be able to coexist with surface dwellers, but not those of this world. Plus there was the fact that Alex was the enemy of the Celestial Dragons and the World Government, so in a way they would be going against her wishes by aligning themselves with him.
But, as King Neptune already said, the world was changing.
There was no point in them aligning themselves with the World Government if they were going to be destroyed soon by Alex, which King Neptune fully believed that he could and will.
"I would say the real question is who should lead our people in this new world..." King Neptune suddenly said.
"!!!"
"Father! What are you saying?!" Fukuboshi demanded in surprise.
"I'm saying that not everyone will move to this Asora. So someone will have to stay here, while someone else will need to lead our people there." Neptune explained. "And I want that someone to be you, my son."
"But father-!"
"But nothing. Just like how the world is changing, the relics of the past like myself should stay behind. It is time for you to step forward, and lead our people into the unknown future."
The king fell silent after he finished saying his piece, as there was nothing else for him to say on the matter. Though the opposite seemed true for Fukuboshi, the prince did not say what he wanted to. This was good, since Neptune's mind was made up.
And just as well, as someone else knocked on the doors to his chamber at the moment.
"Yes?" Neptune called out to whoever was knocking.
"Father-Sama, can I talk to you...?" Came a timid voice, which both Neptune and Fukuboshi recognized instantly.
"Of course Shirahoshi!" Neptune cried as he hurriedly opened the doors to his chambers, revealing the once again giant mermaid Shirahoshi. It had quite the shock for Neptune to see his daughter as a normal sized human, but she had quickly explained why while demonstrating the power of the rings Alex gave her.
"That is all, Fukuboshi." Neptune said to his eldest son, dismissing him since he had said everything he needed to.
"Is Brother-Sama in trouble?" Shirahoshi asked worriedly as her brother left the room.
"Not at all. I just told him something he didn't necessarily want to hear. But enough about that, what did you need?" Neptune asked his daughter.
For a moment Shirahoshi said nothing, instead taking in a deep breath as she steeled herself for whatever it was she wanted to talk about. But then she said something that Neptune never thought he hear from his daughter's lips.
"Father-Sama, please teach me how to fight!"
"..."
"Huh...?"
That was all that could escape Neptune's lips to his daughter's request, which was that LAST thing he thought she'd ever ask him.
"I said I would like to learn how to fight, Father-Sama!" Shirahoshi declared once again to his earlier utterance, proving that he had not misheard what she said earlier.
"I see..... And may I ask why you suddenly with to learn how to fight, my daughter?" The King asked her seriously.
"Because...." Shirahoshi began, before looking down in thought.
"Because I'm tired of being a burden... I'm tired of people needing to protect me... And I don't want to be a useless flower in a garden! I want to be of use to Alex!"
As she declared such, the king was utterly taken aback from how serious his daughter was. Her eyes as she made her plea were the firmest he had ever seen them, and he could literally feel the waves of Haki rolling off of her body.
Otohime was naturally gifted in the use of Observation Haki from birth, being able to use it to even dodge bullets and sense those around her to the point that she was also able to feel the pain and suffering they had felt. It only made sense that Shirahoshi was also naturally skilled in Haki, though she had never been trained in it.
However Neptune could feel it now as his beloved daughter declared her intention to become stronger, despite the fact that no one could ever imagine her hurting even a fly.
"Shirahoshi...." He said in a soft voice full of warmth.
"Father-Sama...?" She asked confusedly.
"Come child. I believe it's time I told you something."
With such clear determination and devotion towards the Dragon Emperor, Neptune decided that it was time to tell his daughter the truth about her powers. How she possessed the ability to even destroy the world if she so wished.

chapters.title: Chapter 556 - 556: Arrival in the New World
chapters.content:
The ocean currents swirled around Alex as he soared through the water, racing upwards towards the surface from Fishman Island.
A few sea kings looked at Alex like he was lunch as he made his way, but a single glance from him was enough to send most of them running. And then there were the ones too stupid to realize he was too much trouble, and swiftly met their ends from Alex's teeth.
In all, it seemed like no time before Alex climbed all ten thousand meters from Fishman Island, and his head broke the surface of the ocean in the New World.
When it did, Alex was greeted by storms unlike anything he had ever seen before.
Water spouts raged in every direction, swells over a hundred feet high on the low side, and winds to put even the worst of hurricanes to shame.
Despite all of this, Alex had a massive smile on his face.
THIS is what the One Piece world, the Grand Line and New World specifically, was all about!
Treacherous seas that could turn at a moment's notice, and islands full of mystery, intrigue, and dangerous opponents!
Alex couldn't help but to lament that he waited to come here until he was already so strong, as everything that made this world fun was already too minor for him. Even the next moment, when a whirlpool opened up to swallow him in an instant, Alex was barely even fazed.
Not as the currents ripped him through the water, his body dragged across a reef, or when a massive sea king smacked him with its tail, Alex couldn't even be bothered to worry. Though he DID turn the sea King into shish kabobs afterwards.
Storing them away for later, Alex continued on his way without worrying about the terrific storm going on around him. His first stop, Punk Hazard.
The island was former research facility that had been left condemned by the World Government and Marines after a poison gas explosion, which had been set off by Caesar Clown. Once a fertile and lush island, it was now a barren wasteland after the poison gas killed off all of the vegetation, animals, and hundreds of inhabitants.
If the timeline had continued according to cannon, then in the near future the Admirals Akainu and Aokiji would duel for the position of the next Fleet Admiral on the island. The result would be the entire island being transformed into half a frozen wasteland, and half a molten hellscape.
At the moment however it was just a dusty barren wasteland, at least until Alex set foot on it.
Alex gave the island one look, before waving his hand while channeling Regeneration magic. Instantly the dull island was transformed back into the lush and vibrant environment it originally was, though unfortunately he couldn't return the animal life as well.
Or could he?
"Maybe this is a good chance to try putting my Life divinity to use?" Alex asked himself out loud, before enveloping the entire island in a time distortion so he could spend a while practicing.
...
More than a few 'days' worth of time later on Punk Hazard, and Alex sat back as he admired the variety of fauna that now called the island home. He had tried blending a bit of the fantastical with the mundane, resulting in quite the diverse array of fairly dangerous creatures.
From the massive mossy moose, with green moss-like fur and large antlers that were like tree branches, to adamantine boars with metal tusks and covered in metal bristle furs, or the stealthy stalkers, large jungle cats with fur capable of adapting to their surroundings to help them blend in.
There were also a large variety of smaller fauna roaming the island alongside the three main megafauna, consisting mostly of reptiles, birds, mammals, and amphibians, that weren't nearly as creative. But they all had a fighting chance to survive in this new world they found themselves in, and would be part of the new ecosystem Alex had created.
Of course he would be checking in when he could to make sure everything was thriving the way it should. But with his little experiment finished, Alex decided to focus on the largest and most dangerous creature on the island.
Smiley.
Smiley was the remnant of the toxic bomb Caesar detonated on the island several years prior, but condensed and animated through the use of a Devil Fruit. The Sara Sara no Mi: model, Axolotl.
Thanks to the Devil Fruit, the poison gained a rudimentary form of intelligence, though it mostly acted on instinct instead of thought. But, without knowing just how dangerous the poison was, Alex told the girls not to mess with Smiley when they came to deal with Caesar and his goons.
Now however, Alex teleported directly in front of the massive doors deep underground that contained Smiley to keep it from running amok on the island.
"Here goes nothing." Alex said to no one in particular, though of course Ddraig and Lauren were always listening.
With his telekinesis, Alex ripped the doors sealing Smiley inside off the hinges and crumpled them like they were paper, before tossing the ball of warped metal aside.
"..."
Though the interior was pitch black, Alex could hear something moving within that shuffled closer to him before a massive gelatinous figure appeared.
"Yo, Smiley!" Alex called up to it.
"!!!"
An inconceivable roar echoed throughout the entire underground lab they were in, literally making it all shake with the creature's fury.
Smiley was furious that the one greeting it was not its master, and immediately after its roar it swung a massive tentacle of pure poison at him.
"Here we go." Alex said with a wry smile, before his entire body was enveloped by the toxic goo.
Anything Alex was wearing was instantly dissolved by the acidity of the poison in Smiley, while even his skin started to feel a little itchy. A notable feat considering how high his Poison Resistance skill was.
If Smiley was able to make even HIS skin crawl, even after he took Magellan's poison, then Alex didn't see any need to hurry. Thankfully the time distortion he'd put up around the island was still in effect.
So Alex just kicked back and relaxed as Smiley tried to dissolve him, something that frustrated the toxic goo to no end.
Time passed, and Alex continued relaxing while Smiley continued trying to melt him. But the longer things went on, the more the living sludge was getting fed up with him.
Unfortunately for it, Alex wasn't just kicking back idly.
Eventually Alex received the notification that his Poison Resistance skill had gone up another level, topping it out at level ten.
"Guess I better wrap this up." He muttered despite still being inside of Smiley.
At that moment the entirety of Smiley's body began to dissolve as it was reduced to its most basic and harmless components, until all that was left was a puddle with a single Devil Fruit laying in the middle.
Alex quickly collected the Devil Fruit and ran a quick search over the lab to make sure there was nothing else of value, only to find another Devil Fruit that had been hidden away. It was the artificial Devil Fruit that would be eaten by Momonosuke in two years, and turn him into a pink dragon. (A.N. Reminder, Alex doesn't know it was supposed to be a direct copy of Kaido's fruit.)
Storing the two fruits away, Alex proceeded to trash the lab so it couldn't be used by anyone else, while also making a copy of all the data that was there for Lala and Hajime to go over. Knowing them, they'd be able to take the work Caesar started on artificial Devil Fruits and be able to perfect them from the faulty Smiles, giving Asora their own endless supply.
It was only when all that was done, that Alex FINALLY left Punk Hazard for his next destination. Dressrosa.
Dressrosa was the kingdom that had been taken over and ruled by Doflamingo for more than a decade, until Yami, Shizuku and Erza all liberated it on Alex's behalf. Now the kingdom was under the rule of the royal family that had been in control before Doflamingo, the Riku family.
Their numbers included the current re-crowned King, Riku Doldo the third, the crown princess Viola, and the second princess Rebecca.
Doldo had been the beloved king of Dressrosa before the pirate Doflamingo returned to reclaim what had been his family's ancient throne. But thanks to Doflamingo, Doldo went from beloved to despised by the entire nation overnight, before the pirate stepped in to retake his family's throne to their cheers from the fake story he wove.
Viola, in a bid to save her father's life, joined Doflamingo's crew as the assassin Violet. A role she performed admirably thanks to her seductive looks, and the power of the Giro Giro no Mi that allowed her to spy on anyone in Dressrosa, from anywhere, and even read their minds.
Rebecca was the only daughter of Viola's older sister and the former crown princess, Scarlet, as well as the greatest gladiator in the country's history, Kyros. After her mother's death though, Rebecca had been raised in hiding by a toy soldier that was actually her father after Sugar used her power on him.
Now Alex was on his way to go meet them for the first time since they had been liberated from Doflamingo, as well as to make contact with a hidden tribe on the island, the Tonttatas.
***
"Humph!" Harrumphed a mature and beautiful woman with long dark brown hair, which was currently splayed out in the water of the Royal baths.
"What's wrong aunt Viola?" Asked a girl in her early teens, with light pink hair that drifted in the water similarly to her aunt's.
"The man that my father wants to meet, the Dragon Emperor. That's what." Viola spat distastefully when she recalled the events over the last several days.
Mostly, they had all been happy and full of rejoicing after the defeat of Doflamingo, due to his crimes being revealed to the populace at last. But for Viola it was different after they heard what the women who had liberated them had to say.
Apparently they had been sent at the behest of a man called the Dragon Emperor, a man who had his wanted poster spread by the World Government the very next day. But when her father asked about the man, all three of them readily answered that he was someone who tried to pretend he was evil when he truly wasn't, and had the habit of 'collecting' any woman who caught his fancy.
They even made the comment before leaving that he would more than likely try to 'collect' both Rebecca and Viola when he got around to visiting Dressrosa in the future.
"Are you still mad about what those three said about him 'collecting' us?" Rebecca asked.
"Yes! But that's not all, the king could very well go along with it if he deems him amicable enough!" Viola declared angrily, but then again no one could blame her after the life she lived, and the powers she had.
Viola had long since developed a deep distrust for men due to the fact that none of them that she'd become involved with had ever been honest with her, something she had been able to easily determine with her powers. It also didn't help that Doflamingo used her as his personal assassin quite often, meaning she was always in contact with the worst type of men.
As for why she and Rebecca may end up being 'collected', it was because King Doldo had completely lost his faith in the World Government after they had been left to rot under Doflamingo's rule for so long. Even if the pirate had been able to fool his own citizens, there was no way the World Government was completely blind to everything he had been doing.
So, if the Dragon Emperor proved to be the better option, then they could throw themselves under his banner, with both Viola and Rebecca being 'collected' in the form of marriage as a sign of good faith.
Rebecca was currently fourteen, which most would say was still too young, but there would no reason not to promise her hand for when she became of age. Viola on the other hand was already well into her twenties, with only a few more years until she reached thirty. As a member of the royal family, especially the crown princess, most would say her first priority in the immediate future would be securing an heir before ascending to the throne.
It was a idea that both quickly gaining momentum in the kingdom, and getting on Viola's nerves.
Of course, Doldo won't just marry her off for the sake of convenience. If he didn't like Alex, then he wouldn't agree to the union if Viola didn't.
"Princesses Viola and Rebecca, the Dragon Emperor has arrived!" An attendant suddenly cried as they hurried into the baths to inform them.
...
"Hurry Rebecca." Viola said as she led the way through the palace halls, with her niece trying to keep up behind her.
Viola was dressed in a long purple dress with different rows of white frills, a pair of matching earrings, and a pink flower to hold her hair into place. Rebecca meanwhile was dressed in a amber colored dress with numerous ruffles of the same color, while her hair was held in place with a light-pink ribbon.
"I'm coming!" Rebecca called out to her aunt as she tried to keep up, still not being used to all of the fancy clothes and shoes that women of the Royal family wore.
Soon the two princesses arrived at their destination, being the throne room where King Doldo was currently receiving the Dragon Emperor.
"Ah! It appeared the princesses have arrived!" Doldo exclaimed when they entered the throne room, and the duo saw Alex for the first time.
"Nice to meet ya ladies." Alex said while waving to them in greeting.
"It is a pleasure to meet you, your highness." Viola said with every bit of the elegance and politeness that she had been taught as a young girl.
"Ah! Pleased to meet you!" Rebecca hurriedly said in greeting, having received none of the lessons Viola received yet.
"I was just telling his majesty of the goings on of the kingdom since Doflamingo was dethroned." Doldo explained to the two of them, to which Alex nodded as he added,
"That's right! Plus I also looked over the country myself when I arrived. It looks as if the people are adapting well to all of the sudden changes."
"???"
"How'd you look over the entire island already? Do you have an ability like the Giro Giro no Mi? Or is your Haki that powerful?" Viola inquired out of curiosity.
"No no, my Haki's not THAT good. Though I probably should start refining it further...." Alex said, more to himself than anything, before continuing,
"One of my abilities is similar to Haki in that I can be aware of, and manipulate, anything in the area around me. The stronger it gets, the larger my influence grows. The entire island is practically a drop in the total area it encompasses."
As Alex explained his ability, Viola's expression hardened as she asked testily, "anything?"
"Yes, anything." Alex answered immediately, before he gave her a lecherous look.
Obviously, with his 'Godly Pervert' skill, Alex had instantly become aware of every single beautiful woman bathing, changing or doing more risqué activities on the island. Viola and Rebecca bathing was no exception.
"You-!" Viola exclaimed as her faced reddened from embarrassment. It was obvious by his expression that he had seen her and Rebecca bathing.
But then Alex actively looked her body up and down, as if she were standing naked before him right then. But that was impossible!
"You can't fool me!" Viola declared as she held her hand up and formed a circle with her pointer finger and thumb.
Immediately her vision pierced Alex's clothes, revealing what he was packing under them, and then his body as his skin vanished to reveal his muscles before his bones. Focusing her vision even more, Viola was able to peer even into Alex's mind to affirm what his thoughts REALLY were.
"!!!"
"A-are you for real!?!?" Viola exclaimed when she saw her naked figure within Alex's mind. And it wasn't just an imagination like all the other guys who pictured her naked, but her actual body as if she were standing naked before him.
"How!?!" She demanded angrily.
"I already said how. If you want to be REALLY impressed, how about a look at your future?" Alex asked, before the scene in his mind shifted.
The next thing she knew, Viola was assaulted by all sorts of perverse images and scenes that had never happened with her and Alex having sex in various positions. She was on her back with her tits bouncing everywhere, then she was on all fours with her ass moving back and forth.
There were scenes of her giving Alex a tit-fuck, blowjobs, or posing in various different positions to show off her most vulgar places. There was even one of her begging for his cock in her ass.
"H-HOW VULGAR!" Viola declared in a very unladylike manner as she recoiled from Alex, petrified from the perverseness of Alex's thoughts.
"What is it aunt Viola?" Rebecca asked innocently.
"Nothing!" Viola declared as she tried to preserve her niece's innocence.
"What'd you think, Viola?" Alex asked her with a smirk.
"Y-you are the single most disgusting, perverted, and horrible beast of a man I have ever had the misfortune of meeting!" Viola declared, before the entire court.
"Viola!" Doldo exclaimed in a surprised tone.
"It's ok." Alex said, pacifying the shocked King before returning his attention to Viola.
He then shocked everyone present as he suddenly appeared in front of her with no one being able to follow his movements, not even the greatest gladiator in Dressrosa history, Kyros.
"Eh-!?" Viola uttered as she went to step back, before Alex gently grabbed her by the wrist.
"Careful, you don't want to fall." Alex said to her while flashing a smile.
"!!!"
In an instant Viola felt as if her heart skipped a beat as she stared at Alex's face, even as he wrapped one arm around her waist.
"You see Viola, I AM a vulgar, disgusting and perverted beast. You can just ask any one of my wives about that. But, I like to think of myself as a beast with class. Sometimes." Alex said with a wry smile.
"Maybe you should try using your ability on me now?" He suggested to her.
Though Viola didn't know exactly what he was doing to have such an effect on her, she did as he suggested and looked through a circle formed by her fingers yet again.
"!!!"
The scenes she saw this time, were completely different!
While the previous scenes she had witnessed were all perverseness of the highest nature, the scenes Viola witnessed now were anything but.
Instead, she witnessed scenes of beauty and serenity. Scenes of a loving father raising and caring for his children, doting on them, and even training them. Then there were scenes of Alex and his wives, either of them on dates, lounging together, or raising their children together.
Aside from the serene and tranquil scenes in Alex's mind, there were also scenes that left Viola dumbfounded. She saw memories of the work Alex put in to master himself and each of his abilities, endless hours spent training his strength, and the force he called 'magic.
But aside from them, she also saw the scenes of what Alex was capable of, like when he was flying through Universe Seven and shattered planets with his bare hands, or when he dueled Beerus.
As the seconds passed Alex let himself be an open book as Viola looked through his memories from ever since he reincarnated. The ones that came before were protected from her(and other's) gaze by Lauren.
Aside from the numerous shocking memories she viewed, Viola was stunned by the fact that Alex was hiding nothing from her gaze, like any other guy who knew about her powers.
By the time she had finished viewing Alex's memories, there were a couple tears in her eyes that needed to be wiped away. Alex of course wiped them away, before asking,
"So? What'd you think?"
"I think you're an idiot." Viola said while looking away with reddened cheeks.
"That's a fair thought." Alex replied with a smirk.
"Um... What just happened?" Rebecca asked confusedly.
"I.....don't know..." Doldo answered as he watched Alex and Viola.
"How about a tour of the island?" Alex asked Viola.
"I-I'd love to..." Viola answered shyly, accepting Alex's offered arm as she led out of the palace.
"We'll be back later Doldo." Alex called back to the king as he and Viola left, leaving the entire assembled court stunned.
And as Alex and Viola departed on their date, a tiny figure with a bushy tail appeared beside the king.
"Please keep an eye on them for me Leo." Doldo asked of the tiny figure without anyone else noticing.
"Of course!" Leo answered while saluting the king, before moving at such a speed that it appeared to disappear.
***
*Earlier*
"!!!"
Hermione awoke with a start as everything that happened before she'd passed out rushed through her mind.
"That guy...!" She swore while jumping out of the bed she was laying in, only to realize she was completely naked under the blankets.
