Venri nodded to the head maid in affirmation, even as she produced tea and a number of snacks to go with it for her. Just as she began pouring the tea though, Venri paused as something appeared in front of her that took the entirety of her attention.
"Venri? I am sure that's enough tea." Grayfia commented, startling the other maid as the burning hot tea overflowed from the cup, and spilled onto her hand.
Though Grayfia was about to ask her what happened, as Venri hardly ever lost concentration like that, she noticed that the others had ceased their sparring match as they too began to stare at something in front of them.
***
"Well this takes me back!" Exclaimed a young woman dressed in red with her blond hair tied into twin braids on either side of her head.
"Indeed! It's such a shame the others aren't here with us." Replied another young woman with identical features, except she was dressed in green while her blond hair was flowing freely while being held back by a headband.
"Right. I do wonder how they're all doing back home." Said the last of the three women, who looked nothing like the other two with her long black hair tied back in a ponytail, and amethyst colored eyes that repeatedly swept the corridor they were in for any enemies.
The trio were of course Veronica, Serena and Jade from the world of Erdrea, who were exploring the replicated Orcus Great Labyrinth to see how far they were able to go.
Despite the fact that they were already nearing the lowest floor, the group wasn't all that much on alert as they fought their way further down. With the skills they had honed in order to fight the Lord of Shadows, Mordegon, and then the root of all evil, Calasmus, there was very little that could threaten them down here.
Instead, they were taking the chance to practice several of the new spells and skills they had learned ever since being summoned to this strange land of Asora.
"Well... If I know them, Erik is off on a stealing spree with his sister, Sylvando is touring the world with his little band of boys, Hendrick has probably been freaking out constantly ever since you went missing, Rab is still working on rebuilding Dundrasil, and Erdrick is back home at Cobblestone getting all cozy with Gemma." Veronica said as she ticked all of their former comrades off her fingers.
"Indeed." Serena said with a giggle, before asking with realization, "do you think they've noticed we've gone missing as well?"
"Hmmm..." Veronica hummed in contemplation.
"Probably. Even if the two of you had been at home at the time, it's entirely possible that your parents and Father Benedictus sent word to Erdrick and the others when they noticed you had disappeared as well." Jade stated knowingly, even as she casually swung her glaive to the side to bisect a monster that had been creeping up on them.
The trio continued until they reached a wide open room, where they could feel something moving in the darkness.
*Thud.*
*Rumble.*
The ground shuddered as something impacted it, before the chamber was suddenly lit up by a series of torches to reveal what they had disturbed within, as all seven different colored heads roared angrily.
"""GRYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!"""
In the face of such a monstrosity, the three girls just looked up at it with intrigue.
"So what is that?"
"I think it's called a hydra."
"They sure have some interesting creatures here."
The three girls all commented offhandedly without any sense of urgency or concern.
"Fizzle!"
With a cry, Veronica used her magic to seal every single head from casting any spells before the three of them leapt into action. Veronica had her whip in hand, while both Serena and Jade had their glaives.
The following battle was long and drawn out, but not because the three girls were unable to finish it off. The battle was prolonged because they decided to try out a series of new skills and techniques against the strong opponent.
And it was only after they were satisfied that they decided to deal the finishing blow, and the mighty beast collapsed with a thunderous rumble as it hit the ground.
"Well that was fun~!" Serena exclaimed as the three of them relaxed from the battle. But right as they did so, something appeared before them that caught all of their attention.
"Is this part of the Dungeon?" Jade asked curiously.
"I don't think so..." Veronica answered.
***
"Hmmm... This place truly is amazing." Uttered an attractive girl with long black hair, two strands of which were tied into braids that were held into place with two ribbons.
Himekawa Hayuru was currently walking around Asora on her own to learn more about this strange world. Ever since they had arrived, she had been focused on fighting and training with her Heart Hybrid Gear(HHG) alongside Aine and Yurisha. So today she decided to take a break as she explored Asora.
The thing that surprised her the most though, despite already seeing it within Alex's harem, was the sheer number of different types of people that were here.
Not only that, but the marketplace that she was currently in was also selling goods that looked like they belonged to every singe period of time. One stall had the merchant selling medieval weapons, like swords, daggers, maces, and bows, while the booth next to it was selling different type of firearms and blasters.
As a proud samurai, Hayuru was naturally drawn to the blades weapons as she examined them with a discerning eye. Of course, none of them could compare to the blades created by her Neros, much less her Gladius. Now if only she didn't need to perform Heart Hybrid with Alex just to use it...
"Looking for a blade little girl? You'll get no better than true Orc-forged steel!" Growled the green-skinned shopkeeper, even as he grinned to flash her his tusks.
"Perhaps I'll just look a little." Hayuru said as she happily browsed the blades. There weren't any katanas, but then again she couldn't expect EVERYONE to make those.
"Hmmm..." She hummed while looking over the items for sale, losing track of her surroundings as she did so.
"Look at that..."
"How daring!"
"She's quite brave."
"Huh?" Hayuru uttered confusedly as she noticed numerous gazes and muttering towards her.
"Little girl, that's quite the bold fashion statement." The Orc vender said to her with flared nostrils and a wide smile.
"What do you mean?" Hayuru asked curiously, before looking down at her clothes. Or rather, complete lack of them.
"!!!"
"KYAAAAAAAAAAA!" Hayuru screamed at the realization that she was completely naked in this massive crowd of people. Ironically, it was her scream that drew more gazes her.
"What's this?"
"Is it some kind of stunt?"
"Maybe she's advertising for a new brothel?"
As more eyes and theories flew towards her, Hayuru's shame reached an all time high as she screamed out,
"NEROS!"
In an instant her body was covered by her robotic battle armor, though it didn't do anything to cover the areas that actually needed to be covered, like her breasts, butt, and crotch.
"How erotic!"
"So this IS a stunt!"
"I think I'm in love!"
"NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!"
With a distressed cry, Himekawa Hayuru used her HHG to fly back to the Misty Manor. Fortunately for her, everyone was distracted a moment later as something appeared in midair before them.
And it was only when she returned to the Misty Manor, that Hayuru was reminded of the penalty for not sending a picture in the previous mass quest, which was randomly being subjected to Dress Break.
***
All throughout Asora, as well as each of the space-time and subspace orbs within it, every single person experienced the same phenomenon as an illusionary screen appeared before them.
On the screen they saw their own names, followed by something called a Rank, then their Race, Titles/nicknames, and finally something referred to as a Job. That slot was filled by something called Jobless for everyone, which was set to a hundred for all of the adults, and most of the children in Asora.
After that was a section labeled Attributes, which listed their Vitality, Mana, Stamina, Strength, Agility, and Intelligence along with numerical values. That section was followed by another labeled Skills, which was separated into two categories called Passive and Active Skills.
Under this section, everyone saw the different abilities and talents they had honed throughout their lives, from combat abilities, to even things as mundane as reading, cooking, and cleaning.
The very bottom of the list was a section called Status Effects, which showed various conditions that every single person had, such as blessings, illnesses, and other conditions they had. It even listed things like old age, or missing limbs.
While everyone else in Asora was pondering the sudden status screen, there was one man who was cackling with what sounded like deranged glee.
"FINALLY! I FINALLY DID IT!" Hajime declared while laughing manically.
Though he had told Alex that he'd need a few more days, Hajime had made a breakthrough in the night that helped him finish Asora's own Status System early. Now it was up and running, and all people would need to do is go to one of the Job changing stations he'd already linked to the Status System to start taking Jobs and grow stronger.
And the way he'd designed the Job system was that, aside from the hundreds of Jobs and Skills he'd installed in it with help from Azazel and his parents, the system itself would create brand new Jobs and Skills based off of the development of the people linked to the Status System.
Like a proud parent, he was REALLY excited to see what kinds of Jobs and Skills would be developed in the future with all of the different races and people in Asora. Even as he continued to laugh evilly in glee of his accomplishment.
***
Unaware that the Status System in Asora was finished, Alex continued on his way in the New World as he hunted down his next target, the Moby Dick.
With the magic compass pointing the way though, Alex knew he was headed in the right direction as he shot through the seas. And at his speed, he managed to arrive shortly after the sun went down.
Seeing a ship designed like a massive white whale, Alex shot out of the water and over the heads of the crew members on board while simultaneously canceling his Wereshark transformation.
"What the-?!"
"A Fishman?"
"It an attack!"
As Alex landed on the deck of the ship, he was immediately surrounded by numerous pirates with expressions of fury. But he just ignored the scrubs while focusing on the massive old man man sitting before him with numerous IVs connected to his body.
"Back off. None of you will be a match for him." The overly large man stated lazily.
"But pops-!"
"Listen to him. Besides, it's not like I'm here to kill a decrepit old man anyways." Alex told them with a smirk, before proceeding to take a seat in front of the old man.
"So what is it you want, dragon brat?" The old man sneered down at Alex with a voice full of contempt.
"Well, I just figured I'd come by to drop something off that belongs to you, Whitebeard." Alex told him with his a small smile, before waving his hand as another person appeared beside him.
"Huh? Pops!" Portgas D. Ace exclaimed in surprise, before seeing the old man before them.
"Ace? Where have you been?"
"That..." Ace began awkwardly, before Alex explained for him.
"My people picked him up right before he could challenge Teach. You're lucky we did, considering that if he had challenged Teach he would've lost."
"Oh?" Whitebeard asked with a snort of amusement. "And I suppose you want my thanks for 'saving' my son?"
"Not at all. I just wanted to return him to you, and make a proposition." Alex said while producing a couple large barrels of ale for them to drink.
"Is that so?" Whitebeard asked, even as he picked up the barrel and took a long drought of the ale inside without a single shred of caution.
"Yeah. You see, I have no official navy in my empire. As such, I think you'd make the perfect Fleet Admiral for it."
"..."
Silence met Alex's offer, for Whitebeard of all people to become his subordinate. An offer that infuriated all of the Pirates surrounding them as they talked.
"Gu.... GURARARARARARA!"
Everyone except Alex was surprised to see Whitebeard throwing his head back and laughing at his 'offer', before he began to slam his hand down on the arm of his chair, making the entire ship and even the surrounding area shudder from the impact.
"That is a good joke!" Whitebeard declared with a smirk, before taking another swig of the ale Alex gave him.
"It was no joke. I'm completely serious." Alex said to him, which made the smirk fade from Whitebeard's face. "Either you can join me on your own, or you can join me after I kick your ass up and down the New World."
"..."
"You're quite the cocky brat, aren't you." Whitebeard growled down at him, making Alex smirk as he took another swig of ale.
*CRASH!*
Whitebeard suddenly crushed the barrel of ale in one of his massive hands, sending the remaining ale splashing to the deck as he stood and ripped the IVs from his body.
"You seem to be forgetting something though..." Whitebeard stated as he reached for his naginata, Murakumogiri.
He then raised the weapon overhead, and swung it around with enough force that he created a cyclone that grew into a full blown tornado around himself and Alex.
"This is bad! Everyone back up!" Cried out Whitebeard's right hand man, and the commander of the First Division, Marco the Phoenix.
Even as they all fled, Whitebeard brought Murakumogiri down onto Alex's head at full force.
*CRAAAAASH!*
Cracks appeared in empty air above Alex's head courtesy of Whitebeard's Devil Fruit power, the Gura Gura no Mi, while the entire ship began to shake violently and powerful shockwaves began to spread out from it in every direction, creating massive tsunamis and clearing the skies of any cloud cover.
"I AM WHITEBEARD!"

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - 559: New World Rumble
chapters.content:
"I AM WHITEBEARD!"
As the declaration rang out, all of the Whitebeard Pirates watched the old man with awe from the show of force.
Even as old as he was, and with all of his health issues, he was easily considered one of, if not THE strongest man in the world. Especially due to the power of his Gura Gura no Mi, which was considered the strongest Devil Fruit in the Paramecia class, and widely believed to be capable of destroying the entire world.
But Whitebeard wasn't strong ONLY because of his Devil Fruit.
His physical strength and Haki dwarfed all others when he was in his prime, and despite his old age and deterioration, he was still significantly stronger than even the warrior giants of Elbaf.
Yet...
Despite all of that...
Despite even him using the power of the Gura Gura no Mi...
And despite him even using one of the twelve Supreme Grade Blades, Murakumogiri...
The Dragon Emperor hadn't even flinched from the attack that triggered tsunamis and cleared the skies.
Instead, Alex was still sitting on the deck of the Moby Dick, a casual smile on his face as he held up a single finger to stop Whitebeard's attack.
"So that's the power of the Gura Gura no Mi? You made my finger go all tingly~." Alex said to him, stunning not just Whitebeard, but all of his crew that were watching.
"No way...."
"He took pop's attack like it was nothing!"
"Look at him! He's just smirking at pops like this is funny!"
Meanwhile, as Alex smiled up at him wryly, and his 'sons' all murmured and whispered about him being able to stop his attack, Whitebeard's eyes just narrowed at him.
"You're a tough little shit, aren't you?" He growled at him.
"You have NO idea." Alex said back to him.
*BOOM!*
No one knew what happened, it was too fast for any of them to follow. But the moment those words left Alex's mouth, there was a concussive blast that forced them all back to the edge of the ship.
And when they were able to look up once more, Whitebeard was gone. Instead, standing directly in his place was the Dragon Emperor, his casual smirk never wavering in the slightest.
"Look!" One man cried out, directing everyone's attention to a figure flying to the horizon.
"""POPS!"""
They all cried out as they recognized the form of Whitebeard as he flew out over the open ocean.
"Damn..." The old man groaned as he saw the water inching ever closer, and no land or ship in sight for him to angle towards instead.
So naturally, he angled himself in midair and swung his fist down at the water itself, coating his hand in the power of the Gura Gura no Mi as he did so.
*BOING!*
"!?!?!"
Instead of splitting the sea like he'd wanted, Whitebeard was stunned to see the water surface STRETCH downward like it was made of rubber, before snapping back into place as the waves continued to roll and crash. Like there was nothing wrong at all.
"I see..." He rumbled as he realized what was happening, right before he hit the surface of the ocean with his body.
Normally this would be a death sentence as a Devil Fruit eater, but the water surface stretched and remained firm like it had a moment before as Whitebeard bounced atop it, before coming to a stop.
"So, you've awakened a Devil Fruit?" He uttered casually as he turned to see Alex standing there on the water surface behind him.
"One of them. I've got three, so I think I need to train the other two a bit more." Alex told him, shocking Whitebeard from the news.
"Oh? And how exactly did you manage to eat more than one Devil Fruit?" He asked curiously, as everyone knew you could only have one, and eating a second fruit would instantly kill you.
"Let's just say I wished upon some stars. But enough about that, let's fight!"
"Very well, you cheeky brat!"
Even as he cursed him, Whitebeard had a large smirk on his face from the worthy opponent before him. After all, when was the last time someone had managed to send HIM flying?
So he decided to get a bit serious as he set Murakumogiri to the side, and reached his hands up to 'grab' the empty air. And with his smile widening, Whitebeard dragged his hands down while leaving illusionary trails with his fingers to have a near instantaneous affect on their surroundings.
Alex smirked back at the old man as everything around him began to shift, the sea itself fragmenting and breaking apart while the entire region began to violently shake. And in every single direction shockwaves spread out through the sea floor, the sea itself, and the very air to impact every single one of the surrounding islands.
"Looks like fun~!" Alex said as he reached up to mimic the old man's movements. "Mind if I give it a try too?"
"!!!"
Whitebeard was shocked as Alex 'grabbed' the empty air in a way that mimicked his movements exactly, before pulling on it with a shit-eating grin.
The vibrations Alex created with Gravity magic directly clashed with the ones Whitebeard made with his Devil Fruit to create the most violent reaction yet, as earth, sea and sky were all torn asunder in a way that made anyone unfortunate enough to be caught up in it think it was the end of the world itself.
"You can't tell me you haven't ever thought about what it'd be like to fight someone with similar powers as yourself!" Alex declared with a massive grin, despite him and Whitebeard literally standing sideways by now with the effects they were having on their surroundings.
"You little brat!" Whitebeard cursed, even as his own grin matched Alex's.
Taking up Murakumogiri once more, he coated his beloved blade with the power of the Gura Gura no Mi, and rushed the Dragon Emperor once more while Alex did the same, even as he coated his fist with Gravity magic.
And as the two clashed, cracks spiderwebbed through the air to trigger shockwaves that could remodel the very face of the New World.
***
*BRRRRRRRRRRRRR! BRRRRRRRRRRRRR! BRRRRRRRRRRRRR!*
"WARNING! WARNING! SEISMIC ACTIVITY DETECTED! TSUNAMI DETECTED! ADVISORIES TO TAKE SHELTER AND SEEK HIGHER GROUND ARE NOW IN EFFECT! WARNING! WARNING! SEISMIC ACTIVITY-"
On an island that was known by many to be the Island of the Future, alarms were blaring as the people were frantically fleeing inland to seek safety in the shelters that were in place. If any of them had stopped to look out to sea, then they would have seen the massive wall of water coming their way as a result of the numerous earth and sea quakes that had been taking place.
"This data.... It could only be Whitebeard!" Declared a man with an apple-topped head, along with a tongue that was so long that it could be contained to his mouth.
But even as he looked over the data and readings being provided by his machines, the man couldn't figure out exactly what was going on. According to them, these seismic waves were coming from TWO opposing forces clashing against one another.
But that couldn't be the case!
Could it?
Was there truly someone who could match the great Whitebeard blow for blow?
"Such valuable data!" The man declared with stars in his eyes as he started reviewing every single detail.
"Sir! The tsunami is rapidly approaching the island! We need to get to higher ground!" Declared one of the numerous aides sent by the World Government to help him.
"Go yourself." The man said without looking up. Data like this was impossible to come across normally, so he certainly didn't plan to leave when there was so much to go over.
"But Dr. Vegapunk sir..." The man uttered helplessly, knowing there was nothing he could do to change his mind. So now his choices were to wait here with the mad scientist, and be swallowed by the wave, or to seek shelter and report that he'd left the world's most powerful brain to die.
"..."
He'll just stay right here...
The man clapped his hands together and looked skywards to utter a prayer to whatever gods he was about to meet, when something caught his attention outside the window of the laboratory.
"What is that sir?"
"Huh? Don't bug me!" The scientist declared as he continued reviewing the data.
"But sir... I think there's a girl flying above the island...?"
"Don't be preposterous-!" Vegapunk began irritably, before he just so happened to glance in the direction the man was looking in.
There, hovering in the sky above the island, was a woman who looked like she was wearing one of his specially designed futuristic suits, though one the likes of which he had never designed since it was notably quite erotic. But the most eye-catching thing about her was the long vibrant pink hair flowing behind her as she hovered there.
Numerous questions floated through both of their heads as they watched the woman hover there, briefly forgetting about the impending tsunami. But then they were surprised as several items appeared in the empty air around her.
The other man wasn't sure what they were, his only theory being some kind of weapons that she was about to use. Dr. Vegapunk however realized exactly what they were, even if he couldn't identify the individual pieces.
His theory was confirmed a second later as all of the pieces began to assemble themselves in a seemingly random fashion, until they formed a rifle the likes of which Vegapunk had never seen.
The woman then aimed the rifle at the steadily approaching wall of water, before firing it in what he immediately recognized as a beam. But it was a beam unlike any Vegapunk had ever seen before, appearing like it was being shot from a cannon instead of a rifle as it impacted the wall of seawater.
Originally the island of Egghead, where they were now, was a winter island that was fairly inhospitable. Shortly after arriving though, Vegapunk had terraformed the island to turn it into a tropical paradise. His efforts had obviously borne fruit on the island itself, but the surrounding waters were still those of a winter island.
As such, when the beam of concentrated energy hit the freezing water that was riddled with chunks of ice, it exploded into a massive cloud of vapor that swiftly engulfed the entire island, plunging them into a sea of thick fog instead of being swept away by a tsunami.
The fog didn't last long though, as it too was quickly blown away thanks to a massive fan the woman had created next, before she slowly drifted down towards the island.
"I-I think I recognize her!" The World Government employee stated when she got closer, and he recognized her features. "T-that's the Pink Devil! Lala Satalin Deviluke!"
"You know me?"
""!!!""
Both Vegapunk and the World Government employee whirled around as Lala's voice came from behind them, startling both since neither had realized she was there. Especially since she'd been out front a second ago.
"Hey!" Lala declared as she looked at Vegapunk with child-like innocence. "Can I look around your lab?"
***
"To think....we would finally be free from the wrath of Kaido, only to witness the end of the world..."
In response to the samurai's grave words, numerous nods and murmurs of agreement met his words as the people clung to each other right as the world shook yet again.
"Oh please..." Anne uttered with undisguised exasperation.
She KNEW the world was not ending. It was just her idiot of a husband getting carried away, yet AGAIN.
Thankfully, though the people of Wano didn't seem to realize it, they were protected from tsunamis here thanks to the geography of Wano itself.
Unlike other islands, with a coast at sea level that elevated as you went further inland, Wano was an island that was completely surrounded by sheer cliffs that were hundreds of feet high, while the interior was filled with water that flowed over in waterfalls. It was the reason the island had been able to maintain its isolationism for so long, since hardly anyone was actually able to enter the island to attack it.
At least, until Orochi brought Kaido in.
*CRACK!*
"Hm?" Anne looked up as a crack filled the air, along with a rumble that didn't belong to the ongoing battle. It was a lot closer.
Flying out using her Telekinesis, Anne searched for the source of the noise until she saw something that made her pause. The outer wall surrounding Wano was cracked.
"Shit!" The Dragon Empress swore uncharacteristically as she immediately used Regeneration magic to seal the crack, only for the air to rumble as another one formed. So she sealed that one as well, before another formed. And then another.
With each clash of Alex and his opponent, Anne was forced to fly all around Wano repairing the massive cracks forming in their outer walls. But it an endless task that was made all the more daunting when Anne heard something rumbling behind her.
Turning around, Anne found herself facing a wall of water hundreds of feet tall.
"..."
Seeing the massive wall of water, Anne promptly flew upwards to get out of the way since he didn't feel like trying to fight it. She could just repair whatever damage the wall took after the wave hit.
With a massive roar, the wave came crashing down on the outer wall of Wano with enough force that the entire island shook, but thankfully there was no real damage to the buildings or people. A moment later though, the sound of something tearing tore through the air as massive chunks of the outer wall came crashing down all at once from the force of the wave.
"Dammit..." Anne swore yet again, and was about to try and repair the damage, when something caught her eye.
As the walls came crashing down, the water filling the bowl had also began to flood out into the ocean. That wasn't what caught her eye, as that was to be expected. But what had was that as the water flowed out, entire cities were being revealed that had been long since submerged.
"What is all this...?" Anne uttered as she flew down to explore the ruins while the water was flowing out.
***
All over the New World similar scenes were playing out as the battle between Alex and Whitebeard raged, even all the way to the Red Line itself as shockwave after shockwave assaulted the massive strip of land.
"What is going on!?!" Demanded the Admiral Akainu as he tried to keep his footing stable, as he and three others looked out over the side leading to the New World.
"This power... This is Whitebeard! I can guarantee it!" Declared the Fleet Admiral Sengoku, recalling all the times he'd fought against Whitebeard in the past.
"Well what the devil is he doing?!" Akainu demanded irritably.
"He doesn't throw his weight around just for fun... He must be fighting someone!" Sengoku declared.
"Is that sooo~?" Drawled the second of the three Admirals present, Kizaru.
"I know what you're thinking Kizaru. Don't do it!" Sengoku ordered him sternly.
"Oh it's ok. I'll be right there and back~!" Kizaru said to assure him, which Sengoku wasn't, before his entire body dissolved into particles of light as he shot into the distance towards the source of the shockwaves.
"..."
*BOOM!*
The next thing any of them knew, the entirely of Mary Geoise was violently shaking for an entirely different reason, as something impacted the Red Line beneath it.
"What was that!?!" Sengoku exclaimed, before several men precariously went over the side of the cliff to check it out.
"I-it's Admiral Kizaru sir!" One of them shouted up to him after what felt like an eternity, making Sengoku pale even before the men slowly hauled up Kizaru's bloodied and battered body.
"He's alive!" One of them cried out.
"Get some medics over here!" Sengoku shouted out urgently, sending numerous men scrambling as they hurried to do just that.
And as they hurried too and fro, he looked down upon the man that had served under him for years. Sengoku couldn't recall the last time he'd seen Kizaru beaten so soundly, at least not since he'd eaten his Devil Fruit.
"Whitebeard did not do this..." He commented to no one in particular.
"The Dragon Emperor..." Akainu growled, giving voice to what they all thought.
There was no way to tell if the Dragon Emperor had done this to Kizaru, but there was no one else they could think of that had the strength to do so, even though none of them had even seen him fight. But based off the strength of his followers, it wasn't too far fetched that he himself would be exceptionally powerful.
But strong enough to instantly put an Admiral of all people so close to death?
No one said anything else as the medics arrived and carried Kizaru off to be treated, but the same thought was going through their minds even as the earth continued to shake beneath their feet, and massive waves crashed against the Red Line.
How do you fight against someone like that?
***
Marco the Phoenix and the rest of Whitebeard's crew all watched with bated breaths as the battle took place just beyond the horizon, even as they had to repeatedly fight against the seaquakes and tsunamis generated by their beloved pops.
"I've never seen pops go all out before..." One of them uttered in awe.
"If this is him NOW, imagine how strong he was in his prime..." Another answered.
But even as they muttered and whispered behind him, Marco could not hold back the fear that was growing in his heart.
Whitebeard was not well.
That was a fact that he knew intimately not only as his right hand man, but also as the old man's doctor.
Years of his heavy drinking, along with all the damage he's taken from uncountable battles, had finally caught up with Whitebeard. Now he was usually hooked up to numerous IVs and machines that Marco personally maintained night and day.
But with each second he wasn't hooked up to them, Whitebeard's health would rapidly decline. It was literally counting down the seconds to his death, to say nothing of whatever damage he was accruing during this battle with the Dragon Emperor.
"Huh?" Marco uttered as he noticed something approaching them, before realizing what it was. Or rather, WHO it was.
"Pops!" He cried out, alerting everyone else to what was happening.
"Catch him!"
"Don't let him fall into the sea!"
Even as they all shouted, Marco took action as his arms changed into wings wreathed in blue flames, allowing him to shoot upwards into the air towards Whitebeard.
With his strength it was easy for Marco to catch Whitebeard in his talons, where he then began using his blue flames to heal the numerous wounds on the old man's body while gently lowering him to the deck of the battered ship.
"Pops! Speak to me!" Marco demanded urgently, continuously channeling his flames even as he reverted to his human form. Never before had he, or ANY of those present seen their beloved pops beaten so badly.
"Man! That was a fun battle!" Alex exclaimed as he appeared behind Marco, immediately earning the wrath of the entire crew.
"You! Do you feel nothing after doing this to pops!" Marco demanded as flames flicked along his body.
"No? I mean, I already said I planned to recruit him. So why would I leave him like that?" Alex asked as if it were obvious, stunning Marco along with everyone else present.
"Hmmm...." Came a groan that drew everyone's attention back to Whitebeard, only to see him completely healed.
No.
He was BETTER than healed!
The old man, while being in his seventies, now easily looked a decade or two younger than he'd had before the battle began. His hair wasn't nearly as white anymore, his skin wasn't nearly as ashen or flabby as it was, and a quick look over told Marco that ALL of Whitebeard's debilitating injuries had vanished as well.
It was like looking at a completely different man!
"Brat... What did you do to me?" Whitebeard demanded of Alex as he slowly rose to his feet, examining and flexing the muscles of his own body as he did so.

"Oh? What brings someone as reclusive as yourself here?" Boomed one of the great gods as they noticed the figure approaching them.
They each towered over the figure by several times their height, and each one radiated power like none of the other gods could ever possess.
But the figure was not daunted.
"Demeter has either been killed, or stripped of her power in the lower world." They stated immediately.
"""!!!!"""
Each of the great gods reacted as they heard the news, though several of them had different reactions.
"You are sure?"
"Yes. I examined the fragments of her statue myself."
"And what is it you're wanting to do about this?"
"Let me descend to lower world, with my powers intact, to find the perpetrator and deal with them." The figure demanded without any hesitation.
"""..."""
The great gods were silent as they contemplated this request, before one stated to the others,
"Let them. If someone in the lower world can truly kill us or steal our powers, then we ALL are threatened."
"Agreed."
"I concure."
One by one they all voiced their agreement, before turning back to the figure and declaring,
"Gather a small group of fellow gods to provide support, and go. We will entrust this task to you, Hades."

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - 561: Slayer Versus Logia
chapters.content:
"Man... Goddesses are sure something else!" Alex exclaimed as he exited the room filled with dozens of the aforementioned goddesses, all slumbering peacefully after he thoroughly satisfied them.
Though none of them were pregnant like they had approached him for, every single goddess was willing to wait the few months or years until Alex was ready to impregnate them. They had all lived for hundreds of millions of years, so such a 'short' amount of time was nothing as long as they were able to conceive a child.
Even Alex's condition of joining his ever increasing army of wives was an acceptable condition, not only because they'd be able to have a child, but because Alex himself with his wives, children, and all of Asora, were so 'interesting' to them. The fact that he was such a satisfying fuck was just a bonus to the goddesses at this point, which they could all attest to now.
Unknown to them though, Alex also planned to return their respective divinities to them that had been left in the divine realm.
Every single god that descended to the mortal realm was required to leave the vast majority of their divine power in their own realm beforehand. This not only made it to where they could truly enjoy themselves in the mortal realm, but also that if their 'mortal' bodies were killed, they could return to the divine realm without actually dying.
BUT, if they were to become a part of Asora and join Alex's wives, then they would need access to all of their power.
That was for the near future though, since all of the aforementioned goddesses were currently catatonic, and Alex had more important things to attend to. Like his children.
Departing from the room, Alex transferred himself to the island that was set aside for his children to train on in the space-time orb. And once he was there, he found himself yet again facing a small horde of adults instead of his children.
"Again...?" Alex groaned as he became instantly mentally exhausted, even as he directed a look of blame at Bonney.
"Daddy!" Edith cried as she leapt over to his side, while her lethal weapons bounced noticeably as well to deal a critical hit to her father. Alex then made a mental note to have his wives teach their daughters about wearing bras already if they were going to keep doing this.
...
After returning them all to their appropriate ages, Alex decided to teach his children a new skill to see how well they'd be able to do it.
"Who here has heard about Haki before?" He asked them all, to which none of the children offered to answer. But that was fair, since Alex genuinely wasn't sure if any of them would have heard about it from him or their moms before.
"Haki is like the type of ki energy used in the pirate world I have been exploring the last few days. It is used in a different way than normal ki in that you can't create blasts with it. Instead, it can be used to sense your surroundings, attack those you can't normally attack, and maybe even see the future."
Pausing slightly when he mentioned the more advanced form of Observation Haki, Alex now had the undivided attention of all of the children.
"The first type is Armament Haki, which is often used to fight Devil Fruit users like myself, who have bodies that can't be hurt normally." Stretching himself out as he said that, Alex continued without pause, "It also works as a form of shield that can protect your body at the same time, and can even be applied to weapons to make them stronger.
"Secondly, is Observation Haki. This one can be used to sense people or animals in your surroundings, as well as predicting attacks right before they happen. It can also be used to attack since you can also see how your opponent may plan to dodge your attack."
Alex then went on to explain a bit more about these two forms of Haki, and how he wanted to train them to use them. Before they could start though, Bonney suddenly spoke up as she asked, "What about the third form of Haki?"
Alex looked at her while the rest of his children looked at him curiously, fighting back a sigh as he did so since he hadn't been planning to discuss that one today.
"There is a third form, like Bonney stated. BUT, it is a special type of Haki that only one in a million people can even use, while even less than that many ever actually unlock and master it. So for now, we're just going to focus on the two."
With that said, they then began a unique training session as Alex blindfolded all of the children and randomly tossed rocks at them. He had rubberized them of course, but each time they hit one of the kids it was still followed by a yelp due to the force that Alex would throw them at. Not hard enough to do actual damage, but still enough to hurt and encourage their training.
Mostly Alex wanted to see if his kids were even able to learn Haki, and the tests for Observation Haki were easy enough that he wouldn't need to be there with them to train it. And if they were able to unlock it, then he could give them proper training to learn the more advanced stages.
They kept the training up for about an hour, during which time the vast majority of the children were unable to show any signs of using Observation Haki, not that Alex expected any different. The exception though was Mai, who managed to successfuly dodge several of the rocks Alex threw at her, even when they came from different directions. However Alex figured he should've expected that, since she was a Nekomata like her mother and aunt, and more in tune to the world around her than the others.
"You....haaaa haaaa...are a demon....haaa haaaa...." Bonney panted while glaring at Alex hatefully after their 'light' workout that followed the Haki training.
"Not my fault you're so weak and out of shape." Alex replied with a shrug, making Bonney look at him incredulously.
"Its ok Bonney! You'll get used to it eventually!" Alec declared as he tried to cheer her up. Though Alex noted that his son's cheeks had a tinge of red to them as he tried to encourage her.
!!!
'My little boy has his first crush!' Alex mentally exclaimed, a feeling of pride welling up within him at the realization. A feeling that he would NOT be feeling if it was one of his daughters instead.
"Daddy?" Called Anna, stirring Alex from his thoughts about Alec's first crush as he looked down at his daughter lovingly.
"Yes Anna?"
"Do we REALLY need to learn how to use Haki?" She asked innocently.
"No, not really. But my belief is that its better to have something and not need it, than to need it and not have it." Alex said sagely, though it seemed none of his children seemed to understand what he was saying.
"Basically, what if you end up fighting someone with the power of a Devil Fruit, like me or uncle Bova, and nothing you can do works because they're immune to punching and kicking? Some of you, like Alec, would be alright, but others wouldn't. So thats why I decided to teach you all how to use Haki."
As he said that, Alex glanced at his eldest son pointedly since his abilities as an Omni-Slayer would make him the natural counter to any Logia Devil Fruit users, while he'd also be able to fight against any Zoan and Paramecia users that someone would normally need Haki to fight against. In fact, Alex wouldn't even hesitate to say his son could probably solo all three of the Admirals without a problem since they were all Logia users.
Not that Alex would readily test his theory.
Just imagining Anne's reaction was enough to send shivers down his spine.
BUT, maybe there was someone who could actually help them see what it was like to fight a Logia user. Someone much safer for them to test their skills against than an Admiral, or even Akeno with her Ragu Ragu no Mi.
It wasn't that Alex didn't trust Akeno, but she could often become....passionate in such matters.
Deciding on his decision, especially since he needed to deal with them anyways, Alex sent Hancock a message while transporting himself, and the children, to a different island. And a moment later, they were joined by an excited Hancock along with all of her new recruits, and her top officers, including her sisters.
"DARLING~!" Hancock cried out the second she saw Alex, leaping forward to smother his face within her breasts. If it were anyone else then he would've dodged so that his daughters wouldn't try to emulate her, but then he'd have to deal with a devastated Hancock.
"It's nice to see you too Hancock." Came Alex's muffled voice from within the valley of her breasts.
"Oh my beloved! I counted every second of every minute, hour, and day until you'd return to me!" Hancock proclaimed like a fanatical devotee, which Alex guessed she was. That suddenly raised a question in his mind, did she know about his priestesses? And if she did, would she join or try to fight them?
Questions that would hopefully take a while to answer, especially since Alex had more important things to worry about right now.
When he was finally able to 'escape' Hancock's bust, Alex cleared his throat while looking over the group of women that had arrived with her. As requested, it was only the top warriors of her crew, and the newest recruits from her raid on Marineford.
Though several of the former Marines were still looking at Alex with undisguised hostility, like Tashigi, the vast majority were now looking at him curiously after spending the entire day in the space-time orb. The giantess specifically had a look bordering on reverence as she looked at him.
"Since everyone's here, then lets get started." Alex said, before producing the few hundred stone statues that were the male Marines from Marineford.
"What are these statues dad~nya?" Mai asked curiously as she stepped forward to look at them.
"These are all men that Hancock turned into stone. But now, I'm going to turn them back." Alex said, before doing just that with a wave of his hand as he use Regeneration magic.
"""!!!"""
Instantly every single statue turned into a person that was battle ready, since they all thought they were still fighting back in Marineford. Only a few of the higher ranking officers had the awareness to notice the change in their surroundings.
"Where are we?!" One demanded, before focusing his attention onto Alex.
"The Dragon Emperor!?!"
"AND the Pirate Empress!"
"How dare you attack the Marines!"
In the face of their immediate hostility, Alex just rolled his eyes. Though he did keep an eye on the few that were remaining calm, mostly the Vice Admirals and a few that were lower in rank, like Smoker.
"Humph! Stupid men that can't even see they already lost." Sandersonia sneered in contempt at them, annoying them while also making them realize the difference in scenery, along with the fact that now their female comrades were standing alongside the enemy.
"What is the meaning of this?" Asked another giant on the Marine's side, John Giant.
"After your defeat I drafted these women into the Kuja Pirates." Hanock readily answered, purely for the sake of speeding this conversation up as much as possible. She detested having to speak to these filthy men more than absolutely necessary.
"I see..." John Giant answered slowly while looking over the gathered women, especially his fellow giantess. However, as he did so, he noticed a peculiar look in her eye as she glanced at the Dragon Emperor repeatedly, seemingly trying to tell him something.
That would have to wait though, since the matter with Alex specifically was more important.
"So, can I assume you didn't unpetrify us for no reason?" He asked the emperor.
"Of course." Alex answered, before adding, "But before we get into that, how about a sparring match Smoker?"
Looking towards the man with several cigars in his mouth as he asked that, Alex had a wide smirk on his face to contrast the other man's perpetual scowl.
"I won't say no, but why?" Smoker growled, not trusting Alex or his suspicious smirk. But they needed to know more about where they were and what was going on, so buying time was the best option available.
"Earlier I was teaching my kids a bit about using Haki, and how it was useful against certain Devil Fruit users. As a Logia user, I was hoping you'd help them understand firsthand." Alex explained while gesturing to his kids, who were all looking at Smoker and the gathered Marines curiously.
"Are you serious?" Smoker growled irritably, annoyed that they were only unpetrified because it was convenient for a bunch of brats.
"Completely. But maybe you want the deal to be sweetened a bit?" Alex asked with a business-like smile, as his devilish side bubbled to the surface.
"IF you manage to beat my son, then I will readily release ALL of you to go back to the Marines, including those Hancock 'drafted', along with a detailed report of my numbers, fighters, and how I plan to invade Mary Geoise."
"""!!!"""
Needless to say that every single Marine present was stunned at Alex's offer, before it was followed by immediate suspicion.
"What's the catch?" Smoker asked with narrowed eyes, not at all trusting Alex or his offer.
"How about.... When you lose, then every single Marine present with swear their loyalty to me, join my own Marine corp that is currently being formed, and will participate in the coming assault on Mary Geoise?"
"""!!!"""
Again, stunned silence met Alex's proposal as every single Marine weighed the two possible outcomes. Either they'd be able to return back with valuable intel on the greatest enemy the World Government has ever seen, or they would be forced to join his forces and fight the very organization they once swore to serve.
"He accepts." John Giant declared on Smoker's behalf, which was also an indirect order as his superior officer.
It was too good an opportunity for them to pass up, since they didn't even know what it was Alex planned to do to them to begin with. At least this way they had a shot to return somewhat victorious with valuable intel.
What John Giant didn't know was that there was already a mole within Alex's inner circle that was feeding information directly to the World Government via CP9, Kalifa. But of course Alex didn't care about her leaking their information, or just handing it over to John Giant IF Smoker managed to win, as it wouldn't change the outcome in the slightest.
"Very well." Smoker fought back a groan as he stood and made his way before Alex, running his eyes over the numerous small brats before him as he did so.
Truthfully, he doubted this would be that much of a fight if they didn't even know the basics of Haki, even if they were impressive for a bunch of brats. But all he'd have to do is humor them a little, and they'd be allowed to go free.
"Excellent!" Alex declared happily, before turing towards one of his children in particular. "You're up Alec."
Alex's eldest son stepped forward with an eager smile as he swung his arms to warm them up in anticipation. But as he walked by his father, Alex whispered in voice that only Alec heard while nudging him, "Maybe Bonney will see how cool you are during this fight."
"!!!"
Alec immediately blushed from embarrassment at his father's comment, making Alex laugh at his son's innocence. But his serious expression soon returned as he stood before Smoker.
"I'd take this seriously if I were you Smoker. The first move is yours." Alex warned him while taking a step back.
Though he'd never admit it with his opponent being a child, Smoker fully intended to take this fight seriously from the start with the stakes being what they were.
"White Blow!" Smoker cried out suddenly, his fist launching forward at Alec as his arm turned into a cloud of white billowing smoke.
Shocking! The guy named Smoker had a body made of smoke!
In all honesty it was an attack that had spelled the end of many a pirate unfortunate enough to cross paths with Smoker, but to the SSJ2 Alec, it might as well have been standing still. Even if Alec wasn't even transformed at this moment.
The little boy calmly sidestepped out of the fist's path as it flew right by him, but Smoker wasn't fazed by his speed as he controlled his fist to turn to make a circle around Alec, allowing him to entrap the young boy in a cage of smoke. But then Alec did something incomprehensible, as he GRABBED the plume of smoke with both hands while simultaniously opening his mouth as wide as possible.
"!!!"
Smoker quickly dissipated his arm and fist while reforming them out of his body, having felt chills the moment Alec made to bite him while questions filled his mind. But he wasn't given any time to ponder them.
Though it was no longer a part of his body, Alec STILL grabbed onto the residual smoke that hung in the air before shoveling it into his mouth, stunning Smoker and everyone else present as he proceeded to eat the smoke.
"What the-!?"
"He's an ability user!?!"
"What kind of ability is THAT?"
Exclamations and mutterings persisted amongst the group of Marines from Alec's strange actions, while Alex's smile just widened. They all then watched as smoke began to emit from Alec's body, and whitish scales formed in patches on his skin as his black hair lightned and turned whispy.
The young boy then turned a predatory eye towards Smoker as the vapor surrounding his body began to gather around his hands, which began to shift into draconic claws.
"Smoke Dragon's Claws!" He roared while surging forward at speeds that Smoker couldnt follow, before slashing his body with his newly formed claws.
Despite Smoker's attempt to dodge the attack, his blood sprayed as Alec's craconic claws raked his arm to give him what was probably the most serious wound he had received after eating his Devil Fruit. And then, as if that wasn't shocking enough, Alec pivoted on his heel to deliver a punch right into Smoker's gut that sent him flying.
"What is this?!" One of the Marine Vice Admirals uttered in disbelief as Alec proceeded to use his new abilities to beat up Smoker.
"THAT, is the omni slayer." Alex said, as if that explained everything.
"What kind of Devil Fruit is that?" One of the Marines asked in fearful awe.
"It's not a Devil Fruit, but a type of magic. Like Logia fruits, slayers come in different elements that they are able to control and use. But, instead of turning their bodies intangible like Logia users, their defense and strength is significantly higher than normal. They're also immune to whichever element they use, and able to EAT said element to become even stronger."
Alex's explanation earned him numerous looks of disbelief, firstly at the idea of magic, and then at the abilties he had described. But, with Alec using said abilties right in front of them, it was hard for them to refute him.
What Alex didn't tell them was that Alec, being an omni slayer, usually only had each element that he'd 'eaten' for a short while compared to the full time that typical slayers had. Except, what Alex didn't know was that as Alec used the smoke slayer powers he had obatined, he also received a notification through their new Asoran system stating that he had received them as an active ability.
They all watched as Alec and Smoker continued to fight, with the latter doing all that he could to try and defeat the child, while the former used his newly acquired smoke slayer powers to corner the Marine Commodore.
As the fight went on every other Marine had to swallow the bitter pill of realization that Smoker was NOT going to win their little agreement, and no one was more crushed by that fact than his own protégé, Tashigi.
In fact, all she saw was the criminal and enemy of justice, Alex, using this chance to humiliate them and show how futile their actions were. To her credit, she was partially right in this assumption since Alex was showing them just how strong his children were, to say nothing of his wives and armies. The former of which she had seen in action for herself during her stay in the space-time orb.
"Alright. Thats enough Alec." The Dragon Emperor suddenly called out, right before Smoker hit the ground in front of him HARD, covered in wounds from their fight while there was barely a scratch on Alec.
"Ok dad!" The little slayer replied as he appeared next to Smoker, the smoke and scales on his body vanishing while his claws returned to being hands.
"THAT, is a Logia fruit user." Alex then stated pointedly to the rest of his children, who were all watching with wide eyes as Smoker's body continued to remain smokey as it shifted between tangible and intangible.
"Cool..." Ryuto uttered as he watched the process, while a few other children also seemed really interested in the power of a Logia. Alex made a mental note to see if any of them would want any from the Admirals after he killed them.
Though he COULD keep the Logia fruits for himself if he wanted, Alex didn't really see the point with the powers he already had. With Devil magic he could spam any elemental attack he wanted, and if he truly desired to do so Alex could even develop slayer type abilities like Alec and some of his other children had, and the power of Nika already rendered him immune to blunt force attacks while the power he took from Buggy rendered him immune to blade attacks.
So, if he ate any more Devil Fruits, Alex figured they would probably be gimmick fruits like the chop and invisibility fruits were, ones that he could have fun with.
Instead, it would make more sense to give an ice Logia to someone like Yuki or Aurora, both of which were actual Yuuki-Onna, or a magma fruit to Regal since he was a Pheonix, or the light fruit to Edith as an angel, both literally and figuratively.
"U-Um.... Excuse me..." One of the Marines suddenly spoke, up, drawing Alex from his thoughts as he looked over the crowd.
"Yes?"
"This means....that we are traitors to the World Government now?" The Marine asked hesitantly, making every other person direct their attention to Alex for an answer. After all, his condition was that when Smoker lost they would join him.
"I wouldn't go so far as to call each of you traitors. After all, it was the World Government and the Celestial Dragons that basically claimed ownership of the world while enslaving the entire populace to their whims and to fund their activities. Instead, think of it as 'opening your eyes'." As he said that, Alex used Spirit magic to directly transfer all of the information his wives and agents had been collecting ever since they had arrived in the One Piece world.
Just about every single noble and royal family that actively supported the Celestial Dragons were rotten to the core, which made it extremely easy for Alex's people to turn their own country against them once their more scandalous secrets were revealed for the world to know. Amongst the intel they had collected, specific examples involved poisoning or otherwise sabotaging any possible opposition within their borders, tyrannical laws and regulations that showed no value towards human life, and even numerous examples of mass genocide or enslavement just to appease the Celestial Dragons.
One example was the burning of the Grey Terminal, an area outside the walls of the Goa Kingdom where Luffy had grown up that was where all of the trash used by the citizens was disposed of. Of course, the massive mountains of trash became home to entire communities of people that were homeless or poor. But then, when word spread that a Celestial Dragon was coming to visit, the royal family approved of a plan to burn all of the trash to clear it away, regardless of the lives that would be lost due to this.
Another example was the truth behind the destruction of the island of Ohara that Robin was from, which was reported that the scolars there intended to revive ancient and powerful weapons to use on the world. The truth of the matter though was that they simply wanted to study an unknown section of history, which the World Government intentially wiped out because it was 'inconvenient' to them.
Alex even showed them numerous situations where the Marines, the agents of 'turth' and 'justice', abused their power and position to promote suffering amongst the people. One was the situation that resulted in Zoro joining Luffy, in which he had been branded a criminal solely because he stopped a little girl from being killed for bumping into the son of an officer. Another had been how an entire island was under the control of the pirate Arlong for several years, while a Marine on Arlong's payroll hid his actions from the world.
With how thorough Alex's people were in their information collecting, teams of Devils of course, there was no shortage of examples to show them from just the last several decades of both nobility and Marines abusing their power to oppress, humiliate, and even flat out murder the very people they were supposed to be ruling or protecting. Even the bundle of justice that was Tashigi was at a loss for words upon seeing Zoro's reason for becoming a pirate.
"Thats just a taste of what the World Government has allowed to happen or even caused over the last eight hundred years. Now tell me, can ANY of you truly call yourselves 'enforcers of justice' knowing all that?" Alex asked as they finished processing everything he had shown them.
Of course, they could just try to claim that it was all fake to make them question themselves, but none of them could find it in them to do that. Especially those that had directly participated in some of the things Alex showed them the truth of, like the destruction of Ohara.
Only a few of the Marines appeared unfazed at the info, and Alex made sure to note them for later since they were most likely the type of Marines that were either corrupted, or believed their position granted them the right to kill as they saw fit.
"Just a little food for thought while you're staying here." Alex said to them, before then using magic to create numerous buildings for housing and so on since he wasn't going to have Hancock re-petrify them just yet. Just in case, Alex also added several layers of barriers around the island to ensure that none of the Marines left it, either by sailing, swimming, or by Devil Fruit powers. Smoker wasn't the only Devil Fruit user amongst them after all.
As for why Alex was going through so much to give them a chance, it was because not all of the Marines were bad.
Several, like Tashigi and Smoker, were true believers of justice, and were flexible in how they would obtain it. Others meanwhile were simply unwitting pawns in the machinations of the World Government.
So, having planted the seed of doubt within them, Alex left the Marines to stew for a while on the island as they thought over everything he had shown them, as well as the strength of just ONE of his young children, which would make them wonder about the strength of Alex's entire empire.
Alex meanwhile went to spend more time with his children now that their training was done for the day, which turned into a game of SSJ tag much to Bonney's chagrin.
***
*Meanwhile, back in the New World...*
"They came back?!"
"They've been gone for over fifty years..."
"I wonder where they've been?"
Mutterings followed two figures as they made their way through their home, which they hadn't seen in over fifty years.
Normally they would be overjoyed to be back home, but right now they had a very important mission as they approached the most powerful and respected figure amongst their people. They had to report, that the sun god had returned.

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - 562: Are You Robbing Me?
chapters.content:
(A.N. RIP Akira Toriyama, the founder of many childhoods, and a man who's creation inspired millions all over the world.)
Winter Schnee stood tall and proud even as dozens of ferocious Beowolves surrounded her, the sound of their snarling filling the air as drool dripped from their mouths. Despite their ferocious attitude and bearing, Winter couldn't help but feel slightly dissatisfied since she had been hoping for a stronger opponent.
Well, their numbers would have to make up for it.
With a growl the first Beowolf lunged at her with its claws and fangs bared to rend her flesh, but Winter smoothly sidestepped it with natrual movements even as the others followed suit.
For several seconds she naturally dodged the claws and teeth of her opponents, her body moving on instinct after years of combat experience and instruction, but that wouldn't be enough to help against so many opponents without her fighting back at all. Sure enough, Winter soon became overwhelmed as one of the Beowolves raked it's claws down her back.
Normally, her Aura would be enough to guard against such an attack, but this time she had willingly allowed the claws to tear through her clothes before slicing clean through into her flesh. And naturally, Winter had expected the usual pain one would expect from receiving such an attack.
But, there was nothing.
Instead....
"AWOOOOOOOOOOOO!"
The Beowolf howled with pain and fury as ice coated the paw that had attacked Winter, only for it to shatter when it tried to put it's weight onto it.
Meanwhile, the gash on Winter's back showed no blood nor flesh, only a chunk of ice that slowly repaired itself after being torn open, and closed before her clothes themselves reformed as well.
"Amazing...." Winter uttered in awe of her new power, the power of the Hie Hie no Mi. It was one of the items called a Devil Fruit that they were able to purchase through the Chatroom shop with the points that they earned, but Winter hadn't bought it.
Instead, she had received the Devil Fruit as 'reward' for a certain surprise quest she had received the other day. A quest that, just by recalling it, the temperature around her plummeted further than it already was as a chilly expression appeared on her face.
"Ice Age." She declared cooly, and suddenly the entire area around her was covered in a layer of ice, not that it appeared any different from before. But the biggest difference was that all of the Beowolves around her had frozen as well, turning them into large ice statues that would shatter at the slightest impact.
With a wave of her hand, Winter did just that as she conjured several large sickles of ice that shot at the frozen Grimm, shattering them and ending their lives. But her expression hadn't changed as she recalled that humiliating experience.
"Fross?" Cried out the figure that emerged from her shadow with a worried expression on it's face, the Pokemon Frosslass that she had received before.
"I'm ok, Frosslass." Winter said to assure it, though her face was still crimson from humiliation.
Her expression remained the same as she desperately tried to think of something other than the price she paid for this otherwise amazing ability, which consisted of every ounce of her dignity and self respect. She even struggled to avoid likening herself to a prostitute since she had essentially sold her body for it.
Returning to her personal airship, Winter quickly turned it on and prepared to return to Atlas now that she had finished testing her new powers for the day. They truly were amazing, and gave her the potential to take on even entire armies without the need for Dust, or the risk of getting injured.
But the girls in the Chatroom were adamant in reminding her that the powers still carried numerous weaknesses, such as making her unable to swim and so on. Winter took their warnings very seriously, especially since in this world of Remnant there were numerous people with the power called Semblances, any one of which could give someone an ability that directly countered her.
Trying to get her mind off of her previously shameful actions that led to her acquiring the Devil Fruit, which indicated that she must've done well in the surprise quest, Winter turned on the radio to listen to any news that was going on in the world. Though that only added to her worries when she heard the report.
"And in other news, a shipment of Dust from the SDC(Schnee Dust Company) has been stolen by the White Fang! This is only the latest in a recent string of violent actions taken by the Faunus extremist group, and many believe that their actions will only escalate!"
Winter narrowed her eyes from the news as she turned the volume down, her mind wandering.
Though she was no longer considered a part of her family, Winter was still concerned about the direction the company was going under her father's command. Originally founded by her maternal grandfather, the company was now being dragged through the mud due to the numerous questionable practices being put into place by her father, such as the mistreatment of it's Faunus employees.
This made them a primary target of the White Fang once they started taking a more extreme approach in fighting against the oppression they had experienced from humans, and was drawing more and more attention to their current questionable practices.
But as she started worrying about the future of the SDC with the Faunus, Winter also realized something that made her blood run cold(or was it hot since she was now made of ice?).
How would Alex react when he finally arrived in Remnant, and his children or wives were mistreated for being 'Faunus'?
(A.N. So I originally planned to give Winter an ability outside of a Devil Fruit since I had been using them so much lately, but all the ones I found were redundant or pointless, like Ice Make when she can use Glyphs, or Esdeath's ability until I saw that it drives the user insane. As you can see, in the end I just went back to Devil Fruits...)
***
"Amazing..." Uttered a woman with bright red hair that was styled into a high ponytail, as she poured over several samples of different metals. Metals the likes of which she, nor anyone else in the world of Remnant, had ever heard of.
Pyrrha Nikos was amazed at the reward she had received from the previous surprise quest, which was a package containing several samples of different types of metals from throughout the Omniverse. It was a reward perfectly suited to her for two specific reasons.
Firstly was her Semblance, Polarity. It allowed her to control even non-magnetic metals however she wished, which she typically used subtly in combat to make her opponents weapons miss her, or to retrieve her spear and shield.
Secondly was that she could imbune her weapons and armor with the different types of metal, making them significantly stronger than they already were after Lala's upgrades.
"What do you think?" She asked the little bipedal canine standing beside her.
"Ri!" Riolu barked in approval as it admired the metals as well. Pyrrha was already making plans to make a set of armor for it as well, to protect it when they fought against Grimm.
Of the different metals though, the two she was most interested in trying out was Vibranium, and Adamantium. The biggest problem she was having was figuring out how to actually rework the metals into her weapons and armor...
***
"Na na na na, na na na! Na na na na, na na na!"
As darkness descended on one city in particular, a solitary girl was wandering the streets dressed in red and black gothic attire, completed by a red hood that covered her head. Under the hood was a pair of headphones blasting one of her favorite songs, even as she entered a shop called From Dust Till Dawn.
The girl was in a good mood after spending the day talking to the other girls on the Chatroom about weapons and other cool inventions, mainly Lala and the two Bulmas. She still didn't quite understand how there could be TWO of one person, but the girl accepted it.
Currently however Lala was busy touring the lab of some genius guy in another world, something that one of the other girls in the Chatroom aid was supposed to be a 'euphemism' for something, but neither the girl nor Lala understood what she was talking about.
Anyway...
During their discussions the girl learned that the others didn't know about Dust, and when she described it to them they became interested in it and it's various applications. She of course focused on weapon augmentation and different styles of ammunition that Dust can be used for, but the others wanted to be able to test and see it for themselves.
Naturally, this led to the girl going to a Dust store to go and buy whatever she could with her allowance. By herself of course, since Yang was busy preparing to go to Beacon Academy. Normally the girl would be sad and lonely about her sister leaving in a few weeks, but with her pokemon Scyther to keep her comany she was ok.
Focusing on her current task though, the girl looked over the selections of Dust that the store had for sale to see how much she could buy with her savings. Soon however she became distracted by a weapons catalog on one of the back shelves, which she readily grabbed and opened to read.
As such, she missed the tinkling of the bell as a group of men dressed in black suits with matching bowler hats, and red ties and sunglasses, walked in after another man with a cane and orange hair. That was, until they started clearing out the stock of Dust from the store, and one noticed her standing alone in the back.
Feeling a rough hand grab her shoulder and spin her around, the girl found herself face-to-face with one of the thugs as he looked down at her angrily, gesturing to indicate her headphones as he did so.
"Yes?" She asked while lowering them politely.
"I said put your hands in the air, NOW." He commanded irritably.
"Are you....robbing me?" She asked confusedly.
"Yes!"
"Ohhh..."
***
At the same time, in an entirely different world, a celebration was going on in what others would only call an icy hell, but the people there called home.
Princess Yue of the Nothern Water Tribe watched as the best masters of waterbending amongst their tribe performed for them, bending the water in ways that most of their tribe could only dream of. Unknownst to them though, Yue was also streaming the display for Katara of the Southern Water Tribe, allowing her to see real waterbenders at work for the first time in her life.
Unfortunately Yue missed the last of the performance, as Katara abruptly said goodbye due to some kind of circumstance. As a result, Yue was slightly surprised when she heard her father, Chief Arnook, speak.
"Thank you Master Pakku, for that wonderful display!" He declared, leading the rest of the people present in applause as the master in question bowed respectfully, and departed alongside his disciples.
As silence returned to the grand hall, Yue listened as her father thanked everyone for attending the feast.
Feasts and celebrations were quite rare for their people due to the fact that they literally lived at the North Pole, and as such they were unable to form any farms. Instead their diets consisted of whatever they were able to hunt, with sea prunes and seaweed making up almost all of the vegetation they ate.
This time was an exception however, and Yue knew why that was as she glanced at one warrior in particular, who appeared exceptionally smug.
"Thank you all for coming tonight! I know we have little enough to celebrate in the last hundred years, but tonight is an exception due to a decision regarding the future of our great tribe!" Chief Arnook declared, earning him numerous applause along with mutterings as everyone wondered what the announcment was.
Yue couldn't help but to notice several of the men in the tribe look at her expectantly, both young and old. She was already past that age, so it was expected that someone would be decided to become her husband soon, and that someone would become the chief of the tribe after her father.
Unknown to them the man her father had decided upon was already chosen secretly, and this was just the night they decided to announce it. But, wether or not Yue would accept it was another story.
"Tonight I have the tremendous honor of announcing the engagement of my daughter, princess Yue, with a young warrior of great skill and repute. Many of you know him and had heard of him, young Hahn!"
At the chief's introduction applause once again filled the hall, as both Hahn and Yue stood to meet each other before the eyes of all of those gathered.
"Spheal?" Cried the little pokemon that had become Yue's closest companion ever since she had received it from Cynthia.
"Its ok Spheal." She told it soothingly, before approachign Hahn.
"Princess Yue. I, Hahn, offer you this necklace as a sign of our engagement before our tribe." Kneeling as he said so, Hahn held out a beautifully carved pendant on a length of blue ribbon.
Silence descended upon the hall as everyone awaited Yue's anticipated acceptance. But then something happened that none of them expected.
"Thank you, warrior Hahn, for your sentiments. But I cannot accept your betrothal." Yue declared, stunning everyone present, but none more so than her parents.
Turning towards them then, she continued firmly,
"My hand belongs to one other, a man of great power and leadership who the Northern Water Tribe would benefit greatly from a union with. A man, who we could never afford to offend. The Dragon Emperor."
Stunned silence met her declaration, until Hahn demanded angrily, "The 'Dragon' Emperor!?! Dragon as in the Fire Nation!?!"
Angry muttering met his demand, as the idea that Yue had accepted a betrothal from the Fire Nation spread like...well, fire, throughout the crowds.
"Silence!" Chief Arnook declared, bringing silence to the hall once more, before he turned towards his daughter with a rare expression of anger on his face. "Explain yourself Yue."
The princess opened her mouth to try and explain herself, but no sound came out as she tried to figure out how to do just that. Truthfully this was her own fault, as the engagement had been confirmed months ago, and was only being publicly announced tonight. She probably should have said something before now.
Before Yue could say anything to try and defend herself though, she noticed a notification on the chatroom that she opened, before there was a blinding light in front of everyone.
When the light faded it revealed another betrothal necklace, one made of ice that would never melt, bound in a black leather cord.
Every eye was on the necklace as it floated in mid air, before it slowly descended and wrapped itself snugly around Yue's neck. The ice pendant was cold, but not uncomfortably so to someone who lived literally surrounded by ice every second of every day.
And then it shimmered suddenly, before an image appeared in the air before Yue that everyone saw, one of a hulking man with wild black hair.
"Princess Yue is mine." The figure proclaimed in a booming voice, giving no room to argue or protest. Not that anyone would, as they all readily knelt before what they believed could only be a Spirit from the Spirit World.
***
"Yippie!"
"Mime Mime!"
"Yippie!"
"Mime Mime!"
"Yippie!"
Ty Lee cried out cheerfully as she lightly tossed her little Mime Jr into the air over and over, a game the little pokemon thoroughly enjoyed as she giggled and flailed her little arms about happily.
The game continued until someone knocked on the pole outside Ty Lee's tent, and she caught Mime Jr one last time before looking over and saying, "Come in."
The flap was opened by none other than the circus ringmaster, who smiled warmly at her as he said,
"Good evening Ty Lee. I just came by to give you a letter that arrived." Handing her a rolled up slip of paper as he said so, Ty Lee readily accepted it believing it was a message from her family.
Ty Lee's parents were nobles from the Fire Nation while she was one of seven identical septuplets, which was part of why she ran away to join the circus since she didn't want to be part of a 'set' for her whole life. Despite that though, she maintained a decent enough relationship with her family, with them often sending letters back and forth.
Just as Ty Lee began to unroll the parchment though, she caught sight of the crest of the royal family at the top.
"Oh! It's from Azula!" Ty Lee exclaimed with her usual bubbly positivity.
"Mime?" Mime Jr asked her worriedly, apparently sensing the unease Ty Lee wouldn't even admit to herself was there.
Ty Lee however unrolled the parchment all of the way and read what was written, before she turned towards Mime Jr and declared, "Azula is coming to see us! Isn't that exciting?"
Despite her upbeat attitude and expression though, Ty Lee's hands began to shake just so slightly at the thought of meeting one of her oldest friends again.
***
"Amazing..."
Suki couldn't help but be amazed as she looked over the items she had received from the Chatroom, which had been rewards for the last surprise quest.
Like Winter, Suki had only gone through with the quest to avoid the punishment, and still felt deeply ashamed for doing so. Especially when she thought about how she had been caught in the act by her fellow warriors.
She couldn't deny that the rewards she had received from it were quite amazing though.
Basically, they were plans and diagrams for numerous tools and weapons that would greatly enhance their combat capabilities, like small capsules that would explode into clouds of smoke when broken, or blades that could be attached to their wrists to be sheathed or unsheathed with a simple wrist movement. Most amazingly though, was the numerous scrolls she received that detailed numerous combat styles that she and her fellow warriors could learn.
"Wow captain! You got all this just for a sexy pose?"
