Once that was done Whitebeard pointed Murakumogiri forward and declared, "take out those cannons!"
As the Fleet Admiral of Asora, the only ones present with higher authority than whitebeard were Alex and his wives, so every single ship prepared to attack at his command. Those with cannons prepared to fire them, while the Nordic ships also had a number of powerful mages on board that readied their spells, before everything was released in one massive bombardment at the Marines.
Metal cannonballs and the elements themselves devastated the Marine lines as numerous ships took irreparable damage, and the alcoves in the cliffs were destroyed.
Even some of the girls got in on the action, with Yue creating massive dragons out of seawater that sucked entire Marine ships into their gaping maws.
Within seconds any semblance of military might the Marines possessed was destroyed, their warships sinking to the bottom of the ocean while the cannoneers stationed throughout the cliffs were systematically destroyed.
"Are you going to participate?" Alex asked Hermione.
"What?! Why would I willingly participate in such barbarism?" She huffed while turning away from him indignantly.
Alex just shrugged at her as he said, "just thought I'd ask since this would be a good chance to practice some of those spells you've been working on."
That made Hermione reconsider slightly, as she wasn't actually against the act of fighting, just the senseless slaughter that seemed to be taking place.
While she was still deliberating though...
"BEHIND US!"
A cry rang out from one of the rear ships to the others, alerting them to numerous figures approaching them from the rear.
***
"All things considered Sengoku, I can't say I disagree with sending half our fleet to surround them in a pincer attack." Warcury said as they watched their ships close in on the Dragon Emperor's fleet.
"Indeed. While all their attention is at us, the warships behind them can take them before they can defend themselves." Sengoku explained, though he was starting to have his doubts after witnessing the destruction the Dragon Emperor's fleet was capable of.
Even with the help of Whitebeard and Big Mom, he had expected that their forces would be able to put much more of a fight and last longer against their combined forces, and when the other half of their fleet appeared they could attack from two sides.
But seeing the casual destruction they were capable of dishing out, to the point that entire ships were being 'eaten' by living water, he was starting to wonder if the cost of victory would even be worth it. IF they even won to begin with.
"Garp, go ahead and cause some chaos." Sengoku ordered the elderly Vice Admiral beside him.
"You sure about that? I can't guarantee that I won't cause some collateral damage!" Garp declared with a predatory grin.
"You have our permission to use your full strength." Warcury affirmed, while the rest of the Elders nodded in agreement from where they were gathered. With the Celestial Dragons wiped out, they didn't care about collateral damage anymore. All that mattered was eliminating the Dragon Emperor.
"Alright!" Garp declared as he took a single step forward, and the earth beneath his foot caved in as an incredible amount of Haki began to radiate from his entire body.
Black lightning began to crackle in every direction around him, carving out deep grooves in the ground while the Marines each began to struggle just to remain conscious. Even the Admirals were taken aback at the show of strength coming from Garp, proving that even if they outranked him, NONE of them would be a match for the elderly Vice Admiral if they were forced to fight.
Sengoku however was stupified for an entirely different reason.
With each step Garp took he caved in the earth beneath him, but what Sengoku noticed was that with each passing second Garp seemed.....younger.
The Haki radiating from Garp's body exploded even more in intensity with each passing second, growing stronger while Garp simultaneously seemed to be growing younger. Even his graying hair and goatee darkened until both were black with occasional strands of white, while the wrinkles around his face began to disappear.
Either not knowing or not caring about the changes to his body(it was both of them), Garp leaped up into the air with enough force that a crater was left behind as he flew out over the open sea. And as he flew, the Haki radiating from his body began to condense completely into his fist.
"BWAHAHAHAHAHAHA! TRY THIS ONE ON FOR SIZE, DRAGON BRAT! GALAXY IMPACT!"
Roaring with laughter as he did so, Garp swung his Haki infused fist right at the lead ship of the fleet that was approaching them, the very same one where he could see the Dragon Emperor sitting there leisurely as everyone else did his fighting for him. Only, nothing happened.
*KABOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!!!!!*
At that exact moment, an explosion sounded behind Garp that prompted him to turn and see untold destruction taking place on the Red Line that looked suspiciously like his Galaxy Impact. Specifically, at Mary Geoise.
"Uhhh..." Garp uttered worriedly as he watched his own attack vaporize the entirety of the Holy City, a cold sweat covering his body as he did so. Well, at least no one had been left in the city when they evacuated it...
However he did NOT like the looks that Sengoku and the Elders were giving him at the moment.
Despite falling right down to the open sea in the middle of an active battlefield, Garp was more worried about the chewing out he was going to receive after this for destroying the Holy City. Though he had technically been given permission to ignore any potential collateral damage...
Just as Garp was wondering how he was going to try and explain this, as he had NO IDEA how his attack got redirected, he landed upon a large glowing surface that appeared out of nowhere below him. A brief examination however showed it was some kind of massive glowing circle, complete with numerous symbols he had never seen before.
Garp barely had any time to wonder if this was from kind of Devil Fruit power when two figures landed in front of him to join him on this floating platform. Figures that Garp immediately recognized, even though he had last seen them literally decades ago.
"What the hell happened to you two!?!" Garp exclaimed as he looked upon two of the remaining Emperors of the Sea, Big Mom and Whitebeard. Except both of them appeared decades younger than they were supposed to be.
""LIKE YOU'RE ONE TO TALK!"" Linlin and Whitebeard both snarled at him in unison, as Garp also appeared decades younger. Something they both had an idea of who was behind it.
"Well, it doesn't matter." Garp suddenly stated, apparently losing interest in the subject as he shoved his pinky finger up his nose.
""YOU'RE DISGUSTING!"" The two former Emperors declared in unison yet again.
Despite the comedy act that was apparently going on, neither Whitebeard or Linlin lowered their guard in the slightest in the presence of the man before them.
Monkey D. Garp was the man known to be a living legend amongst the Marines, and for no small reason. Even now, both Linlin and Whitebeard were unsure if they could take him, especially with Garp also being reverted to his prime.
But they had been given their orders, and both wanted a chance to topple the unstoppable hero of the Marines.
Alex watched from Zenith's deck as the battle began between the trio, which wasn't at all uneven if the first few exchanges were anything to go by. He still couldn't believe just how strong Garp truly was, and wondered if he even needed to revert his age to begin with...
"What about those behind us?" Vivi asked suddenly, stirring Alex's attention as he glance to their rear, where another fleet of Marine ships was approaching them.
"Nah. They're taken care of." Alex said without any concern, making them all wonder what he knew before a sound reached them.
*Dum Dut Da Da~!*
*Dum Dut Da Da~!*
*Dum Dut Da Da~!*
The banging of drums could be heard through the din of battle, though they sounded like cannon fire at first, before their source slowly appeared through the fog that Nami had conjured earlier.
Massive ships.
Three of them to be exact, all large enough to dwarf any other ship in their fleet, and with crews to match.
"BANG THOSE DRUMS!" Roared a voice over the ocean, one that stirred fear within the Marines when they beheld this new enemy.
"GIANTS!"
"WHAT ARE THEY DOING HERE!?!"
These cries and more could be heard coming from the Marines as they displayed no small amount of panic, which was completely unerstandable for any who had seen what a single giant was capable of. A small fleet of them though?
As for why they were here...
"GABABABABA! THEY WANT TO KNOW WHY WE'RE HERE!" One giant roared in amusment.
"GYEGYAGYAGYAGYA! NATURALLY, WE ARE HERE FOR THE SUN GOD!" Another declared, pointing directly at Alex as they closed in on the Marine ships.
"GET RID OF THESE INSECTS." Another giant roared, one who sat upon a throne on the middle and largest of the three ships.
At his command, the army of giants rushed into action as they descended upon the Marines.
"Wow..." Kurumu uttered in awe of the spectacle.
"Right? I couldn't believe it myself when I first felt them approaching." Alex said wryly.
Of course he now knew of EVERYTHING taking place above and below the surface of the ocean around them, due to eating the soul of Poseidon. If he wanted, he could even sink the entire fleet of Marine ships on a whim without having to do more than flexing his pinky, not that he couldn't do so without his newly acquired divinty. But it was an option if he felt like it.
That was also why Alex could feel someone else approaching them, someone who had surprised him more than the giants.
But they were still a ways out yet.
With the giants taking care of their rear for them, Alex turned his attention back to the front where the final bosses were waiting for them.
Even with Garp being distracted by Linlin and Whitebeard, there was still the Admirals, Sengoku, the Five Elders, and the group Alex recently learned of called the God's Knights. Oh yeah, AND there was Imu in hiding somewhere.
"I suppose its about time to start getting a little serious." Alex said as he looked up to where he knew Sengoku was looking down at them.
Of course, Alex planned to participate as little as possible to give the others a chance to get some experience points for their current jobs. And as if to answer that intention...
[NOTICE! The quest 'My Hands Are Tied' has been triggered!
Quest objectives: Do not personally participate in the battle until the timer runs out.
Penalty for failure: ???
Rewards: Chatroom Doorway.(A doorway availible only to the owner of the Chatroom that allows them to travel to other users of the Chatroom)]
Alex blinked in surprise at the sudden quest he received, which was the very same item on the shop he wanted to buy the most. Which was also the most expensive.
Though he wanted to accept the quest right away, Alex hesitated briefly when he saw that there would be a penalty for failing the quest, but it wouldn't show him what it was. That was tricky since it would mean that ANYTHING could happen if he failed the quest, and Alex wasn't sure if he wanted to take that risk.
BUT, the reward was also oh so tempting.
Eventually, after a few seconds of intense deliberation, Alex accepted the quest since, if something went wrong, he would still be able to call in reinforcements to help. After all, he was just unable to intervene himself.
However, the moment after Alex accepted the quest and a timer appeared before him, he sensed several new presences.
"Fuck." Alex swore as he realized he was played by the Chatroom, though not maliciously as numerous figures flew overhead above them.
...
"This is just one massive disaster. Get in there you three, and try not to screw things up this time." Warcury ordered as he looked down at the ongoing battle with disgust, talking to the three Admirals.
"Its about time." Aokiji said while stepping up to the ledge with the other two, being the only one not in hot water since he hadn't participated in the earlier attack.
"Well, first things first~." Kizaru said as he pointed a finger at the battle going on between Garp and the two former Emperors, intending to bring an end to it in an instant. Even if Garp wasn't pleased with the interference, they would be able to remove two of the strongest fighters from the other side.
The tip of Kizaru's finger began to shimmer with intense light as he gathered power to it, enough power to pierce even Big Mom through the heart to kill her. Meanwhile the temperature fluctuated on either side of him by massive margins as both Akainu and Aokiji activated their Devil Fruits, one being magma while the other ice.
Just as Kizaru was about to unleash his attack though, something caught his eye in the sky in front of them.
"Eh?"
"HIYAH!"
The next thing he knew, Kizaru was being sent flying backwards after receiving a kick so fast that even HE couldn't see it, and he moved at the speed of light! He didn't need to wonder long about where the attack came from though, as a woman who looked to be in her late teens landed on the ground before him.
She was an immenesly beautiful young woman, with long flowing golden hair, and matching golden eyes. Her body was garbed in robes of the purest white, depicting a picture of innocence that sharply contrasted just how sinful her body appeared under them. Most curiously about her though, was that she also possessed numerous wings with golden feathers, along with a halo and golden-furred monkey tail.
"Your opponent is me!" The woman declared, planting her foot on the ground between them with enough force that she made the earth itself shake.
"Well this is a surprise~!" Kizaru said, appearing calm on the outside, though he was anything but on the inside.
The same thing could be said of Akainu and Aokiji as well.
The latter was facing another young woman who appeared similarly in age to the one facing Kizaru, except she was dressed in a white martial gi, possessed impossibly beautiful pale skin, and had bushy light-purple hair that was tied into a short ponytail. Curiously, she too had a monkey tail but her's was pure white.
"And who might you be, pretty lady?" Aokiji asked, being taken in by her beauty, though he still remained alert while remembering the force behind her kick.
On the other side, Akainu found himself facing a similarly aged young man, one who had sharp features and blonde hair with orange highlights in it, giving an appearance similar to fire.
"Do you realize the consequences of your actions?" Akainu asked as the magma in his body began to bubble and churn.
"I think I should be asking YOU that." the young man answered as he narrowed his eyes.
"What on earth is going on?!" Sengoku demanded as he looked over the three newcomers, all of which he noted had monkey-like tails. Before he could take even a single step towards them though...
*CRASH!*
ANOTHER figure fell out of the sky right in front of him, which was revealed to be yet another young girl with long white hair, cat-like ears and tail(s), while she was dressed in a white kimono.
"Mama says we should be respectful to Budda-Sama~Nya, but I WILL defeat you~Nya!" She declared in a cute manner, though Sengoku couldn't care less about how cute the girl before him was.
"Whatever is going on, I would say its safe to assume the Dragon Emperor is behind it." One of the Elders, Marcus Mars, declared, before several more figures came out of the sky to stand before him and the other four Elders, as well as the Gods Knights.
Standing before him specifically was another young woman with dark skin that was dressed quite scandalously, though he could feel the wind itself flowing around her curiously.
"Indeed. This has his lunacy written all over it." Warcury said as one of them moved to stand before him, another young woman with pitch-black hair that was dressed in an outrageously frilly and colorful outfit, complete with a scepter in her hands that was topped with a snowflake.
"The scale of these women can't be matched though. So perhaps we can turn this to our favor by capturing them?" Suggested the lord of finance, Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro. Meanwhile the one standing before him was a young man with crimson red hair, though his dress and atmosphere was similar to that of a thug.
"Lets save that talk for after the war." Said Shepard Ju Peter, who was looking what appeared to be his own opponent up and down, an elegant looking young woman with snow-white skin and hair that looked to be white with just the slightest shade of purple.
"Either way, they look like they will make for some interesting specimens to exeriment on." Said Jarcia Saturn, who was facing two opponents compared to the others. Unlike them though, he recognized one of his as none other than one of the pirates known to be a part of the Eleven Supernovas, Jewelry Bonney.
The other however, was the spitting image of the Dragon Emperor himself, just with significantly darker skin tone. And curiously enough, aside from Bonney of course, ALL of them sported monkey-like tails.
"So, who exactly are all of you?" Saturn asked, though the answer was very nearly obvious to anyone with eyes. They just wanted confirmation.
Of them all, the one who stepped forward was the young man who looked just like the Dragon Emperor, who declared with the air of a leader, "I am Alec D. Morningstar, firstborn son of the Dragon Emperor! And these are my brothers and sisters!"
Their suspicions confirmed, the Five Elders smirked confidently as the easiest path to victory showed itself to them.
All the while Alex was sitting on his throne on Zenith's deck, tapping his finger impatiently while alternating his attention between the timer and his children.
"I swear, I'm gonna tan ALL of your hides before the day is over." He muttered to himself, despite the surge of pride that threatened to overwhelm him.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 577: End of the World Government
chapters.content:
Anxiety filled Alex as he glanced between the timer and where he knew his children were fighting, a feeling that was rivalled by his pride at their stepping up to take action.
His concentration was so intense, that he didn't even register the battle that continued between Whitebeard and Linlin against Garp, or look up as numerous figures flew down or teleported to Zenith's deck.
"Where is she?!" Gabriel demanded the second she arrived.
"Up there." Alex said, pointing to the top of the Red Line.
"And you're just sitting here, watching?!" Serafall demanded irritably.
Instead of replying, Alex conjured a projection that perfectly mimicked the Chatroom to show his sudden quest, and the time limit accompanying it.
"What is that?" Vivi asked, having only JUST joined the Chatroom herself.
"It's a quest I got from the Chatroom right before the kids arrived. Basically the quest states that I can't personally intervene in the battle before this timer runs out, and if I do then I'll face a random penalty. So obviously, I can't do anything about them being here myself."
Everyone present could hear the frustration in Alex's voice as he explained what was going on to them, even as the battle continued raging above them.
"Well, if you can't go and get them, I WILL!" Gabriel declared as she spread her angelic wings to take flight, only to find herself completely unable to take off.
"Eh?"
"I grounded you." Alex said in explanation, before each and every one of the mothers tried to do the same thing, only for their feet to not even leave the deck.
Even teleporting wasn't an option as Alex sealed the space around them. Kuroka could get away if she tried of course, as a goddess of space and time, but all she did was direct a level look at Alex that demanded an explanation. Regardless of her own feelings and desire to protect her niece, he was her King.
"Care to explain?" Koneko on the other hand practically growled at him, making Alex shrug as he told them,
"If I'm stuck here, then so are the rest of you. I've got Yue watching over them to make sure no one will die, so until the countdown is finished we can all sit here and twiddle our thumbs together."
The collective mothers all gaped at Alex incredulously as he trapped them here with him, scarcely daring to believe that he'd risk the safety of his own children in such a way. But as if he knew what they were thinking, he then continued,
"They all made their choice, and now they can learn to either deal with consequences of their actions or follow through with their decisions. At least until the timer runs out."
"But they're CHILDREN!" Anne practically snarled at him.
"Yes, they are children. But the thing with children is that they NEED to fuck around sometimes so they can find out. How will they ever grow if we held their hands for every little thing they do? As I said, Yue is watching to make sure they don't die, and they can deal with this on their own until the timer runs out."
Though several of the mothers wanted to argue Alex's decision some more, they all quickly bit their tongues when he gave them an intense look, one that DARED them to question what he had decided further.
Alex hardly, if ever, took a hard stance when it came to his family. One could even say he was a pushover more often than not when it came to his wives and children. However, when the topic was something as important as this, his inner emperor came out and made it clear he would not bend his decision in the slightest, just like when he insisted on training the children.
Not even Grayfia could bring herself to chide her Lord and master, which was also a rare occurrence indeed.
So with Alex's mind made up, the concerned parents all turned their attention back to the battle their children were currently involved in, even as several other battles continued to rage around them.
***
Two beams of light streaked through the skies while moving at, literally, the speed of light as they traded hundreds of blows within mere seconds. One of them was the 'little' princess of Asora and Heaven, Edith, while the other was one of the three Admirals of the Marines, Kizaru.
And Kizaru was beginning to feel vexed.
"Hey hey~. No matter how much you train yourself, there should be a limit to how strong you are~." Kizaru said as yet another of her punches went right by his head, with enough force that it probably would have been REALLY dangerous to his health if it had hit. And he had already learned that the defensive abilities of his Devil Fruit wouldn't work on her.
"Stop moving and let me hit you!" Edith demanded like a spoiled brat, her frustration building even more when he kicked her yet again.
She couldn't help it since Kizaru continuously used Observation Haki not only to just barely avoid all of her attacks, but also to make sure each of his hit her in return. Every time Edith thought she managed to avoid one of his attacks, he changed the trajectory and hit her anyways. And that was only with his hands and feet, since his actual light beams and such were ineffective against her.
But with Edith's physical conditioning after all of her beloved daddy's training, along with her own Saiyan/dragoness constitution, all Kizaru's hits and kicks managed to do was piss her off even more.
As such, the duo were stuck in a perpetual game of cat and mouse.
"Grrr! If I have to go super to beat you up I'm going to be so angry!" Edith declared angrily at him.
"Go 'super'? Does that mean you can get even stronger than this?" Kizaru asked, even as a cold sweat dripped down his back despite his casual expression.
Even with his light speed movements, Kizaru was pushing his Observation Haki to its limits to stay ahead of Edith and her attacks, any one of which might actually kill him! If she could get even stronger...
"Yeah! We all promised not to go super before coming here! So if you make me have to go super, then I'm going to be laughed at by everyone else! So stay still and let me beat you up!"
Despite her insistence, Kizaru persisted in avoiding every single one of Edith's attacks while also desperately trying to come up with a way to defeat her.
Meanwhile, someone else was actually enjoying herself a bit.
"HA! This is actually really fun!" Yuki cried as she traded blows with Admiral Aokiji, who was wondering why this girl was not at all affected by his ice.
Rather than slowing down as the temperature plummeted around them, Yuki was appearing refreshed as her movements sped up and got better over time. Even when he tried freezing her completely solid, Yuki kept coming after him as if the ice itself was a part of her body.
"!!!"
Seeing her come at him now, Aokiji had to create several walls of ice in front of him to blunt the force, and even then he was sent skipping across down the Red Line by the miles.
"That girl..." He drawled irritably after finally coming to a stop, and assessing that one of his arms had been broken in defending himself. Naturally, whatever was nullifying her against his ice also made it so that her punches could actually hit him.
"The last time I felt this bad was during Garp's training..." Aokiji said while dusting himself off, ignoring the pain in his arm as he did so, before Yuki landed right in front of him. He noted as she did so that ice exploded out from where her feet landed.
"Too bad we have to kill each other. You just might have been my dream girl." He said while looking her up and down. She was cute, obviously a tomboy, could fight, and apparently had powers that complimented his own. Who else would have been a better match for him?
Apparently she didn't think so.
"Blege! How gross!" Yuki exclaimed while pretending to vomit.
"You didn't have to be so mean about it..." Aokiji said, right as his Haki went off to warn him about an incoming attack.
"If I could, I'd freeze you right here and turn you into an ugly-sicle!" Yuki declared as she tried to kick him, which Aokiji was just barely able to put up an arm to try and block, sacrificing the arm in the process as there was an audible 'crunch'.
Meanwhile...
"You were foolish to try and go against me. Fire can never match magma." Akainu growled while turning his back on the corpse of his own opponent, who was missing his head, right arm/shoulder, and one of his legs.
"And YOU are foolish to turn your back on your opponent." Said a voice, making Akainu halt in his tracks as he looked back incredulously.
Standing there was his opponent, completely regenerated once more as if nothing had happened to him.
"What are you?" Akainu growled as his body began to churn and bubble menacingly.
"Heh." The boy smirked as he met Akainu's glare, before suddenly the winds began to whip and rear around them, forming a cyclone while the temperature began to rapidly increase.
"I am Regal Phenex, Lord of fire and wind, heir of the Phenex clan and son of the Dragon Emperor! And if you believe that some mere magma is enough to even phase me, then I shall educate you."
By this point the cyclone around them had actually caught fire, accelerating the increase in temperature even more. Akainu however was not worried, as even this was little more than a slightly warm breeze to him.
But then something changed.
He sensed a subtle shift in the fire circling them, something within it that was turning the flames.....sinister.
"What is this?" Akainu growled as he actually began to grow wary of the eerie flames, before his Haki suddenly started warning him.
*CRASH!*
Akainu just barely had time to cross his arms in defense as Regal delivered a punch, one with his fist coated in the same eerie flames that surrounded them, and had enough power that the ground beneath him caved in on itself to form a crater.
And most incredulously of all, the flames coating Regal's fist actually managed to BURN him.
"You claim that fire can never match against magma? Well how about the flames of hell itself?" Regal asked Akainu, even as his entire body was set aflame by the hellfire, which did nothing to hurt him, but began to burn even Akainu's magma.
While the three Admirals were all struggling in one way or another, their Fleet Admiral was faring no better.
Sengoku had already transitioned to the transformed state of his Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Daibutsu, which turned him into a giant golden Buddha.
Not only was Sengoku's body significantly sturdier in this form, due to being made of gold, but he also radiated a type of divine energy that also fueled his attacks, creating powerful shockwaves with a single swing of his fists, or thrust of his palms. And the power behind these shockwaves enough to vaporize entire enemy battleships with ease, making Sengoku a one man army when he fought against pirates and other enemies of the Marines.
And yet, here he was being toyed with by a childish girl...
"Humph! Is Buddha-Sama truly so weak~nya?" Mai asked as she used Touki to match Sengoku blow for blow, all without so much as breaking a sweat.
"Little girl... Be careful who you call weak!" Sengoku roared as he slammed his giant hands together, producing a clear gong-like sound that echoed throughout the battlefield before he thrust one of his palms forward.
The result was a hyper-concentrated shockwave of energy in the shape of a hand that traveled through anything in its path.
"I think aunty taught me this~nya!" Mai exclaimed as she mimicked the movements Sengoku made, before thrusting her own palm forward at the incoming attack while channeling her Touki and Senjutsu to the max.
The force generated from her movements was enough to generate a shockwave dwarfing Sengoku's, destroying it instantly upon impact before impacting Sengoku himself to leave a handprint upon his golden body. But that wasn't all...
Aside from the handprint, Mai's Senjutsu entered Sengoku's body to wreak havoc on his Haki and the flow of energy within. Soon he was unable to even maintain his transformation properly, as indicated when he began to rapidly shift between his human form, fully transformed form, and his hybrid form without pause.
"What did you do!?!" He demanded while trying, and failing, to control his rapid transformations. But when he looked up, Sengoku's mind paused slightly as he saw Mai floating in the air with numerous flaming wheels surrounding her.
"I will now purify Buddha-Sama!" Mai declared, before unleashing the flaming wheels upon Sengoku.
As Sengoku was being 'purified' by Mai's Kasha Wheels, Anna was flying through the air while using the Sky Dragon Slayer arts that her mother taught her to fight against a giant demonic bird, which was actually the elder Marcus Mars in his Itsumade form.
Currently she was flying around and avoiding the energy blasts Mars was spewing at her, destroying entire sections of the Red Line while missing her completely.
"Insignificant pest!" Mars snarled at her as she dodged yet again, all while Anna appeared deep in thought.
"Now how do I beat this bad guy up without hurting him?" She pondered deeply as she avoided a swipe of his talons, followed by the snap of his beak.
Anna was a curious one amongst her siblings, being that she had no desire to fight like they did. She dutifully followed her lessons and the training her father gave them, as it was always better to be able to defend yourself than not according to him, but she herself did not want to hurt others. That was the largest reason why Anna had not participated in the tournament with several of her siblings, and why she would usually take on a supportive role whenever they 'played' with monsters.
So while the rest of her present siblings were fighting, and her own opponent was literally trying to kill her, Anna was trying to find a way to beat him without actually hurting him.
"Hold still and taste the judgement of the gods!" Mars declared angrily.
"Oh! I know!" Anna declared as an idea came to her.
She then manipulated the winds to gather around her hands, and channeled magic power into them to use both offensive and support magic.
"Sky Dragon's Healing Claw!" Anna yelled as she attacked Mars with razor-sharp blades of wind, combined with her own Saiyan strength. It was an attack that would mean instant death for most opponents. However, Anna had also applied healing magic to heal Mars immediately after she attacked him.
There were two things Anna was unaware of when she did this though. Firstly was that Mars himself possessed a healing factor that would have undone all of the damage she did to him within seconds regardless. And second was that her technique was not as merciful as Anna thought it was.
Even as she healed the damage she had inflicted, the pain itself was still there along with the memory of having taken damage. But she was blissfully unaware of this, for now.
"Alright! Next is Sky Dragon's Healing Roar!" She declared. Unleashing a powerful cyclone of air from her mouth that shredded Mars' avian body, before healing him yet again seconds later.
A short distance away Elizabeth, known as Lizzy by friends and family, was battling the Elder Warcury in his transformed state as well, a massive boar-like form known as the Fengxi.
"BUKIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII!"
Warcury let loose a devastating roar infused with Haki, which caused any Marines that were still within the vicinity to collapse while foaming at the mouth. Lizzy meanwhile covered her ears and scrunched up her face at the noise.
"You're too loud! Magical Lizzy~Tan says everyone should get along~! TRANSFORM~!"
At her command, Lizzy waved around her scepter as it began to glow, before her entire body was encased in the light of magic.
Numerous ribbons of light shot out of her scepter to wrap around various areas of her body, before they formed a skirt, thigh-high socks, knee-high boots, a top, gloves that came up past her elbows, and finally a tiara.
When the light cleared it revealed Lizzy, wearing an outfit similar to the one she had been wearing previously, except this one was the outfit supplied by the Dressphere inserted into her scepter. Giving her both the looks and the abilities of a genuine magical girl.
"Now to punish the bad piggy~!" Lizzy declared as she waved her scepter, even as said 'piggy' charged at her with his razor sharp tusks.
As she channeled magic power into her scepter, Lizzy conjured numerous pink hearts in the air around her, spinning in place before pointing her scepter at Warcury and declaring dramatically, "now, face Lizzy~Tan's Love Love Magical Cannon!"
At her command, the hearts all began to rush at Warcury with the force of a hundred cannons, EACH.
The massive pig had never been hit so hard before, with each heart taking out entire chunks of his body and shattering his tusks as if they were made of glass. It was an attack that surely would have put him down, IF it were anyone else.
Before the dust had even cleared he had completely regenerated all of the damage, including the tusks that had been shattered.
"Humph! Such a tough piggy!" Lizzy harrumphed at her opponent, seemingly offended that her attack hasn't worked. Maybe she would have to try something else....
"Still at it Lizzy?" Drawled a voice that prompted her to look up and see her brother Ryuuto lazily flying towards her.
"You're done already!?" Lizzy exclaimed in shock.
"Yep~. The guy turned himself into some kind of demon horse, and then said something stupid. So I just erased him along with a good portion of the area." Ryuuto pointed out a stretch of land as he explained that had a massive hole gouged out of it. It wasn't just destroyed, everything that had been there before was just GONE. As was the usual for the power of destruction
"Well your Destruction makes it easy for YOU! This guy wasn't even actually fazed by my Love Love Magical Cannon!" Lizzy exclaimed as they both descended to the ground, right as Warcury charged at her.
Ryuuto just scoffed even as Lizzy casually backhanded Warcury and sent him flying, before stating irritably, "stop playing around and use your ice instead of that stupid toy then."
"It's not a stupid toy!" Lizzy cried out while waving her scepter around dramatically, instantly freezing Warcury in a massive block of ice that would never melt so she could deal with her annoying brother.
"Yes it is. You could have had that pig spitted and roasted on a fire by now if you used your actual powers, but you just HAD to play around." Ryuuto sneered.
"I WASN'T PLAYING! And YOUR mom is a magical girl too, see!" Lizzy declared as she pulled out a photo of herself, Serafall, Sona, Rias, Akeno and Shuri all dressed like magical girls. Except Sona, Rias and Akeno all looked as if they wanted to be anywhere else in the world.
The effect was immediate as Ryuuto coughed up a little blood from seeing his own mother in such a frilly and skimpy outfit, even without knowing that it may have been used a time or two in her and Alex's bedroom plays.
"That's enough you two, stop fighting." Regal stated as he landed beside them, holding the unconscious and severely burned Akainu by the scruff of his neck before tossing him over by the ice that encased Warcury. And unknown to them, Yue readily used her magic to ensure neither of the defeated opponents would return to the battle.
"Shut up Regal! Stop trying to act more mature than us!"
"I AM more mature than either of you, and there are more important things to focus on right now. Remember what dad taught us, NEVER let your guard down in the middle of a battlefield."
Both Ryuuto and Lizzy flinched when they heard that, and looked down shamefully from forgetting their father's lessons. Meanwhile Alex was nodding sagely from atop Zenith's deck.
"D-do you think Daddy will be disappointed with us?" Lizzy asked worriedly.
"It's too late to worry about that. Let's just do as well as we can here, since we'll all probably be scolded either way." Freydis said as she too suddenly appeared, along with Nocta, Aife, Lana, Shuri, Myuu, Videl and Andre.
They had all gone to battle against the group calling themselves 'Gods Knights', a name that sounded presumptuous even to the youngest amongst them. And to call the trio of fledgling goddesses, Freydis, Nocta and Aife, offended at their supposed divinity was more than an understatement.
"I still cannot believe such weaklings refer to themselves as 'gods'." She spat at the most powerful amongst them, a man with hair and beard and made him look like a crescent moon. True, Freydis' Saiyan heritage combined with the combat divinities she inherited from her mother made her a deadly opponent despite her young age and lack of experience, but then again she SHOULD expect more from someone claiming godhood.
"So who's left?" Andre asked, his giant-like figure towering over even the tallest amongst them.
"Edith looks like she's having a bit of trouble with her opponent- oh, she just went super... And he's down. Yuki, Mai and Anna all look like they're wrapping things up, and Aurora is still fighting that guy over there." Regal said, pointing out every one of the mentioned siblings as he did so. The last amongst them was Aurora, who was in her dragon form as she battled against a guy who had turned into a giant demonic worm.
"I never thought THIS would become a normal scene for me..." Videl said as she watched the numerous battles come to a close, a sentiment not shared by the rest of the kids present since they were all born and raised amongst the weirdness from the beginning.
"Well it has. And there is still THAT over there." Myuu said, pointing to the last of the children, and their opponent.
"Impressive, for some insignificant ants with delusions of grandeur." Jaygarcia Saturn sneered as he looked down upon Alec and Bonney, the former of which was staying back to let Bonney fight. Because for Bonney, this fight was personal.
After being brought to Alex's home she had learned that Saturn was personally responsible for almost every horrible thing that had ever happened to her father throughout his life, as well as hers. Saturn had experimented on both Bonney as an infant and her mother, passing the Sapphire Scale disease on to both of them that had claimed the life of her mother, and would have killed Bonney if not for the care of Kuma.
It was because of her disease that Bonney was unable to even venture outside for nearly her entire life, as both solar and lunar light would advance the Sapphire Scales and potentially kill her. The only hope came when Kuma went to meet with Vegapunk, who had been able to cure her disease in exchange for studying Kuma's Buccaneer blood. But they did not realize the World Government was listening in.
Saturn had demanded that, in exchange for Vegapunk treating Bonney for a disease HE had planted inside of her, Kuma would be required to join the Seven Warlords and do anything the World Government ordered him. On top of that, he was also to give his body over to them via numerous operations to turn him into a human weapon, a cyborg, with the final operation to remove his consciousness completely.
Needless to say Bonney was PISSED, and she wanted revenge on the man who had personally caused so much pain and suffering for her family.
That was why Alec had taken a step back, allowing Bonney to fight on her own, but also staying close enough to help if she needed it.
"Well this 'ant' is going to kick your ass!" Bonney declared as she stepped up in front of Saturn, who had assumed the form of giant demonic spider.
"As I said, delusions of grandeur." Saturn sneered down at her.
"Normally, you would be right..." Bonney said, a hint of a smirk appearing on her lips. "But I came prepared! Distorted Future: Saiyan Shock!"
As she cried out the name of her technique, Bonney, who was still in her true child form, suddenly grew into a more mature version of herself. Unlike her usual mature look though, this time Bonney was significantly more toned with higher muscle density, while a pink monkey-like tail extended out from her backside.
This was the greatest power of her Toshi Toshi no Mi, allowing her to create and alter her own futures depending on her imagination, and she was able to imagine a LOT after her time in Asora. Vampire, Werewolf, Devil, Angel, Fallen Angel, Youkai, Tauren, Orc, Goblin, Elf(s), Dwarf, DRAGON, and even one of the strongest races of all, the Saiyans.
Bonney made use of the time she had spent training this particular form in secret with Alec, feeling the new form of energy flow throughout her body, energy known as Ki. And she used said Ki to launch herself into the air as Saturn fired several blobs of concentrated fluid at her, which splashed onto the ground before melting everything it touched.
But Bonney just ignored the poison as she flew overhead Saturn while gathering Ki to her hands, and then firing a pair of Ki blasts at Saturn from above.
"!!!"
Saturn, who had never encountered such an attack before, was blasted to the ground with enough force that a crater formed beneath him, which only deepened when Bonney shot forward to punch him in the face with her fists.
Flesh tore and bone shattered under her fist, turning Saturn's head into a fine paste that splattered across the dirt and stone of the Red Line. At the same time several of his arachnoid legs also bent unnaturally and cracked, with one or two even being removed completely. It was an attack that would have meant instant death, if it were just about anyone else in this world.
Instead, Saturn began to regenerate almost instantly as his head reformed amidst a cloud of smoke, regenerating even his beard while his limbs cracked back into place.
"Impressive show of strength. It rivals even that of the Giants and Buccaneers." Saturn calmly said as he looked at Bonney with indifference.
"Damn..." Bonney swore, before she rushed in for another series of attacks. But they were each only as effective as the ones before, and they were growing weaker with each passing second.
That was the downside of Distorted Future, the more powerful the transformation, the quicker it wore her out.
Already Bonney was panting with exhaustion after just a few blows, and all Saturn did was regenerate after every one.
"Such a shame. All that power, completely and utterly wasted." Saturn mocked her as the last drops of energy drained from Bonney, and she returned to her true child form.
"No its not." Alec said as he stepped between Bonney and Saturn.
"Oh? And do you possess the same power little ant? It seems as if I will need to study you and all of your siblings." Saturn said without any worry, even as his fellow Elders fell one by one around them.
"Come and see!" Alec declared without any pause or hesitation, his eyes brimming with confidence.
"Kick....his ass.....Alec...." Bonney told him tiredly, even as Anna pulled her away to be treated... And fed.
"I plan to." Alec responded seriously, even as Saturn towered over him.
"You better not disappoint boy." Saturn stated, right before Alec moved.
*BOOOOOOM!*
The next thing the Elder knew he was sent flying back as Alec punched him, and feeling more pain than he had ever felt before as his body began to burn with fire unlike anything he had ever experienced.
*CRACK!*
Alec suddenly appeared beside him in a flash of lightning, his expression one of fury as he cried with his fist cracking, "Lightning Dragon's Metal Fist!"
Tightening the muscles in his fist until they were as hard as steel, and cladding them in powerful lightning, Alec hit Saturn yet again with a force unlike any the world had ever seen. And he wasn't even close to finished yet.
"Stone Dragon's Raging Fist!"
"Tempest Dragon's Vicious Claws!"
"Inferno Dragon's Blazing Roar!"
"Glacial Dragon's Freezing Maw!"
One after another Alec showed them all why he called himself the Omni-Slayer, the elements themselves swirling around him and fortifying his already outrageous Saiyan strength as he brutalized Saturn.
Even Saturn's poison, so potent that it could melt through nearly anything, was ineffective in protecting him from Alec's assault. All the boy had done was EAT some of the poison directly, and suddenly he too could call upon it at a whim.
As the battle prolonged a sense of urgency began to slowly build within Saturn, one that stated that this boy had to be eliminated at ANY cost. What he did not know was that the urgency he was starting to feel, was something that had been long-buried and forgotten to the Elder. A budding sense of fear.
With each attack he received, all without even being allowed to defend himself or attack back, that fear grew within him while Saturn's regenerative powers lessened steadily.
"ENOUGH!" Saturn roared, his Haki exploding outwards in arcs of black lightning that carved grooves into the ground around them, a ground ravaged by the numerous attacks Alec had used thus far.
But rather than shying away from the Haki, Alec ate THAT as well.
By this point Saturn was at his wit's end with NOTHING seemingly working against the brat, and an unfamiliar chill creeping down his spine.
That chill only compounded as an ominously large shadow covered Saturn, eclipsing the sun from his view as he looked up to see Alec in the sky above him as he seemingly took in a deep breath.
"Omni Dragon's....APOCALYPTIC ROOOOOOOOOAR!"
With a literal roar, Alec unleashed hell as all of the elements under his control were expelled from his mouth at once, bearing down onto Saturn with a destructive force matched only by that of the Ancient Weapons.
The Elder vanished from sight as he was engulfed in the destructive power, power great enough that it made the world shake as the Red Line itself was torn asunder. Cracks formed on either side as they stretched all the way down to the ocean, allowing water to rush in to fill them and erode them even more in rapid succession.
All over the battlefield below, people stopped what they were doing and turned their attention towards the Red Line, watching as it broke apart right down the middle where the Holy City once sat.
A deafening roar, from Alec, the tearing of stone, and the rush of water, filled the air as the terrain itself shifted, and continued doing so even after Alec had finished his attack. Needless to say, the only Marine that had any will to continue fighting by this point was none other than Garp, and that was purely because he refused to submit before Whitebeard and Big Mom as he pointedly ignored what was going on around him.
As for the person responsible for all of this...
"Humph! I dare you to come back from THAT!" Alec stated as he landed on the ground beside his siblings, seemingly indifferent to the drastic change in the landscape that he had caused.
"THAT WAS AMAZING ALEC!" Anna cried out excitedly as she hurried to her twin brother, followed closely by the rest of their siblings as they too went to be amazed at Alec's fight, all of which had been returned to their true ages. And Alec wasn't too far off himself, shrinking down as well as they crowded around him.
But there was one person he was looking for the most.
"That was pretty cool, Alec." Bonney said as she approached him, making Alec snicker bashfully.
"Thanks Bonney, it was nothing." He said while trying to play it cool, earning some snickers from his siblings.
One of them even kicked things up a notch by 'accidentally' bumping Bonney on her already unsteady legs, sending her falling into Alec's chest as he naturally caught her.
"Ooh~! Alec and Bonney, sitting in a tree~"
"""K-I-S-S-I-N-G!"""
"First comes LOVE~"
"Next come MARRIAGE~"
"Then comes Alec with a baby carriage~!"
Several of Alec's sisters sang in singsong voices, almost as if they had practiced it. And their efforts were not in vain, as Alec's face was sufficiently red despite the his natural darker skin tone, but he wasn't done being embarrassed yet.
Following the momentum, Bonney flashed a mischevious smirk before quickly planting a kiss on Alec's cheek, stupifying him entirely as his complexion resembled that of a tomato.
"HA! Look how red he is!" One of them cried out, triggering another round of laughter at his expense.
Their merriment and mirth continued for another couple minutes, even as a certain figure approached them.
*Clap.*
"Huh?"
*Clap.*
"Who is that?"
*Clap.*
"Truly, an excellent display." Hissed the figure that was approaching them, a person wearing long flowing robes along with an incredibly tall crown.
0:10
"Who are you?!" Edith readily demanded as they all got ready for another fight.
0:09
"There is no need to give my name-"
0:08
"-let alone to some pests that will be dead soon."
0:07
"I have a bad feeling..." Mai said slowly, missing her usual verbal tick due to her increasing nerves.
0:06
"Well, your insincts are accurate at least."
0:05
*KER-CRAAAAAACK!*
A sudden pressure bore down on all of the children unlike anything they had ever felt before.
0:04
Nearly all of them were unable to so much as breath under the pressure as black lightning unlike anything any of them had ever seen raged all around them.
0:03
The earth itself began to rumble beneath their feet for an entirely different reason than Alec's earlier attack, almost as if with each step of the mysterious figure.
0:02
Alec used every single bit of his strength to look up as the figure stood before him, and feeling something he had never felt before in his short life.
He was about to die.
0:01
"Goodbye, little pests." The figure said without the slightest emotion, producing an arrow-like appendage from within his robes that came to a stop directly in front of Alec's face, ready to impale him through the eye and kill him.
0:00
*...*
Silence suddenly descended upon the world, and the pressure was lifted from the children, allowing them all to breathe once more as they looked around in confusion, before all of their gazes settled on the mysterious figure.
No, BEHIND the figure.
"What...?" The figure uttered in confusion, before slowly turning to see someone else standing there that seemingly towered over him.
"I see....the Dragon-"
"Die."
"..."
There was nothing to indicate what happened next to anyone, no matter how much they thought back on it afterwards, and even reveiwed the scene through Regeneration magic. At the command of the Dragon Emperor, Imu, the secret figure who truly ruled over the entire world, ceased to exist.

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - 578: A Lesson in War
chapters.content:
(A.N. to everyone complaining about the fight with Imu being anticlimactic, that was the point!
Alex isn't playing the game anymore. He's basically the hidden boss that is designed to be almost completely unbeatable, even after you've beaten the main boss and maxed out your levels and stats. It's the reason why he's been trying to take a step back from fighting the enemies himself, since he knows that he'd pretty much win every time unless a reincarnator is involved.
Dealing with Imu wasn't a clash between two boss level characters, it was a man dealing with the thing that threatened his children.)
Alex didn't even spare Imu, the supreme ruler of the World Government that existed solely in the shadows, a single glance as he was erased from existence. Instead, all of his focus was on his children, who were shuffling awkwardly under their father's stern gaze.
"That was incredibly reckless and foolhardy. This was not 'playing', this was a war against seasoned opponents who would have readily killed any of you if given the slightest chance. And each and every one of them was not only trained to do so, but they had all fought uncountable battles until now, and gained immeasurable experience through them. The ONLY reason you all did as well as you did, was because of how naturally powerful you all are."
With every word Alex said the children all deflated just ever so slightly, until they were all looking down shamefully.
"BUT-" Alex added towards the end, making them look up hopefully.
"You all did REALLY well against them considering your lack of experience. As your father, I am exceptionally proud of each and every one of you for standing up and fighting when you didn't have to, even if it was reckless."
Though there was more than Alex wanted to say to them, it could wait until their next training session since it mostly pertained to how they could have done better in their respective fights. He also decided it was time to properly start Haki training as well, as evidenced by Edith's fight against Kizaru.
Speaking of...
While the children were momentarily distracted by his praise, Alex turned his attention to the pile of defeated figures that were being magically restrained by Yue. A wave of his hand and they were all transported somewhere secure so he could extract their Devil Fruits and execute them in private.
When that was done, Alex turned back towards the kids before conjuring himself a chair and sitting in it.
"Now then, come here Edith." Alex said, making the children curious as his eldest daughter approached him.
"What is it daddy?" Edith asked him, a hopeful light in her that maybe they were going to be praised some more. And seeing that, Alex smiled down at her warmly and lovingly, before promptly picking her up and bending her over his knee.
"Eh?" Edith uttered, even as Alex flipped her angelic robes up and pulled her panties down to expose her backside.
"Now then, to go charging onto a battlefield without the permission of your mother's or I, I think three spankings a piece should be suitable." Alex said while still retaining his warm smile, even as his children all turned deathly pale. They were even more terrified now than they had been with Imu.
And for good reason too since their father rarely, if EVER, punished them. And as if to show just how justified their fear was, Alex's hand began glowing with demonic power as he brought it down onto Edith's butt.
*SMACK!*
"HYAAAAAA!"
The sound seemed to echo in every direction as Alex's palm made contact with the delicate flesh, followed promptly by Edith's cry as pain filled her backside.
This was because Alex was using a unique little spell he had come up with after dealing with so many perverts over the years, namely Tio with how tough her body was. Basically the spell multiplied the pain felt by the single spanking without requiring Alex to use more strength, which could literally lead to him flat out killing some of his wives if he wasn't careful.
Right now Alex had multiplied the force to the point that Edith had received the equivalent of a thousand spankings in one, which was why she reacted the way she did. And also why he would only give them three of them.
"One." Alex said slowly, before bringing his hand down a second time, prompting another pained cry from Edith, followed by a third.
One by one Alex spanked each and every one of his children, leaving them all with red butts and teary eyes afterwards, including even Videl and Bonney. Naturally, that last one called him all sorts of colorful names with each spanking.
The odd one out was Myuu, who ended up receiving double the spankings after she tried to make a pass as Alex bent her over his knee.
The entire time Alex was disciplining his children the mothers all watched from afar, each and every single one agreeing with how Alex was handling things. They only approached when he was about done.
"So, do you all understand why you were punished?" Anne asked once Alex had finished with the spankings.
"For fighting without permission..." Anna muttered without meeting her mother's eyes.
"Yes, but can any of you tell me WHY you needed permission?" Anne pressed, to which the children all adopted confused looks.
"Because, what if all of us were busy during the fighting and one of you needed help? Or what if a bad guy took advantage of one you to use against us? Or what if one of them had an ability that would allow them to hurt or even kill you?"
Alex nodded in agreement as he looked seriously at the children.
"That's right. It's one thing if you want to help, but randomly showing up like that is really bad since you have no idea what could happen. Did you all know I had accepted a quest from the Chatroom that prevented me from directly intervening in the battle until time ran out? That means even if someone were to hurt or even kill one of you, I wouldn't have been able to do a single thing about it." Alex explained to them, making several of the kids pale at the thought of their daddy not being able to help them. To them he could do ANYTHING.
"Haaa... Just understand that we need to know if you all want to help out. You may not be able to every time, but I will try to let some of you in the future when you can." Alex said after a moment, making the kids look up with interest.
It was something Alex knew he would have to make peace with. They were all still children, very much so, but they were children capable of erasing a small country if any of them felt like it.
"Now then!" He declared while standing once more. "Let's finish things up here!"
With a wave of his hand Alex transported all of the children and their mothers back to the deck of Zenith, before he began his work. Firstly he announced with a magically enhanced voice,
"This battle is over! The World Government is destroyed, so any remaining Marines are called to put down their arms and surrender!"
As he gave the order several Marines readily put down their weapons and surrendered, with only a few doing so grudgingly. Soon the only one left fighting was Garp, but Alex Left him alone for the moment since Garp was merely Garp.
With all of the fighting having stopped, almost, Alex began with his next plan as he shifted everyone with Spatial magic so that they were all away from the Red Line, even transporting Garp, Whitebeard and Linlin so that they could continue their fight without getting in the way.
Once that was done, he then used his divine authority over Earthquakes to send shockwaves through the Red Line on both sides from where he was.
Though believed to be indestructible, even though Alec cracked it earlier, those watching were dumbfounded as massive chunks of the Red Line began shearing off thanks to the earthquakes passing through it. That was just the beginning though as entire sections of the Red Line began to fracture and break off, creating massive gaps in the stone wall that had divided the world for so long.
Soon a chunk broke off that was large enough that the ships in the New World could even see the seas of Paradise on the other side, stunning them even as the gap widened further.
The same thing was happening all along the Red Line on either side for the entire width of the Grand Line, and even through both of the Calm Belts bordering it until reaching the four cardinal Blues. From the peak to the sea floor, the Red Line was falling.
Of course Alex made sure not to disturb Fishman Island that sat directly beneath the Red Line, and he left a section of it intact that dwarfed any island in the world.
Once he had finished destroying the Red Line enough to allow the seas to all meet each other, Alex began work on the 'little' section he had allowed to remain, an island the size of a small continent.
The first thing Alex did was cover the entire island in a magic circle as he channeled Creation magic into it, changing the very molecular structure of the mineral itself from plain rock.
The entire outer layer of the island was converted into fertile farmland, with a thick wall separating it from the sea. Another thick wall separated the farmland from the interior, where Alex began to meticulously construct a city that was unlike any other city in the entire world.
Firstly Alex adopted the same type of layout as Water 7, creating canals that ran along nearly every single road through the city. Aside from that he also divided the city into seven districts with wide main roads in between each district, each with their own canal that was both wide and deep enough to allow even all but the largest of ships passage while the largest canal yet connected them all to the sea.
While the city itself was divided into six districts like a pizza, one of which he created buildings and roads large enough to accommodate even giants, the seventh district was located directly in the center of the island. It was here that Alex created the largest and most luxurious buildings yet, such as a massive amphitheatre, a gladiator arena, a station where the portal to Asora would be made, and even a racetrack that all surrounded a grand and regal palace.
With the interior just about finished, Alex turned his attention to the exterior as he willed rock and stone to rise from the ocean on the outer edges of the island, creating a harbor large enough to house every single ship present.
"That should do it for now." Alex muttered to himself as he looked over his handy work. There was still PLENTY to do to make the island livable, but Alex believed that what he had done was enough for the moment since the rest needed would be a personal touch.
He then descended to the palace at the very heart of the new island, while also sending word to his wives that it was safe to approach now. They led the way with the rest of the people that had united under Alex's banner, sailing into the harbour and then into the canals that filled the city.
"These roads are even big enough for us!" One of the giants exclaimed, even as they were all forced to disembark since the canals weren't large enough for their ships.
"Your Highness! There are even dwellings and buildings under the water!" A Fishman declared to king Neptune after several of them had gone to explore the canals, which also revealed a number of underground passageways filled with water to connect them.
This made them all excited, as there had never been a place so close to the surface that they could safely stay. Until Alex arrived, all Fishman and mermaids risked enslavement if any of them got too careless close to the surface.
The awe and wonder was felt by everyone present as they explored more of the city on their way inwards, until they finally reached the inner circle. There they all had to dock their ships and disembark along with the giants, before making their way to the palace that towered over everything.
It was only once they entered it, and made their way to the throne room that they found Alex himself lounging upon a golden throne that was elevated above them all, aside from the giants. But even they felt small in Alex's presence.
"Welcome..." Alex began while sweeping his arms wide dramatically, "to Nautica!"
As he declared such, a large banner unfurled behind him that depicted his usual standard, a dragon and ape locked in combat.
"Nautica?" Asked the recently reinstated King of Dressrosa, Riku Doldo the third.
"Yes, Nautica." Alex answered while nodding his head, before conjuring a holographic map as he explained.
"Though I left roughly 90% of it intact, I destroyed enough of the Red Line to allow the waters of North Blue, South Blue, East Blue, West Blue, Paradise and the New World to mix, all of them centered right here. So I built Nautica to act as the new capital of the world, where all races of this world will be welcomed and can call home. Of course it still requires some work, but I already did all of the heavy lifting."
Awe filled the people before Alex as they realized what he was doing, and what the city around them truly symbolized.
While the World Government was founded by kingdoms from all over the world, and purported themselves as the unification of the entire world, there were still several people who were ostracized and cast out for being different races, or for not being directly affiliated with the World Government.
The mermaids/Fishmen were one of the prime examples of this, as they were routinely discriminated against, enslaved and even killed all over the world due to being different. Some races, such as the Buccaneers and Lunarians, were even outright slaughtered and exterminated at the whims of the World Government, and it was commonly believed that the only reason the giants weren't was because some of them could be useful. Not only that, but the Celestial Dragons also routinely held 'native hunting' events, where they would go in and slaughter the natives of an island that was not affiliated with them for sport, along with numerous slaves.
The Celestial Dragons had also long held a monopoly on certain rights and privileges, such as being able to travel wherever they wanted in the world with little to no regard for the dangers involved, and living atop the Red Line in the Holy City. By opening up the oceans, Alex had granted them all the freedom to open trade and travel with one another. Plus he intended to open up the new holy city, Nautica, to all who wished to live there.
Alex gave them a moment to discuss amongst themselves, before he continued, "additionally, Nautica will also be home to the gate that will connect this world to my own world, Asora. From there I will continue my role as emperor with this world becoming one of my own territories, as is my right through conquest. If there are any who would challenge my rule, then speak now or forever hold your peace."
Naturally no one spoke up, as every single one of those gathered here had either sworn themselves to Alex to begin with, or they were kings/queens that rose to power in the last few days after Alex's people incited rebellion against their tyrannical rulers. Even the much feared Revolutionary Army couldn't hold a candle to the amount of change Alex had wrought upon the world, and they had YET to make a single move despite everything Alex had done.
"We came all this way to meet with the sun god." Declared a booming voice as one of the few hulking figures within the palace stepped forward, a giant. "We have always followed the sun god's teachings, and will continue to do so even now. The land and people of Elbaf are yours, Lord Nika."
As he spoke the giant knelt before Alex, pledging his fealty while the few other giants present did the same. At the same time, another banner appeared overhead that bore the sigil of Elbaf.
