"So are you actually trying to take over the world?" Asked another voice, belonging to one of the only two people not fighting, Saitama and Genos.
"I don't want to. But my wives and people are pretty fanatical about spreading my influence. Even if I didn't do this now, some of them would still find ways to increase my influence within your world while also building my wealth, until I was effectively your ruler regardless. I'm just expediting the process while also providing some entertainment."
As Alex said that, Moka delivered a heel-drop right in front of Tank Top Master that missed his body, but shredded his tank top and split the ground beneath them.
*SHHHHHHHRRRRR!*
A terrible tearing noise filled the air as a chasm opened up in the ground beneath them from her attack, of which Moka stood on one side while Tank Top Master collapsed on the other, completely pale as he held the shredded remnants of his tank top in his hands.
"Let's see you get through MY muscles!" Darkshine declared as he rushed Moka, completely confident that the conditioning of his body would defend against her attacks.
"Hmph. Know your place." Moka sneered at him as she spun around, and planted her foot right in the middle of his chest with her full force.
Normally this would be enough for her to reduce anyone to a mere red stain on the surrounding rocks. But, since they didn't come here to actually kill anyone, Alex used his own abilities to stealthily hold Darkshine together as the speedo-clad hero was sent flying back into the mountain range behind him, a hundred miles away.
What neither Alex nor Moka knew was that, with Darkshine still experiencing the pain of Moka's attack, all of his will as a hero was shattered permanently. After today, the S-Class hero would never fight on behalf of humanity ever again.
Tank Top Mater however was charging against Moka while wearing a brand new tank top, incised that she had apparently shredded his favorite one.
Meanwhile Flashy Flash was having a horrible time against the pony-tailed girl as they traded hundreds of blows within a matter of three seconds. Each one was him trying to get through her defenses, and each time she casually deflected his blade as if it were the easiest thing in the world.
Seeing this was going nowhere, Shizuku decided to end the fight as she flashed forward suddenly with her tantō, slicing cleanly through ALL of Flash's equipment as she did so.
His prided sword, armor, clothes, and even hair all fell to Flash's feet in a pile of scrap, leaving him naked and disarmed in the middle of the battlefield.
"This is my win." Shizuku stated as she dispelled her tantō, while Flash glared at her irritably.
"I'm a hero. This isn't over until either you kill me, or I kill you." He stated defiantly while kneeling down to collect the pieces of his armor and sword, not out of sentimentality, but to use as weapons if need be.
"Haaa... If you insist." Shizuku answered as she conjured a length of near invisible wire from her inventory.
The next thing Flash knew, he was tied up in an embarrassing pose that left him completely exposed to both the heroes and women around them, and the cameras, while Shizuku casually sauntered back to Alex's side.
"Do you think I went a little too far?" She asked Alex worriedly while glancing back at Flash.
"Nah. The main point of this is to show off how strong we are, and to give their egos a reality check." Alex said without concern, before sipping some more of the wine Grayfia brought him.
He then turned his attention towards Yuna, who was fighting both Metal Bat and Watchdog Man at the same time, alternating between the Berserker and Yankee Dresspheres as she did so.
As a Berserker Yuna was dressed in numerous animal pelts that came complete with several horns and fangs, while actual claws adorned her hands and feet. In her Yankee attire though, Yuna was wearing a school uniform jacket that hung from her shoulders, while a band of cloth was all that covered her breasts and a long skirt covered her legs all the way down to the ankle.
In her hands was a wooden bokkon,which more than made up for its lack of an edge through durability and strength. Enough so that Yuna was leaving numerous dents all over Metal Bat's metal bat, easily warping beyond recognition.
The only problem Yuna had with the Yankee Dressphere was that it did not give her any panties beneath her skirt. Instead, all she received a single bandaid for some reason.
Even as Yuna handled her two S-Class opponents with ease, Child Emperor was currently curled up in the fetal position as he faced his first ever existential crisis, courtesy of his own opponent. Lala.
No matter what inventions he tried to use to defeat her, Lala would simply use the power of her Gasha Gasha no Mi to disassemble them in order to see how they worked, before reassembling them with her own modifications and improvements. All while talking to Child Emperor and making her own suggestions about future inventions.
Child Emperor was easily one of, if not THE smartest person on the planet when you take his age into consideration.
When also taking into consideration his numerous roles within the organization in analyzing monsters, toxins, upgrading their software and tech, and his own numerous gadgets that he employs when he does go out into the field, Child Emperor was also one of the most important amongst the S-Class heroes alongside Metal Knight.
However he was now calling EVERYTHING he had ever done into question thanks to the pink-haired monster before him.
"What was it all for? What was it all for? What was it all for?" He muttered over and over again, recalling as he did so the numerous advancements he'd made over the years, the innumerable hours and days he'd spent going to cram school, and all of his efforts as a hero.
*Clang!*
*Clang!*
*Clang!*
In another area, Atomic Samurai was busy trying to get through the defence of a scarlet-haired woman attired in a pair of loose-fitting pants with flames embroidered on them, and a band around her breasts while she welded a pair of regular katanas. Erza Scarlet.
No matter what he did though he could not get through at her, all while Erza merely used a single one of her katana to deflect his attacks with no visible effort.
'This woman...' Atomic Samurai thought to himself as she deflected his latest attack with the very tip of her blade.
'I cannot even break through her defenses... Is there anyone amongst the swords masters who would be able to?!'
The woman before Atomic Samurai felt like an unscalable mountain, one whose peak resided within the very clouds with sheer cliffs that were impossible to climb.
"It is time to end this." Erza stated suddenly, drawing him out of his thoughts as both of her katanas disappeared.
Atomic Samurai's first thought was that she was saying that she didn't need them to fight against him. But then another blade appeared in her grip, another katana by the looks of it, one that was significantly longer and was sheathed in an ornate fur sheath.
"One attack each." Erza declared as she held the sheath in one hand to her side, and placed the other on the hilt of the katana. It was the perfect stance for an Iaido.
"Very well." Atomic Samurai responded, sheathing his own katana and getting into a stance that mirrored hers.
Iaido was a technique that sacrificed defence for one instantaneous attack. If he was going to be able to defeat her, this was his chance to.
For a beat neither of them moved, even as numerous battles raged around them. Then...
"..."
Without Atomic Samurai even realizing it, Erza appeared behind him instantly with such speed that she had left an after image in her original place.
"Guh..." He groaned weakly, blood trickling from his mouth, before the samurai dropped to the ground as numerous slashes appeared throughout his body.
Upon her opponent's defeat, Erza reverted to her usual armor/skirted attire and slowly walked back to her Lord's side, her eyes sweeping the battlefield as she did so. For the greatest defenders this world could muster, the majority of S-Class seemed pathetically weak to her.
The man known as Zombieman for example appeared to just be an ordinary man, who possessed the ability to regenerate infinitely so he could continuously fight regardless of his injuries. Yet Yami had him tied up by the strands of her hair to immobilize him.
Puri Puri Prisoner seemed like a titanic hulk with strength akin to a Rook, except Yami also took care of him almost instantaneously due to his perverseness. All she needed to do was hit him a few times with her hair transformed into fists.
Kurumu was fighting the one known as Sweet Mask, and now had him crawling on the ground begging for mercy after conjuring an illusion of the most grotesque and ugly thing Erza had ever seen.
Lucy was walking away from a defeated Pig God, a man who could seemingly eat anything and everything. Only she had summoned Ifrit to roast the man alive to the point of unconsciousness.
That just left Bang and Tatsumaki, who was only fighting them to say she also participated at Alex's request.
Bang was doing....surprisingly well for a regular human at his age. Then again, Shia WAS holding back by not fighting against him directly.
Instead, the bunny-girl was picking up handfuls of Martian sand and throwing them at Bang while using the power of her Moa Moa no Mi. Not only did this increase each grain of sand to the size of cannonballs, but it also increased their speed by a hundred times.
On the receiving end, Bang's hands were moving as fast as he could make them as he used his Fist of Flowing Water Crushing Rock to divert the enhanced grains of sand. He was succeeding so far, but his energy was not limitless while his hands were also sustaining significant damage the longer he kept this up.
On her end, Tatsumaki was starting to struggle as she battled against Yue in a match of Telekinesis versus magic.
Yue when Alex met her was already a force to be reckoned with due to her immortality, significant mana pool, and ability to use all forms of magic from her home world, Tortus.
Now however, her abilities could be considered on the cusp of divine due to not only drinking Alex's blood every day, receiving his Bishop piece, and gaining access to his status/job system, but also because she had recently received the Vampire Progenitor Bloodline from Alex upon his return from the HOTD world.
Tatsumaki on the other hand had not fought against an evenly matched opponent for several years, let alone someone who so obviously outclassed her.
Even as Tatsumaki created several tornadoes, moved entire mountains, and pulled Continental sized meteors from space onto her, Yue dealt with them all with ease of swatting a bug. And the more she pushed herself, the faster Tatsumaki was exhausting herself at the same time due to being unused to using so much of her power at once.
"Sleep..." Yue then said, her hypnotic voice echoing throughout the battlefield as not just Tatsumaki, but every single S-Class hero present that was still awake collapsed into a deep slumber.
Even King, who had slipped away unnoticed by his fellow heroes, and was hiding behind some boulders in fear.
"All the S-Class heroes....have been defeated." Genos stated in a factual tone, though there was obvious shock there as well.
"Well, not ALL of them." Alex stated, even as the petite Yue approached him, before climbing into his lap and straddling him as she sank her fangs into his neck.
"There's still Metal Knight and Drive Knight to consider, on top of the number one, Blast. But even if they HAD been here it would have made no difference." He continued as if he didn't have a certain vampiress sitting in his lap and sucking his blood while grinding her hips against his suggestively.
Even as he said that, Alex looked up suddenly as he sensed something occurring back on earth.
"Tch. And now they appear." Alex snorted irritably.
Understandably, the people of earth had grown terrified upon seeing their greatest heroes being defeated one after the other, all while their opponents didn't even appear winded from their respective battles. And at the same time, the Hero Association was desperately trying to control the situation while also trying to mobilize the aforementioned Metal Knight and Drive Knight, along with contacting Blast.
Unfortunately for them, the people of earth weren't the only ones watching the broadcast that Alex had aired.
Upon seeing the defeat of the S-Class heroes, numerous hidden factions of nonhumans had started to mobilize in a bid for global dominance.
From the oceans, thousands of aquatic figures were rising on behalf of their liege, the Deep Sea King, in a bid to take control of the surface world as well as the oceans.
From the skies, an army of winged figures were descending on behalf of the Sky King to also stake their claim up on the surface world.
Most frighteningly though, was the fact that hundreds of monsters were also flooding the streets from underground access points in a coordinated effort against the remaining heroes, especially A-Class.
They were the Monster Association.
The Monster Association was a group of monsters that organized in an attempt to defeat the hated S-Class heroes and show the humans their rightful place, as nothing more than their cattle.
Terror spread throughout the entire world as all three groups appeared simultaneously, their primary goal being the destruction of the Heroes Association now that the S-Class heroes were no longer available.
"You've got to be kidding me..." Alex groaned irritably as his fun was interrupted, and he waved his hand impatiently as each of the S-Class heroes suddenly awoke while being filled with vigor, and their injuries healed.
"Huh? What happened?" Bang muttered as he awoke, before his gaze landed on Alex.
"YOU-!"
"We don't have the time right now." Alex cut him off impatiently as any other sounds that would have come out of Bang's mouth were silenced.
"The earth is under attack right now by three different groups of monsters."
"""!!!"""
Anything anyone else was about to say was silenced as they all locked in from what Alex told them. Well, all of them but King and Darkshine, while Child Emperor still appeared dispirited from facing Lala earlier.
"Now when I said I wanted to take over the earth, I was kidding. I mean, it'll probably happen, but I'm not that interested in doing so. I only said that to get you all to fight against us seriously.
"Now however you all need to lock in here and deal with this. I'll send you all back right now, and even give some of you some equipment that is even better than the stuff you were using before."
Even as Alex continued speaking, said equipment appeared out of thin air in front of Metal Bat and Flashy Flash, equipment that was far superior to anything they had used before.
"Alright, now I'll scatter each of you across the world so that you get right to it. NOW!"
The second he finished speaking, Alex conjured a Gate for each of the S-Class heroes that transported them randomly throughout the world, allowing them to start fighting the rampant monsters as soon as they arrived.
He also sent back the Association employees, and the other exam takers that he had brought with them.
"Us too?" Shizuku asked curiously as she and the other girls crowded around Alex.
"Of course. This is another chance for us to show off how strong we are." Alex answered as if it were only natural. He then opened the Chatroom while Gating them to earth as well.
[DING!
Alex: exp farming event going on now! Get them while they're hot!]
The second Alex sent that message to the Chatroom, nearly all of the women connected to it began to mobilize as they rushed to try and get as much exp for their respective Jobs as possible. And leading the charge was both Hancock and Azula, the two of them competing to outdo the other.
"What about us?" Saitama asked, making Alex look up from the numerous responses he was receiving from the announcement. Now it was just him, Alex, and Genos present on Mars.
"Well, I can send Genos as well if he wants to participate. But I have some business with you." Alex said as he put his full attention on the baldy.
"I would like to go and help the others, if that is ok with you Master." Genos immediately decided.
"Sure. Knock yourself out." Saitama readily replied, and Genos promptly vanished as Alex used another Gate on him.
"So, what do you want with me? And are you sure they can handle all of that by themselves?" Saitama asked casually, as if earth wasn't currently facing an apocalyptic event.
Then again, if he NEEDED to fight, then Saitama could just launch himself through space to get back. It might take him a few minutes, but Saitama was sure he could aim properly as he glanced at the tiny dot that was the earth.
"I want to fight you of course." Alex stated as if it were obvious.
"Oh?" Saitama muttered while cocking a brow. "Should we really be doing that right now?"
"They're fine. I have complete trust in my wives to deal with whatever comes up while we're busy. And if they can't, I'll know and will drop the fight to go help them. So what do you say?"
"Hmm..."
Saitama hummed as he contemplated Alex's offer for a moment.
Truthfully, he was interested in fighting Alex after seeing what he could do during their entrance examination. But, he had also learned after numerous disappointments not to get his hopes up about finding a good challenge.
Saitama had met numerous monsters that would go on and on about how strong and unbeatable they were, only for him to punch them once and turn them into paste. It made the fights boring, and he had ended up losing a lot of the excitement that came with the early battles from when he first started as a hero.
"How about this." Alex suddenly said, making Saitama look up at him. "Give me a serious punch, just one. And if I survive, then we'll have our fight."
"And if I accidentally kill you?"
"Don't worry, I won't die even if I'm killed. So how about it?"
"..."
Saitama continued looking Alex up and down as he considered the proposal of a fight between the two of them, before making his decision.
"..."
"!!!"
Even as his Observation Haki went off, Alex was unable to even consider dodging as Saitama suddenly appeared before him, his fist a mere inch away from his face.
"Semi-Serious Series: Semi-Serious Punch."
The next thing Alex knew something had hit him right in the middle of his face, and he was flying backwards before crashing into a mountain. And then another. And then a third. And a fourth.
It was only a few mountains later that Alex finally came to a stop, buried halfway through it with blood gushing from his broken nose as he tried to blink away the tears.
"Dafuq?! He didn't even use any Haki!" Alex sputtered in disbelief, even as he healed his nose and focused on the exact spot where Saitama was still standing.
"To break the nose of a man who's made of rubber.... How exciting!" Alex declared before he launched his counter attack.
"Well, I guess that was it...." Saitama muttered dejectedly as Alex flew away, feeling foolish that he had, once again, gotten his hopes up.
He then turned around and prepared to launch himself back to earth, when he sensed something behind him.
"..."
"!!!"
Turning around, Saitama was greeted with sight of a fist that was less than an inch away from his face, before it hit him on the jaw.
Sound couldn't even keep up as Saitama was sent flying away from the force of Alex's punch, far enough that he actually exited Mars' atmosphere and crashed into a whole different terrestrial body. Phobos, the largest of Mars' two moons.
Buried deep within the moon, which had been launched out of Mars' orbit by his hit, Saitama tasted and felt something in his mouth that was unfamiliar, until he spat it out and saw his own tooth and blood.
'Blood...?' Saitama though, his mind stalling slightly as he looked at the red substance.
'When did I last see my own blood?'
Saitama's mind reeled as he came to terms with the pain in his jaw, which was possibly fractured, the tooth he had just lost, and the blood that he could taste and now see with his own eyes.
'I'm bleeding...'
'I'm bleeding!'
'I'M BLEEDING!'
A massive grin appeared on Saitama's face as he realized that, for the first time in a long time, someone had actually managed to injure him.
There was no hesitation in his actions as he readily shattered Phobos, sending chunks of the moon flying in every direction throughout space, and kicked the empty space behind him with enough force that he launched himself back to Mars to continue his battle with Alex.

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - 596: Hero Association Desperation
chapters.content:
"KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!"
Screams could be heard amidst the blaring sirens as monsters flooded the street. Literally.
"BWAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! That's right, FLEE you insignificant insects! I am the DEEP SEA KING! Ruler of the sea, which is the origin of all life on this planet! That makes me the pinnacle of all life, and the rightful ruler of you worms!" Declared the monster leading the swarm coming from the oceans.
Thousands were following the Deep Sea King's lead onto the land, creatures that were twisted into beings like they had crawled out of some Lovecraftian horror novel. And it wasn't just here in J-City.
Every single city that bordered on the ocean was being attacked by the armies of the deep at the same time. And to bolster the aquatic forces that were attacking, the ocean tides were rising at record paces to seemingly wash away the city, and sheets of rain fell from the sky to drench everything. Despite being out of water, the Deep Sea King and his armies were not inconvenienced in the slightest.
They were even casually scrolling through the city as they invaded it, not at all concerned by the prospect of heroes or other monsters. After all, they were the pinnacle of existence! What did THEY have to fear?
"RUN AWAY!"
Panic filled the streets at the Deep Sea King's approach, and people hurriedly fled to the nearest emergency shelter where they believed they would be safe. Everyone, but the heroes.
Though they were terrified, though they knew that they would potentially die against this enemy, almost every hero in the world had rallied to fight against these impossibly powered monsters after watching the S-Class being defeated.
Of those that hadn't been defeated along with the others, both Drive Knight and Metal Knight were also fighting against the hordes of monsters. But they alone could not turn the tides of battle.
*BOOM!*
One of the heroes fighting, an older man dressed in a snakeskin suit, was then sent flying by one of the vanguards of the Deep Sea King.
"BWAHAHAHA! You insignificant pests are NOTHING before the might of the Lord Great White!" Roared a massive great white shark, one with lethal and powerful clawed arms.
"SNEK!" Cried out one of the heroes as he looked back at his fallen comrade.
"Do you really think you have time to be worrying about others?" Sneered a voice that sent chills down his back, before numerous slimy appendages shot forward to wrap around him.
"Guh!" The hero, Lightning Max, cried out as he was tightly squeezed by the tentacles that had captured him.
"You shall make a fine snack." Hissed the monster that had caught him, a creature that could only be described through the numerous myths and legends that had plagued seafarers for all of human history. The kraken.
"Bon appetit." The kraken hissed as it lifted Lightning Max up over its beaked mouth, preparing to swallow him whole.
"No..."
"No!"
"NOOOOOOOO!"
"..."
Just as he was about to be swallowed whole, the kraken suddenly dropped him as its entire body was vaporized.
"Kuh! Huh?" Max grunted, before uttering in confusion that he was still alive, and his opponent was now dead.
"What.....just happened?" He muttered in his confusion, before a soft sound permeated the rain and battlefield.
*Pa*
*Pa.*
*Pa*
Looking up, Lightning Max found himself staring at a beautiful and petite young girl.
She had long dark blue hair that clung to her body in the rain, along with the sundress she was wearing. She was also barefoot, which was the sound he had heard as her feet padded against the wet pavement of the road.
"Are you ok?" The girl asked with the most beautiful voice he had ever heard as she knelt down beside him, her beautiful and delicate features etched with worry over his wellbeing.
"S-somehow..." Lightning Max answered, just barely being able to get the word out as his breath caught in his throat. But then realization struck him.
"You need to get out of here! Quickly! Before the monsters get you!" He yelled, worried about her safety.
"I'll be ok. I am strong." She stated with a warm smile, before standing once more as she continued approaching the Deep Sea King.
The girl ignored the fighting going on around her as she approached the tyrannical and imposing monarch, who focused his attention on her as he knelt down to get closer to her level.
"I smell the sea on you." He stated in observation.
"Indeed. We are both beings who trace our origins to the sea. It is for that reason that I will give you one chance. Take your forces, return to the sea, and swear you will never attack the surface again. Do this, and I promise that I will not destroy you or your people."
"""..."""
Silence descended upon the battlefield, as monster and hero alike looked at her like she was crazy.
"Pft..."
"BWAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!"
The Deep Sea King roared with laughter at the outrageous demand and claim made by the little girl, followed by his subordinates as they struggled to even remain standing.
"HAHAHAHA! Do YOU, little human, truly believe that YOU can defeat ME?! Let alone all of US?!" The Deep Sea King sneered down at her in contempt.
"If you continue waging war against the humans, then I will be forced to." She replied, her tone saddened by the fact.
"I THINK I'LL TAKE MY CHANCES!" The Deep Sea King roared as he swung his massive fist down at her, intending to turn her into paste in an instant. After all, she was so small that she wouldn't even make a proper meal.
"Ahhhhhhh~!"
Before his fist could meet her though, the girl opened her mouth and began to vocalize the most beautiful, harmonious voice any of them had ever heard, while a pair of pure white feathery wings sprouted from her back.
Lightning Max, Stinger, even Snek, who was barely conscious, were all instantly reduced to tears upon hearing her voice and seeing her form. And as for the Deep Sea King and his army...
The moment she opened her mouth, the Deep Sea King and his army were instantly obliterated, to the point that not even a stain remained on the street or buildings. At the same time, the skies overhead began to clear, and the wounds the heroes had accumulated during their fight had started to rapidly heal.
"It's an angel... An angel has come to save us!" One of the nearby civilians shouted as they, and the others that had been unable to make it to the shelter, started coming out of hiding.
"I am no angel." The girl said, even as her song lingered in the air and the clouds parted to shine a ray of light down upon her.
"I am San Otonashi, a siren. In other words, I am a monster."
***
"How can this happen...?" Muttered Sitch, one of the officials of the Hero Association, as he watched the chaos unfold within their headquarters.
In every single city across the world, monsters were attacking in unprecedented numbers as they worked towards an obvious goal, the total annihilation or subjugation of the human race.
Monitors and screens flashed while sirens blared as the coordinators within the Hero Association struggled to keep up with the overwhelming amount of information flooding in, as well as coordinating with the heroes themselves in an effort to protect the people and fight back against the seemingly endless hordes of monsters.
"SIR! I've just received word from Lightning Max that the Deep Sea King has just been defeated along with his army that was attacking J-City! We've also received reports that the sea level is starting to recede, and the storm that had been strengthening them is subsiding!"
A cheer went up at the news as everyone grew relieved. After all, the Deep Sea King and his soldiers were one of the bigger factions attacking at the moment, only losing out to the Monster Association.
"Who did it? Which of the heroes delivered the killing blow? Send word to the upper brass immediately along with a recommendation for an immediate promotion to S-Class!" Sitch declared, while also making arrangements for the victory to be announced over the world. After all. Even if it was just one victory, it could help build the momentum needed to push back against the hordes of monsters that were threatening them.
"U-um... None of them, sir..." The coordinator hesitantly said, bringing the celebrations to a halt.
"What did you say?" Sitch asked her.
"None of the heroes defeated the Deep Sea King. It was HER."
As she said that, the coordinator played the clip featuring the death of the Deep Sea King, in which he and his entire army was obliterated by a single woman the second she opened her mouth. A breathtakingly beautiful woman, with pure white angelic wings. But her first words after defeating the Deep Sea King made all of their blood run cold.
"I am San Otonashi, a siren. In other words, I am a monster."
A monster.
Those words rang through their heads and poured freezing water onto their celebrations as they all truly realized what she was saying. And not only that...
"L-look!" One of the coordinators exclaimed as they pulled up the recorded image of the earlier broadcast, the one in which the man responsible for this, the Dragon Emperor, announced his wives. It was undeniably the same woman who was standing there amongst them.
"W-what do we do sir?" One of the men asked as they all looked to Sitch for answers.
"Isn't it obvious?" Asked a new voice, one that was calm despite the disastrous situation that was occurring.
They all turned to see a man slowly approaching them, a man they all recognized due to his reputation within the Association, and the eye patch covering his left eye. McCoy.
"She claims to be a monster, and she is a direct subordinate of the Dragon Emperor responsible for this. I would even go as far as to say that he conspired with these monster forces for them to attack us after he dealt with the S-Class heroes.
"If they want to claim to be monsters, and align themselves with them as well, then it is only fair that we treat them as such. I believe a threat level Dragon will be adequate for her and the others following the Dragon Emperor. As for he himself? We shall honor him by giving him the highest threat level we possess, threat level God."
"McCoy!" Sitch exclaimed as the other man gave his orders, which were carried out with startling efficiency.
Almost immediately Lightning Max, Stinger, and Snek all received their orders to eliminate the threat level Dragon 'monster' before them, San Otanoshi, the Siren.
That was only the beginning.
In every city reports started pouring in along with the footage from their drones and cameras, that numerous non-human beings were fighting back against the attacking monsters. And most incredulously, they were actively protecting the people.
"Just who has the AUDACITY to stand against ME?" Demanded a beautiful woman with long black hair as she strutted up to one of the most troublesome monsters, Super-S.
Super-S had the appearance of a beautiful woman that was attired in black leather straps and metal spikes that showed off the majority of her body, but under the mask that covered her mouth she was undoubtedly a monster. Completing her dominatrix persona was the long spiky whip that she held in her hands, which would turn those struck with it into her devoted 'love slaves'.
It was for this reason that she was given the danger level of Demon, as she could swifty turn those sent to combat her into her own personal army to take over entire cities.
As for the beautiful woman standing against her, the Hero Association had already confirmed she was one of the people sent by the Dragon Emperor along with all of those following her, a literal army of beautiful women that were capable of turning into large serpents.
Meanwhile, the Sky King and his army of avian monsters had been intercepted by a group of rabbit-eared beings that were darting through air as if they were dancing, allowing them to easily avoid the attacks of the Sky King and his people before they used a pair of dual swords to slice them into pieces.
The remnants of the Terror Lizard Clan, their ruler that was known only as the Ancient King, had also awakened to take this chance to take over the earth. Only it was promptly defeated at the hands of the people that the Dragon Emperor possessed, another rabbit-eared girl that was wielding a giant hammer.
One by one each group of monsters was readily dealt with with little to no known casualties, before they then proceeded to reverse death itself to bring back the people who had died.
Even the Monster Association was helpless against them, as the Monster King Orochi himself was easily dispatched by one of the girls, the crimson haired seductress that had been introduced as Rias Gremory.
"There is no reason to even debate this! Monsters, the lot of them! Assign them disaster levels that are appropriate!" McCoy declared, even as the emergencies passed as they were eliminated bit by bit.
Except none of the heroes were willing to attack the ones who had just saved them.
"This is a bit excessive, don't you think?" A voice declared over their intercoms that shocked everyone.
"Silver Fang?!"
"In the flesh!" The number three hero declared as he appeared on their screens, before he personally dispatched numerous monsters near-instaniously.
"Humph! And you worthless A-Classers want to try and show US up? ID~IOTS!" Declared another new voice as Tatsumaki reappeared as well, just in time to kill a massive octopus monster by crushing it with her telepathic abilities.
Not just the two of them, but all the other S-Class heroes had also reappeared(except Darkshine), joining the battle as they fought to keep the people safe from the rampaging monsters.
"I-I don't understand?!" Sitch uttered in disbelief, while McCoy's solitary eye widened in shock.
